tei:titleStmt.tei:title: ༄༅/ /phyag rgya chen po lhan cig skyes sbyor gyi dngos gzhi'i khrid yig zab don rgya mtsho'i lam tshang
༄༅/ /phyag rgya chen po lhan cig skyes sbyor gyi dngos gzhi'i khrid yig zab don rgya mtsho'i lam tshang

tei:div.tei:p: "$ ༄༅// phyag rgya chen po lhan cig skyes sbyor gyi dngos gzhi'i khrid yig zab don rgya mtsho'i lam tshang

bla na med pa zhes bya ba bzhugs so// ༄༅// bka' brgyud rin po che ye thog sangs rgyas chos sku kun tu bzang*// nges pa lnga ldan longs sku rdo rje 'chang*// bcu gnyis mdzad ston mchog sprul thub pa'i dbang*// ngo bo nyid sku dpal ldan pad+ma skyes// sangs rgyas nyag gcig brgyud pa'i rje btsun tshogs// bka' drin mnyam med rtsa ba'i bla ma'i zhabs// dkon mchog rtsa gsum skyabs gnas rdzogs par 'dud// mkha' mnyam 'gro kun rnam grol byin gyis rlobs// 'dir shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i brjod don 'chad pa'i gzhung lugs rgya bod du byon pa'i paṇa grub ji snyed pas bkral ba la bsam gyis mi khyab kyang*/ gangs can 'dir rang gzhan gyi grub mtha' smra ba'i mkhas grub mang pos/ gdul bya mchog gi skal ba can rnams la legs par 'doms pa'i man ngag chen po rnam gsum du grags pa'i nang tshan nas/ phyag rgya chen po lhan cig skyes sbyor gyi dngos gzhi'i khrid rim zab don rgya mtsho'i lam tshang bla na med pa nyid kyi tshul mdo tsam zhig brjod par bya ba las/ gang zhig skal ldan gyi skyes bu rnams tshe gcig gis byang chub/ 'bras bu rang rig gzhi thog las bsgrub par 'dun pa rnams kyis ni/ lam thams cad kyi snying po'i yang snying nges don zab mo bla na med pa 'di nyid la 'jug cing yang dag par nyams su len par bya dgos pa'o// de la tshul bshad bya tha snyad kyi brda dang sdeb sbyor gtso bor byas na phal cher gyis cung zad go dka' bar dogs pas go bde'i tshul du bshad par bya ba 'di bzhin yin/ de la dang po sngon du 'gro ba'i rim pa/ gnyis pa dngos gzhi'i rim pa/ gsum pa rjes kyi rim pa dang gsum mo// dang po sngon du 'gro ba'i rim pa la'ang spyir bshad pa dang*/ bye brag gi nyams len bshad pa gnyis/ dang po spyir bshad pa la/ dang po chos thams cad rang gi sems su bstan pa/ gnyis pa sems don ma bsgom pa'i skyon dang nyes pa bshad pa/

gsum pa bsgom pa'i phan yon bshad pa dang rnam pa gsum mo/ dang po chos thams cad rang gi sems su bstan pa ni/ de yang spyir snang srid 'khor 'das kyis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad rang gi sems yin te/ sa bcu pa'i mdo las/ kye rgyal ba'i sras dag /khams gsum po 'di dag ni sems tsam mo// zhes dang*/ gur las/ rin chen sems las phyir gyur pa'i// sems can med cing sangs rgyas med// ces dang*/ sam bu ṭi las/ phyi dang nang gi bdag nyid can// 'di dag thams cad sems kyis btags// sems las ma gtogs pa nyid ni// gzhan du yod pa ma yin no// zhes dang*/ ri khrod dbang phyug gis/ chos rnams thams cad rang gi sems yin te// sems las ma gtogs chos gzhan rdul tsam med// ces so// de ltar yin na phyi rol du gzung ba'i yul gzugs sgra la sogs pa'i dngos por snang ba 'di ji ltar yin zhe na/ sems nyid rang gis rang gi gnas lugs ma rig par thog ma med pa nas/ bdag gzhan gnyis su snang bar gyur cing*/ phyi'i rten 'brel sa bon gyi rgyu dang 'brel pa myu gu nas 'bras bu'i bar gyis bsdus pa/ rkyen dang 'brel ba'i chos 'byung lnga dus kyi 'gyur ba dang bcas pas bskyed pa lta bu dang*/ nang gi rten 'brel ma rig pa nas rga shi'i bar gyis bsdus pa lta bur phyi nang gnyis su bar med par shing rta'i 'khor lo ltar 'khor te/ der 'dzin pa'i rtog pa bag chags bsags pas 'khrul ngor phyi rol gyi don du snang ba ste/ lang gshegs las/ bag chags kyis ni dkrugs pa'i sems// don du snang ba rab tu byung*// don yod ma yin sems nyid de// phyi rol don mthong log pa yin// zhes dang*/ saṃ ṭir/ chos rnams sems kyi 'khrul pa ste// sems las ma gtogs chos rnams med// chos su snang ba 'khrul pa'i sems// zhes so// de yang dper na/ sgyu ma mkhan pos sprul pa'i rta glang la sogs pa gdod ma nas rta glang gi rang bzhin ni ngo bor grub pa med kyang*/

rta glang du bsnyon pa med par snang ba ltar/ sems 'khrul pa'i bag chags brtas pa las phyi rol gyi dngos po sna tshogs su snang ba ste/ ting 'dzin rgyal por/ sgyu ma byed pa dag gis gzugs sprul te// rta dang glang po shing rta sna tshogs byas// de la ji bzhin snang ba gang yang med// chos rnams thams cad de bzhin shes par gyis// zhes pa ltar ro// 'o na sems nyid 'khor 'das su 'gyur tshul ji lta bu snyam na/ rang sems 'di nyid rang gis rang ngo ma shes/ rang rig rang tsho ma zin/ 'khrul pa yang 'khrul nying 'khrul du shor bas 'khor bar 'khyams pa yin la/ de ltar min pas rang sems 'di rang gis ngo shes/ rang rig rang tsho tshugs/ 'khrul pa med pa'i dag pa chos nyid/ rang gis rang rig pa ni sangs rgyas pa yin pas/ don du sems las ma gtogs 'khor 'das ci yang med ces/ o rgyan rin po ches gsungs pa ltar yin pas/ srid zhi'i byed po thams cad rang gi rig pa 'di nyid yin pa las/ de ltar 'khor 'das rtsa ba sems yin/ 'khor 'das kyi rtsa ba sems yin phyin chad rang gi sems 'dul ba gal du che ba ni/ dper bgyis na/ mar 'don tshe mar gyi rgyu 'o ma dkrogs na mar yong la/ de min chu dkrogs pas mar mi yong ba bzhin/ rang nyid sangs rgyas kyi 'bras bu bsgrub pa na sangs rgyas kyi rgyur gyur pa rang sems kyi dri ma sbyangs pas 'bras bu thob pa yin ma gtogs chu dkrogs pas mar mi yong ba bzhin/ kha phyi la bltas pas nang don gyi 'bras bu 'grub pa min par shes dgos te/ brtag gnyis las/ rmongs phyir 'khor ba'i gzugs can nyid// rmongs med 'khor ba dag pas ni// 'khor ba mya ngan 'das par 'gyur// zhes dang*/ klu sgrub kyis/ gang zhig 'khor ba'i rgyur gyur pa// de nyid sbyangs pa byas pa las// dag pa de nyid mya ngan 'das// zhes gsungs so// de ltar skyon yon thams cad kyi rtsa ba sems kyis byas pa'am/

sems kyi rgyu las byung ba'am/ sems las shar ba yin te/ lang gshegs las/ me long la ni gzugs snang yang*/ yod pa min par snang ba ltar// sems kyi snang bar ma shes par// rnam par rtog pa gnyis su skye// rnam rtog bag chags 'brel ba yis// sna tshogs sems las byung ba yi// mi rnams la ni phyir rol snang*// 'jig rten pa yi sems tsam mo// phyi rol snang ba yang med de// sems ni sna tshogs rnams su shar// lus la longs spyod gnas 'dra ba// sems tsam du ni ngas bshad do// zhes dang*/ phal po cher/ sems ni ri mo mkhan dang 'dra// sems kyis phung po byas pa ste// 'jig rten khams ni ji snyed pa// de snyed thams cad sems kyis bris// zhes dang*/ dkon mchog sprin las/ 'jig rten sems kyis khrid pa ste// sems kyis sems ni mi mthong ngo*// dge ba'am ni mi dge ba'i// las ni sems kyis bsags pa yin// sems ni mgal me bzhin du 'khor// sems ni rlabs dang 'dra bar g.yo// sems ni nags kyi me bzhin bsreg /sems ni chu chen bzhin du bskyod// ces dang*/ gur las/ thog ma med pa'i srid gyur nas// phyi rol don du brtags pa ste// thams cad sems kyi rnam 'phrul zhing*// sems nyid kun tu song ba'o// zhes dang*/ sems las phyi rol 'gyur med de// gzugs sogs so sor snang ba rnams// sems 'di kho na snang ba yin// zhes gsungs pa ltar gyi don go zhing shes par byed dgos pa'o// gnyis pa sems don ma bsgoms pa'i skyon bshad pa ni/ yang dag pa'i don ma bsgoms na sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la zhugs nas dam pa'i chos la tshig tsam gyi thos bsam la sogs pa ci byas kyang gnas skabs kyi 'bras bu tsam las mthar thug pa'i rnam grol mi thob par dpe du ma'i sgo nas gsungs te/ sdong po bkod pa las// yang dag sangs rgyas bstan pa 'di// thos pa tsam gyis mi 'grub bo// dper na la la chu klung gis// stobs med nan gyis khyer ba dag

/skom nas shi bar gyur pa bzhin// ma bsgoms chos kyang de bzhin no// ji ltar 'gro ba mang po la// zas dang skom dag byin gyur kyang*// bdag ni bkres pas shi ba ltar// ma bsgoms chos kyang de bzhin no// ji ltar sman pa la la zhig /sman rnams thams cad bdog bzhin du// lto ba'i nad kyis shi ba ltar// chos la ma bsgoms de bzhin no// ji ltar dbyig gi mdzod dag tu// rin chen grangs mang bgrang byas kyang*// bdag gis gcig tsam mi thob pa// chos la ma bsgoms de bzhin no// ji ltar bde ba kun ldan pa'i// rgyal po'i pho brang 'khor skyes kyang*// zas dang skom dag mi bdog pa// ma bsgoms chos kyang de bzhin no// ji ltar dmus long ri mo mkhan// tshong 'dus dbus su 'brir bcug kyang*// bdag nyid kyis ni ma mthong bar// chos la ma bsgoms de bzhin no// ji ltar mtsho chen mnyan pa zhig /skye bo mang po sgrol byed kyang*// bdag nyid de nang 'chi ba ltar// ma bsgoms chos kyang de bzhin no// ji ltar lam gyi gzhi mdor yang*// phun sum tshogs pa kun brjod cing*// bdag gis thob par mi 'gyur ba// ma bsgoms chos kyang de bzhin no// zhes pa ltar ro// yang ma bsgoms na sems nyon mongs kyi dbang du yengs nas ngan 'gror ltung ste/ rnam par rol pa'i mdo las/ sems kyi rang bzhin ma rtogs na/ sems rnam par rtog pa'i kha thabs su song bas khams gsum du 'khor zhing rgyud drug tu 'khyams pa yin no// zhes dang*/ spyod 'jug las/ sems ni rnam par g.yeng ba'i mi// nyon mongs mche ba'i phrag na gnas// zhes dang*/ gang gis chos kyi gtso bo mchog /sems kyi gsang 'di ma shes na// bde thob sdug bsngal gzhom 'dod kyang*// de dag don med gyi nar 'khyams// zhes so// yang bsam gtan ma bsgoms na shes rab mi skye/ de ma skyes na byang chub mi thob ste/ bshes spring las/ bsam gtan med par yang ni shes rab med// ces so// des na tshul khrims la gnas pa dang thos bsam byed pa rnams kyang mthar sgom pa la sbyor ba'i phyir yin te/

mdzod las/ tshul gnas thos dang bsam ldan pa// sgom pa la ni rab tu sbyor// zhes sogs kyi lung don shin tu mang la dam pa'i chos tshig dang tha snyad spros bcas kyis g.yengs na dgos don mi 'grub pas/ zab mo'i gdams ngag sems thog tu nyams su len par dril dgos pa'o// gsum pa bsgom pa'i phan yon bshad pa ni/ yang dag pa'i don bsgom pa'i bsod nams ni dpag tu med de/ de kho na nyid bstan pa'i mdo las/ shā ri'i bu gang gis bskal pa gcig gi bar du nyan pa bas/ gang gis se gol gtog pa tsam gcig tu de kho na nyid kyi ting nge 'dzin bsgom pa bsod nams che'o// shā ri'i bu de lta bas na de kho na nyid kyi ting nge 'dzin 'di gzhan la nan gyis gdams par bya'o// zhes dang*/ gtsug tor chen po'i mdo las/ bskal pa mang por thos pa dang bsam pa bas ni nyin gcig chos nyid kyi don bsgom pa bsod nams che'o// de ci'i phyir zhe na/ des skye 'chi'i lam dang ring du 'bral bar byed pa'i phyir ro// zhes dang*/ rtogs pa rgyas pa'i mdo las/ thang gcig bsam gtan thun zhugs na// khams gsum gang ba'i mi rnams la// srog sbyin pas ni 'di don che// zhes dang*/ dam pa 'jug pa'i mdo las/ khams gsum gyi sems can thams cad la ji srid 'tsho'i bar du/ 'tsho ba'i yo byad kyis tshogs bsags pa bas/ gang rnal 'byor la spyod pa'i byang chub sems dpas se gol gtog pa tsam zhig gi ting nge 'dzin bsgoms pa de nyid bsod nams che'o// zhes dang*/ rnga can gyi mdo las/ gang gis sangs rgyas bsgrub par 'dod pa des thog mar gcig bsgrub par bya'o// gcig bsgrub pa gang zhe na/ sems nyid kyi don bsgom pa'o// gcig bsgrub pas mthar chos so cog thams cad kyi rten tshugs pa yin no// des ni chos thams cad kyi don shes par 'gyur ro// zhes dang*/ gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab ba'i mdo las/ byang chub sems dpa' myur du bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub thob par 'dod pas tshig lhur blang bar mi bya ste/

byang chub kyi lam la slob par 'dod pas sgrub pa lhur blang bar bya'o// de ci'i phyir zhe na tshig gis bskal pa'i bar du byang chub thob pa med la/ don rtogs pas skad cig gis grol bar 'gyur ro// zhes dang*/ gtsug tor dkar mo'i mdo las/ gang gis rdul snyed kyi bskal par mdo sde rnams 'bri zhing klog la kha ton du byed pa bas/ tha na nyi ma gcig tsam du zag pa med pa'i shes rab bsgoms na snga ma de las bsod nams dpag tu med pa bskyed cing che'o// zhes dang*/ laṅkar gshegs pa las/ mang du thos pa zhes pa ni don la mkhas pa yin gyis/ tshig la mkhas pa min no// zhes dang*/ ting 'dzin rgyal po las/ phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten khams dag tu// nga yis mdo sde gang bshad pa// tshig 'bru tha dad don gcig ste// thams cad brjod par nus ma yin// tshig gcig rnam par bsgom na ni// de dag thams cad bsgom par 'gyur// zhes dang*/ gzhan yang ting 'dzin bsgom pas 'dod yon la zhen pa bzlog pa dang the tshom gyi gnas rnams gcod pa dang*/ mngon shes dang ting nge 'dzin 'char ba dang*/ snying rje chen po skye zhing yang dag pa'i don mthong ba dang*/ gdul bya byang chub lam la 'god nus pa sogs kyi yon tan mang du gsungs te/ mdo sdud pa las/ bsam gtan gyis ni 'dod pa'i yon tan smad pa 'dor// rigs dang mngon par shes dang ting 'dzin mngon par 'grub// ces dang*/ sa'i snying po 'khor lo bcu pa las/ ting 'dzin bsgoms pas the tshom gcod 'gyur gyi// de ma gtogs pa gzhan gyis nus ma yin// de bas ting 'dzin bsgom pa mchog yin gyis// mkhas pa dag gis de bzhin nan tan bya// zhes dang*/ chos yang dag par sdud pa las/ yid mnyam par bzhag pas yang dag pa ji lta ba mthong bar 'gyur ro// yang dag pa ji lta ba mthong ba'i byang chub sems dpas sems can rnams la snying rje chen po 'jug go /zhes dang*/ mdo sde rgyan las/

bsam gtan gyis kyang skye bo thams cad byang chub lam la 'god// ces so// yang mnyam bzhag gi ting nge 'dzin bsgom pas las dang nyon mongs sgrib pa thams cad skad cig gis byang bar gsungs te/ dkon brtsegs las/ 'od srung 'di lta ste/ dper na khyim mam khang pa lo brgya stong du sus kyang me ma bus pa der/ 'ga' zhig gis mar me gcig btegs na mun pa thams cad sel zhing snang bar byed la/ mun pa yun ring po nas gnas kyang 'od kyis snang ba dang mnyam du mun pa mi gnas pa bzhin du/ las dang nyon mongs pa bskal pa brgya stong du gnas kyang tshul bzhin du yid la byed pa'i rtogs pa skad cig gis sel bar byed do// zhes dang*/ chos 'byung ba med pa'i mdo las/ 'jam dpal gang chos bdag med pa rnam par shes na des las kyi sgrib pa thams cad dag par 'gyur ro// zhes gsungs so// khyad par ni o rgyan pad+ma la mtsho rgyal gyis zhus pa/ rnal 'byor pas sems ma bcos par bsgom pa'i bsod nams dang yon tan gyi tshad ji ltar bzung zhus pas/ slob dpon gyis gsungs pa/ skad cig bsgom pa'i bsod nams kyi tshad kyang bzung bar mi nus te/ shrī singhas/ gal te gaṅgī bye snyed kyi// sems can kun la lus sbyin pas// bsod nams rgya chen gang yin pa// skad cig bsgom pa'i char mi nye// gal te gaṅgī bye snyed kyi// sems can kun gyi srog bton pas// rtse gcig bsgom pa'i 'bum char min// stong gsum rin chen mchod rten gyis// khengs byas bsod nams gang yin pa// des kyang bsgom pa'i char mi nye// sems can kun la rin chen nor// phung po du ma sbyin pa yi// dge rtsa ting 'dzin char mi nye// bsgom pa'i bsod nams tshad las 'das// zhes gsungs pa yin gsungs/ yang slob dpon la zhus pa/ de ltar bsgom pa'i rnal 'byor pa de bsgoms kyang rtogs pa ma shar/ bsgom 'phro la shi na ji ltar skye zhus pas/

slob dpon gyis/ nges 'byung gis gsha' mar bsgoms pa de mir skye ste/ skye ba des 'khor bar mi ldog pa thob/ nyams skyes te mi g.yo tsam shi na ni/ lha'i rang bzhin du skye ste skye ba des sangs rgya'o// nyams rtogs shin tu brtan cing mi g.yo ba thob pa ni srid pa'i bar do la ting nge 'dzin zin te sangs rgyas pa yin gsungs/ 'di la rang re rnams kyis spro ba bskyed par bya ba ni/ de yang khams gsum 'khor ba'i sems can phal cher 'khor ba'i mun pa'i gling du gnas pa las dam pa'i chos kyi 'od zer tsam yang phog pa shin tu dkon/ rang nyid lta bur chags bzhag na/ sngon chad 'khor ba'i skye lus grangs med pa zhig blangs kyang de thams cad phung byed mi dge ba'i g.yos sbyor/ don med 'jig rten gyi las ngan 'ba' zhig las/ dam pa'i chos kyi sgor 'jug pa lta ci smos/ dam pa'i chos zhes zer ba'i mtshan gyi sgra tsam yang thos par dka' ba byung zin pa nyid na'ang*/ dus da res su ngan song sdug bsngal gyi gnas las thar/ mtha' 'khob mi khom pa'i gnas su ma skyes/ dam pa'i chos dang mjal ba 'di lta bu spyir du rang nyid skal ba bzang la ches che ba ni/ da ltar 'jig rten gyi dbang thang can dang zas nor yod pa tsho phal cher bsod nams can zhes bstod pa dang ni mi 'dra ste/ de rnams kyi bsod nams de ni shin tu dman la don med pa/ rmi lam gyi longs spyod/ rmi lam gyi mnga' thang*/ rmi lam rmi skabs rang nyid 'jig rten gyi rgyal po thams cad kyi bdag po yin par rmis kyang don du ci yang med de/ rmi lam de skad cig tsam nas rjes med du 'gro/ dpe de bzhin tshe 'di'i bsod nams ni rtag par mi nus/ mi rtag pa'i rang bzhin yin pas don med/ dam pa'i chos ni rang nyid tshe 'dir skyob pa'i mgon/ phyi ma 'dren pa'i skyabs gnas/ tshe rabs gtan du phan pa'i nor te/ rang res dam pa'i chos thob pa ni tshe 'di'i gnas skabs kyi don 'dzam gling rgyal po thob pa bas kyang bsod nams che/

'khor ba mi khom pa'i gnas su nyam thag pa'i rigs drug gi sems can 'di rnams kyi tshod na rang nyid skal ba ches mchog tu bzang ba las/ lhag par dam chos kyi nying khu/ thos pas chog pa/ bsgom pas grol ba/ nges don zab mo 'di lta bu dang 'phrad cing mjal ba ni bsod nams mchog las mchog tu che/ skal ba shin tu nas kyang bzang*/ de yang khams gsum 'khor ba'i sems can chos kyi skal chad nag po 'di rnams kyi tshad bgyis na/ rang nyid kyi nges don 'di'i lam bsgom par ma nus kyang chos 'di'i sgra thos pa dang*/ lam du zhugs pa 'di tsam gyis kyang sangs rgyas kyi lam phyed na phyin pa lta bus don che bar 'dug /nges don zab mo'i lam 'di ni theg pa thams cad kyi mthar thug /sangs rgyas thams cad kyi bsgrod pa gcig pa'i lam/ rdzogs pa'i byang chub kyi nye lam gsang ba phul du byung ba yin pas lam 'dis byang chub kyi lam thams cad gcig chod kyis myur du rdzogs pa'i byang chub rang la smin par ma zad/ gang zhig chos thams cad kyi snying po dang rtsa ba rang sems mnyam bzhag ting nge 'dzin gyi don bsgom pa 'di ni phan yon ches che ba ste/ mnyam bzhag rang rig gi dran pa 'di ni thun gcig bsgom pa'am/ skad cig se gol gtog pa'i yun tsam bsgoms kyang de'i bsod nams ni mtha' yas tshad bzung ma mchis pa ste bskal pa mang po'i bar du dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas mchod pa bas phan yon che la/ bskal pa mang por khams gsum gyi sems can thams cad la sbyin pa byin pa bas kyang bsod nams che/ lo mang por tshig gi kha 'don bzlas brjod byas pa bas 'gyur che/ yun ring por bskyed rim bsgom pa sogs las stobs che bas de ltar da lta rang res bsgom du yod pa ni bsod nams dang skal ba che/ rang re rnams kyis bsam rang bsam na/ dper na mi dbul po zhig gis nor gyi gter chen po zhig rnyed na mi de ha las par dga' la/

de phyis nas dbul ba'i sdug bsngal dang bral ba de nyid dper mtshon pa las/ rang re de sngon 'khor ba'i gnas su sdug bsngal du mas nyam thag pa las/ da res dam pa'i chos zab mo 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal sel nus pa 'di lta bu dang mjal/ phyin chad 'khor ba mtha' can du 'gyur ba 'di ni tshad bzung med pa'i dga' ba dang*/ 'gran zla med pa'i spro ba 'phel/ da lta nged rang gis chos mi go ba lta bu dang*/ sngon 'gro dngos gzhi'i nyams len mi shes pa lta bu dang*/ rang gi sems la lta'ang mi shes/ bltas kyang mi rig sems bzhag kyang mi sdod 'tshub long nge ba/ gsal yang mi gsal nag thom me ba/ rig kyang mi rig gar song 'dir song med pa de bzhin las rang gis chos mi go bar 'dug /nyams len mi shes par 'dug /sgom mi yong bar 'dug /sems mi rig par 'dug /da ci drag na bsam pa'i yid mug sdug bsngal yid pham yid chad lta bu yong srid na de ni mi dgos te/ de snga rang sgom gyi bag chags med la goms 'dris chung ba des dang po nas shes shes po yong yong po zhig ga nas yong*/ 'phral du ma byung yang de la yid chad mi dgos te/ rang gi sems mnyam bzhag skyong rgyu legs par byung na rab/ de ma byung yang sems mnyam bzhag gi mos pa byed nas sdod pa 'di yang stong 'dug don med lta bu ma yin te/ gzhan lus ngag gi dge sbyor sogs gang las kyang nges don gyi phyogs la mos pa byed pa 'di ka rang drag /gang zhig ting nge 'dzin thun re'am skad cig tsam bsgom pas kyang de'i phan yon bsod nams tshad bzung med la rang gi sgo gsum gting nas 'dul bar 'gyur ba nyid la/ da lta rang nas rang nyid la sgom ma shar sems ngo skyong ma shes kyang*/ sems la lta stangs tsam byed pa 'di yang don che ste/ gzhan chos kyi lag len kha phyi la blta ba'i 'dus byas kyi dge ba gang las kyang*/ 'dir kha nang du phyogs pa'i 'khor 'das byed po rang sems la 'dun pa tsam byed pa don bzang la gnad zab dgos pa che// gang zhig bsam gtan ting nge 'dzin bsgom pa'i blos goms pa gcig gnyis tsam bor nas phyin na'ang*/

de'i bsod nams mtha' med par gsungs pa las/ rang res sems la blta ba 'dis ni sdig sgrib bag chags dang bcas pa thams cad cig car du sbyangs nus/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi byin rlabs 'jug /rang gi rang rgyud la phan/ tshogs thams cad gcig rdzogs su rdzogs/ lam thams cad gcig chod du 'dum/ 'bras bu thams cad nye bar thob pas na/ gzhan gang las kyang sems 'di la blta rgyu yin pa dang*/ blta dgos pa shes pa tsam 'di legs shing go chod pas/ gzhan ma shes kyang sems blta dgos so snyam pa 'dis kyang don chen por 'gyur/ 'di lta bu'i zab chos dang phrad cing sgom du yod pa ni rang re skal ba bzang po/ mi mnyam pa mnyam pa med par che'o bsam pa/ de ltar snying thag pa nas bsam pa'i spro sems 'dun pa bskyed/ da lta rang res sems la lta ba'i sngon du'ang dga' spro gzengs bstod/ bar du sems la lta mi shes blta rgyu med pa sogs byung yang de la yid mug mi bya ba'i sems gso/ rang sems mnyam bzhag la rang yid ches pa yong yong 'dra ba ma byung yang don che bar shes pas lod pa dang skyong mi 'dod pa mi byed/ sems skyong rgyu'i 'dun pa bskyed pa 'di kas chog par bsam pas sems la dpa' bkon nas/ don dam rang sems 'di nyid skyong ba la blo 'gro ba dang sems spro bas ngang mi thung bar byed dgos pa yin no// ༈ //gnyis pa bye brag gi nyams len bshad pa la/ dang por ting nge 'dzin bsgom pa'i lus kyi gnad bshad pa/ gnyis pa ngag gi gnad bshad pa/ gsum pa sems kyi gnad bshad pa dang gsum mo// dang po lus kyi gnad bshad pa la/ thun khrid gzhung las/ sgom pa phyi yi gzhi bca' lus gnad bdun// rkang pa skyil krung re'u mig bzhin bsnol// lag pa mnyam bzhag phyag rgya lte 'og bcings// sgal tshigs gser gyi dong tse brtsegs ltar bsrangs// dpung pa rgod gshog bzhin du phyir yang brgyangs// mgrin pa lcags kyu ltar bkug lce bsgril nas// so mchu bar yod lta stangs rang tsho 'dzin// zhes bshad pa de la lnga las/

dang po lus gnad rnam snang gi chos bdun byed bcings bshad pa/ gnyis pa nges tshig bshad pa/ gsum pa dgos pa gal che ba bshad pa/ bzhi pa skyon bshad pa/ lnga pa yon tan bshad pa dang lnga'o// dang po lus gnad rnam snang gi chos bdun byed bcings bshad pa ni/ rkang pa rdo rje skyil krung dang gcig /lag pa mnyam bzhag gi phyag rgya dang gnyis/ sgal tshigs gser gyi dong rtse brtsegs pa ltar bsrangs pa dang gsum/ dpung pa rgod gshog ltar brgyangs pa dang bzhi/ mgrin pa lcags kyu ltar dgugs pa dang lnga/ lce ya rkan la gtad cing so mchu bar yod tsam bya ba dang drug /de ltar lus gnad drug po de dang*/ de steng mig gi lta stangs mig mi 'gul bar mdun du blta ba de ltar bsnan pas lus gnad rnam snang gi chos bdun zhes bya ba las/ de la dang po rkang pa rdo rje skyil krung ni/ rkang pa g.yas pa steng du bton pa'i rdo rje skyil krung bca' thub pa'am/ 'ga' res de ltar gtan nas ma thub na sems dpa'i skyil krung gis chog /gnyis pa mnyam bzhag phyag rgya lte 'og tu bca' zhes 'di spyir mnyam bzhag phyag rgya ni lag gnyis kyi g.yas steng du bzhag pa'i mthe bong gnyis rtse sprad pa de 'dra zhig la zer zhing*/ rje mi las/ g.yon steng du 'jog pa legs par bshad pa sogs kyi gnas skabs 'dug kyang da res 'dir ni de ma yin pa 'di lta ste/ spyir srin mdzub rtsa ba gnyis la bdud 'jug pa'i rtsa ngan pa gnyis yod gsungs pas/ de dag dgag par bya ba'i ched du/ de gnyis rtsa ba mthe bong gnyis kyis dam du mnan nas brla steng gnyis su 'jog lag ngar gru tshigs ma gug pa sha bsgrim ste brgyangs pa'i gru mo gnyis nang du 'ong bar bya/ khyad par 'og sgo bsdam nas 'og rlung bag tsam yar la 'then pa'i pho ba ldir bar bya ba 'di chos bdun nang du ma gsungs te/ man ngag gnad gcig yin// gsum pa sgal tshigs gser gyi dong tse brtsegs ltar bsrangs pa zhes lus dgye rgu ya yor mi 'dug par drangs te hrang por bsrangs// bzhi pa dpung pa rgod gshog ltar brgyangs zhes pa/

dpung mgo gnyis phyir rgyab tu phul nas thal gong dgye bar byed// lnga pa mgrin pa lcags kyu ltar bkug pa ol ko'i mdud non tsam zhes zer ba/ mgrin pa cher bkug kyang mi bkug /lkog ma 'phyar kyang mi 'phyar/ ltag pa bsgreng nas rang sar 'gug tsam ol ko'i mdud gre mdud la zer ba yin pas de non dgos// drug pa lce ya rkan la gtad pa zhes lce bsgril te ya rkan la gtad de/ khyad par so mi bsgrig mchu mi btsum mi gdangs par so mchu gnyis ka bar yod tsam dgos pa yin// bdun pa mig gi lta stangs la spyir rig pa dbang pos bsgyur/ khyad par mig gis bsgyur bas mig mi 'dzum zhing mi 'gul bar gnya' shing gang tsam thad du lta ba rnam snang gi chos bdun zhes gsungs pa mig g.yas g.yon mdun du mi yengs shing btsums kyang mi btsum hrig ge lta stangs sogs kyang mi byed par sna rtser phab nas bltas kyang 'dra/ gnya' shing gang zer ba khru gang ste/ khru gang gi sa la mig mi 'gul bar lta ba de rnams rnam snang chos bdun yin par 'dug ste/ de skad du/ rnam snang mngon byang las// lus bsrangs rdo rje skyil krung bya// yid ni rtse gcig phyag rgya che// zhes dang*/ chos drug las/ lus ni rdo rje skyil mo krung*// sgal tshigs rin chen rtsar la brgyus// mthong ka rgyun du yangs pa dang*// stong ko shin tu sba bar bya// lce ni ya rkan nyid du gtad// mnyam bzhag phyag rgya lte 'og brtsegs// mig dang shes pa ma 'gyur bar// rlung sems dril la drag tu gcun// zhes dang*/ rdo rje phreng ba'i rgyud las/ sgrub po bde ba'i stan 'dug nas// mig ni sna rtser gtad byas nas/ sna mthong lta ba'i tshad du zhog /phrag dpung mnyam pa lce rkan sbyar// so dang mchu ni bde bar bzhag /dbugs ni dbyung rngub glod nas ni// cung zad rtsol ba bral ba yis// rdo rje skyil krung legs gnas shing*// de ltar phyag rgya dang ldan pa// zhes gsungs pa dang*/

yang skyon gsum dang bral ba gcig dgos pa gsungs pa ni rgyud de nyid nas// 'byung bzhi lus kyi 'dug tshul ni// bde dang yangs dang lhod dang gsum// zhes gsungs/ 'di lus gnad dam po byed pa la bde yangs lhod gsum mi 'dzom pa 'dra zhig 'dug kyang don du lus gnad yin bzhin bcas na dang por mi bde yang rjes nas goms na lus rtsa rlung rnal du phebs na bde yangs lhod gsum yong nges so// gzhan yang*/ rje nā ro pas/ lus kyi gnad thabs bsgom pa'i gnad// ces gsungs pa sogs shin tu mang ba'o/// / gnyis pa nges tshig bshad pa ni/ lus gnad 'di nyid la rnam snang gi chos bdun zer ba'i rgyu mtshan ni bla ma gong ma 'ga' zhig gis lus gnad 'di nyid rnam snang gangs chen mtsho'i bzhugs stangs dang mthun pas/ de ltar ming gi nges tshig tu 'jog par mdzad mod/ de ni gcig tu ma nges pa sogs kyi rgyu mtshan/ rje sangs rgyas rdo rje'i phyag chen rang len sogs las rgyas par gsungs yod de 'dir bshad mi dgos/ don du spyir de bzhin kyang yin mod de/ gtso bo ni gzugs phung rnam par snang mdzad dag pa de'i phyir/ 'dir sbyang gzhi sbyangs 'bras kyi dag pa dang sbyor bar mdzad pa yin la/ de yang rnam snang ni sbyang gzhi'i gzugs phung rnam par dag pa/ sbyang bya gti mug sbyong bar byed pa/ sbyong byed sku rdo rje'i rnal 'byor nyams su len pa/ sbyangs 'bras me long ye shes sam chos kyi dbyings kyi rang bzhin rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi sku'i rigs kyi gtso bor gyur pa yin la/ de yang 'di dag gzhir 'gyur ba nyid 'di'i rgyu mtshan ni/ dang po sbyang gzhi gzugs phung*/ phung po gzhan rnams thams cad kyi rten gzhi yin pa dang*/ gnyis pa sbyang bya gti mug nyon mongs pa thams cad kyi rtsa ba dang*/ gsum pa sbyong byed sku rdo rje'i rnal 'byor rnam snang ni rnal 'byor gzhan thams cad kyi gzhi ma dang*/

bzhi pa sbyangs 'bras me long lta bu'i ye shes kyang ye shes gzhan rnams thams cad kyi gzhi rten yin pa ni/ me long ye shes mi g.yo ste// ye shes gsum ni de la brten// mnyam pa nyid dang so sor rtog /bya ba grub pa kho na'o// zhes gsungs pa ltar dang*/ sbyangs 'bras sku'i rigs ni rigs thams cad kyi rten du gyur par bshad la/ de'i phyir sdom pa'i skabs su skyabs 'gro rnam snang gi sdom par 'jog pa dang*// bskyed rim gyi skabs su gzhal yas khang rnam snang gi rang bzhin du bshad pa ltar/ 'dir yang lus gnad bdun de nyid nyams len rnams kyi gzhi ma dang rtsa ba yin pas/ rnam snang gi chos su bzhag pa ste 'bras bu rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob pa la// 'gros bzhi thim pa'i sgo nas dkyil 'khor bzhi'o// lnga pa mthar thug par mngon par byang chub dgos shing*/ dkyil 'khor de rnams mthar thug mngon du 'gyur ba la thog mar smin grol la sogs pa'i nyams len gyis de rnams las su rung bar byed dgos la/ de yang dkyil 'khor snga ma snga ma las su ma rung bar phyi ma phyi mar las rung du byed mi nus pas/ thog mar lus rtsa'i dkyil 'khor las su rung bar byed dgos/ de la'ang dang po rten gyi lus rags pa las su rung bar byed dgos/ des na rtsa thig gi gnas tshul rlung gi rgyu tshul mi 'khrugs par byed pa la/ lus kyi gnad legs par bca' dgos pas/ lus gnad nyid rdzogs pa'i rim pa'i nyams len gyi thog mar med du mi rung bas rnam par snang mdzad kyi chos su bzhag pa'i rgyu mtshan de bzhin yin la/ des na lus gnad chos bdun la rnam snang gi chos bdun zer ba'i go don mtha' dpyod du bshad pa ste/ 'di las spros na mang yang bsdu na de tsam ste/ chos bdun ni rnam snang gangs chen mtsho dang chos mthun pa'am/ gzugs sbyangs nas rnam par snang mdzad du byed pa'i phyir rnam snang gi chos bdun zhes bya'o// zhes pa brda tsam las ma gsungs pa de'i go don du mdo tsam bshad pa'o/// /

gsum pa dgos gal che bar bshad pa ni/ 'dir lus gnad bca' ba dgos pa che ba'i lung 'dren ni/ kye rdo rje'i rgyud las/ lus la ye shes chen po gnas// rtog pa thams cad yang dag spangs// dngos po kun la khyab pa po// lus gnas lus las ma skyes pa'o// zhes gsungs shing*/ gzhan yang*/ rje karma pa dbang phyug rdo rjes/ phyag chen khrid yig tu 'di ltar gsungs te/ rten lus kyi 'khrul 'khor bcings tsa na brten pa sems la rnam rtog mi 'gyu dgu 'gyu rang 'gags su 'gro ste/ dper na khyim gyi sgo la lcags bcug na brten pa mi la 'gro sa mi yong ba bzhin no// zhes dang*/ yang de ltar sems mi rtog par thim song tsa na lhan skyes kyi ye shes kyi lhag mthong yang rtogs par 'gyur la/ de mthong bar byed pa la sems gnas dgos/ sems gnas par byed pa la lus kyi 'khrul 'khor gcun dgos/ zhes sogs mang du gsungs pa dang*/ rje karma pa dus gsum mkhyen pas/ pha ri la lta na tshu ri nas ltos// stong par 'dod na snang ba gtan la phobs// sems gnas par 'dod na lus kyi 'khrul 'khor gcun// zhes gsungs pa dang gzhan yang man ngag du ma las kyang*/ lus drang pas rtsa drang*/ rtsa drang pas rlung drang*/ rlung drang pas thig le drang*/ thig le drang na sems zin/ zhes gsungs/ gzhan du na/ lus drang pas rtsa drang*/ rtsa drang pas rlung drang*/ rtsa rlung gnad du tshud pas sems zin/ zhes gsungs/ don du rnam rtog gi rta rlung yin pas na/ nged rang gsar bus lus kyog po sgur po byas nas bsgom na sems gnas dka' zhing*/ drang na sems gnas sla ba yin par 'dug /'di yang bzhed tshul mi 'dra ba/ rje bram ze chen po sa ra has ni do ha la sogs par sems kyis rlung zin par dgongs pa yod 'dug pa de ni/ sems ma bcos par bzhag pas rlung yang rang mal du 'gag /rnam rtog kyang zhi ba der dgongs/ rje nā ro pas ni rlung gis sems zin par dgongs/

de ni dang por lus bsrangs rlung bzung na sems kyang der gnas pas na/ de ltar gsungs pa yin 'dug /lar bka' brgyud gong ma rnams kyis rten 'brel lus la bsgrigs pas rtogs pa sems la 'char/ zhes gsungs pa 'dir don thams cad tshang ba'o/// / bzhi pa skyon bshad pa ni/ lar lus bsnyel ba dang*/ 'khyag 'khyog gnad du ma song na/ rtsa yang 'chus/ des rlung yang 'chus te 'gro/ des na sems mi bde mi gnas shing*/ mdor na lus gnad de nyid drang por ma bsrangs pas g.yas su yo na dang po gsal ba 'dra ba zhig 'byung yang*/ de nas gzung ba'i rnam rtog mang*/ 'dir gzung rtog mang ba'i rgyu mtshan ci zhig snyam na/ g.yas ro ma gzung ba'i rang bzhin de ngos su rlung 'chus pas/ de'i dbang gis rlung sems 'jug pa gcig yin pas na gzung ba'i rnam rtog mang ba'i rgyu mtshan de yin la// de la gdon gnod na pho gdon gnod pa yong ba dang*/ de nas lus gnad g.yon du yo na dang por bde yang de nas 'dzin pa'i rnam rtog mang*/ 'dzin pa'i rnam rtog mang ba'i rgyu mtshan g.yon rkyang ma 'dzin pa'i rang bzhin gyi rtsar rlung zhugs pa'i don yin la/ de la gnod byed mo gdon gnod pa dang*/ yang lus gnad rgur drags na lus stod du rlung 'thum pas stod lci/ tshig pa za/ 'di'i tshig pa za ba'i rgyu mtshan rlung srog snying nang du zhugs rtags yin cing*/ de la gdon rgyal po'i gdon/ de gnod pa'i rgyu mtshan snying la rgyal 'gong gi rtsa yod par bshad pas des gnod pa yin la gegs de ma sel na mthar smyo 'bog tu 'gro/ de nas lus gnad dgye rang drags na rlung nang du mi gnas sha pags mtshams su shor bas sha bkra dang skya rbab yong*/ de'i gegs ma sel na mthar thug rmug rdzing ngam mdze ru 'gro/ sked pa nyag na thig le mi brtan des grang ba bskyed/ mgrin pa bkug rang drags na dang por ngag byang yang mthar lce la 'brum pa mang po dang*/

skad 'gags zas yid gar mi yong*/ lce dig pa sogs yong*/ spyi bo btum na gnyid che mgo lci/ klad pa'i steng gi khrag rtsa sbrul 'khyil ba 'dra bar rlung shor nas mgo bor sbrul gyi snang ba dang*/ de'i gegs ma sel na mthar thug klu nad sogs su 'gyur ba ste/ de ltar yang sam+bu ṭi'i rgyud las/ chos kyi phung po brgyad khri dang*// bzhi stong gi ni cho gas ni// lus kyi de nyid mi shes pas// de dag thams cad 'bras bu med// ces gsungs so// mdor na lus gnad ma legs na skyon gyi rnam pa mang du bskyed pas skyon de rnams mi 'byung ba'i phyir/ lus gnad legs par bya ba gal du che ba'o/// /lnga pa lus gnad legs pa'i yon tan bshad pa ni/ spyir lus gnad bca' ba de bzhin lus dben pa'am lus rang babs sam/ lus rnal du babs pa'am lus dag pa zhes pa'i yon tan spyir che bar ma zad/ sgos su lus gnad so so'i yon tan ni/ bsam gtan gyi chos lnga zhes/ rkang pa rdo rje skyil krung gis thur sel gyi rlung zin/ nyon mongs phrag dog zhi/ bar chad kyis mi tshugs/ lag pa mnyam bzhag gi phyag rgyas me mnyam gyi rlung zin/ nyon mongs zhe sdang zhi/ thal gong dgye bas srog 'dzin gyi rlung zin/ mgrin pa gug cing lce ya rkan la gtad pas gyen rgyu'i rlung zin/ nyon mongs 'dod chags zhi/ sgal tshigs bsrangs pas khyab byed kyi rlung zin te/ gti mug zhi/ de yang zin pa'i rgyu mtshan thur sel rlung gsang gnas na gnas pa de rkang pa rdo rje'i skyil krung bcas pas zin par 'gyur ba dang*/ me mnyam kyi rlung lte bar me dang mnyam du gnas pa de/ lag pa mnyam bzhag gi phyag rgya lte 'og du bcas pas zin pa dang*/ srog 'dzin gyi rlung snying khar gnas pa de nyid thal gong dgye bas zin par 'gyur ba dang*/ gyen rgyu'i rlung mgrin par gnas pa de nyid mgrin pa bkug pas zin pa dang*/ khyab byed kyi rlung tshigs rnams la gnas pa de/

sgal tshigs bsrangs pas zin par byed pa ste/ mdor na lus gnad lnga des rtsa ba'i rlung lnga rang thad nas zin cing brtan par byed pa'i don te/ de ltar lus gnad de rnams kyis rtsa ba'i rlung lnga zin cing brtan par byed pa'i yon tan dang*/ de nas mig gi lta stangs kyis ni yan lag gi rlung rgyu ba mig la gnas pa zin pa dang*/ nga rgyal zhi shes pa gsal bar byed cing*/ de yang yid kyi rnam shes phyi rol gyi yul la 'jug pa'i gtso bo mig yin pa de'i rlung zin na zhar du yan lag gi rlung gzhan te/ rnam par rgyu ba rna ba la gnas pa dang*/ yang dag par rgyu ba sna la gnas pa dang*/ rab tu rgyu ba lce la gnas pa dang*/ nges par rgyu ba pags pa dang ba spu'i tshogs la gnas pa rnams zin par 'gyur ba ste/ mdor na lus kyi byed bcings kyis rtsa ba'i rlung lnga dang mig gi lta stangs kyis yan lag gi rlung lnga zin cing brtan la/ de ltar rlung bcu 'ching bas srog brtan pa ngag dben/ bzhon pa de dag 'ching bas byang chub kyi sems kyang mi 'pho la rten thig le de brtan pas brten pa sems kyang mi g.yo bas na sems dben pa ste/ mdor na lus gnad bcings pas lus rtsa drang pas lus dben/ lus rtsa drang pas de zhor rlung 'ching bas ngag dben/ rtsa rlung rnal du phebs pas rten thig le brtan cing des brten pa sems kyang rnam par rtog pa dang bral bas na sems dben te dben pa gsum tshang ba'o// 'di'i yon tan mthar thug pa ni/ rdo rje skyil krung rdzogs sangs rgyas// gsungs pa ltar lus gnad bcings pas lus rnal du phebs/ des rtsa rlung rnal du phebs te/ rlung rgyu ba'i lam ni rtsa yin pas lam de rnal du phebs phyir rlung yang zhor du rnal du 'babs la/ des thig le rnal du phebs par 'gyur te/ de'i rgyu mtshan thig le'i bzhon pa rlung yin pas bzhon pa sdod pas na bzhon pa po'ang sdod dgos pa yin bzhin/

thig le brtan pas sems rnal du phebs par 'gyur te/ de'i rgyu mtshan thig le dang sems gnyis rten brten pa'i 'brel ba can du gnas te/ des na rten thig le 'ching na brten pa sems kyang rang 'ching du 'gro la/ 'di rnal du phebs pa dang 'ching zer ba'i don/ rnal du phebs pas rtsa yon po bsrangs shing rlung log pa rang lugs su rgyu ba dang*/ thig le dwangs pa dang*/ sems gshis thog tu phebs pa'i don yin la/ 'ching zhes pa rlung sems rang gnas su zin pa dang*/ mthar thug rlung sems dbu mar zin ces pa'i don yin la/ de la dang por sems rang gnas dang mthar dbu mar zin pas na/ rtsa thams cad dbu ma dang*/ rlung thams cad ye shes kyi rlung*/ thig le thams cad dwangs ma sems kyi ngo bo sgrib bral te/ de ltar rtsa rlung thig le sems dang bcas pa yongs su dag pas na mi 'gyur ba'i bde ba chen po'i 'bras bu go 'phang dam pa thob par 'gyur ba nyid de/ mthar thug gi 'bras bu ni de bzhin la/ 'dul ba lung las/ rang sangs rgyas mthong ba'i spre'u zhig gis drang srong lnga brgyar lus gnad bstan pa de rnams kyis de ltar byas pas rang sangs rgyas thob pa'i gtam rgyud bzhin yin par 'dug la/ gzhan gnas skabs phan yon ni/ rtsa log rlung log mi 'byung ba rtsa rlung yin lugs yin bzhin rnal du phebs par 'gyur ba sogs yon tan mtha' yas pa'o// ༈ //gnyis pa ngag gi gnad bshad pa ni/ thun khrid gzhung las/ ngag gi smra bcad rang babs dben par gnas// zhes bshad pa de la/ rdzogs chen kun byed las/ ngag gis dz+rab dang snying po bzla mi dgos// lag gis 'du byed phyag rgya bca' mi dgos// sems kyis ting 'dzin 'phro 'du'i las ma byed// ngang la gnas pas g.yo med lhun gyis grub// rang bzhin gnas pas sus kyang bcos su med// ma btsal ji bzhin pa la gnas pa des// byas pa med pa lam gyi mchog tu bsnyen// zhes gsungs so// 'di la shes na rlung ro bsal zhing rlung rang babs su 'jog pa dang*/

de ltar ma shes kyang ngag smra ba bcad de sdod pa gnyis las// dang po shes na rlung ro bsal ba ni/ rang gi lus gnad rnam snang chos bdun de ngos nas/ sna bug gnyis nas dang po rlung ro chung ba gcig /bar du che ba gcig /tha mar shed bskyed de sing sgra dang bcas gtong ba gsum ste rlung ro che chung lan gsum po des bsal/ de'i skabs kyi bsgom rgyu'i dmigs pa la/ rang gi sna nas rlung bus pa de dang mnyam du rang nyid kyi tshe rabs 'khor ba thog med kyi sdig sgrib da lta'i nyes ltung nad gdon bar chad ma dag pa'i rtsa lam du rgyu ba'i las kyi rlung*/ dug gi rlung*/ nyon mongs pa'i rlung sogs ma dag pa'i rlung thams cad dper na du dkar nang nas du ba 'thon par rlung gis bdas pas dbang med du 'thon pa ltar/ rang gi rlung ro gsum po sna nas bsal ba des dbang med du de rnams dang mnyam du phyir 'thon zhing dag par bsam/ 'dis ni khams dwangs pa dang rig pa gsal bar byed pa 'phral gyi dgos pa dang*/ yun du bar chad mi 'jug mthar thug sdig sgrib dag pa la sogs kyi dgos pa mang du yod pas/ de ltar shes pa rnams kyis de bzhin rlung ro lan gsum 'bud cing de'i bsgom don dmigs pa sgom pa dang*/ de ltar mi shes pa rnams kyis ma byung yang 'gal ba cher med// gnyis pa dngos gzhi 'di la/ ngag smra ba bcad de sdod par byed pa ste/ de yang kha dal lab pa sogs don med 'jig rten gyi gtam lta ci smos/ 'don pa 'don pa'am/ bzlas pa byed pa sogs kyang mi byed par/ rlung rang babs/ ngag smra bcad sgra med du sdod par byed dgos pa'o// 'di la nged rang sdug shos 'ga' res ni mnyam bzhag byed dus lta bu yin rung*/ mnyam bzhag de'i mgo mjug bar gsum thams cad du ngag smra bcad mi 'khyongs bar/ dang por smra bcad 'dra zhig byas na'ang de nas sems la lta mi shes/ blta rgyu med dus nas ci 'dug de 'dug mi yong bar kha dal sogs gang min zhig byed 'dug pa des ni thun gyi nyams len ma shes/

thun gyi lag len 'chol/ ngag bag med du byas pas nyes pa yang che ba yin zhing*/ de min 'ga' re zhig gis sngon nas ma ṇi sogs 'don mkhan zhig yin na/ mnyam bzhag byed dus 'dir yang ngag smra ba bcad de mi sdod par/ yang na 'don pa/ yang na bzlas pa ma ṇi sogs 'don mkhan 'ga' re'ang yod 'dug pa de yang ma yin te/ 'di la rang rang so sos sngon nas nyams len la brtan pa rab thob pas 'don pa 'don pas mi gnod pas/ 'don pa bzlas brjod dang rang sems ting nge 'dzin yengs med kyi dran pa 'dre ba yin na de ka los chog kyang*/ las dang po pa rnams dang*/ sems kyi rang ngo dran shes la brtan pa ma thob pa rnams kyis ni dang por rang sems kyi ngo bo skyong ba 'di rang gal che/ rang sems kyi ngo bo dran pa yengs med ma shes na/ lus ngag gi dge sbyor tsam byas kyang*/ gnas skabs kyi 'bras bu las don gyi 'bras bu dam pa mi thob cing*/ sems yengs ba'i dge sbyor thams cad ni rtsa ba rul pa'i sdong po dang*/ nang na med pa'i phyi'i dge ba gzugs brnyan tsam po ste/ sngon nas ma bsgoms pa'i nyes dmigs skabs bshad pa dang 'dra ba de bzhin yin/ des na sems ma yengs pa gtso bor mi 'don/ lus ngag gi dge sbyor gtso bor 'dzin pa/ yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po che bzhag nas/ rin chen phal par rtsis su byed pa'am/ lam nye lam nas mi 'gro bar ring lam nas bskor ba'am/ chos kyi rtsa ba sems yin pas de mi bsgom par/ chos ltar snang tsam byed pa/ 'ban thog tu mda' mi rgyag par/ phyogs don med du 'phen pa'am/ zog bdag sgo phyir bton nas don med mi ngan nang du 'dzud pa lta bur/ kun byed rang sems yengs nas don med nyams len byed pa'am/ sdig sgrib rtsa ba sems yin par de mi sbyong bar/ gzhan kha phyir blta ba/ 'dre shar sgor bzhag nas glud nub sgor skyel ba'am/ sangs rgyas kyi snying po rang sems yin pa de la goms 'dris mi byed par/

lus ngag gi dge sbyor tsam zhig gtso bor 'dzin pa/ don lho ru bzhag lus phar rgyab bstan nas kha byang du bstan nas 'gro ba lta bu/ don ma go gnad ma shes/ mdo 'gags ma zin/ snying po ma lon pa de bzhin mi byed par/ dang por chos kun nyams len mthar thug /sems don rang la rtse gcig dril bar blo thag bcad/ gzhan gyi g.yeng ba spros bcas thams cad spong bar bsam dgos te/ de yang jo bo rjes/ gcig tu mnyam bzhag sems brten nas// lus ngag dge sbyor gtsor mi bya// zhes dang*/ rje mi las/ phyag rgya chen po bsgom dus su// lus ngag gi dge sbyor ma brtson zhig /mi rtog ye shes yal nyen yod// ces dang*/ khyad par o rgyan chen pos/ chos kun rtsa ba rang gi sems nyid de// nang du mnyam par bzhag pas don rtogs 'gyur// lus ngag dge sbyor tsam gyi so na med// des na gcig tu rang sems blta bar bya// zhes gsungs pa rnams go shes yid ches dang bcas/ gzhan gyi 'don brjod bzlas pa yig drug 'don pa sogs mtshan bcas dge ba tsam du zhen pa dang mchog 'dzin zhen chags kyi dbang du ma song ba'i mtshan med rang rig yengs med kyi ting nge 'dzin dam pa 'di chos thams cad kyi rtsa ba/ nyams len ma lus pa'i gnad 'gags/ zab don mtha' dag gi nying khu/ lam thams cad kyi nye lam yin pas yid ches nges shes spro sems 'dun pa dang bcas ngag smra ba bcad nas mnyam par 'jog pa ste/ 'di la rdzogs chen rnams nas/ ngag pi waṃ gi rgyun thag chad pa bzhin du sgra med du 'jog /ces gsungs so// ngag 'don brjod byed pa las kyang smra ba gcod pa 'di phan yon che ba ni/ gdan bzhi las/ rlung dang ngag ni g.yo med pa// 'di yis bsam gtan 'bras bu 'grub// ces gsungs/ dper na rang cag gi ston pa thub pa'i dbang po chu klung ne rañja na'i 'gram du lo drug dka' spyad ting nge 'dzin la bzhugs pa'i skabs kyang*/ sku mi g.yo/

gsung mi grags/ thugs mnyam par bzhag pa ma gtogs/ bzlas brjod kyi grangs bsogs pa mdzad pa min 'dug /de bzhin sngon gyi grub mtha' gsar rnying gong ma rnams kyang ting nge 'dzin mnyam par 'jog skabs sku gsung thugs g.yo med kyi bsam gtan la rtse gcig pa'i sgrub pa gtso bor mdzad pa shas che bar 'dug pa rnams dper mtshon na/ don du ngag smra ba bcad pa 'di ka bzlas pa thams cad kyi mchog ste/ rgyud las/ brjod du med pa bzlas pa'i mchog /ces gsungs pa de ltar shes dgos pa'o/// / ༈ gsum pa sems kyi gnad bshad pa la/ thun khrid gzhung las/ rang sems gdod dag 'khor 'das byed po can// 'di nyid bzo med ngang du mnyam par 'jog /ma yengs pa ni sangs rgyas kun gyi lam// bsgom bya gzhan med dran thog thag chod bskyed// rang rig ngos bzung bral ba stong pa nyid// stong pa'i rang mdangs rnam rtog snang ba'i rtsal// gnyis med blo 'das lhan cig skyes pa'i dbyings// gnas lugs rang ngo ji bzhin shes par bya// zhes bshad pa de la dang po sems kyi 'jog lugs bshad pa/ gnyis pa sems kyi skyon sel bshad pa/ gsum pa sems kyi lam khyer bshad pa dang rnam pa gsum mo// dang po sems kyi 'jog lugs bshad pa la/ dang po sems 'khor 'das thams cad kyi rtsa bar thag bcad par bshad pa/ gnyis pa sems de nyid yengs med kyi dran pa sgom gyi dngos gzhir nges shes bskyed pa bshad pa/ gsum pa dus gsum gyi spros pa bcad nas 'jog par bshad pa/ bzhi pa gnas 'gyu rang babs kyi ngo bo skyong ba bshad pa/ lnga pa yul snang gi steng du ma bcos shes bzhin skyong ba/ drug pa spyod lam rnam bzhi dus kun dran pa rgyun 'tsho skyong ba dang drug go /dang po sems nyid 'di ka 'khor 'das thams cad kyi rtsa bar thag gcod pa ni/ 'di la lung 'dren ni/ brtag gnyis las/ 'di nyid 'khor ba zhes bya ste// 'di nyid mya ngan 'das pa yin// zhes 'di nyid gsung pa gang la ngos 'dzin na rang gi sems 'di nyid de/

rang sems 'di nyid 'khor ba dang mya ngan las 'das pa thams cad kyi rtsa bar gsungs pa'o// gzhan yang*/ grub thob rgyal po sa ra has/ sems nyid gcig pu kun gyi sa bon te// gang las srid dang mya ngan 'das 'phro ba// 'dod pa'i 'bras bu thams cad rab ster ba'i// yid bzhin nor 'dra'i sems la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes dang*/ rdzogs chen kun byed rgyal po las/ sems ni 'khor 'das kun gyi byed po ste// kun byed rgyal po 'di nyid shes par byos// zhes gsungs so// des na don dam pa rang ni rang re rnams mar 'khor bar 'khyams na'ang rang sems 'di ka 'khor bar 'khyams/ yar sangs rgyas thob na'ang rang sems 'di nyid sangs rgyas thob pa ste/ gzhi rang gi rig pa gcig pu 'di nyid las 'khor ba dang mya ngan las 'das pa'am sangs rgyas dang sems can thams cad byung ba'o// de las 'khor ba ji ltar grub cing 'khyams na/ rang gi rig pa 'di nyid ye gdod ma nas dag pa chen po'i ngo bo nyid na'ang*/ rang re glo bur gyi ma rig pa'i dri ma mi zad pas bsgribs par gyur pa'i rang rig rang ngo ma shes/ rang ngo ma shes pas 'khrul pa'i rtog pa dang nyon mongs pa'i 'du byed shar/ 'khrul pa dang nyon mongs pa des las ngan pa bsags/ las kyi rnam smin myong 'khor ba dang ngan song du skye/ rigs drug tu 'khyams/ de rnams kyis sdug bsngal myong bar byas pa ste/ don du 'khor bar 'khyams pa'i rtsa ba rang ni/ da lta'i rang gi sems 'di'i rang ngo rang gis ma shes/ yengs 'khrul gyi dbang du song*/ rang rig rang tsho ma zin/ 'khrul pa'i las la goms 'dris spong dka' ba 'di nyid kyis byas pas/ rang 'khor ba nas 'khor bar 'khyams pa ste/ don du 'khor ba'i rtsa ba thams cad da lta rang gi sems yengs 'khrul gyi dbang du song nas/ brjed dbang gang yin dang 'di cha med pa 'di rang yin par shes shing thag chod par byed pa'o// yang mya ngan las 'das pa'am sangs rgyas pa yang rang sems 'di nyid ma gtogs gzhan gsar du yong rgyu zhig med de/

de yang rang rig glo bur 'khrul pa'i dri ma 'di nyid lam gyi snying po ma yengs pa'i dran pas sbyangs pa yis dri ma yongs su dag ste/ gzhi rang rig ka dag chen po'i don mngon du gyur pa ste/ rang rig 'di nyid rang ngo rang gis shes/ rang so rang gis tshugs/ 'khrul med gnas lugs gzhi'i don rtogs pa dang*/ rig pa 'di ka mya ngan las 'das pa'am sangs rgyas pa zhes bya ste/ mdo 'gags rang ngo shes pa 'di lam gyi gzhi ma dang*/ 'bras bu sangs rgyas kyi rtsa ba yin te sangs rgyas zhes pa'ang rang sems dag pa las gzhan du med pa'o// des na slob dpon rin po ches/ sems 'di 'khor 'das kun gyi byed po ste// sems las min pa'i 'khor 'das gang la'ang med// ces dang*/ rje gong ma rnams kyis/ 'khor 'das lag pa'i lto rgyab/ ces gsungs/ de ltar rang nyid 'khor 'das kyi rtsa ba da lta'i rang sems 'di kho na yin par ma zad/ gzhan phyi rol snod bcud kyi dngos po snang srid kyi chos thams cad kyang rang sems yin te/ 'di la lung 'dren ni/ 'phags pa sa bcu pa las/ kye rgyal ba'i sras dag khams gsum po 'di dag ni sems tsam mo// zhes dang*/ byang chub sems 'grel las/ gzung dang 'dzin pa'i sems kyis ni// rnam par shes pa snang ba ste// rnam shes las ni logs shig na// phyi rol du ni cung zad med// ces gsungs/ de yang dper na phyi rol gyi snang ba 'di dag don la ci yang med kyang rang sems 'khrul pa'i dbang gis yod pa'i dngos por snang ba mkhris nad can gyi dung la ser por mthong ba de/ dung ser po ma yin kyang nad kyi dbang gis mthong ba lta bu dang*/ gcig dang du mar mthong ba ni/ don du rang sems gcig pu 'di las med kyang 'khrul pa dang las kyi dbang gis sna tshogs su snang ba chu la rigs drug gis so sor mthong ba bzhin te/ dper na chu'i dngos po gcig 'di nyid yin kyang*/ chu kha zhig tu 'gro ba rigs drug po dus gcig 'dzoms pas so sos bltas na mthong tshul mi gcig ste/

dmyal ba tsha dmyal pas chu bo mer mthong*/ grang dmyal pas kha ba 'khyags rom du mthong*/ yi dwags rnams kyis rnag khrag /dud 'gro bying na gnas pas gnas khang*/ kha 'thor bas btung bya/ mi rnams kyis kyang de bzhin 'thung bar 'os pa'i chu bzang ngan/ lha ma yin gyis go mtshon/ lhas bdud rtsir mthong ba ste don du chu yin pa la/ rigs drug so so'i las snang gis mthong tshul mi 'dra ba sna tshogs yong ba de ka rang sems las kyi snang ba zhes don du phyi rol du ma grub pas sems kyi snang ba tsam yin pa'o// 'di la lung 'dren ni/ 'phags pa thogs med kyis/ yi dwags dud 'gro mi rnams dang*// lha rnams ji ltar rigs ris su// dngos gcig yid ni tha dad phyir// don ma grub par 'dod pa yin// ces gsungs/ des na da lta'i phyi rol gyi snang ba thams cad kyang don la ma grub kyang med bzhin du rang sems 'khrul pa'i rang snang las grub pa'o// gzhan yang*/ tshe snga phyi'i lus sna tshogs grangs kyis mi langs pa brjes kyang rang sems la brje rgyu med pas/ rang sems 'di ni 'khor ba thog ma med pa'i ye gdod ma nas yod bzhin la/ bar du sems kho rang gis bsags pa'i las kyi dbang gis rigs drug bzang ngan gyi skye ba sna tshogs blangs pa'o// tshe rabs snga ma rnams su'ang*/ skye ba bzang ngan/ las dge sdig gi dbang gis skabs su sdug pa ste/ de snga yang bde sdug thams cad rang sems 'dis myong ba'o// da ltar yang las bzang ngan gyi dran mkhan/ chos 'jig rten gyi byed po thams cad rang sems 'di ka ste// sems 'di med na lus sa rdo ro dang khyad par med mod kyang sems 'di lus la brten nas gnas pas/ bzang ngan legs nyes thams cad byed/ bde sdug ma lus pa'i sa bon 'debs pa'o// tshe rabs phyi ma rnams su'ang sems 'di med par mi 'gro ste/ da lta rang res sdig pa bsags nas dmyal bar 'gro dgos na'ang sems 'di phyi ma dmyal bar skye/

des tsha grang sdug bsngal myong ngo*// da lta rang res dge ba bsgrubs nas mtho ris su skye na'ang sems 'di lha dang mir skye/ des bde skyid myong*/ yar zhing khams dag par 'pho na'ang sems 'di 'pho ba ste/ tshe rabs phyi ma'i bde sdug thams cad kyang sems thog rang la 'bab par byed pa'o// des na mang po yod pa ma yin pas don dag hril gyis dril na/ 'khor 'das thams cad kyi rtsa ba rang gi sems/ tshe snga phyi'i las bzang ngan thams cad bsags mkhan yang rang gi sems/ las de'i bde sdug rnam smin thams cad myong mkhan de yang rang gi sems/ da lta bya ba legs nyes bzang ngan thams cad kyi dran mkhan chos 'jig rten gyi bsam blo btang mkhan/ las dge sdig ma lus pa'i byed po rang gi sems 'di nyid de/ kun byed rgyal po rang sems 'di nyid yin bzhin las/ 'di ka rang gis rang 'dul bar byed dgos pa'o// des na 'khor ba'i rtsa ba sems la thug pa 'di da lta rang gis shes par byas nas/ 'khor ba'i rtsa ba gcod par byed pa dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi snying po sems la thug pa de da lta rang gis shes par byas nas de sgrub par byed dgos pa ste/ 'khor 'das thams cad kyi rtsa ba rang sems 'di ka gcig pu yin par shes bzhin du thag gcod pa las gzhan du bsam blo bzo bcos sgyur sgom mi byed par sems kyi nyams len gnad 'gags 'di rang la dril bar byed dgos pa'o// gnyis pa sems yengs med kyi dran pa sgom gyi dngos gzhir thag gcod nges shes bskyed pa ni/ de ltar 'khor 'das kyi rtsa ba rang gi sems/ bzang ngan thams cad kyi dran mkhan rang gi sems/ chos 'jig rten gyi byed po rang gi sems/ skye ba snga phyi bar ma'i las dge sdig sogs byed mkhan rang gi sems/ las de rnams kyi 'bras bu bde sdug thams cad myong mkhan yang rang gi sems/ mdor na kun byed rgyal po rang sems 'di nyid de/ thams cad kyi rtsa ba rang sems 'di la thug phyir rang sems 'di nyid 'dul ba dang*/

sbyong bar byed pa ni gal du che ba ste/ chu gcod na/ chu mgo'i phug nas bcad na mtha' rang chod la 'gro ba yin ma gtogs mtha' nas gcod stangs byas kyang chod rgyu med pa'i dpe dang 'dra ba ste/ rang res 'khor ba'i rtsa ba gcod na 'khor ba'i rtsa ba byed po rang sems kyi rtsa ba gcod dgos ma gtogs/ rang sems rtsa ba ma chod phyin 'khor ba las grol thabs med pa yin/ gzhan yang dper mtshon par shing gcod par rtsa ba nas bcad na yal ga rang chod la 'gro la/ rtsa ba nas ma bcad pas yal ga bcad kyang slar skye ba'i dpe bzhin/ rang res las ngan pa'i sgrib pa dang sdug bsngal sbyong na de'i skyed byed rang sems 'di ka'i gzhi rtsa gcod dgos la/ 'di nyid ma bcad pa'i gzhan lus ngag gi dge sbyor la sogs kyis 'phral tsam ma gtogs sgrib pa las ngan rtsa ba nas mi chod pas slar las sgrib gsog pa yin pa dang*/ yang dper mtshon na rang gis gzhan gyi sde dpung thul cing dbang du 'dus par byed pa la/ yul de'i rgyal po'am dpon de thub na sde 'khor thams cad rang shugs kyis thub 'gro ba ma gtogs/ rgyal po ma thub pa'i sde dang g.yog 'khor 'ga' re thub kyang des go mi chod pa'i dpes/ kun byed rgyal po rang sems 'di nyid rang gis 'dul na gzhan zhor du 'gro la/ de min rang sems ma thul rang rig dbang du ma 'dus na gzhan bskyed rdzogs bzlas brjod lus ngag gi dge sbyor byed mdog byas kyang*/ dper na rgyal po ma thub tshe g.yog 'khor re gnyis thub kyang go mi chod pa'i dpes/ rang sems dbang du ma 'dus pas rang la dgos don mi yong ba sogs mdor na thams cad kyi byed po da lta'i rang re rnams kyi sems mi dran dgu dran rgod cing 'tshubs la ngan long can 'di rang gis rang 'dul ba gal che ba'i rgyu mtshan de ltar yin/ rang sems 'di nyid rang gis 'dul ba dang skyong ba ma shes pas yengs 'khrul brjed pa dang de'i dbang du song na rang 'khor bar 'khyams pa'i rtsa ba thams cad 'di las 'byung*/

rang sems 'di nyid yengs brjed 'khrul pa'i dbang du ma song bar/ rang gis rang 'tsho zhing ma brjed rang ngo shes na chos thams cad kyi snying po lam thams cad kyi rtsa ba 'di la 'dus/ chos thams cad kyi rtsa ba lam thams cad kyi snying po rang sems ma yengs dran pa 'di la 'dus don ni/ da res sngon nas bshad bzhin 'khor 'das bzang ngan legs nyes bde sdug thams cad rang sems 'di kas byed pas thams cad sems 'di la thug pa de'i don gyis yin/ des na gzhi 'khor 'das thams cad kyi byed po rang gi sems te/ gzhi 'khor 'das thams cad kyi rtsa ba rang sems 'di nyid yin phyir/ lam rang sems ma yengs pa 'di sgom thams cad kyi rtsa ba'am don gyi snying por ma song rang song los yin pa de ltar shes dgos/ de'ang*/ rje dwags po rin po ches/ ma yengs pa ni sangs rgyas kun gyi lam// ma yengs pa ni dge ba'i bshes dang gnyen// ma yengs pa ni gdams pa kun gyi gtso// ma yengs rgyun gyi dran pa 'di// dus gsum sangs rgyas gzhung lam yin// ces gsungs pas/ gsung de'i go don ni/ de ltar kun gyi rtsa ba rang sems ma yengs pa'i dran pa 'di sangs rgyas thams cad kyi lam gyi gtso bo'i snying po ma yengs pa'i dran pa 'di lam gyi sa mkhan bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen/ ma yengs pa'i dran pa ni gdams pa zab mo thams cad kyis gtso bo mchog rab ste/ de yang rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thams cad kyis rang sems ma yengs pa'i lam 'di la brten pas na sangs rgyas thams cad kyi lam gyi gtso bo/ rang sems ma yengs pa'i dran pa 'dis byang chub kyi lam thams cad ston par byed pas na lam gyi sa mkhan bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen/ chos thams cad rang sems la thug pas na/ rang sems ma yengs dran pa 'di gdams ngag thams cad kyi gtso bo de ltar grub pa yin la/ des na ma yengs rgyun gyi dran pa 'di// dus gsum sangs rgyas rnams kyi gzhung lam yin// ces gsungs pa ni/

sngon byon rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thams cad kyang ma yengs pa dran pa'i lam mchog 'di nyid la brten nas mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas/ ma 'ongs 'byon 'gyur rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thams cad kyang ma yengs dran pa'i lam 'di nyid la brten nas mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgya bar 'gyur/ da ltar phyogs bcu'i zhing rab 'byams na bzhugs pa'i rgyal ba thams cad kyang ma yengs dran pa'i lam 'di nyid la brten nas 'tshang rgya bar mdzad pa yin/ dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyang ma yengs pa dran pa'i lam 'di nyid la brten nas mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas pa las/ lam 'di nyid la ma brten pa'i sangs rgyas pa ni su yang mi srid pa ste/ des na rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas sngar byon dang da bzhugs phyis 'byon te dus gsum rgyal ba thams cad rang sems ma yengs pa dran pa'i lam 'di kho na la brten pa yin pas de ltar gsungs pa yin la/ lam 'di phyi nang gsar rnying nges don thams cad kyi rtsa ba mchog rab mdo 'gags gnad don thams cad rang sems ma yengs pa'i dran pa 'di kho na'i lam 'di kar brten pa yin pa ste/ phyi pa mu stegs pa'am bon po la sogs pa'i nges don gyi khrid kyang rang sems lta ba ni mtshungs la/ nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i nges don gyi gzhung lam che ba/ phyag rgya chen po/ rdzogs pa chen po/ dbu ma chen po sogs thams cad kyang rang sems yengs med kyi dran pa skyong ba 'dir gcig la/ rang sems ngo bo mi skyong ba'i lam ni gang du'ang mi srid pas/ rang sems rang ngo shes bzhin dran pas skyong ba 'di lam thams cad kyi snying po/ bsgom don thams cad kyi rtsa ba/ nyams len thams cad kyi mthar thug /man ngag thams cad kyi mdo 'gags/ zab don thams cad kyi gnad gsang yin pas de ltar shes shing go la thag chod pa dang yid ches nges shes chig dril du skyed par byed dgos pa'o// gsum pa sems dus gsum gyi spros pa gcod nas 'jog par bshad pa ni/

de ltar sems ma yengs pa'i dran pa skyong ba de las gzhan bzo bcos gang yang mi byed de/ rang sems 'das pa'i bya byed bsam pa 'das tshar ba rnams kyi rjes mi gcod/ ma 'ongs pa gzhi nas byed rgyu la sogs pa thams cad da lta nas bsam pas sdon mi bsu/ da ltar gyi shes pa gnas pa/ 'gyu ba/ ji ltar snang yang de la slar dpyad gzhig mi byed cing khyad par gzhan du ma yengs par byed/ de yang 'das pa 'gags tshar cing song zin pas da lta bsam byar med la/ ma 'ongs pa yang da ltar ma phyin ma grub yul na med pas bsam kyang dgos pa med cing*/ da lta ba der yang brtags shing dpyad na da lta yengs rkyen dang mthar don med la/ des na 'das pa mi bsam/ ma 'ongs pa mi bsu/ da lta bar yengs 'khrul bsam blo mi gtong bar kha nang du log la rang sems rang gis blta nas rang ngo de ka'i thog tu 'jog /yin min yod med bzang ngan la sogs pa mtshan 'dzin gyi dri ma cung zad kyis kyang ma bsgribs par gnas lugs kyi rang gshis ma bcos pa de ka'i ngang du bzhag /lar phyag rgya chen po gzhi'i gnas lugs don du dus gsum gyi spros pa la ma ltos pa zhig yin yang*/ gsar pas de ltar ngo mi shes mi rtogs pas na dang po rang sems dus gsum gyi bsam blor ma yengs pa gal che/ de ltar ched du bsam blo thams cad phral nas sems gnas gnas bde bde rang zhig 'dod pa'i bsam pas bsgrim drags na mi yong*/ ched du 'di bsgom la sogs bsgom byas bcings na des 'ching zhing*/ sems stong pa yin bsam pa'i blo bzo sogs byas na de ka rnam rtog yin pas skyon du 'gyur mod/ gang 'dra zhig yin na sems rang ngo rang gshis de ka ma yengs tsam ma brjed tsam gyi dran 'dun thu re ba de las gzhan bsam blo gang yang med par lhod de glod la 'jog /lhod pa de'i ngang du sems rang gshis de ka lhug par gnas te bsdad na de ka rang ngo yin mod/ de ltar mi sdod pa'i rnam rtog sna tshogs dran byung na/

der ni sems sdod mi sdod/ 'gyu ba byung ma byung bsam pa sogs mi byed par rang ngo ma yengs tsam de ka'i ngang nas/ rnam rtog thams cad ma yengs pa'i dran pa de kas ngos zin par byas/ ngos zin nas rnam rtog rang ngo de kar glod/ de bzhin glod pa'i dran pa ma yengs pa rgyun ji tsam byung na de yang dran pas ma yengs ma brjed par bya/ sems yengs rnam rtog ngos ma zin na de nas slar yang dran 'dun bsgrims te 'jog /yang gnas sam mi gnas rnam rtog ci byung yang dran pa de'i ngang ma shor ba nas gang shar ngo bo skyong*/ yang dran pa ngang shor brjed yengs 'khrul na dran pa bsgrim te 'jog pa de ltar dgos pa yin te/ sems nyid ngal gso las/ dang por lhod kyis glod la zhog /bsam gtan dri ma bsal ba'i phyir// bar du hrig ge ye re ltos// mnyam rjes 'dres par bya ba'i phyir// tha ma phyam rtser gtang bar bya// sngar byas mi dpyad sngon mi bsu// da ltar 'dzin med nam mkha' bzhag /dus gsum rtog pa'i 'gro 'ong bcad// de ltar rtog med ting 'dzin gnas// zhes dang*/ rje dwags po rin po ches/ 'das pa'i rjes mi gcod/ ma 'ongs pa'i sngon mi bsu/ da ltar gyi shes pa yang dag rnal mar tsan gyis zhog /de la 'das pa'i rjes mi gcod zer tsa na/ 'o skol gyi blo rnam rtog snga ma'i phyir mi 'brang ba yin/ ma 'ongs pa'i sngon mi bsu zer tsa na 'o skol gyi blo rnam par rtog pa phyi ma'i sngon mi bsu ba yin/ da ltar gyi shes pa rnal mar tsan gyis zhog zer tsa na da ltar gang du'ang mi dmigs pa la zer ba yin/ sems ma bcos na gsal/ chu ma rnyogs na dwangs bya ba yin pas ma bcos pa'i ngang la rang gar tsan gyis zhog /de ltar bzhag pas gsal la rtog pa med pa sing nge ye re ba se gol gtog pa tsam mam/ ba 'jo ba'i yun tsam la sogs 'ong ste/ de yun ring ba la yon tan du mi lta/ thung ba la skyon du mi lta bar bsgom/

de'i rjes la rnam par rtog pa gcig yong de la glod nas 'jog /'jur bus bcings pa'i sems nyid 'di// glod na grol bar the tshom med/ ces bya ba yin pas glod pa yin/ de ltar glod cing bsgoms pas gsal la rtog pa med pa de yun je ring je ring ci rigs skye na rang gi ngo bo'i steng du phril gyis 'gro ba 'ong*/ de ltar chu bo'i rgyun gyi ting nge 'dzin bya ba de la zer ba yin/ zhes dang*/ yang ḍom bhi he ru ka'i dgongs pa/ rje dwags po rin po che nyid kyis gsungs pa ni/ chu ma snyogs na dwangs pa bzhin ngang tshul ma bcos par bzhag go /nyi ma sprin gyis ma bsgribs pa bzhin du tshogs drug mi dgag par rang lugs su bzhag go /dus dang spyod lam thams cad du ma yengs par bzhag go /zhes pa shin tu gsal bar gsungs pa ste/ de ltar gyi bsgom don rnams gnad ma 'dzol bar rang gis nyams su blangs dgos pa'o// bzhi pa gnas 'gyu rang babs kyi ngo bo skyong ba ni/ de ltar rang sems dus gsum gyi spros par ma yengs pa'i rang rig ma bcos pa ngo shes dran pa'i rang thog tu bzhag pa de las/ sems gzhan du mi 'phro bar 'dug na de gnas pa yin pas/ gnas na gnas thog gi ngo bo gnas yod bsam pas shes bzhin du skyong*/ gnas pa de yang rang babs su gnas pa'i ngo bo ma brjed tsam du dran 'dun gyis skyong ba las/ gzhan gnas pa'i ngo bo ngos bzung dbyibs dang kha dog gzugs su grub pa med cing gnas pas rang bzhin du sems lhod de sdod pa las/ 'od la sogs pa'i gsal cha dang mthong cha ci yang med/ gnas pa de yang yun ring thung la ma ltos te/ cung zhig yun ring na ring ba de ka'i ngo bo ma brjed par skyong*/ yun ring po rang zhig las dang po pa sgom gsar rnams la gnas dka' bas skad cig tsam las ma gnas kyang de'i ngo bo ma brjed par skyong ste/ don du yun ring thung la rtsis gdab kyis yun ring du gnas pa e 'ong re ba dang*/

yun ring mi gnas dogs pa dang*/ gnas su re ba dang mi gnas dogs pa sogs mi byed/ gnas yun ring ba'am thung ba ji ltar byung ba de'i ngo bo ma brjed par skyong*/ gnas pa'i ngo bo ma brjed pa de yang logs nas blta bya lta mkhan yod pa ma yin pas gnas pa'i ngo bo sems bsdad yod pa de gar yod mi rig pa lta bu'i yengs pa min pa gnas na gnas yod/ bsdad na bsdad yod bsam pas ma brjed par skyong ba yin/ de ltar mi gnas pa'i 'gyu ba ni/ sems ma yengs par rang thog tu bzhag kyang sdod du mi nyan pa'am yang na de snga 'di byas der song der bsdad kyi bsam blo/ yang na ma 'ongs par 'di dag byed dgos kyi bsam blo/ yang na da lta yin kyang mig gis gzugs mthong rna bas sgra thos pa sogs/ de'i thog tu rig pa tur gyis 'gro ba ste/ 'das pa ma 'ongs da lta gsum dran pa/ thag ring thung gang du'ang 'gro zhing*/ bzang po ngan pa ci yang dran pa de mi dran pa'i dgag rgyu med de/ 'gyu ba dngos med bser bu 'dra// 'dzin pa ma zhugs 'gyus pas chog /ces lha rtse ba'i gsung bzhin las/ 'gyu ba dngos med rlung lta bu de rlung sbar bas bzung bas mi zin cing*/ sgo bcad nas mi phyugs nang du bcug pa bzhin 'jog tu med pas/ sems 'phro ba de dgag mi dgos/ 'gyu ba de ma dran na bsam pa'i ngan par bzung nas spong mi dgos/ don du gnas pa sems kyi ngo bo/ 'gyu ba sems kyi rang mdangs/ dper na chu dang chu'i rlabs lta bu/ nyi ma dang nyi ma'i 'od zer lta bu las gnyis su med/ gnas pa'i sems bzang po zhig /'gyu ba'i sems ngan pa zhig /sems na de gnyis gnyis su med/ gnyis su med pa de gnyis su bzung nas bzo bcos dgag sgrub byed pa ni don ma go ba yin pas/ de ltar mi byed par/ 'gyu ba sngar byas da byed da lta phra rags sbom gsum bzang ngan 'bring gsum gyi rtog pa ci shar ci dran gang dran de nyid ma yengs pa'i dran rdzi des ngos zin par byas nas ngos zin bzhin bzo bcos mi byed par 'gyu ba dran thog gi ngo bo ngo shes su skyong*/

des rigs 'gres pa las/ 'gyu ba de yang gcig dran nas sdod rgyu med pas gcig dran gnyis dran sna tshogs su dran pa yod pas gang ltar dran pa thams cad ma rig pas 'khrul cing yengs pa lta bu ma yin pa'i ci dran yengs med kyi dran pa des ngos zin pa'i rang thog tu 'jog dgos/ ngos zin zer ba ni mig gis mthong rgyu'am ngo bo ngos bzung dngos po zhig sems yul na mthong rgyu med kyang*/ sngon nas bshad ltar 'das ma 'ongs kyi bsam blo da ltar mig gis gzugs mthong rna bas sgra thos pa de thog 'gro ba de rnams gong ltar dran pa ma yengs pa'i 'dun pa des/ de 'gyu de dran bsam pa'i ngos zin par byas nas ngos zin bzhin 'phro gcod pa'am tshur bkug pa sogs bzo bcos mi byed par 'gyu ba dran na dran thog gi ngo bo ma brjed par skyong*/ des rigs 'gres pa las 'gyu ba gang dran thams cad ngos zin na des chog /ngos zin pa de yang las dang po pa rnams yun ring po zhig mi yong bas 'ga' re tsam dang por ngos zin kyang de nas bar du gar yengs ma rig pa lta bu'i yengs brjed nas ngos mi zin pa'ang yod/ de mi yong ba da lta nas mi yong ste/ rang re rnams tshe rabs 'khor ba thog med nas yengs 'khrul 'di la goms shing 'dris/ da lta yang rang nyid skye ba blangs nas da lta'i bar yengs 'khrul brjed pa 'ba' zhig las/ ma yengs pa ni da lta'i yud tsam byed mdog 'di ma gtogs ma shes/ de ltar yengs 'khrul der ni goms 'dris cha/ ma yengs pa'i dran pa 'dir ni goms 'dris chung bas ma yengs pa brtan po rang zhig dang po nas ci la yong bas bar du yengs 'gro ba sogs los yong yang*/ de la yengs pa de ngos ma zin na slar ma yengs pa dran pa rgyun 'tsho'am/ bag med pas yengs nas yengs/ brjed nas brjed bzhin gyi dbang du ma song ba'i ma yengs pa'i dran pa brten/ bar du brjed yengs byung yang de'i rjes nas da res yengs shor bsam pa'i yengs pa de ngos zin pa dang*/

slar ma yengs ma brjed par byed dgos bsam pa'i 'dun pa yang dag brten pa de'i ngang nas sdon bzhin gnas 'gyu ngo shes su skyong ba de bzhin gal che/ de la dang po nas yengs dogs kyis bag yod sems khur drag po skad cig gcig kyang ma yengs pa byed dgos bsam pa dang*/ bar du yengs skabs byung yang de'i dbang du ma song ba'i 'dun pa chad mthud dran pa rgyun 'tshor skyong ba de bzhin dgos/ rang gi rang 'tsho'i dran pa ma yengs pa brten pa ni nyams len gyi rtsa ba sgom gyi dngos gzhi yin par shes par gyis/ dran thog nas rang sems 'gro 'dug gnyis por rang gis rang la lta ba las gzhan du bsgom rgyu med/ rig pa gang shar gyi ngo shes na des chog pa las gzhan du bzang bzang gsal gsal zhig 'tshol mi dgos/ rang sems ngo shes su skyong ba las gzhan pa'i kha phyir bltas kyi blta rgyu dang shar rgyu e yod bsam na/ de ni yod pa'i sgo bor nas med pa'i srang mdor 'khyams/ don shar du bzhag nas kha nub tu lta nas 'gro ba dang 'dra/ bsgoms bsgom thams cad don med du 'gro/ ngal ba thams cad la 'bras bu med par 'gyur bas de ltar ma song bar/ rang la yod pa'i rig thog tu skyong*/ rang la yod pa de phar bzhag nas gzhan nas med pa de 'tshol du ma 'gro/ rig pa'i ngo bo ci yang dran gang yang 'gro ba 'di ka la ltos/ rig pa gsal mi gsal la rtsis gdab ma btang*/ gnas 'gyu la dgag sgrub ma byed/ ci gnas gang shar gyi rang bab de kar bzo bcos kyi lhad ma 'jug par rang 'gros su skyong*/ dran pa ma yengs pa de skad cig kyang brjed du mi 'jug par rang gis rang 'tsho skyong ba la brtson dgos pa'o// lnga pa yul snang gi steng du ma bcos shes bzhin skyong ba ni/ de ltar mnyam bzhag gi ngo bo skyong ba der nang du gnas 'gyu'i ngo bo ngo shes su skyong ba tsam ma yin pa'i phyi rol yul snang bsres nas skyong dgos shing*/

de skyong ma shes na phyi yul gyi snang ba dang mi 'dres/ de yang yul snang dang mi 'dre ba tsam du ma zad 'ga' zhig la zang zing 'ar 'ur gyi gnod pa med na bsam pa sogs khong khro'am mi bde ba'i snang ba yong ba'am/ yang na 'ga' res yul snang de thog tu yengs shor ba la sogs kyi tha mal 'khrul par 'gro nyen yod pa yin pas/ des na phyi nas zang zing 'gro 'dug 'ur sgra gtam la sogs pas gnod par mi bde ba'i snang ba de'i dbang du song na snang ba dgrar langs kyi 'phrang zer ba'i gol sa yin cing*/ yul snang gi steng du ngos ma zin par yengs shor na sems tha mal du shor ba yin pas don med la/ de 'drar ma song ba'i rang gi ma yengs pa'i dran pa des mig gis gzugs mthong na mthong thog tu ma yengs/ gzugs legs nyes la 'dzin pa bsam blo rtog dpyod mi gtong bar gzugs rig thog tu ma yengs pa'i dran pa glod nas skyong*/ legs nyes kyi rnam rtog byung na de ga ngo shes kyi dran pas ma brjed par skyong*/ des rigs 'gres pa las/ rna bas sgra che chung gang thos kyang de thog tu ma yengs par skyong*/ der rtog dpyod bsam blo'i dbang du ma shor bar bya/ rtog dpyod byung yang de'i ngo bo ma brjed par skyong*/ gal te 'gro 'dug zang zing 'ur sgra gtam sgra la sogs kyis gnod pa'i snang ba med na ma byung na bsam pa'i mi bde ba byung na de ngos ma zin nas kha yan du ma shor bar mi bde ba'i snang ba de rang gi rtog pa lhang nge ba de ma brjed par skyong*/ mi dga' ba zhig gi rnam rtog byung na de ngos bzung nyon mongs kha yan du ma shor bar zhe sdang na sdang mkhan gyi rtog pa'i steng du ma brjed par skyong*/ des rigs 'gres pa las/ gzhan sna'i yul du dri/ lce'i yul du ro/ lus kyi yul du reg bya la sogs 'dod yon gang snang gi steng du ma brjed par skyong*/ 'di'i 'dod yon lam khyer so so ni rjes kyi sems kyi lam khyer skabs bshad par bya ba las 'dir rgyas par bshad ma dgos/

da lam mnyam bzhag gi ngo thog gzugs sgra la sogs yul snang gi steng du sems ngo skyong 'khyer bshad pa yin pa de bzhin go bar bya dgos/ de ltar mnyam bzhag nas rjes lam rdzogs 'bras bur smon pa ni/ thun khrid las/ nyams myong mthar phyin rtogs pa mngon du gyur// snang rig rtsal rdzogs chos nyid zad sar 'khyol// sku bzhi'i 'bras bu tshe 'dir bde bar 'grub// mi zad 'khor los 'gro kun 'dren gyur cig /ces bshad pa de'i don 'di ltar ngo sprod bgyis pa'i rang rig sems kyi ngo bo legs par bskyangs pa de'i mthus/ nyams myong mthar phyin rtse gcig /gnas lugs kyi rtogs pa mngon gyur spros bral/ snang thog tu rig pa'i rtsal rdzogs pa ro gcig /chos nyid zad sar 'khyol ba sgom med dang*/ yang na rgyud bla mar/ mi g.yo chos rnams thams cad kyi// rtse gcig phyir na brtags pa nyid// ces pa lta bu rtse gcig /gzhan gyi rkyen gyis rtogs min pa// zhes pa lta bu spros bral/ mkhyen pa'i skad cig gcig nyid la// shes bya'i dkyil 'khor kun khyab cing*// zhes pa lta bu ro gcig /'dus ma byas shing lhun gyis grub// ces pa lta bu sgom med/ de bzhin mngon du gyur pa de nyid rtse gcig sprul pa'i sku/ spros bral longs sku/ ro gcig chos sku/ sgom med ngo bo nyid sku ste/ de ltar gyi 'bras bu ring por mi thogs par tshe 'dir bde bar 'grub nas sangs rgyas te/ sku gsung thugs mi zad pa rgyan gyi 'khor los 'gro kun pha mar ma gyur pa gcig kyang med de drin chen sha stag yin la 'di rnams 'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi gzhir tshud pa bdag gis ci ste bzod/ 'di rnams bdag gis 'dren nus par gyur cig /snyam pas bdag las gzhan gces bya dgos pa'o// de lta bu ni rang don rtogs pa mthar phyin/ gzhan don phrin las lhun grub rgyun mi chad du 'byung ba'i rgyu'i gtso bo ste/

rnam snang mngon byang las/ thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes kyi rgyu ni byang chub kyi sems so// zhes sogs mang du gsungs shing*/ rje lha rtse bas/ byams pa'i rtsa ba rab brtan pas// snying rjes gzhan gyi sdug bsngal skyob// bdag las gzhan gces rgyun du bsgom// lag len bsdu ba bzhi la bslab// 'gro drug sems can brtse bas bskyang*// kho bo'i snying gtam gnyis pa yin// zhes gsungs/ 'on kyang mthar thug sems bskyed ni/ rje rgya ras kyis/ sems bcos ma'i sems bskyed ma yin pa'i// stong nyid dang snying rje dbyer med 'di// mthar thug gi sems bskyed yin par nges// bdag gzhan gyi 'dzin pa stor te thal// zhes gsungs pa ltar dang*/ yang na gong ma rnams kyis/ zhen pa'i gnyen po stong pa/ stong pa'i gnyen po snying rje/ de gnyis zung 'jug gi rtogs pa la dmigs med kyi snying rje de gong du na 'phar bas rtsol med du sems can re re'i mdun du sprul pa sogs kyis sku bzhi'i yon tan rdzogs pa'i 'brel tshad don ldan la 'bras bu phyag rgya chen po/ zhes gsungs so// thun khrid du/ rjes dge ba rdzogs byang du rgyas 'debs pa la sogs/ bsngo smon shis brjod gsum bstan pa de la/ rang 'dod med pa'i snying rjes rang gi dge tshogs thams cad sems can rnams kyi don du bsngo smon dpag med kyis mtshams sbyar ba ni tshogs gnyis rgyu'i gtso bor grub ste/ bsngo ba'i le'u las/ ji ltar rgya mtsho che nang chu thigs lhung*// rgya mtsho ma zad bar du de mi 'dzad// de bzhin byang chub yongs bsngo'i dge ba yang*// byang chub ma thob bar du de mi 'dzad// ces sogs du ma dang de bzhin/ rje 'bri gung pas/ tshogs gnyis yid bzhin nor bu la// smon lam gyi byi dor ma byas na// dgos 'dod kyi 'bras bu mi smin pas// rjes bsngo ba 'di la nan tan mdzod// ces gsungs/ rje lha rtse bas/

'gro drug gi don du thugs bskyed nas// las dkar po dge bcus dus 'da' bar// de 'khor gsum yongs su dag na rab// de min yang byang chub yongs bsngo 'tshal// zhes gsungs/ mthar thug bsngo ba de yang gshis kyi bzhugs tshul mngon du gyur na 'khor gsum yongs dag gi bsngo ba ste/ gang zhe na/ bsngo bya sngo byed sngo mkhan gsum rang sems kyi steng du mi dmigs pas/ bcos ma gnyis 'dzin gyi bsngo ba min pas zung 'jug gi bsngo ba'o// de lta bu ni 'gro don gyi'ang rtse mo ste/ rje rgod tshang pas/ 'gro don gyi mthar thug rang 'dod med pa'i snying rje yin te kun la las 'brel 'jog cing smon lam dpag tu med pa thob/ ces gsungs pa dang*/ rje lha rtse bas/ lkog tu smon lam 'debs pa las// g.yeng bas 'gro don byed ma khoms// zhes gsungs so// mthar phyogs dus skyabs gnas rab 'byams yongs kyi byin rlabs me tog char chen rdzogs par bsnyil bar mos nas/ rtsa gsum lha tshogs kyi shis brjod bden grub bcas pas ni/ rang nyid gang gnas yul khams bkra shis shing*/ dam chos sgrub pa'i lam gyi bar chad mi mthun pa'i phyogs mtha' dag zhi zhing*/ phun tshogs mtha' dag yid bzhin du 'byor te/ bkra shis dge legs mi 'bral brtan pa'i dgos pa yod de/ rnal 'byor pa ni bsam pas 'grub// tshul khrims ldan pas bden pa 'grub// ces gsungs/ tshul 'di dag kyang phan yon dgos ched mang po yod phyir gal chung du 'jog par mi bya'o// ༈ //drug pa spyod lam rnam bzhi dus kun dran pas rgyun 'tsho skyong ba ni/ thun khrid las/ dus rnams rtag par skad cig mi 'khrul bar// spyod lam bzang ngan rkyen tshogs ma lus kun// shes bzhin 'dzin med ro snyoms lam du khyer// kun khyab bde ba chen por brtan thob bya// zhes bshad pa de la rang rig gi ngo bo ma yengs pa de yang mnyam bzhag skyong lo skad cig tsam pa de las/

dus rgyun spyod lam bzhi dang bsre zhing skyong ma shes na sgom za 'gro la sogs dang mi 'dres/ de ma 'dres phyin mnyam bzhag rang ni skad cig re lta bu'i yun thung ngu re las yun ring por skyong mi nus/ de ma nus phyin rang gi ma yengs pa'i dran pa de la brtan cha yong dus mi yong bas rang gi sgom pa de la 'bras bu mdo don cher mi yong ba yin pas/ de ltar ma yin par rang gi sems nyid yengs med kyi dran pa dus rgyun rang za 'gro las gsum la sogs spyod lam rnam pa bzhi 'di tsho dang bsre dgos/ 'di la lung 'dren ni/ 'bum las/ rab 'byor ji ltar byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po nang gi lus la lus kyi rjes su blta zhing*/ rnam par spyod pa yin zhe na/ rab 'byor 'di la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'gro na 'gro'o zhes bya bar rab tu shes so// 'greng na 'greng ngo zhes bya bar rab tu shes so// 'dug na 'dug go zhes bya bar rab tu shes so// nyal na nyal lo zhes bya bar rab tu shes so// de'i lus nyams bde ba dang nyams mi bde ba yang rung ste/ ji ltar gnas pa de ltar rab tu shes te/ zhes gsungs/ de bsre lugs ji lta bu yin zhe na/ dper na rang 'gro dus lta bu yin kyang*/ har te longs tshubs se 'gro/ blta sa gar rnyed gtam rgyu ci mang*/ yengs shes ci che ma yin pa'i/ rang langs dus lta bu yin na da res nga langs nas 'gro dus 'di la ma yengs par byed dgos bsam pa'i 'dun pa de'i ngang nas langs/ 'gro dus lta bu yin na yengs sa gar rnyed kyi bag med mi byed par/ rang mig lta stangs rang mdun du phab nas lta ba'i tsho bzung*/ sems ma yengs dgos bsam pa'i 'dun pa rgyun 'tsho brten/ 'gro ba'i skabs su yin kyang gom pa gcig spo gnyis spo gom grangs dang sa tshod lta bur chags bzhag pa'i ma yengs pa brten/ des rigs 'gres pa las/ sdod na'ang lus bag med sems 'khrul pa'i dbang du mi sdod par/

lus kyi gnad rnam snang gi chos bdun/ mig lta stangs tsho ma shor ba/ sems ma yengs pa'i gnad tsho ci zin du 'bad pa thon/ yang gong 'phros lung las/ rab 'byor gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po nang gi lus la mi dmigs pa'i tshul gyis lus kyi rjes su blta zhing rnam par spyod de/ de 'gro'am 'ong yang shes bzhin du spyod pa yin/ blta'am rnam par blta'ang shes bzhin du spyod pa yin/ bskum mam brkyang yang shes bzhin du spyod pa yin/ sbyar ma dang lhung bzed 'chang zhing spyad kyang shes bzhin du spyod pa yin/ zos pa 'chos pa dang 'thung ba dang myong ba la'ang shes bzhin du spyod pa yin/ nyal ba dang gnyid kyis mya myo bsal ba la'ang shes bzhin du spyod pa yin/ 'gro ba dang 'ong ba'ang shes bzhin du spyod pa yin/ 'grengs pa dang 'dug pa'ang shes bzhin du spyod pa yin/ gnyid kyis log gam ma log na'ang shes bzhin du spyod pa yin/ smra ba dang mi smra na'ang shes bzhin du spyod pa yin/ nang du yang dag 'jog pa la yang shes bzhin du spyod pa yin te/ rab 'byor de ltar na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ nang gi lus la de mi dmigs pa'i tshul gyis lus kyi rjes su blta zhing brtson 'grus can shes bzhin dang ldan pa dran pa dang ldan pas 'jig rten gyi chags sems dang yid mi bde ba rnam par bsal zhing rnam par spyod do// zhes gsungs pa de bzhin no// zas kham gcig za na'ang sems ma yengs pa/ skom hub gcig 'thung na'ang sems ma yengs pa/ gtam tshig gcig smra na'ang de thog tu sems ma yengs pa/ las ka che chung ci byed kyang de thog tu sems ma yengs pa/ dal brel ci byung yang de thog tu sems ma yengs pa/ nyal 'dug kyang de thog tu sems ma yengs pa ste/ mdor na 'gro 'dug za 'thung las ka dal brel dus nam yang sems 'khrul pa bag med yengs brjed rgya 'byams su ma shor ba'i/

dang po rang za 'thung las ka 'gro 'dug ci byed kyang de'i sngon du da res skad cig gcig kyang ma yengs par byed dgos bsam pa'i 'dun pa rgyun 'tsho bag yod sems khur drag po byed/ bar du brjed skabs los yong ste/ brjed skabs de'i dbang du ma shor ba'i slar 'dun pa chad 'thud/ yengs pa de ngos bzung ba'i phyir da res rang yengs shor yang da ma yengs par byed dgos bsam pa'i 'dun pa rgyun 'tsho mu mthud du brten pa de lta bu zhig gal che/ de ltar ma byung bar mnyam bzhag 'dra zhig 'dug dus de ma gtogs spyod lam thams cad du dran pa yengs med kyi shes pa 'di la brtson 'grus ma nus na/ mnyam bzhag de rang gi rgyun ring mi nus/ des na dran pa ma yengs pa ni skad cig ma 'ga' re las mi 'byung*/ rgyun du lo zla zhag dus kyi ring thams cad du 'gro 'dug las ka thams cad de'i ngang du 'byams/ sems 'khrul pa dang yengs pa dang brjed pa rang gi rang bzhin du mi tshe 'gro ba las mi yong*/ des na rang gi sems ma yengs pa'i dran pa brtan cha yong dus mi yong bas rang gi chos thob pa don med zhig las mi yong bas de 'drar ma song ba'i dus rgyun spyod lam rnam pa bzhi za 'gro nyal 'dug thams cad du sems ma yengs pa'i dran pa rgyun 'tsho skyong ba gal che/ ma yengs pa'i dran pa 'di dus rgyun rang dal brel nam yin rung*/ rang la skyid sdug legs nyes ci 'dra zhig byung rung gzhi byes lam gsum gang du'ang ma brjed pas rgyun 'tshor ma bskyangs na/ rang re rnams yengs brjed 'khrul pa 'di la ni/ tshe rabs 'khor ba thog med nas bzung da lta'i bar du brjed 'khrul de rang gi dbang du song*/ yengs brjed 'khrul pa 'di 'ba' zhig la goms shing 'dris pa 'di las bzlog pa dang*/ 'di nyid 'phro chod pa dka'/ ma yengs pa'i dran pa 'di ni tshe rabs sngon nas kyang ma goms/ da lta'ang dpe chags bzhag na/
