rang chung nas da lta'i bar lo grangs ci tsam song ba de'i ring du/ ma yengs pa'i dran pa ni skad cig kyang brten ma shes pas yengs brjed 'khrul pa rang gi dbang du song ba las/ 'khrul pa dang dran pa 'di gnyis 'khrul pa la goms shing 'dris/ dran shes la goms 'dris rtsa ba nas ma song bas/ de dang de gnyis dbang che chung shed che chung mi mnyam pa lta bu'i 'khrul pa dang yengs brjed rang shed dang dbang che ba yong ba las/ da res rang gis nges don gyi gdams ngag thob pa'i dus/ de yi snying po rang sems dran pa ma yengs pa sgom gyi rtsa ba 'di bzhin tsho ci zin/ ma yengs pa'i dran pa la rkang ci tshugs shig gal du che ba de ni dang po nas dus thams cad du bag yod dran shes brtson 'grus chen po zhig ma byas pas rang shugs 'bad med lhun grub zhig ni yong dka' bas de ltar rang gis bsam pas dus rnams kun tu rang gi sems ma yengs pa'i dran pa 'di brjed 'byams su ma shor ba'i rtsol ba ci che byed dgos/ de la rang dran pa brtan pa ma thob pa'i don gyis za 'gro nyal sdod sogs la dang po nas 'dres pa'i stabs bde po rang mi yong yang*/ de la dpe chags bzhag na rang gi las ka 'don pa sogs ci yin kyang dang po de bslab dgos/ bslab dus de la dang po nas byang byang ba zhig mi yong yang*/ rang gi las ka ci yin yang de la goms 'dris dang*/ 'don pa lta bu yin na yang bshar sbyangs byas na rim gyis blo la 'jags par byang 'gro ba'i dpe dang 'dra ba las/ ma yengs pa'i dran pa 'di yang dang po rang 'gro 'dug la sogs kyi dus ma yengs pa dgos bsam pa'i 'dun pa btang ba tsam las/ de la stabs bde ba dang gsal ba rang mi yong yang dus rgyun rang sems ma brjed pa'i dran pa rgyun 'tshor brten na rim gyis rang la goms 'dris shig yong rgyu yod/ dran pa ma yengs pa de yang 'gro 'dug las ka sogs kyi dus rang bzhin ma yengs pa yad yud ma brjed pa rgyun 'tsho tsam brten pa de las/

gzhan sgom gsar ba tsho la mnyam bzhag rang la 'dug dus gzhan gyi gnas 'gyu gang shar ci dran thams cad ngos zin pa dka' bas de ltar ma byung yang bab kyis dus rnams thams cad du rang sems ma yengs pa'i dran pa rang bab ma brjed pa tsam brten zhing*/ dang po yengs dogs kyi sems khur/ bar du yang nas yang du dran pa gsal 'debs pa/ tha mar brjed pa de ngos bzung ma yengs pa'i dran pa 'phro mthud la rang le lo snyom las g.yeng ba sogs kyi dbang du ma song ba zhig dgos pa gal du che bas de ltar nges par gyis/ de rnams kyis sems kyi 'jog lugs nyams len gyi skyong lugs bshad pa yin// 'phral du thun gyi sgom lugs bsdus don ni/ thun gyi dngos gzhi nyams len gyi skabs/ thun gyi sngon dang dus rgyun du rang blo chos la 'gro ba'i thabs chos la brtson 'grus bskul ba'i rkyen/ dal 'byor rnyed dka'/ rang nyid mi rtag nges par 'chi ba/ 'chi ba nam yong cha med/ shi nas phyi ma'i dus der rang la dgos pa dam pa'i lha chos/ de'ang tshe 'di skad cig tsam gyi 'dun ma dang mi 'dra ba'i rang nyid tshe rabs rnams su shin tu gal che bar bsam pa sogs nas/ thun gyi dngos gzhir/ sngon 'gro thun mong ma yin pa/ skyabs sems sgo nas phyag 'bul ba/ rang gi lus ngag yid gsum sgrib pa sbyong ba dang*/ maṇ+ḍal gyi sgo nas tshogs gsog pa dang*/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor sgo nas bla ma la gsol ba 'debs pas bla ma'i byin rlabs rang la zhu ba'i sgom rim rnams tshad ldan gang 'grub nas/ phyi lus gnad rnam snang chos bdun/ nang ngag gi gnad smra ba'i ngag gcod pa/ gsang ba sems kyi gnad ni/ gzhi rang sems 'di yengs brjed na des rang 'khor ba la 'khyams/ rang dag cing rang ngo shes rang so tshugs na sangs rgyas pa ste/ 'khor 'das thams cad kyi rtsa ba rang gi sems yin/ rang sems 'di ni dus nam yang med par mi 'gro bas skye ba snga phyi thams cad kyi las dge sdig dran mkhan dang de'i las kyi 'bras bu bde sdug myong mkhan thams cad kyang rang gi sems te/

gzhi kun byed rgyal po rang sems 'di nyid 'khor 'das kyi rtsa ba yin par thag gcod/ 'khor 'das kyi rtsa ba rang sems yin phyin chad nas rang sems 'dul ba gal du los che bas/ lam thams cad kyi rtsa ba/ sgom thams cad kyi snying po/ chos thams cad kyi lam gyi gnad 'gags/ rtsa ba rang ni rang gi sems ma brjed ma 'khrul rang gis rang 'tsho ba'i dran dang shes bzhin 'di nyid yin par nges shes yid ches kyis/ sems ma yengs pa'i dran pa rang thog na gnas pa dang 'gyu ba ste rang sems sdod pa'am 'gro ba'i 'gro 'dug 'di gnyis bzo bcos mi byed par 'gro 'dug gang byas ci dran gyi rang ngo ma brjed pa'i rang babs bskyang*/ gnas pa dang 'gyu ba de gnyis ni dper na chu dang chu'i rlabs lta bu yin pa las/ chu de bzang po dang rlabs de ngan pa dang chu de dang mi gcig zer rgyu med pas chu rlabs chu rang las shar la thim pa yang chu bo rang la thim 'gro ba'i dpe bzhin/ rang sems kyi rang bzhin kyang gnas pa de sems kyi ngo bo/ 'gyu ba sna tshogs de sems kyi rang mdangs/ des na gnas pa bzang po zhig gzhan nas yong ba'am/ 'gyu ba ngan pa zhig logs nas ma byung gnas pa de'i sems gcig /'gyu ba de'i sems gcig /de gnyis so sor ma grub pas/ 'gyu ba sna tshogs ci dran yang sems kyi gshis kyi rang 'od las 'char/ de yang chu rlabs chu la thim pa ltar/ sems kho rang gi ngo thog tu rang grol ba las gzhan du ma grub pas/ gnas pa e yong re bas bsgrub/ 'gyu ba ma byung na bsam pa'i dgag pa sogs bzo bcos dgag sgrub kyi dbang du ma song bar/ gnas na'ang gnas yod bsam pa'i gnas pa'i ngo bo ma brjed pa/ 'gyu ba sna tshogs dran pa'ang gcig dran gnyis dran bzang dran ngan dran thams cad de dran bsam pa'i 'gyu ba'i ngo bo ngo shes thog ma brjed par bskyang*/ brjed yengs shor na 'dun pa mu mthud rgyun 'tsho bskyang*/ phyi yul gyi snang ba mig gis gzugs rig na rig thog tu ma yengs pa/

rna bas sgra thos na thos thog tu ma yengs pa'i dran pa skyong*/ des rigs 'gres pas gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya thams cad kyi thog tu ma brjed pa/ de rnams la legs nyes kyi bsam blo dga' mi dga' byung na de 'khrul par ma shor ba'i gang byung de ka ma yengs pa'i dran pas ltos/ 'di ltar mnyam bzhag gis lus ngag yid gsum gnad thams cad rtse gcig pas ma yengs pa dang*/ de nas thun gyi rjes su dge ba bsngo bar bya zhing*/ khyad par mnyam bzhag thun skabs ma yin pa'i dus rgyun 'gro sdod spyod lam za 'thung las ka dal brel nyal langs kha dal 'don brjod sogs spyod lam thams cad du/ dang por rang sems yengs dogs kyis bag yod sems khur dran shes brjed med kyis gzhi bzung*/ bar du brjed skabs 'dun pas gsal 'debs/ tha mar brjed kyang brjed pa'i 'phro de nas dran pa chad mthud yang nas yang du brten pas/ dus kun dran shes bag yod nyams len sgom gyi dngos gzhi dang mi 'bral ba'i gnad gang zin/ dus nam yang dran shes bag yod du bskyangs na rim gyis je drag tu 'gro/ de ltar mnyam bzhag ngo bo de yang rang nyid las ngan pa'i le lo snyom las g.yeng ba sos dal las ngan gyi dbang du ma song bar/ rang nyid tshe rabs gtan don 'di la yun bsrings nas brtson 'grus kyi rtsol ba ci cher dgos pa'o/// /gnyis pa sems kyi skyon sel bshad pa la'ang*/ dang po bying ba'i skyon sel bshad pa/ gnyis pa rmugs pa'i skyon sel bshad pa/ gsum pa rgod pa'i skyon sel bshad pa/ bzhi pa yengs shas che ba'i skyon sel bshad pa/ lnga pa grims lhod ma snyoms pa'i skyon sel bshad pa/ drug pa gnas 'gyu gnyis 'dzin spang blang rnam rtog dgrar langs kyi skyon sel bshad pa/ bdun pa mi bde ba rtsub nyams kyi skyon sel bshad pa/ brgyad pa bzo bcos blos bsgom gyi skyon sel bshad pa dang rnam pa brgyad do// dang po bying ba'i skyon sel bshad pa ni/

de la bying ba ni/ yid rtog med kyi gnas cha la sbyar nas bskyangs pa na/ de'i 'dzin stangs kyi dran pa'i shugs rim pas lhod por song nas mthar rig pa mi gsal zhing sems thom me bar song ba ni/ bying ba che ba'am rags pa dang*/ dran shugs ma shor kyang dran 'dun gyi gsal cha med par rtog med tsam du 'jam nyal le gnas pa'ang bying ba phra mo ma chod pa'i bying zhad yin la/ 'di la 'ga' zhig gis phyi ma zhi gnas skyon med du sems pa'ang yod do// de lta bu'i bying ba phra mo de yang ma bsal bar bskyang na/ ji tsam skyong yun ring ba bzhin du sems kyi gsal ngar mi thon pa dang*/ dran pa rtul du 'gro ba dang*/ brjed nges che ba sogs 'byung bas skyon chen por 'gyur ro// des na skyon de sel tshul la/ lus gnad sngar ltar las/ lta stangs dpang bstod de mig thad kar bltas pas/ sems zhum pa'am 'thibs pa ltar gyur pa las bzlog ste/ sems snang rgya che zhing gu yangs sogs byas pas bying ba sel nus par bshad de/ phar phyin bsdus par/ zhum par gyur na gzengs kyang bstod// ces dang*/ dbu ma snying por/ zhum pa dmigs pa rgya chen dag /bsgoms pas yangs pa nyid du bya// zhes pa ltar ro// gal te des bying ba rags pa sel yang phra ba ma sel na/ sems ngar bskyed nas skad cig kyang ma yengs par bsgrims te/ zhe 'dod kyi gtad so med par rtse gcig tu sing nge ye re hu re bzhag /de yun mi ring tsam la shigs kyis bshig /yang grim gyis bsgrims nas skad cig kyang ma yengs par tsan gyis 'jog pa la sbyong bar bya'o// de ltar sbyangs pas sngar gyi sems gnas snyom me ba'am 'jam nyal le ba de grung sing nge song nas sing nge ye re hrig ge rjen ne ngos zin pa zhig dgos pa'o// gnyis pa rmugs pa'i skyon sel bshad pa ni/ de la rmugs pa ni/ lus sems nyog /sems dran pa 'di yod med pa/ gnas na gnas pa'i ngo bo 'di zhes dang 'gyu na de'i rang ngo de zin med pa'i 'thibs 'thibs mun mun zhig 'byung ba ste/

rig pa 'thibs bzhin de'i ngang du bskyur na je nas je sdug las mi yong zhing*/ skyon de ma bsal bar bskyangs na dran pa nyams pas gol bar 'gyur srid de// de'i skyon sel tshul la/ lus gnad gong ltar la/ lta stangs nam mkha' bar snang sogs la bltas te/ rig pa ngar dang bcas/ skad cig kyang ma yengs pa byed snyam pa'i 'dun pa shugs bskyed nas rig pa rgya bskyed la 'jog /de'i rgyun bsring zhing de mi brjed par dran pa'i sems khur yid la dung nge ba byas la/ de'i ngang nas yengs ma yengs dang rmugs pa'i skyon rtogs par byed pa'i shes bzhin gyi bya ra tsam zhig ce rer lta/ gzhan dpyad gzhig mang po mi byed/ yang bar bar du ngal gso dang*/ lhag par phyag dang gsol 'debs la brtson nas bskyangs pas/ sems rmugs pa de sel nas gong bzhin dwangs cha dang rig cha 'byung ba'o// de ltar gyi bying rmugs de'i skyon bsal nas mnyam bzhag rang la le lo skad cig kyang med pa'i brtson 'grus drag pos skyong dgos/ 'di la/ rje yang dgon pas/ sgom 'di skyong nus na skyed cig 'phral du 'ong ba yin kyang*/ nged rang gi sgom chen pa 'ga' re ni spos reng sor bzhi pa gcig tshig pa'i yun tsam yang skyong mi nus pa 'dug pa sgom gyi skyed ni ci la 'byung*/ zhes gsungs 'dug pa 'di thugs shin tu bden te/ da lta nged rang 'ga' re mnyam bzhag 'drar 'dug lo byas kyang*/ dran pa rang ni cher mi gsal/ mi gsal ring skyong mi 'dod/ skyong mi 'dod bzhin du de nas 'jog pa'am/ yang na dang po skyong ba de tsam yod par/ bar zhig nas 'gro 'dod las 'dod gtam 'dod lta bu zhig byung na/ de nas mnyam bzhag bskyang rgyu de cam gyis bzhag nas/ yang na 'gro yang na 'dug yang na gtam pa la sogs pas g.yeng bar byed pa de 'dra byas na mi yong bas/ mi gsal ba dang 'thibs pa byung na mi gsal ba de rang la sdug sgur mi 'dzugs par/

bar bar du bla ma la gsol ba 'debs/ sta stangs nam mkha' bar snang la gtad/ rig pa phyi rol snang thog tu spro ba'i gsal ngar dang bcas 'jog pa yang nas yang du bya/ skyong mi 'dod pa byung na/ rang gis rang la las ngan can gtan don dam pa'i chos sgrub pa la brtson 'grus skad cig kyang mi nus pa khyod 'dra bsam pa'i zhe khrel 'debs shing bskul ma btab nas brtson 'grus kyis skyong dgos/ 'gro 'dod gtam 'dod las 'dod byung na de'i dbang du mi gtong bar mnyam bzhag rang la gcig dril du bya ba de ltar gal che ba'o// gsum pa rgod pa'i skyon sel bshad pa ni/ de la rgod pa nyid ni/ yul snying du sdug pa la dmigs nas de la sred pa'i rnam pa can du bshad kyang*/ 'dir ni 'gyod pa dang the tshom dang gnod sems sogs sems ma zhi bar 'phro ba'i rig pa rgod pa'i phyogs su bsdus te de dag zhi bar bya ba yin no// de yang spyir rnam g.yeng dang khyad par chags sogs kyi nyes skyon dran pa'i sgo nas zhi bar bya ba'i tshul gsungs te/ mdo sde rgyan las/ rnam g.yeng nyes pa mthong ba'i phyir// de la mi dga' zhi bar bya// chags sems yid mi bde la sogs// langs pa de bzhin zhi bar byed// ces dang*/ dbu ma snying po las/ g.yeng ba g.yeng ba'i mtshan ma la// nyes dmigs blta bas bsdu bar bya// zhes pa ltar ro// de yang 'phro ba'i yul la sems mi rtog cing blo dgag sgrub glod pa'i ngang du zhi bar byed pa yin te/ phar phyin bsdus par/ rgod par gang tshe gyur pa'i yid// zhi gnas tshul gyis bzlog par bya// zhes gsungs so// de ltar na lus gnad sngar bzhin las/ lta stangs cung zad 'phang smad la/ 'di bsgom 'di mi bsgom dang gnas na dga' ba dang*/ 'phro na mi dga' ba sogs kyi zhe 'dod med par sems gu yangs se ba'i ngang du lhod kyis glod/ de la'ang dgag sgrub kyis bcos bslad mi byed par sems rang babs ji ltar 'dug pa de'i ngang la cham me lhod de bzhag

/de'i ngang nas de las gzhan du ma yengs par byed snyam pa'i dran pa sa le bar rgya bskyed la bskyang*/ de ltar bskyangs pas rnam par rtog pa rags pa mngon mtshan can du thol gyis 'char na de byung rgyal du gtong ba dang*/ de'i rjes su 'brangs nas yengs su yang mi gzhug /'char sgo dgag pa lta bu'i sems tur tur po yang mi bya bar dran pas gsos btab kyin ma yengs pa'i rgyun 'tsho mkhas par bya/ dran bzhin pa'i rtog pa phra ba ban bun rnams la'ang khu 'phrig dang dgag sgrub ci yang mi bya bar blo lhod de ba'i dran pa so ma shor tsam gyis ngang bsring*/ yang sems dwangs sing nge lhan ne gnas pa dang shigs kyis bshig la cung zad re ngal gsos la yang sngar bzhin du bskyangs pas/ sngar bsgrim pa'i tshe rtog pa phra rags thams cad bkag pa ltar song nas sems sing nge ye re ba'i rtog med cig tu rtse gcig gcun dgos pa lta bus cung zad mi bde la/ 'dir glod pa ni ma yengs par dran pa so ma shor tsam gyi ngang nas sems rang lugs ci bder bzhag pas chog pa dang*/ rtog pa phra rags 'char ba'i tshe yang dran pa tsho zin pa na/ rtog pa de nyid kha yan du mi 'chor bar snga phyi ci rigs su lhan gyis zhi nas gnas pa'i steng du cham gyis 'gro ba dang*/ dran 'dzin ma gtogs pa'i gzhan zhe 'dod ma dgos pas sems kyang sngar bas gu yangs pa lta bu zhig 'byung ba dang*/ zhe 'dod shigs bshig lhod glod la sems shigs se lhod de gnas pa'i mtshangs rig na glod pas bogs thon pa yin te/ bram ze chen pos/ 'jur bus bcings pa'i sems de ni// glod na grol bar the tshom med// ces dang*/ til+li pas/ ma bcos gnyug ma'i ngang du glod la zhog /bcings pa glod na grol bar the tshom med// ces dang*/ mai tri pas/ sems la rnam rtog byung na rnal 'byor pas// ras bal bzhin du ma bcos glod la zhog /ces dang*/ rje pad+ma dkar pos/ sems ma bcings ma bcings glod la zhog

/sems bcings na phyogs bcur 'gro bar rtsom// rgya yan du bzhag na rnal du babs// yengs med du bskyangs na rang mtshangs rig /bcos ka ru byas pas sgom gyis bslu// zhes dang*/ rje lha rtse bas/ lhod kyis glod la thang gis 'ong ba yin// zhes gsungs pa ltar ro// yang rnam rtog mang bas ngos zin dka' zhing skyong mi bde na mi bde ba de rang la sdug sgur mi byed par yang glod la ngal gso/ yang dran pa ma yengs pa brten/ de'i rgyun skyong mkhas byas na nam zhig nas bde bar 'ong ba'o// bzhi pa yengs shas che ba'i skyon sel bshad pa la/ thol skyes rbad gcod dang*/ gang shar bzo med gnyis so/ dang po thol skyes rbad gcod bsgom khyer ni/ de yang sems kho rang rang lugs ma bcos par bzhag kyang*/ las dang po pa rnams ma yengs par mi sdod cing yengs 'gro/ mi gnas par gzhan du 'phro 'gro ba de yang ngos mi zin pa sogs 'byung ba ste/ lhod cha che rang drags na slar sngon gyi 'khrul pa'i ngan langs thog /da dung yang ngan longs shor na 'khrul pa yang 'khrul nying 'khrul du 'gro ba'i tshe/ sems gnas pa'ang ngos mi zin/ 'phro rgod kyang ngos mi zin pa lung ma bstan phub ma'i zhabs kyi 'jab chu 'dra ba 'ong bas/ de byung na bsgoms pa'i don go med pas/ dang po de'i gnyen po la thol skyes rbad gcod 'di nyid bsgom dgos te/ de la sngon 'gror bla ma la gdung ba'i shugs drag pos gsol 'debs bya/ lus kyang lus gnad grims cha yod par bcas/ sems kyang snyom las rang ga min pa'i ngar dang bcas/ skad cig kyang ma yengs pa byed dgos bsam pa'i 'dun pa drag po btang nas/ rang sems ngo bo ma yengs pa'i dran pa ched du legs par bsgrims nas 'jog cing*/ dran pa yengs med de ka'i ngang du gnas thub na de ka rang dang*/ der mi gnas pa'i rnam rtog skyes byung na/ rnam rtog thol skyes pa de'i ngo bo ma yengs pa'i 'dun pas tsir tsir bzung nas/

de nas kyang rnam rtog de yi mu la 'byams mi 'jug par dran 'dun shin tu drag pos 'phro rbad rbad bcad nas rang ngo ma yengs pa rang gi thog tu cam cam 'jog /des rigs mtshon nas rnam rtog gang 'phro thams cad dran 'dun drag pos ngos bzung la 'phro gcod byed dgos shing*/ de yang ngos zin la mi zin la min pa'i ngos legs par bzung nas gong bzhin bzhag /'dun pa yengs shor na khyod de snga'ang yengs yengs 'khrul 'khrul che bas 'khor bar 'khyams pa de rang gis rang ma byung ba yin mod/ da rung yang sdug tshod med pa'i yengs brjed 'khrul pa'i dbang du gtong bar byed pa khyod kyi bsam pa gtan nas brlag 'dug bsam pa rang gis rang la byas/ yengs pa la khrel 'jog gyod bdas nas/ slar ma yengs pa'i 'dun pa bsgrims nas bzhag /rnam rtog thams cad ngos bzung yang brjed na 'dun pa bsgrims pa ste/ de ltar rgyun du 'bad par bya dgos/ 'di ltar 'dun pa med na mi 'ong*/ rang gar lus gnad o zom zom du bsdad na stong 'dug dang*/ mig lta stangs byas kyang stong lta yin par 'dug cing*/ sems skyong khul byas kyang don med de/ slob dpon klu sgrub kyis/ dran pa nyams pas chos kun 'jig par 'gyur// zhes dang*/ rje rgya ras kyis/ dran pas ma zin go yul gcig /sangs rgyas lam du 'gro mi srid// ces gsungs pas/ dran 'dun drag po sgom gyi dngos gzhi yin pas cis kyang gal che/ 'di ltar las dang po pa rnams kyis dran pa bsgrims dgos pa'i tshul ni dbu ma snying po las/ sems kyi glang chen logs 'gro ba// dmigs pa'i ka ba brtan po la// dran pa'i thag pas dam bcings te// shes bzhin lcags kyus rim dbang bya// zhes dang*/ sha ba ris/ le lo snyom las dbang mi btang*// rgyun du dran pas bsgom par bya// zhes gsungs/ gsal bkra las kyang*/ dran dang shes bzhin sdon btang la// dus gsum rgyun du ma dran na// theg mchog sngags la ci zhig chud// ces dang*/

rje 'bri gung pas/ dran pa mkhas na sgom mkhas// dran pa med na sgom med// dran pa stor na sgom stor// zhes gsungs/ de ltar dran pa drag po'i rgyun de skyong lugs kyang dang po nas 'dun pa bsgrims bzhin yun ring byung na rab/ ma byung yang dran pas gsos 'debs shing skyong ba de yun thung la grangs mang bar skyong*/ de min thun de yun ring drags na rjes nas 'dun pa'i so shor dogs yod cing*/ 'dun pa'i so shor na 'dun pa dang dran pa drag po cher med pa'i thun yun ring la ngan pa de dgos pa med pas na/ thun thung ba dang*/ de'ang bar du le lo sos dal snyom las su cher mi sdod par slar thun yang nas yang du byed pas grangs mang ba/ de yang 'dun pa drag pos thun yun thung la bzang ba zhig 'ong bar byed dgos/ spyir 'dir thol skyes rbad gcod ces pa'i go don yang sems yengs lung ma bstan dang rnam rtog 'khrul pa lu gu rgyud du 'phro ba/ de nyid la de'i dbang du skad cig kyang mi 'jug par ma yengs pa'i 'dun pa drag po byed dgos bsams te bsgrim/ rnam rtog kyang thol thol gang skyes kyi ngos 'dun pas tsir tsir bzung 'phro rbad rbad bcad la bsgom rgyu yin/ 'di 'dul ba lung las/ mda' mkhan dang ral bskor mkhan 'thab tshul la dpe mdzad de/ dmag lta bu la yin yang mi snying nag pa gnyis kyis zhe sdang gis 'dzing zhing gri 'thab byed na/ de'i tshe de gnyis gcig gis gcig la gnod sems zhe sdang drag po las gzhan skad cig kyang bsam rgyu med pa de bzhin du/ 'dir yang sgom pa dngos gzhi 'di'i tshe ni ma yengs pa'i dran 'dun 'di las gzhan skad cig kyang bsam rgyu dang yengs rgyu med par byed dgos par 'dug /de ltar bsgoms pas rnam rtog nyung du 'gro rgyu med cing*/ dran pa brten tsa na rnam rtog sngar las mang du song ba 'dra ba zhig 'byung*/ de ni mang du song ba ma yin te/

rang re sngar phan chad ma bsgoms shing 'dun pa drag po med pas rnam rtog byung yang ma tshor ma rig pas nyung snang tsam dang*/ da ltar bsgom zhing 'dun pa brten pas rnam rtog skye 'gags thams cad rig pas mang snang yin/ dper bgyid na khang stong bdag med cig tu rkun ma lan grangs brgya tsam song yang byung ma byung gi gleng brjod med la/ bdag yod kyi khang pa zhig tu rkun ma lan gnyis gsum tsam byung na'ang thengs mang byung zer ba'i dpe bzhin/ rang sems dran shes kyi kha 'dzin bdag po med na rnam rtog grangs kyis mi lang ba 'gyus kyang de la bag dang bdag po med pas/ grangs mang nyung ma shes pa khang pa bdag med du rkun ma gar song ma rig pa lta bu yin la/ da res 'di la khang pa bdag yod la rkun ma lan gnyis gsum byung yang mang snang shar ba ltar/ rang sems la dran shes kyi bag dang bdag po yod pas rnam rtog gi skye 'gags rig pa'i dbang gis mang snang shar ba tsam las/ don du mang du song ba min de ltar go ba len cing thag gcod dgos/ de ltar yin lugs shes par byas nas rnam rtog la skyon sgom la sun pa'ang mi byed par rtsol bas skyong dgos pa'o// gnyis pa gang shar bzo med sgom khyer ni/ sngon nas 'dun pa bsgrims drags rnam rtog bkag pa 'dra 'dra des sun pa skyes pa dang*/ 'ga' rer rtsub nyams kyi rnam pa sgom gyi 'dun pa btang tsa na/ skyong mi bde rnam rtog 'phro ling ling tshig pa za bas sems dkrugs pa sems sdug lhang nge ba dang skyo ting ting byed pa sogs yong srid pas de ni 'dun pa snying rus byas nas bskyangs pa'i rtags yin pas skyon med la de rigs la 'di bzhin byed pa yin/ sngon 'gro byed lugs gong dang 'dra/ 'di'i khyad chos/ dang po nas sngon thol skyes rbad gcod dus bzhin 'dun pa drag po byung na ma byung na rnam rtog skyes na ma skyes na 'phro chod na ma chod na de 'dra mi byed par dran pa lhod cha gtso bor 'don/

ma yengs pa tsam gyis 'dun pa bag yod tsam las mi byed/ rnam rtog shar na rnam rtog skyon du lta ba'i dgag sgrub spang blang sogs gtan nas byed mi dgos te/ rje btsun mi las/ rnam rtog med du mi rung ba yin/ sku drin can du shes dgos pa yin/ kho rang la sangs rgyas kyi yon tan thams cad rang chas su yod pa yin pas spong du ga la btub// ces gsungs pa ltar/ rnam rtog gang skyes kyang de ka rang rig phyag rgya chen po'i ngo bo rang yin pas mang na dga'/ dus re la rnam par rtog pa brgya re skyes kyang*/ ngo shes na chos sku brgya yin pas/ dgag pa sgrub pa skad cig byed re snyam pa'i 'dun pa de la bzo bcos mi byed par rnam rtog kho rang la sgom gyi ngo ti bcol nas skyong ba yin te/ rje rgod tshang pas/ rnam rtog kho rang gang 'gyu 'gyur bcug nas rdzi bo mkhas pas phyugs 'tsho ba bzhin du lhod cha gtso bor bton nas skyong ba gal che/ zhes gsungs so// dper na rdzi bo mkhas pas phyugs rnams rim bzhin bskyangs te zas kyi mthil du dang po nas mi rgyag par/ zas mthar bzhag nas rim gyis mthil du 'ong bar byas nas/ kho rang ri mtho ba thams cad mthong sa zhig tu 'gro nas phyugs ma rnams mig 'og tu non tsam byas te/ dgra rkun dang g.yang sa'i phyogs su mi gtong bar zas su bkram pas/ phyugs ma rnams kyang dal la rtswa bzar 'ong ba/ kho rang yang dal ba thabs mkhas pa yin la/ thabs mi mkhas pa zhig gis/ phyugs ma rnams dang po nas zas mthil du rgyag /g.yas nas g.yon du bcum/ steng nas 'og /'og nas steng du 'ded de/ rdzi bo de yang brel zhing dub pa/ phyugs ma rnams kyang rtswa za long med cing sdug pa ni thabs mi mkhas pa'o// de bzhin du sgom chen pas kyang sems glod cha gtso bor bton pas ma yengs pa de nyid rdzi bo lta bu las/ rnam rtog gang dran rnams phyugs 'tsho ba bzhin du byas te/ rnam rtog gang shar rung shar du bcug ste dran rdzi des ma brjed tsam du lhod nas/

'dzin pa ma zhugs tsam gyi rang babs su cham gyis bzhag la sems kho rang rang thog tu gnas na'ang 'dra mi gnas sna tshogs su 'phros kyang gang ltar yang ched gnyer mi bya bar gang shar de lta'i ngang du rang babs ma yengs tsam byed/ brjed skabs byung yang sngon bzhin/ khrel 'debs gyod bdar 'gyod pa sogs ci drag mi byed par/ ma yengs rang bzhin shes tsam de las gzhan pa'i bzo bcos mi byed par ma bcos par 'dug pa rgyun 'tsho byed pa de ka'i rgyun lhod cha gu yangs de ka lhug par skyong dgos pa yin te/ slob dpon rin po ches/ rta dmu rgod 'dul bzhin yan la zhog /ces dang*/ sa ra has/ bcings na 'gyu sogs rgyug nas 'gro// btang na g.yo med gnas par 'gyur// zhes dang*/ til+li pas/ ma bcos gnyug ma'i ngang du glod la zhog /bcings pa glod na grol bar the tshom med// ces dang*/ sha wa ris/ rang bzhin dag pa'i sems la bcos mi dgos// ma bzung ma btang rang ga nyid du zhog /ces dang*/ mai tri pas/ rtog pas bcings pa'i 'jur bu 'di// glod na grol bar the tshom med// ces dang*/ rje mar pas/ gnyug ma'i ngo bo rang rig gsal// zag med bsam gtan rgyun chad med// med pa ma yin 'bras bu med// zhen chags med pas sgom par bzhed// ces dang*/ rje mi las/ sgom pa thag chod blo re bde// sems ma bcos bzhag na yongs kyang bde// zhes dang*/ rje phag grus/ ma bcos rnal ma rang so la// shes pa lhod la cog ger zhog /ces dang*/ rje rgod tshang pas/ phyag rgya chen po bsgom pa la// ma bcos gnyug ma rang sar zhog /ces gsungs pa ltar ro// de ltar ma yin par 'phro rgod che ba la nan gyis bkag nas bsgoms na/ sgom mkhan kho rang dug tu song nas gnas lugs kyi dwangs cha shor/ sems rtsub slong gi 'dam du tshud de/ sgom mkhan smyon par 'ong dogs yod/ rang gis rang bcings brag sked kyi shing thun bzhin lus sems thams cad bsdams kyang sems kho sdod du mi nyan te/

grub thob gling gis/ kha btsum rkub bsdam brag ngos logs kyi shing thun 'dra ba'i sgom chen des ni gar yang mi slebs/ des na lhod kyis glod par legs so// zhes dang*/ pha dam pas/ rnam rtog ngan pa spang la chu rdol 'dra// bkag pas khegs pa mi 'dug ding ri ba// zhes dang*/ rje rgod tshang pas/ ngas ni rnam rtog bkag nas bsgom pa 'di 'dra mu stegs pa de ka rang yin snyam/ zhes dang*/ 'ba' ra ba chen pos/ sgom chen rnams sgom gyis bslus so// zhes pa'ang 'di 'dra ba la dgongs/ 'di lta bu'i gang shar bzo med du lhod shes na nyams kyi sna zin/ rnam rtog chos skur 'phrig tshud/ gang shar chos sku'i rgya yan la nges shes skye/ sgom la shes pa ched du ma bcug kyang sgom la 'du 'bral med pa 'byung*/ mdor na gzhag thabs kyi gnad 'di gnyis kyi dgos don las dang po pa brjed nges che ba la thol skyes rbad gcod kyis 'dun pa yengs med kyi rkang btsug nas/ de nas 'dun pa dang gnyis 'dzin a 'thas che ba spang ba'i ched gang shar bzo med kyi gnad kyis kun kyang gnyis med rang bzhin yongs su shes pa'i klong du glod par byed pa yin/ khrid yig gzhan du/ thol skyes rbad gcod kyis bsgrims/ gang shar bzo med kyis glod// ces pa'ang gsungs so// dang po nas dran pa'i rgyun thag byung na ched du thol skyes rbad gcod mi dgos shing de min kun la 'di gnyis rim pas ston dgos pa'o// lnga pa grims lhod ma snyoms pa'i skyon sel bshad pa ni/ bram zes skud pa 'khel ba ltar bzhag ces pa'i dang po bram zes skud pa 'khel ba'i dpe don dang*/ bram ze zhes bya'i tshig gi brjod bya ni/ gzhan skye bo dmangs dang mi 'dra ba'i bram ze 'di rnams gtsang zhing las la rtsol ba che ba yin par 'dug pas/ de ltar gsungs pa yin zhing*/ de yang bram ze lta bu rung bas bkal ba'i skud pa de grims lhod snyoms pa'i dpe ru 'jog dgos pa yin par 'dug

/de la dpe don dang sbyar na/ dper na skud pa grims drags na 'jur te tshem mi nyan/ ma grims lhod drags na rgya lugs te tshem mi nyan te/ de la grims ma drags lhod ma drags pa'i grims lhod snyoms pa zhig byung na skud pa legs pa bzhin/ 'dir yang*/ sems dran 'dun bsgrims rang drags na dran pa gnyen por a 'thas pas shes pa gnyis gshis thog don gyi rnal du mi phebs/ dran 'dun lhod rang drags na sems lung ma bstan dang 'khrul pa lu gu rgyud rgya yan 'ong bas/ des na de ltar min pa'i dran shes grims lhod snyoms shing ma bsdams pa'i ngos nas ma 'khrul tsam byed dgos pa yin/ de ltar dran shes kyi bya ra ma yengs ma 'khrul tsam pa de ka'i ngos nas rnam rtog shar ba la ni ched du dgag pa dang gnas pa zhig ched du sgrub par mi byed cing rnam rtog de'i dbang du mi gtong bar/ gang shar de ka rang ngo shes pa'i ngang nas de ka'i thog tu 'jog rgyu yin la/ de ltar 'bad rtsol ma byas spang blang phral nas rang ngo'i steng du 'jog pa 'dir goms na rjes su rnam rtog gis mi gnod cing rnam rtog rang nyams len dngos gzhir 'gro ba yin pas gnad shin tu zab/ de lta bu'i grims lhod ran pa'i dran pas spang blang med pa'i bya ra de rgyun du 'jog cing yang brjed na'ang slar rang ngor blta ba'i dran 'dun yang nas yang du gsos 'debs bzhin rim pas gu yangs lhod cha dang bcas bskyang rgyu yin te/ de skad du/ sa ra has/ bram ze'i skud pa 'khel ba bzhin// sems grims lhod snyoms pa'i rnal 'byor bde// zhes dang*/ sems nyid ngal gso las/ bu khyod nyon gang rnam par rtog /'di bdag ma bcings ma grol phyir// ma yengs ma bcos rang gar ni// kye ho dub pa ngal sos shig /ces dang*/ slob dpon klu sgrub kyis/ glang chen lam nas sems tshags tshud par ltar// 'gro 'ong bcad na ngang gis dam pa ste// 'di ltar rtogs so nga la chos ci dgos// zhes dang*/

gang yang ma rtog cir yang ma sems shig /bcas bcos ma byed rang bzhin lhug par zhog /ma bcos pa ni skye med rang bzhin mdzod// shes rab pha rol phyin pa gnyis med lam// dus gsum sangs rgyas kun gyi gshegs shul yin// zhes dang*/ jo bo rjes/ sems nyid spros dang bral ba la// ma bsgrims ma lhod rang sar zhog /ces gsungs pa ltar ro// gong gi bzhag thabs gnyis kyis bsgrims lhod mi snyoms par byed pa de/ bzhag thabs kyi gnad 'dis grims lhod ran pa'i sems skyong lugs gsha' ma rang de 'ong bar byed pa yin/ de yang 'di ltar gnad gsum las/ ma gcig lab kyi sgron mas/ grims kyis bsgrims la lhod kyis glod// sems kyi gnad cig de na gda'// gsungs pa dang gcig pas de ltar shes par bya dgos pa'o// drug pa gnas 'gyu spang blang gnyis 'dzin rnam rtog dgrar langs kyi skyon sel bshad pa ni/ sems bya rtsol thams cad dang bral ba sog ma'i phon thag chod pa lta bur 'jog /ces pa dper na sog phon khres po thag pas bsdam yod pa de'i thag pa bcad nas bzhag na 'ching byed med pas rang sar zhig ste grol nas sdod pa ltar 'dir yang nged rang sgom pa'i tshe na sgom snyam pa dang*/ mi sgom snyam pa dang dran 'dun legs po yod med rnam rtog byung ma byung*/ sems gnas mi gnas gsal mi gsal/ bde mi bde la sogs pa bsam pa'i bya rtsol gnyis 'dzin 'ching ba thams cad dang phral nas/ gnyis 'dzin bya rtsol med pa'i sems kyi ngo bo rang chas rang babs kyi thog tu shigs se glod mnyam par rang lugs su 'jog rgyu yin par 'dug /de yang nged rang 'ga' res gnas 'gyu la legs nyes gnyis su 'dzin cing rnam rtog de skyes na bzo bcos bsgyur bsgom spang blang mang po'i lhad 'jug cing*/ rnam rtog dgrar langs sgom bde bde stong stong po zhig 'dod pa de rang rnam rtog che shos yin/ rnam rtog byung dogs kyis bkag pa skabs skabs tsir tsir rang gis rang bcings pa de 'dra mdzad na/

gnas lugs kyi don ma go skyong khyer gyi gnad ma zin pa yin/ 'o na gang yin na/ zhang rin po ches/ phyag rgya chen po sgom pa la// 'di bya'i tig tig mi bdog gi /dang po bar dang tha ma med// nam dran dus su glod la zhog /ces gsungs pa 'di'i don ni/ phyag rgya chen po'i 'bras bu thob par 'dod pas/ dang po lam nyams su len nas bsgom pa la/ de yang sems rang lugs ma bcos pa'i klong du 'jog pa las/ 'di dang 'di bya dang*/ sems rang ngo'i dus su yin min bzang ngan la sogs pa'i gcig tu tig tig mi bdog /thams cad gnyis med yin zhing de yang sems kyi ngo bo rang gshis de las rnam rtog sna tshogs 'phro ba 'di/ dang por 'di nas skye/ bar du 'dir gnas dang*/ tha mar 'di 'drar 'gyur med de don skye 'gag gnas gsum dang bral ba yin pas rnam rtog la rtsis gdab mi dgos/ rnam rtog nam dran dran der ngos bzung la kho rang thog la glod la zhog /de las gzhan zhig bsgrub mi dgos gsungs pa yin/ lar nged rang gis don ji bzhin ma rtogs pas mi shes pa ma gtogs don rang ni/ rang sems chos sku phyag rgya chen po bsam brjod spros pa'i mtha' thams cad dang bral zhing de las srid zhi'i chos thams cad 'char ba 'char yang zung du 'jug pa zhig yin par 'dug /de ltar ma rtogs kyang 'phral sems bzang ngan du mi 'chos par rig pa 'di ma yengs tsam du skyong ba 'di las/ gzhan bzang bzang yin yin 'dra ba'i sgom gsal stong gcig e yod dang e yong gi re ba mi byed par rang rig ma yengs pa 'di ka nyams len bskyang rgyu'i ngo bo dngos gzhir thag bcad la/ blos byas rnams phral nas 'bol le bzhag /de ka'i ngang nas rnam rtog skyes na thol gyis skyes pa de rang ngo yengs med kyis ngos bzung la de'i rjes su phar mi 'breng*/ bzo bcos kyang mi byed/ rnam rtog de tshur ched du bkug nas gnas thog tu 'jog e thub sogs mi byed par/

rnam rtog rang gis ngos zin bzhin kho rang gi ngo thog tu lhod kyis glod de shigs se bzhag /ma brjed tsam gyis tshur rgyun bsrings bsdad pas/ mthar rang grol ma gtogs rags pa de ka'i ngang du bsdad mi yong*/ yang rnam rtog gcig steng gnyis mthud mang po brgyud mar byung na/ slar dran shes bskyed la gang shar thams cad ngos bzung la de nyid rang gi steng du lhod de shigs ser bzhag ngos zin pa'i rnam rtog ni ji tsam mang yang skyon gang yang med/ gnas pa gcig ched du sgrub mi dgos/ rnam rtog la skyon rtog mkhan rnams shes pa'i steng na blo mi bde ba'i gyong tig cig 'ong*/ de ngos bzung la mi bde ba de kho rang steng du shes pa glod nas mi bsgom pa'i ngang la ma yengs tsam rgyun bsrings bsdad pas/ rnam par rtog pa de spang mi dgos par rang thog tu grol te/ nyams len phyag rgya chen po'i dngos gzhi 'char ba yin/ dran 'dun yengs nas rnam rtog gnyis gsum du ngos ma zin na 'khrul pa skyon che bas/ de ltar mi yong ba'i dran shes brten/ dran shes rgyun mi brtan brjed skabs yong na/ slar dran pa ma yengs pas gsos 'debs byed rgyu de ltar yin/ de lta bu'i shes pa de la ma bcos pa zhes zer te/ mnyam med dwags pos/ sangs rgyas bsgoms te ma mdzad/ sems sgrim pos ma bcos gsungs pa'i/ sangs rgyas bsgoms te zhes pa ni/ sgom 'dod myong 'dod kyis ma bcos/ sems sgrim pos ma bcos pa ni/ mi dran dgu dran gzung 'dzin gyis ma bslad par gang shar gyi steng du lhod de bzhag pa la zer te/ rje btsun gyis/ sems ma bcos pa de sangs rgyas rang du 'dug /ces dang*/ sems ma bcos pa 'di bde mor 'dug /ces dang*/ rje phag grus/ rang sems gdod nas phyag rgya che// bcos med gnyug ma'i rang bzhin te// bla ma'i brda la bsten pa yis// mtshon du med pa'i tshul zhig mtshon// zhes dang*/

grub thob gling gis/ ma bcos so mar bzhag na rtogs pa 'char// chu bo'i gzhung bzhin bskyangs na yongs kyang 'char// dmigs gtad mtshan ma thams cad yongs spongs la// rtag tu mnyam par zhog dang rnal 'byor pa// zhes dang*/ rje rgya ras kyis/ chu ma rnyogs na dwangs/ sems ma bcos na bde// zhes gsungs pas// de ltar shes par bya dgos pa'o// bdun pa mi bde rtsub nyams kyi skyon sel bshad pa ni/ snang cham 'gags par 'dzin cha med pa bu chung lha khang la lta ba ltar bzhag pa zhes/ dper na bu chung bsam med lha khang zhig gi nang du khyer nas bltar bcug pas/ de thams cad khra khed de rig pa tsam zhig las legs nyes sogs mi bsam pa dang*/ 'di yin 'di min 'dzin pa mi 'ong ba de bzhin/ 'dir yang nged rang sgom pa'i tshe na snang ba ma 'gags pa ci shar yang*/ de snang tsam ma gtogs de rnams la legs nyes dga' mi dga'i 'dzin pa mi byed par 'dzin med rang ngo lam me ba de ka'i thog tu mnyam par 'jog rgyu yin// 'dir kun mkhyen pad dkar gyi khrid gzhung zin bris su/ nyams kyi snang ba sna tshogs ci shar yang*/ der gnyis 'dzin dga' sdug med pa'i gang shar 'gags med snang cha de nyid thog tu bzhag par gsungs pa'i don yin te/ 'dir rtsub nyams kyi skyon sel du bshad de/ de yang 'ga' rer sngon bzhin shes pa 'tshubs shing snying mi dga' ba ci byas kyang mi bde ba'i nyams shar ba la/ glod pas mi phan pa sngon bzhin mi bde bar byung na ni/ de byung bzhin sdug sgur mi 'dzug par thun mtshams byed/ gsol 'debs phyag 'bul ba sogs la brtson/ snang nyams skyid pa'i sa ru 'gro ste sems snang nyams kyi thog tu spros nas bzhag /yang na nang du bkug ste lhod cha bcas skyong*/ sgom mi yong bar 'dug bsam pa byung na de la spro ba bskyed la 'di ltar bsam/ da lta rang la mi yong ba de min te/ rang gi shes rgyud da lta rtsub nyams lta bu yong ba 'di/

rang gis nyams len bsgom zhing brtson 'grus byas pas da lta mi bde ba'i nyams 'dra ba 'di byung bas bsgom pa'i nyams la rtsub nyams dang bde nyams gnyis sogs 'byung bar gsungs pa'i rtsub nyams te/ slar nyams rtogs bzang po 'ong ba'i snga ltas yin te/ dper na rjes su me dron po 'bar ba la sngon la du ba 'tshubs pa 'ong ba dang 'dra/ da 'di rang gis bskyang lugs ni shes shing da dung brtson 'grus byas na gzod nyams rtogs bzang po 'char bar the tshom med pas spro ba bskyed de bzhag /rtsa ba'i bla ma la mos gus kyis gsol ba drag po gdab/ de yang zhi ba'i gsol 'debs bya ste/ bla ma yang sku mdog zhal gyi dkyil 'khor rgyas pa zla ba 'dzum zhing mnyes pa'i mdangs dang ldan pa/ rang yang snang ba dga' yal le ba/ yul snang thams cad kyang dga' ba'i rang bzhin du bsam nas/ gsol ba ngag snyan pa'i sgo nas 'debs/ rang nyid kyi rtsub nyams la sogs zhi nas nyams rtogs bzang po 'byung ba'i smon lam byin rlabs zhu/ dngos gzhi nyams len sngon bshad ltar 'dun pa gu yangs lhod pa'i ngos nas gnas pa rnam rtog rnams la bzang ngan du mi blta ste/ thams cad gnyis med bde la lhod pa'i ngang du bzhag /de ltar byas na myur du rtsub nyams de nyid zhi nas da gzod nyams rtogs bzang po skye nas 'ong ba yin/ de yang*/ rje mi las/ gegs dang gol sa mang ba de// chos skyon can yin pa ma lags te// rtags myur du thon pa'i snga ltas yin// zhes gsungs te/ rtsub nyams 'di bskyangs ma shes na skyon du 'gyur yang skyong shes na bogs su che/ gzhan rtags gang yang med pa'i snyoms snyoms shig dang mi 'dra ba yin 'dug /yang 'ga' re ni ji ltar byas kyang lhod cha mi shes pa 'ong bar 'dug pa de ni 'di ltar go ba len cing gshis thog tu bskyang bar bya ste/ lar rang rig sems nyid zhes pa 'di 'phral ngo ma shes pas/ gnas pa 'gyu ba gnyis mi 'dra ba nyams bzang ngan bde rtsub gnyis mi 'dra bar snang ba 'di 'phral gyi nyams dang rkyen gyi 'char sgo tsam ma gtogs don du gnas 'gyu gnyis dang*/

nyams bde rtsub bzang ngan du grub pa skad cig kyang med pas de gzhi la ma grub bzhin du da lta yang gnas 'gyu gnyis 'dzin dang*/ nyams bzang ngan bde rtsub la re dogs spang blang byed don ci yod/ rang rig bsgom bya sgom byed rang gi gzhi rang ni 'di ka yin bsam nas rtsub nyams mi bde ba de ka'i thog tu bzhag /des rigs 'gres/ tshig pa za khrugs se sdug lhang nge ba ci byung yang*/ de ka dran pas ngos bzung kho rang la sgom gyi dngos gzhi bcol nas bskyang*/ gnas 'gyu la gnyis su 'dzin pa dang*/ nyams bde ba dang bzang bar re ba/ mi bde ba dang rtsub par dogs pa/ bzang po bde nyams la sogs e yong gi sgrub pa/ ngan pa rtsub nyams mi bde ba sogs ma byung na bsam pa'i re dogs dgag sgrub mi byed/ re dogs dgag sgrub kyi rnam rtog byung na/ re na re mkhan gyi rtog pa/ dogs na dogs pa za mkhan gyi rtog pa/ spang blo byung na spang blo'i rtog pa/ sgrub blo byung na sgrub blo byed mkhan kho rang gi rang ngo dran pas bzung ste gang dran ci shar de thog tu 'jog /gzhan pa'i sgrub sems skad cig kyang med par byed/ khyad par bla ma la gsol ba btab na mi bde bas mi gnod cing de rang la phugs med pas rang yal du 'gro ba zhig kyang 'ong ba de ltar yin/ mi bde bar skyong khyer 'di bzhin gang la gang phan du byas pas chog go /de lta bu'i bskyang lugs la/ rje til+li pas/ mi mno mi bsam mi dpyad cing*// mi bsgom mi sems rang bab bzhag /ces gsungs pa de'i don/ 'das pa mi mno/ ma 'ongs pa mi bsam/ ched du blos brtags nas mi bsgom/ stong pa nyid ces cang med par yang mi blta/ da lta sgo lnga'i yul du gang snang yang 'di yin 'di min zhes rtog dpyod mi byed par bu chung lhug par gnas pa bzhin du sems rang babs su 'jog pa ste skad cig kyang ma yengs par bya'o// yang*/ bsam dang bsam bya thams cad yongs dor nas// ji ltar bu chung lhug par gnas pa ltar// bla ma'i lung la bsgrims te gus 'bad na// lhan cig skyes pa 'byung bar the tshom med// ces dang*/

bram ze chen pos/ bsam dang bsam bya rab tu spangs nas su// ji ltar bu chung tshul du gnas par bya// zhes dang*/ sha wa ri pas/ sgom du med pas yid la mi bya ste// tha mal shes pa rang lugs gnyug ma la// bcos ma'i dmigs pa dag gis mi bslad de// rang bzhin dag pa'i sems la bcos mi dgos// ma bzung ma btang rang ga nyid du zhog /ces dang*/ rlung ni mi bzung yid ni mi bcings par// ma bcos shes pa bu chung lta bur zhog /ces gsungs so// de ltar ni rtsub nyams kyi 'char sgo thams cad gnyug ma lhun grub ngang du grol ba'i thabs yin pa blo la nges par bya dgos pa'o// brgyad pa bzo bcos blos bsgom gyi skyon sel bshad pa ni/ de yang rnam rtog byung tshor la dgag sgrub mi byed par glang po che la tsher ma btab pa ltar bzhag /ces pa ni/ dper na glang po che lus po khyon che zhing khyad par ko ba mthug pas/ der tsher lcag brgyabs ma brgyabs gtan nas khyad med pa bzhin du/ 'dir yang nged rang sgom byed mkhan rnams kyang gnyis 'dzin mi bde gang shar la spang blang mi gtong bar/ rnam rtog 'gyus pa dang ma 'gyus pa khyad med pa rnam rtog ma byung na/ sgom gnas pa byung na snyam pa gnyis 'dzin re dogs med pa zhig dgos rgyu yin par 'dug /dngos gzhi rnam rtog dgag med dang*/ gnas pa sgrub med kyi ngo bo ma bcos pa'i rang bzhin gshis mdangs ji ltar 'dug pa ji ltar shar ba de rnams ngo bo skyong bar byed dgos/ de ltar ma bcos ma yengs pa/ rgyun 'tsho dus rnams kun tu skyong ba las/ bzo bcos blos bsgom byed pa ni sgom don gyi gnad ma zin pa yin/ de ltar mi byed par de yang dang po yin lugs kyi go ba 'di ltar len cing gnas lugs 'di bzhin bsam dgos/ sngon ched du rtsol bas bsgrim/ bar du ched du rtsol bas glod pa sogs/ grims lhod res 'jog gi skyong lugs mang po byas pa dang*/

khyad par nyams len gyi dngos gzhi'i dus kyi ma yengs pa'i 'dun pa de yang dran pa dang mi dran pa gnyis su phye/ yang dran pa de thog tu rang sems gnas pa dang mi gnas pa gnyis su phye/ gnas pa de'i ngo bo las rnam rtog sna tshogs 'gyu ba dang mi 'gyu ba gnyis su phye/ 'gyu ba'i rang ngo de yang dran pas ngo shes pa dang mi shes pa gnyis su phye/ de ltar gnas 'gyu gnyis po rig pas skyong ba la'ang gsal ba dang mi gsal ba gnyis su phye// de rnams thams cad la'ang skyong lugs bde ba dang mi bde ba gnyis su phye/ de ni rgyun du'ang dran shes skyong ba dang mi skyong ba gnyis su phye/ de rnams la'ang byung ba dang ma byung ba gnyis su phye ba sogs dgag sgrub sbang blang thams cad byas pas/ de ni don du rang rnam rtog gi snon pa gnyis 'dzin la gnyis 'dzin gyi snon pa byas 'dug /sems nyid 'di rang gnyis med ye shes chos sku chen po'i ngo bo yin par/ ji ltar yin/ gang ltar gnas/ ci lta bu zhig shar yang rang sems kho rang gi rang mdangs tsam du snang ba ni ma shes 'dug pas/ da de ltar mi bya bar sems ji ltar gnas pa dang rnam rtog bzang ngan phra rags gang shar kho rang gi rang thog tu bzhag pas de ka rang gis go chod cing chog par 'dug mod/ de min bzang po zhig bsgrub blo byas kyang rang sems rang ngo 'di ma gtogs bzang po zhig gzhan nas shar rgyu dang yong rgyu med la/ ngan pa spang blo byas kyang rang ngo 'di ka ma gtogs gzhan nas sger du ngan pa zhig ma byung mi yong ba nyid du gda' bas/ da ni sems kyi ngo bo la bzang ngan gnyis su ma grub bzhin/ 'phral du rang re 'khrul pa'i dbang gis bzang ngan du lta ba de 'drar mi byed par/ gnas mi gnas bde mi bde gang shar rang gi steng du bzhag nas/ de kar nyams len gyi mthil so rang byas na chog par 'dug bsam pa'i go ba blangs der rang thag bcad pa sngon du btang nas/

don du sems kyi ngo bo rang ngo shes tsam gyi dran pa brten pa los dgos/ de min gzhan du bsam bya thams cad spang*/ rtsol ba thams cad dor/ brtags dpyad thams cad bzhag ste/ shes pa ma bcos pa'i rang bzhin bslad med rang gsal 'gyur med/ de ka rang gi thog tu rang babs su lhod par bzhag /gang shar thams cad rang rig gi ngo bo 'di ka'i rang mdangs su thag bcad nas skyong ba las/ bzang ngan gnyis su mi 'dzin/ bde mi bde gsal mi gsal gnod mi gnod byung ma byung mi byed par gang shar rang ngo'i steng du bzhag /skabs su yengs na skyon du mi lta bar gshis thog tu phab/ de bzhin gyi rgyun skyong bar byed pa yin no// de ltar bzhag pas/ 'phral gsal la rtog med kyi nyams 'char zhing*/ phugs gnyis med ye shes chen po rang la yod bzhin pa de yin lugs yin bzhin gyi ngo bo mthong ba'o// 'di ltar yid byed bsam bya bsgom bya gtad so med par rang gshis su 'jog pa'i lung ni/ 'jam dpal rnam par rol pa'i mdo las/ gang yid la byed pa thams cad bdud kyi las so// gang yid la mi byed par 'jog pa de ni dam pa'o// zhes dang*/ rtsa rgyud las/ rtse gcig rnal 'byor goms par byed// yid la ci yang mi bsam mo// zhes dang*/ ye shes phyag rgya'i mdo las/ gang sgom pa med pa ni sgom pa'o// zhes dang*/ sgom don grub pa las/ bsgom pa'i tshe na ci yang mi sgom ste// tha snyad tsam du sgom zhes de la bya// zhes dang*/ sa ra has/ dngos dang dngos med bde bar gshegs pa'i 'ching ba ste// srid dang zhi ba mnyam nyid tha dad ma byed par// gnyug ma'i yid 'di gcig pu ltos dang rnal 'byor pa// chu la chu bzhag ji bzhin du ni shes bya'o// zhes dang*/ til+li pas/ sems la gtad so med na phyag rgya chen po yin// de la goms shing 'dris na bla med byang chub thob// ces dang*/ sems ni bcos ma ma yin ma bcos min// gnyug ma yid la byar med shes par gyis// zhes gsungs so// rje dwags po rin po ches/

bcas bcos ma byed lhug par zhog /blta nyul ma byed rang sar zhog /yid la ma byed dmigs med zhog /ces dang*/ grub thob o rgyan pas/ yid la byed pa'i chos dang bral// zhes so// de ltar de rnams kyis skyon sel gyi rim pa bshad pa'o// ༈ //gsum pa sems kyi lam khyer bshad pa la/ dang po tshogs drug lam du khyer ba'i tshul bshad pa/ gnyis pa nyon mongs dug lnga lam du khyer ba'i tshul bshad pa/ gsum pa rkyen bde sdug bzang ngan lam du khyer ba'i tshul bshad pa rnam pa gsum las/ dang po tshogs drug lam du khyer ba'i tshul bshad pa ni/ de yang lung las/ lus 'di grong stong 'dra bar shes byas te// rgyal po drug gnas phan tshun yang mi shes// yul drug rkun po tha dad dbang gnas pa// so sor phan tshun mi shes de bzhin no// mig gi dbang pos rtag par gzugs la lta// rna ba'i dbang pos sgra nyan rgyun mi 'chad// sna yi dbang pos rgyun du dri yul bsnams// lce yi dbang pos rtag par ro zhim myong*// lus kyi dbang pos yang 'jam reg bya len/ yid kyi dbang pos chos rigs skyong bar shes// dbang po 'di drug dbang po'i rjes 'brangs pas// so so rang yul dag par rtog pa bskyed// rnam shes sgyu ma sprul pa yang dag min// dbang por gnas nas mi bde 'dod pa tshol// dper na mi zhig grong stong rgyug pa ltar// rnam shes drug po dbang gnas de bzhin no// sems ni kun tshol gnas kyi rjes su 'jug /dbang rten yul dmigs dbang po rnam rig pas// rtag par gzugs sgra dri ro reg la sred// chos la spyod pa'i skad cig tsam mi gnas// rkyen ni ji bzhin dbang drug kun rgyug pas// mkha' la bya 'phur thogs pa med pa 'dra// dbang po rten byed de la ltos nas ni// phyi rol yul ni rnam par rig par nus// lus 'di shes med byed pa po yang med// rang bzhin mi brtan rkyen la ltos nas 'grub// yang dag ma yin rnam rtog las skyes pa'i// 'khrul 'khor bzhin du las kyi dbang gis 'jug

/ces gsungs pas/ de ltar tshogs drug yul gyi snang ba shar ba'i gnas lugs kyi lung shin tu gsal ba de bzhin las/ gzhan yang mdo sde rnams kyi nang nas gsal rgyas su gsungs pa dang*/ gsar rnying man ngag gi dgongs don/ rgya bod bla ma mkhas grub kyi lung yang mtha' yas la/ 'dir rgyas par da lta nang gi don lnga dang*/ phyi'i dbang po sgo lngar 'brel pa ste/ de yang mchin pa las mig gi dbang po shar ba gzugs la sred/ mkhal ma las rna ba'i dbang po shar ba sgra la nyan/ glo ba las sna'i dbang po shar ba dri la snom/ snying las lce'i dbang po shar ba ro la myong*/ mtsher pa las lus kyi dbang po shar ba reg byar thim/ yid las chos kyi dbang po shar bas bzang ngan rtog pa de dag rnams phyi nang 'brel pa can du 'char tshul/ de'i tshogs drug po rnams phyi rol dang nang gi yul drug tu 'jug tshul/ 'jug pa de rnams kyi chags sdang gis las bsags pas 'khor bar 'khyams pa'i tshul de rnams lam gyi gnas skabs su lam du khyer ba las/ theg pa dman pas spang ba/ theg chen pas bsgyur ba/ gsang sngags pas de rnams lam du khyer ba'i rnam bzhag /nges don gyi khrid phyag rdzogs dbu ma la sogs zab mo'i man ngag gi lugs la/ yul drug gi tshogs drug snang ba de rnams mi spang mi bsgyur bar rang bzhin shes pas lam du khyer tshul/ de ltar lam khyer ma shes pa'i skyon/ lam du khyer dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan/ lam khyer bgyis pa'i yon tan/ lam du ji ltar khyer tshul/ lam du khyer ba tshad du slong ba'i rang 'bras bshad pa sogs/ spros na rnam grangs mtha' yas la/ rdzogs chen gyi dbang khrid ngo sprod 'ga' zhig tu/ gzugs legs nyes gnyis ston/ sgra bzang ngan gnyis bsgrags/ dri zhim mi zhim gnyis spro/ ro kha mngar gnyis ston/ reg 'jam rtsub gnyis g.yogs/ bzang ngan rtog pa gnyis 'gyu ru bcug pa ste/ de ltar tshogs drug legs nyes bzang ngan dngos ston la/

chags sdang gnyis 'dzin 'char ba de thog lam khyer bshad pa ste/ dngos bcas rdzas kyi sgo nas rgyas par ngo sprod pa sogs bshad kyang*/ de lta bu'i phyag len 'dir mdzad srol med la/ don du rang gis go na 'di ltar tshogs drug lam khyer bshad pa 'dir thams cad tshang ba las/ dngos bcas rdzas la brten mi dgos pa'i dngos rdzas rang ni/ 'di yi tshogs drug gi rtog snang da lta'i rang re'i snang ba yul sna tshogs pa bzang ngan rgyun mi 'chad pa 'di kas chog pa yin/ de ltar yin lugs yod tshul mgo smos pa ni/ gang zhig chos don gyi go ba yod par brda ston pa tsam las de thams cad bshad kyis mi langs la/ tshogs drug lam khyer mdor bsdus bshad na 'di bzhin yin/ de yang mig gi yul du gzugs brtan pa snod kyi 'jig rten gdos bcas dang g.yo ba bcud kyi sems can mi dud 'gro zas nor longs spyod la sogs pa ji ltar snang yang rang gi sems las gzhan du skad cig kyang ma grub pas bcos ka mi byed/ der legs pa la chags nyes pa la sdang ba ste/ chags sdang rang ga ma'i dbang du shor na mi rung bas/ de ltar ma yin pa'i legs nyes gang snang yang der chags sdang mi byed/ snang ba'i gzugs ma 'gags pa legs nyes ji ltar snang ba de ka las sems nyid logs su mi 'tshol bar de thog tu rang ngo rang shes dran pa dang ma bral ba'i sgo nas byis pas lder so mthong ba ltar lham me ba la mnyam par bzhag /gal te chags sdang gi rnam rtog sna tshogs byung na de nyid yengs med 'dun pas ngos bzung nas de thog ma bcos glod la bzhag /de bzhin du rna ba'i yul du mi dang dud 'gro'i skad/ 'byung ba rlung me sogs kyi 'ur sgra sogs/ mdor na sgra snyan mi snyan gang thos rang gi sems yin/ de rnams la chags sdang 'dzin pa byas de'i dbang du shor na tha mal pa yin pas de ltar mi byed par/ sgra snyan mi snyan tshig lta bu yin na 'jam rtsub ji ltar go yang snyan pa 'jam pa la yid chags pa dang*/

mi snyan rtsub pa la sdang sems mi byed/ sgra ma 'gags pa sna tshogs ji ltar grags pa de ka las sems gzhan du mi 'tshol bar rang gi rig pa dang sgra gang thos de gnyis ka'i rang bzhin shes pa'i klong du bzhag /chags sdang rnam rtog byung na de dbang du mi gtong bar rig pas ngos bzung la de thog glod la bzhag /de bzhin sna'i yul du spos sogs dri zhim pa dang*/ mi gtsang rul dri sogs dri mi zhim pa ste/ dri zhim mi zhim byung na tshor ba de ka rang gi sems yin/ chags sdang gi dbang du btang na mi yong bas/ de 'dra min pa'i gang tshor gang snang de ka dran pas ngos bzung*/ legs par 'dzin pa mi legs par sdang ba med pa'i dri bro ba de ka las sems gzhan du mi 'tshol bar phyi nang yengs med kyi dran pa dang ma bral bar byed/ chags sdang rnam rtog byung na ngo bo de kar blta/ lce'i yul du zas la sogs pa'i ro mngar ba kha ba la sogs pa myong ba de ka rang gi sems yin/ legs nyes la chags sdang dbang du mi gtong bar kha mngar gang byung de ka las sems gzhan du mi 'tshol bar rang thog tu ma yengs par lhan gyis bzhag /chags sdang mi byed/ chags sdang rnam rtog byung na chags sdang ngo bo de kar blta/ de bzhin lus kyi yul du gos la sogs pa'i reg bya 'jam rtsub ci byung yang rang sems yin/ der chags sdang dbang du ma shor ba'i reg bya 'jam na 'jam pa de rang dang*/ rtsub na rtsub pa de ka las sems gzhan du mi 'tshol bar de rang thog tu ma yengs par glod nas bzhag /bde mi bde byung na de nyid ngos bzung ste dran pa dang bcas te 'jog /de bzhin yid kyi yul du legs nyes bzang ngan phra rags kyi rnam rtog ci shar yang rang sems yin/ der legs pa la dga' bar byed pa dang*/ nyes pa la skur sems sogs mi byed par rnam rtog bzang ngan 'bring gsum phra rags sbom gsum gang shar de nyid kyi rang ngo dran pas ngos bzung ste rang babs su bskyang*/

legs nyes rnams la 'di de snyam pa'i 'dzin pa sogs byung na/ de ka 'dzin pa'i rnam rtog yin pas 'dzin pa'i rnam rtog kho rang ngos bzung ste de thog tu glod de 'jog /mdor na rnam rtog bzang ngan min pa'i gnas 'gyu la'ang gdam ka mi byed/ dgag sgrub kyis mi bslad par sems gnas na gnas pa'i ngo bo/ 'phro na 'phro ba'i ngo bo ste/ gang gnas gang shar de nyid kyi steng du glod/ gang shar rang ngo de ka skyong ba las gzhan du bzang ngan mi 'dzin par de'i rgyun bskyang*/ don du ni mig gi yul du gzugs/ rna ba'i yul du sgra/ sna'i yul du dri/ lce'i yul du ro/ lus kyi yul du reg bya/ sems kyi yul du rnam par rtog tshogs te/ yul drug tu tshogs drug snang ba legs nyes gang shar yang*/ der legs nyes rtog dpyod chags sdang mi byed par gang snang gang shar de ka dang po ngos bzung*/ bar du rang thog tu glod nas 'jog /tha ma rang grol du gtong rgyu yin/ 'di yang rang rer tshe rabs 'khor ba thog med nas sngon goms kyi bag chags che bas chags sdang gi rnam rtog mi yong rgyu med/ chags sdang rnam rtog los yong ste/ de 'khrul par ma shor ba'i 'dun pas chags sdang rnam rtog de nyid ngos bzung ste kho rang rang thog tu glod/ chags sdang rnam rtog de nyid rang bzhin shes pa'i ngang du 'jog par bya dgos pa'o// de ltar yang*/ rje rgod tshang pas/ spyir snang ba sna tshogs 'char ba ni rang gi sems yin/ snang ba dang stong pa gnyis su med par ye nas gnas pa yin pas shes pa nang du bzung mi dgos/ de yang*/ mig gi yul du gzugs su snang ba'i dus su gzugs su snang ba de ka rang gi sems yin/ gzugs snang stong gnyis su med pa yin/ gzugs thog rang du 'dzin med du lhan gyis bzhag pas gzung 'dzin rang sar grol 'gro/ de bzhin du sgra dang dri dang ro dang reg bya dang*/ yid las 'gyu ba'ang 'gyu ba'i rang thog tu bzhag pas rang grol du 'gro ba yin/

de'ang shes pa'i thog tu mi sgom par phyi tshogs drug yul gyi thog tu 'dzin med du bsgom pas tshogs drug sgom du shar nas bogs thon 'ong ba yin/ zhes dang*/ grub thob o rgyan pas/ phyi rol gyi brtan pa dang g.yo ba'i dngos po sa rdo ri brag khang khyim la sogs pa bem po'i bye brag ji snyed cig mthong ba dang*/ khams gsum sems can gyi khyad par/ lha dang lha min dang*/ ngan song gsum gyi sems can la sogs pa/ mtho dman ji tsam zhig snang yang*/ de thams cad phyi rol don du grub pa spu nyag ma tsam yang med cing rang gi sems kyi mdangs las shar ba'i rang 'od yin/ de la nyams su len pa'i dus su 'di ltar byed/ sa rdo ri brag bem po'i dngos por shar ba'i dus gang shar gyi bem po de rang gi yul yul can gyi 'dzin pa ma zhugs par ji ltar snang ba'i rang thog de rang du lhod kyis glod nas nyams myong bzang ba'i re ltos dang*/ ngan pa'i dogs pas ma bslad par gang snang de nyid rang la nyams len gyi mthil byas/ rtog pa gzhan gyis bar ma chod pa'i ngang la lhod de shigs se 'jog pa yin/ de ltar bzhag pas snang ba dgag ma dgos/ stong pa bsgrub ma dgos/ gnyen po logs nas btsal ma dgos par bem rig gnyis po gcig tu lam me ba de la snang ba lam du byed pa zer ba yin/ snang sems gcig tu 'dres pa zer/ zung 'jug gi ngo bo mthong ba zer/ nyams len gyi gnad zin pa yin/ de ltar snang thog tu glod ma shes par dran rtog gis legs 'dod kyi bzo bcos mang po byas na snang ba sgom du mi 'char/ yang rigs drug gi sems can mtho ba dang dma' ba dang bzang ba dang ngan pa dang*/ skyid pa dang sdug pa la sogs pa gang mthong bar yang bem po'i nyams len dang 'dra ste/ gang shar de nyid rang ngos bzung nas/ de nyid kyi steng du mi bsgom pa'i ngang la ma yengs tsam du glod nas bzhag pas snang sems zung du 'jug pa yin/

da ltar gyi snang ba 'di la skyon yon du mi blta/ bzo dang bcos ka mi byed/ spang sgrub kyi 'dod blos mi bslad/ ji ltar 'dug pa de ka rang nyams su len pa yin/ zhes gsungs so// de ltar bzhag thabs 'di tsam du ma tshad pa'i dus kun tu tshogs drug lam khyer 'di gtso bor nyams len byed dgos/ de min sems kyi mnyam bzhag skyong lo 'dra zhig byas kyang*/ de nas phyi rol gyi 'dod yon gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya rnams la thug pa'i dus 'dun pa gar song med par byas/ 'dod yon tha mal du spyod 'khrul par shor/ chags sdang re dogs kyi 'khor lo bskor na/ de ni sgom dgos dus ma slebs/ don che ba bor bas mdo don dgos ched med pas na/ de ltar ma song ba'i dngos gzhi mnyam bzhag dus dang khyad par dus kun tu snang yul sogs thams cad yin bzhin rang ngor lam khyer la bslab dgos so// 'di ltar tshogs drug lam du khyer na 'phral du tshogs drug rang ga ma'i dbang du mi shor/ snang bas sgom la mi gnod pa dang*/ bar du snang ba rgyan du 'char ba dang*/ tha ma snang sems gnyis med chos sku gdal ba chen po'i klong du phebs pa'i dgos pa rnams yod pa'o// gnyis pa nyon mongs pa dug lnga lam khyer bshad pa ni/ de yang rang re rnams las dang nyon mongs pa'i dbang gis tshe rabs 'khor ba thog med nas da lta'i bar du 'khor bar 'khyams/ de yi sdug bsngal myong*/ las kyi 'du byed bsags pas skad cig tsam yang ma dal ba lta bu yin pas/ da lta yang nyon mongs pa'i las ngan pa 'di las bzlog dka'/ 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug phrag dog nga rgyal te/ dug lnga'i rnam par rtog pa 'di rnams dbang che/ shugs drag stobs dang ldan/ goms 'dris brtan nam yang thub par dka' ba ste/ de yang dri med bshags rgyud las/ dar cing drag pa'i las dbang de btsan pas// 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal rgya mtshor bying gyur te// zhe sdang 'bar ba'i mes ni rang rgyud bsreg

/gti mug mun pa 'thibs pas shes rab rmongs// 'dod chags rgya mtsho'i 'gram du rnam shes bying*// nga rgyal drag po'i ri bos ngan 'gror mnan// phrag dog rlung dmar 'tshubs pas 'khor bar g.yengs// bdag tu lta ba'i mdud pa dam pos bcings// 'dod pa me dong 'dra ba'i 'obs su lhung*// sdug bsngal mi bzad drag po char ltar babs// zhes gsungs pa de bzhin no// 'di'i nyon mongs pa dug lnga'i las rnams lam khyer 'di nyid la rgyas par/ nyon mongs dug lnga'i ngo bo/ de dag gi dbye ba/ dbye ba 'di la rgyas par 'dod chags kyi rtog pa bzhi bcu/ zhe sdang gi rtog pa so gsum/ gti mug gi rtog pa bdun te/ nyon mongs pa dug gsum gyi kun rtog brgyad cu/ phrag dog gi rtog pa brgyad/ nga rgyal gyi rtog pa bcu gnyis te/ de rnams sdom par dug lnga'i rnam rtog gi dbye ba brgya tham pa de rnams so sor bshad pa/ de lta bu'i dug lnga'i ngo bo dbye ba dang bcas pa lam du khyer dgos tshul/ dug lnga lam khyer ma shes pas nyon mongs rang gar tha mal du spyad pas las bsags tshul/ de las rnam smin myong ste 'khor bar 'khyams tshul/ dug lnga'i las de rnams so so tha dad kyi rnam smin/ ngan song 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal ji ltar 'gyur ba/ de ltar shes pas dug lnga la sogs pa nyon mongs pa thams cad la gnyen pos zin dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan/ gnyen po gtong ba rang gi nyams rtogs drag zhan 'bring dang bstun par dgos tshul/ de'i gnyen po brten lugs/ rang nyid gal te nges don gyi snying po rang rig la goms 'dris ma song bar blo dman pa lta bu zhig yin na/ gzhi spang bya nyon mongs/ spong ba'i lam nyan thos kyi theg pa ltar bya ba'i lam rim gyi sgom don bshad pa/ rang nyid dbang po 'bring blo goms cung zhig yod pa zhig na/ gzhi spang bya nyon mongs bsgyur ba'i lam/ theg chen lam las ji ltar bya lugs/

rang nyid blo rab lam rim pa gnyis la blo sbyangs pa zhig na/ gzhi spang bya nyon mongs pa nyid lam du khyer ba ni/ gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i lam dngos su ji ltar nyams su len pa ste/ de ltar theg pa che chung gi nyams len de dag ni/ dang po theg dman pas nyon mongs spong ba ni/ skye bo tha mal pas gnod byed kyi dug 'dzem zhing spang ba lta bu/ gnyis pa theg chen pas nyon mongs pa bsgyur ba ni/ dug la sngags btab nas dug gi nus pa bcom nas za ba lta bu/ gsum pa gsang sngags pas nyon mongs pa nyid mi spang bar lam du khyer ba ni/ rma bya la sogs pas dug nyid bcud du len pas dug rang kha zas bcud mchog tu 'gro ba lta bu las/ de dag gi dpe don rgyu mtshan mchog dman 'bring po'i dbye ba so sor bshad pa dang*/ lhag par nges don gyi lam bzang po 'di nyid ni/ spang bya rang bzhin yongs su shes pa'i lam ste/ 'di la nyon mongs sogs ngan rtog spang byar gyur pa thams cad mi spang mi bsgyur bar gang shar rang bzhin yongs shes kyis skyong ba'i tshul/ spang bya rang bzhin yongs shes su skyong ba 'di lam thams cad kyi mchog dang snying po yang snying du 'gyur tshul/ de la spang bya rang bzhin yongs shes kyi lam khyer dngos bshad pa/ de ltar spang bya rang bzhin yongs shes kyis ma shes pa'i skyon lam du khyer ba'i yon tan/ lam du bslangs pa'i tshad/ spang bya nyon mongs dug lnga lam khyer de rnams kyis gnas skabs kyi dgos pa 'grub pa'i tshul/ lam khyer de rnams kyi rang 'bras/ mthar thug yon tan bshad pa sogs 'di rnams spros nas gang rgyas su bshad na shin tu mang ba rnam grangs mtha' yas pa theg pa che chung 'bring po thams cad kyi lam tshang ba de ltar yod pa zhig yin rung*/ de ltar yod lugs yin lugs kyi mgo smos ston pa tsam ni/ chos don thugs kyi go ba yod la rgyu mtshan don du gnyer ba rnams la brda ston pa tsam yin/

gzhan thams cad zhib rgyas su bshad pa mi langs pas/ 'dir nyon mongs dug lnga lam khyer nges don gyi lam/ spang bya rang bzhin yongs shes kyis lam du khyer lugs snying po tsam bshad na 'di bzhin yin/ de'ang gang zhig rang re 'khor bar 'khyams pa'i las kyi rtsa ba nyon mongs dug lnga'i rtog pa 'di rnams kha yan tha mal 'dzin pa dang bcas pa de bzhin min pa'i lam du ji bzhin khyer ba gal du che la/ lam khyer med tshe chos kyi mdo don stor ba ni/ de ltar yang*/ dam pa rgya gar bas/ nyon mongs byung dus gnyen pos ma slebs na// chos kyi dgos pa stor ro ding ri ba// zhes gsungs pa ltar yin/ gzhan yang*/ o rgyan rin po che'i gsung zhus lan man ngag phreng ba las/ dgra thams cad kyi nang nas gang che zhus pas/ dgra thams cad kyi nang nas nyon mongs dug lnga'i dgra bo che gsungs/ dug lnga'i dgra bo des ji tsam gnod zhus par/ dug lnga'i dgra bo des gtan nas phung bar byed/ sdug bsngal las thar pa'i mtha' med gsungs/ 'o na de la thabs ci drag zhus par/ thabs gnyen po'i dmag dpung sdud par drag /zhes gsungs/ gnyen po'i dmag de dus nam zhig sdud/ grangs ji tsam dgos zhus par/ nyon mongs pa'i dgra bo ni dus rgyun chad med pa yin phyir/ gnyen po'i dmag kyang rgyun chad med par sdud/ nyon mongs dgra de rnams grangs dang tshad gzung med phyir/ gnyen po'i dmag dpung yang grangs kyi mtha' yas par bsags/ ces gsungs/ de la dmag gi g.yul ji ltar 'thab zhus par/ nyon mongs pa'i dgra de ni g.yo che bas mgo bskor phyir/ dran shes kyi so pa rtag par zhog /nam yong cha med pas bag yod kyi go cha rtag par bgo /shugs che bar thub dka' bas dpa' rtsal stobs bskyed/ 'di la ma bsgrims na rang nyid gtan du pham kha 'byung phyir rem dgos pa yin zhes gsungs so// 'di la sogs pa'i gsung sgros zhus lan shin tu mang yang de tsam gyis chog

/gang ltar nyon mongs pa dug lnga'i yo lang 'di ni skye bo tha mal pa rnams mi tsher dug lnga'i 'khor lo bya ba las kyi rnam smin bsags pa yin pa tsam du ma zad/ rang re chos byed kyi bla ma dge 'dun pa rnams kyang rang rang gi lam du khyer ba'i nyams len ji bzhin zhig ma shes na/ bsam pa thams cad dug lnga'i rtog pa dang*/ bya las thams cad de'i las kyi 'du byed las ma 'das te/ de yang dper mtshon na 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug phrag dog nga rgyal rnams te dug lnga/ gzhan yang ser sna log lta le lo sogs ngan pa'i kun rtog kho na'i 'khor lo ste/ de'ang 'dod chags la phyi rdzas la chags pa ni/ rang gi rgyu nor zog zas la zhen chags ser sna 'dzin pa a 'thas pas/ da lta nor rdzas phran bu re yang rang gis spyod mi nus/ gzhan la mchod sbyin mi nus/ yi dwags rgyal mo'i gter du ser snas bsags 'dzin/ shi na'ang nor la sems chags pas shi spar 'tham pa'ang rang re la mang du yong*/ nang sems can la chags pa ni yul gang zhig rnams la 'dod zhen skom chags dung nge ba/ de'i dbang gis tha mar lus ngag yid gsum gyis las ngan bsags/ khyad par du'ang yid kyis las ni rgyun du gsog bzhin pa rnams dang*// gnyis pa zhe sdang ni/ rang dang mi mthun pa rnams la gnod sems gdug rtsub kyi zhe sdang drag po ldang ba/ de'i las ngan pas gzhan la gnod pa skyel ba/ dus rgyun don yod med thams cad la khong khro gdug sems ldang ba ni/ dper na rang gi grogs 'khor g.yog nye ba phyi nang*/ phyi'i sa cha yul khang*/ 'byung ba rlung me kha char/ dud 'gro sems can zas gos dang bcas pa ste/ mdor na snang ba thams cad zhe sdang gi rkyen/ rtog pa thams cad khong khro'i rtog pa ste/ nyin re la'ang khong khro che chung dpag tu med pa gsog bzhin pa 'di rnams dang*/ rang re rnams la ni ci byas kyang nyen dus dang*/ gang yin rung lo dus med pa lta bu zhig gi khong khro zhe sdang ngan smras 'ba' zhig dus rgyun chad med par dgos pa 'di rnams dang*// gsum pa gti mug ni/

gnyid dang ma rig pa gnyis/ gnyid ni/ o rgyan rin po ches/ mi tshe'i phyed ni gti mug gnyid du song*// lo brgya thub kyang lnga bcu ro ru nyal// zhes gsungs pa bzhin/ rang res lo ji tsam thub pa de yi phyed ril po gnyid kyi rang bzhin gti mug ro nyal yin par ma zad/ da rung des kyang mi tshad nged rang rnams ni nyin mo'i las ka med par sos cung zad dal na gnyid kyi rang bzhin sogs dang*/ chos gsan tshe'ang gzims dgos pa sogs gti mug gnyid ni rgyun mi 'chad pa dang*/ ma rig pa'i gti mug ni/ rang rgyud du ye nas rang chas cis kyang 'bral mi nus pa 'di bzhin sogs dang*// bzhi pa phrag dog ni/ rang re phyi nang thams cad du 'byung la/ 'di ni skye bo mang ma rnams kyis spang dka' la spangs sems mi yong bar ma zad/ rang re chos byed rnams kyang nang du grwa sa chags sdang gi phung po zhes zer ba bzhin/ mched grogs nang du skyid sdug gcig pa'i rdo rje'i spun lta bu yin kyang*/ gzhan zur za/ 'gran sems/ gzhan pha rol po der byung na de la mi 'os pa/ rang dang rang gi nye ba 'dra zhig la yag tu re ba sogs/ phrag dog rang gi rang bzhin te/ che ba ni 'dod pa gang mi gang sna tshogs dran pa dang*/ chung ba tha na gral mtho dman 'dug snga phyi/ phor kha mtho dman yan chod la nga dang khyad byung ma byung gi rnam rtog rgyun mi chad pa dang*/ phyi nas yin na grub mtha' chos lugs gcig kyang de la phrag dog /gal te chos lugs grub mtha' mi gcig pa rnams la ni/ phrag dog de ched du dgos pa dang*/ de gal du che ba dang*/ gzhan la phrag dog de ma mdzad na mi yong ba 'dra zhig gi dbang gis phyogs ris gcig bstod gcig smod rang lugs la kha 'dzin/ gzhan lugs la smod pa/ rang la ma byung dogs/ gzhan la mtho dogs rgyal dogs gzhan rnams kyis rnyed dogs sogs don med kyi rgyal khams stong pa yin rung*/ rang sha steng du yod pa lta bu'i phrag dog gdug rtsub 'ba' zhig 'byung ba de rnams dang*// lnga pa nga rgyal ni/

'jig rten gyi skye bo rnams gzhan la brnyas chos/ rang nyid nga rgyal ba'i rang bzhin te/ mtho bar yod pa rnams ni nga rgyal gyi gong bu/ de min rnams kyang rang che'i nga rgyal re thams cad la yod par ma zad/ rang re chos mdzad rnams la chags bzhag na/ gal te rang la thos bsam sgom gsum phran bu re yod kyang*/ de la de'i tshod kyi nga rgyal/ nga min pa gzhan min/ ngas min pa sus mi shes snyam pa'i nga rgyal khog pa gang ba dang*/ 'di la/ chos pa nga rgyal mi che rgyu'i// gdams ngag zab mo khog nas 'bar// zer ba 'dug bzhin rang la sku yon bslabs sbyangs bsgoms bsgrubs nyams len 'don brjod bzlas grangs sogs chos phyogs nas kyang yon tan che chung 'bring gsum ci yod kyang de'i tshod re'i nga rgyal/ gzhan rang gi lus stobs lang tsho dpa' rgod rgyu nor zog zas yod kyang de'i tshod kyi nga rgyal bcas/ rnam 'dren bla ma dam pa 'ga' zhig nas kyang*/ rang nyid kyi chos kyi che ba dang*/ grub mtha'i che ba lta bu la/ rang lugs khyad par 'phags pa gzhan dang mi mnyam mi 'dra zhes bka' stsal pa sogs nga rgyal yod yod 'dra mo 'ga' re yang gnang 'dug pas mtshon/ 'jig rten kha dper/ zho zo gang yod na snying zo ba tsam/ zer ba de bden pas rtog pa thams cad dug lnga'i 'khor lo/ bya ba thams cad las dang nyon mongs pa'i yo lang las/ de rnams lam du ma khyer na/ nyon mongs pas las bsags/ las las rnam smin myong bas 'khor bar 'khyams pa/ las de bzlog mi nus pas 'khor ba las thar dus med pa nyid yin pas/ des na nyon mongs lam du khyer ba gal che/ lam du khyer tshul ni/ spyir theg pa che chung gi lam/ rang nyid kyi nyams stobs bzang ngan dang bstun pa'i sna tshogs pa gong bshad ltar yin rung*/ phyag chen rang gzhung 'dir ni spang bya rang bzhin yongs shes su lam du khyer ba las/ de la las dang po pa rnams kyis/ dang po nas dug lnga'i dgra bo skyon du bzung nas de la bag yod kyis so pa 'jog

/gnyen po yengs med kyi dran pa dang dus rtag tu mi 'bral bar byed/ rang gi shes rgyud bya spyod nyams len sogs la zhib tu rtog cing dpyad nas/ blo zon bag yod gal che ste/ dper bgyis na 'jig rten na rang la phyi rol nas dgra byed mkhan che chung mang po zhig yod na/ de'i chung ba'i rigs kyis rang la gnod mi thub pas de la skyon med bsam pa las mi dgos mod kyang che ba'i rigs kyis rang la gnod nus pas/ de la rang gis kyang dus rtag tu dgra 'dis gnod ci 'dra zhig byed 'ong bsam pa'i blo zon rang byed dgos pa ltar/ nang du rang sems thog tu dug lnga sogs rtog pa gang shas chung ba dang*/ rkyen thub sla ba de cung zhig drag kyang*/ gang zhig dug lnga'i rtog pa rags pa/ zhe sdang gnod sems gdug rtsub khong khro/ 'dod zhen brkam chags ser sna 'dzin pa brnab sems/ gti mug gnyid bag med 'khrul yengs phrag dog 'gran sems/ nga rgyal log lta sogs dug lnga yan lag dang bcas pa'i/ ngan rtog gang su shas che ba de la/ rang gi rgyud la dug lnga'i rtog pa 'di shas che/ 'di'i dbang du 'chor 'ong bsam pa'i blo zon bzhag nas/ dngos gzhi'i rtog pa de// dang po ngos bzung*/ bar du de dbang du mi btang*/ tha ma rang grol du gtong ba gal che/ de min dgra la blo zon dogs pa ma bzhag skyon med du bsdad na/ pha rol po des kyang de ltar shes pa'i tshod bltas nas/ nam zhig yid la med dus thog rgyag gi gnod skyel te/ de yang rang gi sngon nas blo zon med pa des rang gis dgra mi thub par dgras rang thub yong ba ltar/ nged rang gis kyang dug lnga'i dgra bo 'di la dang po nas blo zon med na// dug lnga'i rtog pa de skye sla la dug lnga'i rtog pa de ltar skyes pa'ang sngon nas bag yod med pas ngos mi zin/ ngos re gnyis zin kyang sngon nas 'dun sems ma goms pas skyon de dbang du 'gro ba las dran pas thul dka' la/

dran pas ma thul tshe ni/ dug lnga'i rtog pas las bsag cing*/ las las rnams smin myong bas rang 'khor bar 'khyams par byed pa sogs mi dge ba dang sdug bsngal gyi gzhi mar 'gyur ba yin pas 'di rigs la dang po nas blo zon dogs pa drag tu 'jog pa gal che/ de'ang*/ phyi rol dgra yis tshe 'dir gnod pa tsam// dug lnga'i dgra bos gtan du brlag par byed// ces gsungs pa ltar/ rang rer tshe 'dir dgra bos gnod pa ji tsam bskyal kyang tshe 'di'i 'jig rten 'phral snang la gnod pa tsam las/ rang 'khor ba ngan song du bskyur bar mi nus la/ nang dug lnga'i dgra bo 'dis ni tshe 'dir yang mi bde ba dang*/ phyi ma dmyal ba yi dwags sogs 'khor ba dang ngan song gsum du 'phen pa'i steng du sdug bsngal gyi rgyur sbyor ba'i gnod pa'i tshabs rang ni/ nang gi dug lnga'i dgra 'di che bas de ltar shes pa'i sgo nas 'di la skyon med du mi 'jog par rnam pa kun tu blo zon dogs pa ci cher byed pa gal che/ de yang dug lnga rags pa la sogs par de ltar blo zon 'jog par ma zad/ de min dug lnga'i rigs gyur shas chung ba rnams la'ang dus kun blo zon byed pa gal che ba ni/ dper na 'jig rten na dgra chung ngu zhig yin rung*/ de la blo zon dang po nas ma byas na pha rol po des kyang*/ sprang pos khyi rgyus lon nas/ yo ge phrag la 'gel zer ba'i dpe bzhin/ gzhan des kyang tshod lon pas dgras ci thub gang thub byed yong ba bzhin/ rang gi shes rgyud dug lnga shas chung ba'i rigs la'ang rnam pa kun tu skyon med du bzhag na de yang ngan long du shor nas shed je cher 'gro bas na/ rtog pa shas chung ba'i rigs la'ang skyon med du mi 'jog par nam yang dran shes kyis 'dul ba gal du che bas/ rtog pa chung ba'i rigs kyang kha yan du mi 'jog par dran pa gnyen pos ngos zin par byas la/ dang po bla ma la mos gus gdung shugs drag pos gsol ba snying gi dkyil nas gdab la/

dug lnga lam du slong nus kyi 'dod gsol kha bsgyur bcas bya/ bar du dug lnga che phra ngos bzung ba de thams cad sems nyid gdod ma nas skye ba med pa'i chos sku rang chas su yod pa de'i rang mdangs yin pas na 'phral so sor snang tsam ma gtogs don du tha dad dang*/ bzang ngan du ma grub pas/ gnyis med mnyam pa'i rang bzhin du thag chod pas dgag sgrub spang blang bsgyur bcos ci yang mi bya bar/ de'i dbang du ma song tsam pa'i rang thog tu bzhag la dran pa brten/ de yang zhe sdang na sdang thog tu dran pa brten/ 'dod zhen na zhen thog tu dran pa brten/ 'thibs rmongs na rmongs thog tu dran pa brten/ phrag dog na dog thog tu dran pa brten/ nga rgyal na rgyal thog tu dran pa brten/ mdor na dug lnga che chung 'bring gsum phra rags sbom gsum thams cad rags pa kha yan dang phra ba bag nyal du ma song ba'i che chung thams cad dran pa rang thog tu ro snyoms pas lam du khyer dgos pa yin/ dug lnga ngo bor ma grub par so so rang rig gis mthong na rang bzhin shes pa zhes bya/ tha mar lam khyer de'i mthus dug lnga gzhi thog nas yal 'dod pa dang*/ dag ma dag sogs kyi re dogs 'dzin pa ci yang mi bya/ gal te re dogs 'dzin pa'i rtog pa phra mo shar yang thams cad sems kyi cho 'phrul rang bzhin du shes pas de ka'i thog tu bzo bcos med par bsgyur zhing 'dzin med rang grol du phyal gyis gtang bar bya'o// de skad du/ snyan rgyud khrid yig las/ zhe sdang drag po zhig lhang gis skyes pa'i dus/ zhe sdang de'i ngo bo la gcer gyis bltas pas/ zhe sdang gi ngo bo stong sang gis song ba/ de ka chos skur rtogs pa'i dus der zhe sdang bros pa'ang med/ zhe sdang spangs pa'ang med/ zhe sdang de bsgyur ba zhig kyang min/ zhe sdang rang sar grol ba ste/ de ni ngo bo yin pas mthar thug go /de bzhin 'dod chags dang gti mug sogs la'ang 'gres rkang ded par bya/

zhes gsungs so/ rjes su grol ba dang nyon mongs lam du slong ba'i dge bas bdag sogs sems can thams cad nyon mongs sogs sgrib gnyis byang nas sangs rgyas par gyur cig /ces smon lam btab/ gsol 'debs smon lam byed pa 'di byung na dgos pa rten 'brel sna tshogs pa yod/ de bzhin gyi nyon mongs lam khyer 'dun pa la dus kun goms su 'jug pa zhig ci nas kyang gal du che ba yin/ 'di la rang re chos byed pa lta bu la chags bzhag kyang*/ chos pa tha ma rnams ni nyon mongs kha yan/ tha mal pa yin nas yin bzhin pa tsam du ma zad/ chos pa tshad ldan yin rgyu ba'i khag khur mdzad pa rnams kyis kyang*/ dug lnga lam slong 'di ni shin tu dka' bar 'dug ste/ de ni sngon bshad ltar lags/ khyad par du sgom chen du khas len pa dang sgrub pa'i khag khur mdzad pa rnams kyis kyang sgom gsar gyis pha yul blos gtong ba dang*/ sgom rnying gis a khrad chu rdung zer ba shin tu bden pas/ dang po tsa na blos btang 'dra zhig mdzad kyang sgom rnying du song bzhin 'dzin pa je che/ zhen pa je dam/ mi dgos dgu dgos/ mi gsog dgu gsog /'jig rten phal pa dang khyad med par yong 'dug pa ni mtshang dang skyon shin tu che ba dang*/ gzhan yang gal te rang gshis ngan gyong lta bu zhig yin na des ni ji tsam bsgoms kyang 'bral rgyu med pa'i rgyud je gyong je ngan je sdug /sgom ngan pa gcig las gshis bzang dga'/ zer ba de yang bden pa 'dra mod/ sgom chen yin bzhin du ru je nga*/ ko long rnam rtog je tsha la 'gro ba'ang mang*/ de yang skyon mtshang che ba des rigs 'gres/ gti mug je che/ snyom las le lo bag med dang*/ phrag dog je rags/ nga rgyal ni lo gcig zla gcig tsam gyi mtshams la sdug sgur byas kyang de tshod kyis nga rgyal/ sems nyams cung zad cig yod kyang nga rgyal de bas che tsam re byed cing mdzad pa sogs yod 'dug la/ de lta bu'i skyon de rnams rang gis brtag dpyad mi yong*/

skyon ngos mi zin/ spong sems dran mi thub pas rang gi skyon der bag med cing*/ sems ma yengs pa 'dra tsam zhig yod pa des chog pa 'dra mo las/ de rtog tshogs nyon mongs dang bsre ba'i lam khyer mi yong ba ste/ rang nyid chos par khas len sgom chen gyi khag khur byed pa yin pa la/ thugs gshis de dang mdzad spyod de skye bo tha mal pa dang khyad med pa de 'dra'ang yong 'dug pas/ de ni 'di lta bu'i dug lnga lam khyer ma byung bas len pa yin pas skyon dang mtshang che ba de 'dra min pa'i lam khyer gal che/ de la skye bo tha mal pa rnams nyon mongs kyis las gsogs pa tha mal pa yin gshis khag med la mtshang chung*/ rang re chos byed pa spyi dang lhag tu nyams len pa rnams kyis nyon mongs 'dzin pa'i dbang du song na chos kyi dgos pa stor bas skyon che/ mtshang che/ ngo tsha ka khrel ba la/ de ltar ma song ba tsam re dgos pa lags/ de yang*/ bsgoms rtags nyon mongs chung ba yin// mkhas rtags sdig la 'dzem pa yin// zhes gsungs/ de'ang rang re tshos mkhas na mkhas rtags las rgyu 'bras shes pas sdig la 'dzem pa dang*/ chos bsgoms na bsgoms rtags nyon mongs shas chung ba zhig los dgos pas/ de ma byung phyin khas len mtho la lag len zhan pa/ nga rgyal che la byed rgyu ngan pa de 'dras ci zhig btub/ 'di rigs la thugs bsam re zhig dgos/ de yang rang rang gi bsam pa sbyor ba thams cad chos min byed srid pas chos dang mthun mi mthun lam du 'gro mi 'gro sogs yang nas yang du brtag dgos te/ lung 'dren ni/ rgyal sras thogs med rin po ches/ rang gi skyon la rang gis ma brtags na// chos pa'i gzugs kyis chos min byed srid pas// dus rnams kun tu rang gi 'khrul pa la// brtags nas spong ba rgyal sras lag len yin// zhes gsungs/ de ltar rang nyid bsam sbyor bag med bsam med brtag dpyad zhib pa ci yang med par ri bo gser bsgom du ma song ba'i/

gang zhig rang gi bsam pa sbyor ba bya spyod rnam 'gyur thams cad chos dang mthun mi mthun/ tshe 'di'i phyogs 'jig rten snang shas su song ma song*/ rnam par dag pa byang chub lam du 'gro mi 'gro sogs kha nang du log mdzub mo rang la bstan te legs par dpyad dgos/ de la nged rang rnams kyis gzhan gyi skyon la brtag pa'i mig gsal blo rno brtag dpyad zhib kyang*/ rag gi skyon de rang gis dpyad pa dang brtag dgos pa mi dran la rang sa de skyon med du 'jog bag med du lus pa mang ba de 'dra ma yin pa'i// mi la lta ba'i mig yod kyang*// rang la lta ba'i me long dgos// zer ba de bzhin rang gis rang la dpyad pa gal che/ de yang rang gi bsam pa rnam par dag /sbyor ba chos dang mthun/ ci byed lam du 'gro ba zhig 'dug na de la dga' ba bsgom/ de ltar chos dang mthun pa de bla ma dang chos kyi bka' drin du bsam pa'i mos gus kyi blo gsal 'debs/ dge ba gong 'phel gyi 'dun smon bya/ gal te bsam pa tshe 'di'i snang shes dang 'dres/ nyon mongs dug lnga'i rtog pa'i rjes su 'brang*/ lag len sdig pa dang nyes ltung gi phyogs su lhung*/ ci byed 'khor ba'i g.yos sbyor du 'dug na/ de la rang gis rang la zhe khrel 'debs sma dbab skyon mtshang ngos bzung*/ nyes ltung la 'gyod pas bshags pa dang*/ spong sems brten pa'i zhe dam bca'/ phyin chad kyi sdom sems bzung*/ skyon gang 'dug pa de yul nas 'don pa'i zhe bcad bya/ 'dzin pa'i rtod phur phud/ blo la yar skyed 'don/ de la bdag lta bur chag bzhag na'ang*/ 'di ltar chos mi la bshad de/ don rang rtsa nas 'chug pa/ rgyu nor zog zas dkor rdzas la tshod med bag med/ len stobs ni gzhan gang las kyang che/ gsog lugs ni 'jig rten pa dang 'dra ba sogs rang sa nas yin rung 'di rnams lam khyer dka' ba 'dra mo nyid na'ang*/ de la rang gi ngos nas tshe 'di blos btang rung mi thong ba'i 'dzin pa che shos rang ni med pa 'dra zhig yin kyang*/

da lta 'phral gyi bstan pa'i lhag bsam/ bla ma dkon mchog gi zhabs tog /dge 'dun gyi 'dzin skyong*/ gzhan phan gyi 'gro 'dug dge rtsa tshogs gsog rten sogs la dkor rdzas ma blangs kyang don med la/ blangs pa de ga rang tshags ma byas na chud zos sbyin par mi the ba'i don med zhig las mi yong phyir/ 'di rigs dgos pa thabs chag lta bu'i blos ched du ma btang la/ rang ngos nas gang ci la'ang rang nom bdag nom gyi 'dzin pa ni gcig la'ang mi byed pa'i rtsis tsam yin/ gang zhig bstan 'dzin gyi skyes bu dam pa rnams kyis bstan pa'i don dang sems can gyi don du phun sum tshogs pa'i dpal la spyod par mdzad pa ni/ rjes su yi rang zhing sangs rgyas 'phags pa'i rnam thar bzang po gzhan don legs mdzad ci nas kyang dgos pa gal du che ba yin pas de ltar rnam dbye phyed dgos pa'o// gsum pa rkyen bde sdug bzang ngan lam du khyer ba'i tshul bshad pa ni/ de yang rkyen bzang ngan bde sdug dge sbyor thog tu lam du khyer ba phun sum tshogs pa'i rten 'brel byang chub thob pa'i sa bon yin pas gtan nas med thabs med pa yin la/ de'ang bzang ngan rkyen sogs sgom dang 'dres dang mi 'dres ni/ rang gi shes rgyud gtso che ste/ de yang 'ga' re zhig bzang rkyen dang 'dres sla la/ ngan rkyen dang 'dres dka' ba/ lto 'grangs nyi mas gros dus chos pa'i gzugs// rkyen ngan sdug bsngal byung tshe tha mal pa// zhes gsungs pa bzhin/ rang sos dal nyams dga' bde zhing skyid pa'i dus nyams len kyang dran pas skyong rgyu yod pa 'dra zhig la/ de min lus la na tsha sems la sdug bsngal/ mi 'dod pa'i rkyen la sogs ngan rkyen byung dus nas de dang mi 'dres pa'i ngan rkyen de rang gi dbang du 'chor/ rang nyid sdug yus ci drag gang drag la rgyu ba de 'drar yong ba dang*/ yang 'ga' re zhig ngan rkyen dang 'dres sla/ bzang rkyen dang 'dres dka' ba ste/
