rje gong ma rnams kyis/ sdug dus chos min pa bsnyabs sa med// skyid dus dran pa dka' mor gda'// zhes gsungs pa bzhin las/ rkyen ngan lus la na tsha/ sems la sdug bsngal mi 'dod pa'i rkyen sogs byung dus/ sgom stor rkyen gyis tshol// zhes gsungs pa ltar/ rkyen des brjed gsos dran slong 'dra zhig byas pas rang yang nges 'byung skyo shas dang dran pa ma yengs pa sogs yong bas ngan rkyen de skabs dran pas zin sla la/ de min bzang rkyen bde dal sos bde nyams dga'/ rang bzhin gyi dus su ni/ rang gar skyid 'dod sos dal le lo snyom las dga' sems brod snang de ka'i dbang du 'gro ba las/ nges 'byung skyo shas kyang mi yong zhing*/ dran pa de skabs dran dka' la/ dran thog tu bzang rkyen de lam du mi slong ba sogs sna tshogs yong bar 'dug ste/ de ltar 'ga' re bzang rkyen dang 'dres sla/ ngan rkyen mi thub/ 'ga' re ngan rkyen dang 'dres sla/ bzang rkyen de dbang du shor ba sogs rigs mi gcig pa mang po yong 'dug pa la/ de ltar rang gis rang la brtag cing dpyad nas/ rkyen bzang ngan gang dang mi 'dres pa'i/ rkyen su mi thub pa de dang po nas ngos bzung nas rgyun du bag yod dang*/ rkyen de thog ched du ro snyoms pa'i dran thog tu lam du khyer ba gal che/ de'ang rkyen de dang bsre ba 'di dag la'ang*/ dang po nas dper bgyis na/ chu ma byung gong nas rag rgyab dgos te/ snga chis kyis chu yong khar rag ma brgyabs na/ chu byung ba dang rag brgyabs kyang rgyab longs med par chu rang dbang cher 'gro ba'i dpe ltar rang re las dang po pa rnams kyis kyang rkyen bzang ngan 'di rnams ma byung gong nas rkyen de rnams dang bsre dgos/ rkyen dang bsre ba gal che/ chos pa'i pho shan thams cad rkyen gyis 'byed pas na/ rkyen dang nyams len mi bsre ba'i thabs med bsam pa'i go ba bag yod/ 'dun pa go cha lta bu de bzhin dus rnams kun tu mi brjed pa yang nas yang du byed dgos la/

de ltar dang po nas rkyen thog tu bsre ba'i 'dun pa bag yod dgos/ de bzhin yang yang byas pa de la rang blo goms pa dang*/ chu ma byung gong nas rag brgyabs tshar ba dang 'dra ba'i/ dngos gzhi'i rkyen de byung dus sngon nas bag yod de'i dbang gis ngos zin sla la/ ngos zin nas kyang sngon gyi rkyen dang bsre dgos bsam pa'i 'dun pa la goms sems des/ rkyen de'ang thub sla ba 'byung ba yin pas/ dang po nas rkyen bzang ngan thams cad dang bsre dgos bsam pa'i bag yod 'dun pa 'di ka rang rgyun ldan brten pa gal che/ de min rgyun ldan bag yod 'dun pa de bzhin ma byas tshe/ chu ma byung gong nas rag ma brgyabs pa dang 'dra ba'i rkyen bzang ngan de rnams la dang po nas bag yod zhig med na ngos zin dka' la/ gal te thang re thang gnyis rab rib cig ngos zin kyang*/ rang re rnams ni chags sdang sogs mi dge ba'i rtog pa dang*/ rkyen de rnams la ni tshe rabs 'khor ba thog med nas goms shing 'dris/ de'i gnyen po dran pa dang*/ 'dun pa 'di nyid ni sngar yang ma goms/ da ltar yang rang gi brtson pas ma sbyangs pas/ rkyen de kho rang kha yan rkyen thog de rang shugs dang rang dbang che bar 'gro ba las/ rkyen de dran pas thul dka' ba nyid yin pas/ de 'drar ma song ba'i dang po nas bag yod dang go cha sogs byed pa gal che ste/ de'ang rkyen bzang ngan de rnams dang bsre dgos bsam pa'i bag yod zhig rang gi sems la rgyun ldan du med na/ skye bo tha mal pa rang dang 'dra ba'i rkyen de rnams ngos mi zin pas/ rkyen de rnams kha yan nag po'i rang bzhin yin/ rkyen bzang ngan de dag gi dbang du skad cig kyang mi gtong bsam pa'i snying stobs kyi go cha zhig med na/ rkyen re gnyis ngos zin kyang rang dbang du mi 'du bas rkyen dbang du shor ba shas che ste de'ang dran pa de thang gcig thang gnyis la sogs rkyen dbang tu shor na ngan pa rkyag long shor ba lta bu'am/

rta rgod btul 'khreb la shor ba lta bus slar thul dka' bas na// ngos zin bzhin de'i dbang du mi gtong bar rang thog tu dran pa'i gnyen po drag tu brten nas rang thog tu 'jog cing lam du khyer ba gal che/ lam du khyer tshul 'dir mdor bsdus ni/ gsung ngag rin po che bzhi sgrom ltar phyag len du bstar ba mchog tu legs/ de'ang bde sdug legs nyes lam khyer bzhi las// dang po bde ba lam khyer ni/ gnas skabs su sdug bsngal med cing*/ rkyen bzang dgra thul zhing dbang du 'dus pa/ gnyen byams pa/ mi nor zas gos 'dzom pa/ mi gzhan gyis bstod bkur snyan grags sogs ci bsam 'grub pa'i bde skyid mang po byung yang*/ de la dga' chags zhen pa'i dbang du btang na/ dge ba bsod nams thams cad stor bas/ de ltar min pa'i skyid pa'i dus kyang der chags zhen gyi dbang du mi gtong bar ngos bzung*/ da lta bde zhing skyid pa tshe sngon dge ba byas pa'i 'bras bu dang*/ bla ma dkon mchog gi bka' drin du bsam/ mos gus kyi gsos su btab/ de min gzhan gyi rkyen rang gi pho sgo sogs su mi 'dzin/ bde skyid longs spyod thams cad bla ma dkon mchog la phul bar dmigs shing*/ dngos su'ang mchod sbyin byed/ sngon dge ba'i 'bras bus da lta bde skyid byung ba dang*/ da yang dge ba byed nas rjes su bde skyid 'ong bar byed bsam pa'i rgyu 'bras la yid ches kyi ngos nas lag len dge ba sgrub cing*/ bde zhing skyid par dga' ba dang chags zhing zhen pa'i blo skyes na dran pas ngos bzung*/ rang gshis thog tu bzhag rang ngo skyong*/ tshe 'dir snang bde skyid phun tshogs thams cad kyang snying po med pa rmi lam sgyu ma lta bur shes par bya ba rgyun du bslab/ rjes su bla ma dkon mchog la gsol ba rtse gcig tu gdab/ bdag gis chags zhen lam du btang ba'i dge bas bdag sogs sems can thams cad gnas skabs sngon gyi bsod nams mi 'dzad cing bsod nams 'phel bas dus rnams kun tu bde skyid phun sum tshogs pa dang mthar thug bde chen sangs rgyas thob par shog

/bsam pa'i smon lam la 'bad/ de ltar byas na phan yon dgos ched rten 'brel chen po sna tshogs pa yod la sngon gyi dge ba mi 'dzad cing gong du 'phel 'gro bas mchog gi dngos grub kyi rgyu'i gtso bor grub/ de min skyid dus de dbang du btang 'dzin zhen rang ga mar bskyed dge ba lam slong ma byas na/ sngon gyi bsod nams chu bcad pa ltar du 'dzad/ phyin chad bsod nams mi 'phel bas tshe 'di'i bde skyid kyang med par 'gyur na byang chub ni gang nas thob/ de 'drar ma song ba'i skyid pa'i dus kyang de'i dbang du mi gtong zhen chags kyi rtog pa dran pas ngos bzung nas/ don yin bzhin bsams nas gang yang ngo shes dang ma bral bar byed/ rjes su gsol 'debs smon lam gyis dge ba shin tu rgya che ba dang byang chub lam du bsgyur ba de sogs la brtson par byed dgos// gnyis pa sdug bsngal lam khyer ni/ rang la phyi ru dgra sdang bas 'tshe ba/ gnyen byams pas bskyur ba/ mi shi ba/ nor zad pa/ zas gos dbul ba/ gzhan gyis brnyas chos/ kha gtong ba/ brdung btags phog pa/ khrims la thug pa/ lha 'dre'i bar chad kyis 'tshe ba sogs/ mdor na lus kyi na tsha/ sems kyi sdug bsngal mi 'dod pa sna tshogs pa zhig byung na/ rkyen ngan de la bsre lugs ni/ rang la mi 'dod pa ci byung de la ched du sems sdug pa dang blo pham pa yid mug sogs mi bya/ lam du khyer zhing byang chub tu rgyas 'debs pa 'di bzhin bsam ste/ de yang*/ rang da ltar mi bde ba 'di rang gis tshe sngon las ngan sdig pa bsags pa'i rnam smin yin te/ rnam smin de yun du lus na je 'phel du 'gro zhing rang phyi mar sdug bsngal tshan po che bskyed pa yin pas da lta lus thog 'dir smin pa dang*/ da ltar smin zhing myur du dag pa ni/ bla ma dkon mchog chos kyi bka' drin yin bsam de la dga' ba bsgom/ dgra la sdang ba/ gnyen la chags pa/ zas gos nor la brnab sems/

gzhan gyis brnyas pa sogs la mi dga' ba/ lha 'dre'i bar chad la re dogs mi byed/ gal srid re dogs chags sdang rnam rtog byung na/ rang gi dran pas ngos zin par byas/ de'i dbang du mi gtong bar de ka'i rang gshis thog tu bzhag /bla ma dkon mchog la phur tshugs su kha dang tshig tsam ma yin par snying khong rus pa'i gting nas mos gus chen pos 'di phyi bar do thams cad du rang la skyid sdug ci byung yang blo khyed shes kyis gsol ba btab/ bdag dang bdag la 'tshe ba'i dgra sogs kyis thog drang sems can thams cad kyi las ngan sdig sgrib thams cad dag par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ bsam pa dang las ngan dag pa'i smon lam btab nas bla ma dkon mchog rang dang sems can rnams la bstim/ de nas rang gi sems kyi ngo bo blta/ de ltar sems kyi ngo bo blta ba'i dus sam/ de min dus skabs nam yin na'ang*// dgra gnyen la chags sdang*/ rang la rkyen ngan byung ba der sdug sems skyo shas kyi rnam rtog byung na de'i dbang du mi gtong*/ dran pas ngos bzung nas/ chags shing zhen na de ka'i ngo bo/ sdang zhing 'khrug na de ka'i ngo bo/ sdug cing skyo na de ka'i ngo bo bltas/ chags sdang skyo gsum ji ltar byung na de ka yengs med kyi 'dun pas ngos bzung*/ de gar nyams len gyi dngos gzhir bcol nas rang sems bskyang*/ de rjes su lam slong smon lam 'debs pa ni/ bdag gis chags sdang sdug bsngal sogs lam du khyer ba 'di'i dge bar brten nas bdag sogs dgra bcas sems can thams cad kyi dus gsum gyi las ngan sdig sgrib thams cad dag par shog /bsam pa'i smon lam snying nas btab/ de ltar 'bad na lam du slong 'gro zhing 'di phyi tshe rabs kun tu legs pa zhig 'ong*/ de ltar ma yin pa'i dus rgyun sos dal skyid dus dge sbyor skyong rgyu zhig dang po yod pa'i khul 'dra zhig byed/ rkyen ngan gang rung zhig byung dus gar song med pa nas/

su las kyang chags sdang gdug sems che ba gcig byas bsdad na chos dgos dus ma slebs pa yin te/ de la rgyal sras thogs med pas/ lto 'grangs nyi mas dros dus chos pa'i gzugs// rkyen ngan sdug bsngal byung tshe tha mal pa// rang sems chos dang 'dres pa mi gda' na// zhes gsungs pa de yong bas/ de 'drar ma song ba'i rkyen byung dus lam khyer dran pa gal che/ de'ang rang la rkyen de bzhin byung bar sdug bsngal du mi bsam/ lam du khyer dgos don rang ni/ de'ang rang la tshe 'dir phyi rol nas rkyen ngan pa dang*/ de'i dbang gis nang du rang gi sems la sdug bsngal sogs mi 'dod pa yong*/ 'di dag thams cad ni tshe sngon sdig pa mi dge ba bsags pa'i myong ba rgyu mthun gyi 'bras bu yin la/ de la lam khyer ma byung na rang bzhin sdug bsngal kha lhag las sgrib pa cher byang mi nus shing*/ lam khyer shes na sdig sgrib thams cad dag par nus pas lam khyer dang sems bskyed smon lam gal che/ de'ang tshe sngon gyi las sgrib tshe 'dir smin pa la spong sems med pa'i dga' ba bsgom rigs pa'i rgyu mtshan ni 'di bzhin yin te/ dper na nyes can gyi mi srog la 'bab pa'i khrims la thug pa de/ rgyu nor dang ngo chen gyis bslus nas srog la ma babs par brdung thag tsam gyis khrims sangs par byung na de la dga' ba cher byed cing spro sems byed mod/ dpe de bzhin rang re tshe sngon sdig pa mi dge ba'i 'bras bus tshe phyi ma rnams su ngan song gi sdug bsngal bzod par dka' ba yun ring por myong dgos pa de nyid/ bla ma dkon mchog gi thugs rje dang chos kyi byin rlabs kyis bslus nas ngan song du mi 'gro bar tshe 'di'i sdug bsngal phran bu tsam gyis rnam smin dag par byung na/ de ni shin tu legs pa yin la/ de ltar shes pa'i spro sems dang dga' ba bskyed nas/ gzhan yang rang gi tshe rabs 'khor ba thog med kyi las sgrib dang*/

khams gsum mar gyur sems can thams cad kyi las sgrib sbyong 'dun gyi sems bskyed bzang po dang bcas da lta'i rang gi sdug bsngal 'dis bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi sdug bsngal dag par shog /bsam pa'i smon lam gsol 'debs byas na/ bdag gzhan gyi sdig sgrib dag pa'i thabs mchog la gzhan gang las kyang phul du byung ba yin te/ des na/ rje gong ma rnams kyis/ rkyen ngan dge ba'i bshes gnyen dang*/ na tsha sdig sgrib gyi phyags shing yin/ zhes gsungs so// 'di la'ang gtong len gyi dmigs pa bsgom pa gnad du che ste/ de'ang rang gi sdug bsngal gyi steng du khams gsum gyi sems can thams cad kyi sdug bsngal las sgrib thams cad rang la 'dus/ de rnams kyi sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu dang bral/ rang gi dge tshogs bde ba thams cad sems can rnams la phar byin pas de rnams gnas skabs kyi bde ba dang mthar thug legs pa'i lam la 'god par bsam pa'i gtong len dmigs pa yang yang bya/ de ltar byas na shin tu dge stobs yon tan che bar 'byung ba yin no/ de ltar rkyen ngan lam du slong bar byas nas// gsum pa legs pa lam du slong ba ni/ de'ang nang du dge sems dad pa/ snying rje/ mos gus/ brtson 'grus/ phan sems/ dag snang sogs dang*/ tshe ring nad med sgom pa 'phel ba de dag byung na/ de'i dbang du btang na mi yong bas/ de tsho gang byung ngos bzung nas rang gi ngo thog der mnyam par bzhag nas blta/ rjes su bla ma dkon mchog la gsol ba gdab/ bdag gis dge sems lam du btang ba 'di'i mthus/ bdag sogs sems can thams cad gnas skabs chos min gyi bsam pa mi skye zhing*/ chos mthun gyi bsam pa ma lus pa skyes te/ chos lam du 'gro ba dang mthar thug 'bras bu sangs rgyas thob par shog /snyam pa'i smon lam bzang po btab/ de ltar byas na dge ba de'ang stobs che lam du 'gro/ byang chub thob sla ba sogs phan yon mang du 'byung*/

de min dge sems de'i dbang du btang nas bcings na/ spyir sgom rang la bzang rtog ngan rtog khyad med cing*/ bkyigs na gser skud dang rtsa thag gang gis bkyigs kyang ngo bo la khyad med pa bzhin 'ching na bzang ngan rtog pa gang gis 'chings khyad med pas de ltar a 'thas 'dzin par ma song bar 'dzin med rang grol 'ong ba'i gnad zab mo ngos bzung lam gtong smon lam sogs sngon bzhin 'bad pa gal che// bzhi pa nyes pa lam khyer ni/ yang rkyen la ma ltos pa'i 'char sgo mi legs pa/ gang ltar byas kyang mi bde zhing nyams rtogs mi 'phel ba/ nyon mongs pas rgyud dkrugs nas snying mi dga' ba/ bsam tshad thog tu mi khel ba/ grags pa ngan pa sogs rkyen ngan sna tshogs byung na/ chos rje 'brug pa'i drag sngags tshig gsum gyis tshar bcad/ ngag nas brjod 'dir snang gi legs nyes zhen chags thams cad blos ling gis bskyur/ re dogs mi byed/ 'char sgo ma legs pa de rang gi steng du ma bcos par glod nas ma yengs tsam du bzhag /bla ma dkon mchog la gsol ba drag tu gdab/ rkyen snang 'di la brten nas bdag dang 'gro ba'i las sgrib dag par byin gyis rlobs/ bsam pa dang*/ rkyen ngan 'di dag gis bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi sdug bsngal sdig sgrib thams cad dag par shog /bsam pa'i smon lam bzang po gdab/ de bzhin byas na mthar skyon rtsa bral du rtogs/ bde chen du ro snyoms/ rkyen thog tu gdengs rnyed pa'i gnad khyad par can sgom gyi bogs 'don bla na ma mchis pa 'ong rgyur 'dug ste/ de'ang 'bri gung 'jig rten mgon pos/ bde skyid thams cad bla ma'i drin du bsam// byas pa shes na bde ba chen po 'phel// sdug bsngal byung na sngon gyi las su bsam// las ngan zad na sdug bsngal 'byung don med// legs pa'i phyogs su rten 'brel zab mo bsgrigs// phun sum tshogs pa rang gis byas pas chog /mi legs pa la gnyen pos ldog bsgom bya// kun rdzob rdzun phugs rdib pa'i gdams ngag yin// zhes gsungs pa'i don yang 'di yin te/

de ltar rgyal sras thogs med pas/ bdag gzhan sgyu ma'i phung po 'di// na na na ste na bas dga'// sngar bsags las ngan 'dzad pa yin/ chos spyod kyi bya ba sna tshogs pa// sgrib gnyis byang ba'i ched du yin// na ba med na de bas dga'// lus sems bde na dge sbyor 'phel// mi lus don chen byed pa yang*// sgo gsum dge la sbyor ba yin// 'byor pa med na med de dga'// bsrung brel gyi bya brel de la med// 'thab rtsod kyi khro 'khrugs ci snyed pa// 'dzin chags kyi nor las 'byung bar nges// 'byor pa yod na yod de dga'// bsod nams kyi dge tshogs spel bas chog /'phral phugs kyi phan bde ji snyed pa// bsod nams kyi 'bras bu yin par nges// myur du shi na shi bas dga'// rkyen ngan gyis bar du ma chod cing*// mtshams sbyor gyis dge sbyor bzang 'grogs pas// ma nor gyi lam du chud par nges// yun du gson na gson pas dga'// nyams myong gi go rtogs bskyed pa la// gdams ngag gi rlan drod ma yal bar// yun du brtan pas smin par 'gyur// zhes sogs mang du gsungs/ de ltar lam khyer 'di bzhin gnad du bsnun pa sogs gal shin tu che bar snang yang*/ dus snyigs ma'i chos byed rnam pa 'ga' rer ni sgom pa yid yul du'ang mi 'ong*/ res 'ga' ni bsgoms kyang rkyen dang mi bsre bar byung dus bsgom/ ma byung dus skyur de 'dra byed pa 'dug ste/ des ni phan pa cher mi 'byung 'dra/ chos thams cad nyon mongs pa'i gnyen por gsungs shing rkyen thog tu bsres nas thub dgos te/ rje rgya ras kyis/ chos shan rkyen gyis 'byed pa la// rkyen dang mi bsre ba'i snying med po// zhes dang*/ rje pad+ma dkar pos/ phal cher mkhas btsun bzang por ming btags kyang*// rkyen ngan gnod pa'i drung du rtse rum rum// zhes so// de phyir sgom rkyen thub mthar 'don dus kun lag len ma 'dzol ba gal che ste/

rje rgod tshang pas/ rang shes pa la gang gnod pa'i steng du sgom pa yin te/ na na na thog tu bsgom/ ltogs na ltogs thog tu bsgom// grang na grang thog tu bsgom/ mi dga' na mi dga' ba'i thog tu bsgoms pas rkyen thams cad sgom du 'char 'ong ba yin ci ste na rkyen snang kho rang sems yin pa'i phyir ro// sems las logs na chos sku med pa'i phyir ro// de ltar bsgoms pas bogs mi yong ba'i thabs med pa yin gyis/ sems nyid ngo bo nyid kyis stong pa'i cha la ched du bsgom rgyu med/ mi sgom pa'i ngang la ma yengs pa zhig med thabs med pa lags so// zhes gsungs pa ltar ro// zhar 'phros/ theg pa chen po'i blo sbyong gi man ngag skyid sdug lam khyer paṇa chen shākya shrī'i khyad chos las/ skyid na bde ba tshogs su bsngo// phan bdes nam mkha' gang bar shog /sdug na kun gyi sdug bsngal khur// bdag gzhan sdig sgrib dag par shog /ces gsungs pa ni skyid sdug lam khyer gtong len dang bsgrags pa shin tu legs par 'dug pa'i don nyams su len na/ rang la bde skyid 'dzom dga' bsam pa'i don 'grub phun sum tshogs pa dang*/ nyams dang rtogs pa gzhi mtho lta bu sogs kyi bde skyid che phra ci lta bu byung na dga' spro de'i dbang du ma song ba'i mi chags mi zhen bde skyid 'di bla ma dkon mchog gi bka' drin du bsam/ bdag gi lus sems bde ba dang skyid pa 'di bla ma rgyal ba rnams kyi spyan sngar mchod sprin rgya mtsho chen por bsgyur te tshogs su bsngo zhing phul bas thugs kyi dgyes pa skyed/ rigs drug sems can kun gyi snang ngor phan bde'i dga' bas nam mkha' gang bar 'gro ba sems can de kun bde skyid phun sum tshogs par shog bsams nas/ de nyid dran pa'i rtsis 'dzin pa'i zhen med 'dzin med ngang nas skyid thog tu ngo bo ngo shes dran pas skyong*/ yang rang la sdug bsngal mi 'dod pa'i rkyen gyi dgra gdon gyi gnod 'tshe/

nang lus la na tsha sems la sdug bsngal ci byung na'ang re dogs sdug bsngal gyi dbang du ma song ba'i tshe sngon gyi las ngan lus thog 'dir smin pa bla ma dkon mchog gi byin rlabs su shes pas dga' ba bsgoms nas/ bdag gi lus mi bde ba 'di la brten nas 'gro ba sems can kun gyi las dang nyon mongs nad dang sdug bsngal bdag la 'dus nas/ de rnams bdag gis khur nus shing de'i mthus bdag gzhan sems can kun gyi sdig sgrib nyes ltung bag chags thams cad dag cing sbyangs nus par shog /snyam nas/ sdug mkhan de rang gi ngo bo'i steng du lhod de glod nas/ ma yengs tsam du bzhag pas sdug bsngal de nyid spang mi dgos par kho rang gi ngo bo bde ba chen po ru 'char ba zhig yong ba yin/ de ltar gyis skyid sdug lam du khyer zhing smon tshig 'don par bya ba'ang legs pas de ltar nges par bya dgos so// de rnams ni phyag chen dngos gzhi'i sngon du 'gro ba'i rim pa'i bsgom don mdor bsdus te bshad pa'o// ༈ //rtsa ba'i sa bcad gnyis pa/ dngos gzhi rang la/ dang po rtse gcig gi rnal 'byor bshad pa/ gnyis pa spros bral gyi rnal 'byor bshad pa/ gsum pa ro gcig gi rnal 'byor bshad pa/ bzhi pa sgom med kyi rnal 'byor bshad pa dang bzhi'o// dang po rtse gcig gi rnal 'byor la'ang zhi gnas kyis ting nge 'dzin gyi rtsa ba bsgrub pa/ de nyid rtse gcig gi rnal 'byor gyi sgo nas sgom pa stobs su spel ba gnyis so// de'i dang po zhi gnas kyis ting nge 'dzin gyi rtsa ba bsgrub pa la'ang*/ dang po sgom gyi rtsa ba zhi gnas kyi nyams tshol ba bshad pa/ gnyis pa de'i skyon spang ba bshad pa/ gsum pa rgyu mtshan nyid so sor bshad pa dang gsum mo// de'i dang po sgom gyi rtsa ba zhi gnas kyi nyams tshol ba la'ang*/ rten can dang rten med gnyis las/ dang po rten can la'ang rlung med rlung can gnyis so// rlung med la'ang ma dag pa rde'u shing bur rten bca' ba dang*/

dag pa de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gsung thugs la rten bca' ba gnyis so// dang po ma dag pa rde'u shing bur rten bca' ba ni/ de yang*/ rje btsun til+li pa'i zhal nas/ lta stangs sems 'dzin yan lag du ma yis// rig pa ngang gis mi gnas bar du bzung*// zhes dang*/ rje rgya ras kyis/ rten can rde'u shing bu dang*/ zhes sogs gsungs pa'i don ni/ rang nyid sngon bzhin lus gnad legs par byed dgos te/ lus gnad med na sems rnal du mi phebs te/ rje dus gsum mkhyen pas/ pha ri la lta 'dod na tshu ri nas ltos/ sems gnas par 'dod pas lus kyi 'khrul 'khor gcun// zhes gsungs/ de ltar lus gnad byas nas dang po bla ma la gsol ba 'debs dgos te/ de'ang man ngag spyi thams cad nas mos gus sgom gyi mgo bo/ zhes gsungs te/ de'ang byams pas/ rang byung rnams kyi don dam ni// dad pa kho nas rtogs bya yin// zhes gsungs/ de ltar bla ma la gsol ba 'debs lugs ni/ bla ma spyi bor bsgom/ sangs rgyas dngos su bsam/ ma nam mas gsol ba tshig tsam ma yin par drag tu btab// phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub thob par byin gyis rlobs// zhes dngos grub zhu/ bdag nyid la bstim/ thugs yid dbyer med du 'dres par bsam pa'i ngang nas/ dmigs rten ni/ mdun du rde'u shing bu gang yang rung ba phra mo zhig mig gi thad rang dang gnya' shing gang tsam du bzhag la/ dmigs rten de kho nar rtse gcig tu blta bar bya zhing*/ de'ang dmigs rten la ha cang bsgrim drags na rtog pa'i 'phro rkyen du 'gyur ba'i phyir rang babs su bzhag la/ dmigs rten 'di don mig shes dang dbang shes yul gzhan la 'phror mi 'jug pa'i rten yin pas/ de ltar bsam la mig rdel gyi steng du sems kyi rang ngo ma yengs par brten cing*/ de la mig rdel thog tu yengs thabs dran med du mi sdod par de'i phra sbom ring thung kha dog la sogs par brtag dpyad kyi bsam blo mi gtong*/

dmigs rten de nyid bye brag la mi blta spyi la blta/ rim gyis mi blta cig car blta/ mig gi lta stangs mi 'gyur ba'i rtod phur mig rdel de rang la bcol nas mig gi lta stangs tsho bzung*/ dmigs rten ma yengs dran pa gso ba'i rten yin la/ dmigs rten de'i steng du ma yengs tsam gyi lta stangs gtad nas 'jog par byed pa yin/ rig pa 'das pa'i bsam blo rjes snyogs su mi gtod/ ma 'ongs pa'i bsam blo sngon bsu ru mi gtong*/ da lta ba'i dran rtog la dpyad gzhig mi bya/ mig gis gzugs mthong ba'i rjes su blta ba dang mi yengs/ rna bas sgra thos pa'i rjes su mi 'brang rang gi rig pa rang gis tsho bzung*/ rang rig ma bcos pa'i klong du 'jog /bzo med kyi gshis su glod/ rang sems rang gis rang ma brjed pa'i dran pa dang 'dun pa thu re bsgrim/ 'khrul med brjed med kyi sgom gyi rang ngo'i steng du 'jog dgos bsam pa'i dran pa ngar bskyed/ de'ang gshis rang babs kyi steng du 'jog /de ltar 'jog pa'i dus bzhag thog las gzhan du mi 'phro bar cung zhig tsam gnas na/ gnas pa de thog gi ngo bo shes bzhin du bskyang*/ gnas yun ring po e yong gi re ba mi byed/ gnas thung bar dogs pa'i dogs pa mi byed/ skad cig tsam las ma gnas kyang de'i ngo bo cung zhig yun ring bar gnas na'ang de'i ngo bo ste/ mdor na gnas na gnas thog tu glod la gnas pa de'i ngo bo yengs med du bskyang*/ de las mi gnas par yang na 'das par de byas kyi bsam blo/ yang na ma 'ongs par de byed kyi bsam blo/ yang na da ltar mig gis gzugs mthong rna bas sgra thos pa de thog tu 'gro ste/ rig pa mi gnas tshe dus gsum gyi bsam blo rnam pa sna tshogs su 'char zhing*/ bzang ngan 'bring gsum gyi rtog pa ci'ang dran gang yang 'phro ba de/ don dam par sems kyi gshis dang gnyis su med pas/ 'gyu ba de ngan par blta mi dgos/

rig pa ngo thog gi rang rtsal ma byung na bsam pas dgag mi dgos/ bzang rtog ngan rtog sngar byas da byed/ phra rags sbom gsum gyi rtog pa ci 'dra zhig shar rung*/ de nyid ma yengs pa'i 'dun pa des ngo tsir gyis bzung la/ de ka rang gi thog tu ngo shes tsam du lhod kyis glod/ dper na rdzi bos ra lug zas la brgyab nas phyogs kyis 'tsho zhing lta ba ltar/ ma yengs dran pa de nyid rdzi bo lta bu las/ rnam rtog gang dran rnams ra lug sogs 'tsho ba ltar/ dran rdzi des ma brjed tsam du skyong pa las/ bzo bcos bsgyur bsgom mang pos lhad mi 'jug /'dun pa brjed pa dang yengs pa byung na/ brjed mtshams de nas dran pas bzung la slar ma yengs pa'i dran pa lhang nge ba brten/ de nas rgyun ring bas lus gnad mi thub pa/ mig sbrid pas dmigs rten mi rig pa/ 'gul ba sems dran pa med pa sogs byung na 'phro rbad kyis bcad la bzhag /yang ngal sos pa dang slar bskyangs te de lta bu sgom shes lhod shes byas nas rgyun du g.yeng ba med par skyong rgyu yin/ 'di ltar ma dag pa rde'u shing bu la sems 'dzin pa 'di ni so so'i skye bo tha mal pa rnams la dang po nas dmigs pa lha sogs bsgom pa dang sems rang lugs su 'jog pa rnams byed du bcug kyang goms 'dris bag chags med pas mi shes/ de bas kho rang sngon nas 'dris shing bag chags yod pa'i rde'u shing bu la brten te sems ma yengs par byed du bcug na de yong zhing thabs shin tu zab pa yin par 'dug /'di ltar byed pa'i dpe lung ni/ bcom ldan 'das kyis zhing mkhan la chos bstan pas ma shes par thong gshol la dper mdzad de de ka dmigs pa'i rten du gyis gsungs pa des kyang ji bzhin shes te dgra bcom pa thob pa dang*/ sngon rgya gar du'ang grub thob brgyad cu rnams la slob dpon gyis chos gsungs par/ 'ga' re pi wang la 'dris pas spang du med pas chos mi 'ong zhes zhus pas/

slob dpon gyis de ni spang mi dgos te/ de ka chos su yod ces der brten ngo sprad pa dang*/ 'ga' re rdzun la 'dris pas sngon bzhin zhus pa de kar brten nas chos gsungs pa dang*/ 'ga' re rol mo dang 'dris par der brten nas bshad pa/ 'ga' re gar la 'dris par der brten nas bshad pa/ 'ga' re glu la 'dris par der brten nas bshad pa ngo sprod btab pas ngo 'phrod pa sogs/ mdor na rgya bod thams cad du dpe shin tu mang ba'o// gnyis pa dag pa de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gsung thugs la rten bca' ba la/ dang po sku gzugs brnyan la rten bca' ba/ gnyis pa gsung yig 'bru la rten bca' ba/ gsum pa thugs thig le la rten bca' ba gsum las/ dang po sku gzugs brnyan la rten bca' ba'i sgom lugs ni/ de'ang de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku bsgom mi shes pa la bslab rgyu ni/ sngon nas de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku lugs su blugs pa'am ri mor bris pa zhig mdun du bzhag /de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku la blta rgyu yod pa 'di bsod nams che zhing*/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku la skyabs su mchi bsam pa'i dad pa dang bcas pas mig dang sems gzhan du ma yengs par rtse gcig tu blta/ de'i sku gzugs legs nyes ji ltar 'dug pa dang sku mdog sogs brtag dpyad mi bya zhing*/ ma yengs dran pa'i rten sangs rgyas kyi sku la bcol nas rang babs su lhod par bskyang*/ rnam rtog dran pas ngos 'dzin/ yengs skabs 'dun pas 'tsho skyong byed/ de la rgyun ring bas lus gnad mi bde zhing sku mi mthong ba sems mi gnas pa sogs byung na 'phro bcad/ slar yang gsol ba btab nas/ yang sngon gyi rgyun de bzhin bskyang*/ de ltar sku la 'dris su bcug ste 'dris nas/ sku rang mig sngar mi 'jog par// rang gi mdun du rin po che'i khri pad+ma dang nyi zlas brgyan pa mchog tu mdzes pa'i steng du/ ston pa bcom ldan 'das shākya'i skyes mchog

sku gser btso ma lta bu zhal gcig phyag gnyis sa gnon dang mnyam gzhag gi phyag rgya can/ mtshan bzang po sum cu rtsa gnyis dang*/ dpe byad bzang po brgyad cus brgyan pa/ thun mtshams kyi sprin ltar dmar ba'i chos gos gsum gyis mdzes shing*/ zhabs rdo rje skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa 'od dang 'od zer gyi 'khor lo can zhig yid kyis bsgom/ de sangs rgyas dngos rang du bsam zhing des chos ston byin gyis brlabs pa dang bcas pa bsam/ 'di ltar bsgom du yod pa ni bsod nams skal ba bzang po bla med bsam pa dang bcas nas/ sangs rgyas kyi sku de la sems gtad nas ma yengs par skyong ba dang*/ de nas kyang der goms nas yang sku de de bas che tsam zhig tu bsam/ der goms pa dang che ru che ru btang ste/ mthar sku shin tu che ba zhig bsgoms nas der sems 'dzin/ yang chung du btang nas mthar yungs 'bru tsam la'ang sems gtad/ de ltar rgyal ba'i sku che chung ma nges par rtsal sbyangs te sems 'dun pa gtad/ 'di ni dang po skye bo tha mal pa rnams rim gyis khrid pa'i thabs te/ dang po 'dris pa'i bag chags la bslab/ de nas rgyal ba'i sku dngos bcas la bslab/ de nas rgyal ba'i sku bsgom pa la bslab pa de ltar yin/ 'di ltar rgyal ba nyid kyis kyang bshad de/ sngon dus khyim bdag rgan por chos stong pa nyid bstan pas ma shes par khyod ci la sems 'gro gsungs pas/ bdag bcom ldan 'das nyid kyi sku la sems 'gro zhus par de ni shin tu legs te/ 'o na bdag nyid bsgoms te de la sems gtod gsungs par/ khyim bdag gis kyang de bzhin byas pas myur bar chos kyi don rtogs pa yin par 'dug pa de bzhin dang*/ gzhan yang de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku la dad pas lta ba 'di la sangs rgyas rjes su dran pa'i ting nge 'dzin rgya mtsho'i dbyings zhes bya ste/ bsod nams shin tu che zhing sgrib pa thams cad dag pa dang*/

yon tan thams cad rdzogs pa'i phan yon kyang shin tu che ste/ mdo las/ shin tu rnyed par dka' ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa mthong bas ni sdig pa thams cad zad pa'o// nyon mongs thams cad 'jil ba'o// 'jigs tshogs su lta ba'i glo bur gyi dri ma thams cad dang bral ba'o// zhes sogs gsungs shing*/ gzhan ni bcom ldan 'das nyid mya ngan las 'das par bzhed pa'i gong du nyid kyi sku stod kyi chos gos bsal te/ sku rjen pa 'khor rnams la bstan nas/ kye rgyal ba'i sras rigs kyi bu rnams de bzhin gshegs pa mthong ba ni shin tu rnyed par dka'/ rnyed pa mnyam med rnyed pa'i dus 'dir ltos shig legs par ltos shig /ces gsungs pa yin/ da lta thub pa sangs rgyas nyid mi bzhugs pas de tsam yon tan med par bsam na de ni ma yin te/ rgyal ba'i sku ci 'dra la'ang*/ dad pas bltas gus pas btud na des chog yon tan thams cad yong ste/ lung las/ gang dag sangs rgyas yid byed pa// de yi mdun du thub pa bzhugs// zhes dang*/ sangs rgyas chos kyi sku can phyir// tshogs kyang de yi mthar thug go /zhes sogs mang du gsungs pas/ don du khyad med/ dad pa yod na rgyal ba'i sku rang min kyang snod bcud gang rigs la dag snang gis yin bsam par byas na'ang*/ dad pa'i legs byas chud mi 'dza' ste/ des kyang yon tan chen po thob pa yang yang gsungs shing*/ rgyal ba'i sku yid kyis bsgoms te der sems gtad pa ni/ shin tu nas kyang bsod nams che ste/ ting nge 'dzin rgyal po'i mdo las/ gser gyi kha dog lta bu'i sku lus kyis// 'jig rten mgon po kun nas mdzes pa ste// dmigs pa de la gang gis sems 'jog pa'i// byang chub sems de mnyam par bzhag ces bya// zhes sogs gsungs pa dang*/ yang de ltar mnyam bzhag gi tshe min kyang*/ dus rgyun 'gro 'dug la sogs thams cad du'ang*/ rgyal ba'i sku'am rgyal ba yid la byed pa dang mi 'bral bar byed dgos/

de yang phan yon che ste/ ting 'dzin rgyal por/ mtshan mo mkha' la skar mas gang ba ltar// 'gro dang 'chag dang nyal dang 'dug pa na// mi gang thub pa'i zla ba dran byed pa// de yi mdun du ston pa rtag tu bzhugs// zhes gsungs/ de ltar mnyam rjes thams cad du sangs rgyas yid byed dang mi 'bral bar bya/ 'dir bying rgod kyi skyon byung na sel thabs ni/ dang po sems mi gsal mi rig nyogs pa'i bying rmugs 'thibs gsum byung na ni/ mig kyang yar 'phang btegs nas/ rgyal ba'i sku'i gtsug tor ram mdzod spu'am zhal gyi dkyil 'khor la sems 'dzin/ sems mi gnas pa'i 'phro rgod mang du byung na mig kyang mar smad nas dmigs pa'ang rgyal ba'i lte ba dang zhabs kyi mthil pad gdan mtshams de dag gang rung du sems 'dzin gtad pas sel ba yod/ bying rgod med pa'i tshe sku yongs rdzogs la gtad pa'am de tsam ma byung na thugs ka'i dpal be'u la gtad pas chog /de la mi gnas na mtshan bzang rnams kyi mas nas yas dang yas nas mar rim pas/ yid kyis ma yengs ngos nas bsngo bsgrang bya ba de ltar yin/ gzhan yang gsang sngags kyi lam sgom mkhan gyis ni bskyed rim gzhan yang byas na legs te/ yi dam bde mchog dus 'khor kyai rdor gsang 'dus/ rta mgrin tshe dpag med 'jam dbyangs spyan ras gzigs phyag rdor sogs mdor na yi dam zhi chags khro bo byang sems gang mos de dang 'dra ba mdun du bsgom/ dad pa dang bcas sems gtad/ sku che chung la rtsal sbyang*/ bying rgod dang bstun pa'i bsam lugs sogs byas na'ang legs shing*/ gzhan rang yi dam lhag pa'i lhar bsgoms nas sems ma bcos par bzhag na'ang legs pas de lta bu'i gnad shes dgos/ de lta bur goms na bskyed rim rtsal thon pa dang*/ sems mi yengs pa'i thabs gnyis ka yin pas shin tu zab/ yi dam gyi lha dang por skad cig krong bskyed dang*/ sku bsdu ba'i tshe me long la has btab pa ltar hril bsdu byas nas dge ba byang chub tu bsngo dgos pa yin/

de ltar na bskyed rdzogs gnyis ka'ang tshang ba'o// gnyis pa gsung yig 'bru la rten bca' ba ni/ lar dang po lus gnad dang*/ bla ma la gsol ba 'debs pa rnams gong dang 'dra/ de nas sems 'jog dmigs pa'i rten ni/ sngon du sku bsgoms pa de'i tshab tu zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dkar po sran ma tsam zhig gi steng du hūm̐ yig phra mo spus bris pa lta bu 'ja' tshon sna lnga 'khor ba zhig bsam ste/ hūm̐ yig de ga la sems ma yengs par gtad/ rnam rtog byung na dran pas bzung ste ma yengs par bya/ yengs na'ang slar 'dun pa bsgrims te dmigs pa bsgom/ de ltar rgyun ring bar bya/ rgyun ring dmigs pa bying na 'phro bcad de/ slar sgom pa de bzhin byed/ bying rgod sel thabs ni/ bying zhing rmugs na zla ba'i dkyil 'khor 'od zer 'bar ba dang*/ de'i steng du hūm̐ yig kyang dkar la 'tsher ba zhig tu bsam nas de la sems gtad/ rgod na hūm̐ yig mthing ga nag cing rngam pa gcig tu bsams nas der sems gtad pas sel/ gzhan nyon mongs che na dmar po bsgom zhing rgyun du kha dog lnga ldan bsgom/ de ltar bsgom pa'i yon tan ni/ rgyud las/ sangs rgyas sku yi ngo bo nyid// yi ge oṃ gyis lus sgrib sbyong*// sangs rgyas gsung gi ngo bo nyid// yi ge āḥyis ngag sgrib sbyong*// sangs rgyas thugs kyi ngo bo nyid// yi ge hūm̐ gis yid sgrib sbyong*// zhes sogs mang du gsungs so// der goms nas ni gcig tu ma nges par/ yi ge oṃ dang āḥhrīḥyig tsheg drag dang bcas pa dang*/ dhīḥyig la sogs pa yi dam gang mos kyi sa bon bskyed pa dang*/ sa bon de'ang yi dam lha'i sku gsung thugs kyi ngo bor bsam pa'i dad pa dang bcas lta ba de bzhin sa bon sngags phreng 'khor ba sogs dmigs pas chog /gzhan yang bdag nyid lhar bsgom ste/ de'i thugs kar sa bon bskyed pa'i mthar sngags phreng yang dmigs nas sems gtad na bskyed rdzogs nyams len shin tu legs pa'o// gsum pa thugs thig le la rten bca' ba ni/

sngar bzhin lus gnad dang mos gus gsol 'debs sngon du btang nas/ de'ang snga sor sku gzugs dang yig 'bru'i tshab tu thig le bris pa lta bu ma yin pa 'od zer gyi rang bzhin sran ma tsam phyi gsal nang gsal de ltar bsgom ste/ der sems gtad pa sogs sngon bzhin bya ba'o/ yang der sems brtan pa dang*/ de bas che ba bya'i sgo nga tsam/ de bas che ba sogs bsgom pa dang*/ yang sran ma las chung ba/ tsa na ka'i 'bras bu chung shos tsam yungs kar tsam la sems 'dzin pa sogs che chung ma nges pa la bslab/ bying zhing rmugs na thig le'i 'od zer gyis rang nyid kyi lus kyi phyi nang thams cad gsal bar bsam/ rgod na thig le nag po 'od 'phro ba la sems gtad pas sel ba yin/ 'di ltar bsgoms pa'i thig le ni dmigs bcas kyi thig le yin/ gzhan ti la ka zhes pa'i sgra don gyi thig le dngos bcas dang*/ de min kun rdzob dang*/ don dam dang chos sku'i thig le zer ba sogs rnam grangs shin tu mang ste/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro las/ snying gi dbus su thig le gnas// thig le'i gzugs su mi shigs pa// ye shes 'od kyi rnam 'khrigs ldan// des na rdo rje rnal 'byor bsgom// rdo rje bdag med ma 'khor lo// bskul ba'i cho ga bsgom par bya// mkha' 'gro ma yi sna rtser ni// yungs kar rnam par gnas par bsgom// 'gro ba ma lus yungs kar du'o// de lta bur ni sgom gyur na// rang byin brlabs pa rab tu 'grub// ces dang*/ rgyal po in+d+ra bo dhis/ 'khor 'das ma lus thams cad kun// thig le gang bu gcig byas nas// stong gsum ma lus khyab pa dang*// yungs 'bru tsam la bsdu bar bya// de dag phra rags gang yin dbus// rdo rje gsum gyi dkyil 'khor dang*// rdo rje'i zhing khams rab 'byams ni// spro dang bsdu ba'i bdag nyid las// rdo rje lta bu'i ting 'dzin dang*// rdzu 'phrul gar gyi dbang phyug thob// ces gsungs pa ltar ro// gzhan yang thugs phyag mtshan la brten pa ni/

mdun gnya' shing gang tsam gyi thad du zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ 'khor lo ser po/ rdo rje sngon po/ rin po che cha brgyad pa/ pad+ma dmar po/ sna tshogs rdo rje/ ral gri sogs 'ja' 'od kyi rang bzhin che chung tshon gang ba'am/ gzhan che chung ci rigs pa bsgoms te der sems 'dzin pa'am/ de bzhin yi dam gang rung gi phyag mtshan bsgoms te 'jog pa sogs byas na'ang legs par 'dug go /'di ltar dag pa de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gsung thugs la rten bca' ba 'di sems dmigs pa'i rten tsam du ma zad phan yon shin tu che ba so so'i skabs tha dad du bshad pa de ltar yin zhing*/ mdor bsdu na dang po rgyal ba'i sku gsung thugs kyi ngo bo mdun du dmigs pas lus ngag yid gsum tha mal las ldog nas/ dad pa brtan par bya phyir dang sgrib sbyong yon tan spel ba yin/ de nas yi dam lha mdun bskyed dang bdag bskyed sa bon phyag mtshan bsgom pa ni/ bskyed rim rtsal 'byongs pa'i ched dang*/ don du lus ngag yid gsum tha mal gyi zhen pa sbyangs nas lha'i sku gsung thugs su sad pa'i phyir te/ mdor na gsang sngags kyi don rang yin pas/ de ltar yin lugs phan yon go bar byas nas nyams su len dgos/ lar 'di ltar rten can ma dag pa bzhag nas bsgoms pas sems rang bzhin rnal du 'bebs par gsungs te/ gsang ba sgron me'i rgyud las/ dmigs pa dag la brten nas su// mi dmigs pa ni rab tu skye// mi dmigs pa la goms byas pas// dmigs med ngo bo nyid du 'grub// ces gsungs pa sogs lung shin du mang ba'o// gnyis pa rlung can la dang po spyir bshad pa dang*/ gnyis pa bsgom don dngos bshad pa gnyis so// dang po spyir bshad pa ni/ de'ang rlung la brten nas sems gnas sgrub tshul mdo rgyud gnyis ka nas gsungs shing*/ mdo phyogs kyi sgom rim rnams su rnam rtog shas che bas rlung bsgom par gsungs pa'i sgom tshul la/

mdzod kyi rang 'grel du/ bgrang dang rjes 'gro 'jog pa dang*// rtogs pa dang ni bsgyur ba dang*// yang dag rnam pa drug tu 'dod// ces bshad pa las/ dang po bgrang ba ni/ dbugs 'byung rngub nye ba nas chu srang dang chu tshod bar grangs ma 'chol bar bgrang ba la dmigs nas sems 'dzin pa'o// gnyis pa rjes 'gro ni/ de'i 'og tu rlung 'di lus thams cad du 'jug gam 'ga' zhig tu 'jug ces lus thams cad kyi mthar thug par rjes su 'gro ba dang ldog pa la dmigs pa'o// gsum pa 'jog pa ni/ thams cad la khyab par rnam par mi rtog pa la sems 'jog pa'o// bzhi pa rtogs pa ni/ rlung gi ngo bo mi dmigs par rtogs pa'o// lnga pa bsgyur ba ni/ rlung la dmigs pa'i blo de nyid zhi gnas kyi dmigs pa gzhan du bsgyur ba'o// drug pa yang dag ni/ gzung 'dzin gyi rtog pa yongs su dag pas rtog med du bsgom pa'o// sngags phyogs nas ni rlung gi sgom tshul rnams grangs shin tu mang bar gsungs shing*/ spyir sgrub brgyud kyi man ngag rnams su rlung sbyor bsam gyis mi khyab pa yod mod/ bye brag phyag chen 'dir yang*/ kha dog la bslab pa/ dbyibs la bslab pa/ grangs la bslab pa/ 'gro 'ong la bslab pa/ yi ger bslab pa/ dgag pa'i sbyor bar bslab pa/ bum pa can la bslab pa dang bdun tsam yod kyang mang gis dogs pas mi spro'o// gnyis pa bsgom don bshad pa la'ang*/ bgrang ba la bslab pa/ 'gro 'ong la bslab pa/ 'bru gsum rdo rje'i bzlas par bslab pa/ bum pa can la bslab pa dang bzhi las/ dang po bgrang ba la bslab pa ni/ sa'i snying po 'khor lo bcu pa'i mdo las/ ji ltar na dran pa'i dbang gis yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin du dbugs phyi nang du rgyu ba la rtogs pa skye na/ yang dag par ji lta ba bzhin du bgrang ba dang*/ zhes dang*/ de bzhin du 'gro ba dang 'ong ba rjes su dran pas bzung bas bsam gtan dag la zhugs pa ni/

yang dag pa'i chos don dam pa la gnas pa'i sems zhes bya'o// bsam gtan yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin du sgom pa zhes bya'o// zhes bsngags pa dang bcas te gsungs la/ sdom 'byung las kyang*/ rnal 'byor pas ni mnyam bzhag pas// 'jug pa'i rlung ni bgrang bar bya// ji srid 'bum la sogs pa'i grangs// sgra dang bral bar rtag tu bzla// sgrub po'i sgra dang bral bar ni// 'bum bzlas yongs su rdzogs pa na// tshe nyams pa yang lo lnga ru// 'tsho ba 'di la the tshom med// ces sogs gsungs pa'o// de ltar na lus gnad chos bdun legs par bca'/ bla ma la gsol ba rtse gcig gdab/ lus ngag yid gsum 'di byed kyi las la mi bkol bar rang babs su bzhag /gzhan sngon bzhin dmigs rten dngos su 'jog pa dang*/ yid kyis bsgom par mi bya bar/ de'i tshab tu rang gi sna bug gi rlung rngam pa dang sgra can dang*/ rgod bag med par dbugs tshur dal bus rngub pa dang*/ phar dal bus dbyung ba de bgrang ba lta bur byas nas rlung la shes pa ma yengs par gtad/ phyir 'gro ba'i tshe'ang dran bzhin pa/ nang du 'ong ba'i tshe'ang dran bzhin par sems bzung*/ sems mi gnas 'phro na'ang 'dun pas 'dzin/ rlung gi 'byung rngub sogs dang sems kyang dran pa'i rgyun thag chad nas yengs skabs de ngos zin par byas nas slar 'dun pa bsgrims nas/ rlung 'byung rngub la shes pa skad cig kyang mi yengs par gtad de bzhag /de'ang dang por khug pa gsum tsam dang*/ de nas lnga tsam dang*/ de nas bdun tsam ci rigs la sems bzung zhing bar bar du cung zad ngal gso ba dang bcas sbyang bar bya la/ mthar khug pa brgya tsam re bar ma chad par dran pas rgyun 'tsho nas skyong*/ yun ring drags brjed nges shin tu che na slar ngal gso nas/ yang sngon bzhin rlung sems skyong bar byed dgos pa'o// de bzhin khrid yig nas mang yang gsal ba 'di ltar gsungs te rlung dang bcas te sems bzung ba ni srog rtsol gyi sgo la mngon par rgyu ba'i rlung nang du 'jug pa dang*/

nang du cung zad gnas pa dang*/ phyi rol du 'byung ba ste/ de lta bu re re bzhin grangs bzung nas dbugs dgu brgya phrag gcig tsam gyi bar sna bug gi sgo kho na las sems gzhan du ma yengs par rtse gcig tu gzhag par bya'o// zhes gsungs pa ltar yin/ 'di ni grangs las rdo rje'i bzlas pa zhes zer ba'o// gnyis pa 'gro 'ong la bslab pa ni/ sngon bzhin lus gnad sogs byas nas/ rlung grangs dang 'byung 'jug mi blta bar/ de tshab tu dbugs dang shes pa bsres nas/ de nas dbugs lte ba nas sna rtse bar 'gro ba dang*/ sna rtse nas lte ba'i bar 'ong ba de gnyis kyi ngo bo la bltas nas der ma yengs pa rtse gcig tu bya/ yengs nas ngos ma zin na slar bsgrims te 'jog pa sogs bya ba yin/ de ltar gyi phan yon ni/ dang po bgrang bas grangs shes pa yin par 'dug /grangs ni dus 'khor sogs nas/ skyes bu nad med dar la babs pas nyin zhag gcig la rlung nyi khri chig stong drug brgya rgyu ba yin par gsungs 'dug /spyir rlung 'dir las dang ye shes sogs dbye ba mang zhing bsre 'pho snyan rgyud bsnyen sgrub sogs mang po nas rlung dngos po'i gnas lugs zhes shin tu mang bar gsungs kyang 'dir nyer mkho med pa'o// gsum pa 'bru gsum rdo rje'i bzlas par bslab pa ni/ sngon gyi grangs dang 'byung 'jug ngo bor blta ba de la goms pa de nas/ 'di nyid kyi lag len ni/ dang po lus gnad legs par bca'/ bla ma la gsol ba gdab/ de nas shes pa rlung sems rang ngo la gtad de/ rlung phyir 'gro ba'i dus rlung de oṃ yig dkar po zhig tu bsams nas thon par dmigs pa dang*/ nang du 'ong ba'i dus hūm̐ yig sngon po zhig tu lam gyis gyur nas nang du byung bar bsam/ gnas pa'i tshe āḥyig dmar po zhig tu gyur nas nang du ltem gyis gnas par bsam/ de ltar 'byung 'jug gnas gsum de yi ge gsum du bsgyur nas/

'phro 'du gnas gsum byas par dmigs par bya'o// der shes pa gtad thams cad rang ngo shes par bya/ rang ngo ma shes nas bsgyur bsgom brjed pa byung na slar 'dun pas bzung ste yang dmigs pa byed de de bzhin la 'bad dgos pa'o// bzhi pa bum pa can la rten bca' ba la bslab pa ni/ sdom 'byung las/ steng dang 'og tu 'gro ba'i rlung*// yid kyis kha sbyor du byed de// de yis rnal 'byor goms pa yis// des ni brtan pa'i go 'phang thob// ces dang*/ dus 'khor las/ kha yang btsum ste sna yi bu ga gnyis ka dag nas phyi rol dag gi rlung ni ma lus pa// srog gi shugs kyis bkug ste dri ma med pa'i glog dang mtshungs pa'i thur sel rlung dang sbyar byas pas// dus kyis goms pa'i sbyor ba dag las zla ba nyi ma me yi dbus su ro mnyam 'gyur// lus la zas la sogs pa bkres pa dang ni skom pa 'phrog ste 'chi ba med pa nyid kyang ster// zhes gsungs pas/ rlung bum pa can la/ sngon du lus gnad chos bdun legs par bca'/ legs par ma bcas na skyon yong bas/ g.yas g.yon du ma yo ba dang rgur ba dgye ba lus gnad ma tshang ba sogs skyon gcig kyang med par byas/ bla ma la gsol ba gdab rang la bstim/ de nas rlung ro sngon 'gro 'bud pa dgu phrugs byed pa'am/ yang na rlung ro che 'bring chung ngu 'bud/ steng rlung sna nas dal bus rngub/ 'og rlung yid tsam yar 'then/ steng 'og rlung gnyis lte 'og tu bsre bar byas nas yun ji tsam thub pa de ltar bzung*/ mi thub la khad pa dang bzung ba de nem gyis mnan la slar rngub chung gcig byas/ g.yas gzhil g.yon gzhil/ de nas dang po shed chung ba/ bar du shed che ba/ tha ma nar bar byas te rlung gtong bar bya zhing*/ de ltar phyi nas rngub pa dang nang du sdom pa dang phyir btang ba'i bar thams cad du sngar bzhin yid ma yengs par dran bzhin pa'i ngang nas bya ba dang*/ khyad par nang du ji srid bsdams pa'i bar du rlung sems gcig tu bsres nas ma yengs pa'i rgyun bsrings pa yin no// de lta bu'i rlung khug ji tsam mos pa byed/

'di dang po nas rgyun ring na mi dga' ste gsus pa na ba sogs yong bas/ rgyun mi ring tsam bzung nas ngal gso/ slar bzung ba sogs thabs mkhas byed dgos/ rjes nas goms bzhin rgyun je ring la btang*/ 'dir gnad bzhi ste/ jo bo nā ro pas/ lcags kyu lta bur dgug par bya// bum pa bzhin du dgang bar bya// rgya mtsho bzhin du gzhil bar bya// mda' ltar gyen du 'phang bar bya// zhes gsungs pa yin no// khyad par rlung rang gar bag med bzung sems 'khrul bcug na/ der ni don gang yang med pas/ sems ma yengs tsam rang bzhin shes pa'i ngang nas rlung rngub pa bzung ba gzhil ba btang ba sogs byed dgos/ don rlung dang sems gnyis ka ji ltar gyi ngo bo shes bzhin dgos pa yin/ rlung sems yengs skabs byung na dran pas bzung nas yang rang ngo'i steng du 'jog /de ltar rgyun 'tsho nas bzung ba 'di thun ring po ma yin pa'i thun thung la grangs mang ba dgos/ sems mi gsal bying shas che na sa mtho sa dang snang yas che sar bsgom/ zas bcud chung bar bya cher mi za/ gdong la chu btab pa sogs bya/ rgod na snang yas chung sar bsgom/ zas bcud che ba za/ rlung drag po bzung ba rnams bya/ rmugs 'thom che drags pas sel dka' na lta stangs dpang bstod la hur 'don sogs bya'o// mi gnas rtog pa ban bun langs shes pa 'tshubs na khams kyi nus pa zad rlung langs pa yin pas/ der rlung mi bzung bar zhag re gnyis ngal gso// lus bkru byug pa bya/ dal bar bsdad nas slar bsgoms pas sel ba yin no// lar bum can 'di khe nyen che/ lus rgas shing 'khogs pa/ nad kyis mnar ba dang*/ gzhan yang lus la skyon cher yod pa rnams kyis ni yun du 'bad par mi btub cing*/ lus la skyon med bum can bzung mkhan rnams kyang lus gnad 'chug na sngar bshad ltar skyon yong zhing steng rlung sum gnyis ma non yar 'khyil na rlung sha pags su shor bas chu ser gyi nad skrangs pa sogs 'byung*/

'og rlung sum cha gcig yar 'then nas bsgom ma shes na rlung 'og tu 'chug pas rmu chu dang 'or dang skya rbab dang gzhang 'brum 'og sgo lugs pa sogs 'ong ba yin/ de'i phyir lus dang rlung gi gnad rnams tshod yod mi byed par legs par khrid nas/ le lo gnad chung mi byed par legs par gzab par gal che/ skyon med kyi rlung bsgom zhing zin na yon tan ni/ 'phral du lus yang ba bde ba sogs 'byung zhing*/ phug rnam smin gyi lus kyi rtsa'ang dag par byed/ 'du ba'i nad mi 'byung*/ lus las su rung bas lus gnad yun ring por bsdad kyang na tsha sogs mi yong*/ smra lce bde zhing phugs ngag yongs su dag par byed/ yid 'phral du bde gsal mi rtog pa sogs kyi nyams skye zhing*/ phugs yid thig le'i zag pa dag pas chos sku bde chen mngon du 'gyur bar byed pa sogs yon tan shin tu mang ngo*// 'di ltar rlung gi sbyor ba 'di dag la brten nas sems kyi gnas pa 'tshol thabs te/ de'ang rlung sems 'jug pa gcig pa'i gnad kyis rlung brtan na sems brtan pas/ rlung la bslabs te sems brtan par byed pa yin te/ rje btsun til+li pas/ blo dman skye bo don la mi gnas na// rlung gi gnad bzung rig pa gcun la bor// zhes dang*/ man ngag thams cad nas/ rlung rta sems la sems rta rlung*// zhes gsungs shing*/ dper na rkya mi la don yod na rta kha nas bzung ste sdod pa bzhin du rlung 'ching na sems 'ching ba chos nyid yin par 'dug de yang dang po nas sems la lta rtog ma byas na mi phan pas/ sems yengs na rlung gi dgos nus med de sbud pa dang 'dra bar gsungs pas na/ sems ma yengs par byed dgos/ de yod na rlung gis kyang lhag par gsal zhing nyams rtogs yod na de'i bogs 'don cher yong ba dang*/ rlung gi yon tan thob pa sogs dgos gnad phan yon mang du yod/ lar/ rje dwags po yan chad du gtum mo rlung khrid gtso bor mdzad nas/

slar don gyi ye shes rtogs par mdzad pa dang*/ rje dwags pos ni/ rgyal bas lung bstan pa ltar nges don phyag rgya chen po 'di nyid rtsal du 'don par mdzad/ de phyin chod bka' brgyud pa rnams kyis gtso bor sems khrid nas/ rjes su gtum mo rlung gi yon tan gyis bogs 'don par mdzad pa yin te/ rje sgom tshul gyis/ rlung sems dbyer med nyams len de// sgom chen rab kyi nyams len yin// zhes sems kyi rtsal 'don mchog tu gsungs shing de ltar grub pa'ang yin/ des na rang res rtsa ba sems kyi nyams len gnad kyis ma zin pa'i byed rgyu mang pos dgos don cher mi 'byung ba 'dra/ rlung sems dbyer med mi skyong ba'i// rlung rkyang 'bud pa skyi ser te// lus kyi 'khrul 'khor gar mkhan 'dra// zhes rje sangs rgyas rdo rjes gsungs 'dug pa de 'drar ma song bar nged rang dang por sems kyi ngo bo brtan pa zhig byas/ de'i rtsal sbyong ba'i ched du rlung gi nyams len byas na legs pa yin/ mthar rlung sems dbyer med du rtogs dgos/ mdangs g.yo byed rlung khams rtsa bral du rtogs// gshis rig pa'i steng du zung du chub// rlung sems dbyer med kyi nyams len la// gzhan mgar sbud kyi brtul zhugs brjed de thal// zhes gsungs so// rtsa thig rlung gsum thams cad kyang*/ sems nyid 'di khar 'bab ste/ ye shes bde chen chos skur rtogs dgos/ gtum mo'i nang nas kyang mthar thug mchog gi gtum mo yin pas de bzhin go dgos pa'o// gnyis pa sems rten med du 'jog pa'i tshul bshad pa ni/ de'ang gong gi sems 'dzin gyi yan lag de dag gis sems kyi gnas cha'am don ji ltar rnyed tshe slar mtshan med mchog gi zhi gnas sems kho rang ma yengs pa rgyun 'tsho la bslab dgos te/ de'ang lus gnad sngar bzhin las/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor bsgoms nas gsol 'debs dang*/ dbang bzhi blangs nas rang la bstim/

de nas phyi'i dmigs rten rlung sogs la sems gtad de 'dzin pa'i sbyor ba mi bya bar sems gang la'ang brten sa med cing yid byed kyi rtog pas kyang ma dkrugs par sems rang lugs kyi ngang nyid la 'jog ste/ de'ang rang rig 'di ma gtogs phyag rgya chen po bya ba'i bzang bzang zhig logs nas bsgrub rgyu med/ gal te don ma go bar yod pa'i sgo bor nas/ med pa'i srang mdor 'khyams zer ltar/ rang sems 'di min pa'i gzhan nas shar rgyu dang mthong rgyu e yod kyi kha phyir bltas kyis bsgrubs na/ don dag 'gro sa shar du bzhag nas kha nub tu gtad nas 'gro ba dang 'dra ste/ bskal par 'bad kyang don med las mi yong bas/ de ltar mi bsam pa'i rang re'i sems rnam rtog sna tshogs 'phro ba 'di ka sgom gyi dngos gzhi nyams len gyi ngo thi yin par shes dgos/ don du sems 'di ma bcos ma yengs par 'jog par phyag rgya chen po sgom bya ba yin/ de las gzhan bsgom rgyu med/ de ltar shes par byas nas/ rang sems ma yengs tsam gyi ngang du lhod kyis glod la bzhag /rang gis rang ma bcings par khres te bor la bzhag /bsgom 'dod dang bsgom min sogs kyi blo mang po phral la bzhag /sems la rtsol ba'i las mi 'chol bar rang babs ma bcos pa'i gshis thog tu bzhag /gshis dran pa ma yengs tsam ma gtogs gang dang gang la'ang gnyer kha mi byed bzo med 'dzin med kyi ngang du phyal le bzhag yang na gzhag thabs rnam pa gsum ste/ dang po phyi dang nang gi yul rkyen gyi rjes su sems yengs su mi 'jug par yengs med so mar bzhag /sgo gsum ha cang bsgrims pas bcings pa lta bu ma yin par rtsol med rang babs su lhug par bzhag /rnam rtog gi ngo bo dran rig gnyis ya bral tha dad gnyen po brten pa lta bu ma yin par rang rig rang gsal ngang du bzhag /'di gsum ming gi rnam grangs gzhan du ma yengs mi bsgom bzo med kyang bya ba yin/

thun mong gi theg pa rnams nas gsungs pa'i rnam par thar pa'i sgo gsum yang 'dir tshang ste/ sems nyid de ka sngar 'das pa'i bya byed sogs 'di byas 'di byung gi rjes gcod mi bya ba ni/ rnam par thar pa'i sgo mtshan ma med pa'i ting nge 'dzin zhes bya/ da lta'i sems la blos byas kyis bsgyur bkod 'dir snang 'di bya'i dgag sgrub med pa ni/ rnam par thar pa stong pa nyid kyi sgo dang*/ ma 'ongs pa 'di dang 'di bzhin 'byung 'gyur gyi sngon bsu dang sgom yong du re ba dang mi yong gi dogs pa lta bu'i 'dod 'dun med pa ni/ rnam par thar pa smon pa med pa'i sgo zhes bya ba yin la/ de thams cad mdor bsdu na rang sems ma bcos ma yengs par 'du/ der yang sems 'dun rang ngo rang shes med pa'i tha mal lung ma bstan dang*/ rnam rtog kyang ngos 'dzin dran pa med pa'i 'khrul pa lu gu rgyud de 'dra mi yong ba'i rang ngo ma yengs tsam zhig gi dran 'dun yod pa byed cing*/ dran 'dun de'ang dam 'jun drags na dran pa rang gis 'ching nas/ sman dug tu song ba'i dpe 'dra yod pas de tsam yang min pa'i rang babs lhug par rang ngo ma yengs tsam ste/ dran 'dun ha cang bsgrims pa dang ha cang lhod pa'i skyon med pa'i ma bsdams ngos nas ma yengs tsam gyis grims lhod snyoms par byed dgos te/ bram ze chen pos/ sems grims lhod snyoms pa'i rnal 'byor bde// zhes dang*/ jo bo rjes/ sems nyid spros dang bral ba la/ ma bsgrims ma lhod rang sar zhog /ces gsungs so// tshul de la dran mkhas bsdam med yengs med du 'tsho ba zer/ dran pa ma yengs pa de las gzhan sgom 'dod gsal 'dod gnas 'dod sogs 'dzin pa blos sgom skad cig kyang mi byed/ rang sems gshis kyi ngo bo gsal ba'am mi gsal ba bde rtsub ji ltar 'dug pa de ka rang babs su glod/ de las gzhan du mi 'phro bar gnas na/ gnas yun ring po yong du re ba dang*/

gnas yun thung bar 'byung gi dogs pa mi byed/ yud tsam mi gnas kyang de'i ngo bo gshis rang babs de la ched du mi sgom pa'i ngang nas gnas pa de ka'i ngo bo'i thog tu glod la yengs med du rang gshis skyong*/ de la mi gnas pa'i 'gyu ba sngar de byas ma 'ongs par de byed da ltar mig gis gzugs mthong rna bas sgra thos thog tu 'gro ba'i bzang ngan 'bring gsum gyi rtog pa ci 'dra zhig shar rung*/ de nyid ma yengs pa'i dran 'dun des bsam pa'am 'gyu ba de'i ngo bo ngo shes thog de la ched du bzo bcos mi byed pa de ka rang gi thog tu 'dzin pa ma zhugs tsam du lhod kyis glod la ma brjed par skyong ste/ de ltar yang rje gong ma rnams kyis/ bsgom med yengs med du skyong ba/ zhes dang*/ ma yengs mi sgom/ zhes dang*/ bsgom rgyu rdul tsam med pa la// yengs su skad cig med par skyong*// zhes gsungs/ 'dir lam rang byung snying po rang 'gros su skyong ba zer/ khyad par rnam rtog mang nyung ci byung yang mang bar skyon/ nyung bar yon tan du mi lta ste/ don dam par sems kyi gshis dang gnyis med gzhi gcig las nam yang mi 'da'/ dper na nyi ma dang nyi ma'i 'od zer lta bu chu dang chu'i rlabs lta bu bzang ngan du grub pa gcig kyang med do// sems bde gsal du gnas pa'am/ rnam rtog sna tshogs ci 'dra 'gyus kyang don du khyad par rdul tsam yang med par thag bcad nas/ rnam rtog gang shar thams cad dran bzhin shes bzhin gyi nges shes dang bcas thams cad ngos zin dgos/ ngos ma zin na 'khrul pa rang ga mar 'char/ ngos zin pa'i rang ngo so ma de ma brjed tsam las gnyis 'dzin gyi dgag sgrub skad cig kyang mi byed par rang bzhin ji ltar yod pa de ka ltar 'jog pa ste/ bram ze chen pos/ rang bzhin bzhag pa ji lta bu nyid de lta nyid// 'bras bu thob pa med pa gdod nas rang la gnas/ zhes dang*/ rang bzhin dag pa'i sems la bsam gtan dag gis mi bslad de// bdag nyid bde la gnas shing gdung bar ma byed cig

/ces dang*/ sha wa ris/ rang bzhin dag pa'i sems la bcos mi dgos// ma bzung ma btang rang ga nyid du zhog /ces dang*/ bir wa pas/ don dam rnal ma chags med don la sbyang bya ste// mi spang mi sgrub mi zhen mi spyod mi 'gog par// rang lugs ci bder spyod pa rab mchog dam pa ste// zhes dang*/ mai tri pas/ rang bzhin ma bcos rnal mar bzhag /ces gsungs/ de la/ rang bzhin yongs shes gu yangs su skyong ba zer/ mdor dril na/ sgom zhes gzhan nas mi 'tshol rang gi sems la lta/ sems ma 'khrul tsam gyis chog pa las bzo bcos bsgyur bsgom mang po'i lhan pa mi 'debs/ sems ma 'khrul tsam thal le ba/ gnas na'ang rang ngo ma brjed tsam thang nge ba/ rnam rtog sna tshogs 'char dus kyang der dran pa'i so ma shor tu re ba'i ngos nas gang shar thams cad ngos bzung nas de thog glod nas shigs se bzhag /yang dran 'dun brjed pa yengs pa byung na slar dran pas ngos zin par byas nas ma yengs pa'i dran pa lhang nge ba brten/ rgyun du dran pa'i so ma shor bar bya/ brjed skabs mang zhing yengs 'khrul che na dran pa la rtsol ba zhan rtags yin pas/ dus kun brjed dogs bag yod dran shes brjed na brjed 'byams su mi 'gro ba'i dran pa yang yang du skyong*/ lar ma bcos par 'jog /ma yengs par skyong zer ba 'di gnad 'gags don gyi snying po yin/ de'ang sems bcos pa gang yin na/ nged rang gis de sngon 'di byas/ da 'di byed/ da lta 'di 'dra bsam pa'i dus gsum gyi bsam pa mang po gtong zhing*/ bsgom don lta bur yang*/ sems bsgrims dgos lhod dgos snyam pa'i bsam pa mang po dang*/ gnas pa zhig e yong*/ 'gyu ba rnam rtog ma byung na bsam pa'i dgag sgrub kyi bsam blo sgom 'ong la re/ mi 'ong dogs pa sogs re dogs kyi bsam pa sogs byas na de sems bcos bzos pa yin/ ma bcos pa ni/ de rnams gang dang gang gi bsam blo mi gtong bar rang sems rang gshis bde dal du gnas pa de ka la bsam blo rtsab rtsub mang po med pa'i rang babs ma bcos pa de ka'i ngang du sdod pa la zer ba yin/

yengs pa gang yin na/ de ltar sems ma bcos pa rang babs kyi gshis su bzhag kyang*/ de nas de'i rang ngo ma yengs par mi skyong ba'i sems gnas pa'ang gnas tshul 'di dang de med/ mi gnas 'phro zhing 'gyu ba'i ngo bo'ang 'di dang 'di snyam pa'i ngos 'dzin med par thams cad ci yin 'di cha dang*/ ci ltar gnas gang ltar 'gyus ma rig pa'i 'khrul pa rgya 'byams na/ de yengs pa yin/ ma yengs pa ni/ sngon sems ma bcos pa rang babs gshis thog tu bzhag pa/ de nas sems rang gis rang ma brjed tsam du ma yengs pa tsam gyi dran pa brten la/ de nas skyong zhes sems gnas sam 'gyu ba ji ltar byung na de thams cad kyi rang ngo dran 'dun gyis ngo shes kyi ngang nas skyong ba yin/ yengs brjed 'khrul na dran pa yang yang brten pa de ltar shes dgos/ yang gnas 'gyu rig gsum zer ba'i don ni/ rang sems 'gro sdod ngo shes pa dgos/ 'gro sdod de gnyis la gnas 'gyu zhes bya ste/ rang sems mi 'gro bar sdod pa gnas pa/ mi sdod par 'gro ba 'gyu ba/ de ltar gnas pa dang 'gyu ba de gnyis ngo shes su skyong ba rig pa ste/ gnas 'gyu rig gsum zer ba'i ming gi 'dogs lugs dang thag bcad lugs de ltar go dgos/ mig rdel sogs rten can gyi rim pa de dag gang zag tha mal pa rim gyis khrid pa'i thabs mkhas pa yin/ dngos gzhi'i nyams len du rang sems rten med nas rang ngo rjen par skyong ba 'di nyid yin zhing shin tu legs pas snyoms las le lor ma shor ba'i brtson 'grus drag po bskyed dgos pa'o// gnyis pa de'i skyon spang ba dang*/ zhi gnas sgrub pa sogs las/ dang po mnyam bzhag gi skyon bying rgod kyi rgyu bshad pa/ gnyis pa rkyen ngos bzung ba/ gsum pa de spong tshul bshad pa gsum mo// dang po bying rgod kyi rgyu bshad pa ni/ ting 'dzin gyi sgrib pa phal cher bying rgod gnyis kyi phyogs su 'dug la/

bying rgod 'byung ba'i rgyu ni/ sgo gsum gyi spyod lam ma dag pa ci rigs las 'byung bar bshad de/ sa'i dngos gzhi las// bying ba'i mtshan ma gang zhe na/ dbang po'i sgo ma bsrungs pa dang*/ zas kyi tshod ma zin pa dang*/ nam gyi cha stod dang nam gyi cha smad la mi nyal ba'i sbyor ba la mi brtson pa dang*/ shes bzhin ma yin par gnas pa dang*/ gti mug spyod pa dang*/ gnyid che ba dang*/ thabs mi shes pa dang*/ le lo dang ldan pa'i 'dun pa dang*/ brtson 'grus dang sems dang*/ dpyod pa dang*/ zhi gnas la mgoms pa dang*/ zhi gnas yongs su byang bar ma byas pas zhi gnas phyogs gcig yid la byed pa dang*/ sems mun pa lta bur 'dug pa dang*/ dmigs pa la gtod par mi dga' ba'o// zhes so// rgod pa'i mtshan ma gang zhe na/ snga ma bzhin du dbang po'i sgo ma bsrungs pa la sogs pa bzhi dang*/ 'dod chags la spyod pa dang*/ nye bar ma zhi ba'i tshul can dang*/ sems skyo ba med pa dang*/ thabs mi shes pa dang*/ snga ma bzhin du ha cang rab tu 'dzin pa dang ldan pa'i 'dun pa la sogs pa dang*/ brtson pa la ma goms pa dang*/ rab tu 'dzin pa la byang bar ma byas pas de'i phyogs gcig sgom pa dang*/ nye du la rtog pa la sogs pa rgod pa dang mthun pa'i chos gang yang rung bas sems rnam par g.yeng ba'o// zhes so// de la bying rgod kyi mtshan ma zhes pa ni bying rgod kyi rgyu dang*/ le lo dang ldan pa'i zhes pa brtson 'grus dang sems dang dpyod pa gsum la sbyar ba dang*/ zhi gnas la goms pa zhes pa de'i nyams snang 'ba' zhig la goms pa dang ha cang rab tu 'dzin pa zhes pa dga' ba'i yul la sems ha cang bzung drags pa ste/ de dang ldan pa'i 'dun pa dang brtson 'grus sogs bzhi'o// gzhan yang las dang 'gro 'dug drag po byas pas thang chad pa dang*/ zas la sogs pa mang ba dang*/ nyi ma la sdod ches pa dang*/ me la gdung ches pa dang*/ nyin mo gnyid pa la sogs byas na bying rmugs 'ong bas/

dang po nas de tsho spang dgos/ yang phan tshun skad cha mang po/ gzhan du 'gro ba ltad mo sogs lta ba de 'dra byas na rgod pa yong bas/ dang po nas bying rgod kyi rgyu de rnams spong ba'i tshul la 'bad par bya/ lar nged rang mnyam bzhag dang po sgom pa 'di la spyod lam 'gro 'dug gtam sogs mi mang zhing rgyun du mnyam bzhag rang la brtson par byed dgos pa'o// gnyis pa skyon ngos bzung ba ni/ de'ang bying ba ni/ sgom rim bar pa las/ gang gi tshe rmus long lta bu'am/ mig mun par zhugs pa lta bu'am/ mig btsum pa lta bur sems kyis dmigs pa gsal bar mi mthong ba de'i tshe bying bar 'gyur bar rig par bya'o// zhes gsungs pa ni lus sems nyog nas dmigs pa'i gsal cha lhod par gyur pa zhig go /rmugs pa ni/ mdzod 'grel du/ lus lci ba nyid dang sems lci ba nyid de lus las su mi rung ba nyid dang sems las su mi rung ba nyid gang yin pa'o// zhes gsungs pa rmongs 'thibs nas lus sems gnyis ka lci zhing bkol du mi btub pa'o// rgod pa ni/ kun btus las/ sdug pa'i mtshan mar rjes su 'jug pa'i 'dod chags kyi char gtogs pa'i sems rnam par ma zhi ba ste/ zhi gnas kyi bar du gcod pa'i las can no// zhes gsungs pa ni yul yid du 'ong zhing snying du sdug pa la dmigs nas/ de la sred pa'i rnam pas phyi la 'phro zhing sems gnas pa'i bar du gcod pa'o// gsum pa spong tshul la/ spyir bshad pa dang*/ bye brag gi lag len bsgom don bstan pa'o// dang po spyir bshad pa ni/ de'ang bying ba rags pa skyes na de 'gog pa la/ snang ba'i mtshan ma dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi yon tan yid la byed pa dang*/ so sor rtog pa'i shes rab kyis dpyod pa dang*/ dmigs pa rgya bskyed pa dang*/ dga' ba bsgoms nas sems gzengs bstod pa sogs bya bar bshad de// sgom rim dang po las/ gal te gang gi tshe rmugs pa dang*/ gnyid kyis non te dmigs pa 'dzin pa la mi gsal zhing sems bying bar gyur pa de'i tshe/

snang ba'i 'du shes sgom pa'am/ mchog tu dga' ba'i rgyal po sangs rgyas la sogs pa'i yon tan yid la byed pas bying ba bsal la dmigs pa de nyid dam du bzung ngo*// zhes dang*/ phar phyin bsdus pa las/ lhag mthong brtson pa'i stobs kyi mthus// zhum par gyur na gzengs kyang bstod// ces dang*/ dbu ma snying po las/ zhum pa dmigs pa rgya chen dag /sgom pas yangs pa nyid du bya// zhes so// snang ba'i mtshan ma ni/ nyan sa las/ mar me'i 'od las sam/ me'i phung po'i 'od las sam/ nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor las snang ba'i mtshan ma zungs shig /ces pa ltar de dag gi 'od kyis thams cad snang zhing gsal bar gyur pa de la sems gtad pa'o// 'di'i spyod lam du'ang snang ba'i mtshan ma yid la byed pa dang*/ rjes dran drug sogs yid dad par 'gyur bar dmigs pas gzengs bstod pa dang*/ bying ba skye ba'i rgyu rmugs gnyid kyis nyes dmigs bsams te spang ba dang*/ 'chag pa dang phyogs rnams dang zla skar la blta ba dang gdong chus bkru ba sogs bya bar nyan thos kyi sa las bshad do// rgod pa rags pa skyes na de 'gog pa ni/ mi rtag pa sogs bsgom nas yid dbyung ba dang*/ rnam g.yeng gi nyes dmigs bsams nas spang ba dang*/ zhi gnas la bzhag nas sems rnal du dbab pa sogs bya ste/ sgom rim dang po las/ gang gi tshe sngon dgod pa dang rtses pa la sogs pa dran zhing bar bar du sems rgod par mthong ba de'i tshe/ mi rtag pa la sogs pa yid 'byung bar 'gyur ba'i dngos po yid la byed pas rgod pa zhi bar bya'o// de nas yang dmigs pa de nyid la sems mngon par 'du byed pa med par 'jug pa la 'bad par bya'o// zhes dang*/ dbu ma snying po las/ g.yeng ba g.yengs pa'i mtshan ma las// nyes dmigs blta bas bsdu bar bya// zhes dang*/ phar phyin bsdus par/ rgod par gang tshe gyur pa'i tshe// zhi gnas tshul gyis bzlog par bya// zhes so// 'di'i spyod lam du'ang*/

dbang po'i sgo bsdam pa dang*/ nad pa'i spyod lam ltar drag shul spong ba dang*/ rgod par 'gyur ba'i yul yid la mi byed pa dang*/ phyag mang du 'tshal ba la sogs pa bya'o// bying rgod phra mo tsam la ni/ bying na gzengs bstod pa dang*/ sgrim pa dang*/ rgod na sems 'phang smad pa dang*/ glod pa sogs yongs su grags pa ltar gyis sel bar byed dgos pa'o// gnyis pa bye brag gi lag len bsgom don bshad pa la/ bying rmugs kyi skyon sel bshad pa/ rgod pa'i skyon sel bshad pa gnyis so// dang po bying rmugs kyi skyon sel la/ bying rmugs kyi skyon ngos bzung ba dang*/ de sel thabs bshad pa'o// dang po ni// de'ang nged rang sems ma bcos ma yengs par 'jog pa'i tshe/ dran pa yengs med dang sems gsal ba de nas rnam rtog kyang thams cad ngos zin pa de 'dra mi yong bas bying ba zhes sems mi gsal/ ma yengs pa'i dran pa brten rgyu med par/ bying bying yas yas ci yin med pa de 'dra 'byung*/ rmugs pa zhes pa/ sems mnyam bzhag byed dus sems gsal ba dang dran pa ma yengs pa mi 'ong bar gnyid kyis non pa lta bu thib thib nyob nyob de 'dra 'byung*/ gnyis pa de sel thabs bshad pa la/ spyod lam gyi sgo nas sel ba/ bsgom don gyi sgo nas sel ba/ dmigs pas sel ba gsum las/ dang po ni/ bying rmugs de gnyis kar sgom dus/ mgo g.yab nang sogs su mi bsgom/ ri'i sgang lta bu sa mtho ba snang g.yer che sa rlung 'ong sa de lta bur 'gro nas bsgom zhing*/ der gos la sogs pa'ang srab par gyon nas rang gi lus 'khyag par byed/ mtshan lta bur bsgoms na ni phyi logs su sdod cing zla ba dang skar ma la bltas te sems ma yengs par 'jog /za 'thung yang brgyag pa rang min pa'i nyung nyung ltogs se ba byas na phan zhing gzhan mgo la sogs chus 'khru ba sogs byas kyang phan/ gnyis pa ni/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor sogs bsgoms la bla ma la sems skyon sel ba'i gsol ba 'debs/

rang la bstim/ bla ma rang sems gnyis med ngang du bzhag /de nas sems ngo rang skyong dus ni/ lus gnad kyang legs par bca'/ rlung ro bsal zhes pa ni/ nang gi dbugs sna nas phar lan gsum bsal te/ de nas mig gi lta stangs sa la phab ste mi lta bar bar snang dang nam mkha' la yar blta/ rig pa'ang gu yangs pa dang*/ yar gzengs bstod hur phyung nas/ de nas ma bcos ma yengs pa de ka'i ngang du 'jog /yang sngon bzhin bying rmugs byung na slar mig gi lta stangs bstod/ rig pa hur phyung la dran pa grims te bsgrims la ma yengs par byed/ de ltar yang yang byas pas skyon de dag sel 'gro/ gsum pa ni/ thig le dkar po 'od kyi rang bzhin can cig rang gi smin mtshams su bsgoms la der sems gtod pa dang*/ yang na mdun gyi nam mkhar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor ram bla ma bzhugs par sems gtad pas sel// gnyis pa rgod pa'i skyon sel la ngos bzung ba dang*/ de sel thabs gnyis so// dang po ni/ sems ma yengs par 'jog pa'i dus/ rgod pa zhes sems gnas cha chung ba tsam gyi mi tshad pa'i ma yengs pa'i dran pa'ang mi 'ong bar bsam blo rnam rtog mang po 'tshab ma 'tshubs su ldangs/ ngos kyang mi zin pa de 'dra 'byung ba'o// gnyis pa de sel thabs bshad pa la spyod lam gyi sgo nas sel ba dang*/ bsgom don gyi sgo nas sel ba dang*/ dmigs pas sel ba dang gsum las/ dang po ni/ sdod sa khang khyim dang g.yeng ba mi la sogs pa med pa'i sa 'gol sar bsdad/ gos kyang dro bar gyon/ rgod pa 'dir za 'thung yang mang ba brgyags pa byas na phan pa yin 'dug /gnyis pa ni/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor bsgom/ sems rgod pa'i skyon sel ba'i gsol ba 'debs/ lus gnad bca' mig gi lta stangs sa la phabs nas sems ma yengs pa'i dran pa de'i ngang du bzhag /de'ang dran pa 'jur po dang rnam rtog ma byung na bsam pa'i bsam blo rtsab rtsub mang po rang mi byed cing*/ dran pa'ang ma yengs tsam du de ka'i ngang du lhod glod nas rnam rtog gang shar ngos zin pa e 'ong lta/

de ma byung nas sngon bzhin rgod pa de ka'i dbang du 'gro na yang dran pa gsal 'debs byed/ de ltar byas pas skyon sel 'gro zhing*/ yang da dung ma sel na sdod gnas sogs sngon dang 'dra ba la/ sems rang ngor 'jog pa'i tshe dang po ma yengs tsam gyi dran pa brten/ de nas rnam rtog rgod po byung na rnam rtog kho rang rgod du bcug /khyod rang gtan du ma sdod par ci nus gang nus su rgyugs shig bsam pa rang gis rang la byas la bzhag /babs kyi dran rdzi tsam ma gtogs gzhan gnyer kha ci'ang mi byed par bzhag pas nam zhig na rnam rtog nyung du 'gro/ gsum pa ni/ rang gi mdun gdan gyi steng du thig le nag po bsgom par sems gtad pa ste/ khrid yig zin bris las/ bying na lta stangs dpang bstod/ sa snang g.yer che sar bsgom/ rmugs pa la gzhan snga ma bzhin dran pas gzhur/ rgod na 'gol sar 'dug /lta stangs smad lhod cha gtso bor bya/ zhes gsungs pa'i don du 'dug la/ las dang po pa rnams sgom la 'jug pa'i tshe sems las su mi rung zhing bar du gcod pa'i rkyen la bying rmugs rgod gsum 'ong zhing de sel thabs gal che bas 'di ltar brtson dgos pa'o/// /gsum pa zhi gnas kyi rgyu mtshan mtshan nyid so sor bshad pa la bdun/ dang po zhi gnas bsgrub dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan bshad pa/ gnyis pa zhi gnas kyi gnas pa rab 'bring tha gsum bshad pa/ gsum pa zhi gnas de'i dbye ba bshad pa/ bzhi pa zhi gnas kyi nyams 'char tshul bshad pa/ lnga pa zhi gnas dang nyams kyi gol sa gcod pa bshad pa/ drug pa zhi gnas dang nyams de'i skyong tshul bshad pa/ bdun pa zhi gnas kyi yon tan dang 'bras bu bshad pa'o// de las dang po zhi gnas bsgrub dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan ni/ spyir 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i lam thams cad kyi rtsa ba zhi gnas nges par bsgrub dgos te/ de'ang 'jig rten pa'i lam la khams gsum las/ 'dod pa'i sas bsdus kyi nyon mongs spong bar byed pa la/

nyon mongs pa mi mthun phyogs kyi gnyen po bskyed pa dang*/ 'dod pa la rags pa dang*/ gzugs la zhi bar lta ba'i rnam pa can gyi lhag mthong bsgrub dgos pas de'i rten du zhi gnas dgos pa'i phyir dang*/ de bzhin gzugs dang gzugs med kyi sas bsdus pa'i bsam gtan gyi nyer bsdog brgyad dang bsam gtan dngos gzhi brgyad bsgrub pa la'ang*/ sa 'og ma 'og ma la rags pa dang*/ gong ma gong ma la zhi bar blta ba'i rnam pa can gyi lhag mthong bsgrub dgos pas de'i rten du'ang zhi gnas dgos pa'i phyir dang*/ 'das lam la theg pa dman pa bden bzhi la dmigs nas gang zag gi bdag 'gog pa'i lhag mthong bskyed pa'i rten du'ang zhi gnas dgos pa'i phyir dang*/ theg chen pa bdag med gnyis ka'i don la dmigs nas gnyis med ye shes kyi lhag mthong bskyed pa'i rten du'ang zhi gnas dgos pa'i phyir ro// der ma zad rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa bzhi dang bsam gtan dang gzugs med kyi snyoms 'jug dang*/ rnam thar brgyad dang mngon shes dang zad par zil gnon la sogs pa'i yon tan bsgrub pa'i rten du'ang zhi gnas dgos te/ sgom rim dang po las// spong ba'i 'du byed brgyad po de dag dang ldan na ting nge 'dzin shin tu khug pa yin te/ des rdzu 'phrul la sogs pa'i yon tan rnams sgrub par byed do// de lta bas na mdo sde las/ spong ba'i 'du byed brgyad dang ldan na rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa bzhi bsgom mo// zhes bka' stsal to// sems rtse gcig pa de phyi phyir las su rung ba nyid dang ldan zhing*/ dmigs pa la sogs pa yon tan gyi khyad par thob pa bsam gtan dang*/ gzugs med pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dang rnam par thar pa la sogs pa'i ming thob bo// zhes sogs dang*/ gzhan yang nyon mongs pa'i rtog pa mngon gyur pa mgo non pa dang*/ mtshan ma'i 'ching ba las grol bar 'gyur ba sogs kyi zhi gnas kyi dgos pa shin tu mang yang*/

'dir sgrub dgos pa'i gtso bo lhag mthong bsgrub pa'i ched du yin zhing*/ de la'ang srid rtse'i bar du 'gro bar byed pa'i 'jig rten pa'i lhag mthong zhi rags kyi rnam pa can dang*/ srid pa'i sa bon rtsa ba nas spong ba'i bdag med pa'i rnam pa can gyi lhag mthong gnyis yod pa las/ phyi ma bskyed pa'i phyir du bsgrub pa yin la/ de bsgrub pa'i rgyu mtshan ni/ zhi gnas med pa'i lhag mthong ni/ 'bab chu'am rlung nang gi mar me ltar/ shin tu g.yo bas mnyam par bzhag par mi 'gyur la/ mnyam par ma bzhag pas yang dag par ji lta ba bzhin mi shes shing mi gsal ba'i phyir te/ sgom rim dang po las/ sems chu bzhin du g.yo ba'i phyir zhi gnas kyi gzhi med par gnas pa med de/ mnyam par ma bzhag pa'i sems kyis ni yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin du shes par mi nus te/ zhes dang*/ sgom rim bar pa las/ zhi gnas dang bral ba'i lhag mthong 'ba' zhig gis ni rnal 'byor pa'i sems yul la rnam par g.yeng bar 'gyur gyi/ rlung gi nang du 'dug pa'i mar me bzhin du brtan par mi 'gyur ro/ de bas na ye shes kyi snang ba shin tu gsal ba mi 'byung ste/ zhes pa ltar ro// 'o na skabs 'dir zhi gnas ci tsam zhig bsgrub snyam na gong du bshad pa'i bsam gtan dang po'i nyer bsdog kyis bsdus pa'i zhi gnas tsam grub na mchog tu bsngags la/ de ma grub na'ang 'dod sems rtse gcig pa tsam zhig grub kyang rung bar mngon te/ slob dpon dpa' bos/ bsngags 'os bsngags bstod las/ khyod kyi chos la mi phyogs pa'i// skye bo gti mug gis ldongs pa// srid rtse'i bar du song nas kyang*// sdug bsngal yang 'byung srid pa bsgrub// khyod kyi bstan pa'i rjes 'gro ba// bsam gtan dngos gzhi ma thob kyang*// bdud kyi mig ras rtsa bzhin du// srid pa dag ni zlog par bgyid// ces bshad pa'o// gzhan rtsol ba cung zad dang bcas te skyong bde ba tsam yang zhi gnas su bzhed cing lhag mthong la khrid du rung bar yang bzhed pa'o// gnyis pa zhi gnas kyi gnas pa rab 'bring tha gsum bshad pa ni/

dang po nged rang gi lus kyi gnad dang sems kyi gnad rnams ji bzhin du bzhag /bar du brtson 'grus kyis bskyangs nas/ dang po rang dus nas 'ga' rer sems gnas pa che ba 'dra zhig 'ong ste/ de ni gnas pa'i sna e zin tsam zer/ gzhan rtse gcig gi rnal 'byor skye ba'i lam stegs lta bu gnas pa rab 'bring tha gsum 'ong ste/ dang po ni sems dran pa bsgrims te rang ngo bskyangs pas 'ga' re zhig la sems gnas gnas 'dra ba rnam rtog cher mi 'ong ba 'dra zhig 'ong ste da dung ngos ma zin/ rig pa dwangs snyigs ma phyed pa yin/ de nas rig pa dwangs snyigs phyed na rnam rtog sngar bas kyang mang du song ba 'dra bas rnam rtog gcig steng gnyis gsum ste 'phro mi chad pa lta bu 'tshab ma 'tshub tu skye/ rnam rtog mang du song bsam pa 'dra ba yong yang*/ de ni min te sngon nas rnam rtog mang po de ltar yod kyang ngos ma zin/ da lta cung zhig rig pa dwangs pas rnam rtog thams cad rig pa yin pas skyon med/ gnas pa dang po ri gzar gyi 'bab chu 'dra zer ba yin/ rnam rtog de rnams kyi rjes su'ang mi 'brang*/ dgag kyang mi dgag par/ gang shar rang thog tu glod nas dran pa ma yengs tsam gyis rgyang 'tsho byed pas chog /de ltar byas pas nam zhig ltar na/ sngon gyi rnam rtog shin tu mang po de phra nyal gyis song nas/ mi rtog pa rang ngor gnas pa'i rgyun ring du 'gro/ skabs skabs su rnam rtog re re gnyis gnyis skyes kyang ngos zin/ ngos zin bzhin gshis thog tu yal 'gro/ rnam rtog de rnams kyis mi gnod pa dang rnam rtog rnams kyang thams cad ngo shes dang ldan pas bskyang ba de la brang 'phrod pa 'ong*/ de ni gnas pa 'bring po chu klung dal gyis 'bab pa dang 'dra zer ba yin/ de'ang nor sa gnyis su yod de/ nor sa'i skyon ni/ sems yengs shas rmugs shas che bas rnam rtog cher mi 'ong ba 'dra ba de 'dra 'ga' rer yong ste de min/

sems kyi rang ngo dwangs gsal shes bzhin dgos pa yin te/ dpe chu klung dal gyis 'bab pa 'dra ba de'ang thag ring po zhig nas de'i 'babs lugs sogs gsal por mi mthong ba dang 'dra ba'ang yod pas de min pa'i/ chu rlung dal 'babs de rtsa ba nas dal gyis 'babs pa 'dra ba'i gsal cha che na yin/ de ltar gnas pa 'bring la goms pas mthar ni/ phra rags kyi rnam rtog thams cad rgyun chad de mi rtog pa'i ngang du me re gnas/ gsal ba'i ngang du lham mer gnas pa zhig 'ong*/ de ni gnas pa tha ma rgya mtsho mi g.yo ba lta bu zer ba yin/ 'dir yang nor sa yod de/ sems bying rmugs rab tu che bas gnas pa'am/ zhi gnas 'thoms po dang nor sa yod/ 'dir ni gsal la dwangs par rig pa dang bcas pa zhig dgos/ dpe rgya mtsho mi g.yo ba'ang mun nang gi rgya mtsho 'dra ba ni min/ nyin par gsal ba'i rgya mtsho dwangs pa 'dra ba yin/ de ltar gnas pa rab 'bring tha gsum rim pa bzhin du 'char te/ de'ang gnas pa dang po ri gzar gyi 'bab chu 'dra ba'i rnam rtog sna tshogs ldang ba/ gnas pa 'bring po chu klung dal gyis 'bab pa 'dra ba'i rnam rtog phal cher zhi ba'i gnas shas che ba/ gnas pa tha ma rgya mtsho mi g.yo ba lta bu ste/ rnam rtog sna tshogs pas gtan nas mi bskyod pa'i gnas nyams chen po rang gi ngang du gnas pa ste/ de ltar rim pa bzhin du 'char ba'am/ yang na 'ga' rer ma nges par 'char bar bshad la/ de ltar rab 'bring tha gsum rim pas 'byung ba'i tshul ni/ til+li pas/ las ni dang po gcong rong 'bab chu 'dra// bar du chu bo gaṅgā dal zhing g.yo// tha ma chu bran ma bu phrad pa ltar/ zhes gsungs pa dang*/ nyams sgron las/ de yang dang po chu drag bzhin// rnam rtog mang zhing cung zad gnas// de nas dal 'bab chu bo bzhin// res gnas res rtog thun phyed gnas// zhes dang*/ pra khrid las/ mi rtog thig le'i ngang la gnas pa ni// mi bskyod dwangs pa'i rgya mtsho chen po'i ngang*// mi g.yo gsal ba til gyi mar me 'dra// zhes gsungs pa dang*/

khyad par gsal ba/ zhang rin po ches/ gnas pa dang po byung dus su// ri gzar logs la rbab 'dril 'dra// rnam rtog zam mi chad par ldang*// sgom nyams med dam snyam pa 'ong*// rnam rtog byung tshad tshor ba de// shes pa cung zad gnas pa yin// gnas pa med pa'i gong rol du// rnam rtog rang gar shor ba yin// rtag par 'gyus kyang ngo mi shes// de nas dal 'bab chu bo bzhin// shes pa dal zhing rnam rtog nyung*// de nas rgya mtsho'i gting bzhin du// shes pa mi g.yo brtan par gnas// zhes so// gnas pa de dag dngos dang dngos min shan 'byed dgos pa'o// gsum pa zhi gnas de'i dbye ba bshad pa la/ dang po de'i dbye ba spyir bshad pa/ gnyis pa de 'grub tshul bshad pa'o// dang po dbye ba spyir bshad pa ni/ de'ang ngo bo'i sgo nas dbye na/ 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i zhi gnas gnyis dang*/ byed las kyi sgo nas dbye na/ mthong chos la bde bar gnas pa'i zhi gnas sogs gsum yod kyang*/ grags che ba ni/ thabs kyi sgo nas sems rnam pa dgur 'byed de/ mdo sde rgyan las/ dmigs pa la ni sems gtad nas// de rgyun rnam par g.yeng mi bya// zhes sogs kyi 'grel par/ dbyig gnyen gyis tshigs su bcad pa bzhi po 'dis ni/ sems gnas pa rnam pa dgus gnas pa'i thabs bstan te/ rnam pa dgu ni/ sems 'jog par byed/ kun tu 'jog par byed/ nges par 'jog par byed/ nye bar 'jog par byed/ dul bar byed/ zhi bar byed/ nye bar zhi bar byed/ rgyud gcig tu byed/ mnyam par 'jog par byed/ ces bya ba yin no// zhes dang*/ kun btus las/ zhi gnas gang zhe na/ 'di dag ste/ nang nyid la sems 'jog pa dang*/ rgyun du 'jog pa dang*/ blan te 'jog pa dang*/ nye bar 'jog pa dang*/ dul bar byed pa dang*/ zhi bar byed pa dang*/ nye bar zhi bar byed pa dang*/ rtse gcig tu byed pa dang*/ mnyam par 'jog pa'o// zhes sems dgu bshad pa'o// gnyis pa de rnams 'grub tshul la/

dang po sems gnas dgu 'grub tshul bshad pa/ gnyis pa stobs drug 'grub tshul bshad pa/ gsum pa yid byed bzhi 'grub tshul bshad pa/ bzhi pa 'phros don bshad pa'o// dang po sems gnas dgu 'grub tshul bshad pa ni/ de'ang thog mar sems spros pa bsdus nas dmigs pa la gtad pas 'dzeg pa'i sems 'grub la/ de bzhin du sems gzhan du mi g.yeng bar gnas pa de'i rgyun bsrings pas rgyun du 'jog pa dang*/ gzhan du g.yeng na'ang slar de nyid la sbyar bas blan te 'jog pa dang*/ sems yang yang bsdus shing phra bar byas pas nye bar 'jog pa dang*/ ting nge 'dzin gyi yon tan mthong nas de la nan tan byas pas dul bar byed pa dang*/ rnam g.yeng gi nyes skyon mthong nas de zhi bar byas pas zhi byed dang*/ ting nge 'dzin la chags sogs kyi rtog pa'i skyon byung na de dag kyang zhi bar byas pas nye bar zhi byed dang*/ ting nge 'dzin la sems 'du byed pa dang bcas te goms par byed pas rtse gcig tu byed pa dang*/ de goms nas rtsol med du ting nge 'dzin la ngam ngam shugs kyis 'jug pas mnyam par 'jog pa'i sems rnams 'grub ste/ mdo sde rgyan las/ dmigs pa la ni sems gtad nas// de rgyun rnam par g.yeng mi bya// zhes sogs gsungs pa'i don to// gnyis pa stobs drug 'grub tshul bshad pa ni/ ting nge 'dzin gyi man ngag thos pa ni dang po thos pa'i stobs dang*/ de nyid nyams su len pa ni gnyis pa bsam pa'i stobs dang*/ dran pa mi g.yeng ba gsum pa dran pa'i stobs dang*/ bying rgod rig pa bzhi pa shes bzhin gyi stobs dang*/ ting nge 'dzin la 'bad rtsol cher byed pa lnga pa brtson 'grus kyi stobs dang*/ shin tu goms par byed pa drug pa 'dris pa'i stobs rnams 'grub par 'gyur ro// gsum pa yid byed bzhi 'grub tshul bshad pa ni/ thog mar ting nge 'dzin la 'bad pa chen pos yid rtse gcig tu bsgrim dgos pas bsgrims te 'jug pa dang*/
