de nas bying rgod kyis bar du gcod pa yod pa'i tshe chad cing 'jug pa dang*/ des bar du gcod mi nus pa'i tshe chad pa med par 'jug pa dang*/ mthar rtsol med du ngang gis 'jug pa'i tshe lhun grub kyi 'jug pa rnams 'grub par 'gyur ro// bzhi pa 'phros don bshad pa ni/ de la rang re'i phyag rgya chen po 'di/ mdo sngags gnyis ka'i yang snying*/ mdo lam sngags lam rdzogs pa yin zer ba la/ 'o na mdo'i lam tshang tshul ci lta bu zer 'dri ba zhig na/ mdo'i lam tshang ba yin no// zhes spyi rgyag gi rnam pa zhig las/ mdo las bshad pa'i sems don sgom pa'i tshul 'di de rnams phyag chen gyi lam rdzogs tshul 'di dang 'di zhes pa so sor bshad cing gsung ba dka' bar 'dug phyir/ de la mdo'i lam gyi ting nge 'dzin sgrub pa'i dngos gzhi sems gnas dgu/ stobs drug /yid byed bzhi sogs phyag len ma yengs dran pa'i lam skyong bar tshang tshul sogs phyogs mtshon pa tsam bshad pa de bzhin la/ gzhan gyi zhi gnas kyi rnam dbye sogs mtshon pa tsam bshad pa de ltar yin/ de lta bu'i sems gnas de shin tu goms pa na thog mar ting nge 'dzin bsgom pa'i kun slong gi dran pas lan gcig mnyam par bzhag na/ rgyun ldan du dran shes thu re 'dzin mi dgos par ting nge 'dzin du cham cham 'gro ba 'byung ste/ de lta bu'i mnyam bzhag bde gsal mi rtog pa'i nyams dang bcas pa gcig la de ka'i mnyam rjes 'dres pa 'ong ste/ de la 'ga' zhig gis dge sbyor bzang por rlom pa yod kyang sems gnas kyi nyams snang tsam du bzhed kyi/ phyag chen 'dir bzhed pa'i dge sbyor ma yin yang*/ rje gong ma rnams kyis sems gnas sgom gyi gzhi'am rkang pa tsam du bzhed la/ 'dir zhi gnas kho na tsam du mi 'dod par zhi lhag 'brel pa'i dge sbyor rnyed nas rtsal du 'don tshul du snang ste// 'on kyang bskyang rgyu'i ting nge 'dzin gyi khyad par tsam ma gtogs/

bsgom bya de dran shes rtsol gsum gyis goms par bskyangs pas/ mthar bsgom bya de la rtsol med du 'jug pa'i mnyam bzhag 'char tshul ni/ rnam pa thams cad du mtshungs pas/ skabs 'dir/ gang zag rim gyis pa'i rigs can la/ zhi gnas rkang tshugs na legs par mthong ste/ spyod 'jug las/ zhi gnas rab tu ldan pa'i lhag mthong gis// zhes dang*/ sgrub brgyud pa'i gsungs las kyang*/ zhi ma gnas na lhag mi mthong*// zhes dang*/ lhag mthong sngas na zhi gnas med// ces gsungs pa'o// bzhi pa zhi gnas gyi nyams 'char tshul bshad pa la'ang*/ dang po nyams bde gsal mi rtog pa 'char tshul bshad pa/ gnyis pa gzhan nyams sna tshogs pa 'char tshul bshad pa'o// dang po bde gsal mi rtog pa 'char tshul la nyams dngos bshad pa dang*/ de gal che bar bshad pa gnyis so// dang po nyams dngos bshad pa ni/ de'i dang por 'phral nyams lus bde ba'am yod du mi tshor ba 'dra ba/ rlung 'gro 'ong mi tshor la/ sems rnam rtog mi rgyu ba/ dran thog tu'ang mi rgyu ba/ rjes thob tu'ang legs par ma dpyad na yul gyi spu ris mi zin pa 'dra ba/ ma bsgoms kyang sgom du cham cham du 'gro ba sogs 'ong*/ de nas bde gsal mi rtog pa dngos ni/ bde nyams la lus bde bas khyab pa dang*/ reg bya bde bar 'char ba dang*/ lus yod med mi tshor bar bde ba dang*/ sems dga' spros dgod 'dod pa dang*/ blo bde zhing skyid snang 'char ba dang*/ nyin mtshan ngo mi shes pa tsam bde bas lus gang sems rgyud gang ba sogs 'byung*/ gsal nyams la sems shel ltar dwangs shing nyams snang sna tshogs gsal ba dang*/ mtshan mo'ang nye ring gi dngos po rnams mthong snyam byed pa dang*/ sgom snang ci rigs la reg mthong gi mtshan ma rnyed pa dang*/ 'od kyi snang ba lta bur gsal ba'i nyams snang dang*/ gzhan sems shes pa'i mngon shes 'ong snyam byed pa 'byung*/ mi rtog pa'i nyams la yul snang yod pa mi tshor bar bya ba byed rgyu brjed pa dang*/

brtan g.yo'i dngos po thams cad stong pa'i 'dzin stangs skye ba dang*/ gzugs sgra sogs kyi yul snang thams cad bkrag med ban bun du 'char ba dang*/ rang med pa lta bu dang*/ snang ba thams cad stong pa'i rnams 'gyur du 'char ba dang*/ rtog pa phra mo tsam yang thim pas stong sangs nam mkha' g.ya' dag pa lta bu'i nyams la sogs pa 'char ba'o// gnyis pa de dag gal che bar bshad pa ni/ nyams bde gsal mi rtog pa de nyid zhen med 'dzin med du bskyangs na/ de'i cha la lhag mthong gi nyams skyes nas/ de nas rnal 'byor gong ma skye ba'i rgyu byed de/ zhen med byung na nyams ji ltar che gnas rgyun ring na dga' ste/ rtogs pa 'char dus rnam rtog nyon mongs zhi zhing brtan cha che ba'i dgos pa yod/ der dgongs nas rje gong ma rnams kyis skyong yun ring po mdzad de/ de ltar yang*/ blo gros rgya mtshos zhus pa'i mdo las/ byang chub sems dpa'i mnyam par bzhag pas ni// lhag mthong gis ni chos rnams rab tu mthong*// mnyam par ma bzhag pas ni ma yin no// de ni lhag mthong gang yin shes rab ste// shes rab des ni sangs rgyas mngon du 'gyur// zhes dang*/ dus 'khor rtsa rgyud las/ lus ngag sems kyi dben pa yis// mi rtog ting 'dzin skye bar 'gyur// mi rtog ting 'dzin skyes pa yis// shes rab ye shes skye bar 'gyur// zhes dang*/ gsang ba sgron me las/ zhi gnas bsgoms pas lhag mthong skye// lhag mthong ye shes skye ba'i rgyu// zhes dang*/ rje btsun gyis/ bde dang gsal dang mi rtog gsum// 'di gsum sgom gyi yang rtse yin// zhes dang*/ yang dgon pas/ blo bral gyi gsal stong rjen pa 'di// rang sa ru zhog la rang la ltos dang*// lhag mthong gi rang zhal mthong ba zhig 'ong gi /zhes gsungs/ tshul des na sgom gyi rtsa ba yin par shes dgos// gnyis pa gzhan nyams sna tshogs 'char tshul bshad pa ni/ rgyas par lus nyams dang gcig

/sems nyams dang gnyis/ snang nyams dang gsum/ rmi lam nyams dang bzhi ste/ snang ba bzhi po de rnams 'char tshul/ 'char ba de rtsa rlung thig le sems kyi rang nyams byed las yin tshul/ de rnams kyang so sor bshad na rtsa gsum 'khor lo bzhi'i rang nyams/ rtsa ba'i rlung lnga dang yan lag gi rlung lnga'i rang nyams/ khams thig le'i rang nyams/ sems kyi rang nyams sogs so sor bshad na mtha' yas kyang*/ 'dir spyi sdom du bsdus don bshad na/ de'ang*/ nyams sgron las/ rlung gi mtshan ma rnam lnga yang*// du ba lta bu lang long dang*// smig rgyu lta bu gya gyu dang*// srin me lta bur dmar 'phro dang*// mar me lta bur dmar skem gsal// mkha' la nyi shar lta bur gsal// zhes gsungs te/ de'ang rtsa gsum gyi g.yas ro ma nas/ sna bug g.yas su rgyu ba'i rlung lnga zin pa la/ sa rlung zin dus su/ snang nyams mig sngar sprin lta bu'am/ du ba lta bu kham long long ba dang*/ skya rib rib pa dang*/ skya bun pa dang*/ sngo 'phyur ba dang*/ spos reng dud pa lta bu dang*/ du ba sngo 'khrigs pa la sogs pa 'byung*/ lus nyams ljid ho re ba mnan pa 'dra ba/ subs ched pa 'dra ba/ sems nyams gnas cha che ba/ bying ba bun ne ba dang*/ rmi nyams du ba/ rlangs pa/ sub ma/ smug pa lta bu kham pa 'khyil pa/ sa nang dang sa phug tu nyal ba rmi/ chu rlung zin pa'i dus su/ snang nyams su smig rgyu lta bu skya rib rib dang*/ chu 'gro ba/ char 'bab pa/ mtsho dang chu rlabs/ 'bab chu sogs chu'i mthong snang dang*/ lus nyams 'jam zhing mnyen pa/ grang sib pa 'byung*/ rmi nyams chu la brgal ba/ 'khyer ba sogs rmi/ me rlung zin dus/ snang nyams srin bu me khyer lta bu skya tshag pa dang*/ me stag 'phro ba la sogs/ me dmar po'i rigs rnams dang*/ lus nyams su drod che ba rngul ba ltogs pa skom pa'i snang ba dang*/ sems nyams su gnas pa'i steng du shes pa 'tshab 'tshub cung re 'byung bas/ 'dir ngal gso zhing lhod la bsgom dgos/

rmi nyams su ri khang khyim rang lus sogs me 'bar ba rmi/ rlung gi rlung zin na snang nyams mar me lta bu/ rlung lta bu sngon dang phyogs su g.yo ba ltar snang ba dang*/ lus nyams lus yang ba/ yeng yeng byed pa/ sems nyams su g.yeng g.yeng ba gtad so med pa/ rmi nyams rlung gis khyer ba/ nam mkhar 'phur ba/ rta rgyug pa/ bya'i khyu rmi/ nam mkha'i rlung zin pas snang nyams su sprin med pa'i nam mkha' lta bu/ che chung ma nges pa sna tshogs pa mthong ba dang*/ yul snang stong par mthong ba dang*/ lus nyams su lus yod du mi tshor ba/ sems nyams gsal stong du 'char ba/ rmi nyams skas ring la gyen du 'dzegs pa/ nam mkha' rgya chen mthong ba sogs rmi zhing*/ g.yon rkyang ma nas sna bug g.yon du rgyu ba'i rlung lnga zin pa la/ nam mkha'i rlung zin pas snang nyams su me 'bar ba lta bu yal 'gro ba dang*/ me long has btab pa lta bu dang*/ me long 'od lta bu lhab lhab pa dang*/ bar snang skya tsig gis gang ba/ ser 'od lam lam dang*/ sems nyams sngon dang 'dra ba las khyad par yul snang med snyam pa/ lus bar snang du yod pa 'dra ba/ lus nyams dang rmi nyams sngon dang 'dra/ rlung gi rlung zin pas snang nyams su zla ba zhes pa gyang la zla ba shar ba lta bu dang*/ sprin bar nas shar ba 'dra ba dang*/ de'ang zla tshes dang nya gang ba/ lcags sgrog 'khril ba lta bu dang*/ shel phreng 'phyar ba lta bu dang*/ skya sleb sleb pa dang*/ skar ma skar mda' lta bu sogs dang*/ lus nyams nam mkha' la yod pa 'dra ba dang*/ nam mkhar 'phags par nus pa'ang 'byung*/ sems nyams su nam mkha' dang 'dres pa 'dra ba/ me rlung zin pas nyi ma zhes pa ri dang khang pa sogs la nyi ma shar ba lta bu// nyi ma'i mthong snang zla ba gzas 'dzin lta bu dang*/ 'od sngo dmar ljang sogs 'char ba/ sems nyams blo rgod shes pa rtsub/ spro thung ba de byung na glod la sgom pa gal du che/ lus nyams dro ba dang*/ kha sna nas du ba 'tshubs pa 'dra ba dang*/

khang par me 'bar ba'i snang ba/ btung bas ngoms pa med pa/ chu rlung zin pas snang nyams su rdo rje zhes pa thig le nag po mig lta bu dang*/ che chung ci rigs sogs 'ong*/ sems nyams res bzang res ngan sogs 'ong*/ de byung na dga' sdug mi byed glod pa gal che/ sa rlung zin pas mchog gi cha zhes pa snang nyams su glog lta bu'i dkar 'khyug pa dang*/ skar mda' 'dra ba/ ser zhugs pa sogs dang*/ sems nyams gsal la brtan pa mi 'phro bar lhan ne gnas pa dang*/ lus nyams su lus g.yon gyi rlung lnga por gsal ba bsgom la 'byung ba shas che/ g.yo 'gul mi 'dod pa sogs 'ong*/ gzhan yang rlung snying gar 'dus pas snying tsha zhing phrug pa dang sngangs pa/ smin mtshams su sems 'dus pa dang*/ spyi bor 'dus pas za zhing 'phrig pa/ gzhan yang lus kyi rtsa mdud grol bas steng nas 'og tu brul snyam pa dang*/ ma bsams par 'gul yed yed pa dang*/ lus khol bur za ba dang*/ 'phrig pa dang sha 'gul ling ling dang*/ tsha shar dang*/ na ba dang sbrid pa dang*/ ngo sbos gzer ba sogs lus la rnam 'gyur ci'ang 'byung*/ 'di tsho rang rgyus med na nad la bzung dogs yod pas shes par dgos/ gzhan yang rlung bcu dus gcig la zin pas thig le dmar ser dmar ljang 'od lnga'i mu khyud gang rung gis bskor ba che chung ma nges pa mthong zhing*/ 'ga' rer de'i dbus su sprul sku rgyan med dang*/ longs sku rgyan can yod pa mthong snang mang nyung ci rigs pa 'byung ba yin par 'dug ste/ de skad du'ang*/ dus kyi 'khor lor/ nam mkhar kun nas zhen pa'i sems dang dmigs mig bcas par rdo rje'i lam du rab tu zhugs pa yis// stong pa las ni du ba smig rgyu rab gsal dri ma med pa'i mkha' snang nyid dang mar me dang*// 'bar ba dang ni zla ba nyi ma rdo rje rnams dang mchog gi cha dang thig le mthong bar 'gyur// de yi dbus su sangs rgyas rnams kyi sku ni yul dang rnam par bral ba du ma longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku// zhes dang*/

nyams kyi sgron me las/ gzhan yang rlung zin bag chags dang*// sems phyogs med pa'i rang snang phyir// ngan song gsum gnas sdug bsngal dang*// 'dod khams lha mi'i snang tshul dang*// pad+ma'i tshal dang sangs rgyas zhing*// nyams kyi snang ba cir yang 'char// zhes gsungs pas nyams kyi snang ba la dmyal ba btso bsreg gi rnam pa can sna tshogs dang*/ yi dwags bkres skom gyis gdung ba'i rnam pa dang*/ dud 'gro'i rigs kyi sdug bsngal dang*/ mi'i bye brag skyes pa bud med rgyan cha lugs mi 'dra ba du ma dang*/ lha ma yin go mtshon 'thab rtsod/ lha'i bde ba sna tshogs dang*/ lung pa'ang ri thang rtsi shing nags tshal la sogs dbyibs mi 'dra ba du ma dang*/ khang khyim dang*/ lha khang dang*/ mchod rten gdugs dang rgyal mtshan me tog rigs mang po dang*/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dang*/ yi dam lha dang*/ mkha' 'gro dang chos skyong la sogs 'phags pa rnams dang*/ sbrul nag sogs sems can 'jigs su rung ba rnams dang*/ lha 'dre ma rungs pa rnams dang*/ las kyi gshin rje 'jigs su rung ba sogs mdor na shes bya la srid tshad rnams mthong nyams lus nyams sems nyams rmi nyams la ci rigs su 'char ba yin par 'dug /de ltar yang*/ sha wa ri pas/ rtags bcu rtogs par gyur pa na// thig le chen po'i snang ba 'byung*// sna tshogs thig le chen po la// res 'gar nag po'i ri mo 'byung*// de na 'gro ba drug sogs dang*// shin tu phra ba'i sprul sku dang*// longs sku du ma mthong gyur pa// sna tshogs gzugs can 'od gsal ba'o// zhes dang*// lam 'bras sogs nas/ srid pa'i rtse mo man chad ting nge 'dzin gyi nyams bshad kyis mi langs pa 'byung*/ zhes sogs mang ngo*// gzhan yang nyams ni rna bas rol mo la sogs pa sna tshogs pa thos pa dang*/ snas dri/ lces ro/ lus kyis reg bya bde rtsub sna tshogs pa zhig 'ong bar bshad de/ lung las/ rnam rtog gzhom du med pas gzugs mthong zhing*// sgra tshor dri myong ro dang reg bya myong*// zhes dang*/

man ngag rnams nas/ 'byung bzhi'i rlung gcig tu 'dus pas 'dod yon sna tshogs myong bar gsungs kyang 'ga' rer zhi gnas sgom yin/ nyams snang byung na 'khrul snang yin// zhes gsungs kyang*/ spyir don dam ma gtogs 'khrul pa los yin te/ nyams 'di rnams don dam gyi lam stegs yin pas 'khrul pa rang ga mar bzung bar mi bya ste/ lar sems can la nyon mongs pa'i snang ba/ rnal 'byor pa la ting nge 'dzin gyi snang ba/ bde bar gshegs pa la dag pa'i snang ba/ zhes snang ba gsum yod cing*/ rgyud man ngag thams cad nas/ 'khrul grol lam gsum du/ snang ba gsum 'byung bar gsungs/ 'dir dper na me 'bar ba'i du ba dang*/ shing rlon tshig pa'i sngon du chu 'dzir pa lta bur snga rtags yin/ lus gnad sogs legs par bsgoms na nyams 'ga' re 'char nges te/ slob dpon rin po ches/ bde gsal mi rtog ting 'dzin las su rung*// 'byung ba'i rlung rnams nang du zin pa yi// rtags dang yon tan rnams ni rim bzhin 'byung*// zhes dang*/ nyams sgron las/ 'gro drug rtsa gnas rlung tshud dag /thog med bag chags sna tshogs dang*// sems nyid cing yang 'char ba'i phyir// 'gro ba snang tshul sna tshogs dang*// lha dang lha mo la sogs dang*// skyed mos tshal dang zhing khams dang*// nyams kyi bye brag cir yang 'char// zhes gsungs so// 'di ltar nyams kyi bshad pa 'di/ nged rang phyag chen gyi nang na spyi tsam ma gtogs nyams thams cad rgyas pa so sor mi 'dug ste/ lar phyag chen gyi lus gnad rlung gnad sems gnad gsum 'di legs par bsgom na rtags 'di rnams kyang ci rigs par 'ong bar 'dug pas 'dir mdor bsdus bshad pa yin/ nyams khrid 'ga' rer nyams byung na mi yong ba lta bur gsungs te/ nged rang phyag chen pas nyams rtags byung na de ka skyong ba dang*/ ma byung na'ang re med kyis sems ngo rkyang pa bskyangs pas chog par bzhed de/ rgyud snying po las/

smig rgyu la sogs rtags gang zhig /lkog tu gyur pa dgos min te// mngon du grub pa'i nam mkha' che// rtags ni dgos pa ga la yod/ ces so// de ltar don gnad shes par bya dgos pa'o// lnga pa zhi gnas dang nyams de'i gol sa bcad pa bshad pa la/ dang po zhi gnas kyi gol sa bshad pa/ gnyis pa nyams kyi gol sa bshad pa'o// dang po zhi gnas kyi gol sa bshad pa la/ dang po zhi gnas la zhen na gol sa che bar bstan pa/ gnyis pa zhi gnas lteng po'i gol sa bshad pa/ gsum pa bsam gtan bzhi'i gol sa bshad pa/ bzhi pa gzugs med skye mched mu bzhi'i gol sa bshad pa/ lnga pa gol sa de rnams gcod par bshad pa dang lnga las/ dang po zhi gnas la zhen pa gol sa che bar bstan pa ni/ de'ang zhi gnas bde gsal mi rtog pa de la zhen na gol zhing lhag mthong rig cha med na yun ci ring yang yon tan gang yang med de/ mdo 'od zer bkye ba las/ byis pa'i bsam gtan bsgom pa ni// bskal pa brgya stong bsgoms byas kyang*// de la rnam grol ci yang med// skye ba len nas thams cad du// de la zhen chags skyed par byed// gal te skye nyid gting rig na// mthong ba rnam par dag par 'gyur// zhes spyir zhi gnas rkyang par yon tan med cing gal te zhi gnas zhen med yun du bskyangs nas mthar phyin na nyan rang gi 'bras bu thob par gsungs pa de ltar dang*/ gzhan yang chos yang dag par 'byung ba'i mdor/ yun ring du ni tshul khrims bsrungs byas shing*// bskal pa mang por bsam gtan bskyed byas kyang*// yang dag nyid mtha' 'di ni ma rtogs na// de dag bstan pa 'di la blo yod min// zhes dang*/ 'phags pa'i spring yig tu/ 'jig rten dag na ting 'dzin sgom byed de// de yis bdag tu 'dzin pa zhig mi byed// de yi nyon mongs phyir yang 'phel 'gyur te// lhag spyod kyis ni ting 'dzin 'di bsgom bzhin// zhes gsungs te/ de'i don mu stegs lhag spyod pas lo bcu gnyis su ting nge 'dzin gcig la gnas pa de'i ral par byi bas tshang bcas te bcad par zhe sdang skyes pas slar dud 'gror skyes pa yin 'dug

/ting 'dzin rgyal po'i mdo las/ mi mkhas pa dag ting 'dzin sgom byed kyang*// de ni bdag tu 'dzin pa 'jig mi 'gyur// de yi nyon mongs phyir zhing rab tu 'phel// lhag spyod kyis ni ting 'dzin 'di bsgoms pas// de ni nang gi rnam par g.yeng ba ste// bdag tu rtog pa rnam g.yeng skye gyur pa// de ni rab 'bar mtshon cha'i 'khrul 'khor 'dra// yongs su smin pa mi bzad sdug bsngal rgyu// zhes dang*/ ār+ya de was/ bsam gtan nags mes yang dang yang du ni// nyon mongs tshang tshing bsregs par gyur pa min// bdag lta'i rtsa ba brtan po ma spangs pas// char gyis brlan bzhin mod la rab tu skye// zhes dang*/ pha dam pas/ rtogs pa med pa'i nyams myong la zhen pa mang*/ sgom chen phal cher 'dir lus pa yin/ zhes gsungs/ dwags po rin po cher/ zhag bcu gsum tsam la rtog pa mi rgyu ba byung ba/ rje btsun la zhus pas/ de'ang sgom yin te/ 'gog pa'i bsam gtan yin pas byang chub mi thob/ bye ma btsir bas mar mi yong zhes gsungs pa sogs kyi lung shin tu mang ba'o// gnyis pa zhi gnas lteng po'i gol sa bshad pa ni/ de'ang thos pa chung zhing bla ma la brten yun thung ba dag la/ dang por sgom rjes mthun tsam skyes kyang de skyong ma shes pa'i ngang ngam shugs kyis lhag mthong gi nges shes shor zhing*/ ting nge 'dzin gyi dran shes lhod par gyur te/ sgom min gyi nyams ci rigs shar ba sgom du rlom pa skyes nas lteng po sogs su gol ba yin la/ de yang ci rigs la sgom bskyangs pas bying rmugs 'phel te/ dang po mig yul gyi gzugs phra rags mi gsal ba wal po lta bur gyur/ de'ang je cher mi gsal du song nas mthar mig shes thim pas gzugs kyi snang ba 'gags/ de bzhin du rna ba'i sgra la sogs pa la'ang ci rigs pa mi gsal zhing*/ mthar 'gags te/ mjug tu yul drug la 'jug pa'i rnam shes drug ka 'gags nas snang med dran med brgyal ba ltar song ba 'ong ste/

dper na mtsho la dar chags pa na chu'i rnam pa dwangs shing gsal ba dang*/ chu nang gi dngos po'i khyad par ji snyed pa mi gsal bar 'gyur ba ltar/ shes pa rtog med du gyur pa sgom du rlom pa ni/ zhi gnas lteng por gol ba'o// de las ni cung zad dwangs shing dran pa yud de ba tsam yod pa/ gzugs sgra sogs kyi snang ba'ang ma 'gags kyang*/ de dag mi gsal ba wal po ltar song nas shes bzhin mi gsal bar rmongs pa'am 'thoms pa'am snyoms pa ltar gyur pa'ang 'byung ste/ de dag ni nyon mongs pa gti mug gi rigs dang*/ de'i nye ba'i nyon mongs pa'i char gtogs su bshad de/ yang tshogs drug gi snang ba gsal mi gsal sogs gang gis kyang rig tshor dang 'du shes med cing*/ gang du'ang yid 'du mi byed par dran med lta bur gnas pa'ang snga ma dang phyogs 'dra ba'i gnas pa lteng po'i rigs yin pas bsgom du mi rung ste/ de dag rmongs pa shas che bar snang bas dud 'gro'i rgyu tshogs su bshad pa'i phyir te// rin chen phreng bar/ rmongs pa phal cher dud 'gror 'gyur// zhes dang*/ dwags po rin po ches/ ma rtogs lteng po sgom gyi bdud// nges shes gting nas ma skyes par// nyams myong bzang zhes mi brjod do// zhes gsungs pa dang*/ gzhan yang rnying lugs kyi 'dra min shan 'byed las/ stong nyid had po'i bsam gtan la// blo bzhag sems kyi mun pa ste// rtogs pa mngon du 'gyur mi srid// lung dang mthun pa'i bsgoms nyams med// lung ma bstan gyi nyams skyes par// rtogs par ming btags log min spyod// de 'dra'i 'dra min bsam gtan la// zhen pa'i blun sgom mang po 'byung*// rtog pa spangs pa'i mi rtog pa// mar 'dod chu la mar bsrubs 'dra// zhes gsungs so// yang de dag la cung zad mi 'dra ba sems dwangs cha'am gsal snang ci rigs dang ldan yang 'dod pa bzhin gyi dran pa dang shes bzhin gyi gsal ngar dang mi ldan na/

de'ang dge ba'i sems rtse gcig par mi 'gro zhing*/ mi dge ba 'dir 'gyur yang med pas/ lung ma bstan gyi sems su gtogs so// de bzhin du dran shes mi gsal bar snang ba mtha' dag la dgag sgrub med par gnas pa tsam yang*/ 'du byed btang snyoms pa'i khongs su gtogs dgos pas/ lung ma bstan gyi sems yin no// lung ma bstan gyi las ni/ phyis rkyen gyis las gzhan du 'gyur srid kyang*/ 'bras bu mtha' gcig mi 'byung bar bshad la/ kha cig mi g.yo ba'i las dang don gcig pa ltar 'chad kyang*/ de ni cung zad mi legs te/ de gnyis kyi khyad par shin tu che ba'i phyir ro// de ltar na sems de gnyis stabs legs na 'du shes med pa'i snyoms 'jug nyon mongs pa can gyi rgyu'i phyogs su 'gro ba srid kyang de ni bsam gtan bzhi dang*/ gzugs med kyi ting nge 'dzin skyon med du'ang mi 'gro bas/ 'dir bsgrub bya'i sgom du ni nam du'ang mi rung ste/ spyod 'jug las/ stong pa nyid dang bral ba'i sems// 'gags pa slar yang skye 'gyur te// 'du shes med pa'i snyoms 'jug yin// zhes gsungs/ de ni 'du shes 'khor dang bcas pa rgyun chad pa'i lha 'du shes med pa zhes pa'i rgyur bshad pa'o// gsum pa bsam gtan bzhir gol bar bshad pa ni/ de'ang zhi gnas kyi ting nge 'dzin de la shin tu goms pa na/ lus sems las su rung zhing btang snyoms kyi sems rtog pa dang dpyod pa dang bcas par gyur pa la/ 'tsher snang med par dga' spro rgyas par 'byung la/ de la goms pa na 'dod pa'i sred pa dang sdig pa'i las sogs dang bral zhing*/ blos rtog dpyod dang zhen pas sgom zhing dga' bde dang ldan par 'gyur ba bsam gtan dang po'i ting nge 'dzin zhes bya ste lha der skye ba'i rgyu byed/ de nas bsam gtan dang po'i rtog dpyod kyi sred pa sogs spangs nas bsgoms pa na/ dga' ba dang bde ba dang sems yongs su dwangs par 'gyur ba ni/

bsam gtan gnyis pa'i ting nge 'dzin zhes bya ste lha der skye ba'i rgyu byed/ de nas bsam gtan gnyis pa'i dga' bde'i sred pa spangs nas bsgoms pa na/ bde ba dang rtog dpyod med pa'i btang snyoms dang dran pa dang shes bzhin dang ldan par 'gyur ba ni bsam gtan gsum pa'i ting nge 'dzin zhes bya ste lha der skye ba'i rgyu byed/ de nas bsam gtan gsum pa'i bde ba'i sred pa de'ang spangs nas bsgoms pas sdug bsngal yang ma yin bde ba yang ma yin zhing rnam rtog thams cad dang bral la gsal ba'i go ma 'gags pa nam mkha' lta bur gyur pa ni/ bsam gtan bzhi pa'i ting nge 'dzin zhes bya ste lha der skye ba'i rgyu byed/ 'di dag ni 'jig rten pa'i ting nge 'dzin rnams kyi nang nas mchog tu grags shing lhag mthong gi rten yin yang zhen pas bsgoms na phyag chen gyi gol sar 'gyur zhing*/ bsam gtan gyi lha gnas de dag tu skye ba'i rgyu byed pa'i phyir te/ rje rgyal mtshan dpal bzang gis/ blo yi ting nge 'dzin la ni// rtog cing zhen pas spyad pa dang*// dga' bde sems ni rtse gcig sgom// de ni bsam gtan dang por gol// ting nge 'dzin la dad pa dang*// dga' bde'i sems ni rtse gcig sgom// de ni bsam gtan gnyis par gol// ting 'dzin rtog dang dpyod med pa'i// btang snyoms dran pa shes bzhin dang*// bde dang sems ni rtse gcig sgom// de ni bsam gtan gsum par gol// btang snyoms yongs su dag pa dang*// dran pa yongs su dag pa dang*// bde sdug gnyis min tshor ba dang*// sems rtse gcig pa bsam gtan bzhir// zhes sogs kyi lung mang ba'o// bzhi pa gzugs med skye mched mu bzhir gol ba ni/ de'ang bsam gtan bzhi pa'i skabs kyi gzugs snang sna tshogs pa snang ba dor bar byas la/ chos thams cad kha dog dbyibs mtha' dbus thams cad dang bral bas nam mkha' dang 'dra zhes/ shes rab kyis dpyad nas sgom la mchog tu bzung ste zhen 'dzin gyi dbang du gyur pa ni/

nam mkha' mtha' yas skye mched du gol/ de nas chos thams cad nam mkha' dang 'dra bsam pa dor nas/ chos thams cad rnam par shes pa'am sems yin snyam nas sgom la mchog tu bzung nas a 'thas par gyur pa ni/ rnam shes mtha' yas skye mched du gol/ de nas chos thams cad rnam par shes pa yin snyam pa dor nas/ thams cad stong pa nyid du ci'ang ma grub gang yang med bsams nas sgom pa la mchog tu bzung nas zhen chags par gyur pa ni/ ci'ang med pa'i skye mched du gol/ de nas ci'ang med do bsam pa de'ang dor nas/ chos gang yang yod pa'ang ma yin/ med pa'ang min snyam nas sgom la mchog tu bzung nas a 'thas par gyur pa ni/ yod min med min skye mched du gol/ de dag yud tsam re bsgom pas skye ba min la/ der a 'thas yun du bsgom nas tshe dus byas na lha der skye ba ste/ rje rgyal mtshan dpal bzang gis/ phyag rgya chen po'i gol sa ni// chos kun nam mkha' bzhin du ni// mtha' yas snyam pa'i blo yis su// mnyam bzhag nam mkha' mtha' yas gol// rnam par shes pa mtha' yas so// snyam pas rnam shes mtha' yas gol// chos kun ci yang med do snyam// bsgoms pas ci yang med par gol// chos kun yod min med pa min// snyam pas mnyam par 'jog pa ni// yod min med min skye mched gol// zhes gsungs pa ltar yin pa'o// lnga pa gol sa de rnams gcod par bshad pa la bzhi las/ dang po zhi gnas bde gsal mi rtog pa'i gol sa gcod pa ni/ bde gsal mi rtog pa'i nyams ji snyed skyes pa des/ re zhig nyon mongs rnam rtog mgo non kyang 'gyur ldog yod pa lcags mes bsreg pa lta bu gsungs shing*/ 'di la nyams der rtogs pa'i ngo bo rlom zhen gyi nges shes skyes shing de la a 'thas mchog tu bzung na nyams rtogs par shor ba'i gol sa che zhing*/ gang zhig bla ma brten yun thung ba dang*/ blo dman dag nyams myong gi rtsi la 'byar nas lo grangs mang por nyams len byas kyang rang sems ngo ma shes pa dang*/

shes kyang shor ba 'ong ste/ rje dwags po rin po ches/ rtogs pa med pa'i lta ba de// mtha' bral zer yang blos byas yin// gdos thag ma chod sgom chen de// ting 'dzin bzang yang 'khor ba'i rgyu// zhes dang*/ rje 'bri gung pas/ nyams myong bzang po ma bcos pa// lha gnas gong mar skye ba'i rgyu// zhes sogs gsungs pa ltar ro// mdor na sems kyi ngo thog tu rdo rus ma thug pa'i bde gsal mi rtog pa ci bzang yang snang la ma nges pa dang*/ sems rtse gcig tu mi gnas ngo thog kyang rtog bcas kyi go ba tsam du gsungs shing*/ mdor na lhag mthong gi nges shes dang mi ldan pa'i ting 'dzin ci tsam bzang yang 'dir bsgrub bya'i sgom min te/ rje yang dgon pas/ sgom zhi gnas kyi me long g.ya' dang bral// nyams drod rtags sna tshogs kyi gzugs brnyan bkra// rang rlom zhen sgeg mo'i byad bzhin lta// lhag mthong gi rang zhal ma mthong ba'i// mtshams de na sgom chen gyi nor sa gcig yod// sems gsal stong kho na gzung 'dzin gyi shubs nas thon cig gsungs// zhes dang*/ rje pad+ma dkar pos/ nyams sna tshogs 'char ba'i ltad mo la// kha phyir bltas byas na gong du 'phel// des gnas lugs mthong ba'i go mi chod// sems ma bcos ji bzhin ngang du zhog /ces gsungs so// des na nyams de dag la mi chags mi zhen rlom sems nga rgyal mi byed par nyams kyi mtho dman du thag bcad de/ nyams gsal stong gi chog shes mi byed par/ lhag mthong gi rig cha gtso bor bton la/ bzang ngan gnyis 'dzin phral nas gang byung la sgom gyi ngo ti bcol nas bskyang*/ khyad par sgom de gtor dogs par bshad de/ rje rgya ras kyis/ sgom shes mang ste bshig shes nyung*// zhes dang*/ rje 'ba' ra bas/ sgom chen rnams sgom gyis bslu bar mchis so// zhes gsungs/ sgom gtor ba byas kyang spros bral du na spar ba'i gdams ngag nyams su blang ba yin la/

rtogs pa byin rlabs la re bas na dus dang rnam pa kun tu/ rtsa ba'i bla ma mtshan ldan gang yin de la mos gus gsha' ma dang ma bral ba'i sgo nas gsol 'debs la brtson dgos/ de ltar brtson pas rang sems gnas lugs chos sku'i lta ba rtogs yong ba yin te/ rgyal dbang rjes/ bsgom sran gyis grol ba the tshom za// mos gus kyis grol ba the tshom med// de gnad ka yod med kyi khyad par yin// zhes gsungs pa ltar ro// gnyis pa zhi gnas lteng po sogs kyi gol sa gcod pa ni/ de'ang zhi gnas bde gsal mi rtog pa'i nyams gsal cha can min pa'i zhi gnas 'thom po de rnams kyi ngang du lus te/ shi na dud 'gror skye bar gsungs te/ rje sa paṇa gyis/ blun pos phyag rgya che sgom pa// phal cher dud 'gro'i rgyu ru 'gyur// gsungs pa'ang thugs bden pas de 'dra la ni gong bshad ltar bshig pa de gal che zhing*/ phyi rol yul snang thog tu skyong dgos/ de nas rtog pa 'og 'gyus su song nas dran med had por song ba ni dran shes stobs chung ba'i skyon yin/ yang na zhe 'dod ha cang tur drags glod ma shes par dran shes nyams pa rgod skyon yin pas/ de gnyis kyi skyon sel tshul gal che ba de ni bshad zin kyang 'chad par 'gyur te/ don bsdu na/ bying ba'i tshe dran shes dang sems kyi gsal ngar bskyed de hur 'don pa dang*/ rgod pa'i tshe dmigs pa la yid bsgrims pa'i zhe 'dod ci rigs glod pa dang*/ grims lhod snyoms nas 'dod pa ltar byung ba'i tshe gzhan dpyad gzhig mi byed par de ka'i rgyun ma shor tsam pa'i rang so bzung nas ngang bsring ba yin te/ klu sgrub kyi dus bzhi mnyam sbyor du/ bying zhing lci ba gzengs bstod cing*// 'thor zhing 'byams pa rang sor bzhag /ces gsungs/ de la dran shes gnyis las dran pas ni/ sems dmigs pa las ma yengs par byed cing shes bzhin gyis yengs ma yengs dang bying rgod ngo shes par byed pa ste/

de'ang dmigs pa las skad cig kyang ma yengs pa byed snyam pa'i 'dun pa shugs bskyed nas de'i rgyun bsrings shing*/ de mi brjed pa'i dran pas sems khur yid la dung nge bar byas la/ de'i ngang nas yengs ma yengs dang*/ bying rgod kyi skyon rtogs par byed pa'i shes bzhin las gzhan dpyad gzhig mang po mi byed par bya ra tsam zhig ce re lta ba yin no// 'di la mdo phyogs nas dran shes phye ste bshad pa mang yang sgrub brgyud pa'i man ngag tu/ dran rig gam dran pa kho nar bsdus pa mang pas/ de ji ltar yin snyam na/ skyon med de/ spyod 'jug las/ gang tshe dran pa yid sgo nas// srung ba'i don ni gnas gyur pa// de tshe shes bzhin 'ong gyur nas// zhes bshad pa'i dran shes gnyis ni phra rags sam rtsing zhib kyi sgo nas phye ba ste/ dran pa gsal ba stobs can gyi khongs su shes bzhin tshang ba'i phyir ro// de ltar yang*/ dbus mtha'i 'grel par/ dran pa nye bar gnas na shes bzhin dang ldan par 'gyur ro// zhes gsungs so// 'di skabs/ dpyod ldan dag /dran shes kyis yid dmigs pa la rtse gcig tu bzung ba'i tshe dmigs pa la gnas mi gnas dang*/ bying rgod byung ma byung brtags pa'i rtog pa phra mo bskyed na ni mi rtog par mi 'gyur la/ ma bskyed na bying rgod sogs rtogs pa'i shes bzhin mi 'byung bas ji ltar bya snyam na/ mi mkhas pa dag /de lta bu'i rtog pa phra mo la skyon du bzung nas/ shes bzhin gyi gsal ngar ni med la sems kyi dwangs cha ni ci rigs yod pa'i gsal cha skyong bar sngar yang*/ de lta bu'i rtog pa phra mo de rtog pa rang mtshan pa ma yin gyi/ lhag mthong dang mtshungs ldan gyi shes bzhin nam rig pa yin pas bskyed dgos te/ sgom rim bar pa las/ de ltar gang la 'dod pa'i dmigs pa de la sems bzhag nas/ de nyid la phyir zhing rgyun du sems bzhag par bya/ de la nye bar bzhag nas sems la 'di ltar bskyed par bya ste/

ci dmigs pa la sems legs par 'dzin tam/ 'on te bying ngam/ 'on te phyi rol gyi yul la rnam par 'khyar bas rnam par g.yengs sam snyam du brtag par bya'o// zhes pa ltar ro// de lta bu'i rtogs pa bskyed lugs kyang ma yengs pa'i dran rgyun btang nas bskyed pa min gyi/ ting nge 'dzin gyi ngang ma shor ba'i thog nas bya ra tsam byed pa yin te/ rtog pa 'di'ang ha cang gi shugs che bar yang yang bskyed na dran pa shor ba'i skyon rtog pa skyon can ldang bas/ snga ma snga ma'i nges shes kyi shugs ma zad tsam la phyi ma phyi mas bya ra tsam byed pa'o// mdor na grims lhod kyi cha snyoms lugs dang skyong tshul 'di dag ni/ bsam gtan gyi skyong tshul mtha' dag gi gnad dam pa'o// tshul de ltar bskyangs pas zhi gnas dang lhag mthong mtshungs ldan gyi don phyin ci ma log pa rtogs par 'gyur te/ de'i dbye ba'ang*/ rje yang dgon pas/ zhi gnas dang rmugs pa nor ba'i nyen yod/ zhi gnas ni rnam rtog phra rags kyi 'gyu ba zhi nas rang sar gnas pa'o// rmugs pa ni rang ngo mi shes pa dang cha med pa'i rtse mun ne ba de'o// lhag mthong gi gnas lugs ni rang zhal stong pa rjen par mthong ba'o// brtags dpyad kyi shes pa ni/ tshig tha snyad la brten nas don spyi blo yul du shar ba'o// zhes gsungs pa ltar ro// de'ang zhi gnas kyi ting nge 'dzin de la sems mi rtog pa rtse gcig tu lhan ne gnas pa'i gnas cha dang*/ dran pa dang shes bzhin ma nyams pa'i gsal ngar nges shes dang bcas pa gnyis tshogs pa zhig ci nas kyang dgos pa'o// gsum pa bsam gtan bzhi'i gol sa gcod pa ni/ de'ang lus sems las rung gi shin sbyangs thob pa'i ting nge 'dzin legs pa 'dra ba de dag ci byung yang zhen chags mi byed/ dga' ba mi bsgom/ der rtogs par rlom zhing chags zhen nas yun du bsgoms na kha phyir bltas kyi shes pa yin zhing*/ 'khor ba las mi 'da' bas sgom gyi gol sa che ba yin/

de dag ni nang nyams kyi mtho dman/ phyi khams kyi byed las/ 'phral mdangs kyi snang nyams 'gyur ldog tsam la rtsis gdab bzung don med de/ sems nyid gshis kyi ngo bo gdod ma nas 'pho 'gyur bzang ngan ma grub la/ ngo bo ngos bzung dang bral ba zhig yin 'dug pa la/ sems nyid kyi rang mdangs su shes pas bzang ngan gnyis su mi 'dzin pa'i nyams snang de ka'i rang ngo'i thog tu glod nas bskyang*/ mdor na gzhi 'khor 'das kyi rtsa ba/ lam gegs dang gol shor gyi rkyen thams cad bzang ngan gnyis 'dzin re dogs 'dis bskyed pas/ de ltar gnyis su mi 'dzin par gnyis med rang rig bzo med rnal ma'i rgyun bskyang zhing gang byung gis sgom go chod par byas nas/ ci shar rgyan du khyer ba ni gdams ngag gi gnad dam pa'o// bzhi pa skye mched mu bzhi'i gol sa gcod pa ni/ de'ang chos thams cad nam mkha' ltar dang*/ sems tsam dang*/ cir yang ma grub pa dang*/ yod min med min dang*/ mtha' gnyis bral du lta ba de dag gi go yul tsam des ci yang mi phan zhing*/ sems rang lugs kyi 'dug tshul ci yod pa de'i ngang ma shor tsam bya ba las/ blos spros nas de rnams lta bu gzhan zhig gsar du bcos shing sgom na/ de gnas lugs kyi don du mi rung ste/ sems kyi gnas lugs la phyogs ris med pas/ snang ba dang stong rig sogs kyi 'char sgo la nye ring dang phyogs 'dzin byas nas mi bsgom/ de bzhin du sems don la gang yang ngos bzung med pas yin min dang blang dor sogs su ngos bzung nas mi bsgom/ sems don la ci yang nges pa med pas btang bzhag sogs kyis ngos bzung dang gtad so byas nas mi bsgom/ sems don la 'pho 'gyur gtan nas med pas/ re dogs kyi khu 'phrig dang rtsis gdab byas nas mi bsgom/ sems don la bzang ngan ci yang med pas dgag sgrub kyi bzo bcos byas nas mi bsgom/ sems don la ci yang dmigs pa dang rtsol bas bsgrubs nas mi bsgom/

mdor na sems kyi gnas lugs la ci'ang bsgom du med pas cir yang mi bsgom ste/ gal te bsgoms na ci 'dra zhig bsgoms kyang yid kyi 'du byed dmigs pa dang mtshan ma dang*/ 'dzin pa dang*/ zhen pa bskyed pa tsam yin la/ de dag gis gnas lugs kyi lta sgom yang dag tu mi rung ba'i phyir ro// de skad du/ mdo las/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa bsgom pa 'di ni chos ci'ang mi bsgom pa lags so// zhes pa sogs dang*/ gsang 'dus las/ dngos po med pa sgom pa med// bsgom par bya ba sgom pa min// de ltar dngos po dngos med pas// sgom pa dmigs su med pa'o// zhes dang*/ gur las/ stong pa bsgom par mi bya ste// stong min bsgom par mi bya'o// zhes gsungs so// de ltar blos bcos nas bsgom rgyu ci'ang med kyang tha mal rang rgyud du mi 'chor ba'i dran pa yengs med cig cis kyang dgos pas/ bsgom med yengs med la bslab/ bde mi bde gsal 'grib ci byung yang*/ de'i rgyu ngo bo'i steng du glod la/ de kas bsgom go gcod cing*/ lam rang byung snying po'i rang bab rang 'gros su/ de ltar bskyangs pas gol sar ma song ba'i rang lugs gsha' mar mthong bar byed/ de ltar chos thams cad don dam nyag gcig rig thog tu rdo rus thug par byed dgos pa'o// gnyis pa nyams kyi gol sa bshad pa la/ dang po bde gsal mi rtog pa'i gol sa bshad pa/ gnyis pa de gcod par bshad pa/ gsum pa nyams sna tshogs pa'i gol sa bshad pa/ bzhi pa nyams de rnams kyi gol sa gcod par bshad pa'o// dang po nyams bde gsal mi rtog pa'i gol sa bshad pa ni/ de'ang bde gsal mi rtog pa'i nyams de dag mchog tu bzung nas de byung na dga'/ ma byung na mi dga' bar zhen cing chags pa'i sgo nas ched gnyer du bskyangs na/ gnas lugs kyi gol sar 'gyur zhing*/ de'ang bde bas 'dod khams gsal bas gzugs khams mi rtog pas gzugs med du skye ba'i rgyu byed pas na/

rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi rgyur mi 'gyur zhing*/ re zhig tsam ngan song gi sdug bsngal myong mi dgos pa'i ngal gso dang*/ khams gsum gyi bde ba myong zin nas slar ngan song gsum du mtha' zin pa med par 'khor bar bshad de/ slob dpon rin po ches/ bde ba la chags na 'dod khams su gol// gsal ba la chags na gzugs khams su gol// mi rtog pa la chags na gzugs med khams su gol// zhes dang*/ rje sgam po pas/ nyams myong gi gol sa gsum ni/ lus bde sems bde lus la bde ba rgyas pa'i nyams 'byung ste/ de la chags shing mngon par zhen pas mchog tu bzung bas 'dod khams nye bar len pa'i rgyu yin pas/ de'i skabs su shi na 'dod pa'i khams su gol nas 'gro ste/ 'dod pa'i khams kyi bde ba'i longs spyod myong nas slar ngan song gsum du mu mtha' med par 'gro ba la tshegs med/ bying rmugs bral la gsal ba'i nyams 'byung ba la chags shing mchog tu bzung bas gzugs khams su gol nas 'gro ba yin/ de'i bde ba dang longs spyod myong nas mar la ltung bar tshegs med/ rnam rtog rlung gis mi bskyod pa'i nyams 'byung ba la chags zhen mchog tu bzung bas gzugs med kyi khams su nye bar len pa'i rgyu yin pas/ de'i skabs su shi na gzugs med khams su gol nas 'gro ba yin/ de'i bde ba dang longs spyod myongs nas ngan song gsum du mu mtha' med par 'gro ba yin/ zhes gsungs pa ltar yin pa'o// gnyis pa de gcod par bshad pa ni/ de ltar mi gol ba'i thabs zhen pa med pa gal che/ de'ang nyams bde bde 'dra ba/ gsal gsal 'dra ba/ gnas gnas 'dra ba ci byung yang*/ der 'di 'dra legs yag 'dis chog 'di dang ma bral na snyam pa sogs/ a 'thas bden zhen mi byed par/ bde gsal mi rtog pa'i ngo bo de ka'i rang thog ngos zin bzhin par skyong dgos te/ rje sgam po pas/ cir yang shar ba cir yang mi 'dzin pa// lam mchog 'di las gong du phul sa med// ces dang*/

rje phag mo gru pas/ nyams la zhen pa byung ba na// zhen pa'i blo la cer gyis ltos// bltas pas zhen pa rang sar dag /skye 'gags med pa'i ngang du gnas// zhes gsungs pa dang*/ yul la rtog pa dang bcas bzhin der dpyod pa'i ting nge 'dzin bsgom par bya'o// zhes lhag mthong dgos par gsungs pa ltar/ de bzhin nges par bya dgos pa'o// gsum pa nyams sna tshogs pa'i gol sa gcod pa ni/ de'ang rtsa rlung gi byed las la/ nyams rnam pa sna tshogs pa shin tu mang bar ji skad bshad pa de lta bur shar ba'ang*/ lar gang zag thams cad la shar ba'i nges pa med de/ de ni lus kyi rtsa rlung gi stobs kyis 'ga' rer shar yang*/ 'di rnams ci rigs re gnyis las thams cad la mi yong zhing 'ga' rer lus nyams gtso che bar 'ong ba dang*/ phal cher mthong nyams che bar 'ong ba dang*/ 'ga' rer sems nyams che ba dang*/ 'ga' rer rmi lam nyams gtso che ba sogs mang*/ nyams de rnams la bzang ngan gnyis 'dzin la a 'thas nas/ bzang bzang 'dra ba rnams la ched du bzang bar bzung nas dga' spro dang*/ ngan pa 'dra bar skyur sems byas na gol sar 'gyur ba dang*/ mdor na chags zhen dang dmigs gtad thams cad lam gol bar bshad de/ bram ze chen pos/ gang la dmigs kyang dmigs pa de yis thar pa bsgrib// bzang bar brtags kyang de yi nad kyis 'khor bar ltung*// dman pas las la brtags pas rnam smin rgyun mi chad// ces dang*/ kye ma 'dod pa'i dngos po gang la khyod nyid chags ma byed// 'di ni bde chen sems mchog gzir ba'i nad rab ste// gal te chags par bya ba'i yul la yid chags na// dri ma med pa'i sems la 'dod pa'i mtshon gyis btab// ces dang*/ gal te yid du 'ong ngo snyam pa'i sems// snying la bab ba gces par bya ba ni// til gyi shun pa tsam gyi zug rngus kyang*// nam yang sdug bsngal 'ba' zhig byed par zad// ces dang*/ bir wa pas/ gnas lugs yid la byed cing nyams la zhen pa dang*// de nyid don la dmigs shing bsgoms na gol ba'o// zhes dang*/

rje btsun mi las/ nyams la yid ches bya mi rung*// de la nges shes skyes pa na// rnam rtog bgegs kyi dbang du 'gro// de de yin te de nyid min// sdong po yin te 'bras bu min// zhes dang*/ grub thob gling ras pas/ nyams myong 'ja' tshon 'dra ba'i ri mo la// blo chung byis pa 'dra ba'i sgom chen chags// bslu brid gol sa zhig yin te ngo ma shes// zhes sogs gsungs pa'o// bzhi pa nyams de rnams kyi gol sa gcod par bshad pa ni/ de ltar nyams snang ma byung yang*/ e yong re ba med pa dang*/ byung yang nyams bzang ngan sna tshogs pa 'ong bar bden zhen re dogs chags sdang byas na lam gyi mi mthun phyogs su 'gro/ nyams su len ma shes na bar chad du 'gro bas na/ de ltar shes shing thag chod pas sgom nyams bzang ngan ci byung thams cad nyams tsam yin par thag bcad nas/ bzang ngan gyi dbye bsal/ chags zhen med par gang shar thog tu bskyangs na mthun pa'i lam gyi rtags yon tan lam gong ma skye ba'i stegs lta bu yin te/ de skad du/ snang ba bcu bdun pa las/ phyi nang rtags kyi rim pa rnams// skyes kyang dga' brod mi bya zhing*/ med kyang mi dga' skye mi bya/ zhes dang*/ gsang ba sgron me las/ rang gi nyams kyi bye brag rnams// tshad ma gsum la brten nas ni// ngo yis zin nas de dang 'phrod// ces dang*/ nyams sgron las/ rtags dang mtshan ma cir snang yang*// ngan rtog dga' brod rlom sems bdud// bzang ngan rtog dpyod mi bya'o// rang byung rang zhi nga smra'o// zhes dang*/ man ngag mtha' dag nas/ rim pa rim min du skye ba'i drod rtags thams cad byung rgyal du bskyang*/ zhes dang*/ kun mkhyen rin po ches/ nyams ban bun zang zing 'ur po 'di// rgyus med kyis bltas na skyon du mthong*// nyams med la dris na mgo bo 'khor// 'di bde stong rgyas pa'i myu gu yin// 'di la bcos par mi byed par// byung rgyal du skyong ba de kas chog

/ces gsungs pa ltar nges par bya dgos pa'o// drug pa zhi gnas dang nyams de skyong tshul bshad pa la/ zhi gnas skyong tshul dang*/ nyams skyong tshul rnam pa gnyis so// dang po zhi gnas skyong tshul ni/ ting nge 'dzin skyong ba'i thun re re bzhin du shes par bya ste/ de'ang ting nge 'dzin sgom pa la 'jug pa'i tshe/ sngon 'gro thun mong ba dal 'byor gyi mi lus rnyed par dka' ba/ rnyed kyang yun ring du mi gnas par 'chi dgos shing 'chi ba'i tshe dam pa'i chos ma gtogs gzhan gyis phan par mi nus par bsam nas 'jig rten 'dir snang la blo rbad rbad bcad/ gtan gyi don chen dam pa'i chos phyogs su blo hril hril dril nas/ spyir tshe 'dir sdig pa mi dge ba mi byed par dam pa'i chos gang 'grub cig byed bsam pa dang*/ khyad par ting nge 'dzin gyi yon tan dran pa'i sgo nas de la dad pa dang don gnyer gyi 'dun pa dang*/ le lo skad cig kyang mi byed par/ dus nyin mtshan bar med par lhur len la brtson 'grus byed snyam pa dang*/ bdag thog ma med pa'i 'khor ba nas da lta'i bar du sems kun tu rtog pa'i rlung gis bskyod de ci'ang rung ba 'ba' zhig yid la byed byed nas/ dge ba'i dmigs pa la sems rtse gcig tu se gol gtog pa'i yun tsam zhig kyang gnas par ma nus pas/ da dung 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho las rang ma brgal zhing*/ gzhan sgrol ba'i nus pa re ma thob pa re ma legs/ da ni bdag gis dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi gdams ngag la brten nas lus sems shin sbyangs kyi bde ba khyad par can bsgrubs te/ sems rtse gcig pa'i ting nge 'dzin la mnyam par bzhag nas rdzogs pa'i byang chub chen po thob par bgyi'o// zhes bsam zhing sngon 'gro'i thun khrid rgyas pa'am/ min kyang skyabs yul bsgoms te/ de'i spyan sngar rang dang sems can thams cad kyi lus ngag yid gsum gus pa'i sgo nas gsol 'debs skyabs 'gro byed par bsams nas/

ma nam ma 'don rjes smon lam dang*/ rjes bla ma'i rnal 'byor bsgoms te gsol 'debs dang*/ mthar bla ma 'od zhu byas nas rang la bstim ste/ sngar bshad ltar gyi ting nge 'dzin skyon med de nyid las yid gzhan du ma yengs shing*/ de la mi brjed pa'i dran pa shugs chen rgyun chags su brten dgos te/ de lta bu'i dran pa stobs chung na brjed nges skyes nas dmigs pa mi zin pa'i phyir ro// de nas dran pa de'i khongs nas bying rgod rtogs par byed pa'i shes bzhin grung po bskyed la des bying rgod kyi skyon byung ma byung gi bya ra thu re ba bya dgos te/ de lta bu'i dran shes bzhin mi gsal ba'am ma grung na ting nge 'dzin gyi gegs skyon ngos mi zin pa'i phyir ro// de nas bying rgod byung na de'i skyon sel tshul sngar bshad pa ltar yid 'du byed pa'i rtsol ba bskyed dgos te/ de 'dra'i rtsol ba chung na bying rgod kyi dbang du gyur nas ting nge 'dzin skyon med mi 'char ba'i phyir ro// de nas bying rgod kyi skyon zhi bar yid kyi 'du byed spangs te de nyid rnal du 'babs pa'i btang snyoms su 'jog dgos te/ de 'dra'i btang snyoms la ma brten na ting nge 'dzin de 'thor nas mnyam par bzhag tu mi btub pa'i phyir te// tshul 'di ni/ dbus mtha' las/ gnas dang de la gnas pa dang*// rgyu dang 'bras bu nyid du 'ong*// dmigs pa brjed par ma gyur dang*// bying dang rgod dang rtog pa dang*// de spongs mngon par 'du byed dang*// zhi tshe rnal du 'jug pa'o// zhes gsungs pa'i don to// 'ga' zhig thog mar ting nge 'dzin la dran 'dun sogs mi bskyed par rang gar rtsol 'jog byas pas dran pa shugs chung nas sems yengs cha shas che bar 'gyur/ shes bzhin mi gsal bas bying rgod kyi skyon ngos mi zin/ gal te zin kyang de rtog pa'o snyam du spang byar ngos bzung nas rig pa'i gsal ngar smad/

ting nge 'dzin skyon med ngos mi zin par nyams snang ci rigs la ting nge 'dzin tu rlom// skabs su ting nge 'dzin skyon med ci rigs shar yang de nyid rnal du mi 'bebs par slar yid kyi 'du byed du mas 'phro rgod bskyed pa rnams ni ting nge 'dzin sgrub tshul gyi thabs mi mkhas pa yin te// des na las dang po pas thog mar dran pa shugs can bskyed/ des blo rgod shas che ba la yid langs rkyen gyis rgod skyon 'byung bas/ de shes bzhin gyis ngos bzung nas skyon bsal bas na rgod pa rags pa zhi'ang 'phro rgod kyi rtog pa phra mo ban bun tsam 'char na/ de la khu 'phrig chen po mi bya bar zhe 'dod cung zad glod pas rtog pa phra mo de'ang rang zhir song ba'i tshe slar bying ba phra rags kyis sems kyi gsal ngar sgrib dogs pa'i bying ba zon byas nas cung zad tsam bsgrims pas/ ci zhig na bying rgod gnyis ka'i dbal chag nas ting nge 'dzin skyon med 'char ro// de'i rigs pas blo bying shas che ba la bying ba phra rags bsal la slar rgod zon byas la ting nge 'dzin bsgrub/ ting nge 'dzin skyon med du byung ba na slar yid kyi 'du byed mang ba'am/ rtsol ba che bas ting nge 'dzin rnal du mi phebs pa'i gegs chen por 'gyur bas ting nge 'dzin gyi ngang ma shor tsam gyi btang snyoms su 'jog pa yin la/ de'ang dran pa ni/ blo'i 'dun pa drag pos dran pa'i shugs bskyed de bzung ba na shugs yod pa'i tshe dmigs pa las sems yengs pa gtan nas mi 'byung zhing*/ cung zad yengs par rtsom pa ni/ dran pa'i shugs cung zad nyams pa dang*/ yengs pa ni dran pa shor ba yin pas/ dran pa snga ma'i shugs ma nyams shing ma shor tsam la slar yang dran pa'i stobs shugs bskyed par bya ste/ mdor na dran pa'i steng du dran pa bsnan pa lta bu dran shugs snga phyi'i bar mi chad par bya'o// shes bzhin ni dran pa shugs can gyi khongs nas 'byung ba yin te/

des bying rgod kyi skyon byung ma byung ce re blta ba'i tshul du bya ra tsam zhig byed la/ de las spros pa'i brtags dpyad gzhig 'brel sogs skabs 'dir mi rung ste/ sems rtse gcig pa'i gegs su 'gyur ba'i phyir ro// rtsol ba'am 'du byed ni/ bying rgod byung na de sel thabs byed pa la mngon par 'du byed pa tsam yin gyi/ bying rgod bsal zin nas de ltar mi rung ste/ yid kyi 'du byed bskyed pa dang*/ yid ni mi g.yo bar byed pa 'gal ba'i phyir te/ sgom rim phyi ma gnyis las kyang*/ gal te sems snyoms par zhugs pa la rtsol bar byas na/ de tshe rnam par g.yeng bar 'gyur ro// zhes bshad pa'i phyir ro/ btang snyoms ni/ bying rgod kyi skyon zhi nas grims lhod snyoms pa'i tshe de la yid rnal du phab la rtsol ba'am yid kyi 'du byed spangs nas ting nge 'dzin de nyid 'tsho skyong mkhas par byed pa ste/ sgom rim bar pa las/ gang gi bying ba dang rgod pa med par gyur te/ dmigs pa de la sems rnal du 'dug par mthong ba de'i tshe rtsol ba glod la btang snyoms su bya zhing*/ de'i tshe ji srid 'dod kyi bar 'dug par bya'o// zhes pa ltar ro// 'o na tshul de lta bu la yun ring thung ji ltar bya snyam na/ las dang po pa la thun ring na dran shes kyi shugs ngang ngam shugs kyis shor nas brjed nges skyes te yengs cha 'byung zhing*/ bying rgod kyi skyon yang myur du ngos mi zin par rnam g.yeng dang bying rgod kyi dbang du 'gyur bas thun chung ngu re yang yang sgom pa yin la/ cung zad goms nas dran shes skyong tshul la mkhas pas ting nge 'dzin skyon med rnal du phebs pa na thun cung zad ring yang skyon du mi 'gyur te/ mdor na lus sems la ting nge 'dzin gyi bar chad ma byung ba de srid du mnyam par 'jog cing*/ byung na bar chad kyi skyon bsal la bsgom par bya ba las thun tshad kyi nges pa ma bshad do// thun 'jog khar dran pa ma brjed pa nas dge ba bsngo ba dang smon lam gdab/

de nas kyang ma yengs dran pa'i ngos nas spyod lam rnam bzhi sogs thams cad la rang gi ngang ma brjed tsam gyi dran 'dun brten pa de'i rgyun rnam pa kun tu 'tsho skyong byed dgos pa'o// gnyis pa nyams kyi skyong tshul bshad pa ni/ de'ang sngon bshad bzhin nyams rtogs bzang ngan sna tshogs ci byung yang de la ched du bzang ngan du 'dzin pa mi byed par gang shar ngo bo 'dzin med du skyong ba yin/ don dam par 'phral du nyams snang legs nyes cung zad tsam ma gtogs phugs bzang ngan du ma grub ste/ rang sems kyi gshis gcig nyid de las bzang ngan du grub pa med/ 'phral bzang ngan 'dra bar snang ba ni/ nang gi rtsa rlung gi rten 'brel tsam yin par shes dgos/ de ltar don du bzang ngan gyi nyams gnyis su ma grub pa 'phral snang tsam du shes par byas nas/ sems nyams bde ba gsal ba dwangs pa/ bzang bzang yin yin legs legs 'dra ba tshor yang ched du bzang por bzung nas/ de la dga' tshor rlom sems 'dzin pa nga rgyal sogs mi byed par rang ngor mnyam par 'jog dgos la/ de ma byas 'dzin zhen rlom sems sogs zhugs na/ de lam du mi 'gro lam las gol ba yin/ dga' tshor rlom pa zhen 'dzin nga rgyal sogs ma byas par gang shar ngo shes dang bcas pas de ka sgrib med rkyang par bskyangs na lam du 'gro/ rtogs pa gong ma skye ba'i lam stegs lta bu yin pas de ltar shes par byed/ yang rmugs pa bying ba sogs dang*/ mthong snang 'jig skrag mi dge ba 'dra ba byung na de la ched du ngan par bzung nas de la spong sems sdug bsngal mi dga' ba sogs byas na/ de lam gyi bar chad du 'gro/ skyon blta dang sdug bsngal mi dga' bar ma byas gang snang gang shar de ka'i ngo bo dran pas bzung la de kar sgom gyi dngos gzhi bcol la bskyangs na des mi gnod pa'i thog lam du 'gro bas legs pa yin te/ khrid yig gzhan rnams su/ so so'i gegs sel thabs dmigs pa rlung 'khrul 'khor/

rdzas sngags dang*/ tha ma'ang spyod lam dang zas kyi rnam dbye sogs mang du gsungs te/ de rnams byed dgos ma byung na 'di ga bzhin legs/ rang gis shes shing zhe bcad brtson 'grus che na 'dis chog gzhan mi dgos/ mi le lo can the tshom che ba la 'dis mi chog gzhan rten 'brel sna tshogs pa los dgos yin pa de bzhin no// lar 'khor 'das gnyis kyi rtsa ba gnyis 'dzin 'dis byed 'dug pas/ 'dir yang nyams bzang ngan gyi gegs dang gol shor e yong mi yong thams cad kyang gnyis 'dzin 'di kar rag 'dug pas 'di rtsa ba nas gcod pa gal che la 'di'i don ma shes rtsa ba ma chod de 'phral bzang ngan la dgos dgos byed byed mang po dgos pa byung na ni/ de ni dper na chu mgo'i phug nas ma chod pa'i 'og nas e chod lta ba dang 'dra bas nam yang zin pa mi yong*/ phung rgan gnyis su 'dzin pa 'di'i rtsa ba chod na de ni chu mgo'i phug nas chod pa dang 'dra bas des chog /gang shar cir snang yang lhod de sdod chog pa yin te/ rje zla 'od gzhon nus/ gnyis 'dzin dri mas skad cig ma sbags na// gang gang de nyid chos sku gyed long yin// zhes sogs gsungs/ don de 'dra bar sems dgos/ des na bzang ngan legs nyes ci byung gang shar la gnyis 'dzin gyi dgag bsgrub med pa'i rang sems ngo bo gnyis med ngang du thag bcad nas gang shar rang ngo sgrib med bzo med ngos nas shes bzhin du bskyangs na des chog par mchis so// bzhi pa zhi gnas dang nyams kyi yon tan 'bras bu bshad pa ni/ zhi gnas la gnod pa'i phyi nang gi 'du 'dzi thams cad spangs pa ni sbyin pa/ lus shing bal gyi 'dab ma ltar yang zhing g.yo 'gul med pa dang sems dmigs pa la lhun grub tu 'jug pa la dga' ba ni lus dang sems shin tu sbyangs pa ste tshul khrims/ ting nge 'dzin la rgod 'gyod sogs kyi sgrib pa med par 'jog pa ni bzod pa/ ting nge 'dzin la rkyen ngan pas nyams par bya mi nus pa de ni brtson 'grus/

ting nge 'dzin gyi gsal snang de la rnam rtog rgyu ba med pa ni bsam gtan/ zhi gnas kyi gsal snang phyogs med du shar bas gzhan gyi bsam pa thams cad rtogs nus pa ni shes rab ste// de ltar yang*/ bskal pa bzang po las/ de la zhi gnas la dmigs pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa drug gang zhen/ gnod par byed pa'i chos rnams spangs pa gang yin pa de ni sbyin pa'o// lus dang sems shin tu sbyangs pa la dga' ba gang yin pa de ni tshul khrims so// sgrib pa med pa la snyoms par 'jug pa gang yin pa de ni bzod pa'o// ting nge 'dzin la gzhan gyis nyams par byar med pa gang yin pa de ni brtson 'grus kyi'o// ye shes kyi sbyor ba ma gud pa gang yin pa de ni bsam gtan gyi'o// bsam pa thams cad rtogs pa gang yin pa de ni shes rab kyi ste/ de dag ni zhi gnas la brten pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa drug go /zhes gsungs so// gzhan yang gcer sgom pas/ zhi gnas kyi bde gsal mi rtog pa'i sgom la zhen chags med pa ni sbyin pa/ sgrib pa lnga dang bral ba ni tshul khrims/ gzhan rkyen gyis mi gnod pa ni bzod pa/ sems rtse gcig pa'i nges shes kyis sgom pa la 'jug pa ni brtson 'grus/ lus ngag yid gsum lham me lhan ne lhang nger g.yo ba med pa ni bsam gtan/ zhi gnas kyi mi mthun phyogs sel ba dang mthun phyogs sgrub pa la mkhas pa ni shes rab bo// zhes gsungs/ gzhan yang*/ tshe 'dir 'dod yon la zhen pa ldog cing*/ mngon shes dang ting nge 'dzin mtha' dag 'char ba dang*/ phyi ma 'dod chags dang bral ba'i lha'i lus thob par bshad de/ sdud pa las/ bsam gtan gyis ni 'dod pa'i yon tan smad pa 'dor/ rigs dang mngon par shes dang ting 'dzin mngon par 'grub/ ces dang*/ bshes spring las/ 'dod spyod dga' dang bde dang sdug bsngal dag /rnam par spangs pa'i bsam gtan bzhi po yis/ tshangs dang 'od gsal dag dang dge rgyas dang*// 'bras bu che lha rnams dang skal mnyam thob// ces dang*/

byang chub lam sgron las/ rnal 'byor zhi gnas grub gyur na// mngon shes dag kyang 'grub par 'gyur// zhes so/ nyams kyi yon tan 'bras bu ni/ o rgyan rin po ches/ chos nyid goms pa'i rtags su 'khrul pa med par kun la byams pa/ zas nor chog shes shing chags pa chung ba/ snying rje che ba/ chos la phyogs ris med pa/ gdams ngag la nan tur byed pa'o/ zhes gsungs pas/ nang du ting nge 'dzin bzang po yod pa'i rtags su 'jig rten 'dir snang la mi dga' la/ chos brgyad mi 'byung ba dang*/ nyon mongs pa rnams shas chung*/ dad pa mos gus snying rje brtson 'grus rnams che zhing*/ lus la zas gos cher mi dgos srin 'bu nyung ba la sogs 'ong ba'o/ gzhan yang lung las/ drod ni bzod pa phra thob dang*// lus yang bde ba 'byung ba dang*// dbugs kyi rgyu ba mi tshor dang*// sems nyid rnal du phebs pa yis// gsal la yul med mi rtog gnas/ 'khor ba'i chos la skyo ba dang*// rang gi gnas la mi chags shing*// thag ring gzhan du 'gro bar 'dod// ngar 'dzin phyogs cha re dogs dang*// nyon mongs chags sdang zhen pa chung*// tha snyad brjed nges kun brtags chung*// don dam sgrub la ya mtshan cing*// byams dang snying rje phan sems ldan// chos brgyad chung zhing don la brtson// zhes dang*/ gsang ba sgron me las/ drod ni rnam pa gsum yin te// phyi rtags lus ni yod mi tshor// nang rtags dbugs ni rgyu mi tshor// gsang rtags dngos po'i zhen pa chung*// zhes dang*/ chos nyid goms pa'i rtags ni 'di ltar lags/ gang la zhen pa med cing chags pa chung*// rtags mtshan de yod gzhan gyi khar ma lus// zhes sogs gsungs pa'o// ༈ //gnyis pa spros bral gyi rnal 'byor bshad pa la/ dang po lhag mthong gi rtsa ba sems la dmigs shing dpyad nas bsgom dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan bshad pa/ gnyis pa lhag mthong sgom tshul gang las gsungs pa ngos bzung bshad pa/

gsum pa zhi gnas lhag mthong gi rnam dbye bshad pa/ bzhi pa lhag mthong gi sbyor bar brten pa bshad pa/ lnga pa lhag mthong dngos gzhi sgom tshul bshad pa/ drug pa lhag mthong skyes ma skyes kyi tshad bshad pa/ bdun pa lhag mthong mthong tshul gzhan dang sbyar ba bshad pa/ brgyad pa zhi lhag zung 'jug gi tshul bshad pa/ dgu pa lhag mthong gi rang 'bras bshad pa'o// dang po lhag mthong gi rtsa ba sems la dmigs shing dpyad nas bsgom dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan ni/ de'ang bshad ma thag pa'i zhi gnas kyi nyams shar ba der lhag mthong gi rig cha med na lam du mi 'gro bas chog shes mi bya bar thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa don du gnyer bas/ bdag med pa'i rnam pa can gyi lhag mthong nges par bsgom dgos te/ de ma bsgoms na zhi gnas kyis re zhig nyon mongs pa mgo non pa tsam las/ bag la nyal mi choms pas/ srid pa las grol bar mi nus pa'i phyir te/ sgom rim bar pa las/ zhi gnas tsam zhig goms par byas pas ni/ rnal 'byor pa rnams kyi sgrib pa ni mi spong gyi/ re zhig nyon mongs rnam par gnon pa tsam du zad de/ shes rab kyi snang ba med pas bag nyal legs par chom par mi 'gyur ro// zhes dang*/ rje btsun gyis/ sems rdzing chu bzhin du bskyil ba des// rtog pa'i 'phro 'du bkag pa tsam// 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho des mi sgrol// zhes gsungs/ de lta bas na zhi lhag gnyis ka zung du 'jug pa zhig dgos par bzhed de/ dgongs pa nges 'grel las/ bsam gtan gyis ni nyon mongs pa rnam par gnon to// zhes zhi gnas dang*/ shes rab kyis ni bag la nyal legs par 'joms par byed do// zhes lhag mthong gsungs shing*/ yang*/ sgom rim bar pa las/ de lta bas na sgrib pa thams cad spangs nas yongs su dag pa'i ye shes 'byung bar 'dod pas zhi gnas la gnas nas shes rab bsgom par bya'o// zhes gsungs pa dang*/ rje btsun gyis/ zhi gnas kyi rdzing la mi zhen par/

lhag mthong gi me tog 'khrungs par shog /ces lhag mthong gtso che gsungs pa de bzhin dang*/ sems la dmigs pa bskyed nas bsgom dgos pa'i tshul ni/ lta spyod kun rig las/ tshig gi rtsa ba ma gcod don gyi rtsa ba chod// don gyi rtsa ba chod na tshig mtha' de ru chod// chos kyi rtsa ba ma gcod sems kyi rtsa ba chod// sems kyi rtsa ba chod na chos kyi bdag po yin// zhes gsungs/ yang sems kyis sems la brtags pas don rtogs yong ba'i tshul dpe dang bcas pa ni/ rnal 'byor dbang phyug til+li pas/ dper na nam mkha'i dkyil du brtags byas na// mtha' dang dbus su 'dzin pa 'gag par 'gyur// de bzhin sems kyis sems la brtags byas na// rnam rtog tshogs 'gags sems kyi rang bzhin mthong*// zhes gsungs pa dang*/ saṃ bu ṭi las/ sdug bsngal ma lus bcings las grol 'dod cing*// rdzogs sangs rgyas kyi bde ba 'dod pa gang*// sems la rang bzhin yod dang med pa dag /brtan por byas nas 'bad de dpyad par bya// zhes dang*/ rnam snang mngon byang gi rgyud las/ bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad la/ byang chub sems dpa' phyag na rdo rjes 'di skad ces gsol to// bcom ldan 'das byang chub dang rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid ni gang las btsal bar bya/ gang gis mngon par byang chub pa lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ gsang ba'i bdag po rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa dang byang chub ni rang gi sems las btsal bar bya'o// zhes gsungs so// 'od srungs kyis zhus pa las// shing gnyis drud pa las ni me 'byung ste// byung ba de yis de gnyis bsregs pa ltar// de bzhin shes rab dbang po skyes nas kyang*// skyes pa de yis de gnyis sreg par byed// ces dang por so sor rtog pa'i shes rab kyis dpyad pas mthar rtog pa de nyid kyang zhi bas rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes 'char ba sogs kyis lhag mthong bsgom dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan mang du gsungs pa'o// gnyis pa lhag mthong sgom tshul gang las gsungs pa ngos bzung ba bshad pa ni/

de 'dra lhag mthong gi dmigs pa la sgrub brgyud pa rnams sems 'tshol/ zhes gsungs/ de'ang sems glo bur 'khrul pa kun rdzob rtsad bdar legs par bcad nas don dam gnas lugs 'khrul med 'tshol ba ste/ de ltar gyi tshul 'di nyid gang las gsungs zhe na/ sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i le'u las/ mkhas pa de ni sems kyi chos nyid tshol// de ni sems kyi chos nyid 'tshol ba na// sems dang sems kyi chos nyid mthong ba med// sems de sems gang gis ni 'tshol byed pa// sems de yang ni rang bzhin mthong ba med// ces 'tshol ba'i 'bras bu dang bcas gsungs shing*/ gtsug na rin chen gyi zhus pa'i mdo las/ des sems kun tu 'tshol ba na/ sems de nang na yang dag par rjes su mi mthong*/ sems de phyi rol na yang dag par rjes su mi mthong*/ sems de phyi nang na yang dag par rjes su mi mthong*/ phung po rnams las yang dag par rjes su mi mthong*/ khams rnams las yang dag par rjes su mi mthong*// skye mched rnams las yang dag par rjes su mi mthong*/ des sems yang dag par rjes su mi mthong bas sems gang las byung zhes sems kyi rgyud kun tu 'tshol zhing de 'di snyam du sems te/ dmigs pa yod pa las sems byung ngo snyam mo/ de'ang 'di snyam du sems te/ dmigs pa de gzhan la sems de gzhan nam/ 'on te dmigs pa gang yin pa nyid sems yin/ gal te dmigs pa'ang gzhan la sems kyang gzhan na ni sems de gnyis su 'gyur ro// 'on te dmigs pa gang yin pa de nyid sems yin na ni/ sems kyis sems nyid ji ltar mthong bar 'gyur te/ sems kyis ni sems mthong bar mi 'gyur ro// zhes dang*/ mdo sde dkon mchog brtsegs pa las/ de ltar sems yongs su 'tshol te/ 'dod chags par gyur pa'am/ zhe sdang bar gyur pa'am/ gti mug par gyur pa'i sems gang yin/ ci 'das pa'am ma 'ongs pa'am da ltar byung ba zhig yin nam/ de la sems 'das pa gang yin pa ni zad pa'o// ma 'ongs pa gang yin pa ni ma skyes pa'o// da ltar byung ba ni gnas pa med do snyam mo// 'od srung sems ni nang na'ang med/

phyi rol na'ang med/ gnyis ka med pa'ang mi dmigs so/ 'od srung sems ni bcad du med pa/ bstan du med pa/ rten ma yin pa/ snang ba med pa/ rnam par rig pa med pa/ gnas med pa'o// zhes pa nas/ 'od srung sems 'di kun tu btsal na mi rnyed do// gang mi rnyed pa ni mi dmigs pa'o// gang mi dmigs pa ni 'das pa ma yin/ ma 'ongs pa ma yin/ da ltar byung ba ma yin no// gang 'das pa ma yin ma 'ongs pa ma yin/ da ltar byung ba ma yin pa ni dus gsum las yang dag par 'das pa'o// gang dus gsum las yang dag par 'das pa ni yod pa ma yin/ med pa ma yin/ zhes dang*// chos kyi dbyings dbyer med pa bstan pa'i mdo las/ sems 'di sngon po'am/ ser po'am/ dmar po'am/ dkar po'am/ btsod kha'am/ shel gyi kha dog lta bu'am/ yang dag pa'am/ yang dag pa ma yin pa'am/ rtag ces bya ba'am/ mi rtag ces bya ba'am/ gzugs can nam/ gzugs can ma yin pa zhig ces so sor rtogs shig /ces dang*/ dpal rnam par snang mdzad mngon par byang chub pa las/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ gsang ba'i bdag po ji ltar rang gi sems yongs su shes par bya zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ rnam par ram/ kha dog tu'am/ dbyibs su'am/ yul du'am/ gzugs su'am/ tshor bar ram/ 'du shes su'am/ 'du byed du'am/ rnam par shes par ram/ bdag tu'am/ bdag gir ram/ gzung bar ram/ 'dzin par ram/ yang dag par ram/ ma dag par ram/ khams su'am/ skye mched du'am/ rnam pa thams cad kyi bar du yongs su btsal kyang mi dmigs pa yin te/ zhes sogs mdo rgyud rnams nas sems btsal dgos brtag dgos pa'i tshul mang du gsungs so// lhag mthong ngos bzung ba ni/ khrid yig 'ga' rer lam dus kyi lhag mthong du ngos bzung ste/ de ni cung mi legs pa 'dra bas/ 'dir rtogs pa'i lhag mthong ngam 'bras bu'i lhag mthong ngos 'dzin bya ba las/ de'i lhag mthong ngo bo ni/ gshis 'gyur med bde chen mdangs skye 'gags gnas bral kun kyang zung 'jug khyab gdal klong yangs chen por gcig yin te/

de'ang rje dwags po rin po ches/ sems nyid lhan cig skyes pa chos kyi sku// snang ba lhan cig skyes pa chos sku'i 'od// de phyir snang sems gnyis med lhan cig skyes// zhes gsungs pa 'dir snang sems dbyer med ces ro gcig gi skad cha 'dra zhig yod kyang skyon med de/ 'di rang du/ dwags po sgom pa tshul khrims snying pos/ sngon gyi tshig la cung zad bsgyur nas spros bral gyi ngo bo'i skad char mdzad pa 'di legs te/ de ni 'di lta ste/ sems nyid lhan cig skyes pa chos kyi sku// rnam rtog lhan cig skyes pa chos sku'i rlabs// de phyir gshis mdangs dbyer med lhan cig skyes// zhes gsungs pas/ de gnyis kyi don mnyam du bshad na/ sems kyi gshis skye med ngos bzung bral ba'i 'od gsal chos kyi sku las/ 'gag med kyi rang rtsal rnam rtog snang ba sna tshogs su 'char ba 'di gnyis dper na nyi ma dang nyi ma'i 'od zer ram chu dang chu rlabs lta bur 'bral mi shes pas na/ de'i ming du snang sems dbyer med lhan cig skyes pa'am gshis mdangs dbyer med lhan cig skyes pa zhes bya ba yin te/ de ltar yang bde mchog sdom 'byung las/ shes rab snying rje'i dbye ba ni// sgron me dang ni 'od gsal bzhin// zhes dang*/ slob dpon yan lag med pa'i rdo rjes/ skye med nyid phyir rang bzhin med// 'gag pa med pa'i rten 'byung ba// yod dang med pa nyams 'di las// zung 'jug nyid du skye bar 'gyur/ zhes so// don rang ni/ da lta'i tha mal gyi shes pa blos byas kyis ma bslad pa 'di ka yin/ 'di nyid min pa'i 'di'i steng du chos sku zer ba'i bzang po zhig gzhan nas 'tshol rgyu bsgrub rgyu med cing*/ 'khrul pa'i rnam rtog ces ngan pa zhig gzhan du bsal rgyu dgag rgyu med pa yin te/ dpal dus kyi 'khor lo las// de phyir ka ye bsal bya ni// cang med gzhag bya ci yang med// dag pa de nyid 'gyur med che// zhes dang*/

byams pa mgon pos/ 'di la bsal bya ci yang med// bzhag par bya ba cung zad med// yang dag nyid la yang dag lta// yang dag mthong na rnam par grol// zhes dang*/ rgyud las/ gang gis 'ching bar byed pa'i rgyu// de ni grol bar byed pa'i lam// 'di na 'ching ba gang yang med// 'ching ba gang yin de grol ba// zhes dang*/ rje pad dkar zhabs kyis/ ma dor ma bsnan rnam rtog 'di ka rang*// yang dag mthong na grol ba yin zhes pa// byams pa'i chos sde kun la gtam ltar grags// zhes gsungs/ bzang ngan gang gis kyang ma bslad pa'i rang rig ye shes 'di nyid slar yang bzo bcos mi byed/ byas kyang byed du med pa'i phyir gnyug ma'am rnal ma lhan cig skyes pa zhes bya ste/ sa ra has/ rang bzhin dag pa'i sems la bsam gtan dag gis mi bslad de/ zhes dang*/ bsam gtan bral bar ci zhig bsam byar yod// brjod du med gang ji ltar bshad du yod// zhes dang*/ rgyud med sngags med bsam bya bsam gtan med// de kun rang rig 'khrul par byed pa'i rgyu// zhes sogs mang du gsungs so// 'di ltar rtogs pa'i lhag mthong gsha' ma 'di rtogs phyin chad gzhan gyi bya rtsol mi dgos pa zhig 'ong bar 'dug pa'o// gsum pa zhi gnas dang lhag mthong gi rnam par dbye ba bshad pa ni/ spyir lhag mthong la mang du yod pa'i zhi rags kyi rnam pa can 'jig rten pa'i lhag mthong dang*/ bden bzhi'i rnam pa can theg dman pa'i lhag mthong ni grub pa phun sum tshogs kyang med du mi rung gi yan lag min la/ bdag med kyi don sgom pa'i lhag mthong ni 'dir bsgrub bya'i lhag mthong yin te/ de la brten nas gzung 'dzin gyis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad kyi gnas tshul gtan la 'bebs dgos pa'i phyir ro// de lta bu'i lhag mthong skye tshul la'ang*/ rgyas par mdo dgongs 'grel dang mngon pa kun btus las gsungs pa'i lhag mthong bzhi dang*/ 'bring po dgongs 'grel nas gsungs pa'i lhag mthong gsum dang*/

de dag gi don bsdus pa bdag med gnyis sgom pa'i lhag mthong sogs rnam dbye mang yang bshad kyis mi langs la/ 'dir lhag mthong gi ngo bo'i dbye ba'am zhi lhag gi dbye ba bshad na/ spyir lhag mthong zer ba 'di phal cher gyis rtse gcig gi skabs dma' dma' 'dra zhig tu bsam kyang de ni dbye ba ma phyed pa yin te/ lhag mthong la dbye ba shin tu mang yang don la gsum du 'du/ lhag mthong la dmigs pa'i lhag mthong dang*/ nyams dus kyi lhag mthong dang*/ rtogs pa'i lhag mthong zhes sam/ yang na gnyis te/ lam gyi lhag mthong dang 'bras bu'i lhag mthong zhes te gnyis yin/ de'ang lam gyi lhag mthong ni zhi gnas kyi dus gsal dwangs so sor rtog pa'i shes rab kyis dpyad pa de yin no// 'bras bu'i lhag mthong ni/ blta bya lta byed gnyis med du la bzla ba'i don ji bzhin rtogs pa de yin par 'dug /de'ang 'dir zhi lhag gi dbye bar sems rang lugs gsha' mar gnas pa zhi gnas dang*/ de nyid rig cha dang bcas pa ni lhag mthong ste/ dkon mchog sprin gyi mdo las/ zhi gnas ni sems rtse gcig pa'o// lhag mthong ni yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin du chos nyid so sor rtogs pa'o// zhes dang*/ ljon pas zhus pa'i mdo las/ zhi gnas ni rtse gcig pa'o// lhag mthong ni rig pa'o// zhes dang*/ gzhan yang*/ rdzogs pa chen po pad+ma lam rim du/ de ltar sems rang lugs su bzhag pas/ rnam rtog phra rags thams cad rang sar nyal zhi nas sems rang sar lhan ne gnas pa zhig 'ong ste de ka la zhi gnas zer/ de'i mdangs ma 'gags pa yul med rang gsal du rjen lhang nge ba zhig 'ong ste/ de ka la lhag mthong zer/ zhes gsungs/ yang byang chub sems kyi sde snod kyi mdo las/ byang chub sems dpa'i zhi gnas ni yang dag pa'i bsam gtan te/ zhi ba'i 'du shes la'ang mi gnas pa'o// lhag mthong gi lta bas mthong*/ de blta ba'ang mi mthong*/ gang gis de ltar mthong ba'o// des yang dag pa nyid mthong ngo*// zhes zhi gnas spyi dang lhag mthong lta ba'i ngo bo bcas gsungs shing*/

shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i mdo las kyang*/ de la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i zhi gnas dang lhag mthong gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi ye shes te/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i zhi gnas dang lhag mthong ngo*// zhes 'bras bu zhi lhag gsungs shing*/ de bzhin mdo rgyud dang bstan bcos gyi lung mang du yod pa'o// bzhi pa lhag mthong gi sbyor ba bsten pa bshad pa ni/ dgongs 'grel du thos bsam gyi lta ba rnam dag lhag mthong gi rgyur gsungs shing*/ sgom rim bar par/ skyes bu dam pa la bsten pa dang*/ mang du thos pa btsal ba dang*/ tshul bzhin du sems pa gsum lhag mthong skye ba'i rgyur gsungs pa las/ skyes bu dam pa ni skabs 'dir zhi lhag gi rtogs pa dang ldan pa'i bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen la bya ste/ rtogs pa dang mi ldan na drang don gyi tha snyad la mkhas kyang don mi 'grub pas so// mang du thos pa btsal ba'ang nges don dri ma med pa'i gsung rab las 'tshol te/ tha snyad dang drang don gyi chos thos kyang nges pa'i don mi rtogs pas so// tshul bzhin sems pa'ang grub thob nas brgyud pa'i gdams pa nyams su len dgos te/ don dam ni rtog ge'i blos brtag cing dpyod pa'i yul min pas so// gzhan yang sngar bshad pa'i bying rgod kyi skyon bsal dgos shing*/ khyad par sgrub brgyud 'dir ni bla ma'i byin rlabs la brten nas lta ba rtogs dgos par bzhed pas/ dang po bla ma la gsol ba drag tu 'debs pa gnad du che ste/ de'ang 'dir lhag mthong gsha' ma'i rtogs pa e 'char mi 'char byin rlabs la rag /rang gi mos gus chen po'i mthus bla ma'i byin rlabs ma zhugs na sems la dpyad pa mi dgos pas cig car du sems dang rnam rtog ngo bo yin bzhin ngo 'phrod pa yong ba yin/ 'on kyang 'dir 'phral rtogs sla phyir dpyad par gsungs 'dug pa de ltar dang*/

mos gus chen po rang med pas bla ma'i byin rlabs ma zhugs na ni/ lhag mthong rgyu'i dpyad pa ni/ lo brgyar byas kyang phan pa med/ dpyad dpyad bsam blo thams cad kha phyir bltas su 'gro ba yin/ des na mos gus gal che ste/ kye rdor las/ gzhan gyis brjod min lhan cig skyes// zhes dang*/ 'di ni byin rlabs rim pa'i phyir// kun mkhyen ye shes de lta bu// zhes sogs mang*/ rje rgod tshang pas/ gsang sngags kyi lam nas tshe gcig lus gcig la sangs rgyas zer ba mang ste/ gzhan gyis khas mi lon/ mos gus kyis khas lon pa yin/ zhes gsungs/ rgyal dbang rjes/ sgom sran gyis grol ba the tshom za// mos gus kyis grol ba the tshom med// de gnad ka yod med kyi khyad par yin// zhes dang*/ rje 'brug pas/ dpal bsam gyis mi khyab gnyug ma'i don// rang rig gis gtan la ma phab na// gzhan rkyen gyis rtogs par mi nus pas// nges don gyi bla ma nang du tshol// zhes gsungs/ 'di rang gi brtson 'grus gal che gsungs pa 'dra zhig yod kyang don/ nges don gyi bla ma nang du tshol/ zhes mos gus chen pos bla ma rang sems gnyis med kyi nyams len bstan pa yin no// rje lha rtse ba chen pos/ nyams len mos gus su go nas gcig shes kun grol de lon song*// zhes sogs gsungs so// de ltar mos gus gal che ba/ des na 'dir thun grangs med par rnam pa kun tu sems gshis zhi gnas dang*/ mdangs mos gus dang ma bral bar ngag gsol 'debs dang ma bral ba/ lus mnyam bzhag dang ma bral bar byed dgos par 'dug /ci ltar dpyad pa'i tshul de'ang dper na bsam blo gtong ba lta bu zhig byas na don med pa kha phyir bltas yin/ paṇ+ḍi ta'i dpyad sgom 'dra ba zhig 'ong*/ de ltar ma yin pa'i ku su lu'i 'jog sgom zhes sems mnyam bzhag ngo bo dang ma bral ba'i ngos nas rang mdangs de rang la rang gis dpyad pa zhig yin/ 'dir rnam par rtog pa'i zhi gnas so sor rtogs pa'i shes rab tu langs pa la zer te/

bram ze chen pos/ kyai ma rang gis rang la de nyid mtshon te ltos// ma yengs sems kyis lta dang bral gyur na// yengs pa'i sems kyis de nyid mthong ba med// ces dang*/ sgom rim du/ 'di ltar gang gi tshe zhi gnas kyi dmigs pa la sems brtan par byas pa de'i tshe shes rab kyis rab tu brtag na yang dag pa'i ye shes kyi snang ba 'byung ste/ zhes sogs gsungs pa'o/ ༈ /lnga pa lhag mthong dngos gzhi bsgom tshul bshad pa la'ang*/ spyir dpyad pa dang*/ khyad par du dpyad pa'i tshul gnyis so// dang po spyir dpyad pa la'ang dang po ngo bo'i gshis la dpyad pa bshad pa/ gnyis pa rang mdangs kyi rnam rtog la dpyad pa bshad pa/ gsum pa gshis mdangs thun mong du dpyad pa bshad pa/ bzhi pa phyi snang ba'i yul la dpyad pa bshad pa'o// dang po ngo bo gshis la dpyad pa la'ang gsum las/ dang po rang sems ngo bo ngos bzung la dpyad pa ni/ lus gnad sngar ltar legs par bcas/ lta stangs ni mig 'bras rang gi thad kar mi 'dzum pa'i tshul du lta ste/ bram ze chen pos/ mig ni mi 'dzum bsgom du med pa'i rnal 'byor dang*// zhes dang*/ gzhan du'ang*/ mig ma btsum pa'i rnal 'byor pa// rnal 'byor kun las khyad par 'phags// zhes dang*// mu stegs tshangs pa gyen du lta// nyan thos zhi ba thur du lta// rdo rje'i spyan ni thad kar blta// zhes bshad do// de nas bla ma la gsol ba btab/ dngos grub zhu byin rlabs blang*/ rang la bstim/ bla ma'i thugs dang rang sems dbyer med kyi klong du bzhag /de'i ngo bo bltas nas/ de nas sems de'i ngo bo la ngos bzung nas yod med dang de'i rnam 'gyur ji ltar snang sogs dpyad/ ngos bzung rgyu 'dra yod par go na der ngos gzung bya 'dzin byed ci 'dra 'dug brtag /rnam pa gsal ba 'dra zhig tu go na de'i gsal ba'i gsal lugs ngos bzung*// de'i rnam pa 'ja' 'od dang nyi zla dang mar me'i 'od lta bur 'dug gam sogs legs par brtag

/'od mdangs med pa 'dra na rang gsal du 'dug gam brtag /de nas gang yang med pa'i stong pa zhig tu go na de stong pa cang med kyi stong pa zhig red dam brtag /cang med stong par go na snang ba rnam rtog 'char zhing gang yang dran shes pa 'di ci las byung legs par brtag /de rig stong zhig tu thag chod nas de kar bzhag /gnyis pa kha dog dang dbyibs la brtag pa ni/ de nas sems de la kha dog dang dbyibs 'dug gam mi 'dug brtag /kha dog dang dbyibs yod pa 'dra zhig tu mthong na/ kha dog la dkar po dmar po sogs ci 'dra 'dug legs par brtag /dbyibs la zlum po dang zur gsum ril bu la sogs pa dang*// mi dang dud 'gro la sogs pa'i gzugs 'dra ba dang sa rdo ri brag 'dra ba ci 'dra 'dug brtag /de'ang yod pa 'dra zhig byung na de la blta rgyu rig rgyu ston rgyu ji ltar 'dug legs par brtag /de kha dog dbyibs sogs med pa'i gsal stong zhig tu thag chod na de kar bzhag go /gsum pa brten sa dang gnas sar dpyad pa ni/ sems de brten sa dang gnas sa phyi nang bar gsum gang du 'dug gam mi 'dug brtag /de yang nang lus su gnas nas 'dug pa 'dra zhig byung na/ de nang gi lus kyi mgo mjug bar gsum yan lag khog pa don lnga snod drug gi cha shas re rer gnas sam lus spyi khyab tu gnas brtag /spyi khyab tu gnas na phyi nang gi tshul du'am/ 'dres pa'i tshul du 'dug gam brtag /'dres pa 'dra na phyi'i gzugs sogs yul rnams la 'phros pa'i tshe ji ltar song sogs brtag /gang la'ang rten gzhi dang gnas sa med pa'i rang rig rang gsal du thag chod na de kar bzhag /'di skabs ngo 'phrod dam mi 'phrod byin rlabs la rag pas/ dpyad dpyad brtags brtags mang po las kyang mos gus gsol 'debs la 'bad/ de ltar byas pas sngar gyi sems gnas pa dang gsal nyams yod na'ang don la 'phrig ma tshud pa de 'dra min pa'i don sems ngos bzung*/

kha dog dbyibs dang rten gnas sogs med cing stong pa/ stong pa'ang rig cha dang bcas pa'i stong pa nyid 'od la sogs med pa'i nam mkhar bltas pas mthong ba 'gags pa dang 'dra ba kho rang gi ngo bo rang rig rang gsal du yod pa thag chod cing nyams su myong dgos te/ til+li pas/ dper na nam mkha'i rang bzhin kha dog dbyibs las 'das// dkar nag dag gis ma gos 'gyur ba med// de bzhin rang sems snying po kha dog dbyibs las 'das// dge sdig dkar nag chos kyis gos mi 'gyur// zhes dang*/ dper na nam mkhar mthong ba tha snyad rab brtags kyang*// nam mkha' la ni 'di 'dra brjod du med// de bzhin rang sems 'od gsal brjod gyur kyang*// 'di 'dra grub ces tha snyad gdags gzhi med// sems kyi rang bzhin gdod nas nam mkha' 'dra// chos rnams ma lus de ru ma 'dus med// ces dang*/ nyi ma'i rtsal gyis/ sna tshogs sems kyi cho 'phrul te// sems de 'di zhes mtshon du med// de phyir 'khor 'das rtsa ba bral// de nyid chos skur shes par gyis// zhes dang*/ rgod tshang pas/ rang gi sems la cer gyis ltos// bltas pas mi mthong dngos po med// ces gsungs so// de'ang ma yengs pa'i dran pa yod pa'i tshe na rang gsal ngo bo 'gyur med dang*/ dran rig med tshe tha mal du 'gro/ des na rang sems ngos gzung bya 'dzin byed med bzhin du rang gis rang rig pa'i dran pa de tsho ma shor bar rgyun skyong dgos so// gnyis pa rang mdangs gyi rnam rtog 'gyu dran la dpyad pa bshad par gsum las/ dang po gang nas skyes dpyad pa ni/ bla ma la gsol ba 'debs te lus gnad dang sems gnas pa'i ngo bor 'jog pa gong dang 'dra// de nas rnam rtog byung ba'am zhi gnas tshan ches pas rnam rtog ma byung yang ma yengs pa'i ngang nas ched du gcig spros/ de'ang de rang ngo la bltas nas/ thog mar rtog pa de rgyu ci las skyes brtags pas sems nyid las skyes snyam na ma las bu skyes pa ltar so sor tshugs thub pa byung ngam brtag

/tshugs thub med pa 'dra na nyi zla las 'od 'phros pa ltar/ rang rtsal las shar ram sems nyid de ka rnam rtog der song ngam sogs legs par brtag /rgyu 'di las skyes dang rkyen 'dis byas dang bzo bo dang mkhan po 'dis bcos sogs med pas rgyu rkyen las ma skyes pa gzhi med rtsa bral ye nas skye med du thag chod na de kar bzhag go /gnyis pa bar du gang gnas dpyad pa ni/ rnam rtog gang shar de phyi nang bar gsum dbang po sgo lnga sogs gang du rgyun chags sam gnas skabs su brten pa'i gnas yul 'dug gam brtag /brten gnas med pa 'dra na de nyid kun slong drag pos bden 'dzin dang bcas par snang ngam brtag /bden 'dzin med 'dra na ngos gzung rgyu 'dug gam 'di yin med pa'i phyal ba zhig tu 'dug gam sogs legs par brtag /gang du'ang gnas sa brten sa ngos bzung dang rnam 'gyur sogs su grub pa skra rtse tsam yang med pas tshul 'di lta bu zhes gang du'ang gnas sa med par thag chod na de kar bzhag go /gsum pa tha ma gang du 'gag dpyad pa ni/ gshis gnas lugs de las rang mdangs rnam rtog gi 'char sgo mthar ji ltar song brtags pas dngos med du song snyam na/ rtog pa de nyid bkag nas dngos med du song ngam/ rang gar sangs nas song ngam brtag /bkag na sus bkag rkyen cis bkag sangs na rkyen gang gis sangs dang rang sangs la song ngam brtags/ gang shar gyi rang 'gros de las 'dir song gi yul dang rjes med pa/ sus kyang mi khegs shing 'char sgo mi dgag pas 'jig pa'am dgag pa med par thag chod na de kar bzhag /de ltar sems nyid kyi ngo mthong ba'i nyams myong rdo rus thug par dpyad pas rtog pa de skye 'gag gnas gsum la mi ltos par rang ngo gra ma nyams par rang gshis su rang shar rang grol byung na sems kyi ngo bo gsha' ma mthong ba yin te/ rje yang dgon pas/ kha cig sems la brtags pas dang po byung ba mi snang bas skye med/

bar du gnas pa med pas gnas med/ tha ma 'gag pa med pas 'gag med zer/ 'dir gang shar skad cig ma de'i ngo bo gdod nas skye ma myong bas skye med dang*/ rig pa'i thad nas ma 'gags pas 'gag med/ rig stong tha dad du mi gnas pas gnas med/ ces gsungs/ de nas bzo med kyi dran pas rang babs skyong*/ rang rig gnyis su 'dzin pa'i bsgom bya dang bral ba'i blo bral gshis thog gi ngang der glod cing thag bcad do// gsum pa gshis mdangs sam gnas 'gyu thun mong du dpyad pa bshad par gsum las/ dang po gcig dang tha dad kyi sgo nas dpyad pa la spyi bye brag gnyis las/ dang po gcig dang tha dad kyi sgo nas dpyad pa ni/ bla mar gsol 'debs dang*/ lus gnad legs par byas/ sems kyi ngo bo brten pa'i ngos nas so sor rtogs pa'i shes rab kyis 'di ltar dpyad de/ sems 'di gcig pu zhig gam mang po zhig 'dug gam brtag /gcig tu 'dug par go na snang ba sna tshogs su 'char ba'i don gang yin par 'dug brtag /tha dad mang po zhig tu go na de tha dad du snang ba de rnams sems kyi ngo bo las min pa'i gzhan gang nas byung brtag /de ltar legs par brtags pas gcig kyang ma yin/ tha dad du'ang ma grub pa de gnyis ka'i mtha' las 'das pa gcig tu go na des chog pa yin no// gnyis pa gnas 'gyu bye brag tu bshad pa ni/ spyir gnas 'gyu gnyis gcig gam tha dad yang nas yang du rtsad gcod/ de 'gyu ba'i tshe gnas pa med par 'gyu'am yang rang ngo gnas bzhin par 'gyu/ 'gyu ba'i tshe gnas pa e 'dug /'gyu ba de las min pa'i logs su gnas pa yin nam min/ gnas pa las min pa'i 'gyu ba gcig logs nas shar rgyu yong rgyu 'dug gam mi 'dug sogs legs par brtag /de ltar brtags pas da dung ma go ste gnas 'gyu gnyis tha dad lta bu 'gyu dus gnas mkhan dang gnas dus 'gyu mkhan sogs 'dug par go na/ 'o na de gnyis sdod dus steng 'og mnyam gshibs/
