gcig gis gcig sgrib sogs ci 'dra byas sdod 'dug pa dang*/ 'gro dus gcig 'gro gcig 'dug gam mnyam 'gro mnyam 'dug ji ltar 'dug sogs legs par brtags nas rtsa gdar chod par byed/ yang gnas dus 'gyu ba mi 'dug /'gyu dus gnas pa mi 'dug pas khong gnyis gcig par 'dug bsam na de gnyis gcig na gcig lugs la brtag /rnam rtog med dus gcig par 'dug pa go na gcig lugs rang de la khong gnyis ji ltar 'dres nas sdod 'dug sogs dpyad/ yang rnam rtog yod dus gcig par 'dug bsam na/ 'gyu ba gnas par phar gcig gam/ gnas pa 'gyu bar tshur gcig gam sogs legs par dpyad pas kun gzhi ngo bo gcig gi rol pa las sna tshogs 'phro ba de tha dad du grub pa med pa/ dper na chu dang rlabs bzhin nam/ nyi ma dang 'od bzhin du sems kyi rang rtsal du shes na gnas 'gyu so sor ma rnyed cing*/ gnas 'gyu'i ngo bo'ang ma rnyed/ gnas 'gyu la dgag sgrub dang spang blang mi dgos par thag chod de/ sems gnas na gnas thog 'gyu na 'gyu thog tu bzhag pas chog par go nas rang shar rang grol du nges shes skye dgos/ de'i tshe lta mkhan gyi rig pa de nyid blta bya'i gnas 'gyu las gzhan du'am/ gnas 'gyu nyid yin no zhes rang gi rig pa'i mig gis dpyad pas rtog dpyod byed mkhan rang yang gnas 'gyu las logs su med par go nas gsal stong rang rig rang gsal bar nyams su myong ste/ don du gshis mdangs zhes sam/ spang bya gnyen po zhes sam/ blta bya lta byed dam/ dran pa rnam rtog ces sam/ gnas pa 'gyu ba zhes sogs ming gi rnam grangs mang po thams cad gnyis su med par shes/ bla ma'i byin rlabs zhugs pas dbyer med du thag legs par chod/ don blta bya lta byed med pa'i klong du slebs pa zhig byung na nges don grub pa yin/ dpyad pa mthar phyin pa yin/ blos byas bral ba'i blo 'das kyi lta ba'am// lta ba sems kyi rdo rje zhes bya ste/

rje btsun gyis/ lta ba yin par nges kyis rang gi sems la ltos// sems las gzhan pa'i lta ba btsal ba na// de yis rang sems spangs pa 'dra'o ang ge lha rje ston pa ba// zhes dang*/ rje btsun mi tra dzo kis kyang*/ e ma ho gdod nas ma skyes pa// 'khor 'das kun gyi byed rgyu can// gzhan min rang gi snying dbus su// bla ma'i drin gyis shes par byos// zhes dang*/ rgyal ba'i dbang pos/ blos byas kyi lta ba bzang yang 'jig /blo 'das la lta ba'i ming yang med// blta bya dang lta byed dbyer med pa'i// nges pa de bla ma'i drin las rnyed// ces gsungs so// de nas gshis mdangs dbyer med rang bzhin yongs shes kyi ngang nas ma brjed tsam du skyong pas chog pa'o// gnyis pa dngos po dngos med kyi sgo nas dpyad pa ni/ de'ang rtog pa sna tshogs 'gyu ba ni sems nyid 'di ka'i rtsal snang tsam du 'dug /de la sems zhes ming tsam du btags pa 'di yod pa dngos por grub bam/ med pa dngos med du grub/ dngos por grub na gzung ba dang 'dzin pa gang du grub/ gzung bar grub na dbyibs kha dog ci lta bu/ 'dzin pa'ang der snang ba nyid du zad la/ dngos po med pa zhig na sna tshogs su snang ba 'di gang gis byas zhes brtags pas/ ngo bor grub pa zhig yod na dngos por bzhag tu rung ste/ rig pa'i brtags pas don ci'ang grub pa med pas sems rtag chad kyi mtha' las 'das pa zhig rtogs dgos pa yin/ rtag chad gang yin na/ klu sgrub kyis/ yod par lta ba rtag lta ste/ med par lta ba chad lta yin/ zhes gsungs/ rtag chad mtha' las 'das lugs ni/ sems de dbyibs kha dog gnas sa brten sa ngo bo ngos bzung dang bral bas na rtag pa'i mthar ma lhung*/ de'ang stong rkyang min pa'i rang rig rang gsal rig cha dang bcas pas na chad pa'i mthar ma lhung ste/ yod pa dngos po'i phyogs su gzhag tu med cing*/ rang rig pa'i ye shes spyod yul du gyur pas med pa dngos med kyi phyogs su ma song*/

des na dngos po dang dngos po med pa gnyis ka dang bral bas rtag chad kyi lam du ma lhung ba dbu ma'i lam zhes bya ste/ gong 'phros/ de phyir yod dang med pa la// mkhas pas gnas par mi bya'o// zhes dang*/ gang gis rten cing 'brel pa 'byung*// 'gag ba med pa skye med pa// chad pa med pa rtag med pa// 'ong ba med pa 'gro med pa// zhes dang*/ yod dang med ces bya ba mtha' yin te// stong dang mi stong 'di yang mtha' yin no// de ltar mtha' gnyis rnam par spang byas nas// mkhas pas dbus la'ang gnas par mi bya'o// zhes gsungs so// des na yod pa dang med pa dang mnyam par lta ba la sogs yid byed blo'i 'dzin stangs thams cad bral nas yid la mi byed par gnyug ma gshis kyi thog tu mnyam par 'jog par bya'o// gsum pa dus gsum gyi sgo nas dpyad pa ni/ de'ang rang sems kyi ngo bo'am bzhugs tshul ni/ rtag chad sogs kyi mtha' las 'das par 'dug go// de ni sems rig stong rjen lhang nge ba sna tshogs ma 'gags par 'char ba 'di nyid kyi ngo bo 'das pa'i sems gar song*/ ma 'ongs pa'i sems gang las byung*/ da lta'i sems ji ltar 'dug brtag /'das pa'i sems ni 'gag cing zhig /ma 'ongs pa'i sems ni ma skyes shing ma byung*/ da lta'i sems ni ngos 'dzin ci'ang med la/ de bzhin du brtags pas/ chos thams cad kyi tshul yang de 'dra zhig ste thams cad kyang bden pa ma yin pa/ rang gi blos brtags pa tsam du zad pas/ skye ba dang 'gag pa dang gnas pa ci'ang grub pa ma yin pa/ nam mkha' ltar dus kun 'gyur ba med par nyams su myong dgos te/ de ltar yang*/ jo bo rjes/ de'ang de ltar 'das pa'i sems ni 'gag cing zhig /ma 'ongs pa'i sems ni ma skyes shing ma byung*/ da ltar gyi sems ni shin tu brtag par dka' ste/ kha dog dbyibs dang bral ba'i nam mkha' dang 'dra bar ma grub pa'o// zhes gsungs so// yang kun gzhi sems kyi ngo bo 'di dang po byung sa 'dug gam mi 'dug

/bar du gnas sa 'dug gam mi 'dug /tha mar 'gro sa 'dug gam mi 'dug sogs legs par brtag /der byung gnas 'gro gsum yod pa 'dra zhig byung na/ der yang dang por gang nas byung*/ bar du gang du gnas/ tha mar gang du 'gro ba de dag legs par brtag /de nas dang po byung sa dang*/ bar du gnas sa dang tha mar 'gro sa mi 'dug par rig na der yang mi 'dug lugs legs par brtag la der thag chod par byas pas na/ dus glo bur du ma byung bas dus thams cad pa/ skye 'gag gnas gsum dang bral bas rgyun chad med pa/ rtogs ma rtogs thams cad la bzang ngan med pa/ gnas pas 'phel 'grib med pa/ ngo shes ma shes med pas kun la thob shor med pa/ dus kun tu 'gyur ba med pas gang bri med pa sogs skye med kyi don gzhi ru chod pa'i nyams myong rdo rus thug par dpyad do// de ltar rnams kyis dpyad pas sems nyid gdod ma nas spros pa'i mtha' thams cad dang bral ba'i mtshang rig pa la sems mthong ba'i tha snyad btags pa tsam las ngos bzung can gyi mthong rgyu mthong mkhan gyi dngos po skra rtse tsam yang mi dmigs shing ma mthong ba/ don la smra bsam gyi yul las 'das pa/ dus thams cad par 'gyur ba med pa'i rang bzhin can zhig yin te/ brtag gnyis las/ rang gi rig pa'i ye shes 'di// ngag gi lam 'das yid kyi spyod yul min/ zhes dang*/ yum las/ smra bsam brjod med shes rab pha rol phyin// ma skyes mi 'gag nam mkha'i ngo bo nyid// so so rang rig ye shes spyod yul ba// dus gsum rgyal ba'i yum la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes dang*/ mdo sdud pa las/ nam mkha' mthong zhes sems can tshig tu rab brjod pa// nam mkha' ji ltar mthong zhes don 'di brtag par gyis// de bzhin chos mthong pa yang de bzhin gshegs pas bstan// mthong ba dpe gzhan gyis ni bsnyad par nus ma yin// zhes dang*/ sdom 'byung las/ sems byung sems su brten gyur na// 'gro la rang bzhin tshul de ni// mkha' mtshungs nam mkha' yang dag gnas// shel lam nor bu gsal ba bzhin// thog ma tha ma med pa'i gzugs// spros bral dbang po'i spyod yul min// 'gyur ba med cing snang ba med// thams cad stong pa nyon mongs med// zhes gsungs/

de ltar sems rang ngo shes shing rang gsal 'dzin pa med pa de la rgya bod kyi mkhas shing grub pa phal cher gyis rang bzhin rnam dag gam rang bzhin yongs shes zhes ming du btags te/ mnga' bdag mai tri pas/ gzhi yi rang bzhin yongs su shes// gnyug ma mtshon du med pa 'di// rgyal ba rnams kyi gshegs shul yin// rang gi sems la rtag tu gnas// zhes dang*/ tog rtse zhabs kyis/ gnyug ma rang bzhin shes pa 'di// grub chen pho mo thams cad kyis// rang bzhin yongs shes ming du btags// bdag kyang nyams len 'di rang yin// zhes dang*/ rje lha rtse bas/ rang bzhin yongs su shes na sgom dang 'bral ba med// gsungs te/ de bzhin mthong nas bcos ma'i lhan po gdab rgyu ci'ang med/ rang rig rang bzhin yongs shes kyis ngo bo ma yengs mi bsgom gu yangs bde ba'i klod du glod cing skyong ba gal che'o// bzhi pa phyi snang ba yul gyi tshogs la dpyad par bya ba ni/ rje dwags pos/ sems kyi 'char sgo gzung 'dzin gyi rtog pa snang sems la ci shar thams cad snang ba'i khongs su bsdus nas gsungs kyang*/ re zhig rtogs bde ba'i phyir skabs 'dir gzung ba'i yul gzugs sogs tshogs drug gi snang ba la snang ba'i tha snyad byas nas de dag la brtag dpyad byas pa yin la/ de'ang las dang bag chags kyis bsdus pa'i mig sogs dbang po lnga dang*/ gzugs sogs yul lnga dang 'phrad pa'i snang ba 'char tshul/ tha mal pa la mngon sum du grags pa rnams la re zhig dbyibs dang kha dog la sogs pa so so'i rang mtshan pa ltar/ dbang shes kyi ngor spyi mthun gyi snang ba 'char ba mi ldog cing*/ de ltar phyi rol gyi yul gzugs sogs su snang ba de dag kyang rdul phran dang phyogs cha dngos su bsil nas rang bzhin med par brtags shing dpyad pa'ang mi byed de/ 'dzin pa'i sems gtan la phab nas gzung bya'i yul sgrog rang grol du 'gro bar bzhed pas/

de ltar na 'dir brtag bya'ang snang mkhan gyi shes pa de nyid gtso bor btags pa yin no// de la dpyad pa'i tshul rnam pa brgyad las// dang po snang yul gyi gnas lugs la brtag pa ni/ bla ma la mos gus gdung shugs dang bcas snang ba gtan la phebs pa'i gsol 'debs kha bsgyur dang bcas kun gyi sngon du 'gro ba nas/ sems ma yengs pa gsal stong gi ngang nas gzugs snang gang yang rung ba zhig gsal lam gyis 'char du bcug /de shar ba na ji ltar snang ba'i gzugs de sems nyid gshis kyi rang mdangs las shar ram/ gzhan logs su grub pa zhig yin nam brtag /de bzhin dngos po dang dbyibs kha dog gnas sa dang brten sa ci 'dra 'dug brtag /sems las gzhan pa'i snang ba yod par go na snang rig gi thog nas dbye ba gang 'dra 'dug brtag /dngos po dbyibs sogs yod 'dra na snang cha ma 'gags tsam du shar ba de las don du grub pa ji ltar 'dug brtag /gzugs kyis mtshon nas snod bcud kyi dngos po'i bye brag dang*/ sgra dang dri la sogs pa 'char du bcug la/ de lta mkhan la rtog cing dpyad do/ de ltar brtags pa'i tshe snang ba'i 'char sgo de nyid 'gag pas mi gsal ba'am sems gsal stong gi ngang du zhi nas yid kyi 'char sgo dang 'dzin rtog zhi nas mnyam gzhag tu song ba yin rung*/ des snang ba dang snang mkhan nyid la 'phrig mi tshud pas/ slar snang ba ci rigs snang du bcug pa'i snang thog de nyid du snang mkhan brtag dpyad byed dgos la/ mdor na ji ltar snang ba'i snang cha ma 'gags par snang bzhin du sems dang snang ba dbyer med pa'i dbyibs kha dog sogs las 'das pa'i stong par shar bas zhen 'dzin med pa'i snang ba bkrag med lta bur myong na 'di'i skabs kyi myong ba cung zad skyes pa yin pas/ de nas snang ba phra rags gang shar thams cad snang la rang bzhin med pa snang stong du bskyang bar bya'o// gnyis pa snang ba de rnams phyi nang gnyis su yod de de la dpyad pa ni/

yang gzugs snang 'char du bcug la sems dang snang ba'i gzugs de gnyis phan tshun nam phyi nang ngam steng 'og sogs su 'dug gam brtag /de ltar 'dug na rang rkya thub pa'am/ ngo bo gnyis so sor grub pa 'dug gam brtag /gal te gzugs snang dang sems gcig na/ sems gzugs snang du song nas gcig gam/ gzugs snang sems su song nas gcig gam brtag /de bzhin snod bcud kyi dngos po sgra sogs la brtags pas snang ba dang sems ye gdod ma nas lhan cig tu nyi ma dang nyi ma'i 'od bzhin du go na de kas chog /gsum pa snang ba'i yul gyi ngos bzung la brtag pa ni/ yang gzugs snang 'char du bcug la/ gzugs snang de stong par ngos gzung rgyu zhig 'dug gam snang bar ngos gzung rgyu zhig 'dug gam/ gsal bar ngos gzung can du 'dug gam brtag /de bzhin snod bcud sgra sogs la dpyad pas ngos gzung rgyu ci'ang med pa zhig tu thag chod na de gar bzhag go// bzhi pa snang yul gyi ngo bo la dpyad pa ni/ yang gzugs snang 'char du bcug pa de'i ngo bo bden par grub par 'dug gam brtag /'khrul ngor sna tshogs cir yang 'char phyir rdzun par 'dug gam brtag /de bzhin gzhan rnams la'ang brtags pas/ yang dag pa'i don cir yang ma grub pa/ rgyu rkyen rten 'brel tsam las byung phyir shin tu med pa'ang ma yin te/ dper na chu nang gi zla ba lta bur nyams su myong ba de kar bzhag go// lnga pa shar tshul la brtag pa ni/ yang gzugs snang 'char bcug pa de pha rol rkyen gyis shar ram/ mthong byed kyi sgo la shar ram/ yid kyi rnam par shes pa las 'char ram sogs legs par brtags pa de bzhin gzhan rnams la'ang brtags pas/ rkyen sgo gnyis sogs kyi yul du shar yang yid kyis ma mthong na go yul mi shar bas yul rkyen dang sgo la rten cing 'brel bar 'byung bar rtogs shing shar thog nas shes pa dang*/ shes thog nas 'char ba rtogs nas nyams su myong na des chog// drug pa 'dzin pa'i yul la dpyad pa ni/

yang gzugs snang 'char bcug la/ mthong chos su snang ba ltar dngos po rang mtshan par 'dzin mkhan la brtag /gnas lugs don la sems nas stong par 'dzin mkhan la brtag /de bzhin yin min bden rdzun du 'dzin mkhan la brtag /gzhan snod bcud sna tshogs rnams la'ang legs par dpyad pas blos mtshan 'dzin gyi dri ma med par rang sar grol ba'i gshis skye med las mdangs 'gags med 'char bar go na des chog go// bdun pa stong mi stong la dpyad pa ni/ yang gzugs snang 'char bcug pa de dngos po gdos bcas su 'dug gam med pas dngos med stong par 'dug gam brtag /dngos snang can du 'dug na mthong byed mig gi rnam par shes pa yul rnam drug gi 'khrul snang lta bu ma yin rtag brtan du 'dug gam mi 'dug brtag /stong par 'dug na stong pa ye med du 'dug gam brtag /gzhan snod bcud bye brag sgra sogs la'ang dpyad pas/ ma brtags ngos ni cir yang snang la/ legs par brtags tshe bden med sgyu ma lta bu snang ba zung 'jug tu rtogs na de kas chog go// brgyad pa 'gags pa'i rdzas la brtag pa ni/ yang gzugs snang 'char bcug la de tha mar mi mthong pas mi snang ba ltar 'gags pa'i tshe/ snang ba'i dngos po 'khrul rten med pa'am yal ba ltar gyur nas 'gags sam/ mthong byed kyi sgo lnga gang rung de'i tshor ba 'gags sam/ mthong byed kyi rnam par shes pa de yengs thabs su song nas yid snga ma rang 'gags su song nas phyi ma gzhan 'char ba'am/ mthong med kyi bag la nyal du song ngam ma song dpyad/ de'i rigs sbyar nas snod bcud sgra sogs kun la dpyad pas 'char sgo mi 'gag /'char sgo mi 'gag cing 'jig pa'am 'gag pa med par nyams su myong na des chog pa'o// de ltar rnams kyis brtags shing dpyad pas snang ba dang sems nyid tha dad pa'i gnyis 'dzin zhig nas snang ba sna tshogs pa rnams cir snang yang ngo bo la ngos gzung rgyu med pa/

snang stong ngam stong snang lta bur nyams su myangs nas sems nyid dang dbyer med pa sgyu ma'i dpe'am khyad par rmi lam gyi sems dang rmi lam gyi snang ba ltar shes dgos te/ dper na rmi lam na phyi rol gyi snang ba sna tshogs ci shar yang rmi lam gyi shes pa nyid las ma 'das shing*/ rmi lam gyi snang ba dang rmi lam gyi shes pa dbyer med de/ de bzhin du phyi rol gyi snang ba sna tshogs pa snang yang snang tsam nyid nas sems nyid 'gag pa med pa'i 'char sgo tsam las ma 'das shing*/ sna tshogs par snang ba'i snang ba dang rang gi sems dbyer med du shes par bya ste/ de skad du'ang mdo las/ khams gsum po ni sems tsam ste// sems su shes na snang ba med// ces dang*/ rje rgod tshang pas/ snang ba 'di thams cad rang gi sems yin/ snang yang rang bzhin med/ ces dang*/ grub thob o rgyan pas/ sems dang snang ba gnyis po me dang tsha ba gcig pa bzhin du gnas pa yin mod/ ces gsungs/ dngos po 'di rdzun par snang ba'i rgyu mtshan ni/ rang re thog ma med pa nas 'khrul ba'i bag chags dang las kyi dbang gis so so'i sems dkrugs pas snang ba sna tshogs pa rmi lam lta bur 'byung zhing*/ de'ang so so'i snang ba tha dad las gcig tu 'di yin zhes byar ngos bzung med de/ dper na mis sa rdor bzung ba la lha 'dre rnams kyis khang bzang mthong ba dang*/ gzhi chu gcig nyid la lhas bdud rtsi dang*/ yi dwags kyis rnag khrag mis ja chang du mthong ba bzhin gang du'ang bden par mi rung ba dang*/ de bzhin du nang du zhe sdang me ltar du 'bar ba yod na/ phyi rol tu snang ba thams cad dgrar snang du 'char ba yin/ nang du byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems 'byongs na phyi rol gyi sems can thams cad pha mar mthong ba yin/ nang du bskyed rim la brtan pa thob na snang ba thams cad lha dang lha mor 'char ba yin/ nang du phyag rgya chen po'i rtogs pa mnyam rjes med par 'byongs na phyi rol gyi snang ba thams cad chos sku bde ba chen po'i rol par 'char ba yin te/

dus gsum mkhyen pas/ zhe sdang ldan pa'i sgom chen la// snang ba thams cad dgra ru mthong*// byams pa sgom pa'i sgom chen la// dgra gnyen med par pha mar mthong*// bskyed rim brtan pa'i sgom chen la// snod bcud thams cad lha ru mthong*// 'od gsal sgom pa'i sgom chen la// phyi nang med par chos skur rtogs// phyi rol de bzhin nang de bzhin// nang gi byed pa phyi ru shar// zhes gsungs so// de ltar na snang ba sna tshogs phyir ma chad/ sems nyid nang du ma lus par snang sems gnyis med du thag bcad nas/ bstod smad bde sdug chags sdang la sogs pa rmi lam bslu brid du shes pas gang dgar bor/ sangs rgyas la'ang 'dod pa med pa'i mnyam nyid de ka ched du mi bsgom/ cir snang gang shar gyi ngo bo ma bcos rang 'gros su skyong dgos pa'o// 'on kyang spyi mthun gyi las dang bag chags ma dag pa de srid du/ des bsdus pa'i yul dang*/ dbang po dang shes pa gsum gyi rten 'byung shes pa tsam las spyi mthun gyi snang ba 'char tshul mi ldog pa snang sems kyi sgro 'dogs dpyis phyin par chod de snang thog tu re dogs dang bral zhing snang sems 'dres pa ro gcig chen po'i skabs su 'byung bar bshad pas 'dir skabs thob tsam du bshad pa'o/// /gnyis pa khyad par bye brag tu dpyad pa bshad par bya ba la/ rtsa ba bdag 'dzin la dpyad pa/ rtog pa rags pa dug lnga'i skye yul gnas lugs la dpyad pa/ rkyen snang skyid sdug bzang ngan gyi mkhan po la dpyad pa spyir gsum las/ dang po bdag 'dzin la phyi nang gi bdag 'dzin rnam pa gnyis te/ dang po gang zag gi bdag 'dzin la dpyad pa ni/ gzugs kyi phung po dang*/ tshor ba'i phung po dang*/ 'du shes kyi phung po dang*/ 'du byed kyi phung po dang*/ rnam par shes pa'i phung po ste/ phung po lnga po de dag la dngos po can zhig gam/ dngos med zhig gam/ de la bdag tu 'dzin zhen rgyu'i bden par grub pa ji lta bu zhig 'dug sogs legs par brtag

/bden par lta ba 'dug na gang zag gi bdag 'dzin yin pas slar yang 'bad pas brtag /de dag ril por stong pa nyid kyi ngo bor rtogs na de la gang zag gi bdag med ces bya ste des chog /gnyis pa chos kyi bdag 'dzin la dpyad pa ni/ dbang po sgo lnga phyi gzung ba'i yul nang 'dzin pa'i sems 'char mkhan rnam par shes pa dang brgyad la rang bzhin du grub pa zhig gam/ ma grub pa zhig gam/ de la bdag gir byed pa'i so sor gzung ba dang 'dzin pas 'ching ba'i rgyu rkyen ci 'dug sogs legs par brtag /'dzin zhen 'dug na chos kyi bdag 'dzin yin pas slar yang yang brtag /stong nyid dag par rtogs na de la chos kyi bdag med zer des chog// gnyis pa rtog pa rags pa dug lnga'i skye yul gnas lugs la dpyad par bya ba la lnga las/ dang po ma rig pa gti mug la dpyad pa ni/ phyi'i las rgyu 'bras la spang blang mi shes pa/ nang gi rig pa'i gnas lugs 'char tshul mtshan nyid la rmongs pa dang*/ 'phral gnyid bro ba dang bying rmugs sogs blo mi gsal ba'am de dag ci rigs 'char du bcug nas gang shar gyi rang ngo so ma de la dpyad par bya ba las/ thog mar ma rig rmongs pa de skye ba'i yul gang nas byung*/ rgyu ci las skyes/ rkyen cis bskyed brtags pas/ sems las skyes snyam na/ ma las bu skyes pa ltar ngo bo gnyis so sor grub par 'dug gam/ chu dang chu'i rlabs lta bu rtsal las shar ram sogs legs par brtag /bar du tshul ji ltar gnas/ lus kyi stod smad phyi nang gang du gnas nas 'dug /dbyibs dang kha dog dngos po ji ltar 'dug sogs brtags pas/ gti mug gi rnam par snang snyam na/ sems kho rang gi rnam 'gyur ma yin pa'i nad kyis btab pa dang gdon gyis bskyed pa ltar du 'dug gam/ sems stong pa la phan gnod byed thub par snang ngam/ sems nyid dang ngo bo tha dad du 'dug gam/ gcig tu 'dug sogs legs par brtag /mthar ji ltar sangs/

'gags na rkyen cis 'gags/ sangs na rkyen gang gis sangs brtags pas/ dngos med du song snyam na rang shugs la zad pa lta bus med nas song ngam/ sems kho rang la phar thim pa zhig gam sogs legs par brtag go /gnyis pa zhen 'dzin 'dod chags la dpyad pa ni/ rang gi rgyu nor zog zas la zhen chags a 'thas pa dang*/ yul gang zhig la chags shing zhen nas 'dod zhen brkam chags dung dung ba'i rtog pa ci rigs yod pa'am 'char du bcug la de'i ngo bo la gong bzhin du brtags te/ dang por skye ba'i yul gang nas byung*/ bar du gnas lugs la ji ltar 'dug /tha mar gang du 'gags sogs legs par brtag go /gsum pa gdug rtsub zhe sdang la dpyad pa ni/ rang dang mi mthun pa'i dgra sogs la gdug rtsub kyi zhe sdang drag po snying na ka re ba dang*/ don yod med la khong khro gdug sems yong ba'i rigs sam ched du ci rigs 'char du bcug pa de'i ngo bo la sngar bzhin dpyad de/ thog mar skye yul gang yin/ bar du tshul ji lta bu zhig tu gnas/ tha mar gang du 'gags sogs 'bad pas brtag /bzhi pa ngan sems phrag dog la dpyad pa ni/ gzhan pha rol po gang yin rung*/ de la mtho dogs rgyal dogs rnyed dogs sogs blo yul mi bde ba'i gdug rtsub kyi sems gyong ting nge che phra ci rigs sam ched du 'char bcug pa de'i ngo bo la snga ma bzhin brtags te/ dang por gang nas skye/ bar du kho rang gi gnas lugs/ mthar gang du 'gags sogs legs par brtag /lnga pa rang mthong nga rgyal la dpyad pa ni/ rang gi gzugs byad 'byor stobs dang*/ thos bsam sgom gsum sogs ji snyed yod pa la nga min pa gzhan min ngas min pa sus mi shes snyam pa gzhan las lhag pa'i blo gang yang rung ba ji snyed yod pa'am ched du 'char bcug pa de'i ngo bo la dpyad de/ thog mar skye ba'i yul gang 'dra zhig nas byung*/ bar du kho rang gnas tshul la ji ltar 'dug /tha mar ji ltar du 'gags sogs snga ma bzhin legs par brtags/

de ltar du dug lnga'i rtog pa la brtags pas/ sems nyid dang dug lnga'i rtog pa tha dad pa lta bu ni gnyis 'dzin gyi blo yin te/ dug lnga'i rnam pa ci shar yang ngo bo ngos bzung med pa gsal stong du nyams su myangs nas/ sems nyid dang dug lnga'i rtog tshogs dbyer med pa chu dang chu rlabs ltar shes dgos te/ dper na chu rlabs ni chu las ma 'das shing chu nyid rlabs su shar la shar yang chu'i ngo bo las gzhan ma yin no// de bzhin du dug lnga'i rtog tshogs kyang shar tsam nyid nas sems nyid gsal stong de las ma 'das shing*/ sems nyid der yang go ma 'gags pa'i dug lnga'i rtog tshogs ci rigs su shar la/ de shar yang ngo bo ngos bzung med pa'i sems nyid gsal stong de nyid las gzhan ma yin par thag chod par bya'o// gsum pa rkyen snang bzang ngan skyid sdug tu dpyad pa la bzhi las/ dang po phyi rkyen bzang ba la dpyad pa ni/ gnas skabs su sdug bsngal med cing zas nor longs spyod snyan grags sogs ci bsam 'grub pa'i bde skyid kyi rnam pa che phra ci rigs rang la byung ba'am ma byung yang ched du 'char bcug pa der snang rig gi ngo bo so ma de dang po ci 'dra zhig nas shar/ shar lugs ji ltar byas nas shar/ bar du kho rang ngo bo dngos po dngos med ji ltar 'dug /mthar snang cha mi snang bar yal tshe gang du yal/ ji ltar yal 'dug sogs legs par brtag /gnyis pa phyi rkyen ngan par dpyad pa ni/ dgras sdang ba lha 'dre'i bar chad lus kyi na tsha/ sems kyi sdug bsngal sogs mi 'dod pa'i rkyen rang la byung ba'am/ med kyang ched du 'char bcug pa de'i snang rig la gong bzhin brtags te/ dang po ji ltar shar/ bar du ngo bo ji ltar 'dug /mthar ji ltar yal sogs dpyad do// gsum pa nang sems skyid pa'am dga' ba la dpyad pa ni/ lus la nad med cing sems bde skyid dga' ba dang nyams rtogs 'phel ba sogs byung ba'am ched du 'char bcug pa'i ngo bo la snga ma bzhin brtags te/

thog mar shar lugs/ bar du ngo bo'i gnas tshul/ tha mar ji ltar yal sogs brtag /bzhi pa nang sems sdug pa'am mi dga' ba la dpyad pa ni/ lus sems mi bde zhing sems sdug pa/ nyams mi 'phel zhing yid mi dga' ba sogs byung ba'am ched du 'char bcug pa'i ngo bor sngar bzhin dpyad de/ dang por shar tshul/ bar du gnas tshul/ mthar ji ltar gyur nas yal sogs brtag /tshul de bzhin gyis brtags pas rkyen snang bzang ngan la dbye ba med pa/ sems nyid stong pa nyid dang dbyer med pa skye med kyi don nyams su myong dgos/ mdor na sems nyid kyi gshis sam gzhi'i rtsad chod pa'i nyams myong rdo rus thug par dpyad dgos/ khrid srol la lar sems 'tshol ci rigs la brten nas/ rtog med kyi sems gsal rig can la 'phrig 'dzud thabs kho na tsam las 'gyu thog dang snang thog la brtag dpyad mi byed pa ni cung zad rtsing bar mthong ste/ de ltar byas na blo rig phal cher la sems gnas pa'i tshe sgom du bde ba dang*/ 'gyu ba dang snang ba'i dus sgom du mi bde ba 'byung ba'i phyir ro// de bzhin 'gyu thog dang snang thog tu bltas pas de zhi gnas gsal stong du 'gro zer ba'ang las dang po pa kha cig la de ltar 'byung mod kyi gzhan ni dran pas rtog snang mnyam bzhag steng du khug pa tsam las rtog snang nyid gtan la phebs nas lam du slong ba min pas de dag gi rnam dbye shes par bya'o// de ltar rnams kyis dpyad pas sems kyi gnas lugs bsam brjod las 'das pa nyams su myong zhing mthar dpyod byed kyi so sor rtogs pa nyid kyang rang zhi rang thim du song nas rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes 'char ba bshad de/ bram ze chen pos/ gdod nas dag pa nam mkha'i rang bzhin la// bltas shing bltas shing mthong ba 'gag par 'gyur// zhes dang*/ gal te sems kyis sems ni mtshon du 'gro// rnam rtog dang ni mi g.yo brtan par gnas// ji ltar lan tshwa chu la thim pa ltar// de ltar sems ni rang bzhin la thim 'gyur// zhes gsungs shing*/

gzhan yang tshe 'dir snang gi zhen 'dzin dang bral chags sdang gi rtsad chod/ snying po'i mtshangs rdol/ kun rdzob kyi rdzun phug rdib/ 'khor ba'i gzhi rtsa chod/ myang 'das kyi rmang gzhi thon/ dug lnga'i rtsa ba skem/ sgyu ma'i ltad mo mthong ba'i dgos pa yod do// drug pa lhag mthong skyes ma skyes kyi tshad 'dzin pa ni/ de ltar lhag mthong sgom pa'i skabs rnams su so sor rtogs pa'i shes rab kyis dpyad pa na/ kha cig zhi gnas kyi gnas cha shas che bas ji ltar dpyad kyang dpyad don la 'phrig ci'ang mi tshud par ji tsam dpyad pa tsam du zhi gnas kyi ting nge 'dzin de nyid shar nas dpyad don thams cad de'i thog tu babs pa'i nges shes skyes pa la ngo bo mthong bar 'khrul pa dang*/ la lar zhi gnas kyi stong nyams shas che bas chos thams cad ngo bo nyid med pa'i stong nyams shar ba la ngo bo mthong bar 'khrul pa'ang 'byung ste/ de dag la re zhig zhi gnas kyi nyams snang dang de'i 'dzin pa sel thabs byas te shes pa nyams kyi rlan dang phral nas slar lhag mthong bsgoms pas don 'grub la/ blo dman zhing las sgrib tshan che ba 'ga' zhig la ni ji tsam dpyad kyang ngo bo mi mthong ba 'ong ste/ de la ni re zhig bsags sbyong gi thabs la brtson pa dang*/ zhi gnas kyi gsal ngar bskyed nas ci zhig nas lhag mthong bsgom mo// gzhan yang kha cig rnam dpyod che bas don spyi'i go ba bzang po shar ba la myong ba skyes par rlom pa dang*/ phal cher thos pa che bas smra mkhas kyang nyams myong med pa ni sman ngo ma 'phrod pas sngo ldum gyi 'khrungs dpe bshad shes pa la chags 'jog pa lta bu dang*/ 'ga' zhig gis ngag tu brjod ma shes kyang skabs thob kyi nyams myong skyes nas ngo thog tu blo thag chod pa'ang 'byung bas/ de dag gi rnam dbye phyed pa ni shin tu gal che ste/ lhag mthong ma skyes pa'i sgom ji ltar bzang yang*/ mu stegs pa dang nang pa thun mong ba'i 'jig rten pa'i sgom ci rigs tsam las theg dman pa'i sgom du'ang mi 'gro na/

theg chen dbu ma pa dang*/ khyad par phyag chen gyi sgom du 'gro ba ga la srid/ rgyu mtshan des na lhag mthong bsgom pa la nan tan du bya ba gal che ba yin no// 'o na lhag mthong skyes pa'i tshad ci tsam la 'jog ce na/ chos nyid kyi bden pa mngon sum du rtogs pa'i lhag mthong phyin ci ma log pa ni spros bral chen po'i skabs tsam las mi 'char la/ 'dir ni las dang po pa'i blo yul du 'char ba'i lhag mthong tsam ste/ dper na tshes gcig gi zla ba la nya gang ba lta bu'i byed las med kyang zla ba'i tha snyad 'jog pa ltar ro// de bas na 'dir ni gong du bshad pa'i rang sems dang de'i rtsal las shar ba'i rtog pa dang snang bas bsdus pa ste/ mdor na gzung 'dzin gyi chos thams cad don dam par skye 'gag gnas gsum dang bral ba'i mtshangs rig cing*/ de dag gi ngo bo nyid dam rang bzhin med pa'i myong ba nges shes dang bcas pa gting nas skyes pa zhig la skabs 'dir lhag mthong du byed dgos/ re zhig de tsam ma skyes kyang nged rang sgrub brgyud pas ni/ rang gi sems nyid kyi ngo bo ngos bzung dang bral ba'i stong pa ste/ de'ang ye gdod ma'i shes pa la bzo ma song ba de yin pas rang rig cing rang gsal ba gnyis tshogs pa'i sems la sems kyis 'phrig tshud pa'i myong ba rnyed pa la las dang po pa'i lhag mthong du 'jog par snang ste/ de tsam zhig thog mar bskyangs pas lhag mthong phyin ci ma log pa rim gyis 'char bar bzhed do/ de ltar bzhed pa'i tshul ni/ sems nyid mngon sum rtog bral gyi ye shes yod med yin min rtag chad gang gi'ang mthar ma lhung zhing gsal rig stong gsum dbyer med du myong shes kyang dpes mtshon du med pa la tshig gi brjod thabs zad pa rang byung rang shar nyid du hrig ge ba 'di la lhag mthong zhes ming du btags yod kyang*/ 'di ni so so'i skye bo'i dus nas rang dang 'du 'bral skad cig tsam med kyang gdams ngag dang byin rlabs kyis ma zin tshe ngo ma shes/

bar du zhi gnas la mnyam par bzhag dus kyang bzhag mkhan nam gnas mi gnas lta mkhan sogs kho rang yin yang rang gis rang ma mthong ba lta bur gyur pa ste/ don la tha mal pa'i dus kyi rnam rtog a 'thas lu gu rgyud du 'phro ba de nyid lhag mthong kho rang rnam rtog tu snang ba nyid las gzhan ma yin la/ zhi gnas kyi nyams dang bde gsal mi rtog pa sogs thams cad kyang lhag mthong gi rig pa kho rang der shar ba las gzhan ma yin yang*/ blo bral rjen pa'i rang ngo ma rig par gnas cha rkyang pa bskyangs na byang chub kyi rgyur mi 'gro bas/ rang ngo mthong phyin chad nas gnas 'gro gang yang lhag mthong ngam phyag rgya chen por ma gyur pa ni ci yang med de/ lo ras kyis/ tshogs drug yul du ci shar yang*// yid ni 'dzin pa ma zhugs na// thams cad rang snang rang grol yin// dbyer med rtogs sam sgom chen kun// zhes gsungs so// mdo phyogs nas sngon du zhi gnas kyi shin sbyangs grub pa'i thog tu lhag mthong bsgoms pa'i mthus shin sbyangs skyes pa la lhag mthong mtshan nyid pa dang*/ de man chad kyi lhag mthong ni lhag mthong rjes mthun par gsungs la/ 'dir de lta bu'i nges pa med de nyams rtogs kyi ngo bo rang la rag las pa'o// bdun pa lhag mthong sgom tshul gzhan dang sbyar ba ni/ mdo dgongs pa nges 'grel la sogs pa las/ chos rnam 'byed sogs kyi lhag mthong bzhi bshad pa dang sbyar na/ 'dir sems kyi rtsal lam mdangs las shar ba rtog pa dang snang bas bsdus pa'i gzung 'dzin gyi chos ji snyed la dmigs pa ni/ chos rnam 'byed kyi lhag mthong yin te/ shes bya ji snyed pa'i chos mtha' dag la dmigs nas de dag rnam par 'byed pa'i phyir ro// gzung 'dzin gyi dngos po de dag kyang rang rang gi ngo bo nyid med par dmigs pa ni rab tu rnam 'byed kyi lhag mthong yin te/ shes bya ji lta ba'i don la dmigs nas rnam par 'byed pa'i phyir ro// don de gnyis la mtshan 'dzin dang bcas te rnam par rtog pa ni yongs su rtog byed kyi lhag mthong yin te/

so sor rtogs pa dang bcas pa ji lta ji snyed kyi don rags pa rnams mtshan 'dzin dang bcas te rnam par rtog pa'i phyir ro// don de gnyis las zhib tu dpyod pa ni yongs su dpyod byed kyi lhag mthong yin te/ ji lta ji snyed kyi don phra zhing phra ba'ang yang dag par dpyod pa'i phyir ro// de ltar yang nyan sa las/ de la ji ltar rnam par 'byed par byed ce na/ dpyad pa rnam par sbyong ba'i dmigs pa dang mkhas pa'i dmigs pa dang nyon mongs pa rnam par sbyong ba'i dmigs pa dag la ji snyed yod pa nyid kyis rnam par 'byed par byed do// ji lta ba bzhin yod pa nyid kyis ni/ rab tu rnam par 'byed par byed pa yin no// shes rab dang ldan pa'i yid la byed pa'i rnam par rtog pa dang bcas pas mtshan mar 'dzin par byed pa'i tshe na ni yongs su rtog par byed pa yin no// yang dag par rtog par byed pa'i tshe na ni yongs su dpyod par byed do// zhes so// yang dgongs 'grel nas/ mtshan ma las byung ba'i lhag mthong sogs gsum bshad pa dang sbyar na 'dir lhag mthong gi dmigs yul mtha' dag la rnam par rtog pa'i tshul ni mtshan ma las byung ba'i lhag mthong yin te/ lhag mthong gi dmigs yul rnam rtog dang bcas pa'i gzugs brnyan kho na yid la byed pa'i phyir ro// de dag ngo bo nyid med par rtogs par byed pa'i tshul rnams ni yongs su 'tshol ba las byung ba'i lhag mthong yin te/ sngar ma rtogs pa'i brtag bya rtog par byed pa'i yid byed yin pa'i phyir ro// chos thams cad ngo bo nyid med pa'i grol ba thob nas goms par byed pa'i tshul rnams ni so sor rtogs pa las byung ba'i lhag mthong yin te/ so sor rtogs pa'i shes rab kyis chos thams cad kyi gnas lugs rtogs nas rnam par grol ba'i yang dag pa'i bde ba la reg par bya ba'i phyir goms par byed pa'i phyir ro// de ltar yang*/ mdo dgongs 'grel las/

mtshan ma las byung ba gang zhe na/ ting nge 'dzin gyi spyod yul rnam par rtog pa dang bcas pa'i gzugs brnyan 'ba' zhig yid la byed pa'i lhag mthong gang yin pa'o// yongs su 'tshol ba las byung ba gang zhe na/ de dang der shes rab kyis shin tu legs par ma rtogs pa'i chos de dag nyid shin tu legs par rtogs par bya ba'i phyir yid la byed pa'i lhag mthong gang yin pa'o// so sor rtogs pa las byung ba gang zhe na/ de dang der shes rab kyis shin tu legs par rtogs pa'i chos rnams las rnam par grol ba/ shin tu legs par bde ba la reg par bya ba'i phyir yid la byed pa'i lhag mthong gang yin pa'o// zhes so// de lta bu'i lhag mthong gi dbye ba mdo dang dgongs 'grel rnams su gsungs pa tsam las/ so sor gtan la 'bebs tshul sgom rim rnams su ma bshad la/ de dag gi gnad bsdus nas bdag med gnyis gtan la 'bebs tshul nyid mdo phyogs la rgya bod gnyis kar grags che bas tshul de dag dang sbyar nas/ 'dir sems kyi ngo bo gtan la 'bebs pa ni mdo phyogs su gang zag gi bdag med gtan la 'bebs pa dang tshul mtshungs te/ mdo phyogs su rig pa dang bcas pas phung po'i rgyun 'dzin pa la gang zag dang des rang rtag pa dang gcig pur bzung nas nga bdag tu zhen cing 'dzin pa gang zag gi bdag dang*/ de rang bzhin med par shes pa gang zag gi bdag med du byed pa de bzhin du/ 'dir yang rang rtag pa gcig pur gzung nas nga bdag tu 'dzin mkhan ni rang gi sems nyid yin la/ de rang bzhin med par gtan la 'bebs shing*/ der ma zad tshul de'i sgom don kyang 'byung ba'i phyir ro// de bzhin du rtog pa dang snang ba gtan la 'bebs pa ni mdo phyogs su chos kyi bdag med gtan la 'bebs pa dang tshul mtshungs te/ mdo phyogs su gang zag gi bdag des brtags pas phung khams la sogs pa rnams chos dang*/ de dag rang mtshan pa'i dngos por zhen cing 'dzin pa chos kyi bdag dang*/

de rang bzhin med par shes pa chos kyi bdag med yin pa bzhin du/ 'dir yang sems nyid kyis brtags pa'i sems byung dang phyi rol gzugs sgra sogs kyi snang ba rang mtshan pa rnams/ rang bzhin med par gtan la 'bebs shing der ma tshad de'i sgom don kyang 'byung ba'i phyir ro// 'on kyang yul dang yul can gtan la 'bebs tshul gyi go rim ni mi 'dra ste/ mdo phyogs rnams su thog mar gzung bya'i yul gtan la ma phebs pas yul can 'dzin pa'i sems gtan la mi phebs par bshad de/ chos kyi grags pas/ 'di yul sun phyung med par ni// de spong bar ni nus ma yin// zhes dang*/ ār+ya de was/ yul la bdag med mthong na ni// srid pa'i sa bon 'gags par byed// ces pa ltar ro// 'dir ni de ltar byas na slar 'dzin pa'i sems gtan la 'bebs pa tshegs che la/ thog mar 'dzin pa'i sems gtan la phebs pas/ des gzung ba'i yul rang grol ltar gtan la phebs sla bar bzhed de/ ljon shing rtsa ba nas bcad pas yal ga dang lo 'dab skems pa'i dpe dang sbyar nas/ til+li pas gsungs pa ltar snying po don gyi gdams ngag thams cad las byung ba'o// brgyad pa zhi lhag zung 'jug tu sgom tshul bshad pa ni/ de'ang sems dmigs pa las mi g.yo ba zhi gnas kyis byed la/ de kho na nyid rtogs nas lta ngan gyis sgul bar mi nus pa ri bo dang 'dra ba lhag mthong gis byed dgos pas zhi lhag gnyis ka dgos te/ zla ba sgron me'i mdo las/ zhi gnas stobs kyis g.yeng ba med par 'gyur// lhag mthong gis ni ri dang 'dra bar 'gyur// zhes gsungs so// de gnyis zung 'jug tu sgom pa la/ las dang po pa la dpyad sgom dang lhag mthong shas che nas rgod par gyur na de'i tshe zhi gnas sgom pa dang*/ 'jog sgom dang zhi gnas shas ches rmugs par gyur na de'i tshe lhag mthong sgom pa dang*/ zhi lhag cha mnyam du 'jug pa'i tshe mngon par 'du mi byed pa'i btang snyoms sgom pa rnams bshad de/

sgom rim dang por/ gal te sems bying bar gyur pa bsal bar ma byas na de'i tshe shin tu bying bas lhag mthong med de sems dmus long bzhin du 'gyur ro// de lta bas na sems bying bar gyur na bsal bar bya'o// gang gis lhag mthong bsgoms pas shes rab shin tu shas che bar gyur pa de'i tshe/ des phyi rol kho nar mar me rlung la bzhag pa bzhin du sems shin tu g.yo bar 'gyur te/ de'i phyir de kho na nyid shin tu gsal bar mthong bar mi 'gyur ro// de bas na de'i tshe zhi gnas bsgom par bya'o// zhi gnas shas che ba 'gyur na shes rab bsgom par bya'o// zhes dang*/ gang gi tshe gnyis ka mnyam du 'jug pa de'i tshe/ lus dang sems la gnod par ma gyur bar du mngon par 'du byed pa med par gnas par bya'o// zhes gsungs so// de lta bu'i don mdor bsdu na/ sems nyid sgom med yengs med gnyis la tshang ste/ 'di las dang po pas shes par bya ba la/ mi bsgom pa ni zhi gnas dang glod pa'i phyogs yin pas de ha cang shas che na bying ba skye la ma yengs pa ni lhag mthong dang bsgrims pa'i phyogs yin pas de ha cang shas che na rgod pa skye bas grims lhod snyoms par mnyam gzhag skyong dgos par bzhed de/ rje sgam po pas/ bcas bcos ma byed lhug par zhog /lta nyul ma byed rang gar zhog /yid la ma byed dmigs med zhog /ces gsungs/ des na sgom 'dod myong 'dod dang 'di sgom snyam pa'i blo bzo ci'ang mi byed par gshis lugs rang babs kyi rang ngo sgrib med de ka rang bzhin yongs shes su skyong zhing de kar nges shes bskyed de/ sa ra has/ 'khor 'das kun gyi rtsa bar gyur pa sems// rtogs nas sgom du med kyis lhug par zhog /rang la bzhag nas gzhan du 'tshol ba a re 'khrul// 'di yin 'di min med do gnyug ma'i ngang*// zhes gsungs/ 'on kyang bsgom rgyu gang yang med pa'i ngang nas/ sems rtse gcig pa lta bur rang la nyams myong ci yod kyi thog nas ma yengs pa zhig nges par dgos te/

bram ze chen pos/ kye ma rang gi de nyid mtshon te ltos// ma yengs sems kyi lta dang bral gyur na// yengs pa'i sems kyis de nyid rtogs mi 'gyur// dngos po'i tshang tshing gseb tu de nyid nor bu gtor/ zhes dang*/ sha wa ris/ kyai ma ma yengs sems kyis rang gis rang la ltos// zhes dang*/ bir wa pas/ yod med cir yang mi rtog ngang la ma yengs bzhag /ces dang*/ til+li pas/ yengs pa med na sgom pa'i rgyal po yin// zhes dang*/ mai tri pas/ ngang la ma yengs gnas pa las// zhes gsungs pa ltar ro// don 'di la ci'ang mi bsgom par rang sems rang lugs su 'jog pa la zhi gnas dang*/ don thog nas ma yengs pa la lhag mthong dang*/ bsgom med yengs med ro mnyam du gyur pa ni zhi lhag zung 'jug gi don tshang zhing*/ 'di la mdo phyogs nas rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes dang*/ rtog bral ma 'khrul pa'i rig pa dang*/ rang bzhin gyi stong nyid ces brjod cing*/ sngags phyogs nas lhan skyes ye shes dang*/ rang bzhin gyi 'od gsal dang*/ thams cad stong pa zhes brjod la/ sgom rim tha ma las/ ji ste gang gi tshe bying ba dang rgod pa las dben pa'i phyir mnyam par zhugs shing rang gi ngang gis 'jug pas de kho na nyid la sems shin tu gsal ba byung bar gyur pa de'i tshe rtsol ba glod pas btang snyoms su bya ste/ de'i tshe zhi gnas dang lhag mthong zung du 'brel ba'i lam grub pa yin par rig par bya'o// zhes gsungs so// 'di ni dmigs bya'i don las logs su gyur pa'i chos gzhan gang yang rnam par mi rtog cing don de nyid la sems rtse gcig tu 'jog pa zhi gnas dang*/ de'i don rang bzhin rnam par 'byed cing rnam par rtog pa'am/ de'i ngo bo nyid med par rtogs pa'i nges shes lhag mthong du 'gyur la/ de gnyis 'dres shing mi phyed pa ni zhi lhag zung 'jug tu 'gyur ba'o// bdun pa lhag mthong gi rang 'bras ni/ de ltar rnams kyis spyir sems 'tshol ba'i lung bstan nas/

de btsal ba'i 'bras bu ji ltar rnyed na/ sngon nas so so'i thad du cung zad re bshad pa ltar yin yang da dung bshad na rang gi sems 'di'i rten ni phyi nang bar gsum gang du'ang ma brten cing*/ sems kyi ngo bo kha dog dbyibs ngos bzung dang bral ba sems kyi rang mdangs gnyis med skye 'gag gnas gsum gyi mtha' dang bral ba des na gang dang gang du ji ltar yang rnyed par ma gyur pa'i stong pa chen po de nyid spros pa bya rtsol gyi mtha' thams cad kyis dben pa ste/ de yod pa'i dngos po nyid du ma dmigs shing*/ de bzhin du med pa dang gnyis ka dang gnyis ka ma yin pa ste mtha' bzhi las grol ba/ sems chos rnams kyi rang bzhin dam pa/ don dam pa'i dbyings/ kun tu rtog pas brtag par bya ba ma yin pa/ yang dag pa gdod ma'i ngo bo stong chen lhun grub tu rig pa zhig tu 'ong ba yin/ don sngon chad dngos por 'dzin pa'i sgrib pas rmongs nas stong pa la stong par ma mthong*/ bdag med pa la bdag med par ma mthong pas/ 'khrul pa lu gu rgyud du gyur pa/ 'dir chos kun gyi snying po man ngag zab mo'i lam la nyams len byas pa dang*/ bla ma dam pa'i byin rlabs chen po'i mthus rang sems gdod nas sgrib bral gyi gshis skye med stong pa nyid kyi gnas lugs phyin ci ma log go ma 'dzol ba yin lugs yin bzhin mngon sum du mthong du med pa'i tshul gyis mthong ste thag chod pa yin/ 'di la man ngag gzhan du 'di ltar gsungs te/ gang mthong na stong pa nyid/ gang gis mthong na stong pa nyid kyis/ ji ltar mthong na stong pa nyid du/ thabs sam rkyen gang gis mthong bar byed pa po gang yin pa'ang stong pa nyid de/ stong pa nyid kyis stong pa nyid la/ stong pa nyid du stong pa nyid ces ngo sprod kyi rnam par dbye ba bzhi sbyor du 'gyur/ zhes sogs thams cad stong pa nyid du sbyar nas gsungs/ de bzhin rgyal ba'i bka' nas phyi stong pa nyid/

nang stong pa nyid/ phyi nang stong pa nyid/ stong pa nyid stong pa nyid/ chos thams cad stong pa nyid sogs stong nyid bcu drug gam sum cu sogs mang du gsungs/ stong pa nyid de rnams la'ang don thob tu rgyas bshad cher yod kyang bshad mi dgos/ don stong pa nyid 'di rnams kyang dbyings stong pa tsam du bzung na mi yong*/ stong pa nyid lhun grub tu rtogs dgos par 'dug /de'ang dper bgyis na nam mkha' ltar rang sems ngo bo kun nas stong pa chos nyid de/ de las nye bar nam yang g.yo ba med bzhin du rnam par snang ba'i rtsal mdangs 'gags pa med pa sna tshogs 'char zhing*/ rnam pa sna tshogs ji ltar shar yang gang shar thams cad stong pa chen por lhun grub ste/ mdor na snang stong gnyis med/ rig stong dbyer med/ gsal stong dbyer med/ bde stong dbyer med ces sogs go zhing rtogs nyams su myong dgos pa yin/ de'ang mdo rgyud man ngag rnams su 'khor ba dang mya ngan las 'das pa'i chos ji snyed pa thams cad ngo bo nyid kyis rab tu stong par bstan cing stong pa nyid kho nar rnam par snang ba'i rtsal 'gags pa med pa sna tshogs 'char zhing lhun gyis grub pa nyid du gsal bar gsungs/ de ltar na 'khor 'das gnyis la 'di lhun grub dang lhun grub min zhes/ phyogs dang rigs su bcad pa yod na ni des lhun grub gsha' ma ma rtogs pas mtshan mar 'dzin pa'i 'ching ba dam por gyur pa yin/ 'dir zab mo'i don gyi nges pa rnyed na 'ching ba mtha' dag rnam par grol bas 'khor 'das la bzang ngan du mi 'byung zhing bzang ngan dbyer med kyi don zab mo mthong mod/ 'di don gyis na stong pa lhun grub gang yin pa de 'bras bu lhun grub tu 'gro/ gzhan yang rig stong snang stong gsal stong bde stong rnams gdod nas zung du 'jug pa lhun grub chen po'i gnas lugs su go bas na rang sems dngos po'i gshis kyi gnas lugs 'di nyid la dri ma sgrib pa'i rkyen gyi cha ma dag par bya ba'i rnam pa dor ba dang bral bar bya ba cung zad tsam yang med cing bsgrub par bya ba'i yon tan gyi tshogs blang ba dang thob par bya ba spu tsam yang med de/

gdod ma nas byang chub chen po'i rang bzhin yin pa'i gnad kyis so// de ltar bsal bzhag med pa'i don gyis rang sar rang grol ba ste/ gnyen po gzhan la ltos pa skad cig kyang med par 'ching ba nyid grol ba'i rgyal po bla na med pa gtan la phebs pas spang blang re dogs kyi mtshan ma thams cad rang sar rang grol don gyi snying po mngon du gyur pa yin te/ lung las/ gang gis 'ching bar byed pa'i rgyu// de ni grol bar byed pa'i lam// 'di na 'ching ba gang yang med// 'ching ba gang yin de grol ba// zhes dang*/ slob dpon klu sgrub kyis/ rtogs na gang gis 'ching bar nus pa khyod kyis smos// 'ching ba gang yin de ni ye nas grol ba nyid// gang la bcings dang 'ching bar byed pa ma grub pas// nags la gnas pa'i glang po gang bder rgyugs su chug /ces dang*/ mkhan po chen po bo dhi satwas/ mnyam nyid dbyings las mi g.yo cho 'phrul sna tshogs ston// chu bran sna tshogs rgya mtshor gcig go ba tshwa'i ror// du ma ro gcig 'di la tha dad yod ma yin// thams cad gnyug ma'i ro yis khyab pas bde// zhes dang*/ grub thob lū hi pas/ gnyug ma'i shes pa 'gyur med mngon du gyur nas kyang*// 'dod pas sangs rgyas logs su 'tshol ba ngal ba ste// glang po rnyed nas glang po'i rjes 'tshol ji bzhin no// nga ni sangs rgyas med par shes pas 'dod blo bral// zhes dang*/ grub thob ghu na dhi pas/ snang srid ye grol chos kyi dbyings// phyag rgya che la spangs rtogs med// nam mkha'i bya yis gang ma 'dzin// byis pas rtsol ba sha thang chad// rtsol med ngang du lhug ger zhog /ces dang*/ ḍoṃ bhi he ru kas/ srid zhi mnyam nyid spros dang bral// rtsol sgrub byed pa sha thang chad// yul sems gnyis med zang thal la// tha dad 'dzin pa nyon re mongs// bdag gzhan gnyis med chos sku la// bzang ngan 'dzin pa snying re rje// zhes dang*/

slob dpon chen po zla ba grags pas/ gang du'ang ma mthong long ba'i mig /ci yang mi sems gti mug dang*// gang du'ang ma phyin 'phye bo'i 'gros// ci yang ma thob dbul po'i gter// zhes dang*/ slob dpon chen po nyi ma sbas pas/ yul la bltas pas skye ba med// sems la bltas pas spros dang bral// gnyis med don 'di blo las 'das// ngas ni ci yang mi shes so// zhes sogs gsungs pa dang*/ rje rgya ras kyis/ sems ji bzhin bzhag pa chos kyi sku// blo yi rtog pa rang sar grol// don bsam du med pa zhig nyams su longs// zhes gsungs pa sogs kyi lung shin tu mang ngo*// ༈ //gsum pa ro gcig gi rnal 'byor bshad pa la/ gnyid dang rmi lam gyi dpes snang ba sems su ngo sprod pa dang*/ chu dang 'khyags rom gyi dpes snang stong zung 'jug tu ngo sprod pa dang*/ chu dang rlabs kyi dpes chos thams cad ro mnyam du gtan la dbab pa gsum las/ dang po gnyid dang rmi lam gyi dpes snang ba sems su ngo sprod pa ni/ de'ang gnyid kyi dus ji ltar snang yang sems las logs su med pa ltar/ da ltar tshogs drug gi snang ba thams cad kyang rmongs pa gti mug gi gnyid log pa'i rmi lam yin zhing*/ rang sems las gzhan du med pas snang ba gang gi yul thog de kar glod nas bzhag pa nyid kyis/ phyi'i yul snang dang rang gi sems zhes gnyis su dbye rgyu med par ro gcig tu 'dres par 'gyur te/ rnal 'byor dbang phyug gling gis/ mdangs rmi lam nyams su myong ba de// snang ba sems su ngo sprod pa'i// slob dpon zhig lags te go lags sam// zhes gsungs/ dper mtshon na rmi lam du sa rdo ri brag rta glang po skyes pa bud med ji ltar rmis kyang*/ rang phar song ba'ang med/ gzhan tshur 'ong ba'ang med/ rang mal sa las ma g.yos par de dag gi snang ba shar ba yin/ 'on kyang de dag gi gzugs ma 'gags par ni shes pa gnyid kyis 'khrul pa dang sngar goms kyi bag chags sna tshogs su shar ba yin pas rmi lam byung dus bden pa ltar snang yang*/

gnyid sad nas de dag gang yang mi bden pa ltar/ 'di ltar snang grags kyi chos dgra gnyen gyi chags sdang la sogs pa 'di thams cad ma rig pa'i gnyid kyis non pa'i so so'i skye bo phyin ci log rnams la de dag mi bden byas kyang*/ gnyid dus kyi rmi lam bzhin a 'thas su snang la/ bla ma'i byin rlabs zhugs nas gzhi'i gnas tshul sad de/ phyi'i snang ba dang nang gi rig pa gnyis gnyis med mkha' la nyi ma shar ba lta bu'i rtogs pa shar ba'i tshe gnyid sad pa'i rmi lam bzhin du bden par ma grub pas/ snang ba ji ltar shar yang de nyid mdog ma 'gyur gra ma nyams pa chos skur bkra lam gyis shar te/ sgom nyams kyi go nas thon/ sems 'dzin gyi rgya las grol/ bag chags sgom du shar ba'i dus yin pas/ phyi nang thams cad sgrib g.yog med par zang thal du lam mer shar te/ mtshan brjod las/ ye shes snang ba lam me ba// zhes pa de'o// 'di'i skabs nyams kyi lhad med pas gnas cha skad cig kyang med par 'khor 'das kyi snang ba bkra hram me ma 'gags/ go yul gyi slad med pas sgom min gyis dogs pa dang 'gyur ba skad cig kyang med/ bsgoms byung gi shes rab nags la me mched pa lta bur yod/ de'i rjes su 'brang nas 'dzin pa zhugs na rtog dpyod kyi shes par song nas gcig chog gi rgyal sa shor dogs yod de/ rtogs pa'i so ma zin pa ro gcig 'dres pa'i rba la g.yeng zer ba'ang 'di la ngos bzung*/ ro gcig gis mnyam rjes 'dzin mi 'dzin ces pa ste/ rgod tshang pas/ 'khor ba zhes pa 'dzin pa la zer bas/ ngas 'khor ba 'di la tho ler byed pa yo ler byed pa byol ler byed pa yin gsungs nas/ gnas gcig tu lo gsum mi bzhugs par spong dag byed de/ ri khrod gzhan du spo ba'i rnam thar yod 'dug cing*/ tshul 'di la/ sa ra has/ til gyi shun pa tsam gyi zug rngus kyang*// nam zhig sdug bsngal 'ba' zhig skyed par byed// gang la zhen pa yod na de yang thongs// zhes gsungs so/

zhen med sgyu ma'i rang 'gros 'ba' zhig la song ba'i tshe ni/ thams cad chos sku'i yo lang 'ba' zhig tu yong ste/ til+li pas/ gser gyi ri yi ngos la bya 'phur na// bya yi rang bzhin bor nas ser por snang*// de ltar rang bzhin ngos nas 'khor ba'i chos// 'khor ba'i rang bzhin bor nas chos skur snang*// zhes sogs gsungs pa'o// gnyis pa chu dang 'khyags rom gyi dpes snang stong zung 'jug tu ngo sprod pa ni/ 'di ltar snang ba'i chos thams cad snang ba'i dus de nyid du ji ltar shar ba'i thog tu ci'ang mi bsgom zhing bzo bcos med par ma yengs tsam du glod nas bzhag pas snang ba'i steng du zung 'jug gi go rtogs skye ste bde cham gyis 'gro/ der snang ba dgag ma dgos/ stong pa bsgrub ma dgos shing*/ snang ba du mar snang yang snang sems gcig gi ngo bor cir yang ma grub pas stong pa zhes bya la/ cir yang ma grub bzhin du cir yang snang bar 'dug pas snang stong zung 'jug gam ro gcig pa zhes bya ste/ 'khyags pa dang chu bzhin no// tshul des na bde stong gsal stong rig stong zung 'jug kyang shes par bya bas du ma ro gcig tu rtogs pa zhes bya ste/ sa ra has/ rtogs par gyur na thams cad de yin te// de las gzhan zhig sus kyang rtogs mi 'gyur// klog pa de yin 'dzin dang sgom pa'ang de// zhes gsungs pas/ dper na chu'i dngos po grang bas bsdams pas 'khyags rom du song yang chu las ma 'das mod kyang sra mkhregs kyi gong bur snang la/ de bzhin rang sems stong pa ma rig 'khrul pa'i gzung 'dzin gyis bsdams pas phyi yul snang ba dang nyon mongs rnam rtog 'khor ba'i chos can du song la/ 'khyags pa de nyid me nyi'i drod kyis bzhus pas chu las ma 'das pa'i rang lugs ma bcos sla bsil rlan pa sngar gshis su langs pa ltar/ 'khrul rtog de bla ma dam pa'i byin rlabs dang*/ lam gyi gdams pa gnyis gnyis med ye shes kyi mes snang 'dzin dang nyon mongs rnam rtog 'khyags pa chur zhu ba ltar sangs pas/

bden snang rig pa dang stong nyid zung du 'jug pa ma bcos gdod ma'i gnas lugs kyi gshis su langs pas/ phyi ru snang ba chos sku'i rgya yan/ nang du rang rig bde ba chen po/ gang shar chos sku'i rgya yan la longs spyod/ 'khor 'das chos sku'i rol par shar/ gzhi 'bras dbyer med kyi don rtogs/ rnam rtog chos sku/ 'khor ba myang 'das/ nyon mongs ye shes su gnas 'gyur bas/ rgyu 'dod chags zhe sdang sogs dug lngas 'bras bu ye shes kyi mdangs ston/ dug lnga'i zhen pa dag byed rang rig ye shes kyis byas pas/ 'khor 'das gnyis med de lta bu la dgongs te/ dpal sa ra has/ khams gsum ma lus 'di dag thams cad ni// 'dod chags chen pos gcig tu kha dog bsgyur cig dang*// zhes so// 'di skabs su la la'i rjes shes la sngar gyi stong 'dzin ma dag pa'i shugs kyis stong pa phyogs gcig tu 'char ba'ang yod pas snang ba thams cad snang stong gnyis med zung 'jug tu rtogs par byed dgos pa'o// gsum pa chu dang rlabs kyi dpes chos thams cad ro mnyam du gtan la dbab pa ni/ chu rlabs chu nyid las shar ba bzhin du/ chos thams cad sems nyid kyi rang mdangs snang ba tsam du nges shes thag chod pas gnyis su 'dzin pa gtan nas spangs te/ gnyis med gang shar cir snang gi rang bzhin yongs shes klong yangs bskyangs pas chos kun ro mnyam zung 'jug yangs pa'i dpal thob par 'gyur te/ sa ra has/ ji srid sems las rnam 'phros pa// de srid mgon po'i rang bzhin te// chu dang rlabs dag gzhan yin nam// zhes gsungs/ dper mtshon na chu'i dngos gzhi lta bu ni sems nyid kyi gshis skye med mtha' bral blo 'das kyi ngo bo ye nas rnam dag ye shes chen po'i rang bzhin du bzhugs pa de nyid yin zhing*/ chu de las rlabs shar ba bzhin ni sems de nyid kyi rang mdangs 'gags med kyi 'char sgor snang ba khams gsum gyis bsdus pa'i snang srid 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad pa yin zhing*/

chu rlabs chu la thim pa ltar ni/ don logs su chad pa'am dngos por grub pa rdul tsam ma grub par shes pas sems kho rang gi ngo thog tu grol bar 'char te/ lang gshegs las/ rnam rtog bag chags 'brel pa yis// sna tshogs sems las byung ba yi// mi rnams la ni phyi rol snang*// 'jig rten pa yi sems tsam mo// phyi rol snang ba yongs med de// sems ni sna tshogs rnams su shar// zhes dang*/ gur las/ gzugs dang sgra dang de bzhin dri// ro dang reg byar skyes pa'i dngos// rin chen sems 'dir brjod nyid de// chos dbyings mchog tu zhi nyid do// gzugs dang tshor dang 'du shes dang*// 'du byed dang ni rnam par shes// thams cad sems 'di'i dngos po las// thub pas gzhan du ma gsungs so// zhes so// 'o na gzugs sogs phyi rol gyi dngos por snang ba 'di ji lta bu zhe na/ sems nyid kyis rang gi gnas lugs ma rig cing rang so ma zin par bdag gzhan gnyis su bzung nas der 'dzin gyi rtog pas bag chags bsags pa'i 'khrul ngor phyir rol gyi dngos po lta bur snang ba ste/ lang gshegs las/ bag chags kyis ni dkrugs pa'i sems// don du snang ba rab tu byung*// don yod ma yin sems nyid de// phyi rol don mthong log pa yin// zhes dang*/ gur las/ thog ma med pa'i srid gyur nas// phyi rol don du brtags pa de// thams cad sems kyi rnam 'phrul zhing*// sems ni kun tu song ba'o// zhes gsungs so// 'o na phyi rol du snang ba tsam du ma zad sra mkhregs la sogs pa'i dngos po rang mtshan par grub pa ji ltar yin zhe na/ 'khrul pa'i bag chags shin tu mang po goms shing 'thas par gyur pa las/ phyi rol du'ang dngos po sra mkhregs la sogs pa'i rang mtshan par snang ba yin te/ bram ze chen pos/ rlung gis chu la zhugs shing dkrugs pa yis// 'jam pa'i chu yang rdo yi gzugs su 'gro// rtog pas dkrugs pa'i rmongs pa gzugs med la// shin tu sra zhing mkhregs pa nyid du 'gyur/

zhes dpe don dang sbyar nas bshad pa ltar ro// skabs 'dir snang ba'i ngo bo gtan la phebs pa na/ snang ba'i ngo bo'am rang bzhin gang du'ang grub pa med pa'i stong nyid dang snang ba'i snang tshul ma 'gags par snang ba gnyis dbyer med du 'byung dgos te/ byang chub sems 'grel las/ ji ltar bu ram mngar ba dang*// me yi rang bzhin tsha ba bzhin// de bzhin chos rnams thams cad kyi// rang bzhin stong pa nyid du 'dod// ces dang*/ kun rdzob stong pa nyid du bshad// stong nyid kho na kun rdzob yin// med na mi 'byung nges pa'i phyir// byas na mi rtag ji bzhin no// zhes gsungs so// gzhan snang sems 'dres pa zhes lan tshwa dang chu bsres pa 'dra ba yod pa ma yin te/ sha wa ri pas/ rang gi sems nyid rtogs na phyag rgya chen po ste// ji ltar snang ba 'di yang rang gi sems las logs na med// ces gsungs pa yin no// de ltar rtogs nas snang stong zung 'jug gam bden gnyis dbyer med stong nyid mtshan ma med pa'i ngang nas mos gus la sogs shes rgyud steng du rang 'char yong rigs rnams de kas khyab kyang*/ dag snang snying rje sogs 'char dka' ba'i rigs der ched du blo sbyong ba'i rten 'brel gyi nyams len la brtson/ gshis blo 'das kyi rtogs pa skyong ba dang*/ mdangs blos byas kyi rten 'brel bsgrig pa gnyis/ 'gal med mnyam pa nyid du lam du 'khyer ba gtso bor bya dgos/ de'ang bla ma sangs rgyas kun 'dus su shes pa'i mos gus brjed med/ snang srid thams cad bla ma'i rol par go ba'i dag snang*/ rig pa'i rang mdangs bskyed rim du langs pa'i bskyed rdzogs/ spros bcas bzlas brjod rnams kyang ya ma bral ba'i zung 'jug /'gro drug ma lus pha mar shes pa'i snying rje/ de rnams kyi don du sems bskyed sangs rgyas thob 'gyur gyi smon lam sogs gnyis chos thams cad la rang rtsal phyogs med du sbyangs nas mthar ni de rnams kyang so so ma yin pa'i bla ma rang sems gnyis med/

snang srid sems kyi rol pa/ bskyed rdzogs zung 'jug chen po/ stong nyid snying rje dbyer med rnams kyi klong du 'ub gang chub/ rtsal rdzogs gang 'grub/ du ma ro gcig gi don la bslab/ de nas kyang chos thams cad la rtsal sbyangs pas 'byongs par byed la ro gcig du ma mngon du 'gyur bar byed de gcig shes kun grol zhes pa tshig tsam du mi 'jog nyams su len zhing*/ de nas chos thams cad la shes rab kyi snang ba phyogs med du ches cher rgyas pa zhig mdzad dgos pa yin tshod du 'dug /'di'i chos nyid rnal 'byor pa la rjes shes stong nyid kun tu 'gro bar 'char ro// chos kyi dbyings kun tu 'gro ba ro gcig du mar shar ba zhes bya ste/ don rang gi sems ngo bo stong pa nyid rnam pa thams cad par 'char ba'i tshul gyis gnas pa rtogs te/ 'di ltar rtogs pas rang don gcig chog ma'i rgyal sa zin nas kyang rang don rkyang par mi gol bar bya/ de'ang dang po stong nyid de ka snying rje'i rtsal du sbyangs pas na/ stong nyid snying rjer shar/ rang 'dod kyi 'khri ba zad/ chos rnams kun dang rgyal ba'i thugs sems can kun gyi sems thams cad ma lus pa ste/ mdor na 'khor 'das ma lus rang sems su rtogs pas/ rang snang gzhan snang ma lus dbang du 'dus shing*/ rang sems kyi ngo bo ye nas rang dag bzhugs pa de ltar rtogs pas rkyen byas nas/ thugs rje'i shugs stong nyid kyi rtsal snying rje'i dbang gis 'khor ba'i sems can ma rig pas bsgribs pa thams cad kyang rang gi rtogs pa lta bur rang grol du gtong bar bslab pa de ni/ gzhan don lhun grub chen po'am rtsol med dam pa 'grub pa yin/ de'ang rang don 'grub nas gzhan don byed pa'i skabs der yang*/ rang nyid kyis dang por nang du rten 'brel nges pa can bsgrigs pas/ de nas nges med kyi rten 'brel sna tshogs phyi ru rgyas pas gdul bya rnams kyi skal ba cha shas ji ltar yod pa de ltar mngon du gyur pas gang la gang 'dul gyi chos dang mdzad pa sna tshogs thabs la mkhas pas myur du sgrol bar byed pa de lta bu ni shin tu gal che ste/

de med na 'gro don mtshan nyid pa mi yong de yod na 'gro don gsha' ma yong ba yin te/ de'ang rje dwags po rin po che la slob ma zhig gis/ bdag gis 'gro don byed par chog gam zhus par/ khyod kyis sems can gyi rgyud tshod shes sam/ de shes na 'gro don ran/ de mi shes na 'gro don mi nus te/ gdul bya lam log par 'chor/ deng sang nged rang sgom chen 'ga' re 'dis sgom rta ri ba la khas len khyi mi ri ba de 'dra'ang byed mkhan 'dug cing*/ ston pa 'ga' res sgom khyi mi ri ba la khas len rta ri ba'ang byed mkhan 'dug pas/ de tsho so sor shes dgos gsungs/ de bzhin bka' brgyud gong ma'i gsung shin tu mang*/ gdul bya'i rgyud tshod mi shes par// blo chung gis 'gro don ma byed cig /be'u sbrel g.yang la 'chor dogs yod/ ces gsungs/ des na 'gro don byed pa la nges med kyi rten 'brel nang nas rgyas pas dus gsum ji ltar shes pa zhig dgos pa yin te/ de'ang rje lha rtse ba ngag dbang bzang po rnam rgyal lhun por bzhugs pa'i skabs/ snga dro rtogs ldan zhig gis rgya gar rdo rje gdan nas rgyal ba'i sku rten gan+dho la byin rlabs can zhig phul/ phyi dro rgya nag nas gnas bskor ba'i rtogs ldan zhig gis ting shag legs pa zhig phul bar rje mnyes nas da lam rten 'brel shin tu legs gsungs/ der rtogs ldan zhig gis bdag cag rnams shes rab dang ye shes res 'jog tu song bas rten 'brel mtha' dag go dka' bar 'dug pas 'dir rten 'brel zhig gsung bar zhu zhus pas/ de la khyod rang zer ba ltar bden/ ye shes la rang dbang thob pa'i rnal 'byor pas/ rde'u'i 'gre log tsam la'ang dus gsum gyi lung ston shes pa yin/ de tsam rang med kyang rje 'brug pa'i thugs rjes rten 'brel ha lam shes zhes gsungs pa ltar yong ba yin par 'dug cing*/ de nas gdul bya de rnams la so so'i skal ba dang mthun par chos ston te/

de'ang lam rim dang mthun par ston dgos pa'am/ cig car du ngo sprod pa'am/ thod brgal du ngo sprod dgos pa so sor te/ de ltar ma bstan par/ smar zhig zong zhig de kho na zhig bstan pa des sman yon du 'gro bar mi 'gyur bas/ de ltar so sor ston dgos pa ste/ de'ang rje lha rtse ba'i mdun du/ shes rab 'brug rgyas 'brog lcags sgo nas chos bros la byon par dang por skra phud ma bzhes/ rje dpag bsam dbang por phul gsungs pa yang zhus par/ khrid gcig gnang*/ khrid kyi sngon 'gro ma rdzogs gong nas/ khyod rdo rje 'chang du song bas rje dpag bsam dbang pos skra phud bzhes ma nus pa yin nam gsungs zhal rgyas mdzad cing*/ de ma thag tu/ rje rang rig rtogs pa'i rnal 'byor pa// lam gang shar dgag sgrub spang blang bral// zhes gsungs te/ spyan ce re gzigs pas dus de nyid du sems nyid chos sku'i rang ngo cig car du ngo 'phrod cing*/ de'ang sngon 'gro ma rdzogs gong nas ngo sprod par mdzad mod/ mtshan ldan bla mas snod ldan slob ma cig car du sangs rgyas par byed pa de 'dra ba'ang yod 'dug /yang gdul bya'i slob ma gzhan du yod na'ang de'i rgyud byin gyis brlabs nus pa zhig dgos te/ de'ang*/ rje lha rtse pa'i sku zhabs nas/ rtogs ldan dge 'dun phrin las zer ba la stod phyogs su ri pa la brdzang bar mdzad/ phyis ri pa slebs nas rje'i zhal nas khyod 'di nas 'gro dus gnas 'gyu'i ngo shes tsam las med pas da ci 'dra yod gsungs par/ kho na re/ bdag rten 'brel zla bdun ma'i mtshams la bsdad pa'i skabs nyin gcig spyil po nas lho phyogs su gangs ri zhig mthong ba des rkyen byas/ pha gi'i phyogs su bla ma bzhugs bsam pa'i mos gus drag po shar bas de nyin mang po ngus te/ de nub gsol ba btab pas rmi lam du mjal te khyod rtogs ldan de tsam skyo mi dgos nga dang nam yang 'bral ba med gsungs nas byin gyis brlabs pa'i snang ba shar/

de phyin dge sbyor la bar lag nyin mtshan med ces zhus pa de bzhin yang yong ba yin par 'dug pas 'di ltar shes dgos so// de min slob ma grol bar mi nus pas ni 'gro don rgya chung ste/ 'brel tshad thams cad 'khor ba nas 'dren nus pa de ltar yong bar shog bsams te dang po nas smon lam gsol 'debs byas na de 'bras mi bslu bas myur bar 'grub pa yin 'dug pa de bzhin brtson dgos pa'o// ༈ //bzhi pa sgom med kyi rnal 'byor nyams su len par bshad pa ni/ nyon shes gyi sgrib pa gnyis rtsa ba nas dag pas spangs pa phun sum tshogs pa 'di ni mnyam par gzhag pa'i gnas skabs/ 'di ni rjes la thob pa'i gnas skabs zhes bya ba med de/ sku gsum lhun gyis grub pa'i dag pa rab 'byams su gyur pas rtogs pa phun sum tshogs pa yin/ de'ang ro gcig chen po'i rtogs pa de sgom med du na spar ba'i skyong tshul la'ang*/ rje yang dgon pas/ bsgom bya'i yul dang sgom byed kyi sems// rig thog nas gnyis su 'dug gam ltos dang*// gnyis med kyi rig pa rten dang phrol la// dran med kyi shes pa phyal bar skyongs dang*// sgom nyin mtshan khor yug tu 'gro ba zhig 'ong gi /zhes gsungs pa ltar bsgom bya'i yul sems kyi gnas lugs de sgom par byed mkhan yang kho rang gi rig thog tu rdul tsam yang dbye rgyu med pa'i chos sku nyag gcig pa de la bsgom bya sgom byed/ dran bya dran byed kyi rten dang phral nas/ blo 'das dran med kyi shes pa phyal bar skyong ba yun bsrings pas nyin mtshan khor yul tu 'gro ba'o// de'ang 'khor 'das kyis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad ni rang gi sems kyi snang ba 'ba' zhig la sems kyi ngo bo'am rang bzhin nam gshis lugs ni ye gdod ma nas dngos dang dngos min snang dang mi snang stong dang mi stong yod med mtha' dbus rtag chad skye 'gags gzung 'dzin gyi mtshan ma thams cad dang bral ba 'pho 'gyur 'gro 'ong g.yo 'gul med pa rgyun mi 'chad pa nam mkha' ltar mtshan nyid dang bral ba ste/

sa ra ha'i zhabs kyi btsun mo do har/ lhan cig skyes gang bdud rtsi'i ro// rgyun mi chad pa'i bdag nyid do// chu bo'i rgyun dang nam mkha' bzhin// mi 'gyur dus rnams kun tu gnas// rtog pa'i rjes 'brang mtshan ma'i blos// nam yang shes pa ma yin no// bsam med yul la brtag tu med// yul med sgom par ga la 'gyur// sgom med nyid kyang yod ma yin// de yi don la gang 'dris pa// sangs rgyas kun gyi thugs dang mnyam// zhes dang*/ sha wa ris/ rgyu dang mi rgyu g.yo dang mi g.yo ba// ji ltar dngos dang dngos med snang stong dang*// thams cad ma lus nam mkha'i rang bzhin las// dus rnams kun tu nam yang g.yo ba med// nam mkha' nam mkha' zhes ni rab brjod kyang*// nam mkha'i ngo bo cir yang grub pa med// yod dang med dang snang dang mi snang dang*// de las gzhan du mtshon pa'i yul las 'das// de ltar nam mkha' sems dang chos nyid la// tha dad cung zad yod pa ma yin te// tha dad ming ni glo bur btags pa tsam// de ni don med rdzun gyi tshig tu zad// ces so// de ni bsnyen sgrub lha sngags thos bsam sgom pa'i mthu las de ltar glo bur du gyur pa ma yin par/ sems kyi rang gshis ye gdod ma nas rang lugs su yod pas tha mal gyi shes pa rjen pa bzo bcos bsgyur bkod ma byas pa'i ming ste/ skye bo tha mal pa byis pa bsam med sems kyis ma zin dus nas 'di ka rang chas su yod pa de rang thog tu phyin cing*/ de la bzang bzhag legs bsgyur gyi blo thabs gang yang byed ma dgos/ glo bur 'khrul rtog gi dri mas bslad pa'i skyon bsal dang bkru sbyang gi byi dor la'ang mi re/ bya rtsol gyi chos thams cad zad sar skyol/ 'khor 'das snang srid kyis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad rang bzhin med pa skye 'gag gnas gsum dang bral ba la re dogs kyi spang blang gang byas thams cad nam mkha' stong pa la bzo bcos 'phri bsnan gyi lhan po gdab pa lta bur song ba'i mtshang rig pas kun rdzob kyi rdzun phug rang rdib tu song*/

dran yengs la sogs pa'i thob shor dang*/ gsal 'grib re dogs bsgom bya sgom byed sgom 'dod zad pas skye med zang thal chen po stong nyid snying rje zung du 'jug pa'i dbyer med gnyug ma rgyun chad med pa ste/ dpal ri khrod dbang phyug gis/ sems yod gyur na chos kun rig gyur na// sems med pa la chos shig su yis rtogs// sems dang chos su snang ba thams cad ni// btsal na mi rnyed 'tshol mkhan gang yang med// med pas dus gsum ma skyes mi 'gags pa// de nyid gzhan du 'gyur ba med pa ni// rang bzhin bde ba chen po'i gnas lugs yin// zhes gsungs so// de bzhin gnas skabs thams cad du chos nyid nyag gcig gi snang ba las mi g.yo ba ni rjes thob tu chos nyid kyi ngang las mi g.yo ba zhes bya la/ chos nyid de ka thugs rje chen po'i rang bzhin du gyur pas srid pa ji srid bar sems can rnams la phan pa dang bde ba sgrub par mdzad pa ni mnyam bzhag tu thugs rje'i klong rdol ba zhes bya'o// thugs rje chen pos gzhan don mdzad pa la rjes thob kyi ming btags pa tsam yin la/ don la mnyam bzhag 'ba' zhig yin no// tshul 'di la sku gnyis zung 'jug ces bya ste/ rang don chos kyi sku las mi g.yo bar gzhan don gzugs skur 'char la/ shar ba de nyid rang don chos sku las mi g.yo bar zung 'jug tu bshad pa yin te/ de'ang rgyud bla ma las/ chos kyi sku las ma g.yos par// sprul pa'i rang bzhin sna tshogs kyis// skye ba mngon par skye ba dang*// zhes gsungs pa dang*/ do ha las/ gnyis med sems kyi sdong po dam pa 'di// khams gsum ma lus kun tu khyab par song*// snying rje'i me tog gzhan phan 'bras bu 'dzin// ces so// tshul 'di la phar phyin theg par/ lam chad pa 'jug pa chad pa'i dbang gis mi slob pa'i lam zhes bzhag pa ltar spang bya nyon mongs pa spong ba'i blo zad/ spong byed kyi gnyen po lam gyi chos zad nas lam chad de/

gzhi ji lta ba de kar zad pas chos gzhi thog tu phebs pa zhes gsungs/ bsgom bya sgom byed zad pa'i dbang gis sgom med kyi rnal 'byor zhes bya ba yin te/ 'di la brtag gnyis las/ bsgom med sgom pa po yang med// lha med sngags kyang yod ma yin// spros pa med pa'i rang bzhin la// lha dang sngags ni yang dag gnas// rnam snang mi bskyod don yod dang*// rin chen dpag med sems dpa' 'o// zhes dang*/ dpal 'dus pa dang*/ dus kyi 'khor lo las kyang*/ dngos po med pa bsgom pa med// bsgom par bya ba sgom pa min// de ltar dngos po dngos med pas// bsgom pa'ang dmigs su med pa'o// zhes 'bras bu'i gnas skabs nyid du gsal bar bshad pa dang*/ de las gzhan du phyin sa med pas 'jug pa chad de/ de las gong du 'phul sa med pas mi gnas pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa phyag rgya chen por gyur pa ste/ til+li pas/ kye ho 'di ni rang rig ye shes te// ngag gi lam 'das yid kyi spyod yul min/ til+li ngas ni cing yang bstan du med// rang gis rang nyid mtshon te shes par byos// zhes gsungs pa'i don mngon par byang chub nas mchog gi dngos grub thob par 'gyur ba'o// ༈ //rtsa ba'i sa bcad gsum pa phyag rgya chen po'i rjes kyi rim pa la/ rgyas par ngo sprod/ dbye ba/ gegs sel/ bogs 'don/ skyong tshul/ shan 'byed/ sa lam gyi rnam dbye/ 'bras bu'i grub tshul sogs spros na mtha' yas kyang*/ 'dir mdo tsam bsdu bar bya ba la// dang por phyag rgya chen po ngos bzung zhing ngo sprod bshad pa/ gnyis pa rang gi sems nyid ngos bzung zhing ngo sprod bshad pa/ gsum pa nyams rtogs kyi gegs dang 'phrang bsal ba bshad pa/ bzhi pa bogs 'don rtsal sbyong gi tshul bshad pa/ lnga pa nyams myong rtogs pa'i spu ris 'byed par bshad pa/ drug pa lam khyer spyod pa'i rim pa bshad pa/ bdun pa sa dang lam gyi ngos bzung bgrod tshul bshad pa/

brgyad pa mthar thug 'bras bu'i rdzogs tshul bshad pa'o// dang po phyag rgya chen po ngos bzung zhing ngo sprod par bya ba la/ rgyas par ngos bzung dang ngo sprod gnyis/ ngos bzung ba la ming*/ don/ rnam grangs/ ngo bo rab dbye shes ma shes kyi skyon yon sogs rnam pa mang yang*/ da res 'dir rnam grangs ngo bo rab dbye sogs bshad nas dgos pa med pas/ ming don ngos bzung dang*/ don dam ngo sprod gnyis kyi sgo nas bshad par bya ba ni/ dang po phyag rgya chen po'i ming don ngos bzung ba ni// rgya gar skad du/ ma hā mu dra/ bod skad du/ phyag rgya chen po zhes pa la/ 'ga' zhig gis/ ma hā chen po dang*/ mu dra rgya yin pa la/ phyag rgya'i sgra med pas phyag rgya chen po zhes mi 'thad par bzhed kyang*/ 'dir phyag gi sgra bsdu ba'i dbang du song ba las shugs kyis 'thon dgos pa'i lung 'og tu 'byung la/ spyir phyag rgya la rtags dang mtshan ma dang*/ nye ba'i mtshan nyid gsum gyi rnam grangs yin la/ dang po rtags kyi mtshan nyid ni/ rtags zhes bya ba de gdab par bya ba'am/ btab pa'i don gyis phyag rgya brjod pa ni/ dper na da ltar bdag lta bus gzhan la btab pa der rgya zer ba ltar/ phyag rgya chen po 'dis 'khor ba dang mya ngan las 'das pa'i chos ma lus pa thams cad la btab pas na phyag rgya dang*/ gnyis pa mtshan ma mtshon par byed pa'i phyag rgya brjod pa ni/ dper na da ltar 'jig rten na rgyal po'am dpon chen po des bka' ji ltar byas pa la 'bangs sde rnams kyis de las mi 'da' zhing 'da' bar mi nus pa ltar 'khor 'das kyi chos ma lus pa thams cad nges don phyag rgya chen po 'di las mi 'da' bas na phyag rgya zhes brjod pa yin la/ de skad du/ 'phags pa nam mkha' mdzod kyis zhus pa'i mdo las/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i phyag rgyas btab ces bya ba la/ de bzhin nyid dbyer med pa de ni phyag rgya ste/ phye ba med pa/ 'jug pa med pa/

mngon par zhen pa med pa/ mi bskyod pa/ bskyod par bya ba ma yin pa ste/ lha dang mi dang lha ma yin dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten gyis bskyod par mi nus so// de ci'i phyir zhe na/ lha dang mi dang lha ma yin dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten ni phyag rgya des btab pa nyid do// de bzhin gshegs pa'i phyag rgya de ni shin tu ma skyes pa'i phyag rgya/ shin tu mtshan ma med pa'i phyag rgya/ shin tu smon pa med pa'i phyag rgya/ shin tu 'dus ma byas pa'i phyag rgya/ 'dod chags dang bral ba'i phyag rgya/ de bzhin nyid kyis phyag rgya/ yang dag pa'i mtha'i phyag rgya/ nam mkha'i phyag rgya ste zhes sogs mang du gsungs/ chen po zhes pa ni nges don gyi chos 'di chos thams cad kyi don te/ 'di'i gong na gzhan med pas na chen po zhes bya ste/ gsang ba grub par/ bzhi pa gong na med pa'i rgyud// mngon par byang chub byed pa po// phyag rgya chen po rnam bsgom pa// de yi gong na gzhan med pa'o// zhes gsungs/ yang snyan rgyud gzhung las/ phyag ni gnyis med ye shes ngo yis zin// rgya ni 'khor ba'i mdud pa grol ba ste// chen po zung 'jug sgron me bltams pa la// zhes dang*/ phyag chen thig ler/ 'di ni phyag rgya chen po ste// phyag ni stong pa'i ye shes yin// rgya ni 'khor ba'i chos las grol// chen po zung du 'jug pa'o// zhes gsungs pas lung de gnyis don gcig par 'dug pas de'i don bshad na/ phyag ni snang stong rig stong sogs gnyis med kyi stong pa nyid rang rig pa'i ye shes ngo shes pa'i don te/ rim lnga las/ rang gis rang rig ye shes 'di// legs mthong gang yin 'dir phyag yin// zhes gsungs/ rgya ni 'khor ba'i rgya gzung 'dzin ma rig 'khrul pa las grol zhing des chos thams cad la rgyas btab ba'am 'debs pa'i don te/ gsang ba 'dus pa las/ dngos po thams cad dang bral ba// phung po khams dang skye mched rnams// gzung dang 'dzin pa rnam par spang*// chos bdag med pa mnyam nyid las// zhes gsungs/

chen po ni thabs shes snang sems sogs thams cad zung 'jug ces gnyis med mnyam par sbyor ba yin zhing*/ de lta bu bsgoms pa ni sgom pa thams cad kyi mchog nyid du 'gyur ba'i don te/ mai tri pas/ thabs dang shes rab mnyam sbyor ba// sgom pa mchog gi rnal 'byor pa// phyag rgya chen po mnyam sbyor ba// zhes so/ yang phyag rgya chen po 'di'i mtshan don ni/ gzhan yang dus 'khor gyi dka' 'grel pad+ma can las 'di ltar gsungs te/ phyag rgya zhes pa ni/ 'das pa dang*/ ma byon pa dang*/ da ltar byung ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad skyed par mdzad pa shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yin la/ rab tu mi gnas pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa'am/ mi 'pho ba'i bde bas bde ba la rgyas btab pas na phyag rgya ste/ las kyi phyag rgya dang*/ ye shes kyi phyag rgya las khyad par du gyur pa dang*/ 'khor ba'i bag chags dang bral bar gyur pas na chen po'o// zhes bshad de/ de bzhin mdo rgyud rnams nas shin tu mang bar gsungs kyang mang gis dogs pas ma spros pa'o// gnyis pa don dam du ngo sprod pa ni/ rje dwags pos/ snang srid 'khor 'das rnams chos nyid skye ba med pa'i ngang las mi 'da' bar rtogs pa ni phyag go /cir snang ci srid thams cad gnyug ma'i don las mi 'da' bas na rgya/ chos nyid rang grol du rtogs pas na chen po'o// zhes gsungs so// de bzhin/ rje gtsang pa rgya ras dang rgod tshang pa sogs kyis kyang phyag rgya chen po zhes pa ni/ snang srid 'khor 'das kyis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad rang sa rang sa nas so ma nyams mdog ma bsgyur bar dus gsum dus med du lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes las mi 'da' bas na phyag rgya/ de las logs su'am de'i phan nam gong na chos gzhan gang yang med pas na chen po zhes zer ba yin gsungs shing*/ yang bla ma gser sdings pa'i theg sgron las/ phyag rgya chen po'i nges tshig ni// las dang nyon mongs sgrib pa rnams// rang grol sems nyid chos sku ru// mjal ba'i phyir na phyag ces bya// mtshan ma'i rnam par rtog pa yis// 'da' bar mi nus phyir na rgya// mtshan nyid theg dang bya spyod sogs// theg pa kun las che bas na// chen po zhes ni brjod pa yin// zhes gsungs/

'di'i don gzhan rnams sngon dang 'dra bar 'dug /tshig dang po phyag rgya zhes pa'ang*/ dper na bla ma dang rgyal po lta bur skye bo rnams kyis mjal nas phyag byed pa bzhin/ 'dir yang las dang nyon mongs pa'i sgrib pa ma rig pa'i rtog pa sogs thams cad rang grol sems nyid de la 'dud dgos shing phyag byed pa ltar na phyag ces bya/ de'ang don du na rang grol chos sku'i gshis yin pas na gtso bo lta bu/ nyon mongs sgrib pa rnam rtog sogs de'i mdangs yin pas na 'bangs 'khor lta bu/ des na ji ltar yang gshis las mi 'da' bas na rgya zhes bya/ theg pa che chung gsang sngags kyi chos kun las ches cher zab lhag che bas na chen po zhes tshig tu brjod pa yin/ phyag rgya chen po 'dir mtshan gyi rnam grangs ni/ in+d+ra bho dhi'i ye shes grub pa las/ 'di ni don dam de nyid de// ye shes rdo rje bla med yin// kun tu bzang po zhes bshad cing*// phyag rgya chen po zhes bya ba// 'di ni chos skur shes bya ste// zhes gsungs pa de'i don 'di ni zhes pa sems/ de la ming gi rnam grangs don dam pa/ de bzhin nyid/ bla na med pa'i ye shes/ sems kyi rdo rje/ kun tu bzang po/ phyag rgya chen po/ chos kyi sku/ zhes sogs lung shin tu mang bas shes par bya'o// zhes gsungs pa yin la/ gzhan yang sbyor ba bdun par/ rang bzhin med dang de bzhin nyid// chos nyid dang ni chos mnyam pa// don dam la sogs rnam grangs kyang*// rang bzhin med pa 'di nyid las// der ni gzhan dag ma gsungs so// zhes bshad/ de bzhin bka' brgyud gong ma'i gsung rnams las kyang*/ phyag rgya chen po/ gdod ma'i mgon po/ sems nyid lhan skyes/ sems nyid kyi dkyil 'khor/ gzhi gnyug ma'i ngo bo/ rang bzhin gyis 'od gsal ba/ bde bar gshegs pa'i snying po/ chos kyi sku'i bzhugs tshul/ zhes sogs mang bar gsungs mod/ de thams cad sems la 'dus pas/

sems byas kyang phyag rgya chen po/ phyag rgya chen po byas kyang sems nyid rang yin par shes dgos so// phyag rgya chen po'i ngo bo ni/ gang du'ang mi gnas shing mtshan nyid thams cad dang bral ba kun la khyab pa/ dpe nam mkha' lta bur bshad de/ in+d+ra bho dhis/ ji ltar mi gnas nam mkha' ni// khyab cing mtshan nyid rnams dang bral// 'di ni don dam de nyid de// zhes sogs mang du gsungs pa'o// gnyis pa rang gi sems nyid ngos bzung zhing ngo sprod par bya ba la/ bsdus par lhan cig skyes pa rnam pa gsum dang*/ sku gsum gyi sgo nas ngo sprod pa tsam gyis chog kyang*/ chos kyi go don shes shing nyams rtogs shar ba'am/ de ltar ma yin yang sems rang rig gi dran pa skyong shes tsam yod pa rnams kyis kyang go zhing*/ go nyams rtogs pa sogs yod pa rnams la'ang*/ sems kyi ngo sprod 'di skor rang gi sems rgyud dang 'dre zhing go ba dang yid ches nges shes skye ba'i dgos pa yod phyir cung zad rgyas par phye nas bshad na 'di bzhin yin/ de la sa bcad nang tshan du dbye ba la// dang po rang sems 'khrul lugs 'khor ba'i sgo nas ngo sprod pa/ gnyis pa rang sems 'khrul med gnas lugs rig pa rtogs pa'i sgo nas ngo sprod pa/ gsum pa rang sems gnyug ma gcig chod kyi sgo nas ngo sprod pa/ bzhi pa rang sems lhan cig skyes pa rnam pa gsum gyi sgo nas ngo sprod pa/ lnga pa rang sems tha mal gyi shes pa gnas lugs ma bcos pa'i sgo nas ngo sprod pa/ drug pa rang sems ngo bo rang bzhin mtshan nyid gsum gyi sgo nas ngo sprod pa/ bdun pa rang sems mnyam rjes kyi sgo nas ngo sprod pa/ brgyad pa rang sems gzhi lam 'bras bu gsum gyi sgo nas ngo sprod pa/ dgu pa rang sems lta sgom spyod 'bras rnam bzhi'i sgo nas ngo sprod pa/ bcu pa rang sems phyag rgya chen por ngo sprod pa/ bcu gcig pa rang sems rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas su ngo sprod pa/

bcu gnyis pa rang sems sku gsum gyi sgo nas ngo sprod pa/ bcu gsum pa rang sems ye shes lnga'i sgo nas ngo sprod par byed pa'o// dang po rang sems 'khrul lugs 'khor ba'i sgo nas ngo sprad par bya ba la gzhi ngos bzung ba/ de las 'khrul tshul bshad pa dang gnyis so// dang po gzhi ngos bzung ba ni/ de'ang sems kyi gnas lugs la/ rgyal dbang rjes/ 'di ltar snang srid 'khor 'das gnyis bsdus kyi chos thams cad de kho na nyid las gzhan med cing*/ de nyid ye gdod ma nas rnam par dag pa dang*/ sus kyang bzo ma byas par lhun gyis grub pa dang*/ thams cad dang dbyer med du gnas pas tha dad med pa/ yod med la sogs pa'i sgro btags dang skur pa thams cad kyis ma bslad pa/ gzung 'dzin la sogs pa'i dri ma thams cad dang bral ba/ dgag sgrub la sogs pa blos byas thams cad kyi yul ma yin pas bsam brjod la sogs pa rtag chad thams cad las 'das pa/ sangs rgyas kyi dgongs pa chos thams cad kyi ngo bor gnas pa/ lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes sam chos sku zhes zer na'ang de lta bu'i ming 'dogs bzang pos ma bsgribs pa/ gnyug ma'i shes pa/ gdod ma'i shes pa zhes gsungs pa de ka phyag rgya chen po'i brjod bya'i don yin mod/ de ka la ni snang tsam du mi gnas pas rten 'brel gyi gzhi/ gang du'ang ma grub pas stong nyid kyi gzhi/ tha dad du mi gnas pas zung 'jug gi gzhi/ phyogs cha dang bral bas khyab gdal gyi gzhi/ zhes kun mkhyen pad dkar gyis gsungs/ lung ni/ rgyud rdo rje rtse mo las/ thog ma tha ma med 'di ni// sems can kun gyi shes pa dang*// de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po mchog /chos dbyings rdo rje chen po ste// zhes dang*/ sangs rgyas thod pa las/ sems nyid dri med me long bzhin// gang bsam de ni gzugs brnyan te// rmi lam lta bur shes mod kyi// 'on kyang rnam par rtog pas bzung*// zhes pa dang*/

mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho las/ shrī yig 'byung ba kun gyi don// phyi dang nang gi bdag nyid 'dod// 'di dag kun rdzob gzugs dang ni// gzugs med bde ba'i mtha' can gang*// e wam̐ la sogs gnyis med pa'ang*// shrī zhes bya ba'i ye shes bstan// ces sogs mang*/ de ltar kun gyi ngo bo kun khyab nam mkha' lta bu kun dang zung du 'jug pa blo bral khyab gdal chen po chos sku'i rang bzhin de'o// gnyis pa de las 'khrul tshul bshad pa ni/ de'ang lar ni bzang ngan med par rigs drug gi sems can kun gyi rgyud la ye nas gnas kyang*/ ma rig pas bsgribs nas/ rang sems rang gis ma mthong*/ rang ngo rang gis ma shes/ de'ang ma shes ma rig pa'i tshul ni rgyu mtshan lnga ste/ de'ang dang po ni/ phyag rgya chen po'i gnas lugs ka nas dag pa stong nyid smra bsam shes brjod kyi blo las 'das shing*/ ngos gzung bya 'dzin byed kyi gtad so gang yang med pas na ma rig pa ste/ dper bgyis na nam mkha' stong par ri mo mi btub pa 'dra ba dang*/ gnyis pa ni/ gnas lugs de yul yul can gyi dngos por ma gyur cing*/ rig bya dang rig mkhan med pas ma rig pa ste mig gis mig mi mthong ba lta bu/ gsum pa ni/ don zab mo de rtogs par byed pa'i rkyen/ bla ma mtshan ldan med pas ma rig pa ste rgyal bu 'bangs su 'khyams pa lta bu/ bzhi pa ni/ dbyings kyi ngo bo gcig tu ma grub pas/ rnam rtog sogs mdangs kyi 'char sgo cir yang 'char mod kyang gshis ma rig pa las mdangs ma rig pa sna tshogs shar bas na thams cad ma rig par song ste sman dug tu song ba lta bu/ lnga pa ni/ sems ye shes su gnas kyang bag chags dbang gis phyin ci log par bltas nas ma rig pa nyid du 'khrul te thag khra sbrul du 'khrul pa lta bu'o// zhes rje yang dgon pas gsungs 'dug cing*/ lung ni sngon sangs rgyas thod pa'i lung 'phros las/ 'on kyang rnam par rtog pas sgrib// ces gsungs pa dang*/
