rgyud las/ sems can rnams ni sangs rgyas nyid// 'on kyang glo bur dri mas sgrib// ces sogs gsungs mod/ don rang rang sems kyi ngo bo ye nas dag pa los yin yang*/ 'phral glo bur gyi dri ma 'khor ba'i bag chags sna tshogs kyis bsgribs/ don des na 'khrul pas mgo bo ches 'khor bas rang nyid snang ba la yul du bzung*/ rig pa la bdag tu bzung*/ mi bden pa la bden par bzung*/ med pa la yod par bzung*/ ma dag pa la dag par bzung*/ dag pa sems nyid chos sku la ma dag par mthong ste/ thams cad don dam rang dang go log nag por song*/ snang ba bdag gzhan gnyis med la gnyis 'dzin gyi chags sdang rmongs gsum gyi las bsags pas las las rnam smin myong*/ 'khrul don med par 'khrul nas 'khor ba la yang 'khor nying 'khor zo chu'i 'khyud mo bskor ba ltar byas nas nged rang tsho bsdad pa yin mod/ da de ltar 'khrul tshabs shin tu che ba de bzlog pa'i thabs ni/ mtshan ldan bla mar gsol ba 'debs pa dang*/ lam gyi snying po rang sems kyi ngo bo ma yengs par skyong bar byed dgos pa yin la/ de'ang*/ rje 'bri gung pa chen pos/ dran pa mkhas na sgom mkhas/ dran pa stor na sgom stor/ zhes gsungs te/ dran med 'khrul par shor na sgom dang bral ba dang*/ dran dang shes bzhin ldan na sgom gyi nyams len dang ldan pa yin pas de ltar du shes pa'i don du kha phyi la mi lta bar nang du log nas rang sems la rang gis lta ba gal che la/ rang sems la bltas kyang ngo bo ngos bzung med pas rang sems 'di ka ma brjed ma 'khrul tsam du glod nas 'jog pa yin/ ma yengs tsam de las gzhan du bzo bcos skad cig tsam mi byed/ ma yengs ma bcos pa'i ngang du 'jog /de las gnas pa 'gyu ba dang tshogs drug snang ba gang shar cir snang gi thog tu 'jog cing de dag gi ngo bo skyong*/ brjed na yengs med kyi dran pa rgyun du bsten par byed pa rnams dgos pa'o// gnyis pa rang sems 'khrul med gnas lugs rig pa rtogs pa'i sgo nas ngo sprod pa ni/

rang gi sems ye gdod ma nas chos kyi sku rang gsal chen por bzhugs pa de da bar du dri mas bsgribs mod/ da dri ma de bsal nas ngo bo ji lta ba rtogs par gnas lugs rtogs pa zer/ rtogs pa de'i ngo bo'am rang bzhin ni don rang gi sems cir yang ma grub pa bcos ma'i spros pa thams cad dang bral ba bsam sgom yul las 'das pa ste/ de'ang mthar thug pa ni/ srid zhi'i chos thams cad bsal bzhag bri gang 'ching grol bya rtsol gza' gtad ched 'dzin sogs bral ba zhig yin/ de ltar rtogs na ma rtogs na gang ltar yang rang sems blo 'das ngo bo de'i ngang nas mdangs 'gags med sna tshogs pa 'phro zhing*/ de ltar 'phro'ang ngo bo rang las ma g.yos par 'char ba des na don rang sems chos skur rtogs pas gnas na chos sku de'i ngo bo/ 'phro na chos sku de'i yo lang*/ ji ltar 'char yang chos sku'i rol pa las skad cig kyang 'da' sa med pa zhig tu shes yong ba yin/ thams cad chos sku'i rang bzhin du shes pa des na gang dang ci la'ang dgag sgrub spang blang rtsis gdab mi dgos par blo yangs rgyang nge ba zhig 'ong*/ de nas snang ba rkyen las skyes pa dang*/ stong pa rkyen dang bral ba gnyis skye med spros bral dus mnyam thug phrad du 'char/ snang ba sna tshogs skye med du shar bas snang ba chos sku'i rang rtsal te/ don dag hril du dril na chos sku ye shes klong yangs zhig tu rtogs pa yin/ de'ang don spyi'i go yul lam tshod 'jog tsam du ma lus pas rang sems gnas lugs ji lta ba rtogs/ 'khrul lugs ji lta ba rig pas snang rig gi thog tu gtan la phebs pa ste/ mdor na tha mal gyi shes pa chos sku rjen pa ru shar/ mngon sum du mthong*/ bde chen du myong*/ the tshom dang bral/ nges shes skyes/ thag chod rnyed/ rtsal 'byongs pa'o// de ltar rtogs pas bdag nyid grol ba ni shes bya'i gshis te dper na nyi ma shar na mun pa rang sar grol ba dang 'dra ste/

tog rtse zhabs kyis/ tha mal shes pa snying gi dbus su sad// tshogs drug dag na bde chen rgyun mi 'chad// ces gsungs/ 'chi med rdo rje'i glu las kyang*/ kye ma hoḥ ma bcos phyag rgya bde ba che// dran pa dran med klong du shar// skye med nam mkha' lta bur khyab// blo las 'das pa'i ngang du gnas// snang ba spros bral bde ba che// dran med cir yang mi rtog pa'i// dran pa sna tshogs sems su gsal// brtags shing btsal na yongs su med// skye ba med phyir 'dzin pa bral// thams cad blo las 'das par mthong*// zhes so// 'on kyang 'di ltar rig shes thag chod pa dka'/ 'phral du thag ma chod kyang gzhi de las nam yang mi 'gyur bas na da ltar lam sgom dus kyang sgom zhes bzang po bsgrub blo dang gzhan nas 'char rgyu yod par bsam mi dgos/ de bsam na kha phyir bltas kyi shes pa yin/ don rang sems gshis ji ltar 'dug pa de ka'i thog tu bzhag nas/ rang ngo de ka las ma yengs tsam pa'i 'dun pa byas nas bzhag pas chog /'di la'ang ched du sgom pa blos bzo ba sems 'dzin sogs byas na dri ma yin pas/ de ltar mi byed par sems rang babs su 'jog dgos rgyu yin/ don rang dran pa'i so ma shor tsam las gzhan mi dgos/ 'di zhes bsgom la tig tig med/ dmigs gtad bral bas na bsgom du med pa'i ngang nas ma yengs par bzhag /rnam rtog ma skyes gnas na gnas pa'i ngang der bzhag /sems rang gis rang ma brjed tsam zhig dgos/ rnam rtog skyes na de'i ngo bor bltas la de'i ngang du bzhag pa las ched du spong mi dgos/ phyi rol snang ba'i tshogs mig dang rnam shes yul du shar na de ka ngos bzung la rang thog tu bzhag /ched du ma 'dzin zhig /de ltar byas na nyams len gyi dge sbyor ma yengs pa/ gang shar gang snang gis sgom go chod pa yin/ dus rnams rgyun du ma yengs ma 'khrul ba byas na sgom dang 'bral ba med de ltar skyong bar byed pa la rang bzhin yongs shes sam rang bzhin rnam dag zer te/

rgyal po in+d+ra bhu tis/ rang bzhin ye nas rnam dag pa// gdod ma'i shes pa spros dang bral// de bzhin gshegs kun ngo bo nyid// bdag kyang 'di nyid rtogs pas grol// zhes dang*/ rje rgod tshang pas/ zab zhi spros bral 'dus ma byas pa'i dbyings// rang bzhin rnam dag bde ba chen po 'di// ye nas rang la gnas pas btsal ma dgos// rang gsal nyid du bzhag pa nyams len yin// zhes dang*/ karma pa chos grags rgya mtshos/ stobs bcu pa kun ma lus gshegs pa'i shul// rang bzhin rnam par dag pa sems kyi gshis// rtogs ldan bla ma'i drin gyis bdag gis rtogs// da ni 'khor ba yod snyam mi bgyid do/ zhes sogs gsungs pa'o// gsum pa rang sems gnyug ma gcig chod kyi sgo nas ngo sprod pa ni/ ngo sprod byas kyang zur nas lhan thabs zab mo ston rgyu yod pa ma yin zhing*/ sngar khrid pa'i nyams len gsal 'debs pa'am/ nyams su len lugs zhib par ston pa la ngo sprod zer ba yin/ de'ang mkhas pa chen po nā ro pa de nyid tshig la paṇ+ḍi tar gyur kyang don rtogs pa med pas ye shes mkha' 'gros brda sprad pa la brten nas/ rje btsun til+li pa'i phyag phyir lo bcu gnyis 'brengs te dka' ba bcu gnyis spyad nas kun gyi mjug tu mya ngam gyi thang chen po'i dkyil du maṇ+ḍal phul gsungs par chag chag 'debs pa'i chu dang*/ tshom bu'i me tog ma rnyed par/ sku las mtshal khrag phyung nas chag chag btab/ snyan mchog sogs bcad nas maṇ+ḍal phul ba'i dus su/ snod kyi dri ma dag par mkhyen nas mchil lham dpral bar brgyab pa dang lhan cig rdo rje'i tshig rkang bzhi pa 'dis ngo sprad pa yin 'dug ste/ de'ang ji skad du/ kye ho 'di ni rang rig ye shes te/ ngag gi lam 'das yid kyi spyod yul min/ til+li ngas ni ci yang bstan du med// rang gis rang nyid mtshon te shes par byos// zhes bstan pa de'i tshig rkang dang po'i don/

kye ho zhes pa til+li pas nā ro pa la bod pa'i tshig yin la/ 'di ni rang rig ye shes te/ zhes gsungs te/ 'di ni zhes pa phyi rol tu gzhan zhig mdzub tshug gis ston rgyu yod pa min te/ 'o na nang du gang ston rgyu yod ci la ngos 'dzin na 'og tu rang rig ye shes te/ zhes gsungs te/ rang gi rig pa ma bcos so ma 'di nyid ye nas dag pa chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes kyi rang bzhin yin par gdams pa dang*/ tshig rkang gnyis pa/ ngag gi lam 'das yid kyi spyod yul min// zhes gsungs pa ni/ de ltar sems nyid rnal ma chos sku'i bzhugs tshul de bsam gyis mi khyab ces sam/ zab pa zhes sam/ gting dpag dka' bas smra bsam shes brjod kyi yul las 'das te/ de'ang sems 'di nyid kyi gshis sam rang ngo 'di ka gzugs su ma grub pa'i stong nyid rgya chad phyogs lhung dang bral bas mtha' bral/ blos byas kyi yul las 'das pas blo 'das te bcing grol gyi mtshan ma gang yang ma dmigs pas ngag gi lam 'das shing yid kyi spyod yul ma yin/ gzhi rtsa bral ba'i sems nyid 'di/ phyi nang snod bcud kun la khyab cing gang du'ang bri gang med pa/ bltas pa tsam gyis mthong ba 'gags pas ngag gi lam las 'das shing yid kyi spyod yul ma yin/ gshis kyi rang mdangs go mi 'gag par sna tshogs su snang yang ngo bo skye 'gag gnas gsum dang bral bas/ ngag gi lam las 'das shing yid kyi spyod yul ma yin te/ de skad du/ dkon mchog sprin gyi mdo las/ gsol pa/ de kho na nyid ces bgyi ba ci lags/ bka' stsal pa/ de kho na nyid ces bgyi ba ni yang dag pa'i tshig bla dgas so// 'di ni so so rang rig pa yin te/ ye shes dag gis gdags par mi nus so// de ci'i phyir zhe na/ smra ba dang*/ brjod pa dang*/ rtog pa thams cad kyi yul las 'das pa/ 'phags pa'i ye shes kyi yul te/ ye gdod ma nas ji bzhin nyid du 'dug pa'o// zhes gsungs/

chos kyi dbyings kyi rang bzhin dbyer med par bstan pa zhes pa'i mdo las shin tu rgyas pa gleng gzhi dang bcas pa bstan/ dkon mchog ta la'i gzungs las/ chos kyi dbyings ni dngos po med par rtogs par bya'o// zhes dang*/ ā li kā li chu klung chen po'i rgyud las/ yang dag don de ci yang mthong ba med// brjod du med cing bsam pa'i yul las 'das// chos sku thig le nyag gcig rang gi sems// zhes dang*/ brtag gnyis las/ ngo bo gzugs med mthong ba'ang med// sgra med thos pa po yang med// dri med snom pa po yang med// ro med myong ba po yang med// reg med reg pa po yang med// sems med sems las byung ba'ang med// ces dang*/ chos sku kun tu bzang pos// rang byung klong yangs brjod du med// 'khor 'das gnyis ka'i ming med do// zhes dang*/ bram ze chen pos/ kha dog yon tan yi ge dpe dang bral// brjod du med pa 'di ni ji ltar mtshon// zhes dang*/ kun mkhyen pad+ma dkar pos/ gang zhig nye bar brjod pa la// kun mkhyen tshig gis dbul gyur cing*// blo yi yul min dpe gzhan gyis// bslad bya min pas dmigs su med// ces sogs gsungs so// de ltar rnams kyis skye med brjod bral don gyi gnad bstan nas tshig rkang gsum par/ til+li ngas ni ci yang bstan du med// ces pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i ye shes blo las 'das pa'i dbyings so/ til+li ngas ni 'di zhes bstan du ci yang med de/ dpes mi mtshon don dam brjod bral du gnas pa'i don gyis te/ de'ang rje btsun gyis/ lta ba gtan la 'bebs tsa na// rmongs pa nga 'dra ma gtogs pa'i// yang dag rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyang*// lkugs pa'am gzhon nu'i dga' ba bzhin// mtshon pa tsam du ma gtogs pa// don du ston pa ngas ma mthong*// zhes gsungs pa bzhin no// tshig rkang bzhi pa/ rang gis rang nyid mtshon te shes par byos// zhes pa ni blo las 'das pa'i don de sngon til+li bdag gis snying ring byas nas ma bstan pa ma yin te/

gzhan gyis rtogs bya min pas so// 'o na gang gis rtogs dgos na/ bla ma'i byin rlabs kyis rten 'byung la/ rang gi sems nyid spros bral zung 'jug skye med blo las 'das pa'i ngang du rtogs dgos te/ de ltar rtogs par gyis shig ces brda tshig sprad pa'o// gdams pa de'i go rgya chod par byas nas/ rgyun gyi nyams len rig thog tu skyong lugs la/ rang sems ngos bzung med pa shes pa gsal stong spros bral 'di la blos bcos nas ched du bsgom rgyu med/ sems kho rang ye nas rang dwangs shig 'dug pa de ka rang babs su cham gyis bzhag /de ltar bzhag kyang mi sdod par rnam rtog sna tshogs su 'phros kyang*/ don dam gyi ngo bo rang du shes par byas nas dus rnams kun tu gnas kyang 'gyus kyang rang ngo rang shes ma brjed par skyong*/ ma brjed tsam 'di las spros pa'i dge sbyor bzang bzang 'dra zhig logs nas 'tshol na gnad 'phyugs par 'gro/ gnas 'gyu gnyis po la'ang dgag sgrub kyi dbang du btang na bcos bslad yin pas skyon che ste/ sems gnas na'ang ngo bo rang bzhin gnas pa dang*/ 'phro rgod che na'ang kho rang gi rang mdangs 'gyu ba tsam ma gtogs bzang ngan gnyis su skad cig kyang ma grub pa yin/ des na bzang ngan phra rags sna tshogs gang shar de ka'i rang ngo skyong ba gnad du che/ gzugs sgra sogs phyi rol gyi yul snang lnga po gang byung yang spang blang mi dgos bzang ngan la chags sdang gi 'dzin pa zhugs su mi 'jug par rang sar rang zhal blta/ brjed skabs byung yang bcos med kyi rang ngo 'khrul par ma shor bar bya'o// bzhi pa rang sems lhan cig skyes pa rnam pa gsum gyi sgo nas ngo sprod bshad pa la/ dang po sems nyid lhan cig skyes pa ngos bzung zhing ngo sprod pa bshad pa/ gnyis pa rnam rtog lhan cig skyes pa ngos bzung zhing ngo sprod pa bshad pa/ gsum pa snang ba lhan cig skyes pa ngos bzung zhing ngo sprod pa bshad pa'o// dang po sems nyid lhan cig skyes pa ngos bzung zhing ngo sprod pa bshad pa ni/

sems kyi ngo bo'am gshis thog 'di nyid du ngo sprod pa yin te/ de la rgyas par bshad na gzhi'i gnas lugs bshad pa/ de la ming btags kyi sgo nas ngo sprod pa sogs mang yang da lam mdor dril ba ni/ rang sems kyi ngo bo 'di ka ma bcos ma yengs pa'i gshis kyi ngo thog tu bzhag cing*/ rang gi sems de'i gnas lugs sam gnas tshul la sems kyis bltas pa'i tshe/ rnam rtog bzang ngan phra rags kyi 'char sgo thams cad ma bkag kyang rang zhi rang dwangs la song bas rang thog tu gnas la/ gnas pa de'i ngo bo la ngos bzung gi dngos po ma grub cing dngos por ma grub kyang rang gis rang rig pa tsam gyi nges shes can de la sems kyi gnas lugs sam gshis kyi bzhugs tshul zhes bya ba/ 'di nyid ngo bo ngos bzung dang dngos por ma grub pas stong pa nyid/ stong pa de'ang stong pa chad lta ba ma yin pa'i stong pa'i ngo bo rig cing gsal bas rang rig pa/ de gnyis dbyer med pa la rig stong dbyer med ces gsungs pas/ rig stong dbyer med 'di ka sems kyi rang bzhin yin te/ de la zhi gnas lhag mthong*/ rang rig ye shes/ lhan cig skyes pa/ spros bral/ rtag chad mtha' bral/ smra bsam brjod med/ phyag rgya chen po/ zhes sogs ming ji ltar btags kyang mi 'gal te sems kyi ngo thog 'di kar tshang ba yin/ rang sems rang lugs su bzhag pa'i dus na rnam rtog rang sar zhi zhing bying rgod med pa'i rang gshis su gnas pa 'di la zhi gnas zhes bya ste/ zhi ni rnam par rtog pa zhi// gnas ni ngo bo'i thog tu gnas pa yin// zhi gnas 'di'i rang bzhin nam ngo bo rang gis lhag ger mthong ba la lhag mthong zhes bya ba ste/ lhag ni sems kyi rang bzhin lhag par gyur pa'i ngo bo dang*/ mthong ba ni de'i gnas lugs mthong ba yin te/ mdo sde rgyan las/ yang dag gnas pa la brten nas// sems la sems ni 'jog phyir dang*// chos rab rnam par 'byed pa'i phyir// zhi gnas dang ni lhag mthong yin// zhes gsungs so// sems kyi gnas pa 'di'ang rmugs pa'am lung ma bstan nam/

'chal ba'am btang snyoms su lus pa ma yin pa'i sems kyi ngo bo rang gsal la/ gsal ba de'ang 'od la sogs pas gsal ba ma yin pa'i gsal ba yul med ngos bzung med la/ ngos bzung med bzhin du gsal la ma 'gags pa'i shes pa seng nge ye re rjen lhang nge bar rang gis rig pas rang rig pa zer/ rang gi sems nyid 'di ka rang rig pa ni rig mkhan yang gzhan du med pas sems kho rang gis kho rang rig pa yin te/ tshig bsdus las/ sems kyang dran rig 'gyu ba tsam// rang bzhin med de rlung gi rtsal// ngo bo stong pa nam mkha' bzhin// chos sku mkha' 'dra mnyam gnas la// phyag rgya che zhes brjod pa yin// zhes gsungs so// ye nas rang la gnas pa de ka rang ngo shes pas ye shes zhes zer te/ ye ni ye gdod ma'i gnas lugs kyi ngo bo 'di ka'o// shes pa ni de nyid rang gis rang shes pa ste/ de ltar yang*/ skyes mchog mar pas/ rang gsal rig pa 'gags pa med// zung 'jug rig pa gnyug ma'i ngang*// ye shes lhun grub lta ba lags// zhes gsungs so// rang dang skad cig 'bral ma myong bas lhan cig skyes pa zer te/ lhan cig ni ye gdod ma nas so so ma yin par khyon cig gam lhan cig tu gnas pa'o// skyes pa ni gzod nas lhan cig tu skyes shing grub pa yin te/ de skad du'ang*/ rje sgam po pas/ lhan cig skyes pa'i rnam shes 'di// ye shes yin par tsir gyis zungs// zhes gsungs so// mtshan 'dzin bzo bcos kyi spros pa thams cad dang bral bas spros bral zhes bya ste/ spros pa ni mtshan 'dzin gyi spros pa thams cad dang bral ba ni mtshan nyid thams cad dang bral zhing 'dus pa ste/ de ltar yang*/ rje phag gru/ sems gdod nas dag pa de bzhin nyid// gdod nas zhi zhing ma skyes pas// ye nas spros pa'i mtha' dang bral// zhes gsungs so// sems kyi ngo bo'am rang bzhin 'di 'dra zhig 'dug ces ngag tu smra rgyu'am yid kyis bsam rgyu'am blos brtag rgyu'i ngos bzung med la/

med bzhin du ma mthong ba'i mthong rgyu ma myong ba'i myong rgyu zhig /rang la yod kyang ngag tu brjod mi shes la/ ngag tu brjod mi shes bzhin du rang gis rang rig pa 'di la smra bsam brjod med ces bya ste/ smra ba ni don dam gyi gnas lugs smra ba'o// bsam pa ni rang bzhin blos bsam pa'o// brjod pa ni gshis kyi bzhugs tshul brjod pa'o// med pa ni de ltar smra bsam brjod pa las 'das pa'i rang bzhin can te/ de skad du'ang*/ yum las/ smra bsam brjod med shes rab pha rol phyin// ma skyes mi 'gag nam mkha'i ngo bo nyid// so so rang rig ye shes spyod yul ba// dus gsum rgyal ba'i yum la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes gsungs so// sems dngos por ma grub pas rtag pa'i mthar ma lhung*/ rang gis rig cing myongs bas chad pa'i mthar ma lhung pas/ rtag chad kyi mtha' las 'das pa ste/ rtag pa ni dngos por rtag pa can no// chad pa ni stong pa chad par lta ba'o// mtha' las ni rtag chad de gnyis ka'i mtha'o// 'das pa ni rtag chad de gnyis ka'i mtha' gnyis las 'das pa ste/ de ltar yang*/ gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i mdo las/ rtag chad skye 'gag la sogs pa'i// mtha' spangs sems ni rang rig cing*// gdod nas spros pa med pa nyid// de don bsam mi khyab par nges// zhes gsungs so// snang srid 'khor 'das kyis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad rang rig 'di las mi 'da' zhing*/ de las lhag pa'i chos gang yang med pas na phyag rgya chen po zhes bya ste/ phyag rgya ni snang srid 'khor 'das kyis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad la mi 'da' ba'i phyag rgyas gdab phyir phyag rgya zhes bya'o// chen po ni 'di kun las lhag cing mchog tu gyur pas ni chen po ste/ de skad du'ang*/ phyag chen thig le las/ 'di ni phyag rgya chen po ste// phyag ni stong pa'i ye shes yin// rgya ni 'khor ba'i chos las grol// chen po zung du 'jug pa'o// zhes gsungs so// 'di la sangs rgyas kyi dgongs pa/

sems can gyi sems nyid/ dngos po'i gnas lugs zhes bya ste/ de'ang ngo shes na ni sangs rgyas kyi dgongs pa'o// ngo ma shes na sems can gyi sems nyid do// gzhi'i gnas tshul ma bcos pa 'di la dngos po'i gnas lugs zhes bya ste/ de nyid rang ngo shes na don dam pa'i gnas lugs mngon du gyur pa'i 'bras bu thob pa ste/ de skad du'ang*/ phyag rgya chen po rab tu mi gnas pa'i rgyud las/ 'di ni phyag rgya chen po ste// 'di ni dri mas ma gos pa// 'di la dgag dang sgrub pa med// lam dang gnyen pos rnyed pa min// 'di ni sangs rgyas kun gyi sku// 'di ni yon tan kun gyi gzhi// 'di ni lhun gyis grub pa yin// zhes dang*/ grub thob bi rū pas/ gdod nas lhan cig skyes pa gzhan nas btsal du med// sems nyid ming stong spros bral phyag rgya chen po de// zhes dang*/ nag po spyod pas/ ye sangs rgyas shig yin pa la// yang sangs rgyas shig 'dod pas 'grub/ ces dang*/ dus gsum mkhyen pas/ sangs rgyas rang gi sems las rnyed// grub pa thob pa'i blo dang bral// zhes dang*/ gling ras kyis/ rang gi sems nyid rtogs na sangs rgyas yin// sgro 'dogs nang nas chod na yongs kyang yin// zhes dang*/ chos rje rgya ras kyis/ sems ma bcos bzhag pa chos kyi sku// blo yi mtshan ma rang sar grol// zhes sogs bka' brgyud gong ma'i rdo rje'i gsung mtha' yas pa'o// gnyis pa rnam rtog lhan cig skyes pa ngos bzung zhing ngo sprod par bshad pa ni/ rang gi sems kyi ngo bo rang rig rang gsal du gnas pa de'i ngang nas bzang ngan 'bring gsum mam phra rags sbom gsum gyi rnam par rtog pa 'gyu dran shar ba de nyid/ rang rig gi dran pa des gang shar de nyid kyi ngo bo la gcer gyis bltas pas/ de nyid rang ngo shes shing rang ngo shes pa de'ang gzhan zhig nas gnyis su snang ba ma yin pas rang gi sems nyid kyi ngo bo de'i rnam pa ma 'gags tsam du gsal bar 'char ba las gzhan du 'gyu dran gnyis su med de/

dper na chu rlabs ni chu las ma 'das shing chu nyid rlabs su shar yang chu las gzhan min pa ltar ro// de la rtog pa de nyid kyi ngo bo'am rang bzhin la ngos bzung gi dngos po med kyang gang shar de nyid 'khrul pa ma yin pa'i ngo shes la ngo shes 'phrad pa ltar rang ngo shes pa tsam las skye med kyi rang bzhin stong pa/ 'gyu stong gi rang bzhin dang ngo bo stong pa gnyis rang sar rang grol ba 'di la/ rnam rtog lhan cig skyes pa'am/ rnam rtog chos kyi sku zhes bya ste/ de la rnam rtog lhan cig skyes pa zhes pa ni/ sems kyi ngo bo skye med dang*/ rang mdangs 'gags med kyi rnam rtog gnyis tha dad ma yin pas dang por lhan cig skyes/ bar du lhan cig gnas pa 'di la rnam rtog lhan cig skyes pa zhes bya'o// rnam rtog chos sku zhes bya ba ni/ rnam rtog rang ngo shes shing rang grol ba de ka chos sku zhes bya ste/ de la rnam rtog chos sku zhes bzang po zhig tu bsgyur rgyu'am chos sku gzhan zhig gis rnam rtog la khyab rgyu yod snyam na go yul rgyas 'gebs yin pas des go mi chod/ rnam rtog chos sku zhes pa ni rnam par rtog pa bzang ngan nam phra rags gang shar gyi ngo bor rang rig gis rang la bltas dus/ de la spang len dgag sgrub ci'ang mi dgos par rnam rtog gang shar ci dran gyi ngo bo gsal stong du rjen lhang nge ba/ gnyug ma lhan cig skyes pa'i ngo bo rang dang dbyer med pa de nyid la chos kyi sku zhes bya'o// de ngo shes pa la rnam rtog ngo shes pa zer te/ spyan ras gzigs kyis/ gang skyes gnyug ma nyid yin phyir// gang shar dran pa sor bzhag na// de ltar stong pa nyid dag tu// rnal 'byor rgyal po gdon mi za// zhes dang*/ mnyam med dwags pos/ rnam rtog chos sku lags par gda'// gnyen pos bcos su med par gda'// rig pa gsal ba'i ngang du gda'// zhes sogs gsungs so// des rigs 'gres pa las/

skyid sdug bzang ngan la sogs pa'i rtog pa'ang de ltar rang gis ngo ma shes pas tha dad du bzung ba ma gtogs chos sku ye shes rang gi ngo bo 'dir ro gcig pas rkyen bzang ngan thams cad lam du bya zhing*/ 'khor ba'i rtsa ba bdag tu 'dzin pa 'di'ang*/ bdag 'dzin kho rang gi ngo bo la bltas dus/ yul dang yul can gnyis ka ma grub pas bdag gzhan thams cad mnyam pa nyid las ma 'das shing dbyer med pa'o// de lta bas na mi rtog pa zhes bzang po zhig bsgrub rgyu med de/ de'ang ngo ma shes na bying rmugs kyi rang bzhin yin/ rnam rtog ces pa'i ngan pa zhig spong rgyu med de ngo shes na rang sems kyi gshis dang gnyis med chos sku'i rang bzhin du gnas/ 'o na ngo ma shes na chos sku ma yin snyam na/ ngo shes rung ma shes rung gzhi'i gnas lugs chos sku las g.yos pa med kyang*/ rnam rtog ngo ma shes na 'khrul pa'i rang bzhin 'char ba'o// de bas na rig pa'i gnas lugs skyong ba la gnas na gnas thog tu skyong ba las ched du spro rgyu med/ 'gyu na 'gyu thog tu skyong ba las ched du bsdu rgyu med/ de ltar gang shar gyi ngo bo skyong zhing sgom go bcad pas nyams len phyogs re bar mi gol zhing thugs dam gyi mu ge mi 'byung bar gda'/ gnas lugs ye dag 'khrul pa rang grol ni nges don rin po che'i gsang tshig ste 'di la lung 'dren ni/ brtag gnyis las/ rnam dag ye shes gzugs can dang*// 'khor ba rnam par rtog pa gnyis// khyad par cung zad yod ma yin// zhes dang*/ yang de nyid las/ 'di nyid 'khor ba zhes bya ste// 'di ni mya ngan 'das pa nyid// 'khor ba spangs nas gzhan du ni// mya ngan 'das pa thob bya min// zhes dang*/ saṃ bu ṭi las/ 'khor ba dang ni mya ngan 'das// gnyis su yod pa ma yin te// 'khor ba'i rang bzhin shes pa la// mya ngan 'das zhes brjod pa yin// zhes dang*/ dkon mchog brtsegs pa las/ ma skyes pa las thams cad skye// skyes tsam nyid na skye ba med// ces dang*/

bir wa pas/ sna tshogs chos skur gsal bas spong len sems mi 'byung*// zhes dang*/ nā ro pas/ rnam rtog rang grol ye shes che// zhes dang*/ rje mar pas/ yid kyi g.yo ba gzung 'dzin gnyis// spros bral chos kyi sku ru thim// zhes dang*/ rje mi las/ nang 'gyu ba yid kyi rnam shes ni// ma rtog dus na ma rig pa// las nyon mongs kun gyi rtsa ba yin// rtogs na rang rig ye shes te// dkar po'i yon tan rdzogs par 'byung*// mthar thug don la ye shes med// chos rnams zad sar bskyal lo gsungs// zhes dang*/ rje sgam po pas/ mtshan mar skyes pa'i rnam rtog 'di// chos sku yin par tsir gyis zungs// zhes dang*/ dus gsum mkhyen pas/ rnam rtog chos sku'i rang bzhin la// bzang ngan byed pa'i blo dang bral// zhes dang*/ 'jig rten mgon pos/ ma rig 'khor ba'i 'khrul rtog dang*// rang byung ye shes chen po gnyis// gzhi la bye brag tha dad med// ces dang*/ gling ras pas/ rnam rtog chos skur rtogs lags pas// skyon yon gyi 'dzin pa stor nas thal// zhes dang*/ zhang rin po ches/ rnam rtog thol gyis byung gyur pa// de nyid 'od gsal chos sku las// gzhan zhig yin snyam ma sems shig /de phyir rnam par rtog pa de/ stong nyid las ni stong nyid 'phro// chos sku las ni chos sku 'phro// zung 'jug las ni zung 'jug 'phro// zhes dang*/ grub thob o rgyan pas/ phyag rgya chen po'i khor yug la// thun sgom blo yis dgos pa med// ces gsungs pa sogs kyi lung shin tu mang ba'o// gsum pa snang ba lhan cig skyes pa ngos bzung zhing ngo sprod bshad pa ni/ 'di ltar phyi rol gyi snang ba tsam du 'char ba'i snod bcud kyi dngos po 'di rnams da lta tha mal par 'khrul pa'i bag chags la goms pa rnams kyi snang ngor phyi rol tha dad du yod cing*/ de'ang dngos po gdos bcas su grub mod kyang*/

don du sems kyi rang snang sngon gyi bag chags la brten nas snang gzugs tsam shar ba las logs su grub pa med phyir rnam rtog lhan skyes dang khyad par med la/ 'dir sems can spyi mthun las snang la brten nas tha mal so skye nged rang rnams la mngon sum rtag brtan ther zug tu snang ba'i gzugs sgra sogs kyi snang ba rnams/ da ltar rang gi mig dang rna ba sogs dbang shes la 'char ba 'di rnams lhan skyes su ngo sprod pa ste/ de'ang yul lnga so so'i ngo sprod ni bshad kyis mi lang bas don dag mdor dril ba ni/ rang gi sems nyid lhan skyes kyi ngo bo rang bzhin yongs shes kyi gshis thog tu bzhag pa'i dus/ da ltar phyi rol gyi snang ba ri brag sa rdo'am mi dang dud 'gro sogs snang ba de la rang gi sems kyi ngo bo ma yengs pa'i dran pa 'dis mer gyis bltas pas/ snang cha mig yul du gang snang de 'gags nas med pa'am mi gsal ba ma yin par/ da lta'i rang snang 'di rang sems kho nas ngo shes tsam du ma yengs par bltas pas phyi rol gyi snang ba de'i mtshan nyid dang rnam pa gsal bzhin du rang gi sems kyis rang ngo shes la rang ngo shes tsam de las ngo bo'am rang bzhin ngos bzung med pa'i stong pa nyid/ stong nyid de'ang rang rig ngo shes de dang tha dad med pa ste/ mdor na phyi rol gyi snang ba sa rdo ri brag dang*/ mi dang dud 'gro la sogs gang snang de'i rnam pa ma 'gags shing gsal/ ngo bo la ngos bzung med pa'i stong pa nyid de gnyis dbyer mi phyed pa/ snang stong ngam stong snang lta bur nyams su myong*/ snang ba dang snang mkhan dbyer med pa snang stong rjen ne 'char ba de lhan skyes kyi ngo bo mthong ba yin/ dper na rmi lam du snod bcud lta bu'i snang ba sna tshogs shar yang shar tsam nyid nas rmi lam gyi shes pa nyid las gzhan don du ma grub pa ltar da lta'i snang ba ji 'dra zhig shar yang*/ rang sems stong pa nyid go ma 'gags pa'i rtsal las spyi mthun gyi las ma dag bar du de 'dra'i snang ba shar ba tsam ste/

shar tsam nas rang sems stong pa nyid kyi rang 'od las gzhan min pa ste/ grub thob gling ras pas/ gzhi rtsa bral ba'i sems nyid la// mdangs rmi lam nyams su myong ba de// snang ba sems su ngo sprod pa'i// slob dpon zhig lags te go lags sam// zhes gsungs/ de ltar phyi rol gzugs snang rang sems dang dbyer med des rigs 'gres pas/ gzhan yang rna ba'i yul du sgra grags pa/ sna'i yul du dri bro ba/ lce'i yul du ro myong ba/ lus kyi yul du reg bya snang ba sogs thams cad sems kyi rang rtsal las gnyis su med la/ gnyis su med kyang sna tshogs su 'char ba ni/ bag chags kyi rang gzugs rnam pa so sor 'char ba/ ngo bo ngos bzung med pa/ ngos bzung med pas stong nyid rang rig dang dbyer mi phyed pa ste/ sgra grags stong dang rang sems gnyis med/ dri tshor stong rang rig dbyer med/ ro myong stong rang sems dang zung 'jug /reg snang stong rang gi sems dang gnyis med de/ mdor na yul snang thams cad rang sems dang gnyis su med pa'o// 'di la snang sems dbyer med don ji bzhin mngon 'gyur ro gcig gi bar mi yong ba yin kyang*/ 'dir snang ba sems su ngo sprod pa'am/ snang sems lhan skyes kyi rang bzhin bshad pa yin/ 'di'i snang sems dbyer med pa'i tshul yang*/ snang ba sems la tshur thim pa'am/ sems snang ba la phar thim pa chu dang phye bsres pa lta bu ni ma yin te/ rang gi sems ma bcos pa'i shes pa 'di nyid phyi rol gyi snang ba'i yul gyi steng la sogs par rang gi sems ngo shes su lhan ner bzhag pa'i dus/ sems dang snang ba gnyis ka stong snang yul med 'char/ stong snang yul med des na sems dang snang ba gnyis tha dad du dbye rgyu mi 'dug mod/ de ni gnas lugs kyi rang snang*/ sems kyi mtshan nyid 'gag med kyi gdangs yin pas/ mar me nyid 'od du snang ba'am/ chu nyid rlabs su shar ba lta bu yin te/

ma bcos pa'i shes pa zung 'jug gi rang bzhin du gnas pa ste/ 'di la bka' brgyud rin po ches/ snang srid chos sku dang*/ cir snang chos sku'i tha snyad du mdzad de/ 'di la lung 'dren ni/ sher snying las/ gzugs stong pa'o// stong pa nyid kyang gzugs so// gzugs las kyang stong pa nyid gzhan ma yin// stong pa nyid las kyang gzugs gzhan ma yin no// zhes gsungs pa dang*/ rdo rje gur las/ rin chen sems las phyir gyur pa'i// sangs rgyas med cing sems can med// rnam par shes pa'i gnas don rnams// phyi rol gyur pa cung zad med// ces dang*/ spyod 'jug las/ lcags bsreg sa gzhi su yis byas// me tshogs 'di dag gang las byung*// de ltar de dag thams cad ni// sdig sems yin par thub pas gsungs// zhes dang*/ nā ro pas/ snang ba rang grol chos kyi sku// zhes dang*/ mar pas/ phyi snang ba sgyu ma'i 'khrul 'khor 'di// skye med phyag rgya chen por rtogs// zhes dang*/ rje mi las/ phyi snang ba ji ltar snang lags kyang*// ma rtogs dus na 'khrul snang ste// phyi yul gyi zhen pas 'ching bar byed// rtogs pa rnams la sgyu mar snang*// yul snang ba sems kyi grogs su shar// mthar thug gi don la snang ma myong*// skye med chos kyi sku ru go /zhes dang*/ rje ras chung pas/ snang ba cir snang go lags sam/ snang ba cir snang ma go na// ma rtogs pa la 'khrul par snang*// rtogs pa rnams la chos skur shar// zhes dang*/ rje dwags pos/ rtog pa'i bag chags snang grags 'di// don dam yin par tsir gyis zungs// zhes dang*/ phag grus/ snang ba'i rang bzhin stong pa nyid// stong pa'i ngo bo snang ba nyid// ces dang*/ 'jig rten mgon pos/ sems nyid lhan cig skyes pa dang*// snang ba lhan cig skyes pa gnyis// ming gcig tha dad mi shes pas// gnyis po gdams ngag gcig tu go /zhes dang*/ chos rje rang byung rdo rjes/

phyi rol snang ba sna tshogs 'di// rang gi sems kyi cho 'phrul te// gzhan du bden pa rdul tsam med// de phyir rang gi sems su ltos// zhes dang*/ rgyal sras thogs med pas/ ji ltar snang ba 'di dag rang gi sems// sems nyid gdod nas spros pa'i mtha' dang bral// de nyid rtogs na gzung 'dzin mtshan ma rnams// yid la mi byed rgyal sras lag len yin// zhes dang*/ rje 'ba' ra bas/ snang ba rten cing 'brel 'byung 'di// me long nang gi byad dang 'dra// rang sems sna tshogs shar ba yin// ji ltar snang bzhin ma grub pas// bden par ma grub rgyal mtshan dpal// zhes dang*/ grub thob gcer sgom pas/ ji ltar snang ba thams cad ni// rig pa sems kyi rang ngo yin// de la gzhi rtsa ngo bo med// snang stong dbyer med shes par bya// zhes sogs dang*/ kun mkhyen pad+ma dkar pos/ de'ang gang dang lhan cig tu gang skyes snyam na/ sems nyid lhan cig skyes pa de dang snang ba lhan cig skyes pa de'o// de'ang phyag rgya chen po phyogs lhung dang bral ba la phyogs lhung gi blos gshis su brtags pas gshis dang mdangs su snang ba yin te/ skyes bu ji bder 'dug pa la lta ba pos dgra gnyen du bzung ba bzhin no// des na gshis kyi dbang du byas na 'gyur ba med pa'i bde ba chen por bzhag /mdangs kyi dbang du byas na rnam kun mchog dang ldan pa'i stong pa nyid du bzhag /de'ang dang po don dam/ gnyis pa kun rdzob/ des na kun rdzob rgyu'am thabs/ don dam 'bras bu thabs byung zhes sogs lung dang bcas gsal bar gsungs pa bzhin yin pa'o// lnga pa rang sems tha mal gyi shes pa gnas lugs ma bcos pa'i sgo nas ngo sprod pa ni/ dang po tha mal gyi shes pa 'di nyid kyi khyad par ngos bzung ba/ gnyis pa sems kyi gnas lugs la tha mal gyi shes pa gsungs tshul/ gsum pa tha mal gyi shes pa de nyid ngos bzung ba/ bzhi pa de la ma yengs pa phyag rgya chen po'i sgom du bstan pa dang bzhi las// dang po tha mal gyi shes pa 'di nyid kyi khyad par ngos bzung ba ni/

de'ang da lta'i shes pa ma bcos pa'i ngang nas gang shar cir snang rang ngo shes pas blo kha mi tshims par/ de dag pa'i sems kyi rnam pa gsal seng nge ba'i ngar dang ldan zhing cham me gnas pa la blo 'gro zhing phyag rgya chen po'i sgom du 'dod par snang yang*/ de ni zhi gnas kyi ting nge 'dzin bying rgod kyi skyon dang bral ba zhig na'ang phyag chen gyi sgom ni cung zad min te/ sems gsal stong gi nyams dang ldan pa tsam las/ lhag mthong gi nges shes dang mi ldan pas so// gal te rtog pa thams cad rang sar zhi ba'i ngang nas sems sam rig pa'i ngo bo gsal la ngos bzung thams cad dang bral ba'i nyams myong nges shes dang ldan na de nyid las dang po pa'i sgom du byed mod kyang*/ rtog pa dang snang ba bkag pa lta bu'i mi rtog pa zhig ci nas kyang dgos par 'dod pa'ang snang bas na/ blo rtse mi rtog par gtad/ khas len rnam rtog chos skur byed mod/ ces gsungs pa'i skyon yong ba las/ gnas lugs rig pa bcos min gyi ngo bo sgom pa ni cung zad kyang min la/ des na tshul de la rjes thob kyi sgom yang 'char dka' ba yin no// de bzhin du kha cig rnam rtog snang ba'i 'char sgo byung ba'i tshe de nyid bkag pa'am bkug nas gsal la mi rtog par 'jog dgos par rig pa dang*/ yang 'ga' zhig dran rig tu re bzung nas sems gsal stong hrig ger gnas dgos par 'dod pa rnams kyang*/ sems ngo thog tu rdo rus 'phrod pas don thog nas dran rig ma yengs pa byung na de nyid las dang po pa'i sgom du byung yang*/ rtog pa dang snang ba'i ngo bor sgro 'dogs ma chod pa la brten nas rtog snang dgrar ldang ba shas che ba ni/ sems kyi rang gshis lhug pa'i mtshang ma rnyed par ha cang bsgrims pa'i nyams myong phyogs re ba yin no// 'on kyang de lta bu'i dge sbyor de ngang skyong mkhas na goms nas de 'dra'i mnyam gzhag de yar 'phel du 'gro zhing rim pas rtog snang gi 'char sgo'ang phra nyar gyis rang zhir song nas mjug tu rtog snang la sgro 'dogs chod pa zhig 'byung yang*/

ci rigs pa thog mar sems kyi 'char sgo gsal zhen mang po 'byung bas/ de dag gi gnas lugs nyams 'og tu ma tshud pa la brten nas sgom shin tu skyong mi bde bar sgom dang sna sun khyer dogs che bas/ sems rtog med dang rtog pa yul snang gi 'char sgo rnams lhan skyes gsum du ngo 'phrod cing sgro 'dogs chod pa dgos la/ khyad par ngo sprod kyi skabs su rtog med kho nar ngo sprad na/ phal cher gyis rnam pa kun tu de lta bu'i ka dpe ma zhig dgos par go nas shin tu gu dog po 'byung bas cung zad mi legs te gtso bor rtog pa dang snang ba'i 'char sgro la ngo 'phrod pa zhig shin tu gal che ba yin no// gnyis pa sems kyi gnas lugs la tha mal gyi shes pa gsungs tshul bshad pa ni/ tha mal gyi shes pa zhes bya ba 'di gzhan dag 'ga' zhig gis 'khrul shes lang can rang kha ba zhig yin snyam du sems mod kyang*/ de ni ma yin te tha mal gyi sgra pra kṛ ta zhes pa rang bzhin dang tha mal gnyis ka la 'jug pas rang bzhin gyi shes pa zhes pa'i don yin la de ni rang bzhin gyis 'od gsal ba gang gis kyang ma bcos ma bslad pa'i shes pa rnal du phebs shing rang gshis dang rang lugs ltar gnas pa'i don yin no// de lta bu'i sems la tha mal gyi shes pa'i tha snyad 'dogs pa dwags po bka' brgyud pa ma gtogs gzhan gyis ma gsungs pa'ang min te/ de kho na nyid rab tu mi gnas pa'i mdo las/ tha mal shes pa'i rang bzhin 'bras bu mchog /ma bcos bzhag na sku gsum 'bras bu thob// rang gar glod na mthar phyin ye shes yin// sems nyid ma bcos rdo rje kun gyi ngang*// rnal mar bzhag pa'i don 'di brjod du med// de ni dus gsum sangs rgyas kun gyi yum// zhes dang*/ dpal sha wa ris/ tha mal shes pa rang lugs gnyug ma la// bcos ma'i dmigs pa dag gis mi bslad de// rang bzhin dag pa'i sems la bcos mi dgos// ma bzung ma btang rang ga nyid du zhog

/ces dang*/ grub chen tog rtse pas/ tha mal shes pa snying gi dbus su sad// tshogs drug dag na bde ba rgyun mi chad// brtags pa thams cad don med sdug bsngal rgyu// bsgom du med pa gnyug ma'i ngang du zhog /ces dang*/ rdze btsun chen pos/ tha mal shes pa skyong skyong nas// ma rig 'khrul pa brjed de thal// zhes dang*/ rje sgam po pas/ tha mal shes pas chog pa'i nyams len 'di// sangs rgyas mi gzugs can gyi drin las rnyed// ces pa la sogs mang du gsungs pa'o// gsum pa tha mal gyi shes pa de nyid ngos bzung ba bshad pa ni/ de ltar tha mal gyi shes pa 'di gleng ba mang yang*/ de nyid gsal bar ngos zin pa nyung bar snang bas bshad par bya ste/ de'ang rje sgam po pa'i tshogs chos chen mo las/ da res 'khor ba las thar bar 'dod na chos thams cad kyi rtsa ba yin pas tha mal gyi shes pa ngo shes dgos/ de'ang tha mal gyi shes pa zhes bya ba/ rang gi shes pa 'di la chos kyi rnam pa gang gis kyang ma bslad pa/ 'jig rten gyi rnam par shes pa gang gis kyang ma rnyogs pa/ bying rmugs dang rtog pa gang gis kyang ma btums par rang sar bzhag pa yin/ de ngo shes na rang gi rig pa'i ye shes yin/ ma rtogs na lhan cig skyes pa'i ma rig pa yin/ rtogs na rig pa zhes bya/ ngo bo zhes bya/ lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes zhes bya/ tha mal gyi shes pa zhes bya/ gnyug ma zhes bya/ spros bral zhes bya/ 'od gsal zhes bya/ zhes pa la sogs pa tha mal gyi shes pa'i ngo bo ngos 'dzin dang*/ ming gi rnam grangs dang de ngo shes na yon tan phal cher las khyad par 'phags tshul rnams rgyas par gsungs te/ de la chos kyi rnam pa gang gis kyang ma bslad pa zhes pa ni/ grub mthas brtags pa'i blo'i 'dzin stangs dang*/ bde gsal mi rtog pa la sogs pa'i nyams kyis sems ma bslad pa'o// 'jig rten gyi rnam par shes pa gang gis kyang ma rnyogs pa zhes pa ni/ chags sdang sogs nyon mongs dang*/

'phral 'di bya 'di byed sogs kyi blo sems kyi rnyogs pas ma bslad pa'o// bying rmugs dang rtog pa gang gis kyang ma btums pa zhes pa ni/ bying rmugs kyis rmongs pa'am 'phro rgod kyi rtog pa rang mtshan pas g.yengs nas sems gyi gnas tshul lam 'dug tshul la sgrib par ma gyur pa'o// rang sar bzhag ces pa ni/ sems nyid kyi ngo bo'am/ gshis sam 'dug tshul ci ltar 'dug pa de nyid slar dgag sgrub kyi rtsol bas ma bslad par kho rang gi 'dug tshul de ka nyid du 'jog pa'o// yang rje sgam po pas/ slob ma sgom chung la gsungs pa ni/ mdor na yod pa dang med pa dang stong pa dang mi stong pa/ rtog pa dang mi rtog pa/ bzang ba dang ngan pa/ legs pa dang ma legs pa la sogs pa'i dgag sgrub dang bcas bcos gang yang mi bya bar/ ji ltar 'char 'char du 'jug pa'i tha mal gyi shes pa 'di nyid kho na ma bcos pa yin gsungs so// zhes dang*/ yang rje sgam po pas/ tha mal gyi shes pa/ ma bcos pa/ gnyug ma gsum las/ tha mal gyi shes pa ni dang po'i shes pa grub mtha' gzhan gyis blo ma bsgyur ba'o// ma bcos pa ni/ bcas bcos mi bya bar rang gar bzhag pa'o/ zhes gsungs pa dang*/ rje yang dgon pas/ mdor na tha mal gyi shes pa sus kyang bzo ma byas pa'i ang so re ba 'di/ kho rang gis kho rang ngo shes pa de la phyag rgya chen po'i sgom skyes pa zer ba yin no// zhes gsungs pas so// de ltar na dang po sngar bshad pa'i sems nyid dang rtog pa dang snang ba gsum gyi gnas lugs dpyis phyin par ngo 'phrod pa zhig ci nas kyang dgos te/ de med na mig cer long can gyis gzugs kyi rnam pa la brtags pa ltar// 'dir tha mal gyi shes pa dang sems ma bcos pa'i don la phrig ci'ang ma tshud cing nges pa'i shes pa mi rnyed la/ de ltar ngo 'phrod na ni/ dgag sgrub kyi blos ma bcos ma bslad pa'i sems kyi 'dug tshul lam gnas tshul ci yod pa de ka la tha mal shes pa yin tshul dang*// de nyid chos sku yin tshul la nges shes gting nas skye bas de ltar tshul bzhin nyams su blangs pas mngon du 'gyur ba yin no// de ltar ma yin pa'i tha mal gyi shes pa'i 'dug tshul ji lta ba rtogs dka' ba'i gnas su bshad de/

rje yang dgon pas/ nyams dang ting nge 'dzin gyi bye brag phyed cing sgom du ngo sprod pa'i bla ma ni mang la/ tha mal gyi shes pa sgom du ngo sprod shes pa'i bla ma ni nyin mo'i skar ma las kyang dkon pa yin no// zhes gsungs pa ltar ro// de lta bu'i tha mal gyi shes pa ngo shes na sems kyi ngo bo mthong ba sogs kyi tha snyad 'jog cing*/ mthong tshul yang goms pa klong du gyur nas mthar mi rtog pa byung ma byung la ma ltos par/ rnam par rtog pa dang bcas/ sems chos med sgom ma byas dus kyi shes pa lta bu de nyid kyang grwa ma nyams zur ma chag par rang ngo shes shing grol ba zhig 'ong ste/ rje sgam po pas/ ji ltar snang ba'i shes pa grwa ma nyams/ zur ma chag pa gyed langs byed pa ni/ sangs rgyas dngos su zhal phyag lam me ba/ zhes dang*/ rje sgom chung gis/ dang po'i shes pa de dang gcig /tha mal gyi shes pa de dang gnyis// yul can gyi shes pa de dang gsum// gang gis de gsum ngo shes na// rang sems rang gis mngon sum du// ngos zin mthong ba ye shes so// sems nyid ma bcos gnyug ma yi// ngo bo rnal mar mthong ba yin// rtog dang bcas pa 'di ka rang*// bkra ni sa ler mthong ba yin// mdor na chos ye cha med pa'i// mi nag gi shes pa de rang yin// zhes sogs dang*/ rje rgya ras kyis/ skye bo tsa na'i shes pa 'di// chos kyi sku ru 'dug pa la// bla mas bstan kyang mi dgos par// rang gi shes su gsha' ba la// zhes pa la sogs sgrub brgyud kyi gsung shin tu mang ba'o// bzhi pa de la ma yengs pa phyag rgya chen po'i sgom du bstan pa bshad pa ni/ de ltar tha mal gyi shes pa de nyid rang ngo shes shing rang rig pa'i dran pa don thog ma yengs pa'i ngang nas/ 'phral du sems kyi rang babs la ci 'dug gang shar de nyid ma bcos par skyong ba la sgom pa zhes bya ste/ rje sgam po pas/ tha mal gyi shes pa yengs med 'di// sgom pa yin par da gzod shes// zhes gsungs pa ltar ro// des na sems kyi rang babs ci 'dug de kar rang ngo shes pa'i dran pa skyong ba las spros na/

de la slar bzo bcos byas shing lhan po btab nas bsgoms na sems ma bcos pa zhes pa'i don dang mi mthun zhing gnas lugs kyi sgom du mi 'gyur la/ 'on kyang 'dzin pa dang bcas pa'i 'khrul shes lang can par ni skad cig kyang yengs na mi rung ste/ gsang ba bdud rtsi rgyal po'i rgyud las/ rang bzhin stong pa 'od gsal ba// bsgom pas rnyed pa ma yin te// ma bsgom pas kyang rnyed pa min/ bsgom pa nyid kyang rtog pa ste// mi sgom pa yang rtog pa nyid// bsgom du rdul tsam med pa la// yengs su skad cig med pa'o// zhes dang*/ sha wa ris/ gang la'ang skyon du mi lta zhing*/ cir yang ma yengs nyams su blangs// drod rtags la sogs 'dod mi bya// bsgom du med par bstan mod kyang*// le lo btang snyoms dbang mi btang*// rgyun du dran pa bsgom par bya// zhes dang*/ sgom don grub pa las/ bsgom pa'i tshe na ci yang mi bsgom ste// tha snyad tsam du bsgom zhes de la brjod/ ces pa ltar ro// de ltar na rkyen snang gi shes pa la sems stong sang nge ba'am bde lam me ba'am/ rnam rtog 'tshubs zing nge ba 'phro ba'am/ snang ba sna tshogs bkra lam gyis 'char yang gnas lugs kyi rang rtsal la khu 'phrig mi byed par rang ngo shes shing rang rig pa'i dran pa 'di nyid ma yengs pa de dag thams cad bzo ma bcos par lhag par skyong ba yin gyis/ rtog pa 'phro ba bkug pa dang*/ snang ba 'char ba bkag nas mi rtog par 'jog dgos pa la/ rje gtsang pa rgya ras kyis sgom lcags kyu ma'i tha snyad mdzad cing sgom rlabs kyang cung zad chung ba yin la/ sems nyid kyi ngo bo dang rnam rtog dang snang ba'i 'char sgo sogs rang rkya thub pa'i tha dad du grub pa gtan nas med pas/ nyi ma las 'od 'phro ba'am mtsho las rlabs shar ba'i dpes mtshon par/ sems rig pa'i rang rtsal sna tshogs su shar ba yin pas/ sems kyi rang babs la ci shar cir snang yang don la bzang ngan med de/

des na gnas na gnas thog /'gyu na 'gyu thog /snang na snang thog de ka rang ngo shes shing rang rig pa'i dran pas skyong ba las gzhan pa'i bsgyur bkod dang bzo bcos bya mi dgos te/ rje sgam po pas/ dgag sgrub kyi rtsol ba mi bya bar mi rtog par 'dug kyang rung*/ rnam rtog sna tshogs su 'char kyin 'dug kyang rung ma bcos par bzhag pas rang gi gnyis 'dzin dang bral/ gnyis med kyi ye shes rang du 'dug ang snyam pa'i go ba byung tsa na/ sems kho rang gi ngo bo'am gshis sam 'dug tshul ngo shes pa yin no// de ltar go na bsgom bya mi dgos/ bor ba'am bzhag tu mi btub par bsgom dbang med du skye ba yin no// rnam rtog sna tshogs dgag tu mi btub par 'char bar 'dug tsa na gnyis med kyi ye shes kyang dgag tu mi btub par 'char ro// zhes dang*/ sgom chung gis/ rig pa gsal ba'i ngo bo de// 'bral med yengs med rgyun chad med// de yi ngang la dran rtog ni// sna tshogs gang dang gang byung ba// thams cad de yi ngo bo yin// tha mal shes pa ma yengs na// dran rtog thams cad rig pa yin// de la skyon du blta mi dgos// zhes gsungs pa ltar ro// 'o na khrid rim ltar khrid mi dgos par thog ma nyid nas sems la ci shar dran pas bzung bas chog gam snyam na/ cig car ba'i rigs can kha cig la de ltar byas nas ngo sprad pas chog pa srid kyang*/ phal cher la khrid rim ltar byas nas ma khrid na sems nyid dang rtog pa dang snang ba'i gnas tshul la sgro 'dogs mi chod cing*/ de dag gi ngo mthong ba'i nyams myong dang nges shes mi 'byung bas dran pa spyi tsam pa yin zhing*/ rang ngo shes shing rang rig pa'i dran pa med pas mi 'ong ste/ 'di la rje sgam po pas/ 'o na 'jig rten pa rnams kyang rnam rtog rang gar 'dug /rnal 'byor pa'ang rang ga tha mal gyi shes par 'dug pa la/ de gnyis la khyad par ci yod/ khyad par med na 'jig rten pa'ang rang grol du mi 'gro'am snyam na/

'jig rten pa la rnal 'byor pa'i gdams ngag med pas/ gnyis med ngo mi shes te dgag sgrub gnyis 'dzin 'ba' zhig 'byung ngo*// gdams ngag thob kyang gnyis med kyi ye shes nges med sna tshogs su 'char ba la yid mi ches pas gnyis 'dzin gyi rnam rtog las grol ba med par skyes shing*/ chos pa rnams kyang thos bsam sgom gsum gyi gnyis 'dzin gyi sdug bsngal sbyong ngo*// rnal 'byor pa ni/ dgag sgrub kyi rgyu dang bral nas gnyis med kyi ye shes nges med kyi rnam rtog bde ba chen po sna tshogs su 'char ro// de gnyis kyi khyad par ni gnad ka de las byung ngo*// zhes mtha' bcad nas gsungs pa ltar yin no// drug pa rang sems ngo bo rang bzhin mtshan nyid gsum gyi sgo nas ngo sprod bshad pa ni// spyir sems kyi gnas tshul la/ ngo bo dang*/ rang bzhin dang*/ mtshan nyid de rnam pa gsum gyi tha snyad bzhag kyang*/ don du sems kyi ngo bo nyid las gzhan min te/ man snyer/ dngos po rnams kyi stong pa nyid kyi ngo bo ni/ rang bzhin dang rnam pa zhes pa don gzhan ma yin te/ rang gi ngo bo zhes pa'i don to// zhes pa ltar ro// 'on kyang ldog pa'i sgo nas phye na/ ngo bo rang bzhin mtshan nyid gsum du phye nas so sor ngos 'dzin yang gsungs te/ rje sgam po pas/ sems kyi ngo bo rang bzhin mtshan nyid gsum las/ ngo bo gsal la rtog pa med pa/ rang bzhin skye 'gags gnas gsum dang bral ba/ mtshan nyid 'khor 'das gnyis su snang ba/ zhes dang*/ yang sems kyi ngo bo bya ba rig pa skye 'gags med pa de yin no// sems kyi rang bzhin bya ba/ rang bzhin gyis dag pa 'khor 'das thams cad la khyab pa'i 'dus ma byas pa de yin no// sems kyi mtshan nyid bya ba bag chags kyi gzugs brnyan sna tshogs su snang ba 'di yin no// zhes dang*/ rje phag mo gru pas/ gnyis su med pa phyag rgya che// mtshan nyid ngo bo rang bzhin gsum// rang bzhin gsal la go ma 'gags// ngo bo skye 'gags spros dang bral// mtshan nyid 'khor 'das du mar snang*// zhes dang*/

rje rang byung pas/ ngo bo stong la rang bzhin gsal// rnam pa 'gags med cir yang 'char// zhes so// sems kyi ngo bo ni/ gdod nas skye 'gags gnas gsum gyi dngos po thams cad dang bral ba/ phung khams skye mched sogs gzung 'dzin gyi rtog pas ma gos pa/ chos thams cad kyi ngo bo bdag med mnyam pa nyid kyi rang bzhin stong pa nyid du gnas te/ gsang 'dus las/ dngos po thams cad dang bral ba// phung po khams dang skye mched dang*// gzung dang 'dzin pa rnams spang pa// chos bdag med pa mnyam nyid pas// rang sems gdod nas ma skyes pa// stong pa nyid kyi rang bzhin no// zhes dang*/ byang chub sems 'grel du/ sangs rgyas rnams kyi byang chub sems// bdag dang phung po rnam rig gi /rtog pa rnams kyis ma bsgribs shing*// rtag tu stong nyid mtshan nyid bzhed/ ces so// des na sngar bshad pa ltar sems kyi ngo bo la tshul mtha' dag gis dpyad cing btsal ba na/ mtshan gzhir grub pa ci'ang ma rnyed cing*/ 'tshol mkhan gyi blo'i spros pa nyid kyang rang zhi rang zad pa ni don dam pa dang ye nas gnas pa'i chos nyid stong pa nyid du bshad de/ bden gnyis las/ kun rdzob 'di ltar snang ba 'di// rig pas brtags na 'ga' mi rnyed// ma rnyed pa nyid don dam yin// ye nas gnas pa'i chos nyid do// zhes pa ltar ro// de lta bu'i sems kyi ngo bo stong pa nyid de ni snang srid 'khor 'das kyis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad kyi ngo bo stong nyid kyang yin te/ ār+ya de was/ dngos gcig dngos po kun gyi ngo bo nyid// dngos kun dngos po gcig gi ngo bo nyid// ces dang*/ bzhi brgya par/ gcig gi stong nyid gang yin pa// de ni kun gyi stong nyid yin// zhes dang*/ bden gnyis las/ stong pa nyid la tha dad ni// cung zad yod pa ma yin no// zhes gsungs so// rang bzhin ni/ brgyad stong par/ sems gyi rang bzhin ni 'od gsal ba'o// zhes dang*/

lang gshegs las/ sems ni rang bzhin 'od gsal te// de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po dag /ces pa la sogs pa sems kyi rang bzhin 'od gsal bar gsungs pa shin tu mang la/ 'od gsal ba zhes pa'i don ni/ skye 'gags la sogs pa'i spros pas dag cing ma gos pa/ phung khams la sogs pa'i rdul dang bral zhing dri ma med pa/ nam mkha' ltar rnam pa kun tu 'gyur ba med pa/ nam mkha'i rang bzhin dang gnyis su med pa la bshad de/ nye bar 'khor gyis zhus pa las/ sems 'di rang bzhin 'od gsal rnam dag cing*// rdul med rdul bral dri ma med par gsungs// zhes dang*/ rgyud bla mar/ sems kyi rang bzhin 'od gsal gang yin pa// de ni nam mkha' bzhin du 'gyur ba med// ces dang*/ gsang 'dus las/ chos rnams rang bzhin 'od gsal bas// gdod nas dag pa nam mkha' bzhin// zhes gsungs/ de ltar na 'ga' zhig gis sems kyi nyams snang gsal cha ci rigs shar ba la rang bzhin gyi 'od gsal ba'i don du rloms pa dang*/ 'od gsal zhes pa'ang nyin byed kyi 'od ltar snang ba dang bcas pa zhig tu nor te/ sems kyi rang bzhin de spros pa'i dri mas ma gos shing de'i dri ma rnam par dag pa la rang bzhin gyis 'od gsal ba'i tha snyad btags pa tsam yin pa gong gi lung rnams kyis grub pa'i phyir dang*/ sems kyi rang bzhin kha dog dang 'od kyi snang ba lta bu'i 'od gsal rgyu yod na sems kha dog dang 'od kyi rang bzhin can du 'gyur ba'i phyir dang*/ de ltar na sems rang bzhin med pa dang rang bzhin gyis dag pa mi 'thad par 'gyur ba'i phyir ro// 'o na rnal 'byor pa'i nyams myong gi 'char tshul la kha dog dang 'od kyi snang ba las 'das pa'i sems kyi rang snang ngam rang 'od lta bu'i rang rig cing rang gsal ba'i shes pa de ji ltar yin snyam na/ de ni nā ro pa'i lta ba mdor bsdus las/ snang zhing srid pa'i chos 'di rnams// rang rig sems las gud na med// snang zhing gsal ba yin pa'i phyir// dper na rang rig nyams myong bzhin// zhes dang*/

rang rig spros bral de nyid kyang*// snang zhing stong la stong zhing snang*// de phyir snang stong dbyer med de// dper na chu yi zla ba ltar// zhes bshad pa ltar sems la gsal rig gi nyams myong shar ba tsam yin la/ de la deng sang nyams myong gi skad cha la rig pa zhes ming du btags pa snang yang*/ de lta bu de rtog pa dang bcas pa'i phyir dang*/ rnam kun mchog ldan gyi stong pa min pa'i phyir dang*/ kun gyi khyab bdag ma yin pa'i phyir rig pa ji lta ba min te/ dus 'khor 'grel chen las/ 'o na rig pa gang yin zhe na/ smras pa/ rig pa zhes pa rnam par mi rtog pa nang gi rig pa ste/ rnam pa thams cad dang ldan pa'i stong pa nyid do// yang 'gyur med kyang rig pa ste/ dmigs pa med pa zag pa med pa'i bdag nyid can no/ rig pa dang ni rgyu dang 'bras bu'i bdag nyid can/ rgyu dang 'bras bu gcig tu 'dres par gyur pa ste/ me'i 'od dang sreg par byed pa gcig tu 'dres par gyur pa bzhin no// zhes dang*/ mtshan brjod las/ kun shes kun rig dam pa po// rnam par shes pa'i chos nyid 'das// zhes sogs dang*/ bdag rig gzhan rig thams cad rig /ces gsungs pa ltar ro// rje 'bri gung pas/ phyag rgya chen po zhes bya ba// rang gi rig pa 'di nyid yin// zhes gsungs pa sogs bsgom byar bshad pa'i rig pa thams cad kyang de bzhin du shes dgos so// de ltar na rnal 'byor pa'i nyams snang la ci shar yang de nyid so so rang rig dang*/ rang bzhin 'od gsal gyi don du gtan nas mi rung ste// dgongs 'grel las/ so so rang rig mtshan med spyod yul te// zhes sogs dang*/ gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i rgyud las// rtag chad skye 'gags la sogs pa'i// mtha' spang sems ni rang rig cing*// gdod nas spros pa med pa nyid// de don bsam mi khyab par nges// zhes so so rang rig gi don mtshan ma med pa dang*/ bsam gyis mi khyab pa la bshad pa'i phyir dang*/

rang bzhin 'od gsal gyi don yang*/ sngar bshad pa ltar yin pa'i phyir ro// mtshan nyid ni/ de ltar sems kyi ngo bo rang bzhin rnam dag de nyid glo bur gyi dri mas bsgribs nas/ rang gi gnas lugs rang gis ma rig pas kun nas nyon mongs kyi rten 'brel la brten nas rigs drug bde sdug dang bcas te 'khor ba'i rnam par snang ba dang*/ glo bur gyi dri ma dang bral zhing gnas lugs rig pa las rnam byang gi rten 'brel la brten nas chos sku don dam pa'i sku mngon du gyur te gzhan snang gzugs sku'i bkod pa sgyu ma lta bu snang ba yin te/ lta ba mdor bsdus las/ e ma hoḥ sems nyid dri ma dang bcas de'i// rnam 'phrul 'gro ba drug la sogs// nam mkha'i khams kyi mtha' klas par// sdug bsngal 'khrul 'khor bsam las 'das// zhes dang*/ e ma hoḥ/ sems nyid dri ma med de yi// rnam 'phrul gzugs skus bsdus pa yi// zhing khams dag par snang ba dang*// dkyil 'khor rnam 'phrul sna tshogs pa// ngo mtshar che ba'i rnam 'phrul dag /nam mkha'i mtha' klas khyab par snang*// zhes dang*/ saṃ bhu ṭir/ chags sogs dgag dka'i dri mas gos gyur pa'i// sems ni rdo rje can gyis 'khor bar gsungs// rang bzhin 'od gsal rtog las rnam par grol// 'dod chags la sogs dri mas gos bral ba'i// gzung ba dang ni 'dzin med sems dpa' mchog /de nyid mya ngan 'das pa mchog tu gsungs// zhes dang*/ rje zla 'od gzhon nus/ de la 'khor ba zhes bya ba ni rang bzhin stong pa nyid yin/ rnam pa 'khrul pa yin/ mtshan nyid sdug bsngal du shar ba yin/ mya ngan las 'das pa zhes bya ba ni rang bzhin stong pa nyid yin/ rnam pa 'khrul pa thams cad zad cing yal ba yin/ mtshan nyid sdug bsngal thams cad las grol ba yin/ zhes gsungs so// 'khrul pa'i tshul yang 'ga' zhig tu// 'khrul pa gzhi la yod srid na// gzhi de dri ma can du 'gyur// gzhi la dri ma gtan med na// gzhi de 'bras bu nyid du 'gyur// 'khrul pa lam nas byung srid na// lam de 'khor ba'i thog mar 'gyur// 'khrul pa sngar med gsar byung na// sangs rgyas sa la 'khrul bar 'gyur// zhes 'byung yang don du/

mtshungs med rgyal dbang rjes/ gzhi la 'khrul pa med kyang gzhi dus nas 'khrul/ zhes gsungs par/ 'di dag gsal zhing go sla ba ni/ grub mchog mi pham blo gros kyi gsung sgros las/ gzhi la 'khrul pa med kyang med pa la med par ngo ma shes pa yin/ de la lhan cig skyes pa'i ma rig pa zer/ des kha phyir bltas nas las sna tshogs gsog pa'i blo'am/ rnam par rtog pa 'di la kun btags kyi ma rig pa bya ba yin/ dper na thag pa sbrul min te min pa la min par ngo ma shes par 'khrul pa ni lhan skyes kyi ma rig pa lta bu yin/ sbrul du 'khrul pa tsam nas sdug bsngal gyi rnam par rtog pa du ma 'byung ba kun btags kyi ma rig pa lta bu yin/ rnam pa 'khrul pa yin/ mtshan nyid sdug bsngal du shar ba yin/ de'ang thog mar thag pa mthong ba'i dus nyid nas sbrul du snang ba bzhin/ lhan skyes kyi ma rig pa dang*/ sems nyid la dus snga phyi gzhan rkyen gyi thag pa med pa yin/ phyis bla ma dam pa'i man ngag gis 'khrul pa'i rtsa ba sems su shes nas 'khrul pa gzhan du ma song zhing*/ 'khrul pa nyid ye shes su 'char ba yin/ thag pa sbrul du 'khrul pa phyis gzhan rkyen gyis thag par rtogs pa'i tshe/ sbrul gzhan du ma song bar sbrul du snang ba de ka thag par shes pas sdug bsngal las grol ba bzhin/ rnam pa 'khrul pa thams cad zad cing yal ba yin/ mtshan nyid sdug bsngal thams cad las grol ba yin/ zhes gsungs/ yang lhan skyes kyi ma rig pa dang glo bur gyi dri ma la/ khyad par yod dam med/ med na ni/ lhan skyes kyi ma rig pa dang glo bur zhes brjod pa'i don gang lags/ zhes zhus par sems nyid kyi dbyings rang bzhin gyis rnam par dag cing 'dus ma byas pa yin pa la/ dri ma ni spang bya 'dus byas mi rtag cing 'gyur ba'i chos can yin pas/ glo bur ba zhes brjod cing*/ lhan skyes kyi ma rig pa ni glo bur gyi dri ma las ma 'das pa yin zhing mtshan nyid 'khor 'das sna tshogs su snang ba'o// zhes pa'i tha snyad gsungs so// deng sang rnal 'byor pa'i nyams myong gi skabs su'ang sems kyi rnam pa cir yang ma nges shing gang du'ang 'gag pa med par sna tshogs su 'char ba ni bag chags sna tshogs pa'i stobs kyis phyi rol gyi don ma yin pa la don ltar 'char zhing*/

de'ang las dang bag chags kyi rkyen gyis ji ltar brtags pa dang bsgyur ba de ltar snang ba ni/ dper na snam bu tshon gyis bsgyur ba ltar ngo bo ma 'gyur yang rnam pa sna tshogs par 'gyur ba ste/ lang gshegs las/ sems ni rang bzhin gyis rnam par dag cing 'od gsal ba ste/ de ni ji lta ji ltar brtag pa de lta de ltar snang ste/ dper na snam bu dkar po kha dog tshon gyis bsgyur ba bzhin no/ zhes gsungs so/ de ltar rnams kyis sems kyi ngo bo rang bzhin mtshan nyid ji bzhin gyi gnas lugs shes pa'i sgo nas nyams len la gnad du bsnun dgos pa'o// bdun pa rang sems mnyam rjes kyi sgo nas ngo sprod bshad pa la// dang po mnyam rjes kyi ngos bzung bshad pa/ gnyis pa mnyam rjes spyi'i skyong thabs bshad pa/ gsum pa mnyam rjes kyi skyong thabs bshad pa/ bzhi pa rjes thob sgyu ma lta bur 'char tshul bshad pa/ lnga pa mnyam rjes 'dres ma 'dres kyi dbye ba bshad pa'o// dang po mnyam rjes kyi ngos bzung bshad pa ni/ de la mnyam bzhag rjes shes rjes thob gsum du yod pa las/ dang po sems nyid lhan skyes dang*/ rnam rtog lhan skyes ngo 'phrod pa'i sems nyid tha mal gyi gshis de ka phyag rgya chen po'i ngo bor shes shing rang rig la lta mkhan blta yul dang*/ gzhag bya 'jog byed ma grub par rig pa'i gshis rang gnas dang*/ rang mdangs sna tshogs su 'phro ba de rnams ye nas tha dad ma yin/ lhan cig skyes pa'i rang bzhin kho na yin bzhin gnas lugs rtogs pas gang shar cir snang la tha dad du lta ba'i ngos bzung blos bsgom mi dgos par/ rang bzhin rang ngo shes pa'i rang babs gu yangs kha yan du skyong chog na mnyam bzhag gsha' ma dang*/ de ltar gshis lugs ni/ lta ba sgrib pa yongs bral du rtogs par ma nus goms 'dris chung ba'i dbang gis rtsal ma rdzogs tshe brjed skabs lta bu los yong yang*/ sems nyid yang dag pa'i ngo na/

brjed yengs dang dran shes la ched du bzang ngan ma grub bzhin dran shes la ched 'dzin blos bsgom bzo bcos lhan po gdab mi dgos par rang babs 'tsho skyong chog pa lta bu'am/ min kyang sems nyid gshis kyi ngo thog tu bzhag nas/ de las gzhan pa'i dran rtog dang yid la byed pa thams cad dang bral bar mtshan ma'i rnam par rtog pas g.yeng ba ma byung gi bar de srid sems rnal phebs su 'jog pa la mnyam bzhag tu byed/ rjes shes ni/ 'char sgo gang byung gi ro myong 'dzin pa zhugs pa yin te/ dper na lam du mgyogs par 'gro ba la sgrog gis ma bcings pa zhig dgos pa bzhin/ rtogs pa'i na 'phar ba la'ang 'dzin pa ma zhugs pa gal che bas 'dzin pa'ang phyogs gcig rang rkyang tsam min par/ phyi nang gsang gsum du phye dgos te/ de la phyi rol 'jig rten 'dir snang gnyen nye ba rgyu nor zog zas la sogs par a 'thas dngos por 'dzin pa/ nang du chags sdang sogs dug lnga/ bde sdug legs nyes sogs rkyen snang gi tshogs/ gsang ba bsgom 'dod myong 'dod dang bcas pa ste/ de rnams kyang ngos ma zin pa rjes shes la 'khrul pa'i rjes shes yin/ ngos zin bzhin 'dzin pa zhugs pa shes bzhin gyi rjes shes dang*/ dran 'dun gyis ngos ma zin pa'i 'dzin zhen la ro myong nas las gsog pa de tha mal par 'khrul pa'i rjes shes yin// shes bzhin rjes shes ni/ rtsa chad kyi lo ma skam med dang*/ sgom pa mi shul du khyi rjes dod pa zhes bya bas gang shar gdams ka mi dgos par gu yangs lta bur skyong ba de ka rang gis chog rgyur byas nas/ slar skad cig yengs med kyi gnad mi bzung nas 'dzin pa zhugs pa la rtsis gdab mi gtong bar skyon med du bsam nas bag yangs su 'jog pa dang las gsog pa de la zer ba yin pas/ shes bzhin du dug mi 'thung ba dang*/ mgo rmog nang du ma chag par bya dgos so// rjes thob ni/ gshis mnyam bzhag stong nyid ngang las ma g.yos bzhin/

mdangs rkyen snang 'dzin zhen thams cad mi 'gag par ci'ang 'char mod kyang*/ 'char ba de rnams rang babs kyi ngo shes 'dzin pa rang dag tu song na rjes thob lam du slong ba yin pas rang grol zhes zer ba'o// gzhan yang cir snang gi rang tshugs mi thub par ngo shes 'char tsam nyid nas yongs su grol ba shar grol dus mnyam dang*/ bya nam mkhar 'phur bar rjes med pa ltar rtog rkyen ci byung la 'dzin zhen gyi nad ro dang bag chags kyi rjes med pa zhes gsungs par 'dug kyang*/ rjes ma 'di dag ni 'byung dka' bar snang*/ ci ste na rkyen snang 'ga' re rang grol du 'gro dka' la/ gang zhig gdong gang du de dbang ma song na'ang*/ slar yang dang yang du dran pa'i nad ro ldang ba dang*/ dngos gzhi'i skabs 'dzin zhen che ba ma zhugs na'ang*/ snod du gla rtsi med kyang de nyid kyi dri ma mi yal ba ltar/ bag chags de ni ci nas kyang dag mi thub pa sogs 'dug par nged rang gis blun sgom don gnad mi shes pa'i mun nag 'thom 'gros dang*/ gang yang skyon du ngos mi zin pa kha ba'i 'og gi 'bar 'bur ltar/ ma yin pa la yin par rgyas 'debs ri bo gser sgom rnams su ma song ba'i thog mtha' bar gsum gyi sgom don gyi gnad shes pa/ phyi nang gsang ba'i 'dzin zhen la skyon du mthong ba/ dran pa rang bzhin shes pa'i ngo thog tu thag chod nges shes thob pa rnams shin tu gces pa'o// gnyis pa mnyam rjes spyi'i skyong thabs bshad pa ni/ rje grub thob chen po u rgyan pas gsungs pa'i sgom don rnam pa bzhi ltar na/ ma bcos so mar 'jog pa/ dran rtog rang yal du gtong ba/ sna tshogs grogs su khyer ba/ snang ba rgya yan du skyong ba rnam so// de la dang po ma bcos so mar 'jog pa zhes pa ni/ sems dus gsum gyi bsam blo thams cad spangs pas ma bcos pa/ ched du bsgom ched du 'dzin pa dang bral ba'i ngang nas sems kyi rang gshis ngo bo so ma ji ltar 'dug pa de ltar gyi steng du glod nas 'jog pas so ma ste/

der yang rang gshis rang ngo shes tsam gyi dran shes dang ma bral ba zhig ni dgos shing gal che/ dran shes de las gzhan bsam dang bsam bya dmigs pa bsgom pa'i yul gang la'ang gtad so med par 'jog rgyu yin// gnyis pa dran rtog rang yal du gtong ba ni/ sems kyi gshis thog tu dran rtog mang po 'phro ba de rnams ngos zin tsam las/ gzhan bzo bcos mi byed par rang ngo de ka'i steng du bzhag /ngo bo de kar bltas pas na mthar ngos bzung med pa'i rang yal du 'gro ba de bzhin 'ong ba'i don gyis dran rtog rang yal du gtong ba zhes gsungs// gsum pa sna tshogs grogs su 'khyer ba ni/ de ltar sems kyi ngo bo ma bcos so ma shes bzhin ldan pa nas dran rtog sna tshogs spang blang med par rang ngor lta zhing rgyun du de ltar 'bad pas 'phral rtags su sems gsal ba 'dra ba dang*/ skabs su mi gsal ba'i byed pa 'dra ba dang*/ skabs su dran rtogs rgod pa sogs skyong bde ba mi bde ba sna tshogs byung na/ de ltar gang shar yang skyon dang yon tan zhes ched du mi 'dzin/ bzang ba bde ba 'dra ba tsho sgrub blo mi byed/ ngan pa mi bde ba 'dra ba tsho dgag blo mi byed par bzang ngan thams cad rang sems gcig pu 'di'i rol gar du thag bcad nas/ gang shar gyi ngo bo'i rang thog tu 'jog dgos/ de ltar thams cad grogs su 'khyer te bzhag pas mthar kun kyang grogs su 'gro bas na sna tshogs grogs 'khyer zhes gsungs/ de bzhin phyi rol gyi yul lnga la'ang brtag dpyad legs nyes bzang ngan la 'dzin pa chags sdang dbang du mi gtong bar/ gang snang shes bzhin gyis zin par byas nas de ka'i thog tu 'jog dgos shing*/ mdor na tshogs drug yul snang thams cad kyi steng du bzo bcos kyi 'dzin pa mi gzhug par rang ngo skyong ba'i grogs su 'khyer rgyu yin par 'dug go/ bzhi pa snang ba rgya yan du gtong ba ni/ phyi yul snang nang rang snang thams cad mi 'gag mi bcings par ngo shes ngos zin tsam nas de thog tu kho rang rgya yan lhug par 'jog pa yin/

de ltar gyi don yang mdor dril na rnam grangs mang po yod pa ma yin te/ sems nyid rang gshis ji ltar 'dug pa de la bzo bcos med par byas/ rang ngo ma yengs tsam gyi ngang la rang lugs su 'bol le/ rtsol med du cham me/ bzo med du shig ge bzhag /yengs med du dran pa tu re bskyangs/ 'gyu ba gang shar yang de la bcas bcos mi byed par rang ngo skyong*/ phyi rol snang ba 'dzin med rang lugs kyi gshis su 'khyer ba de dag yin/ skyong tshul de dag phal cher mnyam rjes gang la'ang phyogs mthun par snang bas spyi'i skyong tshul du bstan pa'o// gsum pa mnyam rjes kyi skyong thabs ni/ thun gyi dngos gzhir/ byang sems rin po ches/ rjes shes zad sar ma bskyal bar// lus gnad rdo rje'i skyil krung dang*// ma bral ba 'di gal che'o// zhes gsungs so// ngag ma bcos par smra bsam brjod med lkugs pa lta bur nyams su len par bya/ yid ma bcos pa rnam rtog snga phyi'i rjes su mi 'brang bar da lta'i shes pa gang shar gyi ngo bo de la bzo bcos mi byed par rang thog tu bzhag /gcun thabs kun gyi rtsa ba 'di nyid ma 'phyugs pa gnad du che ste/ pha dam pas/ gzhi sems can gyi lus ngag yid gsum 'di// lam rnal 'byor pas bcos med gsum du bzhag /'bras bu sangs rgyas kyi sku gsung thugs su grol// zhes dang*/ bang mdzod las/ sems ma bcos na gsal// chu ma rnyogs na dwangs// zhes so// de ltar 'char sgo ji snyed kyi rang thog tu bzhag pas gsal stong 'dzin med rjes shes dang*/ phra rags kyi rtog tshogs ma spangs rang sar thim pas 'od gsal nam mkha'i dkyil lta bu sems nyid lhan skyes kyi ngo bo la rtse gcig tu mnyam par 'jog pa gnyis spel ma'i tshul gyis nyams su blangs/ rjes kyi thun mtshams rnams su ji ltar bya snyam na/ 'dir yang dang por 'bad rtsol bskyed nas dran shes rgyun chags la bslab dgos te/

rje 'bri gung pas/ dran mkhas na bsgom mkhas/ bu kun dran par rtsis su gyis dang*// zhes gsungs pa ltar te/ de'ang skabs 'dir dran rgyu'i dran pa ni/ gtso bor sngar ngo sprad pa'i sems nyid lhan skyes kyi nyams myong nges shes dang bcas pa de nyid yin la/ 'on kyang cung zad mi 'dra ba'i khyad par ni de lta bu dge sbyor gyi dran shugs sam rtsi ma shor tsam gyi dran pa yud de ba'i ngang nas/ 'phral du rkyen shar gyi rtog pa'am/ gzugs sgra sogs kyi snang ba gsal bzhin pa'i thog tu dgag sgrub kyi bden 'dzin ma zhugs par/ dper na bu chung gis lha khang mthong ba'i shes pa ltar gsal la 'dzin pa med pa'i dran pa gu yangs seng nge ba zhig blo rgya bskyed nas 'jog pa yin te/ mdor na sngar ngo sprad pa'i rnam rtog lhan skyes dang snang ba lhan skyes kyi dge sbyor de gnyis kyi ngang skyong ba yin te/ 'di la spyod 'jug las/ ji ltar mthong thos shes pa dag /'dir ni dgag par bya min te// 'dir ni sdug bsngal rgyur gyur pa'i// bden par rtag pa dgag bya yin// zhes bshad do// 'o na de lta bu'i dran pa des dge sbyor ji ltar skyong snyam na/ dper na rdzi bo mkhas pas phyugs skyong ba lta bu bya ste/ des phyugs rnams bzas la ci bder 'gro zhing yan yang*/ de dag gi sna bskyil ba dang rjes 'brang la sogs kyi dka' tshegs bya mi dgos par phyugs rnams mig lam nas ma dor tsam du bskyangs pas chog pa ltar/ 'dir yang rtog pa dang snang ba'i 'char sgo rnams bskyil nas bkag pa'am mi gsal bar byas te ngo thog tu bsgyur ba lta bu'ang ma yin/ rtog snang gi rjes su 'brang nas yengs te dran pa'i rtsi shor zhing dgag sgrub kyi 'dzin pa zhugs pas/ rtog pa dang snang ba rang kha mar 'thas pa'ang ma yin par rnam shes tshogs drug dang rang gi yul thog tu ji ltar 'char yang 'char sgo de nyid gsal bzhin du de'i rang bzhin ngos bzung med pa'i nges shes dang ldan par/

rtog pa thams cad stong 'gyu/ snang ba thams cad stong snang la 'dzin med kyi dran pas bzo ma bcos par rang lugs su skyong ba yin te/ rje rgod tshang pas/ yang gcig rnam rtog skyes pa na// ngo yis tsir gyis bzung mdzod la// kho rang thog tu glod la zhog /rang sar grol bar the tshom med// phyi yi yul la cer gyis ltos// rang sems sgyu ma lta bu yin// gang snang thog tu 'dzin med zhog /bar gyi rig pa khrol du chug /'gyu ba dngos med sir bu 'dra// 'dzin pa ma zhugs 'gyus pas chog /de la rnam rtog sgom shar zer// rang ngo shes pas dgag sgrub bral// ma yengs tsam las bsgom rgyu med// bsgom med ngang las ma yengs mdzod// ces go bde zhing don 'gril bar gsungs pa ltar ro// de lta bu'i spyod lam rnam bzhir dran pas rtsis zin tsam du legs par bskyangs pas/ las dang po pa la thog mar yengs pa shas che'ang*/ mnyam bzhag gi skabs su ngo thog la dran shugs bskyed pa dang*/ rjes thob kyi skabs 'dir yang*/ rtsol bcas kyi dran pa tu re bsten pas rtog pa dang snang ba lam du khyer nas/ rjes shes dang rjes snang thams cad la ngo thog gi dran rgyun gyis bskyangs pas/ dran pa ma yengs pa'i rkang tshugs pa dang*/ rjes thob gcod che ba gnyis ka 'byung la/ de gnyis gcig gis gcig la bogs thon sgom skyed che bar yong ba'i thabs su snang la/ gnas lugs rig pa'i rig shes kyi rgyun dang ldan na/ rjes thob gang shar rang babs su skyong ba dang*/ rkyen snang la bzo bcos mi byed pa sogs kyi thog tu nges pa rnyed par 'gyur bas/ rnam pa kun tu don thog nas ma yengs pa'i dran pa dang bcas pa dang*/ dran pa sgom gyi dngos gzhir 'gyur ba'i rgyu mtshan yang de ltar yin te/ rje sgam po pas/ dran pa'i rgyal po ma yengs lta ba sgoms// sna tshogs rkyen gyis mi 'gyur de la brtson// ma yengs dran pa'i rgyun lam gzhan mi btsal// zhes dang*/

ji srid 'dzin pa'i brtod phur ma phyin par// de srid rnam rtog yod pa'i las sogs pas// ma yengs dran pa'i bya ra bsten pa legs// zhes gsungs so// tshul de dag ni gong smos ltar rjes shes la 'khrul pa dang*/ shes bzhin rjes shes gnyis ka lam du khyer ba'i 'dzin pa dang las bsags kyi dbang du ma shor ba bya/ 'on kyang da dung nang du gzung 'dzin gyi dri ma/ bag chags kyi nad ro// bag nyal gyi 'khrul pa la sogs pa rnams shin tu rig par dka' bas yin rgyu 'dra bar min pa'i ri bo gser bsgom dang*/ rnam rtog kha ba'i 'og gi 'bar 'bur zhes pa'i dpe bzhin du lus dogs yod cing*/ sgom skyon phal cher bag nyal du gnas gsungs pas de ngos zin par byas nas dag pa zhig dgos par snang bas/ phyi rkyen bde sdug bzang ngan ji ltar byung yang chags sdang spang blang dbang du ma song ba zhig dgos la/ de'ang phyi nang chags sdang gzung 'dzin zhen 'khris gang shugs che zhing mi 'dres par ched du ngos zin par bya ba'i gnyen po yang dag gi dran pa dpung bskyed/ 'dun sems bag yod la dus kun bslab/ rags pa rnams shes bzhin las bsags kyi dbang du mi btang*/ bag la nyal phra zhing phra ba tshun ngos zin par byas nas dran thog tu ro snyoms pas lam du khyer dgos pa yin/ de la phyi rkyen 'jig rten 'dir snang gnyen nye ba rgyu nor zog zas thams cad ni/ mdangs sum gyi rmi lam 'dra bar rang nyid 'khrul snang de la zhen 'dzin gyi dbang du ma song ba'i zhen med 'dzin med la bslab/ phyi rkyen bzang na bzang thog tu mi zhen bzang ba lam du khyer/ ngan na ngan thog tu mi zhum ngan thog tu dran pa bsten/ nang rkyen zhe sdang na sdang thog tu dran pa bsten/ 'dod zhen na zhen thog tu ro snyoms pa de bzhin dug lnga gzhan dang rigs 'gres/ rang sems bde na bde thog tu 'jog /sdug na sdug thog tu dran pa bsten pa sogs mdor na phyi rkyen bzang ngan thams cad dang de'i dbang gis nang du rang gi sems la sdug bsngal ba dang bde ba sna tshogs 'byung bas de rnams thams cad de dbang du ma song ba'i/

chags sdang spang blang 'dzin pa med pa'i dran pa rang thog tu lam du khyer ba gal du che'o// phal cher gyis shes bzhin 'dzin dbang du 'gro ba skyon med du 'jog pa 'dis ni sgom la yar skyed med par ma zad/ slar mar skyed du song nas sgom chen rtogs ldan blo dred tshe 'di'i 'dam du tshud pa zhig yong bar 'dug pas zhe zon bya rgyu ci yod 'di la byed pa gal che zhing*/ sgom med yengs med la dus kun brtson pa dang*/ phyi nang dngos 'dzin ro myong 'dzin 'khris zhugs su mi 'jug par gang la'ang 'dzin med rang grol gyi gnad bzung*/ 'dzin pa zhugs na 'dzin mkhan rang thog tu ma yengs par bzhag la rang dwangs su btang dgos/ rtogs pa shar ba rnams kyis bsgom bya sgom byed bzo bcos mi dgos kyang rgyu mtshan legs shes kyi sgo nas thag mi chod cing rang rig tha mal gyi shes pa rang babs ngo shes 'di las ched du sgom mi dgos kyang sngon gyi gzung dran gyi blo ro de da dung mi bskyur bar bsgom rgyu zhig blo la 'dod/ phyi nang tshogs drug rang bzhin yongs shes 'di las myong rgyu zhig mi dgos kyang*/ bde gsal hrig ge ba sogs myong 'dod byed pa de 'drar ma song ba'i/ gsang ba bsgom 'dod kyi 'dzin zhen ci'ang med pa'i ngang nas ma yengs pa'i gnad 'dzin pa yin/ ma yengs pa'i gnad de'ang sems kyi rang ngo la bzo sgom bcos pa ma yin pa'i gnas lugs rang 'gros dri med du skyong dgos pa'o// 'di rnams kyi gnad zin na dag bya'i dri ma rnams kyang dbyar dus kyi 'khyags rom ltar du byang bar 'gyur// de ltar rjes shes lam du slong tshul de la/ rje dwags pos/ 'phrad 'dzoms phyi bsnyags med sprul gsum// gsungs pa de'i don/ rje phag grus gsungs pa/ rtog pa lam du khyer byas nas// thun bzhi'i rim pa sgom gyur na// sngar 'dris mir 'phrad rdo tshan kha// nags mes tshig dang bde gsal stong*// nyams myong mdor bsdus bzhi 'byung ba'i// dang po sngar 'dris mir 'phrad ni// dper na grogs po mdza' bo gnyis// lam du rgyug cing 'phrad gyur na// 'phrad dus nyid nas ngo shes ltar// de bzhin rnal 'byor pa des kyang*// rnam rtog byung dus de nyid du// rang sems stong par chod pa 'byung*// 'phrad 'dzoms bya ba de yin gsungs// gnyis pa rdo tshan kha ba ni// sprin las kha ba byung gyur kyang*// rdo tshan steng du byung ma thag

/de dus nyid du chur 'gyur bzhin// yengs las rtog pa byung gyur na// byung rjes nyid du sems su shes// sems nyid chos sku spros bral du// 'bad mi dgos par rtogs pa 'byung*// phyi bsnyags bya ba de la zer// gsum pa nags mes tshig pa ni// dper na nags la me shor na// shing dang rtswa dang sems can dang*// sa phyogs gtsang dang mi gtsang sogs// rtog pa med par sreg par byed// rlung dang ser ba ci byung yang*// mi 'chi slar grogs byed pa bzhin// rtogs pa'i me lce 'bar tsam na// rnam rtog bzang ngan sna tshogs dang*// gzung 'dzin nyon mongs chags sdang sogs// blang dor dgag sgrub med pa ru// skye med ngang du sreg par byed// rnam rtog ji ltar mang ba ltar// rtogs pa skye ba'i grogs su 'gyur// med sprul zhes pa de la zer// de ltar rtogs pa brtan tsa na// gsal la ma 'gags mtha' dang bral// bde gsal mi rtog zhen pa med// khab kyis btsugs kyang bde ba skye// nyin mtshan thun mtshams 'gro 'dug sogs// spyod lam gang yang khyad med na// bde gsal nyams myong bzhi po de// de tsho nyams kyi 'byung tshul bstan// zhes rgyas par gsungs pa'o// bzhi pa rjes thob sgyu ma ltar 'char tshul bshad pa ni/ spyir sgyu ma lta bur 'char ba la'ang dbang shes kyis snang ba 'dzin pa dang*/ blos stong nyid du nges pa gnyis la brten nas 'char dgos la/ dper na sgyu ma mkhan pos rang gis sprul pa'i rta glang sogs su snang ba mig gi dbang shes kyis 'dzin pa dang*/ snang ba de ltar gyi gzugs de dngos yod du ma grub pa yid shes kyi nges pa gnyis la brten nas gang gzugs su snang ba de rdzun snang du nges pa skye ba de bzhin du/ 'dir yang rnal 'byor pas rjes thob kyi skabs su rkyen snang gi rtog pa'am/ gzugs sgra sogs kyi snang ba shar ba thams cad rgyu rkyen gyi rten 'brel la brten nas mig shes sogs kyi snang ngor bsnyon med du snang ba dang*/

sngar rnam rtog dang snang ba lhan skyes gtan la phebs pa'i nyams myong nges shes dang bcas pa de dran pa'i rtsis zin nas rtog snang de dag rang rang gi ngo bos rang bzhin gyis stong pa'i stong nyid du shes pa gnyis tshogs pas/ rjes thob sgyu ma lta bur 'char te/ sha wa ris/ don la brtags na dmigs pa gsum bral ba'i// yang dag ma yin rmi lam sgyu 'dra ste// chags thogs bral bar dga' zhing skyo med pas// sgyu ma mkhan pos sgyu ma'i don byed mtshungs// zhes dang*/ snang grags thams cad sgyu ma smig rgyu dang*// gzugs brnyan dang mtshungs dngos po mtshan ma med// sgyu mar snang mkhan sems nyid nam mkha' ste// zhes pa ltar ro// de ltar 'char bar byed pa'i stong phyogs 'grub pa la gtso bo sems nyid lhan skyes kyi ngo bo skye med du nges pa'i nges shes dgos pas mnyam bzhag tu ngo thog la shugs 'don pa gal che zhing*/ rjes thob tu rnam rtog dang snang ba lhan skyes gnyis kyi ngo bo la shugs 'don pa gal che la/ snang phyogs sgrub pa la rtog pa dang snang ba rang kho nas 'char zhing 'dzin pa ni rgyu rkyen rten 'brel ci rigs kyi shugs las 'byung zhing goms stobs kyis ched du bsgrub mi dgos kyang*/ yang kha cig stong zhen ha cang ches pa la brten nas las 'bras kyi rten 'brel yang med par 'dzin pa de 'dra yong bar snang bas de ni chad lta chen por 'gyur bas gtan nas mi rung ste las 'bras kyi rten 'brel phra ba la'ang gsal snang gi nges pa rnyed par bya'o// mdor na las 'bras bslu med du shes pa de la rang byan tshud pa dang*/ chos thams cad rang bzhin med pa'i stong nyid du nges pa gnyis 'dzom pa gal che zhing*/ de ngo mtshar gyi gnas su'ang bshad de/ byang chub sems 'grel du/ chos rnams stong pa 'di shes nas// las dang 'bras bu bstan pa gang*// ngo mtshar bas kyang 'di ngo mtshar// rmad byung bas kyang 'di rmad byung*// zhes pa ltar ro// de ltar na chos thams cad kyi rang bzhin nam ngo bo rnam par dpyad de spros pa thams cad dang bral ba la nam mkha' lta bu'i stong nyid dang*/

rang bzhin nam ngo bos stong bzhin du gzugs sogs kyi rnam par snang ba la sgyu ma lta bu'i stong nyid du sngon gyi mkhas pa rnams kyis bshad la/ de la brten nas mnyam bzhag nam mkha' lta bu dang*/ rjes thob sgyu ma lta bu zhes/ deng sang gi nges don phal cher la yongs su grags shing de lta bu'i mnyam bzhag rnam par mi rtog pa la 'jig rten las 'das pa'i ye shes dang*/ rjes thob sgyu ma lta bu la 'jig rten pa'i ye shes kyi tha snyad kyang skabs 'ga' zhig tu bshad tshul yod pa'o// lnga pa mnyam rjes 'dres tshul gyi rnam dbye ni/ gang zag gi blo'i 'char sgo mi 'dra ba mang po zhig 'ong bar snang bas mnyam rjes 'dres tshul ngos bzung can du 'chad dka' zhing*/ bshad pa'ang gzhan du cher ma mthong la/ 'on kyang rje sgam po pa'i zhus lan 'ga' zhig tu/ ngo bo mnyam bzhag rjes thob 'dres pa bya ba ci la zer ba lags zhus par/ spyod lam rnam bzhi gang byed kyang 'od gsal dang ma bral bar rtag tu ngo bor 'ong na 'dres pa yin gsungs so// yang res 'ga' dran pa shor nas rnam rtog gi thog tu 'gro/ dran pa rnyed nas ngo bor yong ba de ma 'dres pa yin nam zhus par/ de ma 'dres pa yin gsungs/ zhes dang*/ rje 'bri gung pas/ mnyam rjes yod par gyur pa la// byang chub sems dpa' zer ba yin// mnyam rjes med par gyur pa la// grub thob sangs rgyas zer ba yin// zhes gsungs pa ltar mnyam rjes mtshan nyid pa yang dag par 'dres pa sgom ro gcig chen po dang sgom med kyi skabs las mi 'byung bar mngon te/ spros bral chen po'i rjes shes su'ang rtog pa dag pa'i 'od gsal 'ba' zhig pa mi 'byung bar gsungs pa dang*/ ro gcig 'bring po'i rjes shes su'ang gzung 'dzin a 'thas kyi snang ba bag re 'byung ba'i phyir ro// yang spros bral chen po'i skabs su mnyam rjes 'dre ba rje sgam po pa bkra shis rnam rgyal sogs kyis bzhed la/

lar ni nged rang gi gshis mdangs mnyam rjes zhes so sor phye ba 'di go sla/ mnyam rjes 'dres ma 'dres 'di thad du/ da lta'i sgom chen rnams kyi gsung rigs rnam pa mang po dang*/ res 'ga' ni rtogs pa tsam skyes kyang*/ bla ma'i gnad kas ma zin pas mnyam rjes ngo shes kyang dka' bar 'dug /don mnyam rjes ma 'dres pa ni gshis mnyam bzhag gi ngo bos blo kha tshims pa 'dra zhig la/ mdangs rjes thob tu mi bde ba bag tsam la rjes shes 'khrul pa'i las sogs ni de yin/ mnyam rjes 'dres pa ni/ rjes shes kyi dri ma dag nas/ mnyam bzhag rjes thob gnyis ka'i gdam ka gtan nas med pas/ blo mnyam par bzhag 'dod kyi zhen pa dang bral zhing gshis mdangs kun la rtsis gdab rang sar grol ba zhig 'dug na de ka yin te/ shes rab 'brug rgyas gyis/ phyi snang ba gzugs brnyan stong pa dang*// nang rig pa blo las 'das pa gnyis// gdod zung 'jug tu gnas pa ngo shes pas// lta ba mtha' bral gyi don la rang byan tshud// ces dang*/ yid 'gyu byed kyi rnam rtog sgom du shar// sems mnyam par bzhag 'dod kyi zhen pa bral// don 'di yin gyi spang bzhag mi 'dug pas// sgom mnyam rjes kyi rtsis gdab ngas mi byed// ces gsungs pa ltar ro// 'ga' zhig gis gzhan de dag mi dgos par mnyam rjes gdam ka med tsam nas 'dres pa zhal gyis bzhes par snang ste/ de 'dres grabs e yin dang*// gzhan gsha' ma zhig yin nam snyam/ de dag gis mnyam rjes kyi dbye tshul mdor bsdus bshad pa yin no// brgyad pa rang sems gzhi lam 'bras gsum gyi sgo nas ngo sprod bshad pa ni// ༈ de'ang thog mar gzhi'i phyag chen gyi gnas lugs mdo tsam bshad na/ gzhi kun la khyab pa'i bde gshegs snying po chos nyid kyi don des ni 'khor 'das thams cad la khyab ste/ dper na nam mkhar stong pas khyab pa'am/ chu la rlan gyis khyab pa ltar/ gdod ma nas kun la 'bral med du gnas pa ste/
