lta ba mdor bsdus las/ rang rig spros bral de nyid ni// 'khor ba'i dngos gzhi de nyid do// mya ngan 'das pa'ang de nyid yin// dbu ma chen po'ang de nyid yin// mthong bar bya ba'ang de nyid yin// bsgom par bya ba'ang de nyid do// thob par bya ba'ang de nyid do// zhes dang*/ rdzogs chen rgyud las/ e ma hoḥ 'khor 'das kun gyi byed rgyu can// gzhan min rang gi snying dbus su// bla ma'i drin gyis rtogs pa byed// ces gsungs pa bzhin/ don dam pa rang ni/ rang re rnams mar 'khor bar 'khyams na'ang rang sems/ yar sangs rgyas thob kyang rang sems te/ gzhi rang gi rig pa gcig pu 'di nyid yin te/ rnam snang mngon byang las/ rnam rtog ma rig chen po ste// 'khor ba'i rgya mtshor ltung byed yin// zhes gsungs pa ltar/ sems kho rang gis rang ngo ma shes bag chags ngan pa'i rjes su breng ma chad par 'brangs pas las bsags tshe 'khor bar 'khyams pa yin la/ rang sems 'di nyid rang gis rang ngo shes/ bag chags 'khrul pa'i rjes su ma 'brangs par/ rang rig rang tsho tshugs na 'ching byed kyi thag pa ma spangs rang sar grol ba ni sangs rgyas pa yin te/ brtag gnyis su/ sems can rnams ni sangs rgyas nyid// 'on kyang glo bur dri mas bsgribs// de nyid bsal na sangs rgyas dngos// ces gsungs so// des na 'khor 'das kyi rtsa ba thams cad rang gi sems srid zhi'i byed po thams cad rang gi rig pa 'di nyid yin la/ rgya chad dang phyogs lhung la sogs pa'i mtha' dang skye 'gags gnas gsum gzhi rtsa dang bral bar gnas te/ rje rgod tshang pas/ sems ni btsal bas mi rnyed/ bltas pas mi mthong*/ brtags na ma grub/ bzung na mi zin/ btang na mi 'gro/ bzhag na mi sdod/ bsres na mi 'dres/ phye bas mi phyed/ phral bas mi phrol/ bltas pas mi shes/ bshad pas mi rtogs/ dpe gang gis kyang mi mtshon/ thog tu gang gis kyang mi khel/ ming gang ltar btags kyang 'gal ba med do// zhes gsungs so// de'ang rang sems 'di kha dog dbyibs sogs dngos por grub pa zhig yod na btsal bas rnyed/

de bzhin bltas pas mthong*/ brtags na grub/ bzung na zin pa sogs yong mod/ de ltar min pas dngos por ma grub/ gdos bcas su ma song rang bzhin dbyibs dang kha dog sogs rdul tsam yang grub pa med pa'i stong pa nyid yin pas/ btsal bas mi rnyed/ bltas pas mi mthong ba sogs yin mod/ de'ang ye nas stong nyid du gnas pa las 'phral stong nyid du song ba min/ blo'i yul las 'das pas blo 'das kyi ngo bo stong nyid lhun grub bya ba yin/ de'i phyir khams gsum gyis bsdus pa'i snang srid 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad stong pa nyid kyi ngang du gnas/ stong nyid min na gcig go gcig gis bkag pa lta bu las snang ba sna tshogs shar mi rung la/ stong nyid yin pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis sna tshogs su 'char rung ba yin la/ dper na nam mkha' ltar rang bzhin gyis rnam par dag kyang gshis de las rang rtsal 'gag med du snang ba la rten 'brel gyi 'char sgo phyi gzung ba'i yul gzugs sgra sogs kyi snang ba/ nang 'dzin pa'i sems kyi rnam rtog phra rags dug lnga che phra bde sdug legs nyes sogs shar zhing gsal ba yin/ de'ang rnam pa rang mdangs tsam du sna tshogs su shar ba ma gtogs/ don gshis ngo bo chos nyid las mi 'da' bar stong pa nyid dang gnyis su med pa/ bzo bcos dang bsal bzhag cung zad kyang ma dgos par rang sa rang sa na 'od gsal lam chos sku phyag rgya chen por ye gdod ma nas lhun grub tu gnas pa yin te/ 'gro mgon zhang rin po ches/ 'di ltar snang ba 'di'ang sems las logs na med ces bya ba ni/ snang ba thams cad sems su mtshon par byed pa'i tha snyad tsam ste/ sems rkyen gyi dbang gis chu la chu bur byung ba lta bu dkar dmar la sogs pa sna tshogs su snang zhing shar ba snang ba rkyen shar yin/ dran pa dang rtog pa mtha' dag ni dper na nam mkhar sprin la sogs pa byung ba dang gnas pa dang thim pa dang 'dra bas rtsa bral yin/

bde sdug btang snyoms kyi las nyams su myong ba thams cad ni dper na rmi lam na bde sdug nyams su myong ba bzhin te gzhi ma grub pa yin/ 'khor ba dang mya ngan las 'das pa'i chos thams cad ni dper na gaṅgā'am pak+ṣu la sogs pa'i chu bo thams cad phyi'i rgya mtshor ro gcig pa bzhin/ tha mi dad par gyur pa'i phyir na 'khor 'das ro gcig go /zhes gsungs so// mdor na rang sems dang po'i sangs rgyas skye med stong nyid blo 'das ye shes chos kyi sku chen po yin la gang shar thams cad dang*/ rnam par rtog pa shar ba rnams gang zag gi blo yis ngo shes ma shes gnyis kyi khyad par yin la/ bsgoms pas bzang du mi 'gro/ ma bsgoms pas ngan du mi 'gro/ dus thams cad du 'gyur ba med pa'o// don ni ma go zhing ngo ma shes pa de dri ma yin cing*/ don go zhing ngo shes pa de dri ma dang bral ba las/ dri ma la bsal rgyu dang*/ ye shes la bzhag rgyu med de/ sangs rgyas las sangs rgyas 'phro/ skye med las skye med 'phro/ stong nyid las stong nyid 'phro/ blo 'das las blo 'das 'phro/ chos sku las chos sku 'phro/ des na blta bya lta byed gshis mdangs/ spang bya spong byed kyi gnyen po thams cad gnyis med tha dad du ma song so sor ma grub/ thams cad gcig tu dril bar shes pa'i don 'di'i gnad gsang go dgos shing*/ 'di ma shes na gzhi gnas lugs kyi phyogs tsam rtogs dpyod ma zhugs pa'i nyams len la 'khrul pa 'byung ba'i phyir ro// de lam dus nyams su len pa la goms par byed pa lam gyi phyag chen te/ de'i don ji skad du bshad pa thams cad yin mod/ 'dir yang cung zad bshad na/ rje rgod tshang pas/ rang gi sems la cer gyis ltos// bltas pas mi mthong dngos po med// med pa'i ngang la lhod de bzhag /yal le chad de 'dzin med zhog /ces sems kyis sems la cer gyis bltas pas sems kyi rang bzhin cir yang ma mthong zhing*/

dngos po med par nyams su myong ba de'i ngang la shes pa rang lugs su lhod de 'jog cing*/ de'ang lung ma bstan du ma song bar dran rig yal le/ 'di sgom gyi gtad so med pa a chad de/ dgag sgrub kyi zhen 'dzin ci yang med par 'jog par bzhed de/ shin tu legs par 'dug /yang ched du mi spro/ ched du mi bsdu/ btang snyoms su mi bzhag /rtog pa rang rgyud du mi gtong*/ byung tshor gyi rjes su mi 'brang*/ rig dpyod kyi lhad mi gzhug /phyi yul med stong pa la dngos por mi 'dzin/ nang bdag med stong pa la phyal par mi blta/ 'gyu ba rtsa bral skyon du mi bzung*/ snang 'dzin dang stong 'dzin rang phyogs su mi gtong*/ 'das pa'i rjes mi snyogs/ ma 'ongs pa'i sngon mi bsu/ da lta bar dngos po mi 'dzin par shes pa bzo med du phyal le/ rtsol med du shig ge /gtad med du khres se/ 'dzin med du bun ne/ skye med du sing nge*/ 'gag med du thal le/ sgrib med du gsal le/ phyi ru yul gcig la 'dus/ nang du sems gcig la 'dus par had de mnyam par 'jog ste/ sa ra has/ 'jur bus bcings pa'i sems nyid 'di// glod na grol bar the tshom med// ces dang*/ rang gi shes pa ma bcos so mar zhog /bcos pa'i sems kyis 'phags lam thob mi 'gyur// zhes gsungs pa'i don ni rang sems kho rang ma yengs tsam la sgom gyi dngos gzhi byas nas 'jog /gzhan ci'ang bsam pa zhe 'dod med pa zhig byed dgos/ rang sems 'di'i ngo bo ni lar spros pa dang bral zhing ye gom yin pas blos ched du mi bsgom/ rang babs de las ched du bzo bcos mi byed/ rnam rtog shar ba ni rang rtsal yin pas ched du spang bar mi byed/ sna mi bskyil bar rang ngo rang shes tsam gyi ngang nas mnyam par 'jog dgos/ de'ang ma yengs pa'i mnyam bzhag byed lugs gcig tu ma nges te/ de'ang so so rang rang gi shes rgyud kyi thog tu nyams rtogs ji ltar yod pa de ched du gsal btab nas skyong ba yin te/

de la rab kyi rab rtog pa shar zhing sgom pa klong du phebs pa rnams la/ da lam 'di skabs kyang rang bzhin gshis lugs yongs shes kyi klong du glod/ ngo thog tu mnyam par 'jog 'jog bya ba'ang tshig yin te/ rtogs pa'i rang ngo 'phrod pas rang rig gnyug ma gshis kyi rang babs la gzhag bya 'jog byed dang bsgom bya sgom byed bral na'ang*/ rnam pa tsam du 'jog rgyu med bzhin mnyam par 'jog /sgom mkhan med bzhin sgom pa'i rnam pa tsam byed/ gzhan ched du dran ma dran dang bsgom mi bsgom gnyis su dbye ba'i gnyis 'dzin gyi sgom la mi ltos pa'i/ bsgom med gshis kyi rang lugs/ chad med dran pa'i rgyun babs de ka rang babs su skyong bas chog pa yin la/ de ltar rang rig sems kyi gshis rang gis rang ngo shes pas rang babs/ bla ma'i thugs dang dbyer med de nyid la bla ma rang sems gnyis med ces sam/ mos gus bla ma'i rnal 'byor zhes bya ba ste/ de ni don dam bla ma'i rnal 'byor zhes bya ba'ang yin te/ de ni gang zag blo rab rtogs pa dang ldan pas nyams su len lugs yin la/ de ltar rtogs pa shar ba ma yin pa'i nyams la sogs kyi skabs thog tu yod pa na/ rang rang gi nyams mtho dman brtan mi brtan ji ltar yod pa de'i rang ngo ched du gsal btab nas skyong ba yin la/ de min gzung dran lta bu yin kyang*/ gzung dran de rab tsam brtan pa'i gang shar cir snang ngo shes su skyong chog pa lta bu yod na de ltar gyi rgyun de nyid ched du gsal btab nas/ rang sems kyi gshis gnas thog tu gnas pa'am mi gnas pa'i bzang ngan gyi rtog pa ci dran yang ngo shes rang babs su skyong ba dang*/ phyi rol yul snang gang shar yang snang thog tu dran pas ngo shes bzhin skyong ba de ltar brtson dgos shing*/ de min gzung dran la brtan pa ma thob pa'i brjed yengs che ba dran rtsol cher dgos pa rnams kyis ni 'di skabs yang yengs tham thom du ma song ba'i ched du rig pa ma bcos pa'i klong du 'jog

/ma yengs pa'i dran pa dang shes bzhin tu re bsgrim/ dran 'dun rtse gcig pa de'i ngang nas rig pa gnas na gnas thog 'gyu na 'gyu thog /phyi rol yul snang yang snang thog ste/ de rang gi thog tu ched du 'dun pas bzung ste de thog tu 'jog /de ltar gnas 'gyu gang shar gyi rang ngo skyong ba las ched du gnas na dga'/ 'gyu na mi dga'/ gnas pa bsgrub/ 'gyu ba dgag pa sogs gnyis 'dzin gyi dgag sgrub mi byed/ rang gshis rang babs kyi rang 'gros skyong*/ bar lag tu yengs skabs byung na yengs nas yengs bzhin gyi dbang du mi gtong ba'i yengs skabs de nyid ngos bzung nas slar 'dun pas 'tsho skyong chad 'thud la brtson par byed/ de ltar mnyam bzhag rang gi skabs dran pa ma yengs pa gtso che ma gtogs nang du sems la ma yengs pa'i dran pa rang gis rang ngo shes pa skyong rgyu med pa'am skyong shes tsam yod kyang rtsol bas skyong mi nus pa'i phyi'i lus gnad lta stangs tsam byed la sems 'khrul pa'i dbang du song na/ de la don med o zob sdod pa zhes bya ba las mnyam bzhag gi ming med pas/ de ltar ma song ba'i mnyam bzhag 'di skabs dran pa ma yengs pa rang la rtsol ba ci che dgos// spyi tsam du sgom skyong tshul la/ rje sgam po pas/ mkhas pa gsum gyi tha snyad gsungs pa ltar na/ dang por sgom mgo rtsom pa la mkhas pa ni/ lus gnad legs par byas nas sngar zhi gnas kyi skabs su bshad pa ltar/ ting nge 'dzin gyi yon tan mthong ba'i sgo nas dang 'dun drag po bskyed cing zhen pa'i sems kyi zug rngu thams cad bsal nas 'jug pa'o// bar du nyams len brten pa la mkhas pa ni/ shes pa bying rgod kyi skyon rnams bcos shing nyams myong 'thug po'i rlan dang bral bar byas te/ sems kyi ngo bo rjen pa skyong ba'o// tha mar 'phro gcod pa la mkhas pa ni/ gsal la yun thung ba la yang yang bskyang nas bsgom dang ma 'khon par bzang gyes byed gsungs te las dang po pa'i dbang du byas pa'o// yang rje sgam po pas/

dang por rtsol sgrub dang bral ba'i lus sems khong glod/ ces pa lus gnad ha cang bsgrim pa min pa'i rang babs su byas nas sems la dmigs bcas kyi zhe 'dod dang rtsol sgrub med par sems rang gshis la gu yangs seng nger glod pa'o/ bar du tsham tshom mi bya bar so ma rang lugs su bzhag /ces pa yin min la sogs pa'i the tshom spangs te/ so ma'i don sems gdod ma'i gnas tshul ci yod pa de la slar bzo bcos mi byed pa'o// tha mar byung tshor thams cad skye med du shes par bya/ zhes pa rkyen snang la shar ba'i byung tshor thams cad ngo shes kyi dran pas slebs ma thag tu skye 'gags gnas gsum gyi ngo bor ma grub pa gnyug ma'i ngang du grol ba'o// yang rje sgam po pas/ nam mkha' ltar yangs shing dpang bstod/ ces pa/ snang ba de ltar du gu yangs sang nge gtong ba'o// sa gzhi ltar rgya bskyed ces pa/ dran shes khyab rgya bskyed pa'o// ri bo ltar lhun brtan/ ces pa sems g.yo 'gul med par bzhag pa'o// mar me ltar gsal bstod/ ces pa rig pa'i ngo bo gsal ngar bskyed pa'o// man shel ltar dri ma spangs/ zhes pa nyams kyi sgrib g.yogs med par shes pa dwangs sang nger bzhag pa'o// yang rgyal ba yang dgon pas/ rje la gsol ba dung gis thob/ mtshan ldan gyi bla ma la gsol ba rtse gcig tu 'debs pa la mos gus sgom gyi mgo bo bya ba yin/ zhes gsungs pas kha tsam tshig tsam ma yin par snying khung rus pa'i gting nas/ ba spu rtse zing nge ba dang*/ gdong mchi ma 'khrug pa dang*/ yid tshogs drug yul gyi snang ba thams cad 'gags nus pa'i sgo nas gsol ba gdab/ sgom ma skyes pa skye byed kyang de yin no// skyes pa bogs 'don pa'ang de yin/ mthar chos nyid ma bu 'dres pa'ang des byed pa yin te/ brgyud pa 'di'i lugs kyis bya ba'i gtso bo 'di rang yin/ khab rtse gnyis kyis bzo mi 'byung ba ltar/ blo rtse gnyis kyis chos kyi dgos don 'grub par dka' bas/

'jig rten blo yi phyams kyis thongs gsungs pa ltar tshe 'di'i bya bzhag gzung 'dzin gyi rtog pa thams cad dung gi rdul phyis pa bzhin du blo yis ling gis bor/ zhen log sgom gyi rkang pa bya ba yin/ de yi ngang la rang gi sems la rang gis lta ste/ dper na rang gi mig la rang gis lta ba lta bu sems la sems kyis bltas pa'i tshe/ 'das pa'i rtog pa thams cad sngar 'gags zin/ ma 'ongs pa'i rtog pa'ang ma byung*/ da lta'i sems ngo bo ngos bzung thams cad dang bral ba'i rig pa sa le hrig ge ba de la rgyun ci ring du bzhag ste/ rang gi sems la cer gyis ltos zhes pas/ sems ma bcos gnyug ma'i rang zhal blta ba de/ sems nyid phyag rgya chen po ngo 'phrod pa yin/ de'i ngang la bzang rtog ngan rtog lung ma bstan gyi rtog pa gang shar yang*/ so so'i skye bo ltar rjes su mi 'brang*/ nyan rang ltar gnyen po sna tshogs kyis mi spangs/ mdo lam ltar gcig dang du bral gyis dpyad nas stong par bzhag pa sogs kyis mi dpyod/ gsang sngags phyi pa ltar lha yin sngags yin gyis mi bsgyur ba phyag rgya chen po'i rang lugs yin pas ci shar de nyid ngo shes par byas nas lhod kyis glod/ gang shar thams cad ngo yis zungs zhes pas/ rnam rtog gang skyes rgya yan du mi gtong bar rang ngo shes pa ni snang srid phyag rgya chen po'i bogs 'don yin pas/ ma yengs pa rtse gcig tu bskyangs pas ci zhig ltar na/ phar la dran pa bsten mi dgos shing dran pas bzung mi dgos par/ ma yengs par sgom gyi ngang la 'gro zhing*/ yengs pas ci mi sto bar 'gro ste/ mtshan ma la brten nas mtshan med skye ba/ dmigs pa la brten nas dmigs med skye ba de kho rang gi gshis yin/ de la goms pas yengs ma yengs med/ dran ma dran med/ mnyam bzhag rjes thob med/ thun dum bu med par gang shar gyi snang rig /gang skyes kyi dran rtog ci byed kyi spyod lam thams cad chos sku'i ngo sprod 'debs/

sku gsum gyi rang zhal ston gyin gda' ste/ dper na chu zhig 'dug na de gya gyur song yang chu/ 'khyil le 'dug kyang chu/ rba rlabs sna tshogs su 'tshubs pa dang dal gyis 'babs pa'ang chu/ grang mor 'dug pa dang dron mo dang 'khyags par 'dug kyang chu las ma 'das pa/ dpe de bzhin du/ phyag rgya chen po'i rnal 'byor pa de sgom kha yan du sdod de dran pa'ang sgom yin/ rtog pa'ang sgom yin/ de tsa na snang srid 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad la bor rgyu'am/ dor rgyu skra'i rtse mo tsam zhig kyang med par ye shes kyi rba klong gcig tu cham gyis song*/ chos nyid kyi nyi ma shar/ bde chen gyi thang ma brdal/ lhun grub kyi 'bras bu smin pa yin no// zhes 'bras bu dang bcas gsungs pa de bzhin las/ de ltar gzhi'i phyag chen rang rig gi dbyings rang bzhin gyis rnam par dag pa la glo bur 'khrul pa'i tshang tshing rnams/ lam phyag chen la goms par byas pa'i ye shes kyi mes bsregs pas/ nam mkha' g.ya' dag pa ltar gnyis snang phra zhing phra ba'ang dag nas/ gzhi ji bzhin mngon du gyur pa'i sgrib bral dag pa gnyis ldan gyi ye shes 'ba' zhig tu gyur pa ni 'bras dus kyi phyag chen sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang grub pa'o// dgu pa rang sems lta sgom spyod 'bras rnam bzhi'i sgo nas ngo sprod pa ni/ de'ang rje gong ma rnams kyi gsung mthun par rkyen thub kyi lta ba zhig dgos/ yengs thub kyi sgom pa zhig dgos/ yan thub kyi spyod pa zhig dgos/ zhes gsungs so/ de gsum gyi don rgya cher bshad na spyir los mang yang*/ mdor bsdus pa ni/ de'ang dang po nged rang lta bu chos kyi rgyu rkyen btsal zhing 'dzom pa dang*/ de nas chos lam du 'gro ba'i thabs la 'bad cing*/ khyad par nges don zab mo'i lam dran pa ma yengs pa 'di ka legs par bsgoms pas/ de nas de'i lta ba'i ngo bo ni/ dang po rkyen thub kyi lta ba zhes te/

de'ang tshig gi lta ba/ bsam pa'i lta ba sogs go yul dang pho tshod la snying po med pas/ de ltar mi byed par sems kyi ngo bo dus rnams kun tu skyong*/ mtshan nyid dang ldan nges shes kyi bla ma zhig la mos gus chen pos gsol ba thun mtshams med par 'debs te/ de nas don dam gshis kyi lta ba la blos byas dang*/ go yul gyis ma bslad pa rang rig rang gsal gyi ngo bo mthong ba zhig bya dgos/ de'ang rang gi sems gyi rang bzhin nam ngo bo'am mtshan nyid ni/ ngo bo ngos bzung med pa'i stong gsal spros pa thams cad dang bral ba nam mkha' lta bu blta bya lta byed gnyis su med pa smra bsam brjod pa'i yul las 'das pa'o// 'di nyid ni 'khor ba dang mya ngan las 'das pa thams cad kyi rtsa ba/ chos thams cad kyi 'byung khungs/ grub mtha' thams cad kyi gzhi ma/ gzhung thams cad kyi brjod bya/ man ngag thams cad kyi nying khu// dang por lta ba'i la bcad sa/ bar du sgom pa'i gzhi bzhag sa dang spyod pa'i khyer so/ tha ma 'bras bu'i skyel so rang ste/ phyogs su ma lhung ris su ma chad pa/ don rang re'i tha mal gyi shes pa rjen pa 'di yin lugs yin bzhin du rang ngo shes/ rang rig gnas lugs ji lta ba rtogs/ rang mdangs 'khrul lugs ji bzhin pa shes pa de la lta ba rtogs pa zer/ gzhan yang sems kyi ngo bo mthong ba zer/ rang rig gi rang bzhin rtogs pa zer/ de'ang dang po'i dus nas chos thams cad cig car du sgro 'dogs chod pa'i lta ba gsha' ma 'di 'dra rang las can ma gtogs gang zag gzhan gyi rgyud la skye bar dka' mod/ 'on kyang nged rang gis dang por lta ba rtogs pa'i lag len bslab pa nas bzung*/ de nas ni lta ba'i ngo bo mtho dman 'bring gsum ji ltar rtogs na'ang*/ de ka slar goms shing 'dris par bya ste/ rkyen bzang ngan 'bring gsum mtshan bcas mtshan med mnyam bzhag rjes thob rjes shes/ spyod lam sogs gnyis chos thams cad dang bsre ste bskyangs nas/

mthar gnyis med du grol ba zhig byed/ dgag sgrub spang blang rtsis gdab kyi dri ma dang bral ba zhig tu 'gyur dgos pa yin no// gnyis pa yengs thub kyi sgom pa zhes pa ni/ de ltar sems skye med 'gags med gnyis med kyi ngo bor rtogs pa'i lta ba sngon du bshad ltar de nyid goms par byed pa la sgom zhes zer te/ de'ang phyi rol yul lnga'i snang ba ci shar yang de thog tu skyong ba ste/ blos byas 'dzin pa'i dri mas ma gos pa'i dri ma med pa'i rang rig rjen pa 'di ka bsgom bya sgom byed kyi spang gnyen gnyis med du thal le ba dran yengs med pa'i rtsol med dran pa yug gcig tu 'byams pa/ btang bzhag med pa'i phyi nang dbyer med du byang chub pa/ gsal 'grib med par 'od gsal khor yug tu 'gro ba zhig dgos tshod yin par 'dug /gsum pa yan thub kyi spyod pa zhes gsungs pa ni/ sngon lta ba rtogs pa de'i rgyun goms par byas pa'i sgom pa de'i ngang nas rtsal sbyangs rkyen sna tshogs dang bsre dgos te/ de'ang gnas lugs lta ba rtogs pa nam mkha' lta bu'i ngang nas tshul 'chos kyi dri ma yid byed kyi zhen 'khris med par shugs 'byung gi spyod pa 'gags med du spyod/ rkyen bzang ngan 'bring gsum gang byung rung*/ lta sgom la sna bskyil dum chad med par ye shes zang thal du 'gro ba zhig dgos pa yin no// de'ang 'di tshor dbye ba mang*/ dbang rnon cig car pa'i rigs rnams la ni/ dang po nas lta sgom spyod gsum 'bras bu dang bcas te bzhi char rdzogs pa'ang yong tshod red/ 'bring la ni lta sgom rdzogs pa zhes sems kyi ngo bo mthong ste dran yengs med kyang rkyen gzhan dang mi 'dre ba ste spyod pa ma rdzogs pa dang*/ tha ma nged rang lugs ni/ dang po sems kyi ngo bo mthong ba lta ba ste/ sems blta bya lta byed gnyis med du shes pa yin/ 'on kyang rgyun du chu bo'i gzhung ltar yong dka' ba ste/

de la goms 'dris byed pa sgom pa/ de'ang goms te brjed yengs med kyang yul snang sogs dang rkyen sna tshogs la 'dre dka' ba ste/ der thams cad yengs med kyi sgom pa de'i ngang du khyer bar byed pa la spyod pa zhes zer rgyu yin/ de bzhin go dgos/ 'bras bu ni mthar phyin pa zhig la zer tshod red/ de ltar gyis lta sgom spyod pa gsum babs 'phros tsam bshad pa yin la/ de'i ngos 'dzin gyi tshul/ rje gong ma rnams kyi gsung lta sgom spyod 'bras dam tshig dang bcas pa shin tu mang yang*/ 'dir nye bar mkho la phan pa ni/ rje mi la'i gsung lta sgom spyod pa dam tshig 'bras bu dang bcas pa de'i don bshad par bya ba las// dang po lta ba'i thag chod la// sems skye med kyi ngang nas 'gags med 'phyo// skye 'gags kyi mtshan ma rang sar grol// lta ba'i thag chod blo re bde// zhes gsungs te/ de'i don ni/ nged rang sems kyi ngo bo mthong bas sems kyi gshis skye med du rtogs pa de'i ngang nas/ rang mdangs 'gags pa med pa sna tshogs 'phyo ba ste/ sna tshogs gang shar yang gshis las 'da' sa med par rtogs/ gshis mdangs de gnyis tha dad du ma song so sor ma grub par de gnyis gcig tu ma rtogs pas na skye 'gags mtshan ma zhes te/ de'ang dang po de ltar gshis skye med las mdangs 'gags med ma rtogs par gzung dran dgos pa'i skabs na/ rnam rtog la skye 'gags gnyis kyi mtshan ma yod de/ de ni dang po rnam rtog shar ba'am skye ba la ngos 'dzin dran pa dang*/ bar du gnas pa dang*/ tha ma 'gags pa la yid byed kyi blo dang mtshan 'dzin gyi dri ma yod kyang 'dir gnyis med kyi ngo bo'am rang bzhin rtogs pa des na/ rnam rtog gang shar la skye 'gags gnas gsum sogs yid byed kyi blo dang mtshan 'dzin gyi dri ma med par rang sar grol te/ de'ang gshis skye med las mdangs 'gags med du 'char/ de'ang rang rig rang ngo rang gis shes pas rang grol du 'gro ba yin mod/

'di bzhin ni sems kyi rdo rje'i lta ba rang gi ngo bo ste gzhan nas ma 'tshol rang sems 'di ka rang yin par thag chod de/ thag chod pas blo re bde zhes gsungs rgyu red// gnyis pa sgom pa ni/ sems bsgom med kyi ngang nas yengs med 'phyo// sems 'dzin gyi mtshan ma rang sar grol// sgom pa'i thag chod blo re bde// zhes pa'i don/ de ltar spangs gnyen nam blta bya lta byed dam gshis mdangs gnyis med kyi lta ba'i ngo bo rang rig rang gsal de las ched du blos byas kyi bsgom bya sgom byed ni ci'ang mi dgos mod/ 'on kyang rang re yengs pa med pa gal che ste/ rang bzhin yongs shes kyi klong du yengs med du 'phyo zhing*/ bsgom med yengs med kyi rgyun rnal ma de las gzhan ched du sems tshur dran pas 'dzin pa'i rnam rtog gi mtshan ma rang sar grol mod/ de ltar sgom med yengs med kyi rgyun de ka sgom pa'i ngo bo yin cing*/ sgom pa'i thag chod pas sngon bzhin te/ blo bde zer rgyu yin// gsum pa spyod pa ni/ shugs 'byung gi ngang nas 'gags med 'phyo// tshul 'chos kyi mtshan ma rang sar grol// spyod pa'i thag chod blo re bde// gsungs pas de ltar gnyis med kyi lta ba/ yengs med kyi sgom pa de ka'i ngang nas rang 'gro 'dug la sogs spyod lam sna tshogs kyang shugs 'byung shes bzhin gyi ngang nas de la ched du 'dzin pa'i kun nas bslangs pa'i tshul 'chos kyi mtshan ma'i dri mas mi bslad de/ rang sar grol ba shes bzhin shugs 'byung rang 'gros de ka spyod pa'i ngo bo yin zhing thag chod/ ces gsung rgyu red// bzhi pa dam tshig ni/ bsrung med kyi ngang nas yengs med 'phyo// bsrung sdom gyi mtshan ma rang sar grol// dam tshig gi thag chod blo re bde// zhes de ltar lta sgom spyod gsum la thag chod pa des na/ dam tshig kyang ched du gnyis 'dzin gyi bsrung bya srung byed med pa'i ngang ste/

de'ang sems kyi don skad cig tsam yengs pa med de des na dam tshig bsrung ba med kyang*/ dam tshig 'chal bar skad cig kyang mi 'gro ba de lta bu ni mtshan bcas kun rdzob kyi bsrung sdom min pa'i mtshan ma rang sar grol ba mtshan med don dam gyi dam tshig bsrung sdom ste/ de ni dam tshig gi ngo bo rang ste thag chod gsung rgyu red// lnga pa 'bras bu ni/ thob med kyi ngang nas bsgrub med 'phyo// re dogs kyi mtshan ma rang sar grol// 'bras bu'i thag chod blo re bde// zhes pa ni/ de ltar rang sems lta ba'i ngo bo rtogs/ sgom pa'i brtan pa thob/ spyod pa'i rtsal 'byongs/ dam tshig gi dri ma bral ba des na de las gzhan pa'i sangs rgyas zhig thob tu med de/ de'ang*/ 'da' ka ye shes las/ sems rtogs na sangs rgyas yin te sangs rgyas gzhan nas mi 'tshol ba'i 'du shes rab tu bsgom par bya'o// zhes bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa ltar las/ bsgrub blo skad cig kyang med pa'i ngang du thag chod mod/ des na mya ngan las 'das pa zhes bzang po zhig la re ba dang*/ 'khor ba zhes ngan pa zhig la dogs pa'i rnam rtog gi mtshan ma rang sar grol ba de lta bu ni bral thob med pa'i 'bras bu ste/ 'bras bu'i thag chod de blo re bde zhes gsungs pa yin/ de tsa na 'khor 'das mnyam pa nyid kyi don rtogs pas re dogs zhig /bral thob med/ 'bras bu la bzla ba de tsam rang nged rang la dkon kyang*/ don rang sems rang gsal 'di ka mar 'khor bar 'khyams pa'i rgyu'ang med pa dang*/ gzhi de ka rang las 'pho 'gyur med pas mya ngan las 'das pa'i ming yang med pas don gcig ste/ 'bras bu de 'dra zhig ni don rtogs dgos pa 'dra snyam/ de min da rung lta sgom spyod 'bras zhig bshad na/ de'ang*/ rje lha rtse ba la/ 'khor rtogs ldan rnams kyis lta sgom spyod gsum gyi phu thag chod pa zhig zhu zhes gsol bar 'di skad gsungs pa yin 'dug

/dpal rgyal ba kun 'dus chos kyi sku// 'bangs dad pa'i snang ngor shar ba yis// mtshan snyan par grags so dpal 'brug pa// pha bka' drin can la gsol ba 'debs// zhes dang por gsungs te/ de'ang drin chen bla mar gsol 'debs sngon du mdzad pa yin/ de'ang rgyal ba kun 'dus kyi ngo bo/ dpal ldan bla ma chos kyi sku'am/ bla ma nyid rgyal ba rnams kyi spyi mes te/ de'ang rje pad dkar gyis/ sngon byon rgyal ba rnams kyis sprul pa'i gzhi// ma byon sangs rgyas rnams kyi 'byung khungs pa// da lta'i skyob pa dag dang dbyer med pa'i// chos kyi rgyal po'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// zhes gsungs pa ltar te/ de'ang rgyal ba'i spyi mes chen po gzhi ma mchog gyur de nyid chos kyi sku'i ngo bo nyid du bzhugs pa las ma gyur sems can nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i don spyi dang khyad par 'bangs zhes gdul bya nyid la dad ldan skal ba dge ba'i snang ngor gzugs kyi sku'i tshul bstan nas der shar ba dang*/ mtshan snyan pa las kyang cher snyan pa rje pad+ma dkar po'am gzhan mtshan sna tshogs su grags shing de grags so// zhes bstod tshig dang*/ de nas dpal 'brug pa/ zhes mtshan spyi'i don ngos bzung zhing*/ de nas ni pha khyed kyis bdag sogs sems can 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho las bton/ mya ngan las 'das pa'i lam du btsud/ mdo don 'khor 'das gnyis med sems nyid rjen pa ngo sprod par mdzad pas na gzhan las ches bka' drin du che ste de la gsol ba 'debs zhes bka' drin bsam pa'i gsol 'debs mdzad pa red/ de nas lta sgom spyod 'bras rang gi ngo bo thag chod pa'i gsung ni/ dang po lta ba la/ dngos med la phyogs lhung ma mchis pas// mtha' bral la lta ba'i ming yang med// blos byas kyi lta ba yul nas thon// dus da res lta ba'i phu thag chod// ces pa'i don ni/ de'ang mtshan ldan bla ma'i byin rlabs zhugs par brten sems dngos po med pa stong pa nyid kyi rang bzhin zhig tu rtogs mod/

de la phyogs lhung zhes pa de'ang sems dngos yod rtag pa'i phyogs su ma lhung ste stong pa/ stong pa de'ang med pa rkyang pa chad pa'i phyogs su ma lhung ste/ stong nyid mdangs sna tshogs su shar ba stong zhing snang ba/ de'ang sems kyi ngo bo stong pa nyid de dang rang mdangs sna tshogs de gnyis dbyer med gcig tu rtogs pa'i gshis mdangs 'dres pas na/ gang la'ang gdam ka med pa'i stong nyid rang du rtogs pa yin/ de stong mi stong snyam pa'i blo yod na/ de ni phyogs lhung gi lta ba las phyogs bral gyi lta ba gsha' ma min te/ 'dir ni stong mi stong snyam pa'i phyogs lhung ma mchis pas na mtha' dang bral ba'i lta ba/ mtha' bral nam mkha' lta bu des na 'di zhes tshad 'jal med/ ngag gi mtshon du mi btub pa de'i don gyis na lta ba'i rang mdangs kun rdzob tsam du lta ba zhes zer ba ma gtogs/ don dam du blta bya lta byed med pas na lta ba'i ming yang med/ de ltar don dam gyi lta ba gsha' ma rtogs pas ni tshig dang go yul gyi lta ba'am don dam par blos byas kyi lta ba la mi re zhing don la mi dogs par blos byas ma dag pa'i cha rnams yul nas thon pa/ de lta bu'i lta ba de nyid rtogs pa tsam gyis mi tshad pa/ dus da res mi lus kyi thog 'di rang nas myur bar lta ba mtha' bral chen po'i phu thag chod/ ces gsungs pa yin no// gnyis pa sgom pa ni/ ye sgom la blos bzo ma mchis pas// yang dag gi dran pa grogs su khug /gang shar kun de de nyid du rig /dus da res sgom pa'i phu thag chod// ces gsungs pa ni/ de ltar sems stong nyid blo las 'das pa'i lta ba rtogs pa des na/ der yang sgom pas nyams su len tshul ni/ ye sgom yin pas blos ma bsgoms gsungs pa ltar sgom med du skyong ba rang las blos bzo bcos byas pa'i sgom ma byas pa'i yang dag gi dran pa zhes lta ba rtogs kyang dri ma ma dag rtsal ma rdzogs pa/

de'ang stong phyogs bde zhing myong 'dzin gyi dri ma phra mo dang snang ba'i thog tu rtsal ma 'byongs pa de dag nas yang dag gi dran par na 'phar ba la grogs su khug ces tshig gi brjod bya tsam de ni stong par myong 'dzin thams cad kyang rtsa ba nas dag cing*/ khyad par ni snang ba'i thog tu rtsal rdzogs pa de'ang gang shar kun de de nyid ces sems kho rang gi rol pa ma 'gags pa tsam du rig cing thag chod de/ de nas sgom pa'i phu thag chod gsungs rgyu yin/ 'di yi lta sgom 'di gnyis rnal 'byor dang sbyar na/ de'ang lta ba sems kyi ngo bo mthong ba spros bral gsha' ma rang*/ der ye sgom la blos bzo ma byas pas/ zhes pa lta ba de'i ngo bo bsgom med yengs med du skyong ba dang*/ de nas yang dag gi dran pa zhes spros bral rtogs pa'i ngo bo bskyangs pas/ yang dag gi dran pa zhes ro gcig tu bogs thon par gsungs/ de'ang ro gcig gi ngo bo ni// gang shar kun de de nyid du rig /ces snang sems 'dres pa'i gsungs de ltar yin/ 'dir gang shar zhes pa la don spyi ltar yin na rnam rtog la gang shar zer te/ da res 'dir de min pas snang ba gang shar yin pa de ltar 'byed dgos// gsum pa spyod pa ni/ rang babs kyi bya ba chos su song*// spang blang du 'dzin pa ngang gis zhig /chos min gyi bya ba shugs kyis 'gags// dus da res spyod pa'i phu thag chod// ces gsungs pa ni/ de yang rnal 'byor bzhi rim spyi'i kha skad las/ spros bral gyi dus su 'dir snang la zhen pa log /ro gcig gi dus su chos brgyad mgo snyoms gsungs 'dug pa de bzhin/ 'dir yang lta sgom gyi phu thag chod pas na/ 'jig rten chos brgyad zad par 'gyur mod/ des na ched du chos brgyad kyi bya ba ma yin pa'i rang babs kyi bya ba de'ang rang 'dod kyi 'khri ba med pas ci byed thams cad sems bskyed smon lam sogs thabs kyis zin na ci byas thams cad chos su 'gro bar gsungs 'dug pa de ltar lag len du khel bas na ci byas chos su song*/

de'ang ched du bsam pa 'di ltar spang blang gi 'dzin pa ngang gis zhig pa las gzhan rgyu 'bras sogs kyi spang blang ni zhig rgyu min te/ rgyu 'bras la phra zhing phra ba nas spang blang dgos/ de ltar nang du chos brgyad dag /phyi ru spang blang bral ba/ des na chos min gyi bya ba shugs kyis 'gags pa ni chos nyid de/ de'ang rang 'dod med cing ci byas thabs kyis zin pa'i phyir ro// des na spyod pa'i shugs 'byung rang 'gros su phu thag chod gsungs pa yin no// bzhi pa 'bras bu ni/ sems 'dus ma byas pa chos kyi sku// gdangs gzhan rkyen sna tshogs sprul skur go /don zung 'jug longs spyod rdzogs par rtogs// dus da res 'bras bu'i phu thag chod// ces gsungs pa ni/ de bzhin lta sgom spyod pa'i rtsal rdzogs pa na 'bras bur slebs te/ de ni rang sems 'dus ma byas zhes/ don sems rig snang ba thams cad dbyer med rang sa rang sar gsal ba las 'dus mi dgos pas na 'dus ma byas te/ 'di nyid gzhi chos sku yin par yin bzhin rtogs zhes 'bras bu gzhi thog tu slebs te/ chos sku de'i gdangs las gzhan rkyen bzang ngan bde sdug sna tshogs pa yong ba de'ang sprul sku zhes chos sku de'i sprul pa'i rol gar du go /de'ang gzhi gdangs de gnyis 'phral du so so tsam zhig ma gtogs don dbyer med zung 'jug longs spyod rdzogs pa zhes zung 'jug gi ngo bor rtogs pa ste/ de'ang sku gsum sems la rnyed pa des na dus da res gzhi legs par rtogs pa'i 'bras bu'i phu thag chod/ zhes gsungs rgyu yin/ de'ang sngon lta ba spros bral/ sgom pa ro gcig ste/ de'ang snang sems dbyer med kyi du ma ro gcig byung mod/ gzhan ro gcig du ma rang ma byung ba da res 'dir ni 'dus ma byas zhes pa'i sgra las ro gcig du ma ste/ de'ang sngon snang ba sems su gcig pa der snang 'dzin zhig yod pa de dag nas snang ba so ma rang sar gsal ba de dbyer med pa/

de'ang rang sems las 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad byung bar shes pa'i rten 'brel mtha' rgyas pa yin// 'dus ma byas 'di chos skur shes// zhes gsungs pas ro gcig du ma'ang sgom med du na 'phar ba/ de'ang chos sku zhes pa tsam rnal 'byor spros bral ro gcig dus nas los yod de/ de sgrib pa mtha' dag dang bral ba'i chos sku min// sgom med kyi dus na chos sku gsha' ma yong*/ de'ang che 'bring chung gsum la dri ma phra mo dag ma dag los yong*/ 'di sgom med spyi'i kha skad yin no// 'di lta bu'i lta sgom spyod 'bras go shes myong bas rtogs pa zhig shin tu gal che ba'o// bcu pa rang sems phyag rgya chen por ngo sprod pa ni/ de'ang spyir phyag rgya chen po bya ba 'dir/ ngos 'dzin lugs mang yang*/ rje bram ze chen po'i bzhed par/ phyag rgya chen por rkyen gsum dang bral ba/ dga' ba bzhi las 'das pa/ 'od gsal khyad par du gyur pa zhes gsungs so// phyag rgya chen po bde ba'i rkyen la ma ltos pa/ gsal ba'i rkyen la ma ltos pa/ mi rtog pa'i rkyen la ma ltos pa'o// de rnams la zhen pa dang*/ 'dzin pa dang*/ blos byas yod pas rkyen gsum dang ma bral ba'o// dga' ba bzhi ni/ dga' ba dang*/ mchog dga' dang*/ khyad dga' dang*/ lhan skyes dga' ba ste/ de rnams la bla mas bstan du yod/ slob mas go rgyu yod/ mtshon bya mtshon byed dang bcas pa'i dpe'i ye shes yin/ phyag rgya chen por/ bla mas bstan du med/ slob mas go rgyu med/ nyams dang myong bas ma 'dres/ rtog pa dang mngon zhen gyis ma bslad/ lta sgom spyod pas ma phye/ gzhi lam 'bras bus ris su ma bcad par/ 'di ltar snang srid 'khor 'das kyi chos la/ bsal bzhag gam/ bcings grol lam/ gnyen pos bzo bcos gcig kyang ma byas par rang sar rang ngo shes par grol ba la phyag rgya chen po zhes bya ste/ de ltar yang*/ phyag rgya chen po rab tu mi gnas pa'i rgyud las/

'di ni phyag rgya chen po ste// 'di ni dri mas ma gos pa// 'di la dgag dang sgrub pa med// lam dang gnyen pos rnyed ma yin// 'di ni sangs rgyas kun gyi sku// 'di ni yon tan kun gyi gzhi// 'di ni lhun gyis grub pa yin// zhes gsungs so// 'od gsal khyad par du gyur pa ni/ snang ba gtad med spros bral yin la phyag rgya chen po ni snang ba so ma/ spros pa rang grol yin pas 'od gsal khyad par du gyur pa'o// de ltar na 'od gsal la lha'i sku'am 'dre'i sku'am/ sdug pa'am mi sdug pa'am bde ba'am mi bde ba'am snang ba'am stong pa rnams la 'od gsal lam mtshan mar rtog pa'am mi rtog pa la sogs pa dmigs gtad bskyed rgyu dang 'byung rgyu ci'ang med pas lha'i sku yin mod/ 'dre'i sku yin mod/ sdug pa yin mod/ mi sdug pa yin mod/ bde ba yin mod/ mi bde ba yin mod/ snang ba yin mdo/ stong pa yin mod snyam du/ 'od gsal lam/ mtshan mar rtog pa dang mi rtog pa/ gang yin pa de dag la/ dgag sgrub spang blang mi byed par rang sar bzhag pa rang gis chog pa yin no// de skad du'ang*/ mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyan las/ 'di la bsal bya ci yang med// bzhag par bya ba cung zad med// yang dag nyid la yang dag lta// yang dag mthong na rnam par grol// zhes gsungs so// de la bsal bzhag gi bcos bslad ci byung yang snang ba yin/ nyams yin/ mtshan ma yin/ dmigs pa yin/ don du nam mkha' la bya 'phur ba phyogs mtshams gang du 'phur yang nam mkha' las mi 'da' ba bzhin rang sems phyag rgya chen po la// gang shar yang phyag rgya chen po/ gnas kyang phyag rgya chen po/ mi gnas 'phros kyang phyag rgya chen po/ snang yang phyag rgya chen po/ myong ba thams cad kyang phyag rgya chen po ste/ mdor na ji ltar gnas gang ltar shar yang thams cad phyag rgya chen po'i rgya las ma 'das pa yin no// phyag rgya chen po'i sgra don ni/ snang srid 'khor 'das thams cad rang sa rang sa nas so ma nyams mdog ma bsgyur bar/

dus gsum dus med du lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes la phyag rgya/ de las log su'am de'i gong na gzhan med pas chen po zer ba yin/ de'ang shes pa skad cig ma'i thog tu phyogs gcig sbyar na/ rnam rtog zhig thol skyes pa'i dus na rnam rtog de la dgag sgrub gcig kyang ma byas par/ rnam rtog de lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes dngos su 'dug pas rtogs rung ma rtogs rung de las mi 'da' bas phyag rgya/ rnam rtog de las logs su ye shes zhes sam sangs rgyas kyi dgongs pa btsal du med pas chen po'o// de ltar yang*/ phyag chen thig le las/ phyag ni stong pa'i ye shes yin// rgya ni 'khor ba'i chos las grol// chen po zung du 'jug pa'o// zhes gsungs so// des na gang ltar shar rung*/ rtogs rung*/ 'khrul rung*/ phyag rgya chen po las 'da' sa med cing*/ phyag rgya chen po las 'bab sa med/ phyag rgya chen po'i dkyil 'khor las yengs su'ang med/ dran pa rang chas la brjed 'khrul med kyang*/ rnam par 'grib pa'i tshul snang ba dper na nyi ma'i snying po la gsal 'grib med kyang*/ sprin gyi dbang gis gsal 'grib 'byung ba dang 'dra/ don du sangs rgyas nas sems can gyi bar thams cad la snang ba ste/ tha na mnar med pa'i me nang du bsreg pa'i dus na'ang*/ dmyal ba'i snang rig so ma de'ang*/ sku gsum gyi ngo bor khrong nger 'dug pa de ka 'khrul du 'khrul sa med/ dngos po'i chos su ma skyes/ dngos med kyi chos su ma bkag /de gnyis tha dad kyi chos su mi snang bas/ don la rtogs thog tu mtha' brgyad rang grol/ gcig mtha' gcig gis ma bkag pas mtha' ye bral/ gol du gol sa med/ de ltar ngo ma shes pa'i yengs pa'am/ 'khrul pa'am/ gol sa la sogs pa thams cad blos brtags kyi blo ngo yin/ mdor na tha mal gyi shes pa sus kyang bzo ma byas pa'i rang lugs rjen pa 'di/ kho rang gis kho rang ngo shes pa la phyag rgya chen po'i don rtogs pa zer ba yin/

de ltar yang*/ rje rang byung rdo rjes/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi dgongs pa/ dam pa rnams kyis don du gnyer ba/ chos sku phyag rgya chen po zer ba'i sgra bo che de/ g.yer po che de/ rang gi sems la zer ba yin no// rang sems ngo ma shes na nga'i sems su zer ba'i mi dran dgu dran gyi rig pa 'di yin no// 'khor ba dang mya ngan las 'das pa'i chos thams cad kyang 'di las ma 'das/ sde snod mdo rgyud kyi bcud kyang 'di yin/ 'di nyams su blangs na bsgom rgyu ci'ang med pas rig pa hrig ge rang sar zhog dang de phyag rgya chen po yin nam ma yin snyam pa'i the tshom mi dgos/ legs su re ba dang nyes su dogs pa mi byed/ rtog pa span spun mang po'i rjes su mi 'brangs/ rig pa hrig ge ba 'di kha'i thog tu bzhag go /lhod de glod la bzhag go /bsgom rgyu de ci'ang mi bdog go /de ltar yang dang yang du bsgoms pas dus tshod cig nas rnam rtog ngo shes nas gzhi med rtsa bral du lhan gyis rtogs pas/ zhen pa thams cad rang sar grol bas skad cig gis bag chags ma lus pa drung phyung nas de nyid sangs rgyas pa zhes bya'o// zhes sgom don dang bcas pa gsal bar gsungs pa'o/// / ༈ bcu gcig pa rang sems rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas su ngo sprod pa ni/ de'ang rang sems dus gsum gyi spros pa bcad de/ yid byed 'dzin stangs gtad so thams cad dang bral ba'i ngang nas/ ma yengs mi sgom lhod nas bzhag par ngo bo ci 'dra zhig yod ce na/ ngo bo zhig logs nas shar rgyu yod pa ma yin/ da ltar gyi shes pa rjen lhang nge ba/ gsal hrig ge ba/ blos byas kyis ma reg pa'i stong nyid rang lugs zhig yod pa de la sems kyi ngo bo zer/ sems nyid kyi dkyil 'khor zer/ gzhi gnyug ma'i ngo bo zer/ rang bzhin gyis 'od gsal ba zer/ bde bar gshegs pa'i snying po zer/ chos kyi sku'i bzhugs tshul yang bya ba yin/

de sogs ming gi rnam grangs mang yang don rang sems gcig 'di yin te/ 'di'i don gsal bar mtshungs med bud+dha shrīs gsungs te/ de'ang 'das par rjes snyegs 'gyod zhen gyi rtsa ba yin pas bzhag go /ma 'ongs pa'i bsam rgya re dogs kyi gzhi ma yin pas bzhag go /da lta'i snang ba 'di chags sdang gi yo langs yin pas bzhag go /kha nang du bltas pa'i rig pa sangs rgyas kyi dgongs pa yin pas nyams su longs/ de'ang sems kyi ngo bo rjen lhang nge ba hrig ge ba zhig yod pa de sangs rgyas kyi dgongs pa bde bar gshegs pa'i snying po rang la yod pa'i ye shes chos sku lhang nge ba de yin no// da 'di la ming sna tshogs su yod de/ ma rtogs dus rang zhes bya/ bdag ces bya/ kun gzhi zhes bya/ mi bsam dgu bsam ste sems zhes bya/ mi rig dgu rig ste rig pa zhes bya/ ma yid dgu yid de yid ces bya/ mi dran dgu dran te dran pa zhes kyang bya/ ngo shes na sangs rgyas zhes kyang bya ste/ bdag tu 'dzin pa kun sangs nas// bdag med ye shes kun khyab rgyas// de la sangs rgyas zhes brjod do// ma rig mun pa kun sangs nas// rig pa'i ye shes rgyas pa la// de la sangs rgyas zhes brjod do// glo bur 'dzin pa kun sangs nas// 'dzin med ye shes rgyas pa la// de la sangs rgyas zhes brjod do// zhes dang*/ yang phyag rgya chen po bde gshegs snying po 'od gsal dri med tha mal shes pa rang byung ye shes sku lnga lhun grub ka dag klong yangs zung 'jug lhan skyes zhes pa la sogs ming la zad pa med kyang*/ hril gyis dril na da lta'i sems rig pa'i ngo bo 'di yin no// zhes gsungs so// 'o na de dag ni kun rtog 'khrul pa'i bag chags dang ngo bo gcig par 'gyur snyam na de ni ma yin te/ rtsal snang de phyin ci log shes kyis bslad pas rang ngo rang gis ma rig pa'i bag chags la brten nas/ kun btags glo bur 'khrul pa'i dri ma zag pa dang bcas pa bsags pas/

gnyen po'i rkyen gyis phral du rung ba gser gyi g.ya' 'am nor bu'i shun pa lta bu ste/ dri ma 'dis stong nyid kyi gshis gdangs rtsal gsum la mi shes pa'i sgrib pas bslad kyang don la thug reg med pa nam mkha' la sprin chags pa ltar gnas te/ rgyud bla ma las/ tshul bzhin ma yin yid byed ni// sems kyi dag pa la rab 'bad// ces dang*/ nā ro pas/ 'on kyang sems de glo bur gyi// rnam rtog dri mas nyon mongs te// chu khams gser dang nam mkha' ltar// gnas skabs dag dang ma dag gnyis// zhes dang*/ rje rang byung pas/ dag pa de nyid da lta yod// yod kyang ma rig kun rtog gis// mi rtog phyir na 'khor ba yin// de nyid bsal na mya ngan 'das// zhes gsungs te// de ltar na dri ma glo bur ba dag rung gi cha nas bsal byar brjod kyis/ rtsal gdangs dgag par gsungs pa min te/ rje rang byung pas/ sems nyid rnam par shes pa yi// dri ma ldan gang kun gzhi ste// dri med sangs rgyas snying por brjod// ma dag kun rtog 'joms byed pa// dag pa'i kun rtog las skyes pa// 'phags pa'i shes rab dbang po ni// 'dzin pa lam gyi bden par gsungs// zhes gsungs shing*/ 'bras bu mtha' thug pa'i skabs su'ang*/ 'du byed skad cig skye 'gags snang*// ma dag 'du byed dag dang mtshungs// gal te de ltar ma yin na// gzugs sku'i phrin las rgyun chad 'gyur// 'on kyang 'du byed ming du brjod// ces gsungs so// 'o na g.yo ba'i rtog yid rtag pa min// zhes ma gsungs sam snyam na/ 'on kyang de la rtag gsum yod// mi rtag gsum po dri ma ste// rtag pa gsum po ye shes yin// zhes dang*/ sgrib gsum dag par gnas pa'i yid// mnyam pa nyid de zhi ba'ang yin// byams dang thugs rje che ldan pa// rdzogs sangs rgyas sogs de la snang*// zhes gsungs pa dang*/ rgyal dbang chos grags rgya mtshos/ gzhi sems kyi gshis skye med kyi dri ma dag pas rang don chos sku dang*/

rnam rtog tu snang ba'i dri ma dag pas gzhan don gzugs skur 'char ba'i phyir rnam rtog gzugs skur bshad kyang mi 'gal gsungs/ 'on kyang tshul 'di rnams rig pa'i gzhung dang sngags las bshad du chug kyang*/ dbu mar ma bshad snyam na/ klu sgrub kyis/ gang gi sems byung dri ma rnams// sems nyid kyis ni sel mdzad de// sems kyi rmongs pa sel ba yi// rang sems de la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes dang*// rten cing 'brel 'byung ma yin pa'i// chos 'ga' yod pa ma yin te// de phyir stong nyid ma yin pa'i// chos 'ga' yod pa ma yin no// zhes sogs gsungs so// des na glo bur gyi dri ma thams cad sems kyi ngo bor yang ma grub/ sems las gzhan du'ang ma grub/ de gnyis su'ang ma grub pas don la grub pa med de/ med bzhin du snang bar glo bur gyi dri ma'am/ 'khrul pa'i snang ba zhes bya ste/ de nyid rtsa brdar bcad pas sems las 'da' sa med pas 'khor 'das kyi rtsa ba sems las shes zhes bya/ cir yang 'char ba'i snang ba dang gang du'ang ma grub pa'i stong pa gnyis rang rig pa'i ye shes skad cig ma'i steng na tha dad mi 'dug pas mnyam pa nyid yin la/ de nyid sangs rgyas kyi dgongs pa'ang yin te/ de'ang rje gong ma rnams kyi gsung las/ rang nyid sangs rgyas nas dang po sems can dus kyi snang rig so ma de ka yod pa dngos po'i chos su ma skyes/ med pa dngos med kyi chos su ma 'gags/ sna tshogs tha dad kyi chos su mi gnas/ rang sa rang sar mtha' brgyad rang gsal du ye nas gnas pa shes pa yin gsungs pa de ka ltar yin te/ rje btsun til+li pas/ ji ltar snang ba'i chos rnams kun// dbyings dang ye shes gnyis su med// 'khor ba'i rnam rtog sna tshogs la// rgyal ba'i sku dang ye shes 'byung*// rang bzhin ma skyes yum gyi klong*// ma 'gags gsal ba yab kyi mkha'// ji ltar gnyis med bde ba che// rnal 'byor rig par dgos pa yin// sbyong byed rig pa'i rtsol ba rnams// thabs dang shes rab gnyis su med// ces gsungs/

de'i tshe 'khor 'das gnyis ka sems su sgro 'dogs chod pas sgro 'dogs nang nas chod pa zhes bya/ ma rtogs na tha dad du bzung bas gnyis 'dzin gyi blo zhes bya/ rtogs na 'ching don med pas gnyis 'dzin gyi skor mgo bud pa zhes bya/ rang gis rang gir rig pas so so rang rig pa'i ye shes zhes bya/ ched du bsgom du med pas sgom med ces bya/ ma spangs rang sar grol bas rtsol med ces bya/ bzang ngan gyi shes pas ma bslad pas so ma zhes bya/ gdod ma'i gshis yin pas ma bcos pa zhes bya/ gzhan nas 'tshol ma dgos pas rang byung zhes bya/ gzhan la brten ma dgos pas rig pa zhes bya/ 'khor ba gzhi la dag pas ka dag ces bya/ 'khor ba gnas su dag pas gnas dag ces bya ste/ mthar thug dbyings su dag pas gnas gyur zhes bya/ ngo bo gzhan du mi 'gyur bas rang bzhin zhes bya/ rnam pa cir yang 'char bas rnam 'gyur zhes bya/ de gnyis dbyer med pas bden gnyis dbyer med zhes bya/ don de ka la 'khor 'das dbyer med ces bya'o// de ltar yang*/ rdo rje 'chang gi zhal nas/ sems nyid gcig la 'khor 'das gnyis su shar// sems nyid rtogs na 'khor ba ma spangs par// mya ngan 'das pa ma btsal lhun gyis grub// chos kyi dbyings la 'khor 'das dbye ba med// ces dang*/ o rgyan rin po ches/ sems nyid rtogs na sangs rgyas te// sems las sangs rgyas gzhan ma 'tshol// ma bsgrubs ye nas sangs rgyas gnas// ma btsal bzhag pas rang sa zin// zhes dang*/ lang gshegs las/ rtog pa spangs pa'i sems nyid 'di// yid kyi rnam shes bzlog pa ste// chos rnams thams cad shes pa'i phyir// sems ni sangs rgyas zhes nga 'chad// ces dang*/ dus 'khor rtsa rgyud las/ sems can sems nyid 'od gsal zhing*// gdod nas skye 'gags gnas bral te// thog ma med pa'i sngon rol nas// dang po mchog gi sangs rgyas te// rgyu med rkyen gyis ma bslad pa// zhes dang*/

bsdus rgyud las/ sems can rnams ni sangs rgyas yin te sangs rgyas chen po gzhan 'dir 'jig rten khams na rnyed mi 'gyur// sems ni rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas nyid de sangs rgyas gzhan du bstan pa med// ces dang*/ 'jam dpal zhal lung las/ dngos kun gtso bo rang sems kyi// ngo bo nyid de rtogs gyur na// sangs rgyas byang chub de nyid do// zhes pa sogs kyi lung shin tu mang ba'o// bcu gnyis pa rang sems sku gsum gyi sgo nas ngo sprod pa ni/ de'ang gzhi gnyug ma sems kyi ngo bo spros bral du gnas pa ni gzhi'i chos sku/ rang bzhin gsal la ma 'gags par brtan pa ni gzhi'i longs sku/ mtshan nyid sna tshogs su 'char ba ni gzhi'i sprul sku/ de gsum tha dad med par gnas pa ni gzhi'i ngo bo nyid sku'o// de ltar gzhi 'khor 'das gnyis med lhan skyes/ de la yin min dang bzang ngan dbye ba med phyir ma bcos so mar bzhag pa'i sems rang babs la bsgom du shes pa nas/ mdangs 'gags med kyi rnam rtog phra rags 'char bar yang spang blang med pa'i kha yan lhug pa dang*/ yul snang sgom gyi dngos gzhir bcol zhing*/ dus nam yang 'khrul par ma 'byams pa de'i tshe sems spros bral du rtogs pa lam gyi chos sku/ rang bzhin gsal la ma 'gags par rang nyams su myong ba lam gyi longs sku/ nges med kyi shes pa sna tshogs su shar zhing gzhi med rtsa bral du gnas pa 'gyu ba stong snang du song ba ni lam gyi sprul sku/ sems kyi ngo bo rang bzhin tha dad med par rtogs pa ni lam gyi ngo bo nyid sku'o// yang na rang sems kyi ngo bo stong gsal blo bral du shar ba'i tshe/ de'i ngo bo gzugs dbyibs kha dog dngos po mtshan ma can ci'ang grub pa med cing*/ phyi stong nang stong ngo bo stong sang nger 'dug pa chos sku/ de'ang stong pa phyal chad du ma song bar stong pa rang gi ngo bo sa le sing nger gsal ba longs sku/

stong pa dang gsal ba tha dad med par stong pa'i rang bzhin gsal ba/ gsal ba'i ngo bo stong pa/ stong gsal dbyer med kyi rig pa de nyid sna tshogs su shar ba thugs rje sprul pa'i sku ste/ de ltar yang*/ klong gsal las/ ngo bo stong pa chos kyi sku// rnam pa gsal ba longs spyod rdzogs// 'gag med kun shar sprul pa'i sku// zhes dang*/ o rgyan rin po ches/ ngo bo stong pa chos kyi sku// ma 'gags rang gsal longs spyod rdzogs// rig rtsal 'gags med sprul pa'i sku// sku gsum rang chas ma bsgrubs 'grub/ ces dang*/ rje rang byung rdo rjes/ stong pa de sku yin/ gsal ba de gsung yin/ de gnyis su med pa mnyam par gnas pa thugs yin/ de sku gsung thugs kyi ngo sprod yin/ zhes gsungs so// tshul de ltar gyi don go yul du ma lus par bskyangs pa'i mthu dang*/ rje btsun bla ma'i byin rlabs zhugs pas tha mal gyi shes pa rjen pa nyid blos byas kyis sgrib pa ma yin pa'i rang ngo nyid rang gis legs par shes pas spang gnyen gnyis su 'dzin pa zhig /thob shor gyi bar chod la 'gag pa'i blo 'das kyi ngo bor khyab par gdal bas kun kyang zung 'jug chos nyid yangs pa'i klong du gser gling nas rdo btsal bas mi rnyed pa lta bu mchog gi sku gsum mngon par byang chub pas chos dbyings spros dang bral ba'i ngang du 'dzin rtog med par ye shes zang thal du 'gro ba rnams 'bras bu'i chos sku/ de'ang gdul bya dag pa rnams kyi ngor mtshan dpes brgyan pa'i longs spyod rdzogs pa'i skur 'char nas don mdzad pa ni 'bras bu'i longs sku/ gdul bya rgyud ma dag pa rnams la gang la gang 'dul du sprul nas/ sems can gyi don mdzad pa ni 'bras bu'i sprul sku/ sku gsum po de'i ngo bo tha dad med pa ni 'bras bu'i ngo bo nyid sku ste/ don gnyis dgos 'dod kyi char 'bebs dge legs lhun grub tu 'byung ba'o// bcu gsum pa rang sems ye shes lnga'i sgo nas ngo sprod pa bshad pa ni/

de'ang rang sems kyi gshis lugs gdod nas dag par blos byas kyis ma bsgribs pa/ stong pa nyid rang gsal gyi ngo bo lhun grub ye shes su gnas pa de las mdangs sna tshogs shar yang de las mi 'da' bar ye shes su gnas pa yin te/ de'ang sems nyid gdod nas skye ba med pa las 'khrul ngor rtog bcas kyi sems thams cad rgyu rkyen las skyes pa ltar snang la/ de ltar skyes pa'ang snang tsam nyid las don la de ltar skyes pa'am grub pa med pa 'di ni kun gzhi nyid kyi chos dbyings ye shes so// de bzhin du snang ba thams cad 'gags pa nyid na don la 'gags pa med pa'i zung 'jug rtog med rang gsal ba 'di ni kun gzhi'i rnam shes me long lta bu'i ye shes so// rten gang la gnas kyang ltar snang tsam nyid las don la gnas pa med pa'i zung 'jug dngos po'i gshis tha dad dang phyogs ris bral ba 'di ni nyon mongs pa can gyi yid mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes so// yul tha dad du dmigs pa nyid ni don la dmigs pa med pa'i zung 'jug yul yul can gnyis med gsal la ma 'dres pa ni yid so sor rtogs pa'i ye shes so// gang la 'gro ba dang 'ong ba ltar snang tsam nyid las don la 'gro 'ong med pa'i zung 'jug /sems nyid ma btsal lhun gyis grub pa ni sgo lnga bya ba grub pa'i ye shes yin no// de ltar rang sems gzhi'i ngo bo bde chen ye shes su bzhugs pa rang dang skad cig 'bral ma myong ba de la dmigs gtad der 'dzin bral zhing bzo med lhug pa'i rang 'gros yengs med khyab gdal du 'byams pa sgom gyi dngos gzhir shes shing*/ tshogs drug ma 'gags pa'i rang rtsal cir snang la blang dor gyis ma gos shing 'dzin med rang grol gyi gnad kyis bskyangs par byas pa de'i mnyam rjes nyid kyi rang ngo gsal ba me long lta bu'i ye shes/ gsal ba'i ngo bo stong pa chos dbyings ye shes/ gsal stong dbyer med pa mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes/

gsal stong de gnyis ma 'dres par so sor gsal ba so sor rtogs pa'i ye shes/ gsal stong de nyid kyi ngo bo ye nas lhun gyis grub pa bya ba grub pa'i ye shes yin te/ thal 'gyur las/ rig pa'i ngo bo ye shes lnga// me long mnyam nyid so sor rtogs/ bya grub chos dbyings ye shes so// zhes dang*/ rje rang byung rdo rjes/ stong pa de chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes yin/ gsal ba de me long ye shes yin/ de gnyis mnyam par gnas pa de mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes yin/ de gnyis ma 'dres par so sor gnas pa de so sor rtogs pa'i ye shes yin/ de rnams ma btsal bar lhun gyis grub pa de bya ba grub pa'i ye shes yin/ de ni ye shes lnga'i ngo sprod yin/ zhes gsungs so// tshul de ltar gyi sgom don de nyid go yul tsam du mi 'jog par brtson pas sgom na// sems nyid gzod ma nas dag par rnam rtog glo bur gyi sgrib pa dang bral nas gzhi'i rang thog tu phebs pas gshis ma bcos ye dag chos sku mngon du gyur cing*/ mdangs sna tshogs rang shar rang grol du rtogs/ phyi nang gi chos kun dbyer med du 'dres pas/ yongs rdzogs bde chen gyi ye shes srid zhi mnyam nyid zung 'jug yangs pa'i klong chen po'i dpal thob ste/ chos gcig shes kun grol gyi gnad lon pas rang grol lhun grub tu gyur pa de'i tshe/ cir yang mi dmigs pa chos dbyings ye shes dang*/ gsal la rtog pa med pa me long lta bu'i ye shes dang*/ 'khor 'das kyi mtha' la mi gnas pa mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes dang*/ chos can ma lus pa mngon sum du sa ler gzigs pa sor rtogs ye shes dang*/ 'gro don mdzad pa la thogs pa med pa'i phrin las 'jug pa bya grub ye shes so// de dag kyang chos dbyings ye shes ni ji lta ba mkhyen pa'i ye shes dang*/ phyi ma bzhi po ji snyed mkhyen pa'i ye shes su 'du bas ye shes gnyis te/

don gnyis rin po che nye bar 'grub pa'i bla med kyi go 'phang dam pa thob par 'gyur ba'o// gsum pa nyams rtogs kyi gegs dang 'phrang bsal ba bshad pa la dbye na/ dang po phyi nang gi gegs bsal ba/ gnyis pa lam spyi'i gegs skyon bsal ba/ gsum pa lam spyi'i nor sa dang gol skyon 'dra min bshad pa/ bzhi pa bye brag gi 'phrang gol shor gegs bzhi bshad pa/ lnga pa 'dra min nor sa spyir bshad pa'o// dang po phyi nang gi gegs bsal ba ni/ rnam snang mngon byang las/ de la gegs ni rnam gnyis te// phyi dang nang gi spyod yul lo// zhes gsungs so// de la phyi'i gegs ni/ mi dpon nye du la sogs pas 'brid cing 'jig rten pa'i snang shes la blo sna 'khrid pa/ ma nus re ltos kyi sgo nas bskyur ma 'gyangs pa/ dgra dang chom rkun la sogs pas gtses pa'i dbang du song nas dge sbyor la brtson pa dor ba ste/ de ltar du ma song ba'i gang 'tshams thabs kyis byol nas 'dun ma thams cad gtan don chos la dril dgos pa yin/ khyad par ting nge 'dzin gyi nyams len bshol nas/ 'jig rten tshe 'di'i snang bar zhen cing chags pas bya rgyu mang ba ni bdud kyi las 'khrul pa las kyang ches 'khrul pa yin te/ rje lha rtse pas/ bsgom skyes pa la dka' ba mi 'dug ste// mthar 'don pa rang zhig dka' bar 'dug /khyod rtogs ldan gyis bar chad ngo mi shes// khong 'jig rten phal dang blo ma bstun// zhes gsungs pa de ltar ma song ba'i tshe 'dir snang gi snang ba mdang sum gyi rmi lam lta bu'i snying po med par shes pas dgos med kyi zhe bcad dang*/ 'dir snang gi zas nor sogs la blo zhugs pa'i sgrub 'dun byung na bar chad du shes pa'i sgo nas zhen pa btang*/ rang res mig ltos byed sa rgyal ba bka' brgyud gong ma'i rnam thar yin pas dus kun dben pa'i gnas su sgrub pa gang 'grub la blo rtse gtod/ der yang yon bdag sogs g.yeng ba mang na bar chad du 'gro bar tshegs med pas phyi nang thams cad la bca' khrims legs par bsdams te sdod cing lto gos lus 'tsho tsam gang byung la brten/

sgrub pa la thang lhod skad cig kyang med pa'i brtson 'grus chen po brtsam dgos shing*/ de'i dus su rkyen bzang ngan sna tshogs 'ong ba shes bya'i gshis te/ gdon bgegs lha 'dre'i cho 'phrul ston pa thogs med dang*/ mi rgod dang gcan gzan la sogs thogs bcas kyi bar chad ci ltar byung yang thog med kyi bag chags rgyud thog tu gnas pa dag par 'dod pa'i slong tshad yin pas/ de ltar shes pa'i sgo nas lam du khyer te/ dge sbyor ngo bo la g.yo ba med pa'i sgo nas kun kyang rang mdangs su shes pas rtsal sbyangs/ lha 'dre pha mar shes pas snying rje bsgom/ yi dam du shes pas dngos grub zhu/ bla mar shes pas gsol ba gdab/ rang sems su shes pas rtogs pa'i yang rtsal ches cher 'don pa gsang spyod ltar nyams su blangs nas gnas lugs la brtan pa yongs su thob par byed dgos/ nang gi gegs ni/ lus kyi 'byung bzhi 'khrugs pas 'du ba cha ma snyoms pa las 'byung ba ste/ rlung mkhris bad kan 'du ba las byung ba'i nad sna tshogs 'byung ba la ni/ lus sbyangs dang drang srong gi gso dpyad la sogs pa'i bcos bya ba'am/ nad thog tu sgom gyi dngos gzhi bcol bas lam du khyer/ yang rnam rtog gi gegs nyon mongs pa lnga'i rtog pa rnams byung rgyal du shor ba dang*/ dge sbyor gyi yon tan nyams rtogs phran bu re skyes kyang*/ de gsang mi thub par bshad ngom mis tshor 'dod bstod na dga' ba sogs chos brgyad kyi dbang du btang ba rnams te/ pha dam pas/ mngon mtshan can la bar chad 'jug pa mang*// gsang spyod nyams su longs shig ding ri ba// zhes gsungs pa ltar/ dug lnga'i rnam rtog thams cad dran thog tu lam du khyer zhing*/ tshe 'dir grags 'dod rnyed 'dod med par/ mis tshor rung ma tshor rung mgu rung ma mgu rung bstod rung smad rung skyid rung sdug rung ngos lkog med par nyams su blangs nas/ yon tan thams cad sba bya zhing*// skyon rnams thams cad 'don par bya// zhes gsungs pa'i don la bslab/

gzhan yang mkhas grub skyer sgang pas/ thig bdud mgo la zhugs pa zhes dge sbyor gyi nyams myong mi gsal ba dang*/ smra bdud lce la zhugs pa zhes smra ba la dga' zhing khyad par nyams myong gsang mi thub pa dang*/ 'phro bdud snying la zhugs pa zhes shes pa yul la 'phro zhing blo rnal du mi phebs pa dang*/ g.yo bdud yan lag la zhugs pa zhes lag pa las la g.yo ba dang*/ rkang pa 'gro sa la g.yo bas dben par sdod mi tshugs par 'gro 'dod pa rnams 'byung ba la rim bzhin/ bla ma spyi bo dang*/ mgrin pa dang*/ snying kha dang*/ lte ba sogs su bsgoms nas so so'i gegs zhi bar gsol ba drag po btab pas zhi bar bzhed do// de bzhin bcad rgya'ang gnad du 'gro ba zhig ma byung phyin/ yun ring bzhin blo je dred/ bcad mtshams je lhod/ byed rgyu je mang*/ nyams len je sdug la 'gro ba'i le los bar chad chen por 'gro bar snang bas chos dred de ltar ma song ba'i zhe bcad drag po dang bcas/ nges don gyi chos gcig pu la dril dgos/ lo zla rer sgrub pa byas nas yon tan zhig e yong re ba de 'dra la ni/ rje zhang rin po ches/ de ma thag tu sgrub rtags 'dod// shor la khad pa'i snga ltas yin// zhes gsungs pa de yong*/ de 'dra 'dod thag nye la brtson 'grus zhan pa 'dir snang blos mi thengs pa zhig mi byed par sgrub pa snyugs bsring la brtson 'grus che ba tshe blos btang zhig gi nyams len la 'bad dgos pa yin/ mdor na lta sgom gyi yon tan yar 'phel du 'gro ba la gnod na bsod nams skyes pa dang thun mong gi dngos grub 'byung ba'ang mchog sgrub pa'i bar chad dang gegs su bshad cing*/ 'khor 'das la bzang ngan med pa mngon du ma gyur gyi bar du zhen 'dzin gyi bdud re re yod 'dug pa ste des na 'khor 'das kyi rtsa ba 'du 'dzi 'dir 'dug pas/ de dbang du ma song ba'i gnyen po dang gang byung gi ngo bo skyong ba'i gcig chod dang lam khyer ci rigs pas skyon sel bar bya'o// gnyis pa lam spyi'i gegs skyon bsal ba ni/

de'ang nyams len gyi ngo thi la gegs sel gal che ba de ni/ sngon nas bla ma'i drung nas sgro 'dogs gcod cing de nas 'di ltar bsgom dus rang gar tshod med mun nag 'dom 'jal min pa'i gang dang gang gi'ang skyon shes pa zhig dgos mod/ de la 'dir thams cad bshad pas mi lang ste/ gang zag dbang po sna tshogs kyi nyams rtogs 'char tshul mi 'dra ba mang po la bshad pa gcig gis rjes gar kheb/ des na yongs rdzogs bshad par mi nus kyang*/ 'gag tu dril ba'i gnad mdor bsdus ni 'di bzhin yin/ lar sems kyi ngo bo ma bcos pa rnam rtog gang shar la dgag sgrub med pa/ snang ba la brtag dpyad 'dzin pa med pa de ngos nas gang ltar gnas ji ltar shar ci 'dra zhig snang yang rang ngo rang shes dang ma bral bar ma yengs pa'i dran pa bsten pa gal che ba de ni sgom gyi rtsa ba yin mod de/ de'ang las dang po par sgom skyon la bying rgod rmugs gsum sogs byung na/ de la sel thabs mang yang*/ don mdor bsdu na de dag la bzang ngan du lta ba'i gnyis 'dzin mi byed par thams cad gang shar rang sems kho rang gi rang mdangs su thag bcad de/ de nas gang byung de ka bskyangs na mthar yul med du grol 'gro ba ste/ rje btsun gyis/ sgom pa yin par nges kyis bying rgod skyon ma bsal// sgom pa 'thor rmugs bying rgod skyon bsal na// nyin par mar me 'degs pa 'dra 'o ang ge lha rje ston pa ba// zhes dang*/ rje sgam po pas/ bying rgod byung na de nyid rang la ltos// zhes so// de nas sgom rtags la ma nges pa rtsub nyams te sems mi bde ba sna tshogs dang*/ bde nyams te sems gnas pa dang bde gsal mi rtog pa sogs yong ba de rnams ci byung na'ang de rnams la ched du bzung zhing bzang ngan du lta ba'i gnyis 'dzin gyi gdam ka mi byed par thams cad rang sems gcig pu'i rnam 'gyur tsam du thag bcad nas/ mi bde na mi bde ba de tsho'i rang ngo*/

bde zhing gsal na bde zhing gsal ba'i rang ngo de rang ste/ gang shar der nyams len gyi dngos gzhi sgom gyi ngo thi bcol nas rang ngo de ka rjen par phud/ shes bzhin ldan pas skyong ba ste de ltar shes dgos/ 'di ltar sgom nyams bzang ngan la rtsis gdab mi byed pa'i gang shar ngo thog tu 'jog pa 'di bzhin gnad du tshud pa zhig byung na stabs bde ba ci byung gang shar gyis chog pa'i sgom chen zer las sla/ gegs dang gol shor ci'ang mi 'byung*/ de 'dra'i gnad de shes dgos ma gtogs/ gzhan rtsab rtsub bzo bcos byed rgyu mang po rang gis chog pa e yin mi shes pas de ltar go bar mdzod/ de ltar rang ngo ma bcos par skyong ba dang gang shar rang bzhin yongs shes su skyong ba der 'bad/ bla ma mtshan ldan la gsol 'debs su rem na des nam zhig gi dus na sgrib pa dag byin rlabs zhugs pas na sems kyi ngo bo mthong ste/ de nas da lta'i tha mal gyi shes pa rjen pa 'di/ bzang rtog gi blo yis ma bcos shing*/ ngan rtog gi dri mas ma gos par/ gdod ma'i gnas lugs kyi rang ngo rang nyid kyis mthong med kyi tshul du mthong zhing don du thams cad phyag rgya chen po yin par go /ngo bo blos byas kyi mtshan ma'i yul las 'das shing*/ blo 'das kyi ngo bor thag chod/ yid ches kyi nges shes nang nas shar bas dga' ba zhig yong*/ de tsa na ni sems nyid lhan cig skyes pa'i ngo bo mthong ba zer zhing*/ de ltar sems nyid lhan skyes kyi rang ngo 'phrod pa des na spangs gnyen gcig tu 'dres te rang mdangs sna tshogs rtog pa gang shar yang gsal stong gi ngo bor shar shar ba de'ang gzhi med rtsa bral du 'char zhing gzhi med rtsa bral du grol bas rnam rtog rang la sgom gyi dngos gzhi 'ong zhing gshis mdangs kyi rtsis gdab ma dgos pa zhig yong ste/ de ni rnam rtog lhan cig skyes pa'i rang zhal mthong ba zer/ de nas kyang goms rtsal sbyangs na/

mthar ni sgo lnga'i yul du gang snang yang thams cad bkrag med du 'char 'dzin med du 'ong ba ste/ yul yul can la gnyis 'dzin mi dgos te/ de ni snang ba lhan cig skyes pa'i rang bzhin rtogs pa zer/ don bsgom bya'i yul snang sna tshogs dang*/ sgom byed kyi sems thams cad dbyer med gcig tu rtogs/ de'ang sgom bsgom rgyu thams cad kyang 'dzin byed kyi gzhi rtsa bral/ dran yengs rgyu thams cad kyang skor ler med pa'i yug gcig tu 'byams klas par 'ong ste/ de ni sgom gyi mchog cig go /de nas ni thug phrad lam khyer gyi spyod pa las gzhan pa'i rtsal logs nas sbyangs rgyu med de 'on kyang 'khor 'das srid zhi'i chos thams cad rang thog tu khyer ba gal che/ de nas rang thog tu 'dres nas kyang de phyogs rgyas su gtong ba gnad zab pa'o// gsum pa lam spyi'i nor sa dang gol skyon 'dra min bshad pa ni/ de'ang phyag rdzogs lam gcod zhi byed sogs sgom don gyi man ngag zab rgyas mtha' yas pa kun gyi dgongs pa'i gnad gcig tu mthun par rang sems ma bcos par 'jog pa kho na nyid lags na'ang gang zag so so'i go tshul gyi dbang gis sna tshogs pa zhig snang mod de/ de la sgom chen pa 'ga' zhig gis ni/ tshogs drug gi snang ba phra rags thams cad 'gags pa'i shes pa rtog med kho na la sgom du 'dzin te/ de ni zhi gnas ltengs por gol ba dang*/ 'ga' zhig gis ni dran rig gis ma zin pa'i gti mug lung ma bstan la sgom brtan por rlom pa de ni blun sgom rmongs par gol/ 'ga' zhig gis sems gsal sing nge ba dang*/ bde lhan ne ba dang*/ stong phyam me ba sogs la sgom du 'dzin te nyams la zhen/ la las ni rtog pa snga ma 'gags nas phyi ma ma skyes kyi bar gyi shes pa had po kho na dgos par 'dod de/ sgom dum bu ru chad/ yang la las ni/ sems nyid chos sku yin no// stong pa yin no// ngos bzung med do// snyam pa sogs yid la bcang pa dang*/

de bzhin du thams cad bden par ma grub bo// sgyu ma lta bu'o// nam mkha' lta bu'o snyam pa la sogs pa'i 'dzin stangs la sgom du 'dod pa ni blos byas yid byed kyi mthar lhung*/ kha cig gis ni/ gang dran ci shar thams cad sgom gyi rang bzhin yin zer te/ rnam rtog tha mal pa'i dbang du btang ste smyon par gol// gzhan dag phal cher ni 'gyu ba la skyon du lta zhing bkag pa dang*/ 'gyus pa de'ang tshur bkug nas sgom la 'jog par 'dod cing*/ 'gyu dran dam pas sdug btsir du 'ching bar byed pa la sogs snang ste/ mdor na sems gnas sam 'gyu'am rnam rtog dang nyon mongs su ga re 'dug gam/ bde gsal mi rtog pa gang rung du lhan ne 'dug gam/ gang ltar snang yang de ka'i rang thog tu bzo bcos spang bsgyur mi dgos par gnyug ma lhan skyes kyi rang 'gros skyong shes pa ni shin tu dkon par mchis so// gzhan yang phyi nang gsar rnying nges don gyi lam thams cad kyi rtsa ba mchog rab mdo 'gags gnad don thams cad rang sems ma yengs pa'i dran pa 'di ka rang yin par lhun gyis grub mod kyang*/ 'ga' zhig la ma yengs pa'i nyams snang yod kyang don thog nas yengs pa mi shes pa'ang 'ong bas de ji lta bu snyam na/ sems kyi gnas lugs go rtog gi yul las 'das pas blo rtog gis rtogs pa'i go don zhig yid la byed cing sems na'ang cung zad yengs/ sems don shes rig las 'das pas/ blo rtog gis shes shing rig pa'i don zhig yid la byed kyang don thog nas cung zad yengs/ sems don bsam gzhig gi yul min pas/ blo rtog gis bsam gzhig byas shing dpyad pas stong pa dang skye med sogs yid la byed kyang don thog nas cung zad yengs/ sems don dmigs gtad kyi yul min pas blo rtog gis ched du dmigs pa gtad pas bde gsal mi rtog pa la sogs kyi snang ba la sems gtad kyang don thog nas cung zad yengs/

mdor na sems kyi gnas lugs yid byed thams cad las 'das par blo dang rtog pas bcos shing bsgrub pa'i mtshan bcas dang mtshan med ci 'dra zhig yid la byas kyang yid byed yin la/ ci'ang yid la mi byed snyam du gnas kyang don thog nas cung zad yengs pa ste/ bram ze chen pos/ yid kyi dri ma dag na lhan skyes te// de tshe mi mthun phyogs kyi 'jug pa med// yid de yid ma yin par byed gyur na// des ni bla med byang chub thob par 'gyur// zhes dang*/ bir wa pas/ de nyid yid la byed cing gnyis mtha'i phyogs lhung na// 'khor bar 'khor zhing srid pa'i rtsa ba yin pa'i phyir// kun gyi gzhi rtsa yid kyi ngo bo gang yin ltos// bltas pas ma mthong yid byed bral na nges par grol// zhes dang*/ sha wa ris/ ltos shig ltos shig ci yang ma lta zhig /sgoms shig sgoms shig ci yang ma sgoms shig /ces so// des na sgom med yengs med kyi gnad skyong dgos pa'o// bzhi pa bye brag gi 'phrang dang gol shor gegs bzhi bshad pa la'ang nang tshan du dbye na/ dang po 'phrang lnga bshad pa/ gnyis pa gol sa gsum dang brgyad 'phros don dang bcas pa bshad pa/ gsum pa shor sa rnam pa bzhi bshad pa/ bzhi pa spyi'i gegs sel bshad pa'o// de las dang po 'phrang lnga bshad pa'i sa bcad nang tshan la'ang dang po snang ba dgrar langs kyi 'phrang bshad pa/ gnyis pa rnam rtog dgrar langs kyi 'phrang bshad pa/ gsum pa stong pa dgrar langs kyi 'phrang bshad pa/ bzhi pa rgyu 'bras dgrar langs kyi 'phrang bshad pa/ lnga pa snying rje dgrar langs kyi 'phrang bshad pa'o// dang po snang ba dgrar langs kyi 'phrang bshad pa ni/ de'ang nged rang mnyam bzhag skyong ba'i dus su/ dang po nas yul lnga dang bsres nas ma bskyangs na/ de nas yul lnga dang mi 'dre ste/ don 'phral du mnyam bzhag rkyen med dgra med rang la sdod dus dga' mo yod na'ang de nas snang thog dang ma bsres na mig yul du snang ba'i tshogs legs mi legs te/

de bzhin rna ba'i yul du sgra snyan mi snyan sogs te yul lnga 'char dus nas de tsho'i dbang du 'chor ba dang*/ legs nyes chags sdang gi 'dzin pa shor yong ba yin/ de shor na mi nyan zhing der yang 'ga' re la ni/ gzugs sgra sogs sems la gnod pa 'di tsho med na ma byung na bsam pa'i zhe sdang skye srid pas de ni snang ba dgrar langs te 'dir dang po nas dogs zon byas nas lam khyer bya dgos te/ pha dam pas/ snang ba dgrar langs khang stong rkun ma 'dra// don la thob shor med do ding ri ba// zhes gsungs so// de'ang mnyam bzhag ngo bo skyong dus nas/ mig gi yul du gzugs sna tshogs legs nyes ci ltar snang yang*/ de la ched du 'dzin pa'i blos legs nyes kyi brtag dpyad mi byed chags sdang 'dzin pa zhugs su mi 'jug par snang thog de rang du glod/ de ka rang ngo rang shes dang bcas te skyong rgyu yin/ de bzhin rna bas mi dang dud 'gro'i sgra la sogs sgra che chung snyan mi snyan ci thos kyang de la ched du sgra de la mi brtag cing*/ mi'i tshig lta bu yin na de'i don la mi dpyad mi bsam par gang thos de ka ngos bzung nas de'i thog tu rang ngo rang shes dang bcas te glod/ dpe des mtshon nas sna'i yul du dri zhim mi zhim sna tshogs/ lce'i yul du zas kyi ro bro mi bro zhim mngar kha ba la sogs par ched du brtags nas/ zhim pa sna tshogs la chags pa mi zhim pa sna tshogs la sdang ba sogs mi byed par gang ltar 'dug pa de ka ngos bzung nas de nyid kyi thog tu lhod de shes bzhin du skyong zhing*/ lus kyi yul du gos la sogs pa'i reg bya 'jam mi 'jam la'ang dga' sdug chags sdang gi dbang du mi gtong bar rang thog tu skyong shes dgos rgyu yin/ don rang ni 'dod yon lnga la ched du mi 'dzin par gang snang gang byung de ka ngos bzung nas de thog tu glod de shes bzhin dran bzhin mnyam bzhag skyong zhing*/

gal srid yul lnga der yang legs nyes chags sdang gi rnam rtog shar na ni rnam rtog de'ang ngos bzung ste rang ngo skyong dgos/ snang ba dgrar langs de la zhe sdang skye ba ni mi rigs pa chen po ste dper na da ltar nged rang rnams lta bur chags bzhag na/ spyir gyis rang gi mi tshe 'dir dus thams cad du chags sdang gi 'khor lo yin par ma zad/ khyad par rang re gshis ngan pa'i rigs kha cig 'di ni dus thams cad du zhe sdang khong khro gdug sems dmod mo rang gi rang bzhin te/ de la pha rol gyi rkyen mi 'dod pa mi dga' ba byung na zhe sdang shor ba ni thams cad la los yong ste/ rang re zhe sdang sogs dug lnga'i rnam rtog 'dir goms 'dris che/ bag chags mthug /shugs che/ dbang btsan pas 'gog tu mi 'dug ste/ de min pa'i don med kyi rnam pa thams cad la zhe sdang gdug rtsub khong khro/ de'i dbang gis ngag tshig dmod mo drag po byed bzhin pa ni/ dper na sa cha lta bu las 'byung ba sems med kyis rang la ched du gnod pa ma byas mod de/ de la zhe sdang dmod mo sa zad yul shor zer ba dang*/ phyi nam mkha' stong pas rang la mi gnod kyang de la sdug gnam phung gnam zer ba sogs/ phyi rol gyi sa rdo ri brag rtsi shing nags tshal/ chu me rlung nam mkha' sogs 'byung ba rnams la'ang don med du zhe sdang dmod mo byed pa dang*/ khyad par mi sems can dud 'gro'i rigs la zhe sdang gdug rtsub dmod mo rgyob brdung yan chad byed pas las ngan pa cher gsog pa dang*/ de min da lta'ang rang la gal che ba'i nyer mkho zas nor mthun rkyen gyi rigs la'ang don med kyang zhe sdang gsog cing dmod mo byed pa ste/ gos la ro shu/ zas la ro khrag zer ba sogs kyis dper mtshon pa ste/ 'di rigs la bsam na rang re rnams kyi sems 'dir mi gnod pa ci'ang med la/ zhe sdang mi yong ba gang yang mi srid pa lta bu dang*/ phyi nang thams cad zhe sdang gdug rtsub kyi rang bzhin smra ba thams cad ngan smras tshig rtsub dmod mo'i rang bzhin byed pa ni/

spyir gyi nyon mongs pa zhe sdang gi 'bras bu dmyal ba yin pas rnam smin che ba dang*/ dug gsum thams cad las kyang zhe sdang 'di rang sdig che ste/ zhe sdang lta bu'i sdig pa med// ces gsungs pas/ zhe sdang 'dis ni rang phung mi la gnod bdag gzhan thams cad la mi bde bar byed pas de'i don gyis nyes pa che bar bshad pa ni/ spyir las rgyu 'bras kyi skabs su bshad pa ltar yin la/ der ma zad snang ba dgrar langs zhes pa snang bar zhe sdang phran bu re skyes kyang de la rnam smin yod pa ni/ dper na sngon sangs rgyas 'od srung gi dus dge slong zhig lam du 'gro ba la chos gos sne mo shing la 'thogs par tshig pa zos te shing bcags pas/ de'i rnam smin ni sngon tshul khrims bsrungs pa'i 'bras bus klu yi rgyal po e le'i 'dab ma zhes bya bar skyes kyang*/ shing la zhe sdang skyes nas bcags pa'i 'bras bus mgo la shing sdong skyes te shing sdong de rlung gis bskyod dus sdug bsngal che zhing rnag khrag mang po yong ba zhig byung ba yin 'dug pa/ de 'dra rnam smin 'jigs pa yin 'dug ste/ da lta nged rang rnams don yod gcig med gnyis la snang ba zhe sdang dmod mo byed mkhan mang bar rnam smin 'dra bas spang thub na spangs dgos pa yin te/ dge bshes pu to bas/ snang ba la zhe sdang byed pa brag la khu tshur brgyab pa dang 'dra ste/ brag la khu tshur brgyab na brag la mi gnod de/ rang lag mgo na ba de bzhin snang ba la zhe sdang dmod mo byas pas snang ba la mi gnod de/ zhe sdang tshig rtsub kyi rnam smin rang la gnod/ ces gsungs 'dug pa go bar mdzod/ snang bar zhe sdang lam khyer dngos ni/ rje nā ro pa til+li pa'i drung nas byon te/ mgar ba'i grong zhig tu zhag mal mdzad pas/ nam phyed yol tsam nas mgar ba gcig gis tho ba tog pa zhig byas pa de nas bzung thams cad langs te tho ba'i sgra chen po mang po de la thugs ma bde nas dang po zhe sdang gi rnam par langs kyang skad cig ma de la zhe sdang gi rtog pa ngos bzung rtsad bcad tho ba'i sgra thog tu mnyam par bzhag mdzad pas/

snang sems dbyer med don gcig mngon du gyur pa ste/ dpe de bzhin nged rang gis mnyam bzhag skyong dus kyang de la gnod pa'i mi la sogs pas 'gro 'dug las ka mang po/ gtam lab 'ur sgra zang zing mang po byed mkhan la de rnams kyis gnod cing 'di tsho med na ma byung na bsam pa'i tshig pa zos pa dang*/ snying yul mi bde ba sogs byung na ni de'i dbang du mi gtong zhing*/ don snang ba thams cad 'phral du ngo shes ma shes ma gtogs thams cad sems su gcig par der bsam zhing*/ de ka lam du khyer dgos pa de go bar byas nas/ yul snang dang khyad par zhe sdang gi rnam rtog gis blo yul ma bde na ma bde ba de ngos bzung rang ngo de nyid shes bzhin ma bcos par skyong shes dgos te/ de ltar yang*/ rje rgod tshang pas/ snang ba 'di thams cad rang gi sems yin/ snang yang rang bzhin med/ me long nang gi gzugs brnyan nam/ chu nang gi zla ba lta bu yin pas 'dzin pa med par phyed de zhog /snang ba dgag mi dgos/ 'dzin med la gnas kyi 'dug na de phyag rgya chen po yin/ de ka ma yengs par skyongs shig /ces gsungs so// de ltar shes na snang bas mi gnod cing snang ba dgrar langs kyi 'phrang de sel ba yin zhing*/ mthar thug snang sems 'dres pa'i rkyen kyang byed de/ de'ang snang ba'i yul sogs gang shar dang min kyang ched du snang thog tu glod nas rang ngo rang shes kyi lam khyer sogs kyang byed dgos pa'o// gnyis pa rnam rtog dgrar langs kyi 'phrang bshad pa ni/ nged rang 'ga' rer sems gnas thog tu skyong bde tsam zhig yod na de nas rnam rtog 'phro rgod mang du byung na mi bde ba'i snang ba dang*/ bzo bcos dgag sgrub rtsab rtsub re dogs mang po langs pa rnam rtog dgrar langs de 'dra byas na mi nyan te/ don du sems gnas gnas bde bde zhig rang 'dod pa de ka 'dod pa'i rnam rtog chen po yin/ sems gnas 'gyu khyad med la ched du bzung nas dgag sgrub byed pa de ka gnyis 'dzin gyi rnam rtog che shos yin te/

dam pa rgya gar pas/ rnam rtog ngan pa spang la chu rdol 'dra// bkag pas kheg pa med do ding ri ba// zhes dang*/ rje mi las/ rnam rtog ni lcags kyi spar bu dgu'i phugs su bcug kyang 'dug pa min zhes gsungs so// nged rang de 'dra mi byed par dang po nas sems gnas 'gyu gnyis khyad med pa gang ltar gnas ci ltar shar yang rang sems kho rang gcig pu de ka'i gshis kyi rol pa'am cho 'phrul yin par shes dgos te/ rje mi las/ nya ma dpal dar 'bum la/ dpe sna tshogs gsungs nas sems nyid gtan la 'bebs bcug pa la/ dang po dpe sna tshogs zhus mod/ don sems nyid bsgom du bde lags te// rnam rtog bsgom du cung ma bde// zhes zhus par/ rje btsun gyis/ sems nyid bsgom du bde lags kyang*// rnam rtog bsgom du ma bde na// rnam rtog sems kyi cho 'phrul yin// da rung cho 'phrul gtan la phob// ces gsungs pa dang*/ rnam rtog kho rang chos skur ngo shes par byas nas glod de bzhag pas grol ba yin no// gsungs pa de ltar go bar byas nas/ gang byung gis chog shes dang*/ sems gnas na'ang de ka'i ngo bo/ rnam rtog 'phro na'ang de nyid ngos bzung ste/ de ka'i ngo bo'i thog tu lhod kyis glod nas ma yengs tsam du skyong dgos te/ rgyud las/ rnam rtog nyid kyis rnam rtog sbyongs// sred pa nyid kyis sred dag byed// ces dang*/ gang gis skye bo 'ching 'gyur ba// de nyid yongs shes rnal 'byor grol// zhes dang*/ rje dwags po rin po ches/ rnam rtog chos sku'i rol pa yin pas mi spang*/ zhes dang*/ rje rgod tshang pas/ rnam rtog brgya skyes na chos sku brgya yin// zhes sogs shin tu mang ngo*// spyir rnam rtog chos sku zhes rnam rtog kho rang rang rig ye shes rtogs pa'i ngo bo yin zhing*/ de ji bzhin rtogs par ni gang shar de ka'i ngo bo so ma nyams mdog ma bsgyur bar gsal stong rjen pa gshis mdangs gnyis su med par 'char yang*/

de 'phral du nyams rtogs skyes nas sgrib pa dag pas yin bzhin ngo shes tsam ma gtogs gzhan rtogs pas slar gsal stong dbyer med du song ba min/ ye gdod ma nas gnyis med gnas pa'i gsal stong chos sku yin par 'dug /'on kyang rang re da lta las ngan bag chags kyis bsgribs nas ngo ma shes pa yin par 'dug ma gtogs/ don dam par kun kyang gnyis med kun khyab rnam dag tu yod par gda' bas/ de la yin par min pa'i gsal 'debs bzo bcos bsgyur bsgom byas nas ci byed/ des na gshis mdangs khyad med pa der bsam/ rnam rtog skyon du lta ba'i dgag blo med par yin lugs yin bzhin gang shar de'i rang ngo shes par byas nas de'i steng du lhod de shig ger bzhag pas sbrul gyi mdud pa bzhin du rang shar rang grol du 'gro bas rtogs pa la skyon du mi lta bar kho rang steng du glod la ma yengs tsam du 'jog pa kho na zab pa ste/ de ltar yang*/ o rgyan rin po ches/ sna tshogs snang ba'i 'char sgo ma bcos par// cir snang ngo shes chos sku'i rol pa'o// zhes dang*/ 'gyu ba rang sar bzhag pas chos skur grol// zhes dang*/ rgyal dbang rjes/ rnam rtog gi rang bzhin shes gyur na// gang shar chos sku ru khro lo lo// rkyen snang 'di rang grol du shigs se shig /ces gsungs so// de'ang bla ma dam pas ngo sprad pa'i tshe rnam rtog las dang nyon mongs kun gyi gzhi yin pa la dgongs nas/ rnam snang mngon byang las/ rnam rtog ma rig chen po ste/ zhes gsungs pa yin la/ bla ma dam pas ngo sprad nas nyams su len pa'i gang zag rnams la dag ma dag 'dres ma'i nyams snang sna tshogs su 'ongs la/ de la bden 'dzin spangs nas ngo shes tsam byas nas glod pas sa lam thams cad kho rang la tshang ba yin te/ zhang rin po ches/ sna tshogs snang ba'i 'char sgo 'di// ma 'gags rang ngo shes pa na// mos gus snying rje zhing sbyangs sogs// sa lam yon tan thams cad kun// 'di la 'bad med lhun gyis grub// de phyir rnam rtog spang mi dgos// rang ngo shes pa lam gyi mchog

/ces gsungs pa dang*/ mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya ba'i tshe'ang*/ sku dang mdzad pa phrin las ye shes thams cad kho rang la rang chas su yod pa yin te/ rje phag grus/ rnam rtog dag pa chos sku'i rtsal// stobs bcu ma 'dres bco brgyad dang*// mi 'jigs cho 'phrul rnam gsum sogs// thams cad ye nas lhun gyis grub// ces sogs gsungs so// rnam rtogs chos sku'i rang zhal du lta shes na/ snang srid chos sku'i rgya yan la spyod shes pa yin pas phyag rgya chen po skya rgyal du 'byung ba'o// gsum pa stong pa dgrar langs kyi 'phrang bshad pa ni/ 'dir ni mtho dman gnyis su yod de/ de'ang dma' ba nyams sogs kyi skabs su ni sems gsal stong du gnas pa de la blo gtad de de kas yid tshims na de ni rtse gcig chen po ste/ gsal stong de nyin mtshan khor yug ltar 'gro ba byung na/ de nas rang gis kyang sgom legs par skyes bsam zhing nga rgyal rlom sems kyang yong nyen yod/ de 'dra byung na der mi chags mi zhen rloms sems nga rgyal mi byed par nyams kyi mtho dman du thag bcad de rang ngo skyong dgos te/ de'ang dper na/ dwags pos rje mi lar/ nged la zhag bcu gnyis tsam la yug gcig tu 'gro ba'i ting nge 'dzin bzang po yod zhus par/ ha ha/ de ni nyams kyi ting nge 'dzin te 'bras bus khams gsum las mi 'phags/ lar bye ma btsir bas snum mi yong*/ yungs kar dang til nag btsir na 'ong ba yin/ de bas nga'i gtum mo nyams su longs zhes gsungs shing*/ de nas bsgoms pas sangs rgyas kyi zhing mthong zhal gzigs pa la sogs pa'i ya mtshan sna tshogs byung ba zhus par/ de skyon dang yon tan gang yang min da rung sgoms gsungs shing*/ rjes nas de tsho nyams rtags tsam zer ba yin/ shing rlon me la bus na 'bar kha chu 'dzir ba dang 'dra/ da gzod rtogs pa'i ye shes gzhi nas 'char zhing de dus mi rgan nga la'ang da lta'i mos gus 'di min pa zhig 'char gsungs pa de tsho nges par byas nas/
