nyams gsal stong la chog shes mi byed par/ rang ngo skyong zhing slar mos gus sogs la nan tan byed dgos te/ de nyams dus kyi yin// rtogs pa'i dus kyi stong pa dgrar langs ni/ stong lta had po ste spros bral gyi skabs yin/ de'ang spros bral gyi gegs/ spros bral med pa'i stong rtsis khyer zer rgyu de yin de'ang sems stong pa nyid gang du'ang ma grub par mthong*/ de las kyang chos thams cad stong pa gang du'ang mi gnas pa rang bzhin med pa stong pa yug gcig tu go nas/ da ni rgyu 'bras zer ba'ang ma grub spong gnyen gang yang med/ sems stong pa nyid la dge bas phan ma btags sdig pas gnod bskyal/ las 'bras sems 'di'i thog na mi smin te/ nam mkha' la sa bon btab tu med pa dang 'dra bsam nas/ dge sdig 'chol bar spyod nas las 'bras ma bsam na ni/ lta spyod log par 'gro ba zhig yong tshod red/ de ni nag po kha 'byams gol shor chen po ste/ slob dpon klu sgrub kyi rtsa sher las/ stong pa nyid la lta nyes na// shes rab chung rnams phung bar 'gyur// ji ltar sbrul la bzung nyes dang*// rig sngags log par bsgrubs pa bzhin// zhes dang*/ bka' brgyud gong ma thams cad kyis nag po kha 'byams kyi lta ba zhes gsungs pa de 'drar ma song ba'i nged rang gis yin lugs yin bzhin 'di ltar nyams su len te/ de'ang sems rang bzhin ma grub pa stong pa nyid chos thams cad kyang de ltar shes zin kyang rnam par snang ba'i rtsal mdangs 'gags med 'di la rgyu 'bras dge sdig rten 'brel la sogs pa kun rdzob tu bslu ba med pa'i don go bar byed dgos shing*/ des na lag len rgyu 'bras phra zhib tu brtsi ba gal che ste/ de'ang rje mi las/ gnyis su med pa'i don rtogs nas// sems nyid chos kyi skur shes kyang*// rgyu 'bras phra zhing phra la 'dzem// zhes dang*/ rje 'bri gung pas/ rgyu 'bras la nges shes skyes tsa na// tho co'i rtsing hral yang rdzun por gda'// nag po kha 'byams kyi spyod pa la// ka blo gtad cig 'dug gam mi 'dug soms// zhes dang*/

rje rgyal mtshan dpal bzang gis/ snang ba sna tshogs rten cing 'brel 'byung yin// stong pa phyogs yan kho nar mi blta bar// byams dang dad pa mos gus la sogs pa// thabs rnams kun la rtsal sbyong byed pa zab// ces gsungs pa ltar/ gshis stong nyid ngang las ma g.yos par mdangs sna tshogs snang ba rten cing 'brel 'byung du shes na stong pa nyid kho na'i 'ching ba las grol ba ste/ rje pad dkar gyi phyag chen rnam bshad las/ sbyin sogs pha rol tu phyin pa drug gi dus 'da' yang zhen pa'i dag byed stong pas byas nas/ zhes gsungs pa ltar/ rgyal bas gsungs pa'i mdo sngags gang nas kyang bden gnyis zung 'jug ma gtogs par thabs shes ya bral gyi chos des sangs rgyas thob par ma gsungs te/ rgyal ba'i yum las/ bya 'dab gshog ma tshang ba la dpe mdzad nas gsungs pa dang mtshungs par 'gyur bas/ thabs shes ya ma bral bar stong pa'i rang mdangs byams dang snying rje dag snang mos gus sems bskyed/ spros bcas bskyed rim sogs mdor na gnyis chos thams cad la rig pa'i yang rtsal sbyong bas kun kyang gnyis med du rtogs par byed dgos te/ de'ang stong pa'i rang mdangs snying rje chen por langs pa'i stong nyid snying rje zung 'jug ngos nas/ byang chub mchog gi sems rgya chen po bskyed de/ 'dus byas 'dus ma byas kyi dge ba thams cad ma gyur sems can la bsngo zhing smon lam 'debs dgos pa yin te/ sa ra has/ snying rje dang bral stong pa nyid zhugs gang*// des ni lam mchog rnyed par mi 'gyur ro// 'on te snying rje 'ba' zhig bsgoms na yang*// 'khor ba 'dir gnas thar pa thob mi 'gyur// gang zhig gnyis por sbyor bar nus pa des// 'khor bar mi gnas mya ngan 'das mi gnas// zhes so/ de bzhin stong pa'i rang mdangs dad pa dag snang du langs nas zhing khams phyogs med du sbyangs pa dang*/ stong pa'i rang mdangs bzo med kyi mos gus su langs nas/

snang srid bla ma sku gsum gyi dkyil 'khor chen po'i rol par lta ba la nan tan du byed pa dang*/ stong pa'i rang mdangs spros bcas lha'i sku bskyed pa'i rim par langs nas phung khams sogs dang snang srid thams cad lha'i 'khor lor sbyangs pas sangs rgyas thams cad dang lam mtshungs pa snang stong dbyer med chu zla lta bu'i zung 'jug thob pa de lta bu ni lam gol 'phyugs med pa rgyal ba'i gzhung lam chen por tshud pa ste/ tshul 'di dag la/ grub thob sha wa ris mai tri pa la/ gnad bcu dgu'i gdams pa bstan pa ste/ de'ang snang ba sems su shes kyang 'dus byas kyi dge ba rgyun ma gcod/ rang sems sangs rgyas su shes kyang rtsa ba'i bla ma ma spongs/ sangs rgyas la re ba med kyang sangs rgyas la skur pa ma 'debs/ dmyal ba la dogs pa med kyang sdig pa phra mo nas spongs/ yi dwags la dogs pa med kyang sbyin pa phra mo tshun rgyun ma gcod/ byol song la dogs pa med kyang lus ngag gi sdom pa srungs/ lha dang 'dre med pa'i don rtogs kyang yi dam gyi lha ma spongs/ skye shi med pa'i don rtogs kyang da dung 'gro ba'i lus la brten pas lta sgom la goms par gyis/ skye ba med pa'i don rtogs kyang dkar po'i chos spyod rgyun ma gcod/ mnyam pa nyid kyi don rtogs kyang 'gro ba phal pa sun ma phyungs/ snang grags chos skur shes kyang rang sems la byi dor nan tan gyis/ thams cad sems su shes kyang sems can phra mo'ang srog ma gcod/ gnyug ma'i ngang du mi 'bral yang dam tshig dang sdom pa rtag tu srungs/ rnam rtog med pa'i lta ba rtogs kyang phyogs ris med pa'i lta ba sgoms/ yengs pa med pa'i sgom pa shes kyang sems la 'dzin chags med par gyis/ ya nga med pa'i spyod pa byung yang 'gro ba dang bstun pa'i spyod pa gyis/ rang sems rtogs kyang zol zog med pa'i dam tshig srungs/ rig pa la skye 'chi med par rtogs kyang lus kyi phung po mi rtag par sgoms/

rang rig pa'i klong rdol yod kyang bla ma dam pa spyi bor khur/ zhes gsungs pa dang*/ til+li pas/ snang ba rten cing 'brel 'byung 'di// skye ba med par ma rtogs par// tshogs gnyis shing rta'i 'khor lo dang*// 'bral bar ma byed nā ro pa// zhes gsungs/ slob dpon rin po che dang chos rgyal srong btsan sgam pos kyang mang du gsungs shing*/ gzhan yang*/ bir wa pas/ kun rdzob sangs rgyas mi re'i gding chen ldan gyur kyang*// bsod nams tshogs chen mi spangs ci nus 'bad par bya// 'khor ba dag la dogs pa'i sems med 'jigs bral yang*// sdig pa'i las rnams phra mo dag la 'dzem par bya// chos rnams thams cad stong pa mkha' ltar rtogs gyur kyang*// chags sdang 'dzin chags thams cad rtsad nas spong bar bya// chos nyid mtha' bral zang thal chen po'i don rtogs kyang*// brtan pa ma thob bar du nyams rtogs gzhan la gsang*// don dam bdag gzhan gnyis su med par rtogs gyur kyang*// kun rdzob 'gro la phan pa'i don chen dag la bsam// 'dren pa gzhan la mi ltos gdeng chen ldan gyur kyang*// bka' drin can gyi bla ma spyi bo'i gtsug na khur// zhes gsungs/ de dag rgya gar grub chen gyi gsung ste/ gzhan bka' brgyud kyi gsung mang yang bsdu na/ rje mi las/ gnyis su med pa'i don rtogs nas// sems nyid chos kyi skur shes kyang*// rgyu 'bras phra zhing phra la 'dzem// lhun gyis grub pa'i don rtogs nas// 'od gsal rgyun chad mi mnga' yang*// bla ma dam pa spyi bor khur// mnyam pa nyid kyi don rtogs nas// re dogs gnyis dang bral gyur kyang*// 'jig rten skye bo sun mi phyungs// brjod du med pa'i don rtogs nas// blang dor med pa'i ngang gnas kyang*// 'gro don smon lam rgya chen thob// ces gsungs/ rje ras chung pas/ phyag rgya chen po'i don rtogs kyang*// rnam smin lus dang ma bral bar// bla ma mkha' 'gro mchod pa gces// mya ngan 'das la 'dod med kyang*// chos spyod dge bcu spyod pa gces// chos rnams rang bzhin sems yin kyang*// tshul 'chos gzhan la mi 'tshe 'tshal// 'bral ba med pa'i don rtogs kyang*// ri khrod 'grim zhing goms pa gces// 'khor bar ltung ba'i dogs med kyang*// sdig pa phra mo spangs pa gces// bdag gzhan mnyam pa'i don rtogs kyang*// snying rjes rigs drug mi gtong gces// rang gi grub mtha' mi bzung yang*// byang chub thugs dang ldan pa gces// sems can mos pa sna tshogs par// lta spyod gzhan dang bstun pa gces// zab mo'i gdams ngag nyams len gnyis// snod ngan rnams la gsang ba gces// rnal 'byor pa yi lus po 'di// shin tu dben par sdod pa gces// de tsho gces pa rnam dgu yin// sgom chen rnams kyi thugs la zhog

/ces dang*/ rje sgam po pas/ lam mchog rin chen phreng ba las/ thun mong gi chos bzhi ni/ thams cad phyag rgya chen por rtogs kyang bla ma spyi bor bsgom zhing 'dus byas kyi dge ba la 'bad/ ci byas chos su song yang sdig pa phra ba la 'dzem/ dben pa dang grong la khyad med kyang dben pa bsten la bsgom/ tsog pu dang nyal ba khyad med kyang tsog pu byas la bsgom/ zhes gsungs/ de bzhin gtsang pa rgya ras sogs kyi gsung shin tu mang ngo*// de lta bu'i nyams len la gnad du bsnun pas stong pa dgrar langs kyi 'phrang las grol ba'o// bzhi pa rgyu 'bras dgrar langs kyi 'phrang bshad pa ni/ de'ang las rgyu 'bras la mchog tu 'dzin pa'ang don dam chos kyi yin lugs ma go bas/ mtshan ma dngos po la mchog tu rlom nas/ sems gnas pa stong pa las g.yeng ba'i bya cha chos spyod la sogs pa g.yeng ba'i spros pa la dga' nas gnas lugs khyad du gsod pa'am yang na der a 'thas na de'ang 'phrang che shos te/ de'ang gzhan gang las kyang phyag rgya chen po stong nyid dgos par gsungs te/ sa ra has/ dge slong dge tshul gnas brtan zhes bya ba'i// ban+de rnams ni de ltar rab byung nas// kha cig mdo sde 'chad par byed cing 'dug /la la ro gcig sems kyi 'dzin tshul mthong*// kha cig theg chen de la rgyu byed kyang*// de ni gzhung lugs mtshan ma'i bstan bcos yin// gzhan dag dkyil 'khor 'khor lo ma lus bsgom/ kha cig bzhi pa'i don 'chad pa la zhugs// la la nam mkha'i khams la rtog par byed// gzhan dag stong nyid lta bar byed pa ste// phal cher mi mthun phyogs la zhugs pa yin// lhan cig skyes bral gzhan gang gis// mya ngan 'das gang sgom byed pa// de dag 'gas kyang don dam ni// gcig shos 'grub par mi 'gyur ro// gang zhig gang la mos par gyur pa des// bsam gtan gnas pas thar pa thob bam ci// mar me ci dgos lha bshos de ci dgos// de la ci bya gsang sngags ci zhig dgos// 'babs stegs 'gro dang dka' thub ci dgos te// chu la zhugs pas thar pa thob bam ci// zhes dang*/

sha wa ris/ kha cig blo yi dbye bas rmongs rnams 'ching*// bdag po khyim du bzhag nas gzhan du 'tshol// kha cig gzugs brnyan dag la don du 'dzin// kha cig rtsa ba bor nas lo ma 'breg /ji ltar byas kyang bslus pa ma tshor ram// zhes dang*/ til+li pas/ khrus dang gtsang sbras bde ba mi rnyed do// lha rnams mchod kyang thar pa thob mi 'gyur// zhes dang*/ sngags su smra dang pha rol phyin pa dang*/ 'dul ba mdo sde sde snod la sogs kyi// rang rang gzhung dang grub pa'i mtha' yis ni// 'od gsal phyag rgya chen po mthong mi 'gyur// zhe 'dod byung bas 'od gsal ma mthong bsgribs// zhes dang*/ bir wa pas/ kha cig dbang bskur ba yis yongs su gdung bar byed// kha cig hūm̐ phaṭ zhes zer phreng ba yongs su bsgrang*// kha cig bshang gci khu ba khrag dag yongs su bza'// kha cig rtsa dang rlung gi rnal 'byor bsgom ste yongs su 'khrul// zhes sogs mang du gsungs pa ste/ de ltar na rang re rnams kyis spyir las rgyu 'bras la bsam pa/ de thog nas nye lam zab mo nges don gyi chos rang la gcig tu dril dgos te/ de'ang nges don chos de'i sngon 'gro tsam ma gtogs gzhan spros bcas bya cha chos spyod cher mi byed par stong nyid kyi don rang sems rang ngo skyong dgos te/ rje btsun mi las dwags po la/ phyag rgya chen po sgom dus su// lus ngag gi dge sbyor ma brtson cig /mi rtog ye shes yal nyen yod// ces gsungs te/ der yang dper na dwags po'ang bar du bka' gdams pa rnams dang khyu 'dres pa'i chos spyod kyis bla mas gsungs bzhin mi rtog pa'i ye shes yal bas thugs the tshom par rjes nas bla ma'i gsung la nges shes skyes te/ de nas stong nyid rang la brtson pa mdzad pas slar rtogs pa'i ye shes shar ba'i rnam thar kyang 'dug cing*/ jo bo rjes/ gcig tu mnyam bzhag sems brten na// lus ngag dge sbyor gtsor mi bya// gsungs pa sogs kyang sems thog tu phab nas/

stong nyid kyi nyams len rang la nges shes bskyed de de ka gtso bor bsgom/ de nas rang rtogs pa shar te brtan pa thob grabs byung na chos thams cad la rtsal sbyong dgos pa de go bar byas nas/ spros bcas sogs thams cad la rtsal sbyangs/ de nas zung du chub nas ni/ lta ba nam mkha' lta bu'i ngang nas chos spyod sgyu ma lta bur byed gsungs pa go bar byas nas/ sems can gyi don du nyin mtshan dal med du chos spyod kyi rim pa la brtson dgos te/ de lta bu'i go rim shes dgos pa'o// lnga pa snying rje dgrar langs kyi 'phrang bshad pa ni/ lar tshe 'dir snang bsam pa'i blos 'gro don du bsnyad btags pa'i rnyed pa tshol ba ni chos la mi the mod/ de min de las grags tsam rang stong nyid la brtan pa ma thob kyang sems can la snying rje skyes te/ des na 'di tshor phan btags dgos 'dug bsam zhing*/ dge bskul 'dra byed pa dran nas sgrub pa las langs 'dod na de ni snying rje dgrar langs te/ de ltar byas na dus la ma babs pa'i gzhan don gzhan la phan chung zhing rang la shin tu gnod pas de 'dra mi byed/ lar snying rje los dgos te/ rang don ma 'grub gong nas blo chung 'gro don byed par bsam pa bar chad yin par shes dgos te/ de'ang rgyud rang byung bde ba las/ rang nyid mi shes gzhan grol ba// ru tra'i sgor lhung rtag tu 'khor/ zhes dang*/ ye shes mkha' mnyam las/ rang sems chos skur ma rtogs par// mdo rgyud mang po bshad shes kyang*// ru tra'i sgor lhung 'khor bar 'khyams// zhes skyon dang*/ o rgyan rin po ches/ mngon shes med par 'gro don mi yong ste// thog mar sgrub la brtson 'grus rim la bskyed// ces dang*/ dam pa rgya gar pas/ bdud kyi 'jug pa dang po bya ba yin/ rang chu nang du lus pas gzhan skam sar thon pa gar yong*/ skabs 'dir rang gi dge sbyor 'phel ba chad gzhan la phan mi thogs pas gzab 'tshal gsungs pa dang*/

yang*/ sgrub pa'i dus su gzhan don byar mi rung*// dge sbyor 'phel ba chad do ding ri ba// zhes zhal ta bzang po gsungs pa dang*/ jo bo rjes/ dang po rang nyid ma thul bar// gzhan dag ji ltas thul bar nus// zhes dang*/ chos rje smar pa rin po ches/ khyod rang rgyud slob mar mi nyan pa'i// gzhan gyi slob dpon byed pa de// lam rgyus med pa'i sa phyogs su// long bas long ba khrid pa 'dra// rang sems rang gis ma rtogs par// gzhan sems ngo sprod byed pa de// dmus long khye'u chung gcig la gcig /zla ba'i kha dog ston pa bzhin// rang sems rang gis ma thul bar// gzhan la chos bshad byed pa de// gdon gyis bzung ba'i nad pa yi// rim 'gro mdze phos byed pa bzhin// rang sems skad cig mi gnas par// gzhan la gdams ngag ston pa de/ zong zad rgyags zad skyes bu yis// brag la sa bon 'debs pa bzhin// lar snying nas byang chub bsgrub 'dod na// 'du 'dzi mal bzhag dben pa bsten// sgrub pa'i bar chad slob ma spongs// zhes gsungs pa dang*/ rje yang dgon pas/ sgom ro gcig ma shar bar 'gro don rgya chen mi 'byung ste// byung yang log pa zhig tu shor ba yin// zhes gsungs pa sogs yid la dran par byas rang thog tu phabs nas/ stong nyid snying rje'i snying po can la brtan pa cher thob cing 'gro don dus la ma babs par gzhan don ltar snang gi bdud la mi bskur zhing*/ byams dang snying rje byang chub kyi sems mi 'dor/ gzhan don rgya chen po'i smon lam gnad du bsnun cing sgrub par snyugs bsring dgos/ lar 'gro don gyi sa bon 'debs pa ni dang po dus nas gal che'o// gnyis pa gol sa rnam pa gsum dang brgyad 'phros don dang bcas pa bshad pa las/ dang po bde gsal mi rtog pas khams gsum du gol ba dang*/ gnyis pa phyir bltas kyi ting nge 'dzin gyis bsam gtan bzhir gol ba dang*/ gsum pa yid byed kyi rtog pas gzugs med skye mched mu bzhir gol ba dang de dag gi 'phros don bcas bshad pa'o//

dang po bde gsal mi rtog pas khams gsum du gol ba ni/ tshul 'di dag zhi gnas skabs su bshad zin kyang*/ 'dir gegs sel gyi rim pa'i tshul du mdor bsdus te bshad na/ nged rang gis bsgoms nas zhi gnas chags pa de la nyams bde gsal mi rtog pa gsum las gang rigs shig yong zhing*/ de la bde ba'i nyams shas che ba la/ zag bcas zag med kyi bde ba sogs so sor ma phye bar/ spyir bde ba de nyid la shes rab kyis brtags te/ de nyid sgom la yang dag par zhen na 'dod pa'i khams su gol bar 'gyur te 'dod chags kyis kun nas dkris pa'i phyir ro// der zhen nas gol yang 'dod khams gnas ris nyi shu las ngan song gi gnas bcur mi skye/ gsal ba'i nyams de la gcig tu zhen na gzugs khams gnas ris bcu bdun du gol/ mi rtog par zhen na gzugs med skye mched mu bzhir gol bar 'gyur te/ rje phag mo gru pas/ bla ma dam pa'i rtsar phyin te/ gdams ngag gang rung nyams blangs pas// bde bas lus sems gang ba 'byung*// zhen cing chags pas bskyangs byas pas// 'dod khams gnas su gol nas 'gro// gsal ba dwangs pa mkha' lta bu// phyi nang zla ba shar ba 'dra// phye dang btsum pa khyad par med// de la zhen cing chags pa yis// sgrub pa po yis bskyangs gyur na// gzugs kyi khams su gol bar 'gyur// phyi dang nang du bltas gyur na// rtog pa phra mo tsam yang med// rdul bral chos skur bltas byas nas// dga' dang mi dga'i bsam pa yis// nyams de nges par bskyangs gyur na/ gzugs med khams su gol bar 'gyur// zhes so// 'dir dper na nyams de rang la brtan cing chags pa de'i ngang du shi na khams gsum du de ltar gol ba yin/ gzhan 'phral yud tsam dang zla ba re gnyis dang lo re tsam la byung zhing*/ de nas nyams de zhig na ni gol rgyu med do// gzhan yang*/ rje yang dgon pas/ bde ba la zhen pa yod/ gsal ba la 'dzin pa yod/

mi rtog pa la blos byas yod pas/ de gsum la zhen na khams gsum du gol zhing*/ zhen 'dzin med kyang gnas lugs kyi rang zhal ma mthong na nyan rang gi 'bras bur gol lo// zhes bzhed pa dang*/ byams snying rje med pa dang dpyad pa'i stong nyid kyis theg dman tsam du gol ba rje sgam po pa'i gsung sgros las 'byung mod kyang*/ nyan rang gi 'bras bu thob pa la/ zhi gnas dang bdag med par dmigs pa'i lhag mthong gnyis ka dgos shing*/ nyon mongs pa rnams spong ba zhig dgos par bshad la/ lhag mthong med pa'i bde gsal mi rtog pa zhen med du bskyangs pa tsam 'jig rten pa'i bsam gtan phal pa yin pas/ des nyan rang dgra bcom 'thob pa mi 'thad do snyam mo// 'o na rje sgam po pas snang la ma nges pa 'gog pa'i rgyur 'gro nyen yod gsungs pa ji ltar yin snyam na/ de ni tshogs chos bkra shis phun tshogs las/ bla ma chos kyi spyan can sems nyid stong pa nyid mngon sum du byas pa zhig gis/ bde gsal mi rtog pa gsum skye med du nges su 'jug /skye med du ma nges na ni/ snang la ma nges pa zhes bya ste/ so sor brtags min gyi 'gog par 'gro/ thun mong gi lam yin pas gar skye cha med pa yin/ zhes gsungs pa ltar so sor brtags min gyi 'gog pa yin la/ de dag ni mngon pa mdzod las/ skye la gtan du gegs byed pa// 'gog gzhan so sor brtags min pas// zhes pa'i rang 'grel las/ ma 'ongs par skye ba la gtan du gegs su 'gyur ba/ bral ba las gzhan pa'i 'gog pa gang yin pa de ni so sor brtags pa ma yin pa'i 'gog pa ste/ 'dir so sor brtags pas thob pa ni ma yin no// zhes sogs bshad pa ltar/ rkyen ma tshang bas ma 'ongs pa'i chos zag bcas zag med rnams skye ba la gtan du gegs byed pa/ so sor brtags 'gog las gzhan pa'i 'gog pa zhig go /de'i 'bras bus gar skye cha med pa'i rgyu mtshan ni/ spyod 'jug las/

stong pa nyid dang bral ba'i sems// 'gags pa slar yang skye 'gyur te// 'du shes med pa'i snyoms 'jug bzhin// zhes pa ltar te/ de la 'du shes med pa ni 'du shes med pa'i lha dag tu skye zhing sems byung 'gog par byed pa zhig dang*/ 'du shes med pa'i snyoms 'jug ni/ des bsam gtan bzhi pa la brten nas 'du shes med pa la thar par 'du shes pas sems dang sems byung 'gog pa'i snyoms 'jug zhig dang*/ 'gog pa'i snyoms 'jug ni 'du shes med/ 'du shes med min gyi skye mched la brten nas 'du shes dang tshor bas skyo ste de dag zhi ba mngon du bya bar 'du shes pas sems sems byung rnams zhi ba'i snyoms 'jug la snyoms par 'jug pa zhig yin la/ de rnams skabs 'dir gol sar 'gyur ba'i don ni/ de dag thams cad bdag med pa'i don dang mi ldan pas 'khor ba'i rtsa ba bdag 'dzin zhi bar mi nus la/ de ma nus pas slar las nyon skyes nas 'khor bar 'khor te/ chos grags kyis/ bdag yod na ni gzhan du shes// bdag gzhan cha las 'dzin dang sdang*// 'di dag dang ni yongs 'brel las// nyes pa thams cad 'byung bar 'gyur// zhes pa ltar ro// dpe lhag spyod kyis ting nge 'dzin bsgoms pa ltar/ srid pa'i rtse mo'i sems thob kyang*// 'khor ba las mi 'da' ba'i don de ltar yin no// so sor brtags 'gog ni/ bden pa bzhi la bar chad med pa'i lam gyi shes rab kyis so sor brtags pas thob pa'i 'gog pa zag bcas kyi chos dang bral ba zhig tu bshad do// de ltar bde gsal mi rtog pa'i nyams de dag 'phral du lus kyi rtsa rlung thig le'i rten 'brel la brten nas shar ba'i bag chags kyi nyams snang la dngos 'dzin dang bden zhen zhugs nas gol ba yin te/ zhen pa gting nas ma log na// sgom nyams bzang yang nyungs ma'i g.yos// zhes pa ltar/ bde gsal mi rtog pa'i nyams de dag la ched du mi bsam mi chags mi zhen par rang ngo rang sar bltas te/

snang rig thams cad chos kyi dbyings su ro mnyam par bya'o// bde gsal mi rtog pa zhen med nyan thos su 'gro ba ni/ slar bla mar mos gus kyis gsol ba legs par btab pas byin rlabs zhugs pa dang*/ nyams dang rtogs pa 'brel ba'i sems kyi rang ngo mthong bar byed dgos pa'o// gnyis pa phyir bltas kyi ting nge 'dzin gyis bsam gtan bzhir gol ba bshad pa ni/ de'ang zhi gnas kyi ting nge 'dzin bde gsal mi rtog pa dang bcas pa'i stobs kyis/ ting 'dzin skyong ba la 'tsher snang med pa dga' spro rgyas pa des thog mar sems las rung gi shin sbyangs skye zhing*/ de'i mthus lus las su rung ba'i rgyur 'gyur ba'i rlung lus la rgyu ste/ des lus la khyab pa na lus las rung gi shin sbyangs skye tshul rnams/ nyan sa las bshad na/ shin sbyangs de skyes nas don so sor rig pa dang*/ mos pa las byung ba rab tu dben pa dang*/ dga' ba dang*/ sdud pa dang*/ dpyod pa dang*/ sbyor ba mthar thug pa'i yid byed drug dang ldan pa na/ gzugs kyi sas bsdus pa'i bsam gtan dang po'i nyer bsdogs su 'gyur ba dang*/ de nas rim pas bsam gtan dang gzugs med la sogs pa'i snyoms 'jug rnams 'grub par bshad de/ sgom rim las/ 'di ltar btang snyoms kyi tshor ba dang ldan zhing rtog pa dang bcas pa dpyod pa dang bcas par gyur pa de'i tshe mi lcogs pa med pa zhes bya ste/ bsam gtan dang po'i sbyor ba'i sems so// gang gi tshe 'dod pa'i sred pa dang sdig pa'i chos rnams dang bral zhing*/ rtog pa dang*/ dpyod pa dang*/ dga' ba dang bde ba dang ldan par gyur pa de'i tshe bsam gtan dang po zhes bya'o// bsam gtan dang po nyid las rtog pa tsam med pa de ni bsam gtan khyad par can zhes bya'o// gang gi tshe rtog pa dang dpyod pa dang bral ba de'i tshe bsam gtan dang po'i sred pa dang bral bar gyur nas dga' ba dang bde ba dang nang yongs su dwangs pa dang ldan par gyur pa de'i tshe bsam gtan gnyis pa zhes bya'o// gang gi tshe bsam gtan gnyis pa'i sred pa dang bral bar gyur te/

bde ba dang btang snyoms dang dran pa dang shes bzhin dag dang ldan par gyur pa de'i tshe bsam gtan gsum pa zhes bya'o// gang gi tshe bsam gtan gsum pa'i sred pa dang bral te/ sdug bsngal ba'ang ma yin bde ba'ang ma yin zhing btang snyoms dang dran pa dag dang ldan par gyur pa de'i tshe bsam gtan bzhi pa zhes bya'o// zhes gsal bar gsungs pa ltar ro// shin sbyangs de thob pa na zhag mang por ting nge 'dzin la mnyam par bzhag kyang*/ de'i tshe lus sems gnyis kyi gnas ngan len rgyun chad nas lus sems la bde dga' thob pa dang bcas pas ting nge 'dzin la 'jug par nus te/ dper na dwags pos zhag bcu gsum la mar me dbu thog tu bzhag nas ting nge 'dzin la bzhugs thub pa lta bu 'byung ba yin no// de dag ni rje gong ma rnams kyis sgom gyi gzhi'am rkang pa tsam du bzhed la/ de la mchog tu bzung nas bskyangs na gnas lugs kyi don du mi rung zhing kha phyir bltas kyi shes pa yin/ a 'thas nas yun du bsgoms te shi ba na bsam gtan gyi lha de dag tu skye ba'i rgyu byed pas 'jig rten mtho ris las mi 'phags/ de ltar ma yin pa'i kha phyi la mi lta bar/ nang du log nas bde nyams de lta bu la mi zhen mi chags par 'dzin med rang ngo rang shes dang bcas skyong nas rtogs pa'i ye shes gsha' ma mthong bar byed dgos pa'o// gsum pa yid byed kyi rtog pas gzugs med skye mched mu bzhir gol ba bshad pa ni/ de'ang chos rnams kha dog dbyibs mtha' dbus thams cad dang bral bas nam mkha' dang 'dra zhes/ chos thams cad nam mkha' dang 'dra bar shes rab kyis dpyad nas/ de la yang dag tu bzung ste zhen cing chags par gyur pa na nam mkha' mtha' yas skye mched du gol te der yang*/ bcom ldan 'das kyis/ kyai rgyal ba'i sras dag khams gsum po 'di dag ni sems tsam mo// zhes gsungs pas nged rang gis der bsam/ chos thams cad rnam shes tsam mam sems yin snyam du de la zhen cing a 'thas na/

rnam shes mtha' yas skye mched du skye/ ci'ang ma grub med bsam du de la zhen na ci'ang med pa'i skye mched du skye/ ci'ang yod pa'ang min med pa'ang min snyam pas der a 'thas na yod min med min gyi skye mched du skye/ de ltar chos thams cad mkha' ltar du lta ba/ chos thams cad sems tsam du 'dzin pa/ chos thams cad med par bsam pa/ chos thams cad yod min med min te mtha' gnyis bral tsam du lta ba de dag ni lar go yul tsam des ci'ang mi phan pas na/ de ltar mi sems par/ dang po sems ma bcos ma yengs pa'i dran par brtson zhing de nas sems kyi ngo bo mthong bar bya/ slar chos thams cad don dam nyag gcig rig thog tu rdo rus thug par byed dgos pa'o// de nas de dag gi 'phros don bshad pa ni/ spyir rang res sems 'di ka ma yengs pa'i gzhi bzung nas gang shar thams cad kho rang gi rang mdangs sam sprul par thag bcad/ de kun la rtsis gdab dgag sgrub med pa'i rang bzhin ngo shes par byed pa'i rang babs de ka dgos te/ rje bla ma rnams kyis sems 'di ka gdod nas dag pa'i ngo bor bzhugs shing spros pa blos sgom thams cad kyi yul las 'das pa bde chen ye shes mngon sum de las gang shar yang thams cad rnam dag ye shes de ka'i rol pa ma gtogs gzhan nas ma byung mi gnas mi 'da'/ zhes sogs gsungs kyang*/ nged rang 'khor ba'i bag chags kyi sgrib pa tshan po ches bsgribs nas de yang mngon sum du mthong yang ngo ma shes/ rang du 'dug kyang thag ma chod/ lhan cig bsdad kyang zhal ma mthong*/ ha re long du song 'dug pa/ zhes rje yang dgon pas bka' bkyon pa de ka grub nas/ 'khrul pa yang 'khrul nying 'khrul chen por 'byams pa yin mod/ de nas da lta sems kyi ngo bo skyong ba'i bzo 'dra zhig byed dus 'dir yang sems kyi ngo bo blos byas kyis bcos/ gnas na dga' ma gnas 'phro na sdug pa sogs spang blang mang po zhig byed pa de 'dra ba ni 'phral gyi log rtog las de ltar min te/

rje gong ma rnams kyis nam mkha' la bya 'phur ba phyogs mtshams gang du 'phur kyang nam mkha' las mi 'da' ba der dpe mdzad/ don du rang sems gdod nas rnam dag chos sku chen po la gang ltar shar yang de ka'i rang bzhin/ ji ltar gyur kyang de nyid kyi ngo bo/ gnas kyang de ka'i rang ngo*/ mi gnas 'phros kyang de'i rang mdangs/ snang ba thams cad kyang de'i rang 'od de/ mdor na gang dran ci shar yang ngo bo rnam dag chos sku ste phyag rgya chen po de las gzhan du ma grub ma skyes mi gnas mi 'gags par gsungs 'dug pas/ gzhi de ltar gnas pa des na 'phral du nged rang gi sems gnas kyang chog 'gyus kyang chog rig kyang chog gsal yang chog dran kyang chog yag kyang chog thams cad sems kyi rol pa las mi 'da' bas de ltar go bas skyong lugs rang sems kyi gshis gsal mi gsal/ bde mi bde ji ltar byung yang de ka'i thog tu bzhag /bde gsal gnas pa'i zhe 'dod med par rtsol med du rang sems lhod de bzhag /sems gsal stong bde mo gnas gnas shig tu mi re bar sems kyi rang ngo ma yengs tsam 'di ka sgom gyi ngo thi bcol la bzhag /ma yengs tsam de kar thal ler gang shar gyi rnam rtog ngos bzung la rang ngo de thog tu bzhag /mdor na gang la'ang 'dzin pa dang dgag sgrub bcos bslad ci'ang mi byed par kun kyang gnyis med mnyam pa'i rang bzhin du thag chod pas gang shar klong du 'jog pa de ltar bgyis pas gegs dang gol shor ci'ang mi 'byung ste/ rje sgam po pas/ spyir gol ba thams cad ni zhen pa'am 'dzin pas gol ba yin pas/ zhen pa'am 'dzin cha thams cad dang bral bar byas la/ zhen med 'dzin med du khres se bzhag go /blangs dor byar med du khres se bzhag go /de ltar ma bcos par bzhag pa de ka la sgom zhes tha snyad btags pa yin no// zhes dang*/ sgron ma las/ btang snyoms tsam du ma bcos ngang bzhag na// tha snyad tsam du sgom zhes de la brjod// zhes gsungs pa ltar ro// yang bde gsal mi rtog pa gsum skye med du nges su 'jug

/skye med du ma nges na ni snang la ma nges pa zhes bya ste/ zhes gong du bshad pa ltar dang*/ spyir khams gsum dang bsam gtan bzhi dang*/ skye mched bzhir gol bar bshad pa de 'dzin pa bag tsam la brten nas gol ba yin/ nyan thos su gol ba ni dpyad pa'i stong pa la gol ba yin/ ngo bo 'dzin med du gnas pa la gol sa med pa yin/ zhes dang*/ rje rgod tshang pas/ nyams len hril gyis dril na/ gnyug ma bsam brjod bral ba la gol shor med pas dngos por yang ma bsgoms/ stong par yang ma 'dzin par byar med du zhog /bde na'ang bde/ ma bde na'ang ma bde/ gsal na'ang gsal/ ma gsal na'ang ma gsal/ dgag sgrub med par zhen med du bzhag pas gol shor gang yang yong ba med/ de byung na ngas len gyis zhes gsungs pa ltar ro// 'o na skye med du nges pa kho nas chog mod/ bde gsal mi rtog pa'i nyams myong gtan nas mi dgos sam snyam na/ de yang cung zad min te/ rje sgam po pas bde gsal mi rtog pa med par sems skye med kyi ngo bo tsam la yang dag par nges kyang*/ bla ma mi la'i zhal nas/ de de yin te de de min// sdong po yin te 'bras bu min// yon tan yin te rtog med min// zhes gsungs/ jo bo chen po'i zhal nas/ nges 'byung bag chags bral ba'i rnal 'byor ma mthong ba// nam mkha'i me tog bung bas 'jib pa 'dra// zhes drangs pa ste/ rtogs pa dang nyams myong gnyis dgos par gsungs so// 'o na ji ltar yin zhe na/ lta ba rtogs pa dang 'brel ba zhes pa/ sems kyi ngo bo rang bzhin gyi gnas lugs de nyid mtha' bral lam spros bral du blos byas pa'am go tshod tsam du ma lus par/ shes rab kyis bltas pas ci'i ngo bor yang grub pa med cing smra bsam shes brjod kyi yul las 'das pa mngon sum du rtogs pa zhig dang*/ sgom pa nyams myong dang 'brel ba zhes pa/ de ltar rtogs pa'i don de'ang go yul tsam du ma lus par rig thog tu gsal sing nge nyams su myong ba zhig dgos par gsungs shing*/

yang rje sgam po pas/ de'ang dang por slob pa'i dus su rig pa gsal sing nge ba la slobs/ de'ang shes pa ma yengs pa la slobs/ de'ang rig pa'i ngo bo la ye ma yengs par bya/ de la goms tsa na nges shes skye ba yin/ zhes dang*/ de'ang rig pa gsal sing nge ba de nyams myong yin/ de la ma yengs pa de gnas pa yin/ shes rab kyis bltas pas ci'i ngo bor yang ma grub pa de rtogs pa yin/ zhes gsungs pa ltar ro// de lta bu'i nyams myong la ni rtogs pa'i rang nyams sam ngo bo'i rang nyams zhes bzhed cing*/ nyams rtogs dbyer med sgom pa gol 'phyugs dang bral bar bzhed de/ rje sgam po pas/ 'o na sgom pa dang 'brel ba'i nyams de gang yin zhe na/ ngo bo'i rang nyams zer/ lhan cig skyes pa'i rang nyams zer/ phyag rgya chen po'i rang nyams zer ba yin/ de gang la zer na rang gi sems kyi ngo bo la zer/ de ji lta bu zhe na/ yod pa ma yin te ngos gzung rgyu skra'i rtse mo brgyar gshag pa tsam yang med/ med pa'ang ma yin te nyams su myong rgyu dang rtogs rgyu zhig yod pa yin te/ de lta bu'i sems kyi ngo bo gsal stong ngos bzung med pa/ gsal stong rgyun chad med par shar dgos/ de lta bu shar na sgom nyams myong dang 'brel bar bya ba'ang yin/ nyams dang rtogs pa dus gcig tu mchi zer ba'ang de la zer ba yin no// zhes gsungs pa ltar/ rang rig rang gsal gyi ngo bo mthong ngo shes na gshis cir yang ma grub pa zhes blo 'das kyi ngo bo mdangs gang du'ang mi 'gags pa zhes sna tshogs rang shar du yod pa de dag kyang zung 'jug klong du gnas shar thim pa de ltar song ba'o// gsum pa shor sa bzhi ni/ stong nyid gshis la shor ba/ lam la shor ba/ gnyen por shor ba/ rgyas 'debs su shor ba dang bzhi'o// 'di dag re re la'ang ye shor dang 'phral shor gnyis su dbye bas shor sa bzhi 'dir nang tshan du dbye na brgyad do// de la don spyi'i rnam pa go yul du shor ba la ye shor gyi tha snyad dang*/

nyams su len lugs 'khrul pa la 'phral shor gyi tha snyad byed pa'ang snang ste/ dang po stong nyid shes bya'i gshis la ye shor ni/ sgom snang stong dbyer med rnam kun mchog ldan gyi stong nyid ces pa/ stong pa nyid dang rten 'brel gnyis med du gnas pa'i tshul ma rig par/ stong nyid de skyon yon gang gis kyang mi gos pa'i gtan med ye ma grub pa zhig tu blos thag bcad nas/ dge sdig gi rgyu 'bras ched du gsod pa'am/ chos thams cad ye dag ye grol la sogs pa'i gshis rkyang du shor zhing*/ de lta bu'i stong rtsis khyer nas kun rdzob kyi rten 'brel la rang byan ma tshud pa'o// de la phyag rgya chen po zhes bya ba ni/ rang gi gshis skye ba med pa yod med rtag chad bden rdzun la sogs pa'i chos thams cad kyis stong pas cir yang grub pa med kyang*/ de'i mdangs mi 'gags par kun rdzob kyi rten 'brel sna tshogs pa 'char bas na/ stong nyid rten 'brel gyi snying po dang rten 'brel stong nyid kyi rang bzhin can du shes pas ni/ stong nyid shes bya'i gshis la mi 'chor te/ rtsa sher/ gang zhig rten 'byung ma yin pa'i// chos 'ga' yod pa ma yin no// de phyir stong pa ma yin pa'i// chos 'ga' yod pa ma yin no// zhes dang*/ byang chub sems 'grel du/ kun rdzob stong pa nyid du bshad// stong nyid kho na kun rdzob yin// zhes pa ltar ro// gnyis pa gshis su 'phral shor ni/ lung rig la thos bsam mang po byas te tha snyad kyi sgo nas don dam pa bya ba'am/ phyag rgya chen po bya ba'am/ dngos po'i gnas lugs 'di ltar yin bsam ste/ bla mas gdams ngag bstan na'ang rang gi de yin sgom na'ang sgom du med ces pa tsam blo yul du bzhag nas/ de'i tshul gzhan la'ang 'chad shes kyang sems rgyud dang ma 'dres pas de nyid gzhan zhig na yod pa ltar song nas/ gnas lugs de nyid rang gi rig thog tu ngo ma 'phrod cing nyams myong gi thog tu ma khel bas blo sra khrig ger sdod pa de'o// 'di ni dred po chos rdugs ces bya ste/

de bas ni sdon nas ma shes kyang 'phral du nges shes skye ba de ka drag /de 'drar ma song bar chos la nges shes bskyed/ nyams len sems thog rang du dril nas skyong dgos te/ til+li pas/ blo yi chos kyis blo 'das don mi rtogs// byas pa'i chos kyis byar med don mi rnyed// blo 'das byar med don de rtogs 'dod na// rig pa rtsad chod sems nyid gcer bur zhog /ces gsungs so// gsum pa lam du shor ba la ye shor ni/ stong nyid kho nas lam thams cad rtogs par 'dod de thabs kyi cha la mi sems pa dang*/ stong nyid lam dang 'bras bu gnyis su med pa la rang gis da lta stong nyid bsgom pa des lam byas te phyis nas 'bras bu sku gsum ye shes lnga ldan gyi sangs rgyas thob par bya snyam pa dang bdag gis stong nyid bsgoms pa las 'bras bu sa bcu lam lnga rnal 'byor bzhi la sogs pa thob par bya snyam pa stong nyid lam shor te/ de spong bar byed dgos/ don rang gi sems rtogs na de nyid chos sku yin zhing*/ chos thams cad gdod ma nas sku bzhi ye shes lnga lhun gyis grub pas gsar du sangs rgyas mi 'tshol bar mnyam nyid chen po'i ngang du gnas par byed dgos te/ bram ze chen pos/ sa dang lam dang sangs rgyas thams cad ro gcig pas// gnyug ma'i ye shes 'di ni yid kyis yid la dris// zhes dang*/ 'bras bu thob pa med pa gdod nas rang la gnas// de ni re dang dogs pa'i gnyen pos 'ching mi dgos// zhes dang*/ rje sgam po pas/ rang rig ngo bo gsal stong 'di// chos sku yin par da gzod shes// thog med rang sems rnam dag 'di// 'bras bu yin par da gzod shes// e ma rin chen sems kyi klong*// rgyu yi dus na 'bras bu dngos// zhes gsungs pa ltar ro// bzhi pa lam la 'phral shor ni/ gnas lugs kyi don ji lta ba bzhin gyi nyams len rang la skyong rgyu yod kyang 'dzin med du thag ma chod cing ltos med du blo ma khel bar/

de min pa zhig gam de bas lhag pa zhig yod du re nas tha mal gyi shes pas blo mi tshims par gzhan du 'tshol ba'am/ sems rang bzhin gyi gnas lugs de nyid la bde bde gsal gsal la sogs pa'i lhan pa btab cing bsgom la 'jog pa ni/ lam la 'phral shor te/ de 'drar ma song bar zhe 'dod kyi bzo 'phro bcad pas cha med du yengs ma shor ba'i gnas lugs rang gshis de la blos sgom gyi lhan po gdab mi dgos te/ rje sgam po pas/ blo yis bzung tshad mtshan ma'i sa bon yin/ cir yang mi 'dzin shar grol dus mnyam yin// zhes dang*/ blo yis cir yang ma bzung cir yang snang*// spros pa'i dri mas rgyud la gos pa med// ces gsungs so// lnga pa gnyen por ye shor ni/ sgom spong gnyen dbyer med/ de nyid rang ngo rang gis rig pas spang bya nyon mongs pa nyid kyi rang gshis nyid gnyen po stong nyid du gnas shing de nyid rang ngo rang gis rig pas spang bya nyon mongs pa nyid gnyen po ye shes su 'char ba ma go bar dug gsum sogs kyi rnam rtog ngan pa skyes pa'i tshe/ 'di ni rnam par ma dag pa thar pa'i srog 'phrog pa ste/ stong pa nyid kyis gzhom par byed snyam du/ nyon mongs rnams stong nyid du blos dpyad nas ma grub pa sgom par byed pa dang*/ yang bla mas gdams ngag bstan pa bsgoms pas rang gis stong nyid bag tsam rtogs nas de nyid gnyen por byas te/ nyon mongs dang rnam rtog spangs nas don dam pa'i sangs rgyas thob pa zhig byed bsam nas/ rtog pa'i gnyen por mi rtog pa bsgom pa sogs ni stong nyid gnyen por shor ba yin pas/ der ni ched du nyon mongs dang rnam rtog spangs nas mi bsgom/ gnod bya gnod byed gnod yul sogs gnyis su mi 'dzin par gang shar rang ngo gnyis 'dzin med pa'i ma bcos ma yengs par skyong dgos te/ brtag gnyis las/ rnam dag ye shes gzugs can dang*// 'khor ba rnam par rtog pa la// khyad par cung zad yod ma yin// zhes dang*/

'khor ba zhe sdang la sogs pa// de rnams chos ni mya ngan 'das// zhes dang*/ mai tri pas/ nyon mongs ye shes chen po ste// zhes pa ltar ro// drug pa gnyen por 'phral shor ni/ rnam par rtog pa rkyen snang gi 'char sgo sogs gang shar thams cad rang ngo shes pa'i yang dag gi dran pa bsten mi shes par/ rtog pa de nyid bshig pa'am/ lcags kyus dgug pa ltar rnam rtog gi gnyen por stong nyid sgom ste tshur bkug nas sgom gyi thog tu 'jog dgos pa 'phral shor te/ de la spang bya de'i rang zhal lta ba dang*/ gang shar rtsol med du lta ba ste/ mai tri pas/ ma skyes pa la rtog pa glo bur ba// stong pa de nyid dbyings kyi ngo bo nyid// de gnyis gdod nas tha dad med pa ste// zhes pa ltar ro// bdun pa rgyas 'debs su ye shor ni/ sgom thabs shes dbyer med dmigs bcas dmigs med sogs chos thams cad kyi ngo bo nyid du gnas pa ma rig par/ lus ngag gi sgo nas 'dus byas kyi dge ba ci rigs pa bsgrubs te/ da ni rang gi 'dus ma byas zab mo stong pa nyid kyi don bsgoms pas 'khor gsum yang dag gi dbyings la 'jug par byed bsam pa dang*/ dkar po'i chos thams cad la dngos 'dzin gyi mtshan mar zhen pas gnyen por lung rig la sogs bsam blos dpyad nas ma grub par bsam ste slar stong nyid du sbyangs pa de nyi tshe ba'i stong nyid yin/ 'khor gsum yang dag gi shes rab kyis zin na rang bzhin ma grub par byas kyang rung ste/ dang por dngos po mtshan ma can du dmigs pa rjes la rang bzhin ma grub pa'i stong pas rgyas 'debs pa'am/ snang ba la stong pas rgyas btab nas bsgoms pas/ bskyed rim la sogs pa bsgom pa de dag stong pas rgyas btab ste stong par song bar bsam ste bsgoms pa rnams ni stong nyid rgyas 'debs su shor ba yin/ 'di sel thabs ni/ nan gyis snang ba 'di stong par mi gcod/ snang ba mi 'gegs par snang dus nyid stong pa nyid du snang ba yin pas/

snang stong dbyer med rang bzhin med pa zung du 'jug par shes dgos pa yin te/ bram ze chen pos/ blo yis bzhag pa'i chos 'di rang gis stong*/ rten dang bral phyir brtag pa thams cad yod ma yin// rang bzhin gnas su grol ba'i de bzhin nyid shes na// mthong thos la sogs med cing de yi rang bzhin bral// zhes dang*/ sha wa ris/ 'du byed las kun ye nas chos kyi dbyings// zhes dang*/ mai tri pas/ gang gis de nyid mngon rtogs na// snang srid thams cad phyag rgya che// chos sku khyab gdal chen po'o// zhes pa ltar ro// brgyad pa rgyas 'debs su 'phral shor ni/ sgom skyong dus mgo rkang ma 'grig cing bdag po ma byung bar shor te/ dang po dga' rab cig skyes kyang phyis yid yul du brengs tsam las med par/ de la phyi bsnyegs kyi yid sgom byas nas dmigs med yin sgom yin mi rtog pa yin snyam du gsal 'debs pa dred po rgyas 'debs te/ de la rig pa 'phros ma thag rig pas rjes 'ded lta bu de ltar ma shor bar/ gang shar la blos sgom gyi lhan pa mi 'debs par yengs med kyi dran pas ngos zin par byas la/ ngos zin thog gi ngo bo ma brjed par skyong dgos te/ rje gong ma rnams kyis/ sgom du rdul tsam med pa la// yengs su skad cig med par skyongs// zhes gsungs pa ltar ro// yang mnyam rjes ro gcig tu ngo ma 'phrod cing rjes shes lam du ma slong bar/ sngon du yengs nas ma nyan slar bsgom dgos snyam du rnam rtog gi 'phro sgom gyis gcod pa lta bu ni blo chung rgyas 'debs su shor ba'o// de la dus rgyun spyod lam rnam bzhi thams cad du ma yengs pa'i dran pa rgyun chags bsten cing*/ brjed par 'dun pa chad mthud la bslab cing*/ sgom dang sgom min dum bur mi gcod par gang byung gi sgom go bcad nas bskyang dgos te/ bram ze chen pos/ mthong dang thos dang dran dang reg pa dang*// za sgom 'chag dang 'gro dang 'dug pa dang*// cal col gtam dang lan smra gyur pa rnams// sems su shes na gcig gis las mi bskyed// ces gsungs pa ltar ro// de lta bu'i shor sa rnams kyi nang nas shes bya'i gshis la ye nas shor ba de ni/

shin tu skyon che ba'i log lta yin te/ sa ra has/ dngos med 'dzin pa de bas kyang ni blun// zhes chad lta dred po de'i 'bras bu ngan 'gro ste/ klu sgrub kyis/ med pa po ni ngan 'gror 'gro// zhes dang*/ rje sgam po pas/ shes bya gshis kyi stong pa de// zhen pa bral yang don ma rtogs// zhes gsungs shing*/ sngon nas bshad pa ltar chos dred du song ba de ni/ chos dred po la sangs rgyas thugs rje rdugs// zhes zer ba ltar gyong chen po yin pas nged rang der ma shor ba gal che/ gzhan shor sa gsum po log ltar mi 'gyur yang gnas lugs don dam rang min pas der ma shor bar rang byung rig pa 'di nyid blos byas kyis mi bslad par skyong ba gal che/ yang shor sa bzhi'i stong pa nyid blos byas kyis sgom pa 'di rnams rnam pa kun tu mi rung ba'ang ma yin te/ don dang po'i las can rnams la chos thams cad ngo bo nyid kyis stong zhing zhi ba'o// zhes blos byas te bsgom par ma byas na las dang po pa dag stong pa nyid la skrag ches pas 'jug par mi 'gyur bas lung dang rigs pa sogs kyi rigs pas thabs kyis dkra dkri byas nas bsgom pa'ang 'gal ba med/ de bzhin las dang nyon mongs pa'i gnyen por bsgom pa dang*/ de lam du byed pa dang*/ spros bcas rnams kyang spros med du rgyas btab nas bsgoms te rim gyis goms su 'jug pa'ang 'thad de mthar ni spang rgyu yin/ des na las dang po pa rnams kyi bsgom bya dang*/ dbang po mchog tu gyur pa gnyis kyi bsgom bya thog mar tshul mi mtshungs te/ dper na skyes bu dar babs kyi kha zas/ byis pa chung ngu la mi 'os pa lta bur gsungs te/ mdor na gang zag gi blo'i rim pa dang bstun nas bsgom pa gal che/ mthar ni 'di ltar shor sa bzhir ma shor bar lta ba'i gnas lugs phyin ci ma log par mngon du byas na bogs 'don gyi mchog tu 'gyur ba'o/// /bzhi pa spyi'i gegs sel bshad pa la/

gzhan yang gegs ni mang ste/ bsod nams kyi tshogs gsog pa'i gegs ni log lta yin te/ de la rten 'brel zab mo khyad du mi gsod par dag snang phyogs med du sbyangs/ gdams ngag nyams su len pa dang dngos grub kyi gegs the tshom yin pas nges shes bskyed/ yon tan myur du skye ba'i gegs bla ma dang yi dam dang gdams ngag la 'dor len sna kha mang ba yin pas/ nges shes gang skyes pa de rang la gnad du bsnun la re dogs kyi blo mang po mi bya/ sgrib gnyis myur du dag pa'i gegs byar med lung ma bstan pa yin pas/ bsod nams kyi tshogs dang thabs lam zab mo la gnad du bsnun/ ye shes kyi tshogs rdzogs pa'i gegs gzung 'dzin yin pas chos thams cad sgyu ma mtha' bral bsam brjod dang bral ba'i gzhung bsrang*/ gzhan don gyi gegs rang gces par 'dzin pa yin pas/ bdag gces btang la snying rje phyogs med du sbyangs zhing gzhan phan gyi smon lam rgya chen po 'debs/ 'di rnams ni lar nged rang la gegs sel gyi rtsa ba rang du 'dug pas thugs la 'jog mdzod// de rnams kyis gegs sel 'ga' re bshad zin pa'o/// /lnga pa 'dra min nor sa bshad pa ni/ nyams dang bsam pa'i gol sa de tsho tsam min pa'i mtho dman kun tu gol sa mang ba ni/ rin chen spungs pa las/ blos byas kyi ni lta ba la// mthar thug yin no snyam na gol// bde gsal mi rtog nyams myong la// chos sku yin no snyam na gol// ma bzhag rang gnas ye shes la// yengs pa yin no snyam na gol// khyad gsod bcos ma'i spyod pa la// 'khrul zhig yin no snyam na gol// chags med spyod pa rtsis med la// nyes ltung phog go snyam na gol// snying rje thabs kyi spyod pa la// dman pa yin no snyam na gol// gding med tho co'i spyod pa la// mthar thug yin no snyam na gol// 'dod ldan gzhan don byed pa la// byang sems yin no snyam na gol// dbye na gol sa bsam mi khyab// bsdu na dngos 'dzin gnyis su 'dus// dngos 'dzin dngos po bdag med rtog

/dngos 'dzin kun dang bral gyur na// gol sa bya ba'i ming yang med// ces gsungs so// de'i don gzhan rnams lung dngos bstan gyis gsal zhing gol skyon gyi rtsa ba dngos 'dzin gnyis su 'dus gsungs pa'i don cung zad bshad na/ spyod 'jug las/ 'jig rten dag na 'tshe ba gang yod dang*// 'jigs dang sdug bsngal ji snyed yod gyur pa// de kun bdag tu 'dzin pa las byung na// 'dre chen des kos bdag la ci zhig bya// zhes pa ltar bdag dang gzhan du 'dzin pa'i 'dzin pa 'khor ba'i rtsa ba yin pas/ bdag 'dzin de nyid ma zhi bas slar yang yang du 'dzin pa bskyed pas srid pa las mi thar bar 'khor lo ltar 'khor ro// de la thar 'dod 'ga' zhig gis kyang las nyon gyi rtsa ba bdag 'dzin yin pa ngos ma zin zhing de spong ma shes par las nyon gyi 'bras bu sdug bsngal spang bar 'dod nas mi dge ba spong zhing thos bsam la sogs pa'i 'dus byas kyi dge ba sgrub par byed kyang bsam sbyor nyes na ci 'gyur cha med la/ bdag 'dzin dngos su zhi thabs bdag med bsgom dgos zer ba'i sgom sgrub pa 'ga' zhig gis kyang*/ yod 'dzin bkag pa'i med 'dzin gyi nges shes shugs bskyed pas/ de las kyang 'dzin pa cher skyes nas chad lta chen por ltung ba yin la/ sgom sgrub legs por 'dod pa 'ga' rer yang sgom pa'i nyams myong shar bar slar zhen 'dzin skyes pas lam gyi gzhung lam ma bsrangs par shor sa bzhi dang gol sa gsum la sogs par 'khyams te/ de'ang mnyam bzhag la 'dzin pa zhugs pas shor gol gyi rtsa ba byed cing*/ rjes shes la 'dzin pa zhugs pas las sogs nas slar 'khor ba'i rgyur 'gyur ba yin no// des na nyes skyon thams cad sems la zhen 'dzin zhugs pa las 'byung bas/ zhen 'dzin ma zhugs pa zhig gal che ste/ bram ze chen pos/ gal te yid du 'ong ngo snyam pa'i sems// snying la bab pa gces par byas na ni// til gyi shun pa tsam gyi zug rngus kyang*// nam zhig sdug bsngal 'ba' zhig byed par zad// ces dang*/

dngos por 'dzin pa phyugs dang 'dra ba ste// dngos med 'dzin pa de bas kyang ni blun// zhes dang*/ gang la zhen pa yod na de yang thong*// zhes pa ltar ro// rgyu mtshan des na rnal 'byor pa la mtshan bcas dang mtshan med bsgoms pa'i nyams snang dang*/ tha mal gyi bag chags la brten pas snang ba rang ga ma la sogs pa cir snang cir 'char yang 'dzin med du 'jog pa lam gyi mchog tu gsungs te/ rje sgam po pas/ cir yang shar ba cir yang mi 'dzin pa'i// lam mchog 'di las gong du 'phul sa med// ces so// de'ang 'dzin med kyi ngang skyong bar goms na bag chags las snang dag pa dang*/ rnam rtog thams cad skyes grol dus mnyam du 'gyur ba dang*/ de'i tshe spros pa'i dri mas rgyud la mi gos pa dang*/ gang snang thams cad chos sku'i rnam rol du 'gyur ba sogs kyi yon tan mang du gsungs te/ rje sgam po pas/ bag chags 'thas pa'i mi snang dgu snang 'di// 'dzin med goms byas ma spangs gnas dag yin// blo yis bzung tshad mtshan ma'i sa bon yin// cir yang mi 'dzin skyes grol dus mnyam yin// zhes dang*/ blo yis cir yang ma bzung cir yang snang*// spros pa'i dri mas rgyud la gos pa med// ces dang*/ gnyis 'dzin dri mas skad cig ma sbags na// gang gang de rang chos sku gyed langs yin// zhes dang*/ rtsis gdab med na rnam rtog skyes grol yin// zhe 'dod med na thams cad mnyam nyid yin// de ltar rtogs na sgom la rgyun chad med// skye 'chi med pas 'pho ba'i rgyal po yin// mtshan ma med pas 'od gsal khor ra yug /ces gsungs so// 'dzin pa zhi na thar pa thob pa ni/ nang du bdag 'dzin dang phyi rol du bdag gi ba'i 'dzin pa zad na/ nyer len gyis phung por nying mtshams sbyor ba 'gags shing*/ phung por nying mtshams sbyor ba zad na skye ba zad/ de zad pas las nyon zad nas thar pa thob pa yin te/ rtsa sher las/ nang dang phyi rol nyid dag la// bdag dang bdag gir gnyis zad na// nye bar len pa 'gags 'gyur zhing*// de zad pas na skye ba zad// las dang nyon mongs zad pas thar// zhes pa ltar ro// de ltar na/

'dzin med zhen med dmigs med mtshan ma med pa gtad so med pa dgag sgrub med pa spang blang med pa re dogs med pa zhe 'dod med pa la sogs pa thams cad gnad gcig pas/ de dag gi tshul rnams zhib tu blo la nges par byas la/ rnal 'byor bzhi la sogs pa so so'i gnas skabs su rang rang gi dge sbyor de'i thog nas ma yengs tsam gyi thog tu 'dzin pa ma zhugs pa zhig rnam pa kun tu gal che ba shes par gyis shig// /bzhi pa bogs 'don rtsal sbyangs kyi tshul bshad pa la sa bcad nang tshan du dbye na/ dang po spyi'i bogs 'don bshad pa/ gnyis pa bye brag gi bogs 'don bshad pa/ gsum pa khyad par gyi bogs 'don bshad pa/ bzhi pa skye med zang thal du la bzla ba bshad pa/ lnga pa sgom rtogs pa'i ngo bo'i bogs 'don bshad pa/ drug pa 'gags med kyi 'char sgo'i rtsal sbyong tshul bshad pa'o/// /dang po spyi'i bogs 'don bshad pa ni/ de'ang tshe 'di'i 'dod yon la zhen na sngon 'gro'i chos mi rtag pa sgoms/ rgyu 'bras la nges shes chung na 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs rnams sgoms/ sems can la snying rje chung na byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems sgoms/ lus tha mal du zhen na yi dam gyi lhar sgom dgos pa ste/ de rnams kyi bogs 'don du/ rang gi rtsa ba'i bla ma mtshan nyid dang ldan pa gang yin pa de ma brjed par bla ma'i rnal 'byor dus rnams kun tu bsgom dgos te/ de'ang sangs rgyas dngos su lta ba'i mos gus chen po'i ngos nas 'di phyi tshe rabs kun tu blo ling gis bkal/ gsol 'debs rang la thun mtshams med par rgyun du 'bad de/ bsam rgyu bla ma las med pa/ byed rgyu mos gus las med pa/ smra rgyu gsol 'debs las med pa zhig gal che ste/ de'ang*/ til+li pas/ bogs 'don yongs kyi chos gcig pu// bla ma yin no rnal 'byor pa// zhes dang*/ nā ro pas/ kun la bla ma'i rnal 'byor shis// zhes gsungs/

gzhan mtshan mar 'dzin par gnyen po yang dag gi dran pa bsten/ nad gdon la de nyid lam khyer gyi gsang spyod byed/ gzhan yang thabs kyi bogs shes rab dang*/ shes rab kyi bogs thabs kyis 'don/ stong pa'i bogs snying rje dang*/ snying rje'i bogs stong pas 'don/ bde ba'i bogs stong pa dang*/ stong pa'i bogs bde bas 'don/ zhes gong ma rnams kyis gsungs/ de'ang nyams su len pa'i gang zag gi blo rigs spyir btang la gsungs kyis/ thabs kyi phyogs su lhung ba'i rnal 'byor pas ni/ mtshan bcas dge sbyor la mchog tu 'dzin cing des 'bras bu thob par rloms pa ste/ de ni gnas lugs kyi don ma rtogs na 'khor ba'i rgyu las ma 'das pas rtag pa dang 'khor ba'i mthar lhung ba yin pas/ shes rab stong nyid la gnad du bsnun dgos pa yin/ shes rab kyi phyogs su lhung ba'i rnal 'byor pas ni/ rang sems stong gsal bde ba zhig la dga' zhing*/ thabs kyi cha dang rten 'brel khyad du gsod pa ni/ chad pa dang myang 'das kyi sar lhung ba yin pas thabs rten 'brel la gnad du bsnun dgos pa yin/ zung du 'jug pa'i rnal 'byor pas ni/ gzhi nas stong nyid kyi rtsal rten 'brel du shar ba rten 'brel 'gags med du sgyu ma mtha' bral yin pas/ nam yang 'bral med du gnas pa ltar lam yang thabs shes zung 'brel du nyams su len pa ste/ las dang po pa'i dus su thabs gtso cher nyams su len/ thabs dang snang ba thams cad sgyu mar bdag med mtha' bral stong pa nyid du ngo sprod/ gnas lugs zab mo rig nas brtan pa ma thob kyi bar du shes rab la gtso bor byed cing thabs dang shes rab rten 'brel khyad du mi gsod/ gnas lugs don der brtan pa thob pa dang thabs shes dbyer med ro mnyam du nyams su len zhing*/ dus thams cad du thabs dang shes rab 'brel ba'i gnad la mkhas par byas pas/ 'bras bu'ang sku gsum lhun grub tu rdzogs pa ni rten 'brel gyi che ba yin/

de bas na stong nyid zab mo dang rten 'brel phyag rgya chen po dbyer med du nyams su len dgos pas na/ ya bral ba dang re re'i mthar lhung ba'i lta sgom spyod pa phyogs zhen can thams cad spangs dgos par gsungs so// thabs kyi bogs shes rab kyis 'don zer ba ni/ de'ang dang po sems ngo cung zad yod kyang de mtshan bcas dge sbyor gyis g.yengs te/ bsgoms kyang bogs med na dngos po la mtshan mar zhen nas thabs rkyang par song ba'i rtags yin pas/ mtshan mar rtog pa'i zhen 'khris thams cad dang phral la/ thabs nyid rang bzhin med pa shes par byas te/ gnas lugs don rang la 'bad pas bogs thon yong*// shes rab kyi bogs thabs kyis 'don zer rgyu ni/ stong nyid rtogs pa'i shes rab yun ring bar bskyangs kyang bogs skyed med na stong pa phyogs gcig par gol rtags yin pas/ thabs rten 'brel la 'bad rten 'brel gyi go rgya bskyed pas bogs thon yong*/ sems ngo gnas pa bzang yang bogs med na/ gnas pa rkyang par shor rtags yin pas/ yengs med mnyam bzhag gi dran pa bsten/ bde ba'i bogs stong pas 'don pa ni/ bde bar bogs ma thon na bde ba la zhen rtags yin pas rlung sems gnyis ka sgom zhing gsal ba'i mdangs bton la gnas lugs kyi shes rab bskyed// stong pa'i bogs bde bas 'don pa ni/ stong pa la bogs ma thon na stong pa'i nyams rkyang pa la zhen pa yin pas/ gtum mo sogs bsgoms nas bde ba'i rnal 'byor dang*/ stong nyid ma rtogs pa'i sems can la snying rje'i rtsal bskyed/ gzhan yang byams snying rje zhen log mos gus mtshan bcas kyi nyams bzang po skyes pa'i dus su zhen cing rjes su 'brangs na skyon yong bas/ stong nyid ngo bo'i rang tsho bzung*/ khyad par ni/ skyon gyi rtsa ba ma bton gyi bar la yon tan gyi bogs thon pa dka' bar gsungs pas na/ nga bdag gi mgo bo gnon/ dug lnga ngan rtog gi dbang du mi gtong bar dbang du bsdu nas lam du slong dgos/

mdor na stong nyid kyi btsan sa zin pa zhig ma byung gi bar du/ sgom la chog shes dang le lo dang lhag par don med 'dir snang la skad cig kyang mi sems par/ mi tshe gang phyid la 'dun pa gtad nas skyid sdug med par sgom snyugs bsring dgos par gda'/ nged rang rnams so nam ma byas par 'bras bu za 'dod pa bzhin/ sgrub pa ma byas par rtogs ldan bzang po zhig bsam ste de rgyud la khel ba dka'/ des na de ltar mi byed de/ phung byed 'dir snang gi dbang du mi gtong bar/ sdod sa dben gnas la bya/ 'tsho ba 'phral phyid la bsten/ sdug sgur stan thog tu btsugs shing*/ der yang 'chi ba snying 'og tu bcug /dgos med legs par bsam// long med rgyud la brten// bla ma la mos gus kyi gzhi bzung*// nyams len gsol 'debs dang*// stong nyid la byed cing brtson 'grus kyis bskyangs// nyams myong zhen med du bzhag /bde sdug 'khris med du bskyur nas// rang sems ngo bo skyong zhing*/ de'ang yun ring la dar drags pa'i sgrub pa zhig la dkyus su bton pas/ rim gyis rtogs pa shar brtan pa thob rtsal rdzogs 'ong ba yin/ nged rang de 'dra rang zhig byung na ma byung na dgos par 'dug /blo nyes na 'di phyi tshe rabs kun tu mi yong bar 'dug pas de 'drar ma song bar rem dgos pa'o// zhen log sgom gyi rkang pa/ mos gus sgom gyi mgo bo/ dran pa sgom gyi snying po zhes gong ma rnams kyis gsungs pa'i/ zhen log mos gus dran pa gsum la dril ba gal du che ba las/ zhen log sgom gyi rkang pa ni/ rang re chos byed rnams don med kyi tshe 'dir snang cung zhig 'di la mi 'byams mi tshe mi skyel bar/ chos kyi gnad dam pa las rgyu 'bras 'chi ba mi rtag pa 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs 'di rnams la legs par bsam nas tshe 'di yi 'khor ba'i gdos thag rbad kyis bcad nas bsam pa sbyor ba dam chos rnam dag tu ling gis btang dgos par 'dug

/dam chos rnam dag gang yin na/ tshe 'dir snang 'jig rten chos brgyad dang rgyu nor zas gsum sogs gang la'ang mi dga' zhing der ltos pa med pa'i chos rkyen gang gis kyang mi g.yo bar bsgrubs na de yin no// de ltar bsgrub dgos rgyu 'dra zhig ni tshe 'di phyir bar gsum gang nas bsam su la bltas kyang 'dug go /da lta tshe 'dir snang 'jig rten 'khor ba'i bslu brid la bltas na sang 'jig rten gzhan du 'gro dus sdug thag chod/ da lta sdug zer ba 'di tsho dang mi 'dra bar 'di tsho las 'bum 'gyur mang pos sdug pa zhig 'ong nges red do// sang 'jig rten pha rol tsam mi dgos/ 'khor ba mtha' med kyi tshe rabs kun tu sdug pa'i mgo zug pa yin par 'dug /don der bsam nas tshe 'dir snang la mi dga' mi chags 'jig rten bslu ba chen pos mgo mi 'khor bar byas nas/ tshe rabs gtan du bde ba dam pa'i chos rnam dag cig la 'bad pa 'don dgos te/ til+li pas/ kyai ma 'jig rten chos la legs rtogs dang*// rtag mi thub ste rmi lam sgyu ma 'dra// rmi lam sgyu ma don la yod ma yin// des na skyo bskyed 'jig rten bya ba thong*// 'khor yul chags sdang 'brel ba kun chod la// gcig pur nags 'dabs ri khrod dgon par sgoms// zhes gsungs so// mos gus sgom gyi mgo bo ni/ mos gus chen pos bla ma la gsol ba snying gi dkyil nas 'debs dgos shing*/ rang rer sgom shar mi shar bla ma'i byin rlabs la re ste/ de don gyis na kha dang tshig tsam ma yin pa'i snying gi khong rus pa'i gting nas mos gus gdung shugs drag pos ngag gsol 'debs rgyun mi chad pa/ lus gus 'dud mchi ma dang bcas te gsol ba 'debs dgos te/ sgom gyi gegs sel ba dang*/ sgom ma skyes pa skye bar byed pa dang*/ skyes pa bogs dbyung bar byed pa dang*/ rtsal ma rdzogs pa rdzogs par byed pa dang*/ 'bras bu rin po che ma thob pa thob par byed pa dang*/

yon tan ma skyes pa skye bar byed mkhan thams cad mtshan ldan bla ma'i byin rlabs yin no// spyir sgrub brgyud rin po che'i gdams pa rang sems phyag rgya chen po sgom par byed pa 'dir mtshan ldan bla mar slob ma mos gus can gyis gsol 'debs kyis rtogs bya ma gtogs/ gzhan ni tshe 'dir snang la mkhas pa dang*/ chos tshig la mkhas pa dang*/ dbang che zhing btsan pa dang*/ nor phyug pa/ pho sgo bzang kha mkhas/ dbang thang chen po rnams kyis rtogs bya min par 'dug /bla ma la yon 'bul ba che bas rtogs bya min par 'dug ste/ bla ma sangs rgyas dngos su lta ba'i mos gus kyis gzhi bzung nas blo gtad ling bskyur gyis nyams len gsol 'debs 'ba' zhig la byed mkhan gyis rtogs par bya rgyu yin no// de ltar go bar byas nas chos kyi mdo don/ mos gus dang gsol 'debs rkyang par thun dang dum bur mi bzung bar dus kun tu 'bad dgos te/ de'ang*/ 'ba' ra ba rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos/ rje la gsol ba ma thebs na/ lus ngag yid gsum chos phyir 'bad kyang*/ dkar gang gi tshod ma bzhin du shes rgyud la mi phan pas/ nā ro paṇa chen gyi bu brgyud 'di ni/ mos gus kyis grol ba sha stag yin te/ gzhan kha mkhas kyi lo rgyus mang ba dang*/ bshad pa mang po'i tshig gi spun pa dang*/ mkhas pa dang btsun pa dang chen po dang*/ grub pa yin no snyam pa'i nga rgyal gyi rwa gdengs pa rnams kyis rtogs bya ma yin/ bla ma dang g.yag 'grogs byed pa'i dred po chos rgyus mkhan rnams kyis spyod yul ma yin/ chos phyir dka' spyad dang snying rus byas snyam pa'i sdug yus can rnams kyi gnas ma yin te/ mos gus 'ba' zhig gis bla ma 'di dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bor bzhugs pa yin na'ang bdag lta bu'i ma dag pa log lta can rnams 'dul ba'i slad du tha mal gyi cha bzung nas/ lam sbyangs pa dang bsgrubs pa'i tshul ston pa ma gtogs/

khyab bdag rdo rje sems dpa' dngos rang yin snyam pa'i mos gus gdung shugs drag pos snying khung rus pa'i gting nas gsol ba dung dung btab ste dbang bzhi blangs nas yang yang rang la bstim/ 'di sgom ma skyes pa skye bar byed pa yin/ skyes pa bogs 'byin par byed pa'ang yin/ sems mi gnas pa gnas par byed pa'ang yin/ ma zin pa zin par byed pa'ang yin/ rnam rtog dang nyon mongs ma grol ba grol bar byed pa'ang yin pas nan tan bskyed par bya'o// zhes gsungs so// dran pa sgom gyi snying po ni/ thos bsam sgom gsum spyi dang*/ khyad par sgom skyong ba la dran pa dang shes bzhin dang bag yod pa la gnas par byas nas bsgom dgos te/ mdo las/ dran dang shes bzhin rtag bsten na// log rtog mtshan mas nye mi nus// zhes dang*/ spyod 'jug las/ sems bsrung 'dod pa rnams la ni// dran pa dang ni shes bzhin dag /srog la bab kyang srungs shig ces// bdag gis de skad 'doms par byed// ces pa ltar ro// de la dran pa ni/ 'dris pa'i don la mi brjed pa zhig yin te/ mngon pa gong ma las/ dran pa gang zhe na/ 'dris pa'i dngos po la sems brjed pa med pa ste/ sems rnam par mi g.yeng pa'i las can no// zhes gsungs so// de la brten nas shes bzhin 'byung ste/ spyod 'jug las/ gang tshe dran pa yid sgo na// bsrung pa'i don du gnas gyur pa// de tshe shes bzhin 'ong 'gyur zhing*// zhes so// de ltar na'ang*/ 'dir ni gtso bor sems kyi gnas lugs skyong zhing bogs dbyung ba'i spyod pa la blang dor tshul bzhin du byed pa'i dran shes bsten pa gal che la/ de lta bu'i dran shes dang mi ldan pa'i skyon ni/ spyod 'jug las/ shes bzhin med pa'i sems ldan pas// thos dang bsam dang sgom pa yang*// glo rdol bum pa'i chu bzhin du// dran pa la ni de mi gnas// thos dang dad pa can dang ni// brtson pa lhur len du ma yang*// shes bzhin med pa'i skyon chags pas// ltung ba'i rnyog dang bcas par 'gyur// shes bzhin med pa'i chom rkun dag

/dran pa nyams pa'i rjes 'brangs nas// bsod nams dag ni nyer bsags kyang*// rkun pos 'phrog bzhin ngan 'gror 'gro// zhes pa ltar ro// de lta bu'i dran shes dang ldan pa la ni bag yod pa 'byung ste/ de'i ngo bo ni kun nas nyon mongs kyi chos rnams la sems srung zhing 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dge ba rnams yongs su sgrub par byed pa ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i gsang ba'i mdo las/ gzhan yang bag yod pa ni rang gi sems 'dul ba dang*/ gzhan gyi sems bsrung ba dang*/ nyon mongs pa la dga' ba'i sems sel ba dang*/ chos la dga' ba'i sems su 'jug pa dang*/ zhes pa nas/ tshul bzhin ma yin pa'i rnam par rtog pa rgyu ba med pa dang*/ sdig pa mi dge ba'i chos thams cad kyi rnam par rtog pa rgyu ba med pa ni/ bag yod pa zhes bya'o// zhes pa ltar ro// des na rang la dge sbyor ji ltar skyong rgyu yod pa de nas bzung dus dang gnas skabs thams cad du de ka'i ngo bo ma yengs par skyong ba lam gyi snying po yin pas rang rig ma bcos pa'i dran pa yengs med dang ma bral ba zhig dgos te/ dran pa shor na des nyams len gyi don de nyid 'chor bas so// de ltar yang*/ klu sgrub kyis/ dbang phyug lus gtogs dran pa bder gshegs kyi// bgrod pa gcig pu'i lam du nye bar bstan// de la bsgrims te mngon par bsrung bgyi zhing*/ dran pa nyams pas chos kun 'jig par 'gyur// zhes dang*/ rje sgam po pas/ dran pa'i rgyal po ma yengs lta ba sgoms// sna tshogs rkyen gyis mi 'gyur de la brtson// ma yengs dran pa'i rgyun las gzhan mi btsal// zhes dang*/ rje phag mo gru pas/ dran pa'i mel tshe 'di ma byas na// bdud bzhi'i rkun mas bskor re ran// ye shes kyi nor bu shor dogs yod// ces dang*/ rje 'bri gung pas/ dus gsum rgyal ba'i gzhung lam de// dus rgyun chad med pa'i dran pa yin// dran pa yengs med ma shes na// lus ngag tab tab kyi kha na med// ces so// de'ang kha cig mi rtog pa'i ngo bo cher mi brtan pa rnams kyis dran pa rang la/

nyams len dngos gzhi'i snying por bzung nas 'bad pas skyong dgos/ rtogs pa'i ngo bo brtan nas brjed pa med pa'i dran pa yug gcig lta bu 'ong na der ni dran pa zhes ched du blos bsgom mi dgos mod/ de bsgoms na sgom gyi lhan pa zhes dri ma yin/ 'on kyang bsgom bya sgom byed med bzhin du ma yengs pa zhig gal che ste/ bsgom rgyu rdul tsam med pa la// yengs su skad cig med par skyongs// zhes sogs mang du gsungs so// dran shes de nyid skabs so so'i dgos pa dgos ched dbye ba sogs slar 'chad par 'gyur la/ tshul 'dir mdo rgyud rnams nas gong smos ltar skabs su yid byed bsgrubs la/ 'ga' zhig tu dran pa med cing yid la byed pa med ces mang du gsungs pa'i bkag pa sna tshogs bshad pa rnams kyang gang zag dbang po'i rim par dgongs pa yin/ dper na chu gcod pa la gru med thabs med kyang pha rol du phyin dus skyur ba bzhin/ lam gyi dri ma sbyong bar yid byed kyi dran pa med du mi rung yang*/ mthar ni dag byar bshad pa'o// gsum pa khyad par gyi bogs 'don bshad pa ni/ de yang rgyal ba gong ma rnams kyi gsung thams cad ni brjod kyis mi langs zhing*/ 'dir skabs su bab pa ni/ rje gong ma rnams gsung mthun par 'di bzhin gsungs te/ sgom gyi bogs 'don mos gus la 'chol// sgom gyi bya ra dran pa la 'chol// sgom gyi phrin las snying rje la 'chol// sgom gyi skyong lugs ngo tsha la 'chol// zhes shā lo ka gcig 'dug pa de so sor bshad na/ dang po sgom gyi bogs 'don mos gus la 'chol gsungs pa de nyid/ de'ang rang la mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i bla ma zhig yod cing*/ rang gis de la mos gus tshud/ nyams dang rtogs pa'i nyams len byed na sgom dang po 'char du ma btub pa 'char bar byed pa dang*/ de shar yang bar du brtan pa ma thob na thob par byed pa dang*/ brtan pa thob kyang tha ma 'bras bu'i klong chen por ma 'chol na de 'chol bar byed pa thams cad bla ma sangs rgyas kyi ngo bo de la mos gus rtse gcig pas gsol ba 'debs dgos pa yin par 'dug

/de ni kun gyi nang nas gal che ba yin par 'dug /de'ang dus dang rnam pa thams cad du bla ma la mos gus mi gcod de/ mos gus de'ang*/ tho tsam 'ol tsam ma yin pa'i gdung shugs drag po bskyed/ snying khong rus pa'i gting nas gsol ba gdab/ bla ma de'i skyon cung zad cig bzung yang yon tan skye ba'i gegs byed pas skyon du mi rtog /skyon dran na rang snang ma dag pa shes par byas la slar yon tan dran pa'i sgo nas mos gus la gnad du bsnun/ gtso bor bla ma spyi bor bsgoms nas gsol 'debs dang*/ khyad par snying gi dbus su bsgom ste gsol ba 'debs/ bla ma'i thugs dang rang gi sems gnyis med du bsres te dge sbyor gyi ngo bo skyong bar 'bad/ de ltar byas na mos gus tshad du phyin pa'i bogs dang dge sbyor la brtan pa thob pa'i bogs dang bla ma rang sems gnyis med du shes pa'i bogs 'don la sogs pa 'ong ba yin/ de nas kyang bla ma phyogs re ba zhig dang mos gus phyogs re ba zhig mi byed par/ kun khyab mos gus zhes sems can thams cad bzang ngan du mi phye bar 'gro ba rigs drug gam khams gsum gyi sems can thams cad bla mar bsgom bla ma'i sprul par bsam nas thams cad la mos gus rtse gcig byed/ rang gi lus longs spyod dus gsum gyi dge rtsa thams cad mchod pa'i tshul du 'bul/ gzhan yang maṇ+ḍal spyi khyab ltar srid zhi'i mchod pa thams cad kyis kyang mchod/ mos gus rtse gcig pas gsol ba legs par 'debs/ de nas rjes su khams gsum bla ma'i rang bzhin de rnams thams cad rang la bstim/ rang gi sems dang gnyis med du mnyam par bzhag ste nyams len gyi ngo bo skyong*/ de bzhin dus rnams kun tu 'bad cing rgyun du'ang de'i dam tshig ni/ stong nyid kyi ngo bo dang ma bral ba nas/ snod kyi 'jig rten yul ri la sogs pa'ang bla ma'i zhing khams sam/ de min kyang gang 'dul der ston 'byung bas 'dul ba la sangs rgyas 'byung bar sprul gsungs 'dug pa de ltar shes par byas/

legs nyes chags sdang du mi 'dzin/ thams cad dag pa'i klong du bsgyur/ de nas bcud kyi sems can mi la sogs skye 'gro pho mo dud 'gro dang bcas pa tha na 'bu srin sbrang bu yan chad gang mthong ba de bla ma'i skur wal wal gsal nas mos gus dung dung byed/ de rnams la gnod 'tshe brnyas chos bzang ngan chags sdang du lta ba spu tsam yang mi byed/ rgyun du bla mar bsgoms nas mos gus la 'bad/ sems can de rnams kyi sgra sna tshogs thos na de bzhin bzang ngan chags sdang mi byed par bla ma'i gsung gi rol pa chos kyi sgrar 'khyer/ mdor na snang grags rig gsum bla ma'i sku gsung thugs su bsgom pa'i mos gus byed/ de yang spyir dran tshad thugs su 'khyer pa'i mos gus zer ba yod kyang de sems kyi ngo bo ma 'phrod pa tshos ched du blos sgom/ 'khyer so legs par ngo 'phrod na/ gang shar stong nyid de ka bla ma'i thugs te/ de ka rang babs las ched du 'khyer so mi dgos pa yin/ yul snang thams cad bla ma'i zhing khams sprul pa/ sems can thams cad bla ma'i ngo bo/ sgra grags thams cad bla ma'i gsung ste/ chos kyi rang bzhin de ltar bsgoms nas mos gus byed dgos pa yin/ de'ang snang srid dag par 'khyer phyin de nas ni chags sdang med pa gal che bas/ de'ang rang la gnyen nye ba la sogs pas sger du brtse ba byed na de la mi chags babs kyis snang ba dag par byed/ khyad par dgra bo la sogs pas gnod bskyal na de la mi sdang lhag par de kha bla mar bsgom mos gus kyis mchod gsol ba 'debs rang la bstim/ rang dang gnyis med du bzhag /dngos su ngan byas byung yang der mi sdang bar bla ma'i sprul pa'i ngo bor bsam// ngan byed thams cad ni bla ma'i byin rlabs dang dbang bskur gyi 'jug sgo stsol ba yin pas dga' bsam pa dang ngan smras thams cad gdams ngag chos su go bar byed/ ngan sems thams cad rang la snying rje ba dang thugs brtse ba dang bcas pas byin gyis brlabs pa yin pas de ltar bsam la mos gus byed/

dpe des rigs mtshon nas bzang ngan thams cad bla mar bsgom mos gus byed/ tha na 'bu srin gyis gnod 'tshe tshun bla ma'i sku gsung thugs kyi rol pa byin rlabs 'jug sgo can du bsam/ sdang sems skad cig kyang mi byed par de ltar lag len du bslab/ rgyun du snang srid bla mar bsgom pa'i mos gus mchod pa gsol 'debs de ltar byed dgos pa yin par 'dug /de ltar 'bad na mthar snang srid thams cad bla ma'i sku gsung thugs kyi rol par 'char/ dag pa rab 'byams kyi zhing du sleb/ khyab gdal chen po'i mos gus 'byongs zhes bya ba'i legs po zhig 'ong ba yin/ de'ang dag pa rab 'byams ji ltar yin na/ dang po snod dag pa la'ang bka' brgyud gong ma rnams kyi gsung mang yang*/ 'dir rje grub mchog shes rab 'brug rgyas la/ slob ma rnams kyis gsungs mgur rbad dang sbrag pa zhig zhu zhes zhus par/ rje'i gsung las/ rbad rang ngag dbang bzang po'i bu brgyud 'dir yod de// nga rang gi lus 'di sangs rgyas kyi zhing du tshegs med/ de bas nga rang gi rbad la 'di ltar yin/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing zer ba logs nas 'tshol dgos pa min/ nga rang gi sdod sa 'di ka sangs rgyas kyi zhing rang yin/ nga rang dmyal ba lcags sreg gi sa gzhi'i nang du bsregs kyang sangs rgyas kyi zhing dang khyad med pa'i gdengs chen po yod pa yin/ zhes gsungs so// bcud dag pa la 'byongs pa ni/ rje dam ba rgya gar ba la/ kun dgas/ dam pas de bzhin gshegs pa rgya mtsho lta bu'i zhal gzigs sam zhus par/ dam pa'i zhal nas/ sangs rgyas kyi zhal mthong ba dang*/ sbur ba'i zhal mthong ba gnyis khyad ci yod gsungs/ de de bzhin gshegs pa'i zhal mthong na dga' zhus par/ mthong na dga' bsam pa de ka rang gis ma mthong ba yin gsungs pa de ltar yong ba yin 'dug /tshul 'di ni rang res mched grogs la dag snang bsgom pa'ang shin tu dka' bar 'dug mod/ chos kyi don gnad thams cad tshang bar byed na sems can la snying rje zhes/

rang mthon po 'dra 'dra sems can la dma' ba 'dra ba de rang byas pas 'thus rgyu min/ de rang la a 'thas na des ni gsang sngags bum dbang gi dam tshig thams cad lha'i rang bzhin du blta rgyu de las 'gal 'gro/ mos gus dag pa rab 'byams de las 'gal 'gro/ de ltar ma yin pa gang dgos zhe na/ thams cad la dag snang dgos pa yin/ gtso bor sems can thams cad la byams snying rje bsam nas sems bskyed kyi ngang nas dge ba rgya chen po bsgrubs los dgos kyang de min dag snang yang gal che/ gal che ba'i don bum dbang gi dam tshig mi nyams pa dang*/ bla ma'i mos gus dag pa rab 'byams yong ba'i phyir yin te/ phyag len du gang thebs la 'bad dgos pa'o// sgom gyi bya ra dran pa la 'chol zhes pa/ lar las dang po pa so so'i skye bo'i dus nas bzung*/ sa bcu rgyun mtha'i lam rdzogs kyi bar sgom gyi spang bya thams cad dran pas spong nus par chos skad spyi dang rgyal ba'i bka' las gsungs shing*/ spyir sgom gyi rang skad la'ang las dang po pa rtse gcig gi sna skyong ba nas sgom med blo zad chos zad kyi bar du dran pa dgos zer ba yod kyang*/ dran pa der yang dran pa na rim gcig pa min zhing dran pa'i na rim mang bas de ltar shes dgos/ de min dang po gnas 'gyu'i mgo 'dzugs dus kyi dran pa de ka rjes su'ang e yin bsam pa'i ming gcig pa la 'khrul don ma 'byed na mi yong*/ dran pa'i dbye ba spyir shin tu mang*/ rnal 'byor bzhi sogs dbye ba 'dis 'byed/ las dang po pa dang bar pa sbyangs myong can thams cad la'ang med du mi rung pa'i nyams len gyi rtsa ba dran pa yin te/ de'ang nyams rtogs ma shar ba tshos ni da dung nyams rtogs 'char du re bas nam yang dran pa'i 'dun pa rtse gcig dang mi 'bral bar byed dgos/ dran pa yod na sgom yod/ dran 'dun med na sgom stor gsungs 'dug pa de tshor bsam dgos rgyu yin// zhi gnas shar ba tsho la'ang dran pa dgos te/

gnas nyams de la rang ngo rang shes kyi dran pa med na zhi gnas lteng po yin pas gnas nyams ji tsam che na'ang sgom du mi the/ sangs rgyas kyi lam du mi 'gro/ gnas nyams der gsal nyams rang ngo rang shes kyi dran pa yod na de sgom du the zhing sangs rgyas kyi lam du 'gro/ zhi gnas de'i thog tu bde gsal mi rtog pa la sogs nyams sna tshogs shar ba der yang dran pa dgos te/ dran pa rang ngo rang shes med na bde gsal mi rtog pa de'i ro myong nas de la chags shing zhen na sgom du mi the sangs rgyas kyi lam la skad cig kyang mi 'gro ba'i gol sar 'chor/ sems bde ba gsal ba mi rtog pa la sogs pa'i nyams de'i ro mi myong ma chags ma zhen par bde na bde ba/ gsal na gsal ba/ mi rtog gnas na gnas pa ste/ don nyams gang shar de ka dran pas ngos bzung nyams de'i rang ngo shes bzhin du bskyangs na de khams gsum du mi gol zhing sangs rgyas kyi lam du 'gro/ sgom rtogs pa dngos gzhi skye ba'i lam stegs lta bu yin/ yang bde nyams de ltar ma yin pa'i rtsub nyams sems 'phro rgod mang po sdug pa mi bde ba sna tshogs 'byung ba la'ang dran pa dgos te/ dran pa med na mi bde ba de'i dbang du shor nas/ chos bar chad kyis khyer tshar/ 'bras bu kha thag ring bas/ der yang lar rtsub nyams tsam du shes par bya zhing*/ don du sems bde ba dang mi bde ba gnyis ka rang gi nyams tsam du thag bcad/ mi bde bar skyon du mi lta bar/ de nas 'phro rgod mang na mang ba de rang mi bde na mi bde ba de rang*/ sdug na sdug pa de rang gi rang ngo dran pas bzung nas gang shar de ka rang ngo rang shes su bskyangs na de nas rtsub nyams kyis gnod mi 'khyol/ mthar rang grol du 'gro bas gegs yon tan du thob bya ba'ang yod pa yin/ gzhan yang de bzhin sgom skyon bying rgod rmugs gsum la'ang 'dra/ der yang dran pa med na skyon de ka'i dbang du 'chor de min ched du bying rgod la skyon du ma bltas/

'phral rang nyams gsal mi gsal tsam du bsam nas bying rgod gar shar de ka ngos bzung la kho rang rang ngo sger du phud la dran pa dang bcas pas bskyangs na mthar de'i mu la mi sdod de skyon de dag nas yon tan zhig 'char 'ong bas/ des na sgom skyon la'ang dran pa gal che zhing*/ de ltar rtse gcig dus su'ang dran pa gal che ba yin/ dran pa legs po skyong shes na gegs dang gol shor med/ gegs dang gol shor yon tan du 'char nas bogs re re thon yong bas/ de ltar rnam dbye shes par bya dgos shing*// de nas bla ma mtshan ldan la mos gus rtse gcig gis gsol ba dus rnams kun tu 'debs shing*/ rang gi dran pa 'bad pas bskyangs na de nas nam zhig rang gi sgrib pa dag pa dang*/ bla ma'i byin rlabs zhugs nas/ sgom gzhan du med par rang gi sems su thag chod/ rang gi sems kyang rnam rtog thams cad dran par 'dres pas spang bya gnyen por shar/ gshis mdangs zhes sam/ dran pa rnam rtog zhes sam/ blta bya lta byed spang bya gnyen po zhes pa sogs ming so so don gcig yin pa de ltar go bas gnyis med du thag chod pa/ gshis ma yengs pa las gang shar yang mi bde ba med pa/ rang shar rang sar ngo shes rang grol du 'char bas blo gu yangs ser 'gro ba yin/ de bzhin sems ngo mthong na'ang da dung brtan pa ma thob pas brjed pa cung zad 'ong ba der yang dran pa gtso che ste dran pa ma yengs pa'i sgom med na dran pa yug gcig 'brel mi thub/ sgom sprin bar gyi nyi ma 'dra ba de kar sdod yong ste/ der ched du bsgom rgyu med pa'i ngang nas dran pa yengs med bsten te/ sgom med yengs med la rtsal bton na de nas dran pa'i bar 'brel te dran pa yug gcig tu 'gro/ rtsol med kyi dran pa zer ba'ang yod/ rtsol med kyi dran pa byung yang da dung rang ngo rgyun du gsal 'debs par dran pa gal che ste/ de med na rtog pa'i dri ma mi 'dag cing rjes thob rjes shes su 'chor/

sgom la bogs med/ der yang ched du dran pa bzo bcos gang yod de'ang rtogs pa'i ngo bo slar sgrib med gab med ther du bton nas rang ngo rjen pa de ka skyong*/ rang rtsal mos gus gsol 'debs sems bskyed snying rje dag snang zhe bcad dang*/ lhag tu yul snang rkyen thog tu sbyangs/ de ltar byas na sgom gzung 'dzin gyi dri ma dag /ma tshor bar rjes thob rjes shes su mi 'chor/ bla ma'i mos gus gsol 'debs sogs la'ang gnyis 'dzin kho na min pa'i bla ma rang sems su 'char/ mos gus gsol 'debs kyis rtogs pa'i dri ma sbyong ba las mi dgos pa 'byung*/ sems bskyed dag snang sogs kyang kun rdzob tsam min pa'i stong nyid snying rje don dam sems bskyed dag snang la sogs pa 'char/ snang ba yul rkyen dang 'dres pa'i zung 'jug rtogs pa'i sgom chen gsha' ma ste yang dag gi dran par 'gro ba yin pas de ltar nged rang sgom chen rnams kyis go ba dang nyan shes par byas nas nyams su len dgos par 'dug go /mdor na gnyen po bzung dran nas blo 'das dran pa'i bar gyi dran pa'i na 'pho ba la dran pa kho rang gi byed las su gtogs 'dug pas de ltar go bar mdzad nas rgyun du ma yengs mi bsgom la 'bad par mdzad dgos te/ blo gros 'byung gnas kyis zhus pa'i mdo las/ dran pa gang gis bdud kyis skabs mi rnyed pa dang*/ dran pa gang gis lam log par mi 'gyur ba dang*/ dran pa sgo lta bus sems la sems byung gi mi dge ba thams cad kyis skabs mi rnyed pa 'di ni yang dag pa'i dran pa'o zhes sogs mang du gsungs/ de bzhin tris sna paṇ+ḍi tas/ ngos bzung med par ngo sprad pas// stong pa nyid du nyams su myong*// dran pa'i mel tshes srung mkhas pas// 'khrul pa'i rkun mas glags ma rnyed// rgyun chad med par nyams blangs pas// 'du 'bral med par mngon du gyur// zhes gsungs pa ltar yin pa'o// sgom gyi phrin las snying rje la 'chol/

zhes gsungs pa 'dir rnam pa gnyis su yod de rang dang po'i dus nas/ 'gro don gyi sa bon 'debs pa dang*/ de nas rtogs pa shar nas kyang stong nyid kyi rtsal snying rjer 'don pa gnyis yin/ de la dang po 'gro don gyi sa bon 'debs pa ni/ sngon nas bshad pa'i sems bskyed de ka yin/ de'ang rang gis dang po dge ba'i mgo sgrub dus nas rang tshe 'di'i don du lta ci smos/ rang nyid gcig pu zhi bde 'dod pa nyan thos kyi lta ba yin pas de ltar mi byed/ ha ma go ba'i bsam pa mdo med kyang mi byed par/ theg chen gyi lta bas zin pa'i ngang nas rang gis dge ba byas pa dang chos sgrub pa'ang ma rgan sems can thams cad sangs rgyas kyi sa la 'god pa'i ched du/ rang gis myur du sangs rgyas g.yel ba med par bsgrub bsam pa'i byang chub kyi sems rin po che sngon du btang zhing*/ dngos gzhi dge ba'i dus su'ang sems can thams cad ma brjed pa dang*/ rjes nas kyang dge ba de thams cad kyi bsod nams sems can thams cad kyi don du bsngo ba de ltar 'bad pa byed dgos rgyu yin/ gzhan yang rgyun du sems can che chung thams cad la gnod sems skad cig kyang mi byed pa'i snying rje sbyangs nas phan thogs kyi bya ba ci 'grub byed cing*/ de min rang gis chos kyi bya ba mchod pa byed pa/ sbyin pa gtong ba/ lha rten bzhengs pa/ gsung rab klog pa sogs chos spyod kyi dge ba ci byed na'ang de'i sngon du sems can thams cad kyi don du bsam zhing rjes su'ang dge ba sems can thams cad kyi don du bsngo/ de ltar rigs 'gres nas mdor na 'dus byas dge ba lus ngag yid gsum gyi chos spyod thams cad sems can gyi don du bsam zhing dge ba bsngo ba de ltar byed dgos rgyu yin par 'dug /de ltar byas na phan yon dpag med yod par 'dug pa sems bskyed spyi'i phan yon dang 'dra mod/ khyad par du 'gro don gyi sa bon thebs pas rang 'bras bu thob sla zhing 'bras bu thob dus kyang 'gro don bla med rgya chen po yong ba yin te/

rje grub thob o rgyan pa'i zhal nas/ rang res shes rab snying po 'don shes tsam dang*/ rtsam pa chu sdor 'grub pa tsam gyi dus nas 'gro don gyi sa bon 'debs dgos/ de dus su sa bon ma btab par sems can yal bar dor na 'gro don gyi rten 'brel 'phyugs zhes gsungs 'dug pa de tshor bsam dgos/ de dag las dang po pa'i bsam pa sems bskyed lugs mdor bsdus pa yin/ nged rang sems kyi ngo bo stong nyid rtogs pa rnams kyis ni/ lar rgyal ba gong ma rnams kyi gsung 'ga' rer/ stong nyid gsha' ma rtogs na rang gis stong nyid rtogs pa'i mthus/ sems can thams cad la sangs rgyas rang la yod pa ngo ma shes pa 'khor bar 'khyams pa a re sdug bsam pa'i snying rje mi 'char pa mi srid/ snying rje de 'char ba'i dus nas sems bskyed bzang po lag tu lon pa zhig mi byed pa mi srid/ de nas des 'gro don rgya chen zhig mi 'grub pa mi srid/ ces gsungs 'dug ste/ de 'dra ba nged rang la dka' bar 'dug /stong nyid kyang gsha' ma rtogs pa dka' bar 'dug cing de'ang stong nyid phyogs re ba las snying rje zung du 'jug pa shin tu dka' bar 'dug mod/ sngon gyi gsung de rje gong ma khong rnams kyi thugs tshod la gsungs pa yin/ las can don gnyis 'grub pa'i smon lam can tsho la de 'dra los yong ste/ nged rang la de mi yong*/ de mi yong yang bskyur 'jog rgyu min/ rim gyis stong nyid snying rje'i snying por slob dgos pa yin/ 'gro don rgya chen po'i sa bon 'debs dgos pa yin/ der yang ji ltar byed na lar 'dir shin du mang*/ rje gtsang pa rgya ras kyi khyad chos rten 'brel kho bo lugs zhes pa'ang gtso bo 'dir dgongs te/ de bzhin drug gsum bco brgyad la sogs pa'i zhal gdams dang gzhan yang shin tu mang ste/ de rnams thams cad brjod pas gar long*/ don dag shin tu bsdus pa 'di bzhin yin/

de'ang rang res sems kyi ngo bo mthong yang de nas sems can la snying rje dge ba sems bskyed dang rgyun du nges can gyi rten 'brel bsgrigs pa sogs mi byed par smar gcig zong gcig rang ngo de ka skyong ba 'dra zhig byas nas bsdad na dge sbyor rang ngor yang rtsal chen por mi thon cing*/ lhag tu tshe 'dir sems can la phan thogs dang gzhan du'ang 'gro don rgya chen mi 'byung*/ rang sangs rgyas nyan thos la sogs nyan rang rnams la'ang stong nyid lta ba rnam par dag pa los yod de sems bskyed kyi gnad kyis ma zin pas gol/ nyan thos tshos kyang chos kyi bdag med gang zag bdag med sogs bdag med kyi don rnams los rtogs te sems bskyed dang snying rje med pas lam dman par gol ba yin mod/ de ltar skyon ngos bzung nas bsgrub bya ni/ rang gis dge sbyor ngo bo las ma g.yos pa de ka'i ngang nas sems can thams cad la snying rje sbyangs/ de'ang snying rje skye dka' na sems can thams cad rang gi pha ma drin can du bsam pa sogs snying rje skye ba'i thabs rnams bsam/ lhag tu bla ma la mos gus gsol 'debs kyis stong nyid snying rje dbyer med du 'byongs par byin gyis rlobs bsam pa'i smon lam dang gsol 'debs byed cing rang gis snying rje sbyangs/ lus ngag gi dge sbyor nyams len ci byed thams cad kyi sngon du snying rje sems bskyed/ dngos gzhi du'ang sems can thams cad ma brjed pa dper na bla ma la gsol ba 'debs na'ang rang dang sems can thams cad kyis mos gus kyis gsol ba 'debs par bsams shing bla ma'i byin rlabs kyang rang dang sems can thams cad la zhugs par bsam/ dpe des rigs 'gres nas lus ngag yid gsum gyis nyams len dge sbyor ci byed na'ang rang dang sems can thams cad khyad skad cig kyang mi byed par mnyam du bsgoms shing*/ de nas rjes su dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad kyang sems can thams cad kyi don du bsngo/
