rgyun du'ang sems snying rje dang ma bral ba'i sgo nas lag len sems can kun la phan ci thogs bya zhing chos spyod kyi dge ba ci byed na'ang*/ sngon du sems bskyed rjes su bsngo ba byed/ rang nyid sdug bsngal dang nad la sogs pas mi bde ba'i dus der rang gi sngon las su bsam zhing de thog tu khams gsum gyi sems can thams cad kyi nad dang sdug bsngal mi bde ba thams cad rang la 'dus par bsams shing*/ de rnams gnas skabs bde ba phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan par bsam/ de nas rang nyid kyi dge tshogs dus gsum du bsags pa ci mchis pa thams cad sems can rnams la phar btang bas dge tshogs de rnams sems can thams cad kyi rgyud thog tu smin te/ thams cad bla med byang chub kyi sa la 'khod par bsam/ de lta bu'i btang len ni rang la rkyen ngan byung dus tsam min pa'i dus nam yang nyin rer thang mang po'am tha na gnyis gsum sogs dam bca' lta bu byas nas gtong len dmigs pa bsam pa rnam dag de ltar bsgom/ rgyun du'ang sems can che phra kun la gnod 'tshe ngan sems byed pa lta ci smos/ rtsed mo'i ched du'ang mi byed/ gzhan la gnod 'tshe byed du'ang mi 'jug /gzhan gyis gnod 'tshe byas par rjes su yi rangs kyang mi bsgom/ rang gis sems can gyi srog blu ba la sogs nas bzung*/ tha na 'bu srin gcig gis gcig la gnod 'tshe dang chu la lhung ba la sogs pa'ang mthong ma thag 'don pa dang*/ shi ba sogs la snying rje smon lam rgya chen po byed pa ste/ sems can che phra thams cad la snying rje dang ma bral ba'i ngos nas dngos su phan thogs ci che/ 'bu srin sems can thams cad mthong tshad la snying rje sems bskyed kyis ma ṇi dang gzungs sngags sogs bsgrangs nas der 'debs pa// spyan ras gzigs la thugs rje bskul bas 'dren pa'i dmigs pa smon lam yan byed cing gal srid ma tshor bar shi ba sogs la 'dren pa'i dmigs pa bshags pa smon lam yag po byed dgos par 'dug

/der yang rang snying rje sems bskyed bzang po rgyun du mi lcogs mi mos pa sogs byung na rang gis rang la khrel 'ded cing sems can thams cad rang gi pha mar lan grangs mang por ma gyur pa gcig kyang med pa'i drin can rkyang pa la khyod 'dra ba bsam med blo ma rungs pa las ngan khrel med po khyod kyis de ltar ma shes shes kyang mi bsam par da khyod rang gi rang don gcig rang bsam 'dug ste/ khyod kyis rang don yang bsam pa'i gnad mi shes pas mi 'grub pa gnyis med seng ge zhig rang byed 'dug par bsam pa byed de/ lung las kyang*/ skye bo rmongs pas rang gi bde don gnyer// de ma thob pas rtag tu sdug bsngal rgyu// ston pas rtag tu gzhan don brtson pas ni// gnyis ka'i don du mya ngan 'das par gyur/ zhes gsungs yod pa de tshor bsam la/ de ltar sems bskyed snying rje las spros pa gzhan rang 'dod zhi bde skad cig kyang mi byed bsam pa'i zhe dam bcas te de nas sngon bzhin sems bskyed snying rje'i don la bslab/ bla ma la gsol ba 'debs/ rang stong nyid snying rje 'byongs pa dang*/ tshe rabs kun tu sems can kun la phan thogs yong ba dang khyad par bla med byang chub thob nas 'gro don rgya chen po yong bar shog bsam pa'i smon lam gsol 'debs byed/ rang gi dge sbyor gyi ngo bo rkyen lus ngag gi chos spyod dang 'dres phyin sos dal du mi sdod par sems can thams cad kyi don du dmigs pa'i lus ngag gi dge sbyor chos spyod la brtson 'grus chen po byed cing gtong len gyi dmigs pa 'ba' zhig sgom de ltar sems can rnams la snying rje sems bskyed la bslab cing*/ de nas kyang skabs su rang sems dang sems can gnyis med kyi klong du mnyam par bzhag /de bzhin dus kun la 'bad na/ de nas nam zhig bla ma'i byin rlabs kyi stobs dang rang gi dge ba'i dbang gis stong nyid snying rje dbyer med du rtogs yong ba yin tshod 'dug

/stong nyid snying rje de ltar rtogs na ni rang tshod kyi 'bras bu yag po zhig yin par 'dug /tshe 'dir sgom chen pho hreng zhes rang gcig pu min pa'i gzhan don slob ma 'ong ba dang*/ tshe rabs kun tu gzhan don dpag med 'grub pa yin par 'dug /'dir yang gol sa nor sa yod de/ de ni stong nyid snying rje tsam rtogs kyang rang 'dod kyi 'khri ba ma zad cing stong nyid snying rje klong du ma gyur bar du dngos su 'gro don byed rgyu min par 'dug ste/ de'ang 'dir snying rje sbyangs pas snying rje cung zad cig shar nas da mi phan par 'dug /sems can la phan btags dgos 'dug bsams nas/ phan thogs cher mi yong bzhin e yong bltas na ni/ de ha ma go na snying rje dgrar langs kyi 'phrang zhes sgom gyi gegs la 'phrang lnga yod pa'i gcig de yin pas/ de ltar mi byed de/ rje rgyal ba gong ma rnams kyis/ lkog tu smon lam 'debs pa 'di// 'gro don phal gyis do zla min// gsungs pa de yid la bzhag nas/ da dung snying rje'i rtsal sbyong*/ sems bskyed kyi gzhi bzung nas/ rtogs pa skyong zhing smon lam 'debs/ zhes gsungs pa de blo la nges par byas nas/ rtab rtabs su blo chung mi byed par yin bzhin stong nyid snying rje dang ma bral ba'i rtsal sbyong*/ stong nyid snying rje'i klong du phebs pa zhig dgos rgyu yin 'dug /nang du rang don mngon du gyur nas gzhan don dus la bab na/ da 'gro don ran zer phar 'gro dgos pa min par 'dug /tshur gdul bya thams cad rtsol med du 'dus yong ba yin par 'dug /de nas bla ma dkon mchog yi dam mkha' 'gros kyang lung ston pa yin par 'dug /de ltar min pa'i 'phral blo chung ni gol sa yin par 'dug /lar sems can gyi 'gro don rgya chen po zhig la bsam pa rtse gcig byed pa las 'phral gyi bsam pa med pa zhig dgos par 'dug /'phral rang tshe 'di lta bu zhig la gzhan dang mi 'dra ba'i 'gro don zhig e 'ong bsam na de ni rang 'dod kha rkyang yin pas/

de lta'i rang 'dod de ma zad bar du 'gro don gsha' ma rang de 'grub rgyu min par 'dug /rang 'dod kyi rnyed tshol 'gro don du ming btags pa ni/ mi ltogs gla e rnyed la 'gro ba bzhin phar nyug nyug nas 'gro ba de ni chos dang rgyab 'gal ya re cha/ rang don 'grub nas gzhan don dus bab rgyal po rgyal sar bzhugs pa bzhin tshur rub rub 'dus pa zhig dgos pa yin tshod 'dug go /'di tsho la tshig gam sgra phar tshur gzhan du 'gyur 'gro dogs yod de// de yang rgyal ba gong ma rnams 'ga' re phar 'gro don du phebs pa dang*/ de bzhin da ltar yang bla ma sangs rgyas rnam pa tsho phar 'gro don du byon nas/ sems can 'brel tshad don ldan mdzad pa mang po 'dug pa de ni mchog yin/ don du sangs rgyas rnams rang 'dod med kyang sems can rnams las ngan pas tshur thams cad 'dus dka' ba der thugs rjes gzigs nas/ sku ngal ba khyad du bsad bzhin byon nas sems can dpag tu med pa 'brel tshad don ldan chen po mdzad pa de ni gzhan zhi bde sos dal du bsgur sdod pa las ches khyad par du 'phags pa'i sangs rgyas byang sems chen po'i mdzad pa yin 'dug /de ni bstod pa'i yul phyag gi gnas mchod pa'i rten yin/ de min rang don ma 'grub gzhan don ma ran kyang*/ rang 'dod kyis kun nas bslangs pa'i 'gro 'gro bya byed mang po de ni don dag med la don dag med pa tsam du ma zad 'bras bu sdug bsngal yang yong ba de spang dgos zer rgyu yin/ yang rang don mngon du ma gyur gzhan don dus la ma bab kyang rang 'dod rang ni min zhing dge bskul sogs phan btags bsam nas 'gro ba zhig 'ong ba der yang rang 'dod cher med cing gzhan don bsam pas de'ang legs po los yin te/ chos kyi byed lugs shig yin yang*/ nged rang nges don sgrub brgyud gong ma'i rnam thar skyong na da dung de'ang cung zad ma yin te/ de'i don rang gis sems can gyi don rgya chen nus pa zhig byung na dang sems can grol bar byed rgyu thabs mi chags pas 'phral du de ltar mi byed par rang smin du 'jug

/de nas 'gro don rgya chen po tshad med pa byed pa yin te// tshe 'dir ma 'grub kyang tshe rabs gzhan du 'khor ba stong dogs med pas na ga ler byed pas chog 'dug go /mdor na rang gzhan gyi don gang byed kyang chos bzhin lam du 'gro mi 'gro'i rtsa ba thams cad rang 'dod zer ba 'dis byed 'dug pas/ rang 'dod zhugs tshad 'khor ba'i g.yos sbyor yin zhing*/ rang 'dod med na ci byas chos su 'gro ste/ de bas na 'khor 'das gnyis kyi bsgyur so'ang rang 'dod 'dis byed par 'dug pas gang la'ang rang 'dod ma zhugs pa zhig ci nas kyang gal che'o// de ltar dang po sgom gyi phrin las snying rje la 'chol zer ba de nas bzung 'phros su'ang sems bskyed snying rje sbyong tshul dang 'gro don ran tshod sogs mdor bsdus bshad pa'o// gzhan yang de'i 'phros la/ stong nyid legs par rtogs pas thams cad rang mdangs gnyis med du thag chod rtsal 'byongs pa yin na de mi dgos kyang*/ gzhan ni mos gus dang snying rje dang sems bskyed dag snang sogs kyang lam du slong ba dgos gal du che ba ste/ de la'ang las dang po pas mos gus chen po sems kyis mi bzod pa lta bu mig nas mchi ma rang dbang med par 'chor ba lus sems rtse zing nge tshugs mi thub pa la sogs pa gdung shugs drag po de ltar byung yang*/ de dus nas rang gi dge sbyor rang ngo rang tsho 'dzin pa gal che/ rang gi rtogs pa'i rang ngo mos gus gdung shugs de'i dbang du phar song na des byin rlabs kyi rten 'brel dum tsam 'phyugs pas/ de ltar min pa'i mos gus gdung shugs che bzhin rang gi rtogs pa'i ngo bo'ang gsal btab ste mos gus gdung shugs de rtogs pa'i ngo bor tshur 'dus par byas na des bla ma dkon mchog thams cad rang dbang du 'dus nas byin rlabs kyi tshan kha rdol ba'i rten 'brel chen po yod pa yin pas de bzhin go dgos/ yang mos gus gdung shugs byung na de'i dbang du mi gtong bsam pa'i gnyen po lta bu zhig brten nas de dgag pa 'dra byed rgyu min te/

phag sna ru rdo mi brdeg /zhes gsungs/ 'di la nor sa yod de/ deng mos gus gdung shugs byung na dang po kho rang ji tsam byung ba bskyed/ de bas cher bskyed rgyu sogs 'dug na'ang bskyed/ de nas mos gus gdung shugs de ka rang ngo rang shes su 'jog pa yin pas/ de ltar gnad go dgos/ dpe des mtshon nas snying rje la sogs par yang sems can dman pa sdug bsngal gyis nyam thag pa sogs mthong ba'i rkyen gyis sems kyis mi bzod pa lta bu 'ong ba de ltar byung na dang po nas sna mi bskyil bar gang che che bskyed cing de nas snying rje de'i shed rdzogs pa dang rang ngo rang shes su 'jog dgos te/ de bzhin dag snang sbyangs rgyu 'di la'ang don rang sems ngo bo ma yengs pa bzo bcos med pa'i thog de nas rang mdangs thams cad bla mar bsgom pa'i nges shes dang mos gus byed dgos rgyu yin te/ 'di la bzang rtog lam slong zer/ mos gus snying rje 'di lam du ma bslangs par de'i dbang du shor na 'gro don gyi rten 'brel cung zad 'phyugs nas/ des 'gro don 'ongs kyang de tshur dbang du mi 'dus par 'gro don phar snyog par 'gro dgos pa zhig yong ba yin cing*/ rang ngo'i thog tu tshur 'dus na 'gro don phar bsnyag mi dgos par/ tshur shugs kyis 'dus pa zhig 'ong ba yin 'dug go /de bzhin dag snang la'ang 'dra/ don phar dbang du shor na gzhan thams cad kyis rang la dag snang tsam yong yang rtsol med rang ni yong dka' ba dang*/ tshur dbang du 'dus na rtsol med kyis yong ba yin par 'dug /'di dag gi gnad go bar mdzad dgos pa'o// sgom gyi skyong lugs ngo tsha la 'chol/ zhes gsungs pa de ni rje lha rtse pa'i tshogs chos mno 'khor ma nas/ 'phral du mos gus che la rting gdong pa chung na mthar dam nyams su 'chor nyen yod/ ces pa'i gdong pa chung ba ci lags zhus par/ gdong ba chung ba bya ba ngo tsha dang khrel med pa la zer bas/

chos pa bya ba ngo tsha shes pa gal che zhing*/ chos mthar mi phyin pa thams cad ngo tsha med pas lan gsungs/ ngo tsha med pa'i rgyu rkyen gang lags zhus par/ rgyu 'dod pa yin/ 'dod pas ngo tsha bsgribs zer ba'i gtam de ma gsan nam/ rkyen la nges pa med phal cher chang gis byas pa mang*/ byas shes drin du mi gzo ba de khrel med pa yin te/ byas pa shes shing byas pa gzo ba/ byas pa chud zos su mi gtong ba'i mi la dpal mgon nye bar gnas/ zhes dpal phag mo gru pas gsungs so// zhes gsungs/ spyir chos mdzad yongs kyang yin te/ de'ang rang gis chos sgrub pa/ sdom pa dam tshig srung ba thams cad la/ lar phyi yi grogs mched sogs gzhan gyis ma khrel ba zhig los dgos te/ khyad par ni de'ang gzhan gyis ma mthong bas chog par brtsi ba de la ngos lkog can gyi zog po zer ba ste des mi yong bas/ nang du rang sems dpang por bzhag ste/ rang gis rang la bsams kyang ma khrel ba zhig byed dgos shing*/ yang dgos ni/ da lta nged rang 'ga' res mi las bla ma dkon mchog lod pa 'dra 'drar brtsi ste/ chos min gyi bya ba zhig byed na de mi la 'dzem mod/ bla ma dkon mchog ye shes spyan ldan dbyings nas gzigs mkhan la ji mi snyam par byed mkhan de 'dra ni zhe re khrel bsam pa go log nyams mtshar/ mi las gnyan tsam sems can las che tsam/ mi tha mal pa las 'jigs tsam zhig dang mang tsam zhig gis sgrib med sa ler gzigs ci byas tha ler mkhyen 'gro bas/ nged rang gis byung na dang bla ma dkon mchog ye shes spyan ldan rnams la dogs zon re 'jog nas bya ba 'chol par mi spyod cing*/ gal srid phra ba re re tsam byung na de'ang gzigs yod dgongs yod bsam pa'i 'gyod pa zhed po dang bcas bshags sdom byed dgos pa 'dra zhig ni 'dug 'di'i don rang ni nged rang sgom chen rnams dang por dben pa brten nas sgrub pas nyams rtogs shar yang de nas de mthar mi 'don par rang sems 'jig rten chos brgyad kyis kun nas bslangs pa'i 'dir snang sgrub blo de las ngan langs pa'i bar chad dam gzhan yang bdud kyi g.yo thabs sogs bar chad la ngos ma zin na zad med cig 'ong bas gang byung ba de'i dbang du btang ste/

de bas kyang 'tshubs 'khyil le btang na lha mi bla ma la ngo tsha bas de 'dra mi byed par/ nyams rtogs mthar ma thon gyi bar ram/ khyad par sgom tshe shi dang mnyam par byed pa'i dam bca' lta bu zhig bzung nas/ rje gong ma rnams kyi rnam thar la bsam/ mig 'phang yar btegs te/ tshe 'dir snang sgrub blo skad cig kyang mi byed par/ dben pa'i ri la 'dug /de'ang mdo med du skad cig kyang mi sdod par bya/ bsdad na ngas dben pa brten pa don go chung*/ bla ma dkon mchog la ngo tsha bsam ste/ de'ang rten 'brel rnams nas/ phyi dben pa'i gnas/ nang bsam gtan gyi khang bu/ gsang ba lus gnad/ de kho na nyid gnas lugs kyi steng du rkyen gang gis kyang g.yo ba med par chu bo'i rgyun gyi rnal 'byor zhes gsungs 'dug pa de ltar 'bad dgos rgyu yin par 'dug /de ltar byas na sgrub pa'i lag rjes rtogs pa la rim gyis bogs thon yong ba yin/ de min dang po sgrub pa byas pa de dus tha ma nyams/ rab rtogs pa shar ba tsam byung ste/ de'ang rang ngo ma yengs tsam du skyong bde ba tsam zhig byung yang phyin chad nas/ de yang spom me yo re/ blo sna ngang ring nge*/ brtson 'grus zhan ting nge ba zhig byas pas/ sems kyi ngo bo la bogs thon rgyu med cing*/ bogs mi thon pa ma tshad de ka'ang dri ma ma sbyangs par slar sdug tu 'gro ste/ sgom skyes bdag po med par 'jog pa de 'drar song na gyong che ste/ rje rgya ras kyis/ sgom skyes bdag po med pa ni// phyug po rlung gis khyer ba 'dra// seng ge khyi yi zla la shor// nor bu rin chen 'dam du bying*// zhes dang*/ des na sgom la bdag po gces// zhes sogs gsungs/ rje lha rtse bas/ nged rang gi rtogs ldan rnying pa 'di tsho ni sgom la yar skyed kyi skad cha khyer yong rgyu chen po rang mi 'dug pas bem po rnying du song ba 'dra zhig yin pa 'dra/ sgom la yar skyed med na rtogs ldan rnying pa snying med yin zhes gsungs pa de lta 'i bka' bkyon mi phog pa'i thabs nged rang gis byed dgos te/

rje o rgyan pas/ nged rang dag sgom chen rnams lo grangs dang khyad par dbyar dgun ston dpyid so sor/ da res 'di ltar brtson 'grus byed de dge sbyor ngo bo na 'di tsam 'phar ba zhig byed bsam pa dgos gsungs pa de bzhin nged rang gis kyang lo zla ba song bzhin stong zad je sdug tu mi gtong bar phyi ru lo zla song bzhin de tshod kyis nang du rang gi rtogs pa yar skyed 'ong ba la rang yid ches blo tshims/ sgrub pa byas pa'i lag rjes/ mi gzhan mched grogs dang bla ma dkon mchog la ngo mi tsha ba tsam zhig byed dgos pa'o// bzhi pa skye med zang thal du la bzla ba bshad pa la/ dang po la bzla'i ming don/ gnyis pa la bzla'i dus tshod/ gsum pa la bzla'i gshis kyi gnas lugs/ bzhi pa la bzla rgyu'i sems kyi ngo bo lta ba/ lnga pa skye med zang thal du la bzla ba dngos/ drug pa de la nyin mtshan khor yug tu bsre ba/ bdun pa la bzla'i dgos pa bshad pa'o// 'di rnams spros na shin tu mang yang mdo tsam du bsdu ba'i// dang po ming don ni/ la bzla zhes pa som nyi mi za bar blo thag gcod pa'am/ rang gi sems skye 'gags gnas gsum dang dus gsum la sogs pa'i spros pa bcad de/ skye med blo 'das kyi dbyings su skyel ba'i don yin te/ til+li pas/ yid la ci yang mi byed la bzla'i chos la ltos// zhes dang*/ bram ze chen pos/ gdod nas ma skyes rang bzhin yin pa la// de ring dpal ldan bla mas bstan pas rtogs// zhes dang*/ sha wa ris/ 'di ltar dus gsum rnam pa thams cad du// yid la byar med mtha' bral gnyug ma'i ngang*// zhes dang*/ mai tri pas/ chos kun mkha' 'dra mnyam gnas la// phyag rgya che zhes brjod pa yin// zhes sogs kyis bstan cing sgrub brgyud 'dir yang*/ mnyam med dwags po'i gab pa mngon phyung gi man ngag la sogs pa'i dgongs pa yin/ la bzla'i dmigs rim ni phyis sgrub brgyud pa rnams kyis rnam grangs du mar gsungs pa'o// gnyis pa la bzla ba'i dus tshod ni/

sgrub pa po bde gsal mi rtog pa'i nyams myong mthug po dag nas rig pa gsal dwangs thon te/ gsal stong nam mkha' lta bu'i sgom khor yug tu song ba'i dus sam/ nyin snang shas cher nyams de'i khongs su 'gro zhing*/ rtog pa 'gyu thog tu dran pas nam zin 'gyu ba stong gsal stong 'gyur 'char la tshogs drug gi yul snang gi thog tu dran pas nam zin snang ba stong snang du sa ler 'char ba ste/ mdor na rtogs pa dang snang ba thams cad gsal stong snang stong sgyu ma lta bu'i nyams myong dang nges shes thag chod skyes pa de'i tshe la bzla ba yin la/ de las la bzla ba sngas na ni/ rang gi rig thog tu nyams myong nges shes dang bcas pa'i rkang mi tshugs shing*/ go yul tsam la brten nas/ chos kyis dred pas stong skad kyi kha ta mtho ba zhig yong*/ des blo 'chol te rang yang 'khrul rlom gyi dbang du 'gro la gzhan gyis kyang rtogs pa dang ldan pa mthong ba 'byung yang*/ de ni dred po chos rgyus mkhan phyi ldir nang stong khang stong sgo lcags can lta bur gsungs pas/ don thog tu rtag mi thub cing rang bslu bar 'gyur ro// ha cang phyis nas la bzla ma shes na/ skal ldan las 'phro can dag rang sems dang rang snang slob dpon du shar te nyams myong gi zhen 'dzin rang dag la song nas grol ba thob par 'gyur yang*/ phal cher rang gi nyams myong la bzang rtog nges shes kyi 'dzin pa cher song nas/ sgom chen myong ba'i rtsi la 'byar ba zhes bya ba'i gol sar lhung ba yin te/ rje rgya ras kyis/ sgom shes mang ste bshig shes nyung*// zhes pa ltar ro// de ltar na la bzla ba'i man ngag 'di ni las 'phro can cig car du grol ba'i thabs dang*/ gzhan dag kyang rnal 'byor bzhi'i 'og ma 'og ma nas gong ma gong mar bogs 'don cing*/ dge sbyor na spar ba'i man ngag khyad par can yin la/ gnyug ma rab rib can gyis lo mang du bsgom dgos pa'i nyams len don thob zhag 'ga' tsam na 'byung ba'i yon tan ches cher bshad do// gsum pa la bzla'i gshis kyi gnas lugs ni/

chos thams cad kyi gzhi'i gnas lugs skye ba med pa de nyid yin la/ de ni sngar sems kyi ngo bo'am rang bzhin gtan la phab pa'i skabs su brjod zin kyang*/ 'dir yang cung zad bshad na/ srid zhis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad ni rang sems kyi snang ba 'ba' zhig yin la/ rang sems kyi ngo bo'am/ rang bzhin nam gshis lugs ni/ dngos po dang dngos med snang ba dang stong pa yod pa dang med pa la sogs pa gang gi'ang ngo bo nyid du ma skyes pa/ gzung 'dzin la sogs pa'i mtshan ma thams cad dang bral ba/ 'pho 'gyur 'gro 'ong la sogs kyis g.yo ba med pa/ dus gsum du 'gyur ba med pas rgyun mi 'chad pa/ nam mkha' ltar cis kyang mi gos shing mi 'gyur ba zhig yin te/ mda' bsnun zhabs kyis/ lhan cig skyes pa'i rang bzhin de nyid ni// dngos dang dngos po med pa ma yin zhes// mda' bsnun 'o dod rtag tu 'bod par byed// ces dang*/ bi rū pas/ sems nyid ming stong spros bral phyag rgya chen po ste// nam mkha'i rang bzhin gdod nas mi stong yin dang mtshungs// ngo bo nyid kyis ma skyes mtshan ma'i dngos dang bral// mkha' ltar kun la khyab cing 'pho dang 'gyur ba med// dus rnams kun tu stong zhing ye nas bdag med do// zhes so/ de yang glo bur du de ltar gyur pa ma yin par sems kyi gshis ye nas de ltar du gnas shing 'gyur ba med pa zhig yin te/ dper na nam mkha' stong mi stong la sogs par tha snyad btags kyang nam mkha'i rang bzhin 'di 'dra zhes sus kyang brjod du med pa ltar te/ de skad du'ang*/ til+li pas/ dper na nam mkha' stong par tha snyad rab btags kyang*// nam mkha' la ni 'di 'dra brjod du med// de bzhin rang sems 'od gsal brjod gyur kyang*// 'di 'drar grub ces tha snyad gdags gzhi med// de ltar sems kyi rang bzhin gdod nas nam mkha' 'dra// zhes so// des na sems dang sems las shar ba'i chos thams cad gdod ma nas rang bzhin med pas skye 'gags gnas gsum dang bral zhing dran yengs la sogs pas thob shor dang 'pho 'gyur mi nus pa skye med zang thal chen po zhig yin te/

sha wa ris/ sems yod gyur na chos kun yod rig ste// sems med pa la chos shig su yis rtogs// sems dang chos su snang ba thams cad pa// btsal na mi rnyed tshol mkhan gang na'ang med// med pas dus gsum ma skyes mi 'gags pa// de nyid gzhan du 'gyur ba med pa ni// rang bzhin bde ba chen po'i gnas lugs yin// zhes gsungs pa bzhin yin pa'o/// / ༈ bzhi pa la bzla rgyu'i sems kyi ngo bo lta ba la/ rtogs pa dang snang ba'i ngo bo lta ba dang*/ bsgom bya dang sgom byed kyi ngo bo lta ba gnyis kyi// dang po rtogs pa dang snang ba'i ngo bo lta ba ni/ spyir lam 'di byin rlabs kyi lam yin pas/ bla ma la mos gus kyi shugs bskyed dgos pa dang*/ khyad par sgom gyi bogs 'don mos gus la brten nas 'byung bar don brgyud rin po che'i bzhed srol te/ brtag gnyis las/ 'di ni byin rlabs rim pa'i phyir// kun mkhyen ye shes de lta bu// zhes dang*// gzhan gyis brjod min lhan cig skyes// gang du yang ni mi rnyed de// bla mas dus thabs bstan pa dang*// rang gi bsod nams las shes bya// zhes dang*/ byams pas/ rang byung rnams kyi don dam de// dad pa kho na'i rtogs bya yin// zhes mdo rgyud gsar rnying bstan bcos mtha' dag nas brjod kyis mi langs par bstan pa bzhin/ mos gus byin rlabs kho na'i byed las la rag las pa ste/ skabs 'dir dge sbyor ci rigs tsam dang khyad par bla ma'i rnal 'byor la brtson zhing bla ma la chos sku'i mos gus bskyed nas snang srid chos skur rtogs par gsol ba drag tu 'debs pa sngon du 'gro bas sngar bshad pa ltar ngo bo'i bzhag thabs kyi mnyam bzhag rtse gcig tu skyong ste rig pa dwangs snyigs phyed par byas la/ de nas rig pa ma yengs shing 'di bsgom gyi gtad so med par sems gu yangs seng nge ba'i ngang nas/ yid la bde dogs cher mi 'byung ba'i rnam rtog phra mo shar ba'am ched du spros te/

de'i rnam pa gsal bzhin pa'i ngang nas ngo bo la 'dzin med yengs med ce re lta/ de bzhin du yid la dga' mi dga'i zug rngu bskyed pa'i rnam rtog phra rags mngon mtshan che ba shar ba'am ched du spros te/ phra rags de gnyis kyi ngo bo la khyad par ci 'dug yang yang lta/ de la sgro 'dogs chod na de dag dang sems gnas dus kyis ngo bo la khyad par ci 'dug lta/ de bzhin du bde sdug la sogs pa'i chos brgyad dang*/ 'dod chags la sogs pa nyon mongs pa'i rnam par rtog pa rnam grangs mang po zhig la lta/ res rtog pa dgag res mang du spro// res rtog pa'i rgyun rkyang ded bya ba sogs sna tshogs pa byas nas so so'i ngo bor lta bar byas te sgro 'dogs bcad/ de bzhin du phyi rol gyi yul snang rnams la'ang brtag par bya ste/ gzugs mdzes mi mdzes che chung kha dog dbyibs la sogs pa mi 'dra ba du ma dang*/ sgra snyan mi snyan che chung 'gyur khugs la sogs pa'i rnam grangs mang po dang*/ lus kyi rnam 'gyur sna tshogs dang mig 'byed 'dzum g.yas lta g.yon lta la sogs pa'i sgo nas snang ba 'char lugs mi 'dra ba sna tshogs pa 'ong bar byas te/ de dag gi ngo bo dang sems kyi ngo bo la khyad par ci 'dug lta ba rnams dmigs pa so sor phral te zhag 'gar sgro 'dogs gcod do// de ltar byas pa'i don thob ni/ rtog pa dang snang ba'i 'char sgo ci shar yang*/ de dag dgag mi dgos par rnam pa gsal bzhin du ngo bo ngos bzung med pa gsal stong snang stong rang rig nyag gcig tu blo thag chod pa zhig dgos te/ de'i don ni sngar rnam rtog dang snang ba lhan skyes ngo sprod kyi skabs su bshad zin la/ 'dir yang bram ze chen pos/ gdong du bab pa 'di ltar snang ba kun// khyod kyis rtsa ba stong pa nyid dang lhan cig byos// zhes dang*/ bir wa pas/ dran rtog mtshan ma med de smig rgyu'i chu bo ltar// ma bcings ma grol gnyug ma'i ngang las ma g.yos so// zhes dang*/

mai tri pas/ ma skyes pa la rtog pa glo bur ba// rtog pa de nyid dbyings kyi ngo bor gnas// zhes dang*/ sna tshogs snang ba sems kyi ngo bo 'di// thug phrad tsam gyis ma grub phyag rgya che// zhes gsungs pa ltar ro// gnyis pa bsgom bya dang sgom byed kyi ngo bo lta ba ni/ 'dir bsgom par bya rgyu ni rang sems kyi ngo thog de yin la de skye 'gags gnas gsum dang bral zhing ngos bzung med pa'i blo 'das shig yin snyam pa'i yid byed dang go ba tsam blo la nges pas mi chog par/ de nyid 'phral mar nyams myong gi thog tu rnal 'byor mngon sum tshul gyis sgro 'dogs gcod dgos pas/ de la sngar bzhin du rig pa ma yengs shing gu yangs sang nge ba'i ngang nas bsgom par bya dgos rgyu'i don gyi ngo bo de la yengs med 'dzin med du ce re lhang nger bltas la ji ltar 'dug yang yang lta/ de bzhin sgom par byed mkhan gyi shes pa'i ngo bo la ce re bltas pas de gnyis la phan tshun nam/ phyi nang lta bu'am/ gnyis snang 'dug na sgro 'dogs ma chod pa yin pas slar yang legs par brtags te/ mdor na bsgom par bya rgyu dang sgom par byed mkhan tha mi dad cing dbyer med pa'i dran rig sgyu ma lta bu zhig tu snang ba dang*/ dran rig de'ang ming tsam du btags pa las/ don la ngos gzung rgyu dang mtshon gzhi spu rtse tsam yang med pa'i ye stong phyal ba nyid du blo thag chod dgos shing de ltar sgro 'dogs chod pa na de bzhin dus gsum gyi shes pa la khyad par ci 'dug lta ste/ de'ang 'das pa'i sems gar song*/ ma 'ong pa'i sems gang las byung*/ da lta'i sems ji ltar 'dug bltas pas dus gsum gyi sems skye 'gags gnas gsum lta bur mthong na/ skabs don la phrig ma tshud pa yin pas slar yang legs par brtags te/ rang bzhin ngos bzung med cing rgyun chad ma myong bas dus gsum du dbyer med pa/ nam mkha' ltar dus thams cad par zang thal nyag gcig tu blo thag chod dgos so// de bzhin du nga'o bdag go snyam pa'i 'dzin mkhan dang*/

gzhan no pha rol lo snyam du 'dzin mkhan gyi shes pa gnyis la'ang brtag par bya ste/ de'ang phyin nang ngam phan tshun lta bu'i gnyis snang 'char na sgro 'dogs ma chod pa yin pas slar yang legs par brtags nas/ thams cad kyang sems nyid gdod ma nas gzhi med rtsa bral/ zla med gcig pu/ rang byung rang grol/ dngos med phyal pa nyid du blo thag chod dgos shing*/ de ltar bsgom bya sgom byed dus gsum gyi shes pa dang*/ bdag gzhan gnyis snang gi shes pa thams cad kyang ming so so dang blos so sor brtags pa tsam las rgyud tha mi dad par ngo bo cir yang ma grub kyang rkyen gyis cir yang 'char ba'i sems nyid sgyu ma lta bu/ ngo bo la 'khrul grol med pa/ skyon yon gyis ma gos pa/ thob shor dang 'du 'bral med pa zhig tu blo thag bcad nas/ zhag 'gar ched 'dzin dang dgag sgrub med par gang shar rang babs lhug pa bzo med bcos med du bskyang nas thag chod kyi nges shes bskyed par bya ste/ bram ze chen pos/ kye ma rang bzhin bral bas de nyid bsgom du yod ma zer// gal te bsgom par bya dang sgom byed gnyis rtog na// gnyis su 'dzin pa'i yid kyis byang chub sems spangs pas// skyes bu des ni rang gis rang la sdig pa byas// zhes dang*/ sgom dang bsgom bya med pa'i sems ni rang bzhin bral// re dogs med pa'i mthar thug pa ni rdo rje sems// zhes dang*/ bir wa pas/ sems kyi chos nyid klong na 'di yin med pas na// de la sgom dang bsgom par bya ba gnyis su med// ces dang*/ mthong bya mthong byed bral bas tha dad rang sar grol// nyams su len mkhan stor bas rtsol sgrub kun dang bral// 'thob bya'i 'bras bu stor bas re dogs kun las grol// nga bdag rtsad nas thon pas bdud kyi g.yul las rgyal// dngos 'dzin rang sar zhig pas 'khor 'das kun las grol// zhes pa la sogs pa'i don yin no// lnga pa skye med zang thal du la bzla ba dngos ni/

gong du bshad pa de dag la nges shes thag chod pa skyes na/ de nas bsgom par bya tshul nges shes kyi 'dzin pa bshig /sgom par byed mkhan gyi dran pa glod/ de bzhin du nyams su myong bya la zhe 'dod btang*/ nyams su myong byed kyi 'bad rtsol dor/ rtogs par bya rgyu'i don blos btang*/ rtogs par byed mkhan gyi yid zhi bar byas te/ mdor na 'di'o snyam pa'i 'du shes dang*/ 'di ltar snyam pa'i yid kyi 'du byed thams cad dor/ bsgom 'dod dran 'dod myong 'dod rig 'dod la sogs pa'i zhe 'dod thams cad ling nger bskyur/ gang yang yid la mi byed snyam pa'i 'dun pa'ang mi bya bar/ rang ga tha mal gyi sems bzo med bcos med gnyer med rang yan de kar ci bder sdod/ rtog pa dang snang ba rang ga ma ci shar yang de la dgag sgrub kyi blos bzo bcos dang bsgyur bkod ci'ang mi bya bar gang dgar btang*/ yid byed kyi rjes su mi 'brangs par/ sems dum re yengs pa'i tshe de la sems khral dang skyon du lta ba dang brtag gzhig kyang mi bya/ dran pa'i tshe bsgom rgyu myong rgyu bya rgyu sogs gang yang med pa'i tha mal ma bcos pa de kar bskyur/ za 'chag nyal gsum la'ang 'di bya 'di byed kyi 'du shes dang 'du byed kyi blo rags pas mi byed par blo bral gyi ngang nas ci nus bya/ de las gzhan pa'i lus kyis bya ba dang las ka gang yang mi byed/ gtor ma dang gsol 'debs nyung zad tsam re ma gtogs gzhan kha ton dang dge sbyor thams cad bzhag la smra ba bcad/ nyal ba'i tshe zhe 'dod ci'ang med pa'i tha mal bcos med zang mar nyal/ de ltar yid byed thams cad blos btang nas zhag 'ga'i bar du rang gar bsdad pas nyams myong bzang ba la chags zhen dang dga' tshor gyi 'dzin pa grol/ ngan rtog 'khrul pa la skyon 'dzin dang ko long zhi nas/ tha mal gyi sems gang 'dug ci byung ci shar de ka sgom gyi rang bzhin stong pa'i rnam 'gyur don la skye 'gags med pa/

bral thob med pa/ spang blang med pa/ sems yengs ma yengs dang*/ dran pas zin ma zin dang*/ nyams su myong ma myong dang*/ don rtogs ma rtogs med par/ snang srid thams cad blo yul du shar ba'i tshe rang shar rang byung*/ nub pa'i tshe rang zhi rang grol/ zla med gcig pu zang thal/ thams cad sgom gyi rang bzhin/ sgom gyi khor yug sgom las ma 'das par blo thag chod pa'i nges shes skye ba zhig dgos so// skabs 'dir 'ga' zhig la ha cang yid byed bkag drags pa la brten nas/ zhi gnas lteng por 'khor ba dang*/ la la des rlung sems nang du 'thum ste/ nyams snang mi bde zhing sems gu dog pa'i sdug bsngal 'byung ste/ de la ni skyo sangs ci rigs bya zhing yid kyi 'char sgo'ang re zhig ci bder btang la ngal bsos te bya'o// myong ba skyon med skyes na de la zhag 'ga'i bar 'byams su bcug cing skabs re tsam sgom min pa'i sems dang gnas skabs 'dug gam lta/ de la yengs pa dang gnyid la sogs pa sgom min par shes na/ sgom min pa de dag gi ngo bo dang rang bzhin la slar brtag ste de dag gi gnas lugs rig par bya ste/ don 'di dag tu bram ze chen pos/ bya ba byed pa'i yid ni gang du'ang ma btsal na// yon tan btsal mi dgos shing de yi mi mthun bral// rgyud dang bstan bcos kun las de nyid rnyed min pas// zhe 'dod med pa'i sems la rgyu yi dri ma bral// zhes dang*/ sha wa ris/ 'khor ba mya ngan 'das pa'i chos rnams kun// de nyid mthong bas rang bzhin med pa'i phyir/ re dang dogs pa'i bsam pa zad gyur pas// spang dang blang ba'i 'bad rtsol ci byar yod// ces dang*/ bir wa pas/ rtogs bya rtogs byed med pas phyogs ris mtha' dang bral// bral dang ma bral med pas mnyam nyid gnyug ma'i ngang*// de ltar nges par rtogs na gzhan la dri rgyu med// sna tshogs chos skur gsal bas spang len sems mi 'byung*// sgom dang mi sgom med pas mtshan mas gos pa med/

snang dang mi snang yul la nam yang brten mi byed// bya dang byed pa'i sems med dmigs pa kun dang bral// re dang dogs pa'i blo med zhen pa kun las grol// zhes dang*/ til+li pas/ zhe 'dod byung bas 'od gsal ma mthong bsgribs// rtog pa'i bsrung sdom dam tshig don las nyams// yid la mi byed zhe 'dod kun dang bral// rang byung rang zhi chu yi rba rlabs 'dra// mi gnas mi dmigs don las mi 'da' na// dam tshig mi 'da' mun pa'i sgron me yin// zhe 'dod kun bral mtha' la mi gnas na// sde snod chos rnams ma lus mthong bar 'gyur// zhes pa sogs grub chen rnams kyi gsung shin tu mang la/ rje sgam po pas kyang*/ blang dor ci yang ma byas lam ma btsal// 'bras bu ci yang ma mthong re dogs zhi// sgro btags rig pas rdzun gyis mgo bskor sangs// zhes dang*/ dang po sems nyid yod par ma gyur pas// gnas 'gyu ye shes de ni su yis rig /des na byas dang byed pa thams cad kun// nam mkha'i so nam dka' las nyid du zad// ces dang*/ gtad so med par phyal par btang ba yin// gzung ba med par dran 'dzin bor ba yin// sgom med ngang la tha mal 'dug pa yin// bdag po med pas ci dga' mu dga' yin// zhes dang*/ dran pa'i 'tsho skyong med pas yengs dogs med// mnyam rjes res mor med pas thun mtshams bral// gang byung chos kyi dbyings la blang dor med// thams cad sgro btags yin pa'i rdzun phug rig /ces dang*/ sems med rtogs na snang srid rgya yan yin// rtsis gdab med na rnam rtog skyes grol yin// zhe 'dod med na thams cad mnyam nyid yin// de ltar rtogs na sgom la rgyun chad med// ces sogs dang*/ gzhan yang gong ma rnams kyi gsung mang ba'o// drug pa de las nyin mtshan 'khor yug tu bsre ba ni/ gong du bshad pa'i sgom khor yug des nyin mnyam rjes bsre zhing*/ de mtshan mo la'ang bsre bar bya ste/

de la mnyam rjes skyong tshul phal cher sngar bshad pa ltar yin kyang la bzla'i skabs 'dir ha cang gis bzung dran tur drags na des nyams skye zhing de la'ang zhen 'dzin skye dogs yod pas/ nam dran gyi tshe zhe 'dod thams cad blos btang zhing*/ btang snyoms pa'i 'dun pa rtsol bar mi bya bar gnyer med bzo med glod rab sgom rab kyi tshul du mnyam rjes kyi dbye ba med par skyong dgos te/ rje zhang gis/ phyag rgya chen po sgom pa la// 'di bya'i tig tig mi bdog gi /dang po bar dang tha ma med// nam dran dus su glod la zhog /ces gsungs pa ltar ro// de ltar byas na dran med phyal bar shor ba'i sgom du mi 'gro'am snyam na skyon med de/ spyir nam dran gyi tshe glod pa de ka zhen 'dzin bshig pa'i dran pa yin la/ yid byed dang bral ba'i ngang du sdod pa de nyid ni/ gnas lugs ji lta ba'i dran pa yang dag yin pas 'jur dran dang bzung dran las ches khyad par du gyur pa yin te/ sha wa ris/ yid la mi byed phyag rgya chen po la// bsgom rgyu rdul tsam med pas mi bsgom ste// bsgom med don dang 'bral med sgom pa'i mchog /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro// 'on kyang rjes shes dum re yengs shor na'ang*/ rjes thob kyi dran pas nam zin de dag gi gnas lugs rig pas rjes chod pa dang*/ rjes chod na mnyam rjes 'gro ba'i khongs su sdud pa dang*/ de lta bu sgom khor yug gi tha snyad bzhed la/ de bzhin nyin khor yug mtshan mor bsre ba la/ gnyid 'gro bar rtsom pa'i tshe/ dang po rtsol ba dang bcas pas yid byed thams cad dang bral ba'i nyin gyi dge sbyor de'i ngang nas gnyid du 'gro bar bya zhing*/ des gnyid dang rmi lam lam du slang na mchog yin kyang*/ de ni srid pa tsam las skabs 'dir phal cher la mi 'byung bas/ gnyid dran med du song zhing rmi lam 'khrul par shar yang*/ gnyid sad ma thag tu de dag gi gnas lugs rig pas chog pa dang*/

de yang nyin mtshan khor yug tu song ba'i tha snyad bzhed la/ rje sgam po pa'i zhus lan rnams las/ 'o na dran pas ma zin tsa na ngo bo mi 'ong ba'i rtog pa rang ga ma de dran pas zin pa dang*/ sngar gyi rnam rtog tsho 'dag gam mi 'dag dran pas shi ma shi med par 'dzin dgos sam mi dgos zhus pas/ dran pas ma zin pa'i rnam rtog rang ga ma rnams dran pas zin ma khad du sangs la dag /dran pas shi ma shi med par 'dzin mi dgos/ 'on kyang dran pas ma yengs pa byed na mnyam rjes 'dres skyen pa la phan/ dran pas ma zin kyang rnam rtog gis gnod pa dang*/ sgrib pa dang bar du gcod pa gtan nas med gsungs/ zhes dang*/ gnyid dang rmi lam gyi dus su 'od gsal rang chas su yod pas chog /dran pas ma zin pa de nyid sad pa'i rjes su bltas pas/ de yang 'od gsal las gzhan med par yid ches pas chu bo'i rgyun yin gsungs so// zhes sogs skabs 'di dag la dogs pa bcad pa'i zhus len mang du snang ngo*// gal te dran yengs la thob shor gyi khu 'phrig chen po 'dug na da dung sems kyi rang bzhin dang gnas lugs rgyun mi chad pa'i tshul ma rtogs pas la bzla cung zad sngas pa yin te/ rje sgam po pas/ yengs pa'i tshe na 'khrul pa rang mtshan pa// dran tshe ngo bo gud na thob pa zhig /de 'dra gang de gnyis chos mi rig pas// sgom la thob shor de ni ngas ma rtogs// gnyis chos yod na blang dor rigs pa la// med par byed pa de rang skyon can yin// zhes dang*/ dran pas thob dang yengs pas 'khrul pa rnams// blo yis bzung mod don la thob shor med// ces gsungs pa ltar ro// de ltar la bzla'i don de dag la nges shes skyes na gzhan mtshan bcas dang yid byed gang yang mi bya bar zhag lnga re tsam la la bzla'i ngang la 'byams su bcug /yang zhag re tsam ci bder ngal bso/ yang zhag bdun re dang bcu re tsam du/ la bzla re dang ngal bso re spel nas/

gnas lugs kyi rtogs pa de nyin par khor yug ma song bar du la bzla/ nyin par khor yug tu song na de nyid la goms 'dris byas pas mtshan la'ang rim pa rim pas 'char zhing shin tu goms na nyin mtshan dpyis phyin par 'gre bar gsungs so// bdun pa la bzla'i dgos don ni/ bsgom bya sgom byed myang bya myong byed rtogs bya rtogs byed sogs kyi gnyis 'dzin dang stong 'dzin la sogs pa'i zhen 'dzin thams cad bshigs nas gzhi'i gnas lugs kyi steng du cham gyis gtong ba'i ched du yin la/ gang zag rab 'bring la zhag grangs ci rigs par gnyis 'dzin dang bral ba'i gnas lugs kyi rtogs pa 'char zhing*/ 'char tshul ni sbyangs pa che chung gi khyad par la brten nas gcig tu ma nges par 'char ro// 'ga' zhig la de lta bu'i rtog pa ci nas kyang shar ma thub na/ re zhig mnyam rjes su dge sbyor skyong tshul sngar bshad pa bzhin skyong zhing*/ phyis rim pas gnyis 'dzin stong 'dzin sogs kyi 'dzin pa dang yang yang phral nas bsgoms pas rtogs pa rim gyis 'char bar bzhed de/ gnas lugs kyi rtogs pa gsha' ma zhig shar na rgyal ba'i bka' mdo rgyud man ngag dang bcas pa'i snying po'i don 'di nyid yin pas lam gzhan dang brgyud pa gzhan las ches cher zab pa'o// lnga pa sgom rtogs pa'i ngo bo'i bogs 'don bshad pa ni/ de yang sgom gyi ngo bo ma grub pa'i ngang du skyong gsungs pa/ nged rang sems kyi ngo bo mthong gang shar la ched 'dzin mi dgos pa'i rang shar rang sar ngo shes tsam gyis chog la// rang bzhin yongs shes kyi rgyun brtan kyang nyams mtho dman sogs sna tshogs 'ong ste/ de yang*/ rje btsun gyis/ rnal 'byor gyi nyams la ci yang 'char// dbyar kha'i spang la ci yang skye// zhes gsungs pa des na mtho dman 'dra ba sna tshogs pa 'ga' re la yong mod/ de yang rje btsun gyi gsung de dang po gnas nyams sogs kyi nyams la gsungs pa 'dra zhig yod de/

de min rnal 'byor ces pa'i sgra las te/ rnal 'byor zer ba'i go don sems nyid rnal ma'i don la dbang 'byor bas rnal 'byor zhes zer la des na rtogs pa la yang sbyar chog pas/ rnal 'byor pa rtogs pa shar ba la'ang 'phral yul gyi rkyen khams dbang sogs kyis mtho dman 'dra ba sna tshogs pa 'ong mod/ de'i tshe ni dngos gzhi ma grub pa'i ngang du shes par byas nas skyong dgos te/ de yang phyi yul gyi snang ba/ nang sems kyi rang nyams/ sgom mkhan rang*/ bsgom bya'i yul/ sgom rang rang gi ngo bo gang yang ma grub par rang bzhin stong pa nyid de ka'i ngang du yengs med du skyong dgos te/ de yang 'phral sems bde ba/ mi bde ba/ skyong ba'i skabs brtan mi brtan ci byung yang*/ thams cad ma lus 'phral du rang mdangs snang tsam ma gtogs don thams cad sems nyid kyi ngo bo stong nyid rang gsal de'i cho 'phrul yin pa de ltar go bar byas nas/ 'phral bde mi bde tsam la skyon yon skad cig kyang mi 'dzin/ gnyis 'dzin de ngo shes par byas/ rkyen thams cad kyi rtsa ba/ phung mkhan thams cad kyi gzhi ma gnyis 'dzin de ka rang yin par bsam nas de phral te/ gnyis med ye shes rang sems gang snang gang shar de ka'i rang ngor ched du yengs pa med pa'i ngang nas skyong dgos so// de min dang po rtogs pa skyong bde tsam yod kyang*/ de nas rkyen nam rang gi khams kyis byas pa'i mtho dman snang ba byung na/ de nas ni 'di 'dra 'ong ma thang bsam pa dang gnyis 'dzin gyi blos tsab tsub mang po zhig byed cing dge sbyor ngo bo las g.yel ba zhig byas na/ de ni sgom lam khyer gnad la rdugs pa ste des mtho dman de yang mi sel bogs kyang mi thon pa'i thabs rdugs pa zhig 'ong ba yin pas/ de ltar mi byed par sngon bshad ltar thams cad rang sems rang mdangs su thag bcad de/ sems kyang rang bzhin ma grub pa stong pa nyid kyi klong der gtad/

gang shar bzo med gnyer med rtsis gdab med pa nas gang snang gang shar rang ngo ched du rtsal bton/ yengs med sgom med kyi gnad kyis skyong bar byed dgos so// don rang sems ngo bo la ched du sgom med/ rang snang sna tshogs gang shar la ched du bzo med rang byung gi rtsal la rang ngor blta ba'i 'dzin med rang grol du btang dgos pa yin/ 'dir lam rang byung snying por rang 'gros su skyong ba zhes rje gong ma rnams kyis gsungs 'di ltar lam khyer cir snang rgyan du khyer shes na cir snang rgyan du 'char zhes bya ba de yong ba'o// drug pa 'gags med kyi 'char sgo'i rtsal sbyong bshad pa ni/ rang res sems kyi ngo bo gsha' ma mthong na des rtsal sbyong rgyu cher med la/ ngo bo rnam dag tu ma rtogs pas ji ltar rigs pa'i rtogs pa shar ba de goms par bskyangs pas na rim gyis nges shes skye zhing dri ma dag pa'i yon tan 'char mod/ 'on kyang*/ rje mi la lta bus kyang*/ sba la tshag tshigs 'dug pa 'di// bod kyi rnal 'byor ras pa la// rnam rtog phra mo yod pa'i rtags// zhes bag la nyal gyi 'khrul pa phra mo yod par zhal gyis bzhes shing*/ de bzhin gong ma rnams kyis kyang ltar snang tsam du g.yeng bas gnod pa'i tshul mdzad nas dben pa kho na brten pa yin/ gzhan yang*/ rje chos grub dpal bzang gis/ bdag gnam mtsho se mo do la sdod skabs rjes shes mi skye bar 'dug bsam kyang phyis gzhan gyi spyod ngan mthong bas rjes shes skyes byung zhes gsungs par/ rje lha rtse bas/ de la nyams len gang 'dra mdzad zhus pas/ dpyad dgos par 'dug /zhes pa thengs gsum du stsal/ de ltar shin tu yin pas nged rang dran pa rgyun chad med pa'i rtsol med yang dag gi dran pa rkyen dang 'gre ba lta bu byung yang ngo bo ma brjed par khu 'phrig ji ltar 'dug legs par brtags nas 'dug na rig pa'i rtsal phyungs shing mdangs kyi gzo rgya la gzab/

rgyun du sgom med yengs med dang*/ chos mnyam nyid lam khyer la bslab pa rnams yin zhing*/ khyad par/ chos rje rgya ras kyis/ blo 'das rtogs pa skyong ba dang*// blos byas rten 'brel bsgrigs pa rnams// bye ma'i sgang yur lta bur snyam// zhes gsungs so// don rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob par byed pa la/ stong nyid snying rje zung 'jug gi ngang nas gzugs sku'i sa bon 'debs dgos/ de ji lta bu zhe na/ sems nyid rang ngo rang shes ngang nas sems can yongs la snying rje dang*/ 'gag med kyi 'char sgo thams cad sems bskyed chen pos dge bar bsgyur ba yin/ de yang mdor bsdu na rnam pa gsum ste/ mi dge ba'i 'ol kha dge bar bsgyur ba/ lung ma bstan pa thams cad dge ba'i phyogs su bsgyur ba/ dge ba rnams dge tshogs rgya chen du spel ba dag go// dang po ni lnga ldan nyams len ltar ram// yang na 'di lta ste/ zhe sdang lta bu lhang gis skyes pa spang blang mi byed dbang du mi gtong de ka'i ngo bo la bltas nas sems can thams cad kyi zhe sdang bdag la smin par gyur cig /bdag gis sems can gyi zhe sdang khur nus par gyur cig /deng phyin chad sems can thams cad la nyon mongs pa zhe sdang gi bsam pa skad cig kyang mi skye bar gyur cig /bdag sangs rgyas pa'i zhing de ru nyon mongs pa zhe sdang gi sgra mi grags par gyur cig /ces smon lam rtse gcig tu btab/ de bzhin kun la sbyar ro// gnyis pa ni/ spyod lam rnam bzhir bsam pa bzang ngan gnyis ka sogs med pa ni lung ma bstan te/ de la dper na bza' btung tshogs 'khor dang 'gro 'dug bskor bar shes pa'i gdams pa ltar/ bza' btung dus rang lha'i rnal 'byor dang ldan pas rol pa sogs/ bla sgrub lta bu dang*/ 'gro ba'i dus g.yas phyogs su skyabs yul rnams bzhugs par dmigs nas/ de la bskor ba byed pa'i 'dun pa la sogs pa ste/ de bzhin rigs pas bskrun la 'gres mod/

tha na zhwa gyon na'ang sems can thams cad kyi don du skyabs dkon mchog gsum spyi bor khur ba dang ma bral bar bya'o snyam pa dang*/ gos gyon na bag yod rnam dag gi gos gyon snyam pa dang*/ ska rags bcings na'ang brtson 'grus drag po'i ska rags dang mi 'bral bar bya snyam pa sogs dgos pa gong ma rnams kyi rnam thar du mdor bsdus gsal ba ltar dang*/ lhag par lung rtogs las byung ba'i go bas 'geb dgos/ gzhan yang rgyal ba rgod tshang pas/ dngos po yid du 'ong ba mthong dus/ dkon mchog gsum la 'bul ba'i blo ma skyes/ zhen pa rang 'dod skyes nas mchod rdzas de chud zos pa yin/ chos rje mchod ces zhen med kyi gnad kho bos shes pa yin gsungs pas gnad mang ngo*// gsum pa ni/ bla ma'i zhabs tog dang chos spyod bcu yi rim pa rnams che phra ji ltar rigs pa sgrub snyam pa'i rtog pa byung na/ de mi 'grub snyam pa'i sgyid lug gi bsam pa mi gtong bar de ltar bya'o 'grub par gyur cig snyam pa dang*/ 'grub pa'i rigs kyang sems can thams cad kyi don du dmigs nas lag len du 'debs/ sbyin pa lta bu yin na der nas 'bru gcig byi'ur sbyin na'ang sems can thams cad kyi don du dmigs nas byin na/ sems can gyi grangs dang mnyam pa'i 'bras bu 'byung zhes mdo rgyud du ma nas gsungs pas dge ba'i bsam sbyor che chung gang 'dra zhig yin yang sangs rgyas lam du 'gro ba'i bsam pa sems bskyed dang bsngo smon gyis rgyas gdab dgos/ 'di dag ltar gyi don rgyud thog tu bkal na/ lung las/ chos rnams thams cad bsam pa'i rang gzugs gsungs pas 'bras bu rgya cher 'phel lo// byas tshad chos su 'gro ba'i gdams ngag zhes pa'i dgongs pa yang lon pa yin/ rten 'brel sogs chos thams cad kyi snying po yang shes pa yin/ don gnyis lhun grub myur du 'byung ba'i rkyen yang byed pa yin te/ chos rje rgya ras kyis/

rnam rtog la bzo ba mkhas pas na// yon tan kun rang gis byas pas chog /ces sogs gong ma rnams kyi gsung mtha' yas so// grub mchog mi pham rjes/ 'di rnams kyi don gser gyi dngos por dpe mdzad nas gsungs/ 'di bzhin chos kyi gnad chen po mdo rgyud bstan bcos rnams nas dngos dang shugs kyis rim par lan brgyar gsungs kyang rtog ge pa rnams kyi spyod yul du ma gyur/ 'o skol sgrub brgyud pa rnams kyang lar ni thams cad 'dir snang mkhan las spros pa chod pa nyin skar tsam du snang*/ 'on kyang skal ldan byang chub sgrub mkhan re gnyis dag gis kyang*/ 'ga' zhig gis ni ma shes/ res 'gas ni gnad chung du 'jog mod/ de bas na rtogs pa shar yang rtsal rdzogs dus med/ rtsal cung zhig rdzogs kyang yon tan 'char dus med/ yon tan shar yang gzhan phan 'grub dus med pas bstan pa nyams dma' bar gda'/ de ltar mi 'byung ba'i don thabs 'di rnams ma shes pa yin pas cis kyang nyams len du bstar bar bya dgos/ gzhan yang nged rang phyag rgya chen po pa rnams rnam rtog spun thag chod pa'i dus/ bzang ngan gyi rtog pa gang yang stobs che bas/ ngan rtog dang 'khor ba'i chos la 'dun pa gtan nas mi byed/ gang shar thams cad de ma thag tu lam du 'khyer/ gzhan yang gnyid kha dang sad ma thag /tho rangs dang kha zas kyi dus dang rjes thob snang shes kyi dus la sogs pa nyen che zhing dus gnyan pa yin pas/ nyams len gyi gnad zin pa gal che gegs sel bogs 'don kyang de dus legs pa'o// lnga pa nyams myong rtogs pa'i spu ris 'byed pa bshad pa la/ dang po rnal 'byor bzhi po spyi'i khogs bshad pa dang*/ gnyis pa rnal 'byor bzhi'i bye brag so sor bshad pa'o// de la dang po rnal 'byor bzhi po spyi'i khog bshad pa la'ang*/// / ༈ dang po rnal 'byor bzhi'i nyams rtogs skye yul gang zag gi dbang rim bshad pa dang*/ gnyis pa nyams rtogs skye bya dngos gzhi rnal 'byor bzhi'i tshul mdo rgyud las gsungs pa bshad pa dang*/

gsum pa rnal 'byor bzhi'i don rags pa thun mong du bshad pa'o// dang po gang zag gi dbang rim bshad pa ni/ 'dir rgyas par gsang 'dus las gang zag rnam pa lnga dang*/ rdzogs chen rnams las gang zag rnam gsum re rer gsum gsum du dbye ba'i gang zag rnam pa dgu'i dbang rim bshad pa sogs mang yang*/ 'dir mdor bsdus pa'i gang zag dbang po rab 'bring tha ma gsum gyi rnam dbye bshad par bya ste/ rab cig char pa'i skye tshul ni/ dang por zhi gnas kyi dus sam/ lhag mthong la khrid pa'i dus sam/ ngo sprod dus nas go ba dang nyams myong rtogs pa gsum dus gcig la shar te/ rtse gcig tsam dang spros bral man tsam dang*/ ro gcig man tsam dang*/ sgom med man tsam/ cig car du skye ba'ang yod la skyes pa de yang brtan te/ dper na gcong rong gi lung par nyi ma shar ba na mun pa sangs pa dang sa rdo dros pa sogs dus mnyam du 'byung ba lta bu/ gang zag sbyangs pa shin tu che ba yin 'dug /'bring thod rgal ba'i skye tshul ni/ go myong rtogs gsum dang rnal 'byor bzhi snga ma snga ma ma brtan par phyi ma phyi ma thol gyis skye la/ skyes kyang mi brtan par 'phel 'grib shin tu che ba zhig ste/ dper na sprin bar gyi nyi ma 'char nub 'ong ba lta bu gang zag sbyangs pa 'bring can no// 'on kyang des yun du dben pa brten zhing mtshams la gnas pa dang*/ bla ma la mos gus byed cing gsol 'debs drag tu byas nas snying rus bskyed de bsgoms na rtogs pa brtan po thob par gsungs la/ gal te sgom yun thung nas tshe 'dir rtogs pa ma brtan kyang rtogs pa gsha' ma bar dor 'char bar bzhed do// tha ma rim gyis pa'i skye tshul ni/ go myong rtogs gsum dang rnal 'byor bzhi rim pas 'char zhing*/ snga ma snga ma brtan nas phyi ma phyi ma rim pas skye la/ skye lugs kyang bul zhing ngo bo cung zad mthong yang 'phral du spang bya mi spong zhing gnyen po la rang dbang mi thob pa zhig 'byung ste/

dper na gnam kha zheng can gyi nyi ma shar ba ltar/ shar ma thag sa rdo dros pa dang 'khyags pa 'ju bar mi nus rim gyis dros dgos pa lta bu gang zag sbyangs pa cung zhan pa ste/ rigs phyi ma gnyis ka'ang mos gus dang snying rus bskyed na byin rlabs kyi gnad kas cig car ba ltar 'gyur ba la tshegs med par bshad la/ de yang dus tshod nges med du rtogs pa skyes nas blo thag chod pa dang*/ rtogs pa skyes kyang ngo ma shes par cha med rtsis med du song ba sogs sna tshogs pa 'ong bar bshad pas/ bla ma dang mched grogs nyams myong can la brten pa gal che'o// go myong rtogs gsum gyi shan 'byed ni/ de yang rang nyid thos bsam sbyangs pas gdams ngag go bas/ sems kyi gnas lugs 'di lta bu 'dug bsam pa go ba dang*/ don rnams tshul bzhin nyams 'og tu tshud cing rig thog tu myong rgyu yod pa nyams myong dang*/ rang gis bsod nams stobs dang bla ma'i byin rlabs zhugs pas sems kyi ngo bo mthong ba la rtogs pa zhes zer te/ rje rgya ras kyis/ brtag dpyad byas pa go ba yin// bde gsal mtho dman nyams myong yin// gnas lugs ngo shes rtogs pa yin// zhes gsungs pa ltar ro// de yang nged rang go bas mi yong*/ nyams myong gis kyang mi chog /rtogs pa rang shar dgos te/ rje yang dgon pas/ lar shog bu la bris pa de rnams la yi ge bya ba yin/ slob dpon gyis gsungs pa dang rang gi khar 'byin shes pa de rnams la tshig bya ba yin/ de tsug yin par 'dug snyam du blo yul du byung ba de rnams la go yul bya ba yin/ des nyon mongs pa'i mgo yang mi non/ rnam par rtog pa'i spun thag kyang mi chod/ rkyen bzang ngan ro yang mi snyoms/ sdug thug tsa na mchu na ba la thug /po ti mdzo khal lnga brgya la longs pa yod kyang 'chi tsa na shul du lus pa yin/ shog bu ldeb gcig kyang khyer ba la mi phan/ gdams ngag zab mo i thi mtshal mgo ma bcu yod kyang khams pa cig shi ba bzhin 'ong dogs yod/

de rnams kyi don 'dir zhib tu mi 'ong tshig gis sde snod gsum dang rgyud sde bzhi blo la bshad pa yod kyang shi khar blo la bzhag tu med srid pa yin/ lo tsā ba chen po rngog bsam yas bye ma ri rtser sku gshegs pa'i dus/ 'di la brten nas bdag cag 'khor bar grol du 'gro snyam nas/ rgya mtshor 'jug pa gang yin pa/ sbu ba rab brtsegs rdol ba'i phung po 'dis// ri mchog 'dra ba de nyid gtan nas bslus// zhes thos bsam rkyang pa la thugs chad pa'i gsung byon pa de/ khong rang ni thos grol chen po'i gsung dgongs pa can yin te/ phyi rabs kyi thos bsam rkyang pa rnams la lji ba yin gsungs/ phal po che'i mdo las/ ji ltar bu ram mngar ba'i ro// thos pas ro ni mi myong ste/ bsgoms pas ro ni myong bar 'gyur// zhes pa dang*/ dper na mi ltogs pa gcig gis zan zan zhes kha nas bton yang 'grangs pa la mi phan/ nas yos su brngos phye ru btags te chu la brdzis lag pas rbad kyis bcad cing zos na 'grangs par 'ong*/ dpe de bzhin du chos 'di rgyud la skye dgos/ de skye ba la sgom dgos/ sgom pa la 'jig rten blos btang tshe 'di yi rdos thag bcad/ lto rgyab la gyong bskur/ lus srog thed la bor/ bka' brgyud kyi rnam thar bsam/ go cha dang sdug sran bskyed/ gnas ri khrod kyi dgon pa 'grim zhing sgrub pa snyugs su bsring zhing btang ba'i dus su rang gi nang nas skye tshul gcig 'ong ba yin/ zhes gsungs pa ltar ro// nyams rtogs kyi dbye ba la/ bka' brgyud gong ma'i gsungs las/ nyams dang rtogs pa nor ra re/ zhes gsungs pas nor sa che// ma nor bar byed dgos pa las/ dang po nyams la'ang so so'i 'char tshul/ goms shas che chung*/ brtan pa thob ma thob sogs kyis mtha' gcig rang du ma nges kyang*/ spyir btang tsam du nyams kyi skabs rang sems stong gsal mi rtog pa'i ngang du tha le gnas cha che zhing*/

de las tshogs drug gi snang ba 'char ba yang rjen lhang nger ngo shes shing rang thog tu bun ne ling nger yal bar 'gyur ba yin la/ rtogs pa'i skabs sngon nyams dus ngo bo sgrib byed dri ma de dag nas rang sems tha mal gyi shes pa gshis kyi rang ngo 'phrod cing*/ rang rtsal sna tshogs skye 'gags med par rtogs pas gang ci la'ang blo yi mtshan 'dzin gyi yul las 'das pa'i gang shar rang bzhin yongs shes klong yangs su 'byams klas pa'o// mdor na nyams kyi ban bun dang*/ rtogs pa'i ngo bo gnyis kyi sa mtshams ni/ nyams kyi skabs sems ji ltar bde gsal can brtan pa 'byung na'ang de la ngo bo ma rtogs rang bzhin ma shes pa'i the tshom mtshan 'dzin mchog zhen dang nga rgyal rlom zhen nges shes kha 'dzin sogs/ blo yi 'dzin stangs kyi dri ma zhig yod la/ mos gus snying rje sogs kyang 'di yod med pa'i sra thing nge ba rnams 'byung*/ rtogs pa gsha' ma ni/ dri ma de dag dag pa'i sems nyid bzo med gshis lugs kyi rang thog tu thag chod/ the tshom med/ 'dzin pa bral/ nga rgyal dag /rang gi sems ngo rtogs pas/ de ltar ma rtogs pa'i sems can kun la snying rje chen po dang*/ ngo sprod byin rlabs bdag po rtsa ba'i bla ma la sangs rgyas dngos kyi 'du shes brtan po'i mos gus skye ba yin/ gzhan yang mnyam med dwags por/ nyams dang rtogs pa gnyis khyad ci yod zhus pas/ nyams ni blo yi yul las ma 'das par yod pa yin pas/ dper na sprin gseb kyi nyi ma dang 'dra bas bde ba/ gsal ba/ mi rtog pa gsum res mtho res dma' res gnas pa 'ong la/ de la ma zhen par bskyangs pas blo yi dri ma dag nas rtogs pa da gzod 'char/ rtogs pa ni snang sems gnyis med du blo yi gting nas 'od gsal gyi ngang la rgyun chad med pa/ bsgom bya sgom byed dang bral ba'i dus su rtogs thob dus gcig tu 'char ba la zer ba yin/ zhes gsal bar gsungs pa ltar ro// rnal 'byor bzhi yi rtse gcig nyams/

gzhan spros bral ro gcig sgom med gsum la ni nyams dang rtogs pa so sor phye dgos/ de'ang dang po rtse gcig gi nyams ni/ shes pa gsal sing nge ba de ngo bo/ mtho dman byung na da dung nyams yin mi brtan/ mtho dman chung na bogs drag /spyir rtse gcig nyams yin rtogs pa min/ spros bral nang nas en tsam zhig skye med du shes pa la/ bla mas bstan pa de yin par byung ang snyam nas rang sems ngo shes pa de nyams/ shes pa de kho rang gis kho rang rang bzhin med pa lhangs kyis rtogs pa rtogs pa yin/ ro gcig la ni/ rang gi lus phyi yi snang ba rang gi sems gsum rang bzhin med pa yin ang snyam pa nyams/ phyi rol gyi snang ba 'di me long nang gi gzugs brnyan bzhin so sor snang yang gcig tu lhan gyis rtogs pa de rtogs pa yin/ sgom med la ni/ nan ltar bsgom bya sgom byed mi 'dug snyam pa nyams/ shes pa kho rang gis kho rang sgom byed dang bral bar lhan gyis rtogs pa rtogs pa yin te/ de ltar nyams dang rtogs pa ma nor bar 'byed pa gal che ba'o// gnyis pa nyams rtogs skye bya dngos gzhi rnal 'byor bzhi yi tshul mdo rgyud las gsungs pa bshad pa la/ dang po gsar ma'i mdo rgyud bstan bcos las gsungs pa dang*/ gnyis pa rnying ma rdzogs chen rang gzhung sogs las bshad pa'i tshul bstan pa rnam pa gnyis so// dang po gsar ma'i mdo rgyud bstan bcos las gsungs pa ni/ lang kar gshegs pa las/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ blo gros chen po chos bzhi dang ldan pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams rnal 'byor chen po'i rnal 'byor can du 'gyur ro// bzhi gang zhe na 'di lta ste/ rang gi sems snang ba rnam par bsgom pa dang*/ skye ba dang gnas pa dang*/ 'jig par lta ba rnam par spong ba dang*/ phyi rol gyi dngos po dngos po med par rtogs pa dang*/ 'phags pa so so rang gi ye shes khong du chud par mos pa yin te/

blo gros chen po chos bzhi po 'di dag dang ldan pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams rnal 'byor chen po'i rnal 'byor can du 'gyur ro// zhes pas rnal 'byor bzhi bstan par bzhed la/ de yang so sor phye nas bshad na/ sems snang ba rnam par bsgoms pas rtse gcig gi rnal 'byor bstan te/ de nyid du/ blo gros chen po/ de la ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rang gi sems snang ba rnam par sgom pa la mkhas pa yin zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ 'di ltar khams gsum 'di ni rang gi sems tsam ste/ bdag dang bdag gi dang bral ba/ g.yo ba med pa/ blang ba dang dor ba dang bral ba/ thog ma med pa'i dus kyi spros pa'i gnas ngan len gyi bag chags la mngon par zhen pas gos pa/ khams gsum gyi gzugs rnam pa sna tshogs la nye bar spyod pas 'brel ba/ lus dang longs spyod gnas dang 'gro bar rnam par rtog pa'i rjes su song bar snang ngo*// zhes rab tu rtogs te/ zhes gsungs pa dang*/ rtse gcig gi rnal 'byor don mthun pa'i phyir ro// skye ba dang gnas pa dang 'jig par lta ba rnam par spong bas spros bral gyi rnal 'byor bstan te/ de nyid du/ blo gros chen po ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ skye ba dang gnas pa dang 'jig par lta ba rnam par spong ba yin zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ dngos po thams cad ni sgyu ma dang rmi lam gyi gzugs skye ba dang 'dra bar bdag dang gzhan dang gnyis ka med pa'i phyir mi skye ste/ rang gi sems snang ba tsam gyi rjes su 'brang ba dang phyi rol gyi dngos po dngos po med par mthong ngo*// dngos po med par mthong bas rnam par shes pa rnams 'jug pa med pa dang*/ rkyen rnams kyang phung po dang*/ spungs pa med par mthong nas khams gsum rnam par rtog pa'i rkyen las byung bar mthong bas/ phyi nang gi chos thams cad mi dmigs shing rang bzhin med par rjes su mthong ba'i phyir/

skye ba'i lta ba rnam par log nas sgyu ma la sogs pa'i chos kyi rang bzhin du rjes su rtogs pas mi skye ba'i chos la bzod pa rab tu thob ste/ zhes pa dang spros bral gyi rnal 'byor don mthun pa'i phyir ro// phyi rol gyi dngos po dngos po med par rab tu rtog pa la mkhas pas ro gcig gi rnal 'byor bstan te/ de nyid du/ blo gros chen po de la ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po phyi rol gyi dngos po dngos po med par rtogs pa la mkhas pa yin zhe na/ 'di ltar ste/ dngos po thams cad ni smig rgyu dang rmi lam dang skra shad 'dzing ba lta bu'o// dngos po thams cad thog ma med pa'i dus kyis spros pa'i gnas ngan len gyi rnam par rtog pa'i bag chags rnam pa sna tshogs pa la mngon par zhen pa'i rgyu las byung ba yin te rang bzhin med pa'o// zhes yang dag par mthong bas byang chub sems dpa' 'am zhes pa dang ro gcig gi rnal 'byor don mthun pa'i phyir ro// 'phags pa so so rang gi ye shes khong du chud par mos pas sgom med kyi rnal 'byor bstan te/ de nyid du blo gros chen po ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'phags pa so so rang gi ye shes khong du chud par mos pa yin zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ mi skye ba'i chos la bzod pa rab tu thob nas sa brgyad pa la gnas te/ sems dang yid dang yid byed kyi rnam par shes pa dang chos lnga dang rang bzhin dang bdag med pa gnyis rtogs pa rab tu gyur pa khong du chud pa'i phyir yid kyi lus kyang rab tu thob bo// zhes pa dang sgom med kyi rnal 'byor don mthun pa'i phyir ro// de bzhin du/ lang gshegs las/ sems tsam la ni brten nas su// phyi rol don la mi brtag go /de bzhin nyid kyi dmigs gnas nas// sems tsam las kyang 'da' bar bya// sems tsam las ni 'das nas su// snang ba med la 'da' bar bya// snang med gnas pa'i rnal 'byor pa// de yis theg pa chen po mthong*// zhes gsungs pa dang*/

de'i don sgom rim du bshad pa dang*/ sher phyin man ngag tu bshad pa rnams kyang rnal 'byor bzhi dang don mthun no// yang*/ ā li kā li chu klung chen po'i rgyud las/ seng ge rnam par bsgying ba'i ting 'dzin gyis// rtse gcig mi g.yo dwangs pas shes pa gsal// rang byung ye shes khong nas sad par byed// bzod pa brtan pas ngan song sdug bsngal spong*// gnyis pa sgyu ma lta bu'i ting 'dzin gyis// spros dang bral ba'i mnyam bzhag chen po la// bsam gyis mi khyab ting 'dzin rtsal du shar// drod thob nas ni skye la rang dbang bsgyur// gsum pa dpa' bar 'gro ba'i ting 'dzin gyis// du ma ro gcig sa bcu'i rtogs pa 'char// dus gsum rgyal ba'i sras pos 'gro don mdzad// rtse thob nas ni 'phel ba rgyun mi chad// bzhi pa rdo rje lta bu'i ting 'dzin gyis// sgom du med pa'i nyams len brtson pa la// rnam mkhyen sangs rgyas zhing khams dpag med mthong*// ma btsal lhun grub chos mchog chen po yin// ces gsungs par grags la/ mdor na sngar bshad pa'i sems nyid lhan cig skyes pa chos kyi sku ni rgya mtsho chen po dang 'dra ste kun gyi gzhi yin/ de'i gnas lugs rtogs pa la rtse gcig tu bzhag /rnam rtog lhan cig skyes pa chos sku'i rtsal ni rgya mtsho'i rlabs dang 'dra ste chos sku'i rang rtsal yin/ de'i gnas lugs rtogs pa la spros bral du bzhag /snang ba lhan cig skyes pa chos sku'i 'od ni/ rgya mtsho'i nang du gzugs brnyan sna tshogs shar ba dang 'dra ste bsam pa'i rang gzugs yin/ de'i gnas lugs rtogs pa la ro gcig tu bzhag /rtogs pa de gsum mthar phyin nas 'bad rtsol gyis sgom du med pa ni/ mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas te/ sgom med du bzhag pa yin gsungs pa ste/ de bas na bka' dang bstan bcos rgyud dang man ngag zab dgu thams cad rnal 'byor bzhi la skyel ba dang snying po mi byed pa med cing rnal 'byor bzhi yi rim pa thugs nyams su ma bstar ba'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dang grub pa'i skyes mchog gang yang yod pa ma yin pas/

mdo las/ chu thams cad rgya mtshor phyin pa na lan tshwa'i ror ro gcig pa ltar theg pa chen por ro gcig par gsungs pa ltar yin no// khyad par du/ bram ze chen po'i/ 'chi med rdo rje'i glu las/ dran pa med par 'jug pas rtog pa mi dgag par// shes pa rang lugs bzhag na gnas par 'gyur// zhes dang*/ 'di la gnas na bde chen nyams 'byung ste// dang po snang ba stong par myong ba'i sems// chab rom snang yang chu ru ngo shes bzhin// gnyis pa dran pa'i snang ba ma 'gags par// stong pa bde dang tha mi dad pa 'byung*// chab rom chu ru zhu ba'i gnas skabs bzhin// gsum pa dran med skye ba med la thim// thams cad tha mi dad pa bde ba chen por gcig /de bzhin chab rom thams cad chu dang dbyer med bzhin// blo 'das 'bras bu 'dod pa med 'grub pas// sman mchog nang na si ta ji bzhin no// zhes pa dang*/ klu sgrub kyis rim lngar gsungs pa'i/ sems dben dang rtse gcig don gcig /'od gsal dang spros bral don gcig /slob pa'i zung 'jug dang ro gcig don gcig /mi slob pa'i zung 'jug dang sgom med don gcig go /grub chen lwa ba pas/ lhun gyis grub pa dang*/ bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang*/ zung du 'jug pa dang*/ rnam par dag pa zhes rnal 'byor bzhi gsungs/ sha wa ri pas/ ting 'dzin nyams su myong ba dang*/ rnal 'byor dang*/ shin tu rnal 'byor dang*/ rnal 'byor chen po'i ming gis rnal 'byor bzhi gsungs/ mai tri pas/ sgro 'dogs chod pa'i dus dang*/ dbang thob pa'i dus dang*/ gdengs thob pa'i dus dang*/ rig pa de nyid du grol ba'i dus bzhi la/ nang tshan dgu re gsungs/ gzhan yang ye shes gsang ba'i rgyud las/ dang po gnas pa'i ting nge 'dzin// gnyis pa la ni mi g.yo ba// gsum pa mnyam pa nyid du sbyor// bzhi pa ye shes lhun gyis grub// ces dang*/ dpal dus kyi 'khor lor/ rtse gcig rags pa dbyibs kyi sbyong byed/

spros bral phra ba rlung*/ ro gcig shin tu phra ba sems sbyong*/ sgom med ye shes sbyong bas 'bras bur mdzad pas na/ rim bzhin du/ sku phyag rgya chen po/ gsung phyag rgya chen po/ thugs phyag rgya chen po/ ye shes phyag rgya chen po/ zhes bshad/ gzhan yang rnal 'byor bzhi po re rer yang*/ bde gsal mi rtog pa'i nyams gsum re 'byung ste/ de'ang bde ba'i bye brag la/ dga' ba dang*/ mchog dga' dang*/ dga' bral gyi dga' ba dang*/ lhan cig skyes pa'i dga' ba ste/ mas brtan pa'i dga' ba bzhi dang gsal ba'i bye brag snang ba mched pa thob pa nyer thob kyi 'od gsal te gsal snang gi rim pa bzhi dang*/ mi rtog pa'i bye brag stong pa/ shin tu stong pa/ stong pa chen po/ thams cad stong pa chen po ste/ stong pa bzhi dang*/ chos drug pas/ zin brtan dbang 'byor bzhi dang*/ lam 'bras pas/ dbang bzhi'i lam gyi 'gros dang sbyar ba sogs dang shin tu 'brel zhing dbang bzhi'i 'gros su rje nā ro pas kyang bzhed de/ san+dha pa rol pa'i rdo rje la gsungs pa/ phyag rgya chen po'i rtogs pa yi// dang po rnam rtog glo bur ba// de nyid la ni lta ba yi// ma rig pa las log pa ni// rig pa gsal la 'dzin med du// rtogs na rig pa'i dbang zhes bya// dug lnga ye shes lngar gnas na// bum pa'i dbang du 'dod pa'o// de la 'gags pa med pa'i rtsal// phyogs cha med par 'char bas na// stong pa'i ngang nas bde ba 'char// gsal ba gnyis pa'i dbang du 'dod// lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes ni// bde stong dbyer med nam mkha'i ngang*// zung 'jug ro gcig chen po la// snang sems bde ba chen por myong*// shes rab ye shes dbang du bshad// dbang gsum dbyer med sems su 'dus// sems nyid mkha' ltar dag pa na// mnyam bzhag rjes 'jog med pa nyid// bden gnyis zung 'jug bzhi pa yin/ zhes gsungs pa dang*/ rgyal po'i btsun mo kā par bhu dza yis/

bram ze chen po sa ra ha la zhus pa la gsungs pa/ rig pa rtse gcig bum pa'i dbang*// bde ba spros bral gsang ba'i dbang*// gsum pa mnyam pa nyid du sbyor// bsgom du med pa bzhi pa'o// zhes kyang gsungs la/ mdor na thabs lam pas 'khor lo bzhi'i rtsa mdud grol zhing thig rlung 'ching ba'i rim pas rnal 'byor bzhi rim du na 'pho bar gsungs pa/ rje btsun mi la'i rnam thar du// bha bram pa sogs kyis gsungs pa'i lam rtags kyi nyams snang lan bzhir shar tshul dbang tshul de lta bu'i sgo nas sngags lam gyi 'gros dang yang nges par mthun pa go dgos pa yin no// gnyis pa rnying ma rdzogs chen rang gzhung sogs las bshad pa'i tshul bstan pa ni/ rdzogs pa chen po'i gnad kyi zin tig las/ de dag sems su dag pas na// mi dge'i las rnams ngang gis spangs// zhes rtse gcig /sems nyid spros dang bral ba la// gzung dang 'dzin pa thams cad spangs// zhes spros bral/ snang ba chos kyi skur shar bas// rnam par rtog pa shugs kyis spangs// zhes ro gcig /'khor 'das rang bzhin med shes pas// gnyis su 'dzin pa thams cad spangs// zhes sgom med de/ yang dag spong ba bzhi dang sbyar nas gsungs/ yang*/ drod ni sems kyi ngo bo mthong*// rtse mo skye med chos skur te// bzod pa 'khor 'das blang dor med// chos mchog 'khor 'das sems la thim// zhes pa sbyor lam nges 'byed bzhi dang rnal 'byor bzhi sbyar nas gsungs pa sogs gsar rnying thams cad dgongs pa mthun/ tshul 'di dag gis mtshon nas mdo rgyud gsar rnying man ngag dang bcas pa nas/ sems rtse gcig pa'i mnyam bzhag ston pa rnams kyis rtse gcig /skye med mtha' bral ston pa rnams kyis spros bral/ bde chen mnyam nyid ston pa rnams kyis ro gcig /blang dor dang bsal bzhag med par ston pa rnams kyis sgom med bstan par dgongs par bya'o// gsum pa rnal 'byor bzhi'i don rags pa thun mong du bshad pa la/

dang po so so'i khyad par bshad pa/ gnyis pa khyad par gzhan bshad pa'o// dang po so so'i khyad par bshad pa la'ang dran pa'i dbye ba bzhi/ ting nge 'dzin gyi ngos 'dzin bzhi/ mnyam bzhag gi rtogs pa bzhi/ rtogs pa'i 'khor sa bzhi/ rjes shes kyi skye tshul bzhi/ rjes shes kyi dri ma bzhi/ rjes thob kyi dag tshul bzhi/ mnyam rjes kyi sa mtshams bzhi/ bsgom pa'i dus bzhi/ mnyam bzhag gi rtogs pas sgrib pa dag lugs bzhi/ nyams rtogs kyi sa mtshams bzhi/ kun rdzob rgyu 'bras kyi mkhyen tshul bzhi'o// dang po dran pa'i dbye ba bzhi ni/ spyir dran pa la/ gnyen po bzung dran/ stong nyid bzung dran/ rtsol med kyi dran pa/ yang dag gi dran pa/ blo 'das kyi dran pa rnams las// dang po gnyen po bzung dran zhes pa rtse gcig dang po'i skabs/ de ni rnam rtog gnyen por de nyid ngos bzung ba'i dran pa ste/ spang bya gnyen po tha dad tsam las med pa yin/ de nas sems kyi ngo bo mthong nas brtan pa ma thob bar ni stong nyid bzung dran/ de don sems kyi ngo bo mthongs bas spang gnyen dbyer med du shes shing stong pa nyid rtogs kyang brtan pa ma thob pas ngo bo de las brjed skabs dum tsam yong ba der dran pa dgos pas na de ltar yin/ de nas brtan pa thob nas rtsol med kyi dran pa ste/ 'dir ming gi brjod bya mang la/ dran pa gcig pa'i ting nge 'dzin yang zer/ bzung dran dag pa zhes kyang zer/ dran pa'i bar 'brel zhes kyang zer/ sgom khor yug ma zhes kyang zer/ de sogs mang*/ 'on kyang der yang zhib tu na dran pa gcig pa'i ting nge 'dzin zhes pa ting nge 'dzin la yengs med tsam min pa'i der nges shes kyi cha dang*/ sgom khor yug ma mtshan nyid pa rang la nyin mtshan 'dres pa dgos par 'dug /de yang rtsol med dran pa zhes/ rang nyid rtogs pa'i ngo bo de las skad cig kyang yengs su med pas rkyen gang gis kyang mi gnod pa zhig 'ong ba yin/

de nyin par 'byung la mtshan mo gnyid dus ma byung na sgom res 'jog ma yin/ rtsol med dran pa des nyin mtshan 'dres na sgom khor yug ma/ yang nyin mtshan 'di skabs nyin rtsol med de ka'i rgyun rang las mtshan gnyid dus kyang ngo bo de ka'i ngang nas gnyid du 'gro ba gnyid sad dus kyang slar ngo bo brten mi dgos pa ngo bo rang thog rtsol med byung na/ de la ni nyin mtshan gyi bar 'brel zer ba yin/ de ma byung na ni gnyid sad dus sogs slar ngo bo ched du brten dgos pa byung na de ni nyin mtshan bar ma 'brel zhes zer ba yin/ man ngag 'ga' rer nyin mtshan bar 'brel na nyin mtshan 'dres pa'ang byas chog tsam yin gsungs 'dug /yang rtsol med yang dag gi dran pa zhes gsungs pa 'di rtsol med byung phyin yang dag kyang de zhor la btags nas lab mkhan 'dug kyang de ni ma yin te/ sngon nas bshad pa'i ting nge 'dzin 'di gnyis la spyir ngo bo yengs med los yin te/ yang dag dang ting nge 'dzin gnyis byed pa la da dung gzung 'dzin myong 'dod sogs kyi dri ma dag rgyu zhig dang thag chod nges shes chen po zhig skye rgyu yod/ rnal 'byor bzhi dran pa'i skabs su phye dus gsung 'ga' rer/ rtse gcig rnam rtog bzung dran/ spros bral stong nyid dran pa/ ro gcig skye med dran pa/ sgom med blo 'das dran pa/ zhes gsungs 'dug cing*/ yang 'ga' rer rtse gcig sngon dang 'dra ba la spros bral skye med dran pa/ ro gcig blo 'das dran pa/ sgom med dbyings su thim pa zhes sogs gsungs/ de dag ni so so'i khyad chos gdul bya so so'i skal ba dang 'tshams par gsungs pa yin 'dug /nga rang blo dang 'dris pa ni 'di 'dra zhig byung ste/ de yang rtse gcig sngon ma dang 'dra/ spros bral ni lar dbang po mi rno ba rnams rtogs pa'i ngo bo tsam zhig mthong yang brtan pa ma thob pas brjed par los yong*/ brjed par yong tshe stong nyid bzung dran 'dra zhig 'dug kyang de ni chags cher ma bzhag pa'i spros bral gyi ngo bo gsha' ma dang spros bral mtshan nyid pa rang la rkyen dang 'dres ngo shes shig dgos par 'dug phyir spros bral rtsol med kyi dran pa rang dang*/

gzhan bzung dran dag pa dran pa'i bar 'brel zhes pa'ang 'di ka yin/ de nas spros bral dang ro gcig gi khyad par ngo bo myong 'dzin sogs dag ma dag dang*/ khyad par snang thog tu rtsal 'byongs ma 'byongs sogs kyis yin zhing*/ yang dag dran par yang de ltar dgos pas na/ ro gcig yang dag dran pa ngo ma rang dang*/ gzhan dran pa gcig pa'i ting nge 'dzin yang yin/ des na ro gcig dang sgom med kyi khyad par rtsol med yang dag gi dran pa'i rtog pa de dag ma dag gam blo las 'das ma 'das yin pas na/ sgom med blo 'das kyi dran pa/ blo 'das zer ba 'di yang dbye ba mang*/ bsgom bya sgom byed kyi blo las 'das pa tsam la blo 'das zer zhing*/ de ni spros bral dus nas yod pas/ spros bral dus nas bzung blo 'das yod de/ blo 'das zer ba tshig gi brjod bya tsam ma gtogs blo 'das gsha' ma min/ da res sgom med du blo 'das dran pa zer rgyu 'di ni blo 'das chen po rang ste/ don spang bya gnyen po thams cad zad pa yang dag dran pa'i rtog pa de yang blo las 'das pas blo 'das/ de nas de'i gong na gzhan med pas na chen po ste/ sgom med blo 'das dran pa zhes pa blo 'das kyi don sngon nas bshad bzhin dang*/ 'di dran pa zer ba lar dran rig thams cad dbyings su thim pa'i dran bya dran byed rtsa ba nas zad pa zhig yin na'ang 'dir dran pa zhes pa ni sngon gyi dran par dbye ba'i shugs 'gros kyis rang bzhin du sbyar ba de bzhin yin// gnyis pa ting nge 'dzin gyi ngos 'dzin bzhi ni/ rje sgom chung gis/ sa le ngang la gnas pa rtse gcig yin// zhes pa sems gnas 'gyu ba gcig tu 'dres pa'i rig pa gsal stong nam mkha' ltar mtha' dbus med pa'i ngang du sa le sing nge ye re gnas pa de yin/ sgro 'dogs chod pa spros bral yin// zhes pa gzung 'dzin nam phyi nang gi chos thams cad la skye 'gags gnas gsum dang mtshan 'dzin gyi spros pa las grol nas thams cad skye med stong pa nyid du sgro 'dogs chod pa'o// spang blang med pa ro gcig yin// zhes pa/

snang srid 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad la skye 'gag gi spros pa bral ma bral stong mi stong sogs kyi dgag sgrub dang spang blang med par gnyug ma'i ngang du mnyam pa nyid du gyur pa'o// myong ba dag pa sgom med yin// zhes pa sngar gyi nyams dang myong ba'i dri ma thams cad dag nas lam gyi rtogs pa dang rang bzhin gyi gnas lugs 'dres te mnyam rjes dang dran yengs med pa zhig go// gsum pa mnyam bzhag gi rtogs pa bzhi ni/ rje sgom chung gis/ rtse gcig dus su ngo bo rtogs// zhes pa sems rtog med du gsal la ngos bzung med pa myong thog tu khel zhing nges shes skyes pa sems kyi ngo bo rtogs pa'o// spros bral dus su rang bzhin rtogs// zhes pa sems skye 'gag gnas gsum dang bral ba'i 'dus ma byas rang bzhin med par rig pa sems kyi rang bzhin rtogs pa'o// ro gcig dus su mtshan nyid rtogs// zhes pa sems nyid bag chags kyi gzugs brnyan sna tshogs su snang ba rnams skye med kyi ngang du ro mnyam zhing stong nyid kyi rtsal ma 'gags pa'ang snang ba sna tshogs su 'char ba'i rten 'brel rig pa sems kyi mtshan nyid rtogs pa'o// sgom med rtogs pa khor yug ma// ces pa myang bya myong byed dang rtogs bya rtogs byed kyi dbye ba med par thams cad mnyam nyid gnyug ma chen po'i rtogs pa khor yug tu 'gro bar bzhed do// bzhi pa rtogs pa'i 'khor sa bzhi ni/ rje sgom chung gis/ rtse gcig mun pa'i dkyil na 'byams// zhes pa sems nyid gsal stong gi ngang du sa le sing nger gnas pa tsam byung yang*/ de'i nyams myong ci rigs kyis bsgribs nas rig pa'i ngo bo gsal la go ma 'gags pa'i shes pa de la yid ches dang nges shes ma skyes pa ni mun pa'i nang du 'byams pa ltar mthong bya ma mthong ba'o// spros bral med pa'i stong rtsis khyer// zhes pa don gang la'ang phyi nang gi chos la stong 'dzin dang de'i nges shes kyi nyams kyi dbang du song nas snang phyogs las 'bras kyi rten 'brel la rang byan ma tshud par g.yel ba'am khyad du gsod pa chad lta med pa'i stong rtsis khyer ba 'byung ngo*// ro gcig 'dres pa'i rba la g.yengs// zhes pas/

snang ba dang sems gcig tu myong zhing rtogs pa'i tshe/ mos gus dang snying rje sogs bya ba'i yul ma rnyed par dag snang dang snying rje sogs thabs kyi cha la rmongs nas theg dman du lhung ba yod par bzhed pa chu'i rba la g.yeng ba ltar g.yang sa che ba'o// sgom med nyi ma sprin gyis sgrib// ces pa mnyam bzhag 'ba' zhig bsgom bya sgom byed dang bral ba'i rtogs pa shar yang sgyu ma lta bu'i gnyis snang dang mi rtog pa ngo ma shes na nyi ma sprin gyis bkab pa ltar rtogs pa'i sgrib byed ma sangs pa'i don du bzhed do// lnga pa rjes shes kyi skye tshul bzhi ni/ rje sgom chung gis/ rtse gcig gi rjes shes a 'thas/ zhes pa/ nang nyams myong gi zhen 'dzin ma dag pas rjes shes su'ang gzung 'dzin gyi dngos po la bden 'dzin ma zhig par dngos 'dzin a 'thas kyi snang ba 'char ba'o// spros bral gyi rjes shes sgyu ma/ zhes pa chos thams cad skye med stong par rtogs pas rjes shes su yul dang yul can gyi rnam par snang yang de la bden 'dzin med par sgyu ma lta bur 'char ba'o// ro gcig gi rjes shes stong pa/ zhes pa 'ga' zhig gis rjes shes su snang ba thams cad snang stong gnyis med zung 'jug tu ma shes par sngar gyi stong 'dzin ma dag pa'i shugs kyis stong pa phyogs gcig par 'char ba yod pas rjes shes stong par 'char ba'o// sgom med kyi rjes shes snying rje/ zhes pa 'di skabs mnyam rjes 'dres pas rjes shes rang ga ma med kyang rjes thob tsam du dmigs med snying rje'i 'char sgo yod pas rjes shes snying rjer 'char ba'i tha snyad byas pa'o// drug pa rjes shes kyi dri ma bzhi ni/ rje sgom chung gis/ rtse gcig la dngos 'dzin gyi dri ma/ zhes pa/ nyams myong nges shes dang bcas pa'i zhen 'dzin ma dag pas dngos 'dzin gyi dri ma can no// spros bral la ngo shes ma shes kyi dri ma/ zhes pa/

gang ci'ang rung bar stong 'dzin nges shes kyi cha yod pas stong phyogs dge sbyor du bde zhing snang phyogs mi bde bar zung 'jug tu ngo ma shes kyi dri ma can no// ro gcig la nyams kyi dri ma/ zhes pa 'dir yang zung 'jug tu ma tshud pas stong 'dzin phra mo dang*/ zung du tshud kyang de la'ang sgyu ma lta bur snang ba'i nyams kyi dri ma can no// sgom med la shes bya'i dri ma/ zhes pa rjes snang du mi rtog pa ngo ma shes pa'i kun gzhi'i rnam shes rtog bral lung ma bstan du gnas par yod par bshad pa de chos nyid rang gsal du ma shar ba'i cha yin pas de la shes bya'i dri ma zhes bzhed do// bdun pa rjes thob kyi dag tshul bzhi ni/ rje sgom chung gis/ rtse gcig bral yod thob pa med// ces pa 'gyu dran yengs na sgom 'chor bas bral ba yod la/ dran pas zin yang rang sa'i dge sbyor de'i rgyun rnyed pa tsam ma gtogs ji lta ba'i sgom thob rgyu med pa'o// spros bral bral thob gnyis ka yod// ces pa stong nyid bzung dran gyis shor na sgom 'chor nas bral ba yod la/ dran pas zin tsa na skye med kyi ngo bo mthong ba'i sgom ji lta ba thob pas thob pa yod pa'o// ro gcig bral ba med la thob pa yod// ces pa rjes snang gi thog tu dran pas ma zin kyang rtog pa'i rgyun ma chad pas bral ba med pa la yang dag gi dran pas zin ma thag snang stong du 'char bas thob pa yod pa'o// sgom med bral thob gnyis ka med// ces pa dran pa ye shes kyi 'khor lor shar bas sgom dang bral ba med la/ snang ba gang shar de kas chog pas sgom gsar du thob pa med par bzhed do/// / ༈ brgyad pa mnyam rjes kyi sa mtshams bzhi ni/ rje sgom chung gis/ rtse gcig rang sa'i mnyam rjes yod// ces pa rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes ji lta ba ma skyes pas mnyam bzhag mtshan nyid pa med cing*/ snang ba skye med du ma rtogs pas rjes snang sgyu ma lta bur mi 'char bas rjes thob mtshan nyid pa med la/

'on kyang rtse gcig rang sa'i dge sbyor de la mnyam par 'jog rgyu dang yengs nas dran pas rjes la thob rgyu yod do// spros bral mnyam rjes so sor 'byed// ces pa phyi nang gi chos thams cad la yul dang yul can gyi gnyis 'dzin las grol te gnyis med kyi ye shes zang thal du shar ba ni rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes yin pas mnyam bzhag mtshan nyid pa yin zhing*/ rjes shes su yul dang yul can gyi gnyis snang tsam shar yang bden med sgyu ma ltar 'char ba rjes thob mtshan nyid pa yin pas mnyam rjes so sor 'byed pa'o// ro gcig dus su mnyam rjes 'dres// zhes pa mnyam bzhag gi dus snang stong sogs gnyis chos thams cad gnyis med du gnas la/ rjes su'ang zung 'jug gi dran pas nam zin sgyu ma ltar snang stong gnyis med du 'char bas mnyam rjes 'dres pa'i tha snyad mdzad do// sgom med mnyam bzhag 'ba' zhig go /zhes pa snang ba'i 'char sgo yod kyang de mnyam bzhag gi ngang las 'char bas mnyam bzhag las gzhan du ma song bar mnyam bzhag 'ba' zhig tu bzhed do// dgu pa sgom pa'i dus bzhi ni/ rje sgom chung gis/ rtse gcig a 'thas sgom pa'i dus// zhes pa rang sa'i mnyam bzhag dus dran 'dzin thu re byas nas nyams myong ngos bzung can skyong zhing*/ rjes shes su'ang 'gyu dran gyis 'gugs sgom byed pa gtso che bas a 'thas su sgom pa'o// spros bral mnyam rjes sgom pa'i dus/ zhes pa gzung dran stobs bskyed de mnyam bzhag nam mkha' lta bu dang rjes thob sgyu ma lta bur bskyangs pas mnyam rjes gnyis su bsgom pa'o/ ro gcig zung 'jug bsgom pa'i dus// zhes pa snang stong dbyer med du shes pa'i yang dag gi dran pas mnyam rjes thams cad zung 'jug tu sgom pa'o// sgom med mngon du gyur pa'i dus/ zhes pa rtogs pa de nyid mthar phyin nas zung 'jug mngon du gyur pa gnyug ma chu bo'i rgyun gyi rnal 'byor du rtogs pa'o// bcu pa mnyam bzhag gi rtogs pas sgrib pa dag lugs bzhi ni// rje yang dgon pas// rtse gcig gi dus su gzugs kyi phung po dang bral/

sgo lnga'i rnam shes 'dag /ces pa ni gzugs snang gi ngo bo ma grub pas sgo lnga rang stong du 'char ba'o// spros bral dus su tshor ba dang*/ 'du shes kyi phung po dang*/ yid kyi rnam par shes pa 'dag /ces pa ni bde sdug byung tshor myong rig gi 'dzin pa stong gsal du dag pas tha snyad kyis gdags pa med pa'o// ro gcig gi dus su 'du byed kyi phung po dang*/ nyon mongs pa can gyi yid 'dag /ces pa/ 'dzin zhen kun sbyor gyi sems med pa dang*/ nga dang nga yir 'dzin pa thams cad gzhi rtsa med par rtogs pa'o// sgom med kyi dus su rnam par shes pa'i phung po dang*/ kun gzhi'i rnam par shes pa 'dag /ces pa/ nges shes ngos bzung gi yul gyi myong 'dzin med pa dang*/ rtog med lung ma bstan dag nas rtog med rang gsal du shar ba'o// bcu gcig pa nyams rtogs kyi sa mtshams bzhi ni/ rtse gcig nyams rtogs dri ma can// zhes pa 'dzin zhen 'ching ba dang bcas pa kho na'o// spros bral nyams rtogs ru shan phyed// ces pa rtogs pa brtan pa yul med shar bas nyams rtogs ma 'dres par rig pa'o// ro gcig nyams rtogs zung du 'jug /ces pa nyams myong de nyid rtogs par shar bas dbyer med ro gcig pa'o// sgom med rtogs pa khor yug ma/ zhes pa ni gnyis med la rgyun chad med pa'i ye shes mngon du gyur pa'o// bcu gnyis pa kun rdzob rgyu 'bras kyi mkhyen tshul bzhi la/ rtse gcig gi dus rgyu 'bras a 'thas/ zhes pa rig pa shin tu dwangs sing nge ba'i 'char sgo la rgyu 'bras phra rags la 'phrig tshud kyang dngos po kun la bden 'dzin du yod pa'o// spros bral gyi dus su rgyu 'bras sgyu ma lta bu/ zhes pa sems nyid gshis stong nyid skye 'gag 'gyur ba med pa'i mdangs 'gag med rten 'brel sgyu ma lta bu'i rgyu 'bras su go ba'o// ro gcig gi dus su rgyu 'bras nam mkha' lta bu/
