zhes pa ni/ chos dbyings ye dag stong pa chen po'i stong nyid las rtsal 'gags med rten 'brel 'byung ba'o// sgom med kyi dus su gzhi med kyi rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba/ zhes pa dbyings rang bzhin rnam par dag pa'i ye shes ji lta ba las/ gdangs 'gag med ji snyed pa rten cing 'brel 'byung mngon du gyur pa la gnyis snang dbyer med par mkhyen pa'o// gnyis pa khyad par gzhan bshad pa la/ ngo bo'i khyad par/ mnyam rjes kyi khyad par/ gnyen po'i khyad par/ spang bya'i khyad par/ gnas lugs rtogs pa'i khyad par lnga las// dang po ngo bo'i khyad par ni/ rang sems gshis chos kyi skur ma rtogs pa rtse gcig rtogs pa spros bral te khyad par dang*/ rang sems chos sku gshis mdangs dbyer med/ de las yul snang chos kun zung 'jug tu ma shar ba spros bral/ yul snang chos kun so ma nyams mdog ma bsgyur bar zung 'jug ngo bor lam mer shar ba ro gcig ste khyad par dang*/ yang nges shes 'dzin 'khris phra mo gcig yod pa ro gcig /de yang dag ste thams cad ye shes kyi 'khor yug gcig pa sgom med de khyad par// gnyis pa mnyam rjes kyi khyad par ni/ rtse gcig gi mnyam rjes ni gnas mi gnas kyis 'byed/ bde gsal mi rtog par gnas pa mnyam bzhag /mi gnas pa rjes thob/ yengs na rjes shes/ spros bral gyi mnyam rjes dran ma dran gyis 'byed de/ rang ngo gsal la gnas pa mnyam bzhag /de nas shes bzhin rang mdangs 'phro ba rjes thob/ rtog pa'i dbang du shor ba rjes shes/ ro gcig gi mnyam rjes 'dzin mi 'dzin te snang rig sems gsum 'dzin med rjen par gnas pa mnyam bzhag /'dzin med las mi g.yo bzhin rang mdangs sna tshogs su 'char ba rjes thob/ de yang nyin par 'dzin pa phra mo zhugs pa'am khyad par gnyid dus 'dzin pa dang bcas pa ste rjes shes/ sgom med la mnyam rjes ya bral med kyang*/ phra zhing phra ba'i 'dzin pa phra mo yod med yin gsungs 'dug

/gsum pa gnyen po'i khyad par ni/ rtse gcig gi dus su rang sems ma bcos rang lugs kyi ngang du mnyam par bzhag pas bde gsal mi rtog pa'i nyams skyes pas spang bya nyon mongs pa rnam rtog shugs chad de rang grol gnyen por bsgom pa yin/ spros bral gyi dus su dran pas zin nas rnam rtog chos skur shar yang brjed bar du rjes shes langs pa de ngos 'dzin gyis skyong ba spang bya gnyen por bsgom/ ro gcig gi dus sems nyid nam mkha' lta bu'i ngang las ma g.yos bzhin du dran snang sna tshogs su 'char la/ 'char tsam nyid nas sems nyid chos sku'i ngang du rtogs nas zung 'jug gnyen por bsgom/ sgom med kyi dus yid byed blo yi 'dzin pa dang bral/ chos nyid zad sar 'khyol bas ci yang bsgom du med pa yin no// bzhi pa spang bya spong ba'i khyad par ni/ rtse gcig gi dus nyams bzang po skye bas 'dod yon la zhen pa ldog /spros bral gyi dus gnas lugs go bas tshe 'di blos thongs/ ro gcig gi dus snang ba sems su shes pas 'jig rten chos brgyad mgo snyoms/ sgom med kyi dus blo zad chos zad du song bas dri ma phra mo thams cad kyang dag pa'o// lnga pa gnas lugs rtogs pa'i khyad par ni/ rtse gcig gi dus snang ba sems su rtogs/ spros bral gyi dus phyi nang rten 'brel chos rnams stong pa nyid du rtogs/ ro gcig gi dus ngo bo stong pa nyid de phyi nang srid zhi'i chos rten 'brel sna tshogs su rtogs/ sgom med kyi dus su stong pa dang rten 'brel yang mnyam nyid yang dag tu rtogs pa'o// yang*/ rje dwags po rin po ches/ rtse gcig gi rnal 'byor ni gsal la ma 'gag pa skad cig ma'i shes pa de yin/ spros bral gyi rnal 'byor ni rig pa'i ngo bo skye med du mthong bas/ yar sangs rgyas la mi re/ mar 'khor ba la mi dogs/ bar du snang ba la mi 'dzin/ gzhan gyis bsgyur du mi btub pa'o// ro gcig gi rnal 'byor ni snang stong dbyer med du rtogs pa'o// sgom med kyi rnal 'byor ni cir snang cir skyes ngo bo gcig tu shar nas dran rtogs thams cad bsgom du song ba yin gsungs/

yang*/ rje rgya ras kyis/ rtse gcig nyams kyi mtho dman yin// 'jig rten lam ste las rnams sogs// spros bral pha yul mthong ba yin// phal cher sgom la res 'jog byed// ro gcig snang ba bsgom du shar// 'khor yug ma ru song ba yin// sgom med chos sku'i gdan sa yin// phal cher sgom med btags par song*// zhes rtse gcig 'jig rten pa'i lam dang*/ spros bral gzhi'i gnas lugs mthong ba dang*/ ro gcig snang ba sgom shar dang*/ sgom med chos sku dngos yin pa dang*/ deng sang gi sgom med phal cher btags pa bar bzhed pa dang*/ yang de nyid kyis/ rtse gcig bskyangs yun ring lags na// 'dod yon zhen pa dbang med bzlog /mngon shes rdzu 'phrul la sogs pa// drang srong yon tan cha shas tsam// spros bral rtogs pa bskyangs ba na// rdzun snang nges med ltad mor che// sbyong stobs dbang po rno brtul gyis// sems dpa'i yon tan cha shas 'byung*// zhen med snying rje 'char thang yin// ro gcig bskyangs yun ring lags na// sangs rgyas zhing khams ltad mor che// 'dre log spyi gtsug gar song yang*// rgyal po gdan las g.yo ba med/ rgyu 'bras rten 'brel shar tshe la// nyi ma'i gung la za 'og bkram// sangs rgyas yon tan cha shas tsam// 'gro don dpag tu med pa 'byung*// sgom med rab tu song tsam na// mdzad pa mthar 'don yon tan 'byung*// zhes rnal 'byor bzhi bsgoms pas so so'i rtags dang yon tan 'char tshul rnams gsungs la/ yang*/ rje rgod tshang pa'i zhal nas/ yul med kyi rig pa rang gsal 'di// goms nas mngon du gyur pa la// rnal 'byor bzhi ru btags nas gda'// don ni ye shes zang thal lags// zhes gsungs so// grub thob gtsang smyon pa'i zhal gdams/ snang grags kyi chos thams cad thol skyes kyi rig pa skad cig ma'i steng du rdzogs shing tshang la/ de yang gzhi lam 'bras gsum mam rnal 'byor bzhi'i ngo bo la gnas te/

tshogs drug gi snang ba zhig shar tsam na ngang las mi g.yo bas na rtse gcig /rtse gcig pa'i dus na mtshan 'dzin gyi spros pa dang bral bas na spros bral/ spros pa dang bral ba'i dus na 'khor 'das mnyam nyid ro gcig pas na ro gcig /ro gcig pa'i dus na blos las 'das pas na sgom med do// yang thol skyes kyi rnam rtog so ma la gra chag zur nyams med pa rtse gcig /rang ngo shes pa spros bral/ gsal stong zung 'jug tu myong ba ro gcig /blo 'das chen por grol ba sgom med do// yang na/ so ma nyams pa rtse gcig /lhug pa spros bral/ rang dwangs ro gcig /brjod bral sgom med do// yang na/ skye med las mi 'da' ba rtse gcig /'gag med du 'char ba spros bral/ gnyis med du myong ba ro gcig /myong dag tu 'gro ba sgom med do// zhes gsungs so// mdor na mnyam bzhag la ji tsam 'dod pa gnas thub pa rtse gcig /tha mal gyi shes pa rang ngo shes shing gzhi rtsa med par rtogs pa la spros bral/ 'khor 'das gnyis snang gi 'dzin pa rig thog tu grol ba ro gcig /nges shes bag chags kyi dri ma thams cad dag pa la sgom med zer ba ste/ rnal 'byor bzhi yi ngo bo 'dir 'dus shing*/ rnal 'byor gong ma gsum la/ rje phag mo gru pa'i zhal gdams/ dpal stag lung thang pa'i bzhed pa/ grub thob gtsang pa smyon pa'i gsung rgyun ni 'di lta ste/ de la don rnam pa dgu ste/ dang po rtogs lugs gsum ni/ spros bral rang bzhin skye med du rtogs/ ro gcig ngo bo zung 'jug tu rtogs/ sgom med kyis mtshan nyid gnyis med du rtogs so/ gnyis pa bral lugs gsum ni/ spros bral 'khor ba'i rtog rgya dang bral/ ro gcig rnam smin gyi lus rgya dang bral/ sgom med bag chags kyi snang rgya dang bral// gsum pa mngon gyur gsum ni/ spros bral du rags pa'i rgyu 'bras mngon du gyur/ ro gcig tu phra ba'i rgyu 'bras mngon du gyur/

sgom med du dag pa'i rgyu 'bras mngon du gyur pa'o// bzhi pa dag lugs gsum ni/ spros bral dus nyon mongs pa'i sgrib pa dag /ro gcig dus las kyi sgrib pa dag /sgom med dus shes bya'i sgrib pa dag go// lnga pa rtogs lugs gsum ni/ spros bral dus su chos skur rtogs/ ro gcig dus su 'ja' lus kyi skur rtogs/ sgom med sku gsum mngon du rtogs so// drug pa lus gsum ni/ spros bral smon lam gyi lus/ ro gcig ting nge 'dzin gyi lus/ sgom med phrin las kyi lus so// bdun pa 'char lugs gsum ni/ spros bral du snang med shes rab dang po 'char/ ro gcig tu bar pa 'char/ sgom med du gsum pa 'char ro// brgyad pa ldan lugs gsum ni/ spros bral rtsol bcas kyi snying rjer ldan/ ro gcig rtsol med kyi snying rjer ldan/ sgom med dmigs med kyi snying rjer ldan no// dgu pa dus gsum ni/ spros bral dus su rnam rtog chos skur shar/ ro gcig dus su rnam rtog bsgom du shar/ sgom med bya rtsol thams cad dbyings su thim ste ye shes rang la grub pa'o// gnyis pa rnal 'byor bzhi bye brag so sor bshad pa la/ dang po rnal 'byor bzhi la so sor dbye ba byung tshul dang*/ gnyis pa dbye ba de nyid bshad pa'o// dang po so sor dbye ba byung tshul ni// rtsa ba ni sngon bshad ltar mdo rgyud bstan bcos rnams las/ gsal bar bstan kyang rgya bod kyi bla ma rnams kyis rang bab las ched du bstan par ma mdzad mod/ deng sang nyams len pa rnams la go bde bar mdzad pa'i bka' drin che ba ni/ rje sgam po pas mdzad pa yin la/ rje sgom tshul la gnang ba'i zhal gdams su rnal 'byor bzhi po so so la rab 'bring tha mar phye ba zhig 'byung ba dang*/ phag grus zhus lan du'ang bstan/ de nas sgom tshul gyis rnal 'byor bzhi tshigs bcad mdor bsdus gsungs/ rje phag grus rnal 'byor bzhi la dbye ba mdzad/

de bzhin du bla ma zhang rin po ches kyang mdo tsam gsungs/ gzhan yang dwags po'i slob ma yang slob rnams dang*/ phag gru'i slob ma 'bri stag sogs kyis kyang rnal 'byor bzhi rim bstan par mdzad pa mtha' yas mod// rang lugs khyad par ni/ 'gro ba'i mgon po gtsang pa rgya ras kyis rnal 'byor bzhi gsum bcu gnyis/ shan 'byed bcu gsum sa lam dang sbyar ba rnams mdzad/ de'i slob brgyud/ stod 'brug /smad 'brug /gdan sa brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams kyis kyang rnal 'byor bzhi'i gsung sgros/ zhal gdams/ gzhung dbye ba mang du mdzad pas/ deng sang sgrub brgyud rin po che 'di nyid la yongs su grags shing dge sbyor gyi nyams rtogs mtho dman dang dbye 'byed la shin tu skabs su babs la ngo mtshar che bar snang ngo*// de'ang rje phag mo gru pas/ rnal 'byor bcu gnyis su 'byed tshul 'di nyid grags che bar snang bas de'i tshul ni/ rtse gcig chung ngu sems bde gsal gyi ngo bo mthong ba dang*/ 'bring po ting nge 'dzin de la rang dbang thob pa dang*/ chen po de'i 'khor yug tu song ba dang*/ spros bral chung ngu rang sems skye med du rtogs pa dang*/ 'bring po rtsa ba bral bar rtogs pa dang*/ chen po phyi nang thams cad la sgro 'dogs chod pa dang*/ ro gcig chung ngu 'khor 'das gcig tu 'dres pa dang*/ 'bring po gzung 'dzin gyi rtsa ba chod pa dang*/ chen po chos thams cad mnyam nyid kyi ngang du zhi ba dang*/ sgom med chung ngu bsgom bya sgom byed dang bral ba dang*/ 'bring po lhun grub kyi rang sa zin pa dang*/ chen po 'od gsal gnyis med 'dres pa la bzhed de/ de dag gi don ni 'chad 'gyur las shes so// rnal 'byor bcu gnyis po de dag la them skas kyi rim pa lta bur ni ma nges te/ dper na rtse gcig chen po'i nyams rtogs ma rdzogs par spros bral chung 'bring ci rigs 'char ba dang*/ spros bral chen po'i nyams rtogs ma rdzogs par ro gcig chung 'bring ci rigs 'char ba dang*/

ro gcig chen po'i nyams rtogs ma rdzogs par sgom med chung 'bring ci rigs 'char ba'ang yod pas bshad tshod thams cad go rim ltar 'byung bar mi mngon no// de ltar na nyams rtogs 'char tshul phal cher sngar gyi sgrub brgyud pa rnams kyis dben pa kho na brten zhing sgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan btsugs pa'i thugs nyams las 'khrungs pa dang*/ de yang gang zag rim gyis pa'i dbang du mdzad nas gsungs pas cig car ba dang*/ thod brgal ba la mtha' gcig tu ma nges shing*/ khyad par deng sang gi sgrub pa po phal cher ni le lo dang rnam g.yeng gi dbang du 'chor bar snang bas/ ji skad gsungs pa'i 'char tshul rnams 'byung bar ma nges so// 'on kyang skyes stobs kyi shes rab che ba dang*/ rgyud la bla ma'i byin rlabs zhugs pa dag la rtogs pa'i ngo bo ji lta ba deng sang yang 'char ba dang*/ de'i dge sbyor gyi tshad 'dzin pa la gal che bar snang bas sgrub brgyud gong ma rnams kyi gsung la brten nas bshad par bya'o// gnyis pa dbye ba de nyid bshad pa la/ dang po rtse gcig gi rnal 'byor bshad pa/ gnyis pa spros bral gyi rnal 'byor bshad pa/ gsum pa ro gcig gi rnal 'byor bshad pa/ bzhi pa sgom med kyi rnal 'byor bshad pa'o// dang po rtse gcig gi rnal 'byor bshad pa la/ dang po rtse gcig gi ngo bo bshad pa/ gnyis pa rtse gcig gi nyams myong bshad pa/ gsum pa rtse gcig gi gol sa bshad pa/ bzhi pa rtse gcig gi rnam dbye bshad pa/ lnga pa rtse gcig gi skyong thabs bogs 'don bshad pa/ drug pa rtse gcig gi sa mtshams bshad pa'o// dang po rtse gcig gi ngo bo bshad pa ni/ de yang rtse gcig ces pa'i don ni/ rang sems gnas lugs kyi don las ma yengs pa'i dran pa rtse gcig pas sam/ gnas 'gyu 'dres pas rig pa rtse gcig pas na rtse gcig ces bya'o// 'o na gnas lugs kyi don ji lta ba spros bral du rtogs par bshad pa dang mi 'gal lam snyam na skyon med de/

bsgom bya rang sems tsam dang phyi nang gi chos thams cad kyi khyad par dang*/ nyams myong nges shes kyi yul 'dzin dang bcas pa dang*/ de dang bral ba sogs kyi khyad par shin tu che ba'o// kha cig zhi gnas la sems rtse gcig par bshad pa dang*/ de'i skabs su sems rtog med kyi ngang du rtse gcig tu gnas shing shes bzhin gyi gsal ngar sa le yod pa la skabs 'dir rtse gcig tu 'khrul pa dang*/ 'ga' zhig zhi gnas de nyid kyi thog tu stong nyid kyi go ba skyes pa'i nges shes yod pa la 'khrul pa dag snang yang*/ snga ma ni shin tu mi 'thad de/ zhi gnas skyon med tsam shar yang lhag mthong gi nges shes gtan nas med pa'i phyir ro// phyi ma'ang min te/ stong nyid la blo kha phyogs pa'i go shes tsam las/ sems nyid ngo bo mthong ba'i lhag mthong gi nges shes dang mi ldan pa'i phyir ro/ des na 'di la sems ngo mthong pa'i mthong don la rig pa rtse gcig tu gnas pa zhig dang*/ gnas 'gyu ro mnyam du 'dres shing rang ngo shes pa'i dran rig yod pa zhig dgos te/ rtse gcig dus su ngo bo rtogs/ zhes dang*/ rje yang dgon pas/ blo rtog pa ru 'gyu ba gnas lugs kyi sgo/ rang ngo shes pa nyams len gyi gnad/ rang zhal dang mjal bas rang dang 'dres/ rang min pa'i dran rtog cig 'dug gam ltos dang*/ sgom gnas 'gyu'i bar lag 'dre ba zhig 'ong gi /zhes rtse gcig skyong tshul du bshad pa bzhin rtogs dgos pa'o// gnyis pa rtse gcig gi nyams myong bshad pa ni/ rtse gcig chung ngu'i dus/ sems gsal stong bde nyams dang bcas pa'i mnyam bzhag ngos bzung can/ zhen 'dzin dang bcas skyong rgyu 'byung la/ nyams de'i ngang nas rtog pa dang snang ba 'char ba na phal cher tshugs mi thub par rang sangs rang grol du 'gro zhing*/ sgom yin snyam pa'i blo nges shes kyi 'dzin pa'ang skye/ skabs la lar rtog pa grol mi thub pa'ang 'byung*/ rjes snang phal cher dga' spro'i nyams dang bcas te a 'thas su 'char/

rjes shes su dran pas ni zin/ gsal stong gi nyams dang bcas te stong pa yin sems snang yin snyam pa'i 'dzin stangs 'byung*/ rmi lam gsal dwangs thon tsam las sngar gyi rmi lam dang khyad cher mi 'ong*/ 'ga' zhig la rmi lam grangs mang zhing ngos bzung chung ba 'ong*/ zhes mnyam par 'jog dka' zhing nga la sgom mi skye ba 'dra snyam pa 'byung zhing*/ res sgom bzang po skye ba 'dra snyam pa'ang 'byung bas dge sbyor 'phel 'grib che/ bla ma la mos gus/ mched grogs la dag snang*/ sems can la snying rje skye'o// rtse gcig 'bring po'i dus/ gsal stong bde nyams dang bcas pa'i ting nge 'dzin de nam bsgom bsgom brtan po 'byung zhing*/ res ma bsgoms kyang ting nge 'dzin du cham gyis 'gro/ nyams de'i ngang nas rtog snang 'char ba sngar bas nyung zhing gang shar rang grol du 'gro/ rjes snang gsal stong gi nyams dang bcas pas snang ba gu yangs seng nge ba 'byung*/ res a 'thas su'ang 'char/ rtog pa thol skyes thams cad ngos zin pa tsam gyis gnas steng du yal 'gro ba/ de'i stobs kyis sgom snying shin tu 'dod pa 'byung*/ rmi lam du nyams kyis slebs ma slebs ci rigs 'byung*/ 'ga' zhig la rmi lam nyung du 'gro ba'ang 'ong*/ sgom la spro ba skye'o// rtse gcig chen po'i dus/ gsal stong nyams ldan gyi ting nge 'dzin de rgyun chad med par shar bas/ rtog pa mang po 'phro mi thub par gnas pa'i ngang du rang zhir 'gro ste gnas pa g.yo 'gul mi nus pa 'byung*/ rmi lam phal cher de'i ngang du chud de bzang zhan gyi 'dzin pa dang bcas pa'i nges shes la/ sems bde stong rig stong rnam rtog gsal stong snang ba snang stong sogs kyi stong nyams mang po dang*/ chos thams cad rmi lam sgyu ma lta bur 'dug snyam pa'i nyams myong mang du 'char/ mngon shes phra mo sogs zag bcas kyi yon tan 'ga' re yang skye/ goms nas khor yug tu song bas sgom med du rlom pa'ang 'byung*/

mos gus dang dag snang sogs skye'o// gsum pa rtse gcig gi gol sa skyon sel bshad pa ni/ tshul 'di'i gol sa skyon sel rgyas par bshad zin la/ 'dir skabs bab kyi don mtshon tsam ni/ 'ga' zhig gnas 'gyu'i spu ris gsal por mi mthong bar thog ma nas brjed rgyu dang yengs rgyu mi 'dug zer nas/ phyogs gcig bsrungs nas sdod pa yong bas 'di la zhi gnas lteng por 'dod/ sgom du byas na bskal par bskyangs kyang yon tan mi skye dud 'gro'i rgyur yang gsungs/ 'di'i gegs sel la dran shes shugs bskyed nas snang thog tu rtsal sbyangs/ yang la lar rnam rtog thol skyes pa dang de ngos 'dzin mkhan gyi dran pa re rtse 'phrod na spangs gnyen brang 'phrod zer/ sbyor lam pa'i nyams len dngos gzhir yong*/ 'di tsam skyes pa mang po 'ga' zhig gis gang shar skyong gin yod zer nas ngo thog tu rlom pa 'dug kyang*/ 'di ga rang bskyang rung dge sbyor la skyed ye mi yong bas na spang dgos/ rtse gcig gi nyams 'dis kun rtog thams cad mgo mnan nas re zhig ldang 'dug med kyang nyams yal nas ro langs yong bas 'gyur ba ldog pa lcags mes bsregs pa lta bu zhes gsungs/ nyams der rlom zhen gyi nges shes skye zhing de la 'thas na nyams rtog par shor ba'i gol sa shin tu che zhing sgrub pa po rnam dpyod dman pa bla ma bsten yun thung ba dag /nyams myong gi rtsi la 'byar nas mi tsher sgrub lo byas kyang sems ngo mi shes pa dang*/ dang por shes kyang shor ba 'ong ste/ rje sgam po pas/ rtogs pa med pa'i lta ba de// mtha' bral zer yang blos byas yin// rdos thag ma chod sgom chen de// ting 'dzin bzang yang 'khor ba'i rgyu// zhes dang*/ rje 'bri gung pas/ nyams myong bzang po ma bcos pa// lha gnas gong mar skye ba'i rgyu// zhes pa ltar ro// nyams de zhen med du bskyangs na yon tan thams cad kyi gzhi ma'am rtsa bar 'ong*/

sems kyi gnas lugs rjen pa de nyid la'ang blo yi zhen chags dang 'dzin pa ma zhugs pa gal che ste/ bram ze chen pos/ gang la zhen pa yod na de yang thong*// zhes dang*// rje sgam po pas/ gnyis 'dzin can gyi sgom chen de// nyams su myong yang don ma yin// zhes so// 'ga' zhig nyams de zhig nas tha mal du khres se 'gro bas/ nga'i sgom bor snyam nas/ rtsol ba byas kyang sngar bzhin mi 'ong*/ ci grags byas kyang rdul tsam mi yong*/ 'di nyams dag mtshams su ngo sprod par gsungs pa de yin pas rig thog tu ngo 'phrod dgos/ ngo sprod ma byung na rtog pa'i mgo gnon mkhan med pas skye bo tha mal pa dang lta spyod bstun nas las kyi rjes su 'brangs pas ngan song sogs su skye ba'ang srid gsungs/ gal srid bla ma dang yang thag 'gyang zhing rtogs ldan nyams myong can yang ma rnyed na/ gzhan spras spros gang yang mi byed par/ rang gi bla ma la blo gtad ling bskyur gyis/ gsol 'debs la brtson na byin rlabs zhugs nas rtogs pa ngo 'phrod par 'byung ba'o// bzhi pa la rtse gcig gi rnam dbye bshad pa la gsum ste/ dang po rtse gcig rnam pa gsum bshad pa/ gnyis pa rtse gcig rnam pa bzhi bshad pa/ gsum pa rtse gcig rnam pa drug bshad pa'o// dang po rtse gcig rnam pa gsum bshad pa ni/ sems kyi ngo bo gsal stong gi bde nyams dang bcas pa'i ting nge 'dzin skyes shing*/ de skyong dka' ba tsam nas bzung ste nam sgom sgom 'ong ba'i bar rtse gcig chung ngu*/ res ma bsgom kyang ting nge 'dzin de 'char zhing*/ sgom pa'i tshe brtan por 'ong bas rang dbang thob pa rtse gcig 'bring po// ting nge 'dzin de'i nyams rgyun chad med par shar te mnyam rjes dang spyod lam nyin mtshan khor yug tu rig pa gsal stong de'i ngang du cham gyis 'gro ba rtse gcig chen po'o// gnyis pa rnal 'byor bzhi po bzhi bzhi bcu drug tu dbye ba las/

dang po rtse gcig gi rnam dbye bzhi ni/ dang po phra rags kyi rtog pa zhi nas gsal stong ngang du gnas pa rtse gcig gi rtse gcig/ gnyis pa gnas pa'i ngo bo la mtshan 'dzin gyi sgro 'dogs chod pa rtse gcig gi spros bral/ gsum pa bde gsal mi rtog pa gsum ka la spang blang med par zung du 'jug pa rtse gcig gi ro gcig /bzhi pa myong mkhan gyi shes pa ma grub par shes pa de rtse gcig gi sgom med do// gsum pa rnal 'byor bzhi po drug bzhi nyer bzhir dbye ba las/ dang po rtse gcig rnam pa drug bshad pa ni/ rje rgya ras kyi rnam dbye mdzad pa de ltar bshad na/ dang po ngo bo mthong ma mthong ni/ sems kyi ngo bo cir yang grub pa med pas na stong pa/ stong zhing 'char sgo ma 'gags pas na gsal ba ste gsal stong dbyer med nam mkha' dwangs pa'i dkyil lta bu'i shes pa de la yid ches shing*/ de nyid rang gis rang rig cing rtog med du nges shes skyes na rtse gcig gi ngo bo mthong*/ sems bde gsal mi rtog pa'i nyams kyi ngang du sa le sing nge gnas pa tsam 'dug kyang rang rig pa'i ye shes la nges shes kyi 'phrig ma tshud na/ lhag mthong gi nyams dang ma 'brel/ snang la ma nges pa'i nyams myong byis pas chu zla mthong ba lta bu yin te ngo bo ma mthong*/ gnyis pa rtsal rdzogs ma rdzogs mnyam bzhag bde gsal mi rtog pa'i ting nge 'dzin rang rig nges shes dang bcas pa'i ngang la nam bzhag bzhag yong na rtsal rdzogs/ res bsgoms kyang mi yong*/ res ma bsgoms kyang yong na da rung rtsal ma rdzogs/ gsum pa rnam rtog bsgom du shar ma shar ni/ rnam rtog skyes tshad ngos zin pa tsam gyis sgom de'i ngang du kyur gyi 'gro zhing gnyid nyams kyi 'od gsal du tshud na rnam rtog bsgom du shar/ gzung dran gyi dran pas kyang rnam rtog zhi ma nus par sgom lcags kyu mas bkug cing slar bsgom la bzhag dgos na rnam rtog bsgom du ma shar/

bzhi pa yon tan skyes ma skyes ni/ gnas pa des phyi rol gyi yul la blo mi 'jug pas 'jig rten chos brgyad las blo log pa dang*/ phyi nang gi srin bu'i rgyun spangs mngon shes cung zad dang zad par zil gnon la sogs pa'i rdzu 'phrul ston nus na rtse gcig gi yon tan skyes/ sems las su mi rung zhing yid zhi ba ma thob na sgom gyi dwangs snyigs ma phyed cing thun mong gi drod rtags 'byin ma nus na yon tan ma skyes/ lnga pa kun rdzob la rang byan tshud ma tshud ni/ ting nge 'dzin dwangs pa'i 'char sgo'i rjes shes su phyi nang gi rgyu 'bras phra rags mi bslu bar 'byung ba'i rten 'brel la phrig tshud nas blang dor tshul bzhin bsgrubs na kun rdzob la rang byan tshud/ de lta bu'i rten 'brel nges pa ma rnyed cing rgyu 'bras kyi blang dor la g.yel na rang byan ma tshud/ drug pa gzugs sku'i sa bon thebs ma thebs ni/ sgom de'i mdangs la sems can rnams la dmigs bcas kyi snying rje skye zhing*/ gzhan phan gyi smon lam rgya chen po 'debs nus na gzugs sku'i sa bon thebs/ ting nge 'dzin gyi nyams ci rigs kyis bsgribs nas snying rje skye dka' zhing rang nyid gcig pu'i zhi bde don du gnyer na gzugs sku'i sa bon ma thebs pa'o// lnga pa rtse gcig gi skyong thabs bogs 'don bshad pa ni/ rtse gcig gsum ka'i dus su ri mtshams dang*/ 'dag sbyar dang*/ smra bcad la brtson par bya'o// grib che ba phog na blo las su mi rung zhing shes rab 'grib pas dkor grib la 'dzem/ grib chung yang ting nge 'dzin mi gsal zhing de'i gegs skyon mang du 'byung bas grib la shin tu 'dzem zhing gtsang sbra dang spyod lam gzab/ grib phog na grib sel bya/ sems ma yengs pa rtse gcig lhod cha yang yod pa/ bzang ngan ji ltar gyi nyams shar yang rang ngor gnyis 'dzin dgag sgrub med pa'i ngang nas rang ngo shes bzhin du skyong*/

'ga' zhig la bying rgod phal cher la so so'i skyon sel thabs dang*/ ngo blta mang du bya/ ha cang rmugs na skyon che bas sdig bshags ci rigs bya/ bla ma la dbang zhu ba dang ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang mang du blangs/ tshogs 'khor dang mchod 'bul dang sbyin gtong bya zhing*/ bla ma dang mched grogs nyams can la zhus te skyon bsal/ ha cang skyon che zhing bla ma dang mched grogs la zhu mi 'dod pa dang*/ log lta skyes pa byung na bdud kyi bar chad yin pas skyabs 'gror rem par bya/ skyo shas nges 'byung mos gus dag snang snying rje rnams rtsal du bton nas sgom/ zhag grangs 'ga' re dub bsangs bya zhing lus sbyong ci rigs kyang bya'o// de nas ting nge 'dzin de sngar bshad pa ltar 'gyur dran dang bzung dran ci rigs pas so byas nya sgug pa ltar rtse gcig tu skyong*/ rtog dpyod kyi go yul dang*/ mi rtog pa'i gnas pa dang*/ myong ba'i nyams dang*/ rjes shes kyi snang shes rnams kyi rjes su mi 'brangs/ nyams bzang ba la zhen pa dang*/ ngan pa la skyon blta mi bya bar blo gang shar la dgag sgrub kyi 'dzin pa ma zhugs par bskyang*/ nyams mthug na ngo thog la sgrib pas nyams kyi rlan dang yang yang phral te/ rig pa ngar bskyed la bzo bcos ma phog pa'i shes pa so ma de nyid skyong*/ skabs su sgrub brgyud gong ma rnams kyis dka' spyad snying rus kyi sgo nas sgrub tshugs bzung ba'i rnam thar dang*/ rdo rje'i mgur la sogs pa'ang bltas te/ rang yang de lta bu'i rnam thar skyong ba'i snying stobs bskyed pa sogs bya'o// rtse gcig gi rnal 'byor lo mang por bskyangs kyang spros bral du bogs ma thon na/ zhen pa gsum gtong bar gsungs te/ bdag tu zhen pa btang ba ni tshe 'di'i chags zhen gyi rdos thag bcad la mi khyu nas bud/ dgra gnyen gyi chags sdang dor zhing 'jig rten gyi 'khri ba btang*/ lus bla ma la 'bul/ phung po'i gces 'dzin skabs ku su lu'i mchod sbyin mang du bya'o// longs spyod la zhen pa btang ba ni/

nor rdzas ci yod bla ma mnyes pa'i 'bul ba/ yi dam lha tshogs mnyes pa'i mchod gtor dang tshogs 'khor/ rdo rje spun mnyes pa'i spong dag byas la/ skyid 'dod za 'dod 'phyor 'dod kyi 'dzom cha blos gtong*/ lto gos gtam gsum khyad du bsad/ sngar bshad pa'i ri dwags lta bu'i spyod pa la sogs pa bya/ chags sdang dang g.yeng ba can gyi gnas pha yul sogs spang*/ cis kyang spang ma tshugs na lo shas smra bcad bya'o// ting nge 'dzin la zhen pa btang ba ni/ dga' zhing spro la yid ches pa'i nyams bzang po thams cad bshig /gnas lugs la gang shar bzang ngan med par thag bcad de/ nyams dang bral ba'i sems nyid rjen pa rnal ma rang lugs ci yod de ka las gzhan du ma yengs shing mi sgom pa zhig dgos te/ rje sgam po pas/ dang po slob pa'i dus su shes pa gsal sing nge ba la bslab/ de yang ma yengs pa la bslab/ de yang rig pa'i ngo bo ma yengs pa la bslab/ de la goms tsa na rang la nges shes skye ba yin/ zhes dang*/ rje rgya ras kyis/ rtse gcig dus su song tsa na// nyams myong gzhig cing sgom med bsgom// zhes so// khyad par rtogs ldan bla ma mtshan nyid dang ldan pa la blo gtad ling bskyur gyis mos gus mtshan nyid pa nas/ gsol 'debs la dus dang rnam pa kun tu brtson par byas pas rim gyis dge sbyor la bogs thon te/ nam zhig nas rig pa dwangs snyigs phyed nyams myong gi zhen 'dzin dag nas sems kyi gnas lugs ji bzhin rtogs nas spros bral gyi rtogs pa 'char ba'o// drug pa rtse gcig gi sa mtshams bshad pa ni/ de yang rtse gcig man chad zag bcas/ spros bral 'di dgongs pa mnyam bzhag zag med/ rtse gcig phan chad rnam par rtog pa/ tshun chad rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes/ rtse gcig phan chad 'jig rten pa'i sgom/ de tshun 'jig rten las 'das pa/ rtse gcig phan chad mos pa spyod pa'i sa/ rtse gcig tshun chad nus pa spyod pa'i sa/

rtse gcig phan chad don dam btags pa/ tshun chad don dam mtshan nyid pa/ rtse gcig phan chad rjes dpag tshad ma/ spros bral tshun chad mngon sum tshad ma/ zhes sogs gsungs pa dang*/ rtse gcig chung ngu tshogs lam chung ngu*/ 'bring po'i skabs chos rgyun gyi ting nge 'dzin thob pas tshogs lam 'bring po dang chen po gnyis ka rdzogs/ rtse gcig chen po sbyor lam gyi ye shes skye bas sbyor lam ngo ma/ des na rtse gcig chen pos kyang 'jig rten chos mchog las ma bsgrod pas gsum ka 'jig rten pa'i sa yin pa'o/// /gnyis pa spros bral gyi rnal 'byor bshad pa la drug ste/ dang po spros bral gyi ngo bo nges tshig bshad pa/ gnyis pa spros bral gyi nyams myong bshad pa/ gsum pa spros bral gyi gol sa bshad pa/ bzhi pa spros bral gyi rnam dbye bshad pa/ lnga pa spros bral gyi skyong thabs bogs 'don bshad pa/ drug pa spros bral gyi sa mtshams bshad pa'o// dang po spros bral gyi ngo bo nges tshig bshad pa ni/ de la spros bral zhes pa'i don ni/ de yang rang gi sgrib pa dag pa dang*/ bla ma'i byin rlabs zhugs pas/ sems kho rang phyag rgya chen po'i ngo bor shes pa yong ba yin te/ sems kyang dga' yal ler 'ong zhing spong gnyen gnyis med du shes pas na/ sngon bzhin gnyen po dam po mi dgos par blo yangs rgyangs kyis 'gro/ sems ngo bo rang gsal las gang shar sna tshogs kyang rang bzhin yongs shes kyi klong du bsgyur nas bzhag chog pa las/ gzhan dgag sgrub ched 'dzin mi dgos/ des na brod pa skyes te/ de tsa na bla ma la'ang mos gus cher 'gro ste/ rang blo chos dang 'dres pa zhig 'ong ba yin/ 'di la/ rgyal ba yang dgon pas/ las 'phro sad pa/ byin rlabs zhugs pa/ nyams myong mthar phyin pa gsum gyi rten 'brel las/ ci zhig ltar na spros bral chos kyi bden pa mthong ba ste/ gang mthong na rang mthong*/ gang gis mthong na rang gis mthong*/

ji ltar mthong na yul yul can gnyis su med par mthong*/ 'das pa'i shes pa 'gags/ ma 'ongs pa'i shes pa ma skyes pa'i bar du/ da ltar gyi shes pa kho rang yul med du rang ngo shes pa'o// zhes dang*/ yang rtogs pa de'i skad cig la gzung 'dzin gyi shubs nas thon/ tshig tha snyad go ba nyams myong thams cad phyi shun spun par song zhes dang*/ gzhan yang*/ sems rnam rtog chos skur shar ba de// don spros bral chung ngu'i skye tshul yin// gnad che ba gang shar gyi thog tu gcun// zhes gsungs so// de yang rnam rtog chos sku zhes pa 'di spros bral rang dus chos sku sgrib med mtshan nyid pa mi rtogs par 'dug kyang 'dir rnam rtog chos sku zhes pa/ chos sku'i rang bzhin tsam gsungs pa yin/ de yang sems kyi ngo bo stong pa nyid chos sku/ de'i rang mdangs sna tshogs 'char ba de ltar mnyam nyid du shes/ bsgom bya sgom byed zung du chub nas gnas lugs rtogs pas na rnam rtog chos sku zer ba yin no// des na gang shar cir snang rang ngo thams cad rang bzhin yongs shes de las gzhan gdam ka skad cig kyang mi dgos pa'i blo yangs po yong*/ rang sems rang bzhin shes tsam rgyun de las gzhan ched du spang gnyen gnyis 'dzin gyi gnyen po brten mi dgos pa'i bsgom bya sgom byed mi dgos pas na bsgom bya bral ba zer/ yang rje gong ma rnams kyis rtogs pa'i gdings tshad 'di ltar gsungs te/ zag med kyi chos nyid mngon sum du mthong*/ 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal rang rgyud pa dang bral bas rab tu dga' ba'i sa/ 'khor 'das gnyis kyi sa mtshams 'byed/ the tshom gyi sgro 'dogs chod/ dus gsum gcig tu rtogs/ sems kyi skad cig don kun rig /phyi ru bltas na spros dang bral// nang du bltas na spros dang bral// shes pa rten med par rig pa gang la'ang ma reg pa/ spros pa thams cad dang bral ba/ rig pa'i ngo bo de shun pa 'dus pa dang 'dra ba'am/

ngo bo la snying po bcug pa lta bu zhig 'ong*/ de tsa na ngo bo rnyed pa yin/ ma rnyed na ngo ma shes pa yin/ dbul pos gter rnyed pa lta bu'i zag pa med pa'i dga' ba rgyas pa ste/ sems spro sing nge dga' sing nge ba zhig 'ong*/ de nas nan tan bskyed nas bsgoms pas 'khrul pa'i rtog pa thams cad sangs nas rtsol sgrub kyi nyams len dang bral ba'i rig pa spros med du song bas spros bral gyi rnal 'byor zer/ zhes dang*/ rje rgod tshang pas/ rtse gcig gi nyams dag nas rtogs pa rim gyis 'gro/ sna tshogs su shar ba rnams spros bral du rtogs nas dran pas zin pa dang*/ dran rtog gnyis ka dag nas tha mal du khres se 'gro ba 'di la sgom gyi ngo bo mthong ba zer ba yin/ zhes gsungs/ 'dir tha mal gsungs pa 'di la don gsum ste/ de yang dang po rtog pa'i tha mal ni/ rnam rtog skad cig 'di yin/ gnyis pa nyams kyi tha mal ni/ rtog pa de ngos bzung ba'i dran pa dang rtog pa gnyis ka dag nas yul med du sdod pa 'di yin zhing*/ de ni rtse gcig chen po'i rtogs pa spros bral chung ngu'i nyams da dung ngo bo ma mthong*/ gsum pa rtogs pa'i tha mal ni/ rtog pa skad cig ma'i ngo bo la 'khor 'das gnyis kas ma gos par ye nas rang la rang gsal du yod pa de ngos bzung bas rang zhi nas 'gro ste/ de yang dag ma dag la mi ltos par skad cig mar skyes la ma 'gag par rang ngo shes pa de yin par gsungs 'dug mod/ yang rje rgya ras kyis/ rtse gcig dang spros bral gyi khyad par rnam rtog chos skur shar ma shar yin/ gsungs pas/ rnam rtog de skye 'gag gnas gsum la ltos ring la sems kyi ngo bo mthong byas kyang gsha' ma rang ma mthong*/ sems kyi ngo bo gsha' ma mthong bas ni/ rtog pa de skye 'gag gnas gsum la skad cig kyang mi ltos par rang ngo grwa ma nyams pa gshis su 'char te rang shar rang grol zer rgyu de ka yong*/

de yang*/ gong ma rnams kyis/ sems skye 'gag gnas gsum dang bral te/ rig pa skad cig ma de rig pa'i thad nas ma 'gags/ stong pa'i thad nas ma skyes/ rig stong gnyis su med par gnas pa med/ dbyer med ces pa yang med pas blo las 'das pa ste/ de rang ngo shes pas nyon sgrib bral/ der 'dzin gyi dri ma med pas shes sgrib bral/ zhes gsungs so// 'dir kha cig gzung 'dzin gyi rtog pa'i spros pa med pa spros bral gyi don du 'dod pa dang*/ la la chos thams cad stong nyid du ngo shes pa'i nges shes spros bral gyi don du 'dod par snang yang mi 'thad de/ snga ma ltar na rtog med kyi zhi gnas tsam yang spros bral du 'gyur ba'i phyir dang*/ phyi ma ltar na/ stong nyid dang bden med kyi nges shes skyes pa'i zhen 'dzin yang spros bral du 'gyur ba'i phyir ro// des na spros bral gyi dus su sems kyi rang bzhin rtogs par gsungs shing*/ sems kyi rang bzhin ni nam mkha' ltar 'pho 'gyur med pa'i 'dus ma byas su bshad de/ mdo las/ zab zhi spros bral 'od gsal 'dus ma byas// zhes dang*/ rgyud bla mar/ sems kyi rang bzhin 'od gsal gang yin pa// de ni nam mkha' bzhin du 'gyur med de// zhes sogs gsungs pa'o// gnyis pa spros bral gyi nyams myong bshad pa ni/ chos thams cad kyi ngo bo skye 'gag gnas gsum gyi spros pa dang bral yang thams cad stong par 'dzin pa'i 'dzin pa yod la/ rjes shes su dgra gnyen dang chags sdang gi 'dzin pa a 'thas su skye zhing gnyid dang rmi lam phal cher yang 'khrul pa 'byung*/ dge sbyor la mtho dman che/ bla ma dang mched grogs dang rang gi dge sbyor la res dad pa dang nges shes skye/ res the tshom skye ba'ang srid do// spros bral 'bring gi dus stong 'dzin gyi nyams de dag nas gang la'ang zhen pa chung*/ rnam rtog bag chags kyi 'char sgo bkra hrig ge ba/ rig stong 'gyu stong dngos po'i chos su ma skyes/

dngos med kyi chos su ma 'gags/ tha dad kyi chos su mi gnas/ skye 'gag gnas gsum dang bral bar rtogs/ 'di'i skabs su rnam rtog gi rtsa ba chod nas 'gyu thog tu sgro 'dogs chod kyang snang thog tu a 'thas kyi re dogs dum re 'ong*/ rjes shes dang rmi lam gyi tshe 'khrul ma 'khrul sna tshogs 'byung*/ bla ma dang mched grogs dang dge sbyor la dad pa dang the tshom sogs kyi mtho dman dum re 'byung*/ res sangs rgyas thob rgyu dang dmyal bar skye rgyu med snyam pa'ang 'byung ngo*// spros bral chen po'i dus/ 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad kyi rtsa ba chod pas phyi nang thams cad la sgro 'dogs chod de re dogs med cing*/ chos thams cad la stong mi stong sogs kyi re dogs med par blo yangs phyal gyis 'gro/ snang ba thams cad kyang stong zhing bdag med par 'char/ rjes shes su rtog pa thams cad dag pas shes pa dwangs sing nge ba 'ba' zhig cung mi 'ong yang*/ rig stong snang stong gi nyams bzang po dang bcas te/ nyin par gyi sgom la rgyun chad med/ 'on kyang dran pas rgyun chad med par zin pa cung zad mi 'ong bas bzung dran re la ltos dgos/ rmi lam du 'khrul pa dang zin pa dum re 'ong*/ res sangs rgyas thob rgyu med dmyal bar skye rgyu med gnas lugs kyi don rtogs snyam pa 'ong*/ gting zab pa'i chos rnams kyang go /sems nyid bla mar 'char/ snang ba dge sbyor gyi grogs su'ang 'gro/ gang la'ang zhen pa chung chos brgyad las blo ldog /'on kyang da ni bla ma mi dgos snyam pa dang nga rgyal dang rlom sems dang*/ gzhan khyad du gsod pa sogs 'byung dogs yod par gsungs pa'o// gsum pa spros bral gyi gol sa gegs skyon sel ba bshad pa ni/ 'di'i skabs stong nyams che nas las rgyu 'bras sogs ma grub cing*/ mi bden par go nas blang dor 'chol bar spyod nyen yod pas/ spros bral med pa'i stong rdzis khyer zer ba'i gol sa yang 'dir 'ong ba yin/

rgyu 'bras stong nyid du shar ba zer/ ji lta ba'i sa bon thebs kyang*/ ji snyed pa'i sa bon rul/ don dam ngo shes kyang kun rdzob ngo ma shes pas/ nag po kha 'byams bdud kyi las zer/ de la las rgyu 'bras bslu med du shes pas rgyu 'bras la blang dor tshul bzhin bya ba dang*/ kun rdzob rten cing 'brel 'byung du shes pas bden gnyis mnyam 'khyer don la brtson/ gzhan yang 'dzin pa'i rjes su 'brangs na/ rtsa chad lo ma skam med 'ong bas/ sgom mi shul du khyi rjes 'byung ba dang*/ sgom skyes bdag po med pa zer/ des na sgom med yengs med la rtsal du 'don zhing*/ 'khor 'das bzang ngan 'char sgo sna tshogs snang tsam du 'dzin med spang blang med par bskyang dgos pa'o// bzhi pa spros bral gyi rnam dbye bshad pa la/ dang po spros bral rnam pa gsum bshad pa dang*/ gnyis pa spros bral rnam pa bzhi bshad pa/ gsum pa spros bral rnam pa drug bshad pa'o// dang po spros bral rnam pa gsum bshad pa ni/ sems kyi ngo bo skye 'gags kyi spros pa dang bral bar rtogs kyang de nyid stong par 'dzin pa'i nges shes kyi nyams myong dang ma bral zhing*/ 'khor bar 'khyams dogs dang myang 'das thob tu re ba'i re dogs yod pa spros bral chung ngu*/ sems snang 'dzin dang stong 'dzin gyi nyams myong dag pas sems nyid gzhi med rtsa bral du rtogs kyang*/ phyi'i yul snang gi thog tu re dogs kyi 'dzin pa 'ong zhing sgro 'dogs ma chod pa spros bral 'bring po/ snang srid 'khor 'das kyis bsdus pa'i phyi nang gi chos thams cad la stong 'dzin nges shes kyi 'dzin pa grol nas re dogs dang bral zhing sgro 'dogs chod pa spros bral chen po'o// gnyis pa rnal 'byor bzhi po bzhi bzhi bcu drug tu dbye ba las/ gnyis pa spros bral gyi dbye ba bzhi ni/ dang po rnam rtog gang shar skye med kyi ngang du 'gro ba spros bral gyi rtse gcig// gnyis pa tshogs drug gi yul snang mtshan mar ma grub cing de la 'dzin pa'i sgro 'dogs chod pa spros bral gyi spros bral/

gsum pa rnam rtog gang shar la spang blang med pa spros bral gyi ro gcig /bzhi pa stong nyid kyi myong ba dag pa spros bral gyi sgom med yin/ rnal 'byor bzhi po drug bzhi nyer bzhir dbye ba las/ gnyis pa spros bral gyi rnam dbye drug bshad pa la/ dang po ngo bo mthong ma mthong ni/ sems kyi ngo bo spros bral du mthong ba la/ nges shes kyi 'dzin pa grol/ spros bral du myong tshor mkhan po'i rtsa ba chod pas spros pa thams cad dag pa'i ngang du phyal gyis 'gro na spros bral gyi ngo bo mthong*/ de la stong 'dzin nam nges shes kyi cha thams cad ni spros bral gyi nyams yin/ spros bral du nyams rtogs kyang yul yul can gyi cha bag tsam 'dug na ngo bo ma mthong*/ gnyis pa rtsal rdzogs ma rdzogs ni/ 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad ngo shes pas re dogs dang stong 'dzin gyi cha tsam yang med par thams cad spros bral du sgro 'dogs chod na spros bral gyi rtsal rdzogs/ rnam rtog skye med du shes kyang yul snang gi thog tu re dogs dang stong 'dzin nyams ma dag na rtsal ma rdzogs/ gsum pa rnam rtog bsgom du shar ma shar ni/ gang shar gyi dran rtog thams cad stong 'gyu rig thog tu rtogs pa dang snang ba thams cad stong snang du ngo shes tsam gyi mnyam nyid du 'char nas rjes shes dang rjes snang thams cad mnyam bzhag gi rtogs pa lta bur 'char na rnam rtog bsgom du shar/ mnyam bzhag gi rtogs pa dran snang gi steng du ma byung par rjes shes dang rjes snang gi thog tu lam du mi slong na de'i dbang gis nyams thog tu dge sbyor mi 'drongs pas rnam rtog bsgom du ma shar/ bzhi pa yon tan skyes ma skyes ni/ thabs lam sogs yon tan sad byed kyi lam rkyen dang phrad nas grub pa'i rtags dang rtogs pa 'brel na spros bral gyi yon tan skyes/ chos nyid don rtogs kyang lam rkyen dang ma 'gyur bar grub rtags kyi snang cha med na yon tan ma skyes/

lnga pa kun rdzob la rang byan tshud ma tshud ni/ stong pa'i mdangs rgyu 'bras su rtogs pas gshis ci yang ma yin kyang*/ rkyen gyis cir yang byar btub pa'i rten 'brel chos thams cad tshogs pa las byung ba/ rkyen las skyes pa/ sgyu ma lta bu'i rgyu 'bras snang sems sgyu ma'i 'char sgor go na kun rdzob la rang byan tshud/ de kho na nyid la rmongs pa'i ma rig pa ma sangs pas las rgyu 'bras la rmongs pa'i ma rig pas bsgribs nas rgyu 'bras kyi rten 'brel ma go na kun rdzob la rang byan ma tshud/ drug pa gzugs sku'i sa bon thebs ma thebs ni/ stong nyid rtogs pa'i rtsal dmigs med kyi snying rjer shar nas/ sems bskyed smon lam sogs kyi 'khrul 'khor gyis rjes kyi snang bar legs tshogs kyi rten 'brel bden med du bsgrigs shes na/ gzugs sku'i sa bon thebs/ stong nyid rtogs kyang snying rje skye dka' zhing gzhan phan gyi rten 'brel bsgrigs mi shes na gzugs sku'i sa bon ma thebs pa'o// lnga pa spros bral gyi skyong thabs bogs 'don bshad pa ni/ spros bral gsum ka'i tshe'ang zhen pa gsum btang nas/ dben pa brten zhing smra bcad dang 'dag sbyar la nan tan bya/ gtor ma dang bla ma'i gsol 'debs nyung zad tsam ma gtogs mtshan bcas kyi dge sbyor rnam grangs mang na mi dga' bar bshad pas/ re zhig de dag dor nas sgom skyes bdag po med pa de 'drar mi byed par dang po brjed par byung na stong nyid bzung dran kho na la bslab/ rang ngo rjen pa de nyid skyong dgos te/ rje lha rtse bas/ chos thams cad kyi snying po rang bzhin lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes sam don dam pa'i bden pa phyag rgya chen po zung 'jug rab tu mi gnas pa tha mal gyi shes pa sus kyang bzo ma byas pa so so rang gis rig pa rjen ce re ba 'di ka skyong ba yin te/ rje lo tsā ba chen pos/ ri me ltar 'bar ba'i dgon pa ru// sems stong pa nyid la sbar zin byas// zhes so// rang rig ngo shes dang ma bral na// rkyen bzang ngan thams cad grogs su 'char// lam gang shar la spang blang med// ched du bsgom rgyu med kyang yengs su skad cig mi gtong*/

sgom med yengs med 'di la lam rang byung snying po rang 'gros zer te/ rgyun du brtson 'grus kyis skyong*/ yang skabs skabs su mchod sbyin sogs 'dus byas kyi dge ba gsog pa dang*/ mos gus dag snang snying rje rnams sgom zhing rgyu 'bras kyi rten 'brel rnams bsam/ bla ma dang mched grogs rtogs ldan la zab mo'i gleng bslang bya ba dang*/ grub thob brgyud pa'i rdo rje'i mgur sogs la blta ba dang dbyangs su blangs pa sogs bya zhing*/ rtogs pa'i ngo bo dang bstun te nges shes bskyed/ 'di'i dus su rig pa ngar bskyed ther la 'don dgos te/ de min snyom me ba des sgom gyi dri ma mi rig mnyam rjes mi phyed pa yin/ rig pa ther la bton te mnyam rjes gsum po rang rang so sor shes par byed/ rjes shes dbang du mi gtong bar stong nyid kyi rang tsho bzung nas bskyang dgos te/ rje sgam po pas/ spros bral gyi rnal 'byor dus su btang snyoms su ma lus par shes pa ngar dang ldan pa gal che/ zhes dang*/ rje rgya ras kyis/ spros bral dus su song tsa na// gnyis bsdus chos rnams bsre zhing sgom// zhes shes pa ngar bskyed la snang ba sna tshogs la bsre zhing spros bral sgom par bshad la/ rje yang dgon pas/ ma yengs pa'i dran pa so ma shor/ mi bsgom pa'i gnas lugs bzo ma byed// bsam med kyi rig pa smrar ma 'dod/ brtag dpyad kyis ma bslad kha yan skyongs dang*// sgom spros bral gyi ma bu 'phrod pa cig 'ong gi /zhes gsungs pas gzung dran shugs bskyed de/ spros bral gyi ngo thog ma shor ma yengs pa dang*/ de'i gnas lugs la bzo bcos mi rung bas gzhan gsar du ci yang mi sgom pa dang*/ smra bsam brjod med kyi rig pa la brtag dpyad mi bya bar rang yan du skyong ba rnams brten no// bde shas chung zhing 'gro 'dod dang snying mi dga' ba sogs byung na thabs lam 'bar 'dzag dang*/

mchog gi gtum mo dang lus sbyong ci rigs bya/ spros bral chen po'i rtogs pa skyes nas de lor bskyang yang bogs ma thon na/ slar zhen pa gsum btang ba dang*/ dbang zhu ba nyams chag bshags pa sogs bya zhing rtogs pa 'phel bar gsol ba gdab/ rang yi dam du bsgom la dmyal ba'i sdug bsngal bsam zhing*/ de sems su thag bcad la spros bral gyi ngang du mnyam par bzhag /de bzhin du lha'i bde skyid bsam la spros bral du 'jog pa dang*/ 'khor ba'i gnas tshul bsam la spros bral du 'jog pa dang*/ myang 'das kyi gnas lugs bsam la spros bral du 'jog pa dang*/ res ri bo'i rtser phyin la spros bral du glod/ res mang po'i 'dun sar song la spros bral du glod/ rlung thun re bzung la snang ba la mig ha re blta zhing spros bral du glod pa rnams kyis bogs dbyung*/ skabs su lha 'dre drag po gnas pa'i yul dang*/ ltad mo chen po'i sar phyin nas rig pa brjed med du bskyangs pas/ dngos sam nyams snang la lha 'dre'i cho 'phrul sems slong khams 'dus sogs mi dge ba sna tshogs yong*/ de la slong tshad zer/ de dus lha 'dre pha mar shes pa'i byams pa chen po'i ngang nas sngon gyi lan chags 'jal ba'i ched du/ rang gi lus ril po 'di ka lha 'dre la sbyin te ngag tu 'di dag brjod/ 'o sha la dga' bas sha zo/ khrag la dga' bas khrag 'thung*/ rings na rjen par zo/ mi rings na tshos la zo/ theg pa 'dug na khur la song byas te blos ling btang nas/ sems chos kyi ngang las ma g.yos par bsdad pas/ dge sbyor la bogs rtsol med du thon/ rig pa shugs je cher 'gro/ tha mal gyi shes pa bkra lam me ba 'di ka'i rang bzhin chos kyi skur 'dug pa la snyam pa'i nges pa nang nas 'char/ de la tshar tshad zer ba yin/ dge sbyor nyin mtshan 'khor yug tu song na bar do med par sangs chung rgya zhes kun mkhyen 'brug pas gsungs/ rkyen gyis bskul ba'i 'char sgo sna tshogs kyi rjes su mi 'breng*/

las rgyu 'bras khyad du bsad na gol bas skad cig ma'i 'dor len bya/ sbyin sogs dkar po'i chos thams cad lag len yin pas/ gtor ma brgya rtsa mi bcag /'gro don smon lam yin pas rgya chen btab/ de thams cad yengs med kyi dran pa'i ngang nas byas na ye shes kyi rol pa'am chos sku'i rang rtsal zer ba yin/ de ltar bskyangs pas ci zhig na 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad la spros pa dang bral ma bral stong mi stong spang blang sogs kyi dgag sgrub med par cir snang thams cad gra ma chag zur ma nyams par phyag rgya chen por ro gcig pa'i rnal 'byor 'char ro// drug pa spros bral gyi sa mtshams bshad pa ni/ spros bral chung ngur chos nyid kyi bden pa mthong bas des 'khor ba'i 'jigs pa bral zhing byang chub thob pa la nye ba dang*/ sems can gyi don grub par mthong ste dga' ba khyad par can skye bas/ sa dang po rab tu dga' ba/ spros bral 'bring por chos kun gzhi med rtsa bral du rtogs pa'i mthus tshul khrims la 'chal ba'i dri mas mi gos pas/ sa gnyis pa dri ma med pa/ spros bral chen por chos thams cad snang la rang bzhin med par 'od gsal lta bur 'char bas sa gsum pa 'od byed pa yin pa'o/// /gsum pa ro gcig gi rnal 'byor bshad pa la drug ste/ dang po ro gcig gi ngo bo bshad pa/ gnyis pa ro gcig gi nyams myong bshad pa/ gsum pa ro gcig gi gol sa bshad pa/ bzhi pa ro gcig gi rnam dbye bshad pa/ lnga pa ro gcig gi skyong thabs bogs 'don bshad pa/ drug pa ro gcig gi sa mtshams bshad pa'o// dang po ro gcig gi ngo bo bshad pa ni/ ro gcig gi rnal 'byor zhes pa'i don la/ spyir bstan du snang srid 'khor 'das kyis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad chos nyid stong pa nyid du ro gcig pas ro gcig bshad de/ bram ze chen pos/ sna tshogs chos thams cad stong par don gcig par rtogs par byed pa bla ma dam pa nyid yin te/

zhes dang*/ sha wa ris/ gaṅgā la sogs chu klung thams cad pa// ba tshwa can gyi rgya mtshor ro gcig ltar// brtags pa'i sems dang sems byung sna tshogs kun// chos kyi dbyings su ro gcig shes par gyis// zhes so// 'on kyang skabs 'di yi ro gcig don ni/ snang ba dang mi snang ba lta bu tshul mi 'dra ba'i gnyis chos du ma yang zung 'jug gi ngo bor ro gcig pas na ro gcig ces bya ste/ rje phag grus/ snang dang mi snang sna tshogs sems dang stong*// stong dang mi stong ro gcig dbyer med stong*// rtogs dang mi rtogs ro gcig mnyam rjes med// sgom dang mi sgom ro gcig dag pa'i ngang*// spros dang spros bral ro gcig chos kyi dbyings// zhes dang*/ 'di dang tshul mthun par rje zhang gis kyang gsungs so// kha cig spyir bstan gyi ro gcig ltar chos thams cad kyi ngo bo stong nyid du ro gcig pa ltar/ skabs 'di yi ro gcig tu smra ba mi 'thad de/ de ltar na de lta bu'i rnal 'byor ro gcig gi rnal 'byor du smra dgos par 'gyur la/ de smra na spros bral chung 'bring yang ro gcig gi rnal 'byor du smra dgos te/ rgyu mtshan mtshungs pa'i phyir ro// de yang spros bral gyi skabs su chos thams cad stong nyid du rtogs pa yod kyang*/ stong phyogs la bde zhing snang phyogs la cung zad mi bde bar yod par bshad pas/ ji lta ba'i zung 'jug gi rtogs pa med la/ ro gcig gsha' ma rtogs nas snang ba gra ma chag zur ma nyams pa snang stong zung 'jug tu 'char bar bshad pas/ des na gnyis chos du ma zung 'jug ro gcig pas/ skabs 'dir ro gcig gi don du byas na 'thad par 'gyur ba'o// gnyis pa ro gcig gi nyams myong bshad pa ni/ ro gcig chung ngu'i dus thams cad gnyug ma'i ngo bor rtogs kyang de'i nyams myong dang nges shes kyi 'dzin pa yod la/ rjes shes kyi skabs su yul rkyen drag pos dkrugs pa'i tshogs drug gi snang ba dge sbyor du mi bde ba 'ong*/

rang gar yang gzung 'dzin a 'thas kyi snang ba dum re 'byung*/ de'i bag chags kyis rmi lam na'ang 'khrul pa dang 'dzin pa dum re 'ong*/ res lus snang sems gsum dbyer med pa'i nyams kyang skye/ 'on kyang rgyu 'bras la rtsis 'jog dang mos gus dang snying rje chung du 'gro ba srid gsungs so// ro gcig 'bring gi dus rtogs bya rtogs byed dang myang bya myong byed kyi gnyis 'dzin grol/ snang ba dang sems gnyis su 'dzin pa'i rtsa ba chod/ rjes shes dang rmi lam yang sngar bas 'khrul pa chung zhing a 'thas kyi 'dzin pa yang cher mi 'ong*/ phyi rol gyi gdul bya la phan gnod kyi nus pa 'byung bar bshad do// ro gcig chen po'i dus mnyam nyid gnyug ma ma 'gags pa'i rtsal sna tshogs su shar ba la bden 'dzin dang bral ba'i gnyis med kyi rtogs pa de nyid nyin mtshan 'khor mar 'byung*/ mnyam rjes dpyis phyin pa 'dre bas chu bo rgyun gyi rnal 'byor du 'gyur/ mi rtog pa'i 'char sgo snang la ma nges pa gsal tsam gyis myong tshor cung zad re 'byung*/ rjes shes su snang ba 'dzin med gsal stong sgyu ma lta bur snang zhing de la shes bzhin pa'i gnyis snang phra mo re 'char/ 'dzin med kyi rmi lam 'al 'ol tsam 'gags med du 'byung zhing res rmi lam med pa'ang 'ong*/ skabs 'dir mngon shes phra mo 'char/ yi dam gyi lha dang mkha' 'gros lung bstan 'byung zhing phrag dog kyang rtsa ba nas zhi bar gsungs so// gsum pa ro gcig gi gol sa skyon sel bshad pa ni/ de yang 'di skabs rnam rtog sgom du shar bas nges med kyi rten 'brel nang nas 'char/ chos thams cad kyi gnas lugs dang mtshan nyid 'di ltar yin pa dang*/ de ltar 'dug sogs sgom byung gi shes rab nags la me mched pa ltar rdol yong*/ de'i rjes su 'brangs na rtog dpyod kyi shes par song nas rig pa so shor bas gcig chog gi rgyal sa zin par dka'/

go ba dang chos skad bzang yang nyams myong zhan pas nyin par yengs rkyen mtshan mo rmi lam 'khrul phyir 'chor/ mgur ma dang tshigs bcad 'dra rtsom snying 'dod/ chos brgyad kyi snang shes langs pas/ chos 'jig rten gang la'ang rang mkhas snyam pa'i rlom zhen skye/ de bas gzhan de dang de la skyon 'di 'dra 'dug snyam nas gzhan skyon mdzub mos bru/ rang skyon en re mthong yang sbar mos 'geb/ chos pa gzhan la phrag dog 'gran sems byed/ da nas 'jig rten gyi bya ba la 'di tshug byas na de tshug byas na chog 'dug snyam pa'i ram ram 'char ba de yi rjes su 'brangs na/ gcig chog gi rgyal sa 'chor bas rtsab rtsub kyis lung pa 'geng yong*/ sgom ma dang sbyin bdag gi rtsam gtor la blo 'gro phan sems su go /bla ma dang mched grogs kyi bslab bya log par mthong bas bar chad kyis tshugs sla/ zhe 'dod kyis brtsam tshad mthar mi phyin/ mis 'phya la rang sdug pas 'o brgyal ba lags so// nyams myong la gnas cha med pas sdod mi tshugs tshe srang kha rgyan du mthong ba yong*/ ro gcig 'dres pa'i rba la g.yengs zer ba'i gol sa yin/ de yang bzang rkyen rnams lam du slong dka'/ phrag dog gi rtog pa yang rna mchog la sir bu rgyug pa ltar yong gsungs/ bar chad dang dngos grub 'thab pa'i dus yin pas khe nyen che/ yon tan gyi rtsal kha rdzogs ran pa de bsod des chun pa dka' mo rang yin/ de la dgongs nas/ rje rgya ras kyis/ chu khol ka'i me ma gsod/ rgod 'phur kha'i gshog pa ma gcog /dka' las byas pa'i nor chu la ma pho// gter rdol kha'i kha ma bkab// so nam byas pa'i ston thog sad la ma bskur// sogs gsungs pa yin mod/ dus 'dir rkyen bzang ngan gang gis kyang ma bskyod par gnyen po'i ltag tshan mos gus kyis byed cing dgos med kyi drag sngags bgrang zhing 'dzin med rang grol la bslab/ rje rgod tshang pas/ myong 'dod ma zad par rtogs pa'i thabs mi chag gsungs pas myong 'dod kyi 'char sgo sna tshogs phra chod sbom chod du btang nas sdod par nus na/

bar chad thams cad rang sar zhi nas/ dngos grub thams cad char bzhin 'bebs/ lha 'dre mi gsum dbang du 'dus/ rang don chos sku'i rgyal sa zin/ gzhan don rtsol med lhun grub tu 'byung bas/ rtogs ldan gyi rnal 'byor 'di la pho rgod skyes pa zer/ bsod nams che ba'i mchog kyang 'di la zer bas de ltar nges par bya dgos pa'o// bzhi pa ro gcig gi rnam dbye la gsum ste/ dang po ro gcig rnam pa gsum bshad pa/ gnyis pa ro gcig rnam pa bzhi bshad pa/ gsum pa ro gcig rnam pa drug bshad pa'o// dang po ro gcig rnam pa gsum bshad pa ni/ 'khor 'das sogs gnyis bsdus kyi chos thams cad zung 'jug phyag rgya chen po'i ngo bor ro gcig tu rtogs kyang der nyams su myong zhing 'dzin pa'i nges shes kyi 'khris yod pa ro gcig chung ngu*/ du ma ro gcig tu nyams su myong ba'i nges shes kyi 'dzin pa dag nas/ gzung ba yul gyi snang ba phyir ma lus/ der 'dzin pa'i sems nang du ma lus par snang sems dbyer med lam me ba mngon du gyur pa ro gcig 'bring po/ de ltar du ma ro gcig rtogs shing ro gcig gi rtogs pa de du ma'i snang ba shar bas snang srid thams cad gnyug ma'i ngang du zhi ba ro gcig chen po'o// gnyis pa rnal 'byor bzhi po bzhi bzhi bcu drug tu dbye ba las/ gsum pa ro gcig gi rnam dbye bzhi bshad pa ni/ dang po du ma'i chos thams cad rtogs pa gcig gi ngang du 'dzin med du gnas pa ro gcig gi rtse gcig /gnyis pa snang sems tha dad tu 'dzin pa'i sgro 'dogs chod pa ro gcig gi spros bral/ gsum pa snang stong gnyis la dgag sgrub kyi spang blang dang bral ba'i lus sems snang ba gsum 'dres pa ro gcig gi ro gcig /bzhi pa bsgom bya sgom byed kyi myong ba dag pa ro gcig gi sgom med yin pa'o// gsum pa rnal 'byor bzhi po drug bzhi nyer bzhir dbye ba las gsum pa ro gcig gi rnam dbye drug bshad pa la/

dang po ngo bo mthong ma mthong ni/ tshogs drug gang shar gyi snang ba thams cad bcos bslad mi dgos par rang sar rang ngo shes pa na/ ro gcig gi rtogs pa yin pas ngo bo mthong*/ da dung grol rgyu dang thob rgyu dang nges shes thag ma chod pa'i 'dzin pa rgyud dang 'dres pa'i dgag sgrub kyi dri ma cung zad cig 'dug na ro gcig gi nyams yin pas ngo bo ma mthong*// gnyis pa rtsal rdzogs ma rdzogs ni/ snang srid 'khor 'das kyi chos kun mnyam nyid gnam sa bla 'og 'gyur kyang gnyen pos bcos su med par rang sar rang rig gis chog pa'i du ma ro gcig gi rtogs pa des du ma'i snang ba la dbang bsgyur bas stong nyid kun 'gro la ltem rkyang med na rtsal rdzogs/ mnyam bzhag ro gcig gi rtogs pa des rjes thob la mi 'dre ba sgo lnga'i yul snang rang rgyud par shar na gnyis med du rtogs kyang gnyis snang gi rgya las ma grol ba zhes bya ste/ dgag sgrub kyi dri ma cung zad dang ma bral ba 'dug na rtsal ma rdzogs/ gsum pa rnam rtog bsgom du shar ma shar ni/ snang sems gcig tu 'dres pas ngar 'dzin rtsa ba nas zad de nyon mongs pa can gyi yid dag /rang ma grub pa de la ltos nas gzhan ma grub ste/ rang gzhan dang snang sems gcig tu 'dres pas 'khrig pa'i 'dod pa dang bral/ phrag dog rtsa ba nas zhi/ tshogs drug zang thal gyi 'char sgo la bcings grol gyi 'gro 'ong med par gang shar gyis chog pas na rnam rtog bsgom du shar/ tshogs drug gi 'char sgo rnams ngo shes kyis dran pas thob dgos pa'am grol dgos na rnam rtog bsgom du ma shar/ bzhi pa yon tan skyes ma skyes ni/ lus sems snang ba gsum gcig tu 'dres shing gnyis med sna tshogs su shar bas/ 'byung ba la dbang thob pa'i rdzu 'phrul dang*/ mngon shes dang mkhyen pa'i ye shes kyis phyi nang gi chos la dbang bsgyur bas dag pa'i sa la gnas pa'i yon tan 'byung ste/

shes pa skad cig ma'i steng du 'khor 'das legs tshogs sgrub pa dang*/ nyes skyon spong ba dang*/ yon tan bskyed par nus pas rnam rtog la dbang bsgyur/ skyes nas myong 'gyur gyi las bskal pa du ma'i pha rol nas mnar med par skye ba'i las bsags bag la nyal du lus pa rang dbang med par blangs nas/ da lta rmi lam 'khrugs pa tsam cig gis rang dag tu byed pa'am/ dge ba'i las bskal pa mang po'i pha rol tu smin par byed pa yang*/ dus 'di nyid du mngon du byed pa la sogs pa las la dbang bsgyur ba/ dus gsum mnyam pa nyid du rtogs shing*/ skad cig la cha med du rtogs pas/ bskal pa skad cig mar byin gyis rlob pa'am/ skad cig ma bskal par byin gyis rlob pa sogs dus la dbang bsgyur/ lus sems snang ba gsum 'dres pas/ nam mkha' dang lag mthil mnyam pa dang*/ stong gsum nyung 'brur 'dzud pa dang*/ gcig mang por bsgyur ba dang*/ mang po gcig tu byed pa dang*/ rigs drug so so'i gzugs su rang rang gi skad kyis chos smra ba sogs snang ba la dbang bsgyur/ mgrin pa'i rtsa kha 'byed gsung gi mdzod rdol/ ngag gi dbang phyug 'grub/ rtsom pa'i spobs pa la thogs pa med/ ston pa'i gsung rab kyi don la ma rmongs/ shes bya'i chos la chags thogs med pas na ye shes la dbang bsgyur ba la sogs pa'i rdzu 'phrul thob na ro gcig gi yon tan skyes/ ro gcig gi rtogs pa tsam skyes kyang yon tan sad byed kyi lam rkyen zhan pas grub rtags ma thon na yon tan ma skyes/ lnga pa kun rdzob la rang byan tshud ma tshud ni/ du ma'i snang ba rtog pa gcig gi ngo bor dbyer med cing ro gcig rtogs pa du ma'i rgyu 'bras la dbang bsgyur/ rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba skad cig ma rgyu 'bras kyi 'khor lo nyi ma'i gung la za 'og bkram pa bzhin du gsal/ shes pa skad cig ma'i 'char sgo la 'khor 'das gnyis rgyab gyes/

dge sdig gi 'dor len sgrib pa sbyong ba'i spel sbyong byed/ stong pa'i chos nyid las stong pa'i chos 'byung*/ nam mkha' lta bu'i rgyu 'bras mngon du gyur/ bag chags kyi 'brel chad pas las rgyu 'bras skad cig gnyis par mi sdod/ 'khor 'das lam gsum gyis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad kyi 'byung rgyu gnas gzhi 'jig rkyen du shes pas/ lus ngag yid gsum gyi 'khrul 'khor dang tha na rde'u shing bu bsgyur bzlog gis kyang skyon dang yon tan gyi spang blang shes/ phyi rol gyi snang ba bya dang byi'u tshun gyis kyang chos tshur la ston/ de ltar snang ba rang sems rang mtshan du rtogs pas rten 'brel rgyu 'bras kyi mtha' la mkhas pa ni kun rdzob la rang byan tshud ro gcig sems kyi mtshan nyid rtogs/ snang thog tu sems kyi sgro 'dogs chod/ kun rdzob shes pa shes rab yin pas las rgyu 'bras la rmongs pa'i ma rig pa sangs te/ ji snyed pa mkhyen pa'i ye shes kyi cha skye dgos pa la/ stong pa ro gcig du ma'i rgyu 'bras ma shar na/ kun rdzob la rang byan ma tshud/ drug pa gzugs sku'i sa bon thebs ma thebs ni/ de ltar du ma ro gcig rtogs shing ro gcig du ma la dbang bsgyur ba'i dus su kun khyab kyi snying rje dang rtsol med kyi phrin las 'byung bas/ 'khor 'das kun gyi bdag por 'gyur/ snang ba dang mi snang ba'i 'khor dang longs spyod kyi sprin 'du/ lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten gyis mchod cing gtsug gi nor bur gyur pa ni/ dbang med kyi rgyu 'bras te/ rje phag mo gru pas/ snying nas rtsa ba chod gyur cing*// ro gcig ngang la 'byams gyur na// dpal gyi ri la dar chen 'phyar// dgos dgu mi 'dod bzhin du 'byung*// de 'bad med kyi rgyu 'bras ma lags sam// zhes gsungs/ 'di'i dus su gzhan don la ska rag bcings pa'i dus phun sum tshogs pa lnga la rgyun chad med par dbang bsgyur bas/

tshe bsod nams kyi tshogs su ma gyur cing*/ gzhan don gyi gter kha phyed pa na/ gzugs sku'i sa bon theb pa yin/ du ma ro gcig tu rtogs shing ro gcig du mar shar ba tsam 'dug kyang rtogs pa'i rtsal snang snying rjer ma thon/ gzhan don gyi gter kha ma bye na gzugs sku'i sa bon ma thebs pa'o// lnga pa ro gcig gi skyong thabs bogs 'don bshad pa ni/ ro gcig gsum ka'i skabs su gnas phal cher dben pa brten/ res 'ga' tsam tshogs su'ang bsdad/ sgom ma bsgoms dran ma dran khyad med pa ltar byung yang*/ dben par yang dag gi dran pas rtogs pa'i ngo bo yengs med du skyong ba nyid gnad che la/ gzhan yang*/ sgam po pas/ du ma ro gcig gi rnal 'byor dus su go yul spyi'i rnam pa dang ma 'dres par nang du nyams su myong ba gal che/ zhes ro gcig gi rtogs pa de nyid la shugs 'don par gsungs pa dang*/ rje rgya ras kyis/ ro gcig rnal 'byor non tsam na// 'gro don sa bon 'di ru gda'// rang la brtsi rgyu mi bdog kyang*// mi bden bzhin du rten 'brel bsgrig /ces gzhan phan gyi smon lam rgya chen po 'debs shing*/ rten 'brel bzang po thams cad bsgrig par bshad pa dang*/ rje yang dgon pas/ sgo lnga yul thog tu 'char ba 'gags med kyi mdangs/ yul 'dzin med las skye ba skye med kyi gshis/ snang zhen ma bkag kyang 'gags pa rang babs kyi sgom/ stong snang blo bral du 'char ba rang 'gros kyi lam/ snang ba la skyon du ma lta 'dzin pa thong dang*/ sgom ro gcig gi klong du phebs pa cig 'ong gi /zhes snang ba la ci 'char cir snang yang 'dzin pa gtong bar bshad pa rnams shes par bya'o// bogs 'don tshul phal cher spros bral chen po dang 'dra/ ro gcig chung 'bring gi skabs su rgyu 'bras kyi blang dor dang mos gus dag snang snying rje la sogs pa'i thabs kyi cha la khyad du gsod srid pas de dag shugs phyung la bsgom/

rten 'brel bzang po thams cad bsgrig cing ngan pa thams cad spangs pa dang*/ dge sdig gi blang dor tshul bzhin du bya ba gal che ste/ rje sgom tshul gyis/ lar gnyis su med pa'i don rtogs kyang*// dkar po'i chos rnams mi gcog 'tshal// bsgom du med pa'i don rtogs kyang*// thabs kyi zhabs tog mi gcog 'tshal// spyod pa blang dor ma mchis kyang*// gzhan gyi sdig rkyen mi bgyid 'tshal// 'bras bu re dogs ma mchis kyang*// nyon mongs kha yan mi btang 'tshal// zhes gsungs pa ltar ro// ro gcig chen po rtogs kyang phan gnod kyi nus pa mi 'byung ba dang*/ mngon shes dang mkha' 'gro'i lung bstan la sogs pa'i mtshan ma ma byung na/ dam tshig nyams pa dang gzhan gyis nyams grib phog pa yin pas bshags sdom drag po bya/ tshwa tshwa stong rtsa sogs btab cing re re la me tog re phul la/ bdag gi grib nye bar zhi bar mdzad du gsol/ zhes gsol ba gdab/ gzhan yang grib sel gyi gzungs chog dang*/ dge ba'i las sna ci rigs bya/ mtshan rtags la sogs pa byung na de la rlom sems dang dga' mi dga' sogs 'dug na bdud zhugs pa yin pas/ phan 'dogs pa dang gnod pa skyel ba dang bdud la sogs pa thams cad rang gi sems yin/ sems nam mkha' ltar mtha' dbus med snyam du bsam/ lar ro gcig skyes nas rtog pa la mi 'jigs/ yon tan la mi dga'/ skyon gyis kha brid kyang mi nus pa yin/ slar la phrag dog che/ nyon mongs mang*/ rnam rtog rags/ zur mgo rno/ dga' mi dga' 'dug na/ bdud sems la zhugs pa yin pas/ de ngo shes par byas la dge sbyor la rem par bya/ lar sgom dang mi mthun pa thams cad bdud rang du ngo shes par bya/ zhes gsungs so// de ltar gyi skyon bsal zhing bskyangs pas nyams myong gi dri ma dag /lam gyi rtogs pa dang rang bzhin gyi gnas lugs 'dres nas/ mnyam rjes dang dran yengs med pa ni sgom med kyi rtogs pa 'char ba'o// drug pa ro gcig gi sa mtshams bshad pa ni/

ro gcig chung ngu'i ye shes kyi rang rtsal des spang bya gzhi med du dag pa'am sreg par byed pas na bzhi pa 'od 'phro ba/ ro gcig 'bring po la nang gses kyis gnyis su 'byed de/ de yang mnyam bzhag tu du ma ro gcig rjes thob tu snang sems dum re 'dre ba'i skabs sems can mi dmigs pas sems can gyi don ched du sbyangs pa dang*/ rang sems zhi bde la phyogs pa las bsrung dka' bas lnga pa sbyangs dka' ba/ de nas rjes shes ro gcig du mar 'char ba'i stong pa nyid kun tu 'gro bar 'char ba'i skabs 'khor 'das kyi chos kun sems kyi ngo bor rtogs pa'i don de rig pa skad cig ma'i mngon du gyur pas drug pa mngon du gyur pa/ ro gcig chen po la'ang sa gnyis yod pa'i/ dang po dman pa las ring du 'phags te lam thun mong ma yin pas bdun pa ring du song ba/ gnyis pa gzung 'dzin gyi rtog pa ro gcig tu gyur pa'i dbang gis g.yo bar mi nus pas brgyad pa mi g.yo ba'o/// /bzhi pa sgom med kyi rnal 'byor bshad pa la drug ste/ dang po sgom med kyi ngo bo bshad pa/ gnyis pa sgom med kyi nyams myong bshad pa/ gsum pa sgom med kyi gol sa bshad pa/ bzhi pa sgom med kyi rnam dbye bshad pa/ lnga pa sgom med kyi skyong thabs bshad pa/ drug pa sgom med kyi sa mtshams bshad pa'o// dang po sgom med kyi ngo bo bshad pa ni/ sgom med ces pa'i don la spyir bstan tsam du bsgom bya'i dngos po mi dmigs pa'am/ rang bzhin med pa'i don gyis sgom med du bzhag pa ni/ dus 'khor gsang 'dus las/ dngos po med pas sgom pa med// bsgom par bya ba sgom pa min// de ltar dngos po dngos med pas// sgom pa dmigs su med pa'o// zhes pa ltar ro// bsgom bya dang sgom byed gnyis su med pa'i don gyis sgom med du bzhag pa ni/ bram ze chen pos/ kyai ma rang bzhin bral ba'i de nyid sgom du yod ma zer// gal te bsgom par bya dang sgom byed gnyis rtog na// gnyis su 'dzin pa'i yid kyis byang chub sems spangs nas// zhes pa ltar ro// rgyu mtshan 'di la brten nas kha cig

/tshul de gnyis sgom med kyi rnal 'byor gyi don du 'dod pa mi 'thad de/ snga ma ltar na/ spros bral gyi rnal 'byor yan sgom med kyi rnal 'byor du 'gyur ba dang*/ phyi ma ltar na ro gcig gi skabs kyang sgom med kyi rnal 'byor du 'gyur ba'i phyir ro// 'o na ji ltar zhe na/ ro gcig gi skabs su bsgom bya sgom byed kyi blo phra mo gcig yod pa de yang dag cing mnyam rjes dang dran ma dran med par rtogs pa 'ba' zhig tu gyur nas sgom gyi bya rtsol dang bral bas sgom med ces bya ste/ sha wa ris/ rtogs pa can la bsgom bya sgom byed med// ji ltar nam mkhas nam mkha' dmigs su med// de ltar stong pas stong pa bsgom du med// gnyis med shes pa chu dang 'o ma ltar// sna tshogs ro gcig bde chen rgyun chad med// ces dang*/ rje zhang gis/ sgom med rnal 'byor shar dus su// rig pa'i ngo bo rten dang bral// rnal 'byor pa la bsgom rgyu med// sgom mkhan mi 'dug phyal par song*// zhes pa ltar yin pa'o// gnyis pa sgom med kyi nyams myong bshad pa ni/ sgom med chung ngu ni/ gnyis snang phal cher dag nas/ ched du bsgom ma dgos/ dran pas bzung ma dgos par snang ba thams cad bsgom du shar te/ phal cher bsgom thog nas g.yo ba med pa 'byung la rjes snang gi skabs su mi rtog ngo ma shes/ zhes bya ba ma rig pa'am mi shes pa'i lhag ma kun gzhi'i rnam shes kyi cha rtog bral lung ma bstan gyi sems su gnas pa zhig yod par bshad cing*/ de nyid gnas ngan len gyi dri mar bzhed do// rjes shes su las sogs mi nus kyang*/ ye shes su ma dag pa'i 'dzin rtog sgyu ma lta bu yad yud skye ba dang*/ rmi lam du'ang ngo ma shes kyi bden 'dzin cung zad 'byung bar bshad do// sgom med 'bring gi dus/ sgyu ma lta bu'i gnyis snang phra mo de yang dag nas nyin mtshan thams cad sgom med kyi rtogs pa 'khor yug tu 'gyur zhing*/

rjes snang du mi rtog ngo ma shes kyi cha phra zhing phra ba zhig yod la/ de nyid rang gsal du 'char ba zhes bya ba gshis babs dang mthun par rdzogs pa la zer te/ de nyid gnas ngan len gyi dri ma phra zhing phra ba yin zhing mtshan mo la'ang de'i cha yod par bshad do// sgom med chen po'i dus/ mi rtog ngo ma shes kyi cha phra zhing phra ba de yang ye shes su dag nas rang bzhin gyi 'od gsal dang rtogs pa'i 'od gsal gnyis 'dres pas ye shes kyi klong 'byams su gyur pa la rang don la chos skur byang chub pa'i tha snyad dang*/ de'i rtsal phyogs med du 'byangs pa dang*/ gdul bya'i dag snang gi rten 'brel tshogs pa las gzhan don du gzugs sku'i snang brnyan shar te 'khor ba ji srid du 'gro don lhun grub tu 'byung bar bzhed do// gsum pa sgom med kyi gol sa bshad pa ni/ rnal 'byor gong ma bzhi po'i sa bcad kyi 'gres sbyar tsam ma gtogs sgom med la gol skyon med de/ rje rgod tshang pas/ nyin par gyi dus su yang rjes snang sgyu ma'am stong gsal du mngon tsam/ yun se gol gtog pa'i bar tsam 'byung yang dran pas bzung rgyu'i tha snyad med par de nyid ngo bo rang dag tu 'gro ba yong gsungs/ 'on kyang rnam pa tsam du/ sgom med nyi ma sprin gyis sgribs// zhes pa bsgom bya sgom byed dang bral bas sgom mnyam bzhag 'ba' zhig tu gyur kyang*/ nang du shes pa ma zad pas ye shes rang 'grib ste/ lam gyi ye shes 'bras bu'i ye shes su rnam par ma dag /phyi ru shes bya ma zad pas ji snyed pa'i chos la gnyis snang phra mo dang ma bral ba 'dug na gol sar 'gyur bar bshad pas/ de dag gi gnyis 'dzin phra mo yang ngos bzung nas dag par bgyis pas 'khor 'das thams cad chos sku chen po gcig tu gyur nas sgom med chen po 'od gsal gnyis 'dres mi slob pa'i zung 'jug mngon du 'gyur ba'o// bzhi pa sgom med kyi rnam dbye la gsum ste/

dang po sgom med rnam pa gsum bshad pa/ gnyis pa sgom med rnam pa bzhi bshad pa/ gsum pa sgom med rnam pa drug bshad pa'o// dang po sgom med rnam pa gsum bshad pa ni/ dran pas bzung mi dgos ched du mnyam par bzhag mi dgos par snang ba thams cad bsgom du shar nas bsgom bya sgom byed kyi dbye ba med cing*/ sgyu ma lta bu'i nyams myong gi 'dzin pa cung zad tsam skye ba yod kyi bar sgom med chung ngu*/ de lta bu'i 'dzin pa dang bral te nyin mtshan thams cad sgom med rtogs par 'khor yug tu song bas lhun grub kyi rang sa zin cing rjes snang du rnam shes kyi cha phra mo rang gsal du 'char ba sgom med 'bring po/ rnam shes kyi cha phra mo de yang ye shes su gyur nas 'od gsal gnyis 'dres shing de'i klong 'byams 'ba' zhig tu gyur pa sgom med chen po'o// gnyis pa rnal 'byor bzhi po bzhi bzhi bcu drug tu dbye ba las/ bzhi pa sgom med kyi rnam dbye bzhi ni/ dang po ji lta ba'i ngang las mi 'da' bar gnas pa sgom med kyi rtse gcig yin/ gnyis pa shes bya ji snyed pa'i chos la sgro 'dogs chod pa sgom med kyi spros bral/ gsum pa 'gro ba mtha' dag gi don la spang blang med pa sgom med kyi ro gcig/ bzhi pa ye shes rang sgrib kyi myong ba dag pa sgom med kyi sgom med yin no// gsum pa rnal 'byor bzhi po drug bzhi nyer bzhi dbye ba las/ bzhi pa sgom med rnam pa drug bshad pa la/ dang po ngo bo mthong ma mthong ni/ dang po sgom med kyi rtogs pa de la dus thams cad du dran pas bzung rgyu'am goms par bya rgyu'i myong ba thams cad rtsa ba nas dag pa na sgom med kyi ngo bo mthong*/ da dung rtogs pa de la goms par bya rgyu'am gsal du 'gro rgyu cung zad cig 'dug na ngo bo ma mthong*/ gnyis pa rtsal rdzogs ma rdzogs ni rtogs pa'i ye shes la gnyis 'dzin gyi dri ma dang sems ngo ma shes kyi cha gtan nas med par shes dang shes bya gcig tu zad de// ye shes chos kyi dbyings dang dbyer med du gyur pa na sgom med kyi rtsal rdzogs/

phyi ru shes bya ma zad pas ji snyed pa'i chos la gnyis snang phra mo dang ma bral mi rtog ngo ma shes kyi cha cung zad 'dug kyang sgom med kyi rtsal ma rdzogs/ gsum pa rnam rtog sgom du shar ma shar ni/ phung po lnga dang bral zhing lus sems med pa snang ba snang med du rgya gsum las grol nas kun gzhi'i rnam shes gnas su dag na rnam rtog sgom du shar ba'o/ tshogs drug dang nyon yid dag kyang kun gzhi la lus sems kyi snang ba'i 'dzin pa bag la nyal phra mo dang nyams myong gi dri ma phra mo tsam zhig 'dug na'ang rnam rtog bsgom du ma shar/ bzhi pa yon tan skyes ma skyes ni/ lus 'ja' lus ye shes kyi gzugs sku dang sems 'od gsal chos skur gyur nas/ zhing khams dag pa rab 'byams su snang na sgom med kyi yon tan skyes/ thabs rten 'brel gyi 'gros ma thim zhing*/ shes rab rtogs pa'i rtsal zhan pas/ da dung lus sems dang snod bcud la ma dag pa'i snang ba dang 'dzin pa cung zad tsam 'dug kyang sgom med kyi yon tan ma skyes/ lnga pa kun rdzob la rang byan tshud ma tshud ni/ ji lta ba dang ji snyed pa dang stobs dang mi 'jigs pa dang*/ ma 'dres pa'i chos rnams yongs su rdzogs par mngon du gyur na kun rdzob rnam par dag cing mthar phyin pas rang byan tshud pa yin/ ji lta ba'i rtogs pa mngon du gyur kyang ji snyed pa'i mkhyen pa phra zhing phra ba rnams rgya gsum gyi dri mas mngon du ma gyur na kun rdzob rnam par ma dag ste/ rang byan ma tshud pa yin/ drug pa gzugs sku'i sa bon thebs ma thebs ni/ rang gzhan snod bcud brtan g.yo dngos po thams cad rdo rje gsum gyi ngo bo chos sku gcig tu gyur pas/ yang dag par rdzogs par sangs rgyas nas/ sems can gyi khams rgyud dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi thugs rje gnyis su med par khyab pas/ 'khor ba ma stong gi bar du mchog gi sprul sku rgyun mi chad na gzugs sku'i phrin las kyis don mngon du gyur pa yin/

de ltar ma gyur bar da dung zhing khams gsum gyi dus la ltos dgos na gzugs sku'i sa bon gyi nus pa ma smin pa'o// lnga pa sgom med kyi skyong thabs bshad pa ni/ sgom med kyi dbye ba la de ltar bshad kyang*/ tshe 'dir 'char ba'i sgom med mthar thug ni/ rang sems sangs rgyas su lhan gyis go nas spang bya spang du med/ gnyen po brten du med/ dag bya rgyu dang bral/ dag byed sems dang bral/ shi ma shi med pa'i nges pa gting nas thob ste/ mnyam rjes med par nges shes lhang gis skyes pa tsam gyis sgom med la mi 'char bar bzhed do// de'i nyams myong skyong tshul la/ rje sgam po pas/ sgom du med pa'i rnal 'byor gyi dus nyams myong gi rtsi la ma 'byar ba gal che/ nyams la ma zhen pa zhig dgos/ zhes skabs 'dir yang nyams myong la zhen 'dzin skyes dogs bya dgos par gsungs pas/ nyams bzang ngan ci la yang dgag sgrub dang zhen 'dzin ma zhugs pa zhig gal che zhing*/ sems bag la nyal ngo ma shes kyi cha thams cad kyang ngo shes dang ma bral ba zhig tu sbyong dgos pas/ yang dag gi dran pa'am blo 'das kyi dran pa ma yengs pa ni sgom gyi rtsa ba yin no// rgyu mtshan des na mi tshe ci byung sgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan btsugs te/ ma yengs mi sgom pas tha mal gyi shes pa mthar skyel dgos par bzhed de// rje rgya ras kyis/ sgom med dma' shos ro gcig 'dra// dge sbyor byed lugs gcig pa yin// sgom med rab ni sangs rgyas pa// bya rtsol thams cad bral ba yin/ zhes sgom med chung 'bring dang ro gcig dag sbyong skyong tshul gcig par bshad de/ rje yang dgon pas/ bsgom bya'i yul dang sgom byed kyi sems// rig thog na gnyis su 'dug gam ltos dang*// gnyis med kyi rig pa rten dang phrol la// dran med kyi shes pa phyal par skyong dang*// sgom nyin mtshan khor yug tu 'byams pa gcig 'ong gi /zhes bsgom bya dang sgom byed dbyer med pa'i rig pa de nyid rten med gtad med du byas te/

dran pa med cing yid la byed pa med pa'i shes pa 'dzin med rang yan du phyal bar skyong bar bshad de/ dran pa med cing yid la byed pa med pa'i don ni sngar bshad zin te/ spyir sgom nyams khor yug tu song ba'i sgom med 'dra ba rtse gcig tu'ang 'ong zhing*/ bsgom bya sgom byed dbyer med pa'i sgom med tsam spros bral du yang 'byung la/ cir snang thams cad bsgom du shar nas mnyam rjes med pa'i sgom med tsam ro gcig tu yang 'byung bas/ de dag thams cad sgom nyams kyi bye brag tsam yin pa dang*/ rtogs pa'i sgom med ci lta ba min pas rnam dbye shes dgos shing*/ sgom med kyi rtogs pa mthar phyin pa dang rdzogs pa'i byang chub thob dus mnyam yang*/ tshe 'dir sgom med dpyis phyin pa min la/ tshe 'dir 'char ba'i sgom med sgom med btags pa tsam du bzhed de/ rje rgya ras kyis/ sgom med chos sku'i gdan sa yin// phal cher sgom med btags par song*// zhes pa ltar ro/// /drug pa sgom med kyi sa mtshams bshad pa ni/ sgom med chung ngu legs pa'i yon tan thams cad dang ldan pas dgu pa legs pa'i blo gros/ sgom med 'bring po gzhan don 'bad med du 'byung zhing chos char chad med du spro bas bcu pa chos kyi sprin/ sgom med chen po chos thams cad dag pa rab 'byams su gyur pas/ bcu gcig kun tu 'od kyi sa zhes bzhed do// lar rnal 'byor bzhi bzhi bcu drug sogs 'di rnams la 'og ma'i ming gong ma la btags pa'i/ nyams len tshod 'jog mtho skad med pa gcig dgos te/ rje sgom tshul la/ glan sgom gyis rnal 'byor bzhi'i khyad par zhus pa la/ rtse gcig sems kyi ngo bo shes pa yin/ spros bral sems kyi rang bzhin shes pa yin// ro gcig snang ba'i rang bzhin shes pa yin// sgom med am de nga la cha med// ces gsungs pa ste/ sgom med zhal gyis ma bzhes shing*/ rje phag mo gru pa'i slob mar yang ro gcig rtogs pa phyed dang bzhi'i tha snyad byung ba dang*/

rje rgod tshang pa dang grub thob u rgyan pa sogs kyis kyang ro gcig tsam gyis zhal bzhes las ma mdzad pa dang*/ gong ma phal cher gyis kyang spros bral che 'bring tsam gyi rtogs tshul las ma gsungs pa de ni/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams/ rang don du sangs rgyas par sa mtshams la ltos pa ma mchis na'ang*/ gdul bya gang 'dul der ston dgongs pa can gyi gsung yin/ deng sang ro gcig tsam du sgom med kyi rtogs pa shar bar khas len pa rnams/ rnal 'byor bzhi'i rnam gzhag rnams zhib tu ma shes kyang de 'dra zhig la zer rgyu i yin snyam nas smra ba yin na/ de ni mngon pa'i nga rgyal dang blun gtam 'ba' zhig tu snang la/ myong thog la med phyin gzhan yin yin mang pos ci rang byed/ rnal 'byor gong ma'i yang dag gi dran pa gsha' ma rtogs mkhan nyin mo'i skar ma tsam yin zhing*/ 'og ma'i ming gong ma la btags pa/ dper na spros bral chung ngu las ma rtogs kyang 'bring du khas len pa dang*/ 'bring las med pa chen por 'bod pa sogs mi rung*/ de 'dra shes bzhin du smra ba yin na/ stong zob 'jig rten chos brgyad rang*/ mi dge bcu yi mi chos bla ma'i rdzun yin pas/ de ni chos dang shes rgyud ma 'dres pa ya re cha/ 'jigs su rung*/ de 'dra smra ci dgos/ rang la rtogs pa'i ngo bo ci 'dra yod na/ de ka 'di dang 'di zhes smra chog /ming bzang po snyan po 'dra ba tsho btags mi dgos/ ming btags na rang gi bla ma des/ khyod kyis nyams len mtho dman 'bring gsum 'di dang 'di zhes btags rgyu yin/ de ltar na sgom la ming snyan po lab rgyu ma byung na'ang*/ rang la rtogs pa'i ngo bo thag chod nges shes brtan por yod na des chog ste/ rje lha rtse pas/ lar spros bral gyi rtogs pa gsha' ma gcig shar na des chog /ro gcig la sogs ske myang myang byed don med/ rang sa'i myong ba ma brtan pa'i khas len mthon po byed mkhan mang ste de 'dra gzod/

zhes gsungs so// de ltar na dge sbyor ngo bo la phyi ru tshig gis sgro btags pa med pa dang*/ nang du rang la sems ngo legs por skyong rgyu yod rung*/ de la mtho 'jigs bsam na mi rung sgom chen sgom gyis 'ching zer ba'i bub sa yod pa yin zhing*/ chos zer ba nyon mongs pa'i gnyen por 'gro dgos par 'dug pas de la sems nas nyams len bzang po yod kyang*/ kha skad mthon po dang nga rgyal ba'i sgrib pa'i dri ma de rnams ngos bzung la/ de ka sbyang dgos par 'dug go /de ltar rnal 'byor bzhi 'dir dbye bsal dang*/ rnam grangs kyi rigs ni brjod kyis mi langs shing zad mtha' med pa zhig snang yang 'gags don la dgos pa gal che nges pa ni gnas lugs sems kyi rang mtshangs ji bzhin pa zhig ngo shes nas/ blos byas kyis ma bslad pa'i rang babs tha mal shes pa rang 'gros skyong tshul gyi gnad go ba zhig kho na gal che bar gda' ste/ rje btsun til+li pas/ blo yi chos kyis blo 'das don mi rtogs// byas pa'i chos kyis byar med don mi rnyed// blo 'das byar med don de rtogs 'dod na// rig pa rtsad chod sems nyid gcer bur zhog /ces dang*/ grub thob gling gis/ rje yi zhal nas gnyug ma'i don// sgoms shig gsungs nas bsgoms lags kyang*// bsgom bya sgom byed gtor nas thal// thun mtshams bzung rgyu mi gda' 'o// zhes dang*/ rgyal dbang rjes/ mi la las stong nyid stong nyid zer// stong mkhan stong yul ma grub pas// byas shing bcos pa ma lags te// gshis rang bzhin gyis stong pa yin pa 'dra// zhes dang*/ ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma ni gu ma'i zhal nas// cir snang sgom du ma shes na// gnyen po bsten gyis ga la langs// yul rkyen spangs pas mi langs te// sgyu mar shes na rang sar grol// zhes gsungs so// de ltar na rang rig sems gnyis su 'dzin pa'i bsgom bya thams cad dang bral ba'i blo bral gyi ngang der glod cing thag bcad/

rang rtsal 'gags med kyi 'char sgo rnam rtog dang snang ba sna tshogs rang bzhin yongs shes rjes thob 'dzin med rang grol du btang*/ gnyis snang la 'dzin pa zhugs pa rjes shes skad cig ma tsam gyi dbang du'ang mi btang*/ bzang ngan gyi rkyen lung ma bstan gyi las sogs mtha' dag rang gi ngo thog tu grol cha bskyed/ de yang sems thog tu lam khyer tsam du ma zad sems bskyed gsol gdab smon lam 'dun pa sogs kyis mtshams sbyar ba'i las dang bya ba thams cad byang chub lam du rgyas gdab/ mos gus bskyed rim/ dag snang*/ snying rje/ sems bskyed/ smon lam sogs la rtogs pa'i rang rtsal sbyong*/ de rnams kyang bla ma rang sems/ bskyed rdzogs zung 'jug /dag pa rab 'byams/ stong nyid snying rje/ don dam sems bskyed/ 'khor gsum yang dag gi smon lam sogs rig pa'i gshis dang rnam dbyer med pa'i zung 'jug chen po'i klong yangs su rtsal rdzogs pa gces/ rten 'brel gyi lag len la ma rmongs pa'i don gnyis rten 'byung gi sgo phun sum tshogs par bsgrig pa gal che ba'o// de ltar rnal 'byor bzhi yi rnam dbye de rnams nyams myong gi sgo nas 'chad dgos par snang bas/ gzhung bshad dag las ches dka' zhing*/ khyad par rnal 'byor phyi ma rnams blo yul du ma shar bas shin tu dka' yang rnam gzhag 'di dag rje sgam po pa che chung gi zhal gdams dang*/ rje rgya ras dang*/ sgam po pa bkra shis rnam rgyal sogs grub thob gong ma rnams kyi gsung la gzhi byas/ rang gi nyams rtogs phran bus zur brgyan nas zhib char bshad pa'o/// /drug pa lam khyer spyod pa'i rim pa bshad pa la/ dang po lam khyer gyi dus dang spyod pa bshad pa/ gnyis pa lam khyer spyi yi gnad bshad pa/ gsum pa lam khyer drug so sor bshad pa'o// dang po lam khyer gyi dus dang spyod pa bshad pa ni/ lam khyer bya ba'i dus la/ spyir sems nyid lhan skyes kyi ngo bo mthong zhing*/
