'di dag gi skabs su yon tan gyi bye brag dbang po lnga yang 'byung ste/ gang zhe na nges shes tshad med skye ba ni dad pa'i dbang po dang*/ yengs med don la blta ba dran pa'i dbang po dang*/ le los bar mi chod pa brtson 'grus kyi dbang po dang*/ sgom la rgyun chad med pa ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang po dang*/ nges pa'i don rtogs pa shes rab kyi dbang po dang lnga 'byung zhing*/ de lnga so so nas rtsal rdzogs pa'am/ stobs su gyur pa la/ stobs lnga yang brjod do// de ltar rtse gcig gsum mngon du gyur pas/ sbyor lam mthar phyin nas/ spros bral la sleb pa dang*/ sngar ma mthong ba'i bden pa mthong bas mthong lam thob pa ste/ 'di skabs su phar phyin theg par byang chub kyi yan lag bdun bsgom par gsungs pa rnams kyang 'dir shugs las 'byung ba nyid/ de yang chos nyid gnas lugs kyi don ji bzhin pa'i ngang la gnas pa ni ting nge 'dzin byang chub kyi yan lag /nyon mongs pa dang ma 'dres pa ni chos rnam par 'byed pa byang chub kyi yan lag /ting nge 'dzin de nyid dran tsam gyis mthong spang gi dri ma rang sar dag phyir dran pa byang chub kyi yan lag /le lo g.yeng ba las grol ba brtson 'grus kyi yan lag /zag med kyi dga' bde la spyod pa'i dga' ba byang chub kyi yan lag /spang bya ma lus pa dag pas shin tu spyod pa byang chub kyi yan lag /'khor 'das mnyam nyid du rtogs pa btang snyoms byang chub kyi yan lag dang bdun rdzogs par 'gyur la/ gzhan yang mthong lam gyi yon tan sna tshogs pa du ma dang ting nge 'dzin gyi sgo mtha' yas pa thob par gsungs so// mthong lam gyi yon tan rtogs pa gsha' ma skyes tshe/ yon tan thams cad kyi 'byung khungs sam gzhi rten byed pa'i phyir sa thob pa zhes bya ba ste/ phal chen gyi mdo las/ sa thob gyur ma thag tu 'jigs pa lnga dang bral// 'tshe ba med dang 'chi dang ngan 'gror mi ltung dang*// 'khor gyi nang du 'jigs bral de la bag tsha med// ces pa dang*/

sa bcu'i yon tan rnams gong nas gong du 'phel bar 'gyur la/ sa thob yan chod du sgom lam zhes bya ba ste/ de nyid la'ang*/ mnyam bzhag thams cad zag med kyi ting nge 'dzin kho na dang*/ rjes snang 'phags lam yan lag brgyad du goms par byed pa rnams zag bcas su 'dod cing*/ brgyad gang zhe na yang dag pa'i lta ba dang*/ rtogs pa dang*/ ngag dang*/ las kyi mtha' dang*/ 'tsho ba dang*/ rtsol ba dang*/ dran pa dang*/ yang dag pa'i ting nge 'dzin rnams yin te/ mdor na/ 'di dag ni phyin ci ma log pa'i chos can 'ba' zhig tu 'grub phyir/ theg pa 'og ma dag las khyad par du 'phags pa'i ldog chos du ma can sha stag go /sa rnams kyi dang po ni yon tan khyad par can de dag la/ dga' ba mchog tu gyur pa'i phyir sa dang po rab tu dga' ba zhes bya zhing*/ 'dir ni spros bral dang po ting nge 'dzin gyis dga' ba cher rgyas pa sa dang po rab tu dga' ba/ sgom spang gi dri ma dang bral bas sa gnyis pa dri ma med pa/ rtogs don gyi rtsal las 'gro ba'i don byed pas sa gsum pa 'od byed pa/ spros bral 'bring por/ sangs rgyas kyi che bas yon tan gong du 'phel bas sa bzhi pa 'od 'phro ba/ stong nyid snying rje zung 'jug gi rtogs pas bag chags kyi dri ma sbyangs dka' ba thams cad byang bas sa lnga pa sbyangs dka' ba/ spros bral chen po mngon du gyur tshe 'khor 'das skye med du rtogs pas drug pa mngon gyur gyi sa rnams non pa ste/ 'di ltar 'di man chad nyan rang rnams dang thun mong gi sar bshad nas/ de nas mnyam rjes 'khor 'das sogs gnyis snang phal cher zung 'jug tu grol te/ ro gcig rtogs pa shar ba'i thog mar sa bdun pa ring du song ba/ ro gcig 'bring por/ rtogs chos yang dag gi dran pa las g.yo ba med pas sa brgyad pa mi g.yo ba/ ro gcig chen por gnyis snang sgyu ma lta bu phra mo tsam ma gtogs gzhan dri ma phal cher dag pas sa dgu pa legs pa'i blo gros/

gnyis snang phra mo de yang rang sar dag ste/ sa lam gyi yon tan thams cad mthar phyin la 'on kyang kun gzhi'i rnam shes kyi lhag ma'i dri ma'am bag chags kyi 'dzin cha shes bya'i sgrib pa phra zhing phra ba zhig yod pa de la/ 'dir sgom med chung 'bring gi skabs te/ thun mong pa ltar na sa bcu pa chos kyi sprin zhes bya zhing*/ de ltar 'di yan chad ni byang sems sa bcu'i dbang phyug rnams dang skal ba mnyam pa'i yon tan mnga' la des na mi rtog ngo ma shes kyi dri ma shes bya'i bag chags phra mo de nyid kyang rdo rje lta bu'i ye shes kyi ngo bo rang byung rang rig chen por thim pas sgrib byed gtan du bral gyur te/ ji lta dang ji snyed pa'i ye shes kyi rtsal dang mkhyen brtse'i nus pa'i stobs rnams yongs su rdzogs pa'i tshe// spyir thun mong theg pa mthar phyin pa'i lam mchog rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang dngos dang*/ phyag rgya chen po'i skabs 'dir sgom med chen por brjod la/ gsang sngags spyi ltar na 'di dus las nyon bag chags kyi sgrib cha bral tshe lam sbyong bgrod dngos bya rgyu med mod/ yon tan gyi 'phel cha'i ldog chos sam khyad kyi bye brag la ming du btags te/ bcu gcig pa kun tu 'od dang*/ bcu gnyis ma chags pad+ma'i sa ste thun mong ma yin pa sa gnyis po skad cig la mngon du byas nas rang don chos sku mthar phyin pa'i rol rtsal las/ gzhan don gzugs skus mkha' khyab kyi 'gro ba'i don chen 'khor ba ma stong gi bar du rgyun mi chad par mdzad pa bcu gsum rdo rje 'dzin pa sangs rgyas kyi sa nyid du gsungs so// des na 'di dag gi sa lam gong du bgrod rgyu yod pa'i bar ni slob lam zhes bya zhing*/ gong du bgrod yul med par mthar thug pa'i tshe mi slob pa'i lam du brjod pa ste/ bcu gsum rdo rje 'dzin pa ni gsang sngags nang pa'i 'bras bu mthar phyin pa'o// de lta bu'i sa thob rnams la yon tan gyi khyad par ci lta bu yod ce na/

gang gi sa dang po thob tshe/ phyogs bcur sprul pa sku yi zhing khams brgya phrag dus gcig la bgrod nus pa dang*/ sangs rgyas brgya yi zhal mthong zhing chos nyan pa dang*/ lus srog longs spyod rgyal srid bu dang chung ma sogs kyang ltos med du btang ba'i sbyin pa mi 'dra ba brgya phrag kyang dus gcig la byed nus pa dang*/ 'od dmar por 'phro zhing dkar por bsdu ba dang*/ ser po spros nas sngon por 'khyil ba dang*/ mang por spro zhing nyung ngur bsdu ba sogs 'od zer mi 'dra ba brgya phrag dus gcig la 'gyed nus pa dang*/ gdul bya mi 'dra ba brgya la so so'i khams dbang bsam pa dang mthun pa'i chos sgo brgya rtsa dus gcig la ston nus pa dang*/ dpa' bar 'gro ba dang*/ dpung bkod pa dang*/ seng ge rnam par bsgying pa sogs/ rgyal ba'i yum las gsungs pa'i ting nge 'dzin mi 'dra ba brgya la dus gcig tu snyoms par 'jug nus pa dang*/ nam mkha' la 'gro zhing sa la 'dzul ba/ ri brag la thogs pa med cing chu la mi bying ba/ stod nas me 'bar zhing smad nas chu 'brub pa'am/ de gnyis res mos dang gcig las mang por sprul zhing mang po gcig tu bsdu ba'i sprul bsgyur sogs rdzu 'phrul gyi bkod pa rigs mi 'dra ba brgya rtsa brgyad dus gcig la ston nus pa/ de ltar yon tan brgya phrag bdun la dbang 'byor bar 'gyur la de bzhin du rim pas sa gnyis pa la yon tan de lta bu stong phrag bdun/ gsum par khri phrag bdun/ bzhi par 'bum phrag bdun/ lnga par bye ba phrag bdun/ drug par sa ya bdun/ bdun par dung phyur bdun/ brgyad par ther 'bum bdun/ dgu par ther 'bum chen po bdun/ bcu pa la de 'dren phrag bdun dang*/ bcu gnyis par rab bkram chen po phrag bdun sogs su 'gyur la/ bcu gsum rdo rje 'dzin pa sangs rgyas sku gsum gyi bdag nyid mngon du gyur pa'i dus kyi che ba'i yon tan gyi rnam grangs ni mtha' yas phyir/

su zhig gis tshad 'dzin te blo yi ra ba las brgal ba'i chos nyid do// de ltar thun mong theg pa nas gsungs pa'i sa bcu lam lnga thams cad theg pa'i yang rtse phyag rgya chen po'i lam 'dir ma 'dres pa yongs rdzogs su tshang phyir/ rnal 'byor bzhi po tshul bzhin mngon du gyur pa zhig la ni sa lam gyi yon tan mtha' dag kyang rim gyis sam/ cig car du rdzogs pa'i chos nyid yin gyi/ 'on kyang ltar snang du la lar de dag sogs kyi yon tan mngon mtshan can du snang tshul la mi ston pa ni gsang sngags gsang ba'i nye lam gyi ya tshul kyang yin no// 'on kyang tshul 'di la rje rgya ras kyis/ nyan thos rgyan can rgyan med gnyis// byang sems grags can grags med gnyis// sngags la gsang spyod tshogs spyod gnyis// yon tan bshad tshod brtan thub gnyis// sa lam yon tan dgongs can la// sgom chen sbyang stobs che chung gis// rdzu 'phrul yod med sna tshogs dang*// 'gro don 'grub dang mi 'grub 'byung*// zhes sogs mang du gsungs pa'i don bsdu na/ mtshan nyid theg par gsungs pa'i sa lam gyi yon tan rnams dgongs pa can yin pa dang*/ de dang lam yang mi gcig pas lam rtags kyang mi gcig pa dang*/ nyan thos la rgyan can rgyan med dang*/ byang sems la grags can grags med yod pa ltar/ sgom chen la'ang sngon gyi sbyangs stobs che chung gis tshe 'dir rdzu 'phrul yod med sna tshogs 'byung ba dang*/ rdzu 'phrul la sogs pa'i yon tan bsgrub pa la 'jig rten pa'i lam dang sngags lam la 'bad dgos par gsungs so/// /brgyad pa mthar thug 'bras bu'i rdzogs tshul bshad pa ni/ de yang 'bras bu phyag rgya chen po sku gsum dbyer med/ sku gnyis zung 'jug gi don bshad pas mjug bsdu ba ni/ rnal 'byor skal ldan zhig gnas lugs gzhi'i phyag chen gyi rang zhal mthong zhing*/ lta sgom lam gyi phyag chen la nyams len gnad du bsnun pas goms pa mthar phyin pa de'i sa lam gyi yon tan de ltar rdzogs nas mthar thug 'bras bu phyag rgya chen po don dam chos sku mngon du gyur pa'i shugs kyis sku gnyis shar bas sku gsum gyi ngang du mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya ba'o// de ltar yang*/

byang chub lam sgron las/ sangs rgyas byang chub yun mi ring*// zhes gsungs so// sangs rgyas de yang*/ sdom ni/ rang bzhin sgra don dbye ba dang*// rnam gzhag drang nges mtshan nyid dang*// khyad par dang ni don bdun gyis// rdzogs sangs rgyas kyi sku rnams bzhugs// zhes pa'o// de la dang po yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi rang bzhin ni/ spangs pa phun sum tshogs pa dang*/ ye shes phun sum tshogs pa'o// de la spangs pa phun sum tshogs pa ni/ nyon mongs pa'i sgrib pa dang*/ shes bya'i sgrib pa dang sa dang lam rnams sun phyung nas rdo rje lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin gyi mjug thog tu ma lus par spangs pa ste/ de yang snyoms 'jug gi sgrib pa la sogs pa ni/ sgrib pa gnyis po de yi dbye bar zad pas/ gnyis po de spangs pas sgrib pa thams cad spangs pa yin no// ye shes phun sum tshogs pa ni/ shes rab kyi pha rol phyin pa stong phrag brgya pa las/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas ni chos thams cad la sgrib pa med pa'i ye shes brnyes pa ste/ zhes dang*/ yang de nyid kyi le'u nyer gcig pa las kyang*/ bla na med pa'i sangs rgyas kyi ye shes yod do// chos kyi khor lo bskor ba yod do// sems can yongs su smin par byed pa yod do// zhes gsungs so// mdo gzhan las kyang ye shes bshad pa mang po yod do// bstan bcos kyi dbang du byas na/ mdo sde rgyan las/ ji ltar nyi ma'i 'od zer gcig /byung na 'od zer kun 'byung ba// de bzhin sangs rgyas rnams kyis kyang*// ye shes 'byung ba shes par bya// zhes sogs dang*/ me long ye shes mi g.yo ste// ye shes gsum ni de la brten// mnyam pa nyid dang so sor rtog /bya ba grub pa kho na'o// zhes gsungs so// bstan bcos gzhan las kyang sangs rgyas kyi ye shes bshad do// gzhung de dag la brten nas sangs rgyas la ye shes mnga' bar bzhed do// de yang mnga' lugs bshad na/

ye shes de mdor bsdus na/ ji lta ba mkhyen pa'i ye shes dang*/ ji snyed pa mkhyen pa'i ye shes gnyis yin/ de la ji lta ba mkhyen pa'i ye shes ni/ don dam mkhyen pa ste/ sngar brjod pa ltar/ rdo rje lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin gyi mthar thug pa de kho na nyid yongs su goms pa las/ yul gyi spros pa las 'das par bshad pas na/ blo yi 'jug pa mtha' dag la rab tu zhi bas/ chos kyi dbyings spros pa med pa dang*/ ye shes spros pa med pa gnyis ro gcig pas/ chu la chu bzhag pa'am/ mar la mar bzhag pa ltar dbyer med pa'am/ gzugs ci yang ma mthong ba la nam mkha' mthong bar bsnyad pa ltar ram/ snang ba med pa'i shes rab chen po yon tan rin po che thams cad kyi rten du gyur pa ste/ de ltar yang*/ ji ltar chu la chu bzhag dang*// mar la mar ni rjes zhugs ltar// shes bya spros bral de nyid dang*// dbyer med ye shes rnams 'dres pa// de ni sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// rang bzhin chos sku zhes byar brjod/ ces pa dang*/ nam mkha' mthong zhes sems can tshig tu rab brjod pa// nam mkha' ji ltar mthong zhes don 'dir brtag par gyis// de ltar chos mthong ba yang de bzhin gshegs pas bstan// mthong ba dpe gzhan gyis ni rnyed par nus ma yin// zhes gsungs so// ji snyed mkhyen pa'i ye shes kun rdzob tha snyad pa'i don rnam pa thams cad du mkhyen pa yin te/ rdo rje lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin la brten nas sgrib pa'i sa bon thams cad bcom pas shes rab chen por 'gyur/ de'i stobs kyis shes bya'i tshogs dus gsum gyis bsdus pa'i don mtha' dag skyu ru ra rlon pa lag mthil du bzhag pa ltar mkhyen cing gzigs pa yin no// mdo las kyang sangs rgyas kyis kun rdzob mkhyen par bzhed de/ ji skad du/ rma bya'i mdongs ni gcig pu yi// rgyu yi rnam pa tha dad pa// kun mkhyen min pa shes bya min// de mkhyen pa ni kun mkhyen stobs// zhes gsungs so// rgyud bla ma las/

thugs rje chen pos 'jig rten mkhyen// 'jig rten kun la gzigs nas ni// zhes gsungs so// ji ltar mkhyen cing gzigs na dngos 'dzin lta bu ma yin te/ sgyu ma lta bur mkhyen zhing gzigs pa ni/ de ltar yang*/ chos yang dag par sdud pa'i mdo las/ dper na sgyu ma mkhan po 'ga'// sgyu ma thar bar bya phyir brtson// gang phyir de ni mngon shes pas// sgyu ma la ni de mi chags// de bzhin srid gsum sgyu ma ltar// rdzogs pa'i byang chub mkhas pas mkhyen// zhes gsungs so// yab sras mjal ba'i mdo las/ sgyu ma mkhan pos sgyu sprul pa// sgyu ma lags par 'tshal bas na// de la rmongs par 'gyur ma lags// khyod kyis 'gro kun de bzhin gzigs// thams cad gzigs la phyag 'tshal bstod// ces gsungs so// de ltar na spangs pa phun sum tshogs pa'am/ ye shes phun sum tshogs pa de sangs rgyas kyi ngo bo'i rang bzhin no// rgyud bla ma las kyang*/ sangs rgyas nyid du dbyer med pa// dag pa'i chos kyi rab che ba// nyi mkha' bzhin te spong ba dang*// ye shes gnyis kyi mtshan nyid do// zhes dang*/ mdo sde rgyan las/ gang la nyon mongs shes bya'i sgrib pas sa bon dus ring rtag ldan pa// spong ba shin tu rgya chen rnam pa kun gyis rab tu bcom gyur cing*// gnas gyur chos dkar yon tan mchog ldan thob pa sangs rgyas nyid// ces gsungs so// sgra'i don bshad na/ ci'i phyir sangs rgyas zhes bya zhe na/ ma rig pa gnyid dang 'dra ba las sangs nas/ shes bya gnyis la blo rgyas pas na sangs rgyas zhes bya'o// de ltar yang*/ ma rig gnyid las sangs phyir dang*// blo rgyas gnyis phyir sangs rgyas yin// zhes gsungs so// de la ma rig pa'i gnyid las sangs zhes pa'i don ni// sngar bshad pa'i spang pa phun sum tshogs pa yin no// shes bya la blo rgyas zhes pa yang sngar bshad pa'i ye shes phun sum tshogs pa de nyid do// dbye ba bshad na/

sangs rgyas la dbye na sku rnam pa gsum ste/ chos kyi sku dang*/ longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku dang*/ sprul pa'i sku ste// de ltar yang*/ mdo sde gser 'od dam pa las/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la sku gsum mnga' ste/ chos kyi sku dang*/ longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku dang*/ sprul pa'i sku'o// zhes gsungs so// 'o na lung kha cig las/ sku gnyis su bshad pa dang*/ sku bzhir bshad pa'ang yod/ sku lngar bshad pa'ang yod snyam tsa na/ de ltar bshad kyang thams cad sku gsum po de rang du 'dus pa yin te/ mdo sde rgyan las/ sku gsum dag gis sangs rgyas kyi// sku bsdus par ni shes par bya// zhes gsungs so// sku gsum gyi rnam gzhag bshad na/ chos kyi sku ni sangs rgyas dngos yin te/ 'phags pa brgyad stong pa las/ de bzhin gshegs pa ni gzugs kyi skur mi blta ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa ni chos kyi sku'o// zhes dang*/ mdo ting 'dzin rgyal po las/ rgyal ba'i dbang po gzugs kyi skur mi blta// zhes gsungs so// gzugs sku gnyis ni chos kyi sku'i byin rlabs dang*/ gdul bya'i snang ba dang*/ sngon gyi smon lam las grub pa'i sku ste/ de gsum 'dzom pa las byung ba shes par bya'o// sku gsum du grangs nges pa'i rgyu mtshan ni/ dgos pa la ltos pa'i grangs te/ rang don du chos sku yin la/ gzhan don du gzugs sku rnam gnyis yin no/ de la chos skus rang don ci ltar byed na/ chos kyi sku de thob nas yon tan thams cad kyi gzhi rten yin pas/ stobs dang mi 'jigs pa la sogs yon tan thams cad bos pa bzhin du 'du bar 'gyur ba'i phyir ro// gzhan don gzugs sku rnam gnyis yod pas bzhag pa yin te/ dag pa'i gdul bya'i ngo la longs sku/ ma dag pa'i gdul bya'i ngo la sprul sku'o// des na sangs rgyas la sku rnam pa gsum du nges so// sku gsum so so'i mtshan nyid 'chad pa la/ chos kyi sku zhes pa de yang*/

chos kyi dbyings stong pa nyid kyi don rtogs pas nor ba thams cad zad pa'am 'khrul ngor snang ba'i rang bzhin log tsam zhig la/ chos kyi sku zhes brtags pa tsam yin gyi/ don gyi ngo bo la chos kyi sku dang chos kyi sku yi mtshan nyid dang*/ mtshan nyid kyi gzhir grub pa gang yang mi mnga' ba'i phyir ro// rang rig ma bcos pa gdod ma'i ye shes 'pho 'gyur bri gang med par khams gsum sems can kun gyi rgyud la ye khyab tu bzhugs pa de nyid nyams len gyi thabs gnad zab mos mngon du byas pa ste/ 'di las gzhan pa'i sangs rgyas chos sku zhes sngar med gsar byung ni ma yin no// ldog pa'i sgo nas bshad na chos kyi sku mtshan nyid brgyad ldan te/ mnyam pa dang*/ zab pa dang*/ rtag pa dang*/ gcig pa dang*/ yang dag pa dang*/ gtsang ba dang*/ 'od gsal ba dang*/ longs spyod rdzogs pa dang 'brel ba'o// de la mnyam pa ni/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi chos kyi sku la khyad par med pa'i phyir ro// zab pa ni/ spros pa thams cad dang bral bas rtogs par dka' ba'i phyir ro// rtag pa ni/ 'dus ma byas pa thog mtha' bar gsum du skye 'gags bral ba'i phyir ro// gcig pa ni/ dbyings dang ye shes tha mi dad pas dbyer med pa'i phyir ro// yang dag pa ni/ sgro skur gnyis kyi mtha' las 'das pas phyin ci ma log pa'i phyir ro// gtsang ba ni/ nyon mongs shes bya snyoms 'jug gi sgrib pa gsum gyi dri ma dang bral ba'i phyir ro// 'od gsal ba ni/ rtog pa med pa ste/ rnam par mi rtog pas mi rtog pa de nyid du mi dmigs pa'i phyir ro// chos kyi sku de'i mdangs gsal stong ye shes kyi rol pa de dang*/ gzhi'i chos sku de gnyis med zung 'jug tu gnas pa ste/ yon tan rgya chen po'i bdag nyid kyi longs spyod rdzogs pa'i rten du gyur pa'i phyir ro// de ltar yang rgyud bla ma las/ thog ma dbus mtha' med cing rnam dbyer med// gnyis med gsum bral dri med rnam rtog med// chos dbyings rang bzhin gang yin de rtogs pa// mnyam par bzhag pa'i rnal 'byor pa yis mthong*// zhes gsungs so// mdo sde rgyan las/

rang bzhin sku ni mnyam pa dang*// phra zhing longs spyod rdzogs 'brel dang*// zhes gsungs so// longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku yang mtshan nyid brgyad dang ldan te/ 'khor dang*/ zhing dang*/ sku dang*/ mtshan dang*/ chos dang*/ mdzad pa dang*/ lhun gyis grub pa dang*/ rang bzhin med pa'o// de la gang dang lhan cig tu spyod pa'i 'khor ni/ sa bcu la gnas pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sha stag go /gang du longs spyod pa'i zhing ni/ zhing khams yongs su dag pa'o// gang gis longs spyod pa'i sku ni/ dpal rnam par snang mdzad la sogs pa'o// gang dang ldan pa'i mtshan ni/ sku de mtshan bzang po sum cu rtsa gnyis dang dpe byad bzang po brgyad cu dang ldan pa'o// gang la rdzogs par longs spyod rtogs pa'i chos ni/ theg pa chen po 'ba' zhig go /gang mdzad pa'i phrin las ni/ rgyal sras lung ston pa la sogs mdzad pa'o// lhun gyis grub pa ni/ mdzad pa la sogs pa de dag thams cad la 'bad pa dang bral te nor bu'i rgyal po ltar lhun grub tu 'byung ba'o// rang bzhin med pa ni/ sku la sogs pa sna tshogs su snang yang shel gyi kha dog ltar sna tshogs kyi rang bzhin dang bral ba'o// de ltar yang*/ mdo sde rgyan las/ longs spyod rdzogs pa khams kun tu// 'khor yang sdud dang zhing dang mtshan// sku dang chos rdzogs longs spyod dang*/ mdzad pa dag gi tha dad do// zhes gsungs so// mngon rtogs rgyan las/ mtshan ni sum cu rtsa gnyis dang*// dpe byad brgyad cu'i bdag nyid ni// theg chen nye bar longs spyod phyir// thub pa'i longs spyod rdzogs skur bzhengs// zhes gsungs so// sprul pa'i sku yang mtshan nyid brgyad dang ldan te/ rten dang*/ rgyu dang*/ zhing dang*/ dus dang*/ rang bzhin dang*/ 'jug par byed pa dang*/ smin par byed pa dang*/ grol bar byed pa'o// de la rten ni chos kyi sku ste g.yo ba med bzhin du'o// rgyu ni/ 'gro ba mtha' dag la phan par bzhed pa'i snying rje chen po las byung ba'o// zhing ni/

yongs su dag pa'i zhing dang*/ yongs su ma dag pa'i zhing ngo*// dus ni/ 'jig rten ji srid gnas kyi bar du rgyun mi chad pa'o// rang bzhin ni/ sprul pa gsum gyi gzugs can gyis te/ bzo sprul pi wang len pa la sogs pa bzo sna tshogs dpe med pa mkhas shing sbyor ba dang*/ skye ba sprul pa ri bong la sogs dman pa sna tshogs kyang len pa dang*/ mchog gi sprul pa ni/ dga' ldan nas gshegs pa dang*/ lhums su zhugs pa nas zhi ba chen por gshegs pa'i bar ston pa'o// de ltar yang*/ mdo sde rgyan las/ bzo dang skye dang byang chub sems// mya ngan 'das pa rtag ston pas// sangs rgyas sprul pa'i sku 'di ni// rnam par grol ba'i thabs chen no// zhes dang/ rgyud bla ma las kyang*/ sprul pa'i rang bzhin sna tshogs kyis// skye ba mngon par skye ba dang*// dga' ldan gnas nas 'pho ba dang*// lhums su 'jug dang bltams pa dang*/ bzo yi gnas la mkhas pa dang*// btsun mo'i 'khor la dgyes rol dang*// nges 'byung dka' ba spyad pa dang*// byang chub snying por gshegs pa dang*// bdud sde 'joms dang rdzogs par ni// byang chub chos kyi 'khor lo dang*// mya ngan 'da' bar gshegs mdzad dang*// yongs su ma dag zhing rnams su// srid pa ji srid gnas par ston// zhes gsungs so// 'jug par byed pa ni/ 'jig rten tha mal pa dag ci rigs par mya ngan las 'das pa rnam pa gsum la 'dun zhing 'jug par byed pa'o/ smin par byed pa ni/ lam la zhugs pa rnams tshogs yongs su smin par byed pa'o// grol bar byed pa ni/ de ltar brgyad po de sprul pa'i sku yi mtshan nyid de// mngon rtogs rgyan las/ gang gis srid pa ji srid par// 'gro la phan pa sna tshogs pa// mnyam du mdzad pa'i sku de ni// thub pa'i sprul sku rgyun mi chad// ces gsungs so// khyad par ni gsum ste/ mnyam pa'i khyad par dang*/ rtag pa'i khyad par dang*/

snang ba'i khyad par ro// de la dang po mnyam pa'i khyad par ni/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi chos kyi sku ni/ rten chos kyi dbyings tha dad med pas mnyam pa'o// sangs rgyas thams cad kyi longs sku ni/ sangs rgyas thams cad dang 'gro don la dgongs pa mnyam pas mnyam pa'o// sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sprul pa'i sku ni phrin las thun mong du gyur pas mnyam pa'o// de ltar yang*/ mdo sde rgyan las/ de dag rten dang dgongs pa dang*/ phrin las kyis ni mnyam pa nyid// ces gsungs so// rtag pa'i khyad par ni/ chos kyi sku don dam par skye 'gags dang bral ba'i bdag nyid yin pas/ rang bzhin gyis rtag pa'o// longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku ni/ chos kyi longs spyod rgyun chad pa med pa'i rgyun gyis rtag pa'o// sprul pa'i sku ni mi snang bar gyur nas kyang yang nas yang du ston pa ste/ rigs mthun rgyun chad kyang 'tshams pa'i dus las mi yol ba yang byung ba'i phyir bya ba byed pa rtag pa'o// de ltar yang*/ mngon rtogs rgyan las/ rang bzhin dang ni rgyun mi chad// rgyun gyis de nyid rtag pa nyid// ces gsungs so// snang ba'i khyad par ni/ chos kyi dbyings la shes bya'i sgrib pa dag pas ni chos sku snang ngo*// nyon mongs pa'i sgrib pa dag pas ni longs sku snang ngo*// las kyi sgrib pa dag pas ni sprul sku snang ngo*// sku gsum po de dag la zung 'jug yan lag bdun gyi yon tan mnga' ba ste/ bdun gang zhe na/ 'og min gyi gnas su sems dpa' chen po rnams la zab rgyas gsang sngags kyi chos 'khor la rtag par rgyun du longs spyod kyi yan lag dang gcig /mtshan dpe rdzogs pa'i ye shes kyi sku de nyid rang 'od kyi yum dang sbyor bas kha sbyor gyi yan lag dang gnyis/ zag med kyi bde ba chen po rgyun chad med phyir bde ba chen po'i yan lag dang gsum ka longs sku'i khyad chos yin pa dang gsum/

dmigs med kyi thugs rjes mkha' ltar khyab pa ni snying rjes yongs su gang ba'i yan lag dang bzhi/ phrin las rgya chen po 'khor ba'i mtha' mnyam rtog med lhun grub tu 'byung ba'i rgyun mi chad pa'i yan lag dang lnga/ myang 'das zhi ba'i mtha' la mi gnas pa ni 'gog pa med pa'i yan lag ste drug /'di dag ni sprul sku'i khyad chos yin pa dang*/ stong nyid snying rje zung 'jug spros pa thams cad dang bral ba'i rang bzhin med pa'i yan lag ni chos sku'i khyad chos su 'dren pa dang bdun/ de ltar sku gsum yan lag bdun ldan dang*/ yang dbang phyug gi yon tan brgyad dang ldan pa yang 'dren te/ de yang sku gang la gang 'dul rnam pa thams cad dang ldan pa ni sku yi dbang phyug dang gcig /gang 'dul chos 'khor rgyun mi chad pa ni gsung gi dbang phyug dang gnyis/ rtog med thugs rje mnga' ba ni thugs kyi dbang phyug dang gsum/ rdzu 'phrul thogs pa med pa ni rdzu 'phrul gyi dbang phyug dang bzhi/ 'khor 'das dus gsum mnyam nyid ro gcig par mngon par byang chub pa ni kun 'gro'i dbang phyug dang lnga/ ri rab so gnyis kyi rdul dang mnyam pa'i lha mos 'dod yon gyis mchod kyang 'dod pas gos pa med pa ni 'dod pa'i dbang phyug dang drug /yid bzhin nor bu ltar 'gro ba'i re 'dod yid bzhin du skong bas ci 'dod bskyed pa'i dbang phyug dang bdun/ 'og min chos dbyings pho brang na khams gsum chos kyi rgyal por rtag tu bzhugs pa ni gnas kyi dbang phyug ste/ de ltar dbang phyug brgyad ldan du 'dren pa 'di dag ni longs sku'i yon tan gyi rnam grangs yin la/ sprul pa'i sku ni/ chos longs gnyis kyi rnam par 'phrul pa bsam yas gdul bya 'gro ba'i chu snod ji snyed dang 'tshams pa'i gdul bya der sprul pa'i zla snang de snyed du 'byung phyir bzo dang skye dang byang chub chen po la sogs gang la gang 'dul gyi sprul bkod rab 'byams mtha' yas par mdzad pa ni sangs rgyas rnams kyi sku gsung thugs kyi gsang ba mi zad pa rgyan gyi 'khor lo zhes bya zhing*/

de yang sku mi zad pa rgyan gyi 'khor lo/ gsung mi zad pa rgyan gyi 'khor lo/ thugs mi zad pa rgyan gyi 'khor lo'o// de'i dang po la gnyis las/ sku'i gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa ni/ sangs rgyas kyi sku yi tshad gzhan sus kyang bzung bar mi nus te/ dkon mchog brtsegs pa las/ byang chub sems dpa' shugs 'chang gis bcom ldan 'das kyi dbu yi gtsug tor gyi mtha' rtogs par 'dod nas/ ri rab kyi steng dang*/ sum cu rtsa gsum dang*/ tshangs pa'i 'jig rten dang*/ de bzhin du steng phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams bye ba phrag brgya 'das pa na/ 'jig rten gyi khams pad+ma can zhes bya ba na/ de bzhin gshegs pa pad+mo'i dpal gyi snying po'i rgyal po bzhugs pa'i sa rnams la rim gyis phyin te bltas kyang dbu'i gtsug tor gyi mtha' ma mthong ba lta bu'o// sku thams cad pa ni/ sprul pa mchog nas bzung ste snang srid shes bya'i khams la srid tshad kyi sku yi bkod pa gdul bya gang la sku gang gis 'dul ba de la de dang rjes su 'tshams pa'i skur bstan nas don mdzad pa'o// gsung la yang gnyis las/ gsung gi gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa ni/ sangs rgyas kyi gsung de drung nas nyan kyang che ba med la/ dpag tshad dang rgyang grags la sogs pa nas nyan kyang chung ba med pa ste/ de yang maung gal gyi bus/ nub phyogs bde ba can dang*/ de nas kyang 'jig rten gyi khams bye ba phrag brgya 'das pa na/ 'od zer can gyi 'jig rten gyi khams zhes bya ba na/ de bzhin gshegs pa 'od zer kun nas 'byung ba 'khor dang bcas pa bzhugs pa'i gnas su byon te nyan pas kyang chung du med pa thos pa lta bu'o// gsung thams cad pa ni/ dag pa lha'i skad nas bzung ste/ klu dang gnod sbyin dang*/ srin po la sogs pa 'gro ba so so'i skad du chos ston nus pa'o// thugs la'ang gnyis las/ thugs kyi gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa ni/ sangs rgyas kyi thugs kyis shes bya mkhyen pa bzhin gzhan sus kyang mi mkhyen te/

maung gal gyi bu 'phags pa dgra bcom pa rdzu 'phrul dang ldan pas kyang rang gi ma gang du skyes pa ma mkhyen pa/ bcom ldan 'das kyis mkhyen pa lta bu dang*/ dgra bcom pa gzhan sus kyang*/ khyim bdag dpal skyes la thar pa'i sa bon yod pa ma mkhyen nas/ rab tu byung ma nus pa la bcom ldan 'das kyis dpal skyes skye ba bdun gyi gong rol na khyir skyes pa na phag gis bdas nas mchod rten zhig la bskor ba byas pas dge ba'i sa bon yod pa mkhyen pa dang*// rab tu 'byung bar gnang ba lta bu'o// thugs thams cad pa ni/ ji lta ba dang ji snyed pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes mnga' ba ste/ de yang ji lta ba ni dngos po'i gnas lugs ma bcos pa mkhyen zhing mngon du gyur pa yin la/ ji snyed pa mkhyen pa ni// shes bya'i chos thams cad la mi mkhyen pa'am ma gzigs pa'i dri ma dang bral zhing rgyu dang 'bras bu'i rten 'brel ma lus pa thugs su chud pas gang yang ma 'dres par mkhyen pa'o// de lta bu 'grub pa'i rgyu ni/ da lta lam gyi skabs su don dam stong pa nyid phyag rgya chen po la nyams len gnad du bsnun pas 'bras bu chos kyi sku 'grub cing*/ de'i yan lag gam thabs kyi char sems bskyed smon lam sogs rnam par dag pa bgyis pas sprul pa'i sku dang*/ bskyed rim zab mo bsgom pa'i rgyu 'bras las longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku ste/ nyam len de dag so so ya bral res 'jog lta bur ma yin par thabs shes zung 'jug 'khor gsum yongs dag chen por 'bad pa'i mthu 'bras kyis sku gsum 'du 'bral med pa'i ngo bo gtan srid zin par 'gyur ba'o/ de bas na sngar bshad pa'i sku gsum po dang*/ de'ang sku bzhi'am lnga sogs kyi dbye ba du ma rnams kyang ngo bo gcig las yon tan nam byed las lta bu'i sgo nas ming so sor btags pa ste/ mdor bsdu na da lta sems nyid gshis mdangs rtsal gsum la/

de tshe sku gsum du brjod pa nyid las gzhan ma yin no// skabs 'di na rgyu'i theg pa dang*/ sngags 'og ma'i rgyud sde dag tu de dang de'i skabs don gzhan la dgongs pa dang*/ ldem por dgongs pa phyogs re'i mdzad stangs kyis bstan bcos dang*/ bzhed srol sna tshogs te/ de yang chos kyi sku la zhal phyag tu grub ma grub/ de'i zhing khams dngos bstan du yod med dang*/ sangs rgyas la rang rgyud bsdus pa'i ye shes yod med dang*/ gzugs sku gnyis po la rang snang gi tshor ba yod med sogs kyi rtsod gzhi dang dgag sgrub du mas zin cing so sor rtog pa byed par snang mod kyi/ de thams cad rang rang gi skabs de dang der ni de nyid bden pa yin mod kyang*/ theg pa'i bcud kyi snying po 'di dag gi skabs su ni 'og ma'i lta grub la ltos mi 'tshal zhing*/ thams cad dang mthun pa thams cad las khyad par du gyur pa zhes pa'i dgongs pa ste/ de lta bu'i dgongs pa gang la zer na/ 'khor 'das snang srid kyis bsdus pa'i chos so cog thams cad la/ bden mi bden yod med/ yin min skye 'gags 'gro 'ong rtag chad la sogs pa gang yang mi zhen mi 'dzin/ mi dgag mi sgrub ste/ gang med par smra na chad pa'i mthar lhung zhing*/ yod par 'dzin na ni rtag pa'i mtha' dang*/ yod med gnyis ka ma yin no snyam du sems na'ang blos byas kyi rang bzhin las ma 'das pa'i phyir ro// gzhan snang gi ngor ni yod na yod du chug ste/ 'gag med kyi 'char sgo la zad mtha' med cing rgyu 'bras rten 'brel la bslu ba med pa'i phyir dang*/ gang zhig med pa rnams kyi ngor ni med du chug ste/ gshis ngor gang du'ang grub pa med pas rang bzhin stong pa nyid las ma g.yos pa'i phyir dang*/ yod med gnyis ka ma yin par yang chug ste mtha' gang du'ang ma lhung zhing phyogs dang ris su ma chad pa'i phyir ro// de bas na phyi rol gyi snod bcud du snang ba'i dngos po thams cad ni ma dag sems can rnams kyi bag chags las snang 'khrul ngor ni 'byung lnga gdos bcas a 'thas kyi tshul dang*/

lam pa'i rnal 'byor rnams kyi ngor ni rang sems 'gag med kyi tshul dang*/ sangs rgyas byang sems la ni ye shes rang gsal gyi zhing snang ste/ don dam par na thams cad sems nyid kyi cho rol kho na nyid dang*/ de bzhin du nang gi sems dang sems byung gi rtog tshogs rnams kyang ma dag 'khrul pa'i skye 'gro rnams la ni las nyon bag chags kyi rang bzhin/ lam pa'i rnal 'byor rnams la lta sgom nyams rtogs kyi bye brag /bde gshegs sku gsum gyi sangs rgyas rnams la ni mkhyen brtse ye shes kyi rol pa ste/ des na rgyu'am gzhi'i gnas lugs la ni khyad par rdul tsam ma mchis na'ang*/ glo bur kun btags kyi sgrib pas cher 'thum pa dang*/ cung zad 'thum pa dang*/ sgrib pa bral ba dang bcas pa'i khyad par du gyur phyir// gzhi lam 'bras gsum ka'i ngo bo sku gnyis zung 'jug gam/ sku gsum dbyer med nyid las ma 'das/ mi 'da' 'da' bar mi 'gyur ba'i don gyi snying po rang sems ma bcos phyag rgya chen po'i ngang du glod pa kho na gnad du che'o// 'dus ma byas pa'i chos la 'dus byas blo yis sgro btags skur 'debs byas te/ tshig gi mtha' la zhen cing phyogs re'i grub mtha'i kha bzung nas rtsod pa byed pa rnams ni/ byis pa'i skye bo dag gis nam mkha'i mtha' rgya rtsod pa dang mtshungs phyir/ de bas na bzo med lhug pa'i klong du khyab brdal mnyam nyid chen por zhog mdzod dang*/ rnal 'byor bzhi dang sa bcu lam lnga sku gsum lhun grub kyi 'bras bu dang bcas pa'i dbyings su bgrod bya bgrod byed kyi mtshan ma las 'das pa'i ngang du grol bar gdon mi za ba nyid do// de ltar sngon dngos rjes kyi rim pa de thams cad thos lo dang*/ dpe cha'i steng du ma lus par brtson 'grus drag pos skad cig kyang g.yel ba med par nyams su blangs pas/ 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad kyi bdag por rang nyid 'gro bas rang nyid kyi don 'grub pa ste/

de yang sgrib pa sbyang zhing yon tan gong nas gong du spel bas rdzogs pa'i byang chub chen po yongs su thob par byas nas/ gzhan don nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can gyi khams rnams thar pa byang chub kyi go 'phang rin po cher 'god par bya'o// de ltar rnams kyi chos rnams kun gyi mchog las mchog tu gyur pa'am/ snying po'i yang snying nges don phyag rgya chen po'i khrid kyi rim pa legs par rdzogs te// de yang mang du bshad kyang je mang las ma mchis pas don hril gyis dril na/ rang re rnams da res gcig pu tsam dal 'byor gyi mi lus thob pa dang*/ 'di yang yun ring por mi rtag nam 'chi nges med la 'chi ba de'i tshe ring la phan thogs pa ni dam pa'i chos dang*/ dus der 'jigs pa dang sdug bsngal las skyob nus pa/ bla ma dang dkon mchog dam pa'i chos las gzhan med pa ste/ de la rang re phyi ma dang tshe rabs thams cad du ngan song gsum sogs 'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi rang bzhin du tshud na shin tu nas kyang nyam nyes sdug bsngal zhing*/ 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal de yang da res kyi rang re'i lus 'di thog mi tshe yud tsam skad cig tsam 'di thog nas spong bar ma nus na phyis 'khor ba nas thar thabs gang yang med pas/ dus da res blo mi nor bsam pa mi brlag par/ rang gi tshe rabs gtan gyi don chen dam pa'i chos rang la gtan du phan pa de nyid da lam ci nas kyang bsgrub dgos/ de yang lus 'di thog nas med na gtan med// lus 'di thog nas yod na gtan yod/ yod med dang sdug bsngal bde ba'i gdams ka da res byar yod pa la gdams ka mi nor ba'i rang tshe rabs thams cad dang*/ dus gtan gyi don chen rnam dkar dam pa'i chos la blo phyogs pas spyir sdig pa spang dge ba bsgrub rgyu 'bras kyi 'dor len la gzab pa/ sgos su don med rmi lam lta bu'i tshe 'dir nges 'byung skyo shas kyis chos kyang tshig dang gzugs tsam ma yin pa'i rang rang gi sdom pa dang dam tshig rnam par dag pa bsrung ba dang*/

yang sgos sems kyi rtsa ba ma chod na gzhan cis kyang mi phan pas 'khor ba dang mya ngan las 'das pa thams cad kyi rtsa ba'am gzhi ma rang gi sems 'di nyid yengs med dran pa'i lam gyis 'dul bas rang rig ka dag chos sku'i ngo bo mngon du gyur par byas nas/ de yang mos gus/ dag snang*/ snying rje/ smon lam sogs la rtsal sbyangs nas gzhan don gzugs sku'i rten 'brel phyogs med gong du bsgrigs pas sku gnyis sam/ sku gsum 'bras bu myur du rdzogs pa'i gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i rol pas mkha' mnyam 'gro ba'i don byed pa ste/ rang gzhan gyi don thams cad yongs su bsgrub cing 'grub pa zhig dgos pa de ltar blo la nges pa'i lag len gdams ngag go yul tsam gyis sa lam mi chod pas sems thog rdo rus thug pa zhig dgos pa de ltar dang*/ sems kyi dri ma sbyong ba la chos gdams ngag zab mo rgyun chad med par nyams su lon pa zhig dgos pa dang*/ gdams ngag tshig la ma zhen par nyams myong rgyud la skyes pa zhig dgos pa dang*/ kha phyir bltas kyis bsam pas g.yeng ba thams cad bdud kyi las yin pas de ltar mi byed pa'i sems gshis thog tu mnyam par 'jog pa zhig dgos pa dang*/ lam gyi 'khrul pa sel lam mi sel bla ma'i byin rlabs la rag las pas/ bla mar mos gus gsol 'debs gsha' ma la brtson pa zhig dgos pa dang*/ 'khor ba dang mya ngan las 'das pa thams cad kyi rtsa ba'am gzhi ma rang sems 'di nyid kyi rtsa ba ma chod na gzhan ji ltar byas kyang 'khor ba gtan mi spong bas sems kyi rtsa ba chod pa zhig dgos pa dang*/ dus rnams kun tu sems dran shes dang ma bral ba zhig med na lam mi chod/ bag chags nad ro ldang bas ma yengs dran pa'i rkang tshugs pa zhig dgos pa dang*/ nyams len gyi gnad 'gags ma shes na lam du mi 'gro bas gnad go bas gnad du bsnun pa zhig dgos pa ste/ de yang mdo rgyud thams cad kyi snying po nges don yin pas nges don ngo sprod sems la thebs pa zhig dgos pa dang*/

phyag rgya chen po gnyug ma'i ye shes rang sems rang yin pas sgro 'dogs nang nas chod pas rang rig ka dag chos sku mngon du gyur pa zhig dgos pa dang*/ gang shar gyi gnyen po dran pa sogs gnyis su med pa'i spang gnyen gnyis med du 'dres pa zhig dgos pa dang*/ gnas lugs rang babs la ched du bsgom rgyu med pas blo 'das kyi rtogs pa skyong ba zhig dgos pa dang*/ cir snang chos sku'i rol pa yin pas gang shar la rtsis gdab med pa zhig dgos pa dang*/ sems nyid gshis kyi rang 'od la 'gags pa med par shes nas rgya yan lhug par 'jog pa zhig dgos pa dang*/ mtho dman gyi snang bar rtsis gdab med par gang shar sgom du 'char ba zhig dgos pa dang*/ chos nyid rtsal la bzang ngan med par shes pa'i gang byung lam du slong ba zhig dgos pa dang*/ skye med kyi gdangs la sna tshogs su 'char ba cir snang rgyan du khyer ba zhig dgos pa dang*/ lhan skyes kyi ye shes la rgyun chad med pa 'byung ba'i dran pa yug gcig tu 'gro ba zhig dgos pa dang*/ snang grags kyi chos thams cad sems kyi rang gzugs yin pa de ltar nyams len gyi rtsal 'byongs pa zhig dgos pa dang*/ mthar thug 'khor 'das gnyis su med pa ste gnyis 'dzin gyi mdud pa grol ba zhig dgos pa dang*/ chags sdang gi rtsa ba sems la thug pa ste gzung 'dzin gyi dri ma zad pa zhig dgos pa dang*/ 'bras bu chos nyid bral thob med pa zhig yin par de ltar shes pa zhig dgos pa dang*/ dgos dgu thams cad rang la tshang bas gdengs tshad sems la 'cha' ba zhig dgos pa dang*/ 'bras bu snying rje sems bskyed smon lam sogs la rtsal sbyong bas gzhan don gzugs sku'i rten 'brel phyogs med du bsgrigs pas sku gnyis sam sku gsum 'bras bu myur du rdzogs pa'i gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i rol pas mkha' mnyam 'gro ba'i don byed pa ste/ rang dang gzhan gyi don thams cad yongs su sgrub cing 'grub pa zhig dgos pa de ltar thams cad kyi blo la nges pas lag len du 'debs pa gal che ba yin te don gyi snying po de tsam mo/// /zhes pa'ang karma bstan 'phel gyi skyes mtha' khams pa ngag dbang kun dga' bstan 'dzin dge legs dpal bzang pos sbyar ba dge'o//
